title: Attributing Agentic Failure in Reasoning Vision-Language Models with Interactive 2D Environments
summary: Agentic benchmarks report a success rate that confounds distinct causes of failure: misreading the environment, never working out how components of the environment operates, operating the components in the wrong order, and failing to recover from a mistake, each of which calls for a different fix. We present an early preview of MultiNet v2.0-Gridworld - an interactive maze environment built for attribution rather than ranking. Four different types of mechanisms, namely key-door pairs, switch-gate pairs, distractors and decoys, and ordered combinations of these mechanisms, can be added, modified, or removed independently while the renderer, the action space, and the scoring function stay fixed. A breadth-first search over the joint state of position, facing direction, inventory, and mechanism state gives every instance an exact optimal action count, which sets its difficulty and grades unfinished episodes. We fix the evaluation protocol on 15 held-out mazes over 540 episodes, then evaluate three vision-language models on 50 mazes. They solve 6 of 150 episodes, 45 of the 50 mazes were not solved by any model, and no episode containing a switch-gate mechanism was solved.

AI.tldr: 提出用于"归因"而非"排名"的交互式迷宫环境 MultiNet v2.0-Gridworld，通过可独立增删的四类机制（钥匙-门、开关-闸门、干扰物与诱饵、有序组合）隔离不同失败原因，并用联合状态空间上的 BFS 给出精确最优动作数作为难度与评分标准。在 540 回合固定协议下，三个视觉语言模型仅解决 150 个回合中的 6 个，50 个迷宫中 45 个无任何模型解出，含开关-闸门机制的回合全部失败。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准仅报告单一成功率，混淆了多种本质不同的失败原因：误读环境、未弄清组件运作方式、操作顺序错误、错误后无法恢复，而上述每种失败对应完全不同的改进方案。因此需要一个能对失败原因做归因、而非仅做模型排名的评测环境。
AI.method: 构建可交互迷宫环境，支持四类机制（钥匙-门对、开关-闸门对、干扰物与诱饵、机制的有序组合）独立增删，同时保持渲染器、动作空间与评分函数不变，从而实现变量受控的消融式评测。对位置、朝向、库存物品与机制状态构成的联合状态空间执行广度优先搜索，得到每个实例的精确最优动作数，用于设定难度并对未完成回合进行评分。评测协议固定为 15 个留出迷宫、共 540 回合。
AI.result: 在该协议下评测三个视觉语言模型（另在 50 个迷宫上评测）：150 个回合中仅解出 6 个；50 个迷宫中有 45 个未被任何模型解出；所有包含开关-闸门机制的回合均无成功案例。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉语言模型在需要理解机制运作方式与有序依赖关系的组合任务上几乎完全失效，尤其难以处理开关-闸门类机制；基准的成功率指标掩盖了这种结构性缺陷。该工作作为早期预览，将评测从排名转向失败原因归因。

title: Quantum Machine Learning for Signature Forgery Detection
comment: Accepted and presented at 2026 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Information, Communication and Systems (SPICSCON) for Publication IEEE Xplore
summary: Offline handwritten signatures remain a primary behavioural biometric in legal and financial documents. Detecting skilled forgeries from a static raster image is hard because pen pressure, timing and stroke order are missing. This work studies a family of quantum machine learning pipelines for offline signature forgery detection on a public Kaggle corpus of images split into two classes. We pair a ZZ feature map quantum kernel with three classical learners: K-Nearest Neighbours, Support Vector Machine and Random Forest. We then propose a deeper hybrid that uses EfficientNetB0 as a frozen feature extractor, reduces the resulting 1280 dimensional representation to a qubit register sized subspace through a quantum compatible principal component projection and decides class membership with a nearest neighbour rule. On a single held out test fold the proposed hybrid reaches 92.62 percent accuracy. On stratified five fold cross validation the same pipeline yields a mean accuracy of 91.26 percent with a standard deviation of 1.13 percent. The pipeline keeps a quantum embedding step that is portable to NISQ hardware. We report a controlled ablation across six quantum variants, confusion matrices, a t SNE projection and per class precision, recall and F1 score.

AI.tldr: 该文研究离线手写签名伪造检测，提出将经典特征提取（EfficientNetB0）与量子特征映射/PCA投影及最近邻判决结合的混合量子机器学习流水线，并系统对比六种量子变体。
AI.motivation: 离线手写签名是法律与金融文档中的主要行为生物特征，但静态栅格图像缺失笔压、时序与笔画顺序信息，导致熟练伪造检测困难，作者由此探索量子机器学习流水线在该任务上的可行性。
AI.method: 使用Kaggle公开二类图像数据集。基线为ZZ特征映射量子核配合三种经典学习器（KNN、SVM、随机森林）；进一步提出更深的混合方案：以EfficientNetB0为冻结特征提取器，将1280维表示经量子兼容的主成分投影降至量子比特寄存器维度子空间，再用最近邻规则判别。并做六种量子变体的受控消融。
AI.result: 单次留出测试折上混合方案达92.62%准确率；分层五折交叉验证平均准确率91.26%，标准差1.13%。另报告混淆矩阵、t-SNE投影及各分类别精确率、召回率、F1值。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线保留了可迁移至NISQ硬件的量子嵌入步骤，在离线签名熟练伪造检测上取得约92%的准确率，验证了经典-量子混合范式的有效性。

title: Code availability is not enough: schemas for documenting and extending data analysis
summary: A data analysis involves a sequence of decisions, from data cleaning to model specification, each of which can affect the reported result. Reproducing that result is not the same as understanding the sequence of decisions that produced it and the reasons for each: the code mixes those decisions with implementation details, while the manuscript states the major decisions and their rationale but scatters them across its sections and often leaves out the minor ones. A reader may then ask how the result would change under a different decision: the question itself is easy to pose, but implementing it is often non-trivial in practice. In this work, we propose a schema that represents a data analysis as a collection of decisions in natural language, from which large language models (LLMs) can generate and validate analysis scripts directly. This workflow can also expand a single analysis into a full multiverse of alternatives, specified in an alternative file, ready for comparison. We demonstrate the proposed workflow in two applications. In the first, we construct a schema for a published regression analysis of heaped smoking data and show that it reproduces the reported estimates, and that a reviewer-suggested alternative can be specified through the alternative file and turned into code automatically. In the second, where no schema is provided, we show how the workflow serves instead as a reproducibility check, applied to the many-analysts football study. As an intermediate representation between the manuscript and code scripts, our schema gives a self-contained account of an analysis and makes it extensible from a reader's perspective.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种以自然语言"决策集合"表示数据分析的schema，使LLM可直接据其生成与验证分析脚本，并可将单一分析扩展为多宇宙（multiverse）备选方案；在两个应用中分别验证了复现与原样复现检查的可行性。
AI.motivation: 复现结果不等于理解决策链条：代码把分析决策与实现细节混杂，论文虽陈述主要决策及理由但散落各处且遗漏次要决策；读者提出"若换一种决策结果会怎样"虽易，实操却很困难。
AI.method: 构建一种schema，将数据分析表示为自然语言的决策集合，作为手稿与代码之间的中间表示；LLM据此直接生成并验证分析脚本，并可通过单独的alternative文件把单一分析扩展为完整的多宇宙备选集合以供比较。
AI.result: 应用一：为已发表的对"堆积（heaped）吸烟数据"的回归分析构建schema，成功复现报告估计值，并将审稿人建议的替代方案通过alternative文件自动转成代码。应用二：在无schema的多分析师足球研究中，将该工作流用作可复现性检查。
AI.conclusion: 作为手稿与代码之间的中间表示，该schema提供了自包含的分析描述，并从读者视角使分析可扩展。

title: Temporal Exposure to Byzantine Vulnerability Under Intermittent Participation in Federated Learning
summary: In this paper, we study the effect of participation variability on per-round Byzantine vulnerability. We formalise Dynamic Participation Exposure (DPE), a phenomenon in which the global Byzantine fraction remains below an aggregation rule's tolerance threshold, while a participating client set violates, or approaches violation of, the assumptions required for robust aggregation. Under stochastic participation, we derive the probability of per round exposure and analyse how active-set size affects the variability of the observed Byzantine fraction. We further examine the accumulation of exposure over multiple rounds and consider adversaries that selectively participate during favourable rounds. Our analysis shows that intermittent participation does not automatically imply aggregation failure. Rather, it transforms Byzantine robustness from a static population-level property into a stochastic and temporal property. To mitigate this risk, we outline actionable design recommendations based on minimum active-set constraints, temporal monitoring, participation history, and adaptive aggregation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"动态参与暴露"（DPE）概念，揭示全局拜占庭比例低于聚合规则容忍阈值时，单轮参与者集合仍可能违约的随机性风险。
AI.motivation: 现有拜占庭鲁棒聚合分析以静态总体拜占庭比例为假设基础，忽视参与者的间歇性与波动性可能导致单轮活跃集合不满足鲁棒聚合前提的问题。
AI.method: 形式化DPE现象；在随机参与模型下推导单轮暴露概率，分析活跃集规模对观测拜占庭比例变异性的影响；考察多轮暴露累积及选择性参与的对抗策略。
AI.result: 间歇性参与并不必然导致聚合失败，但使拜占庭鲁棒性由静态总体属性转变为随机且时序性的属性；活跃集越小，单轮拜占庭比例波动越大、暴露风险越高，且暴露可跨轮累积。
AI.conclusion: 应通过最小活跃集约束、时序监测、参与历史与自适应聚合等设计手段缓解DPE风险。

title: Effect-Driven Skill Abstractions for Offline Reinforcement Learning
comment: The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems, NeurIPS 2026
summary: We seek to learn discrete skill abstractions to facilitate long-horizon, goal-conditioned reinforcement-learning (RL) tasks. Recent approaches have shown success by quantizing actions via clustering or reconstruction. However, these objectives lead to skills that are not directly related to what the current state affords or what the goal requires. Instead, we argue that goal-directed skills should be driven by \emph{how they affect the state} of the agent. To realize this, we introduce a novel quantization method for action chunks that optimizes next-state predictions conditioned on the current state and action. This objective encourages skills to be distinguished by the future states they lead to, resulting in a vocabulary that spans diverse outcomes reachable from a given state. Our framework can easily be paired with common offline RL methods by replacing their continuous actor head with a discrete one that selects among the learned skills. We can execute these skills in the environment by converting them back to continuous actions using a trained low-level controller. Experiments on benchmark navigation and manipulation tasks largely show substantial and consistent improvements over both the continuous-actor baselines and reconstruction-based discretizations. Our project page can be found at: https://burcukilic.github.io/projects/effect-driven-skill-abstractions/.

AI.tldr: 提出一种“状态效应驱动”的动作块量化方法：以当前状态与动作下的下一状态预测为量化目标，使离散技能按所导致的未来状态区分，从而构建覆盖多可达结果离散技能词汇表；并与离线RL结合时将连续actor头替换为离散选择头，经低层控制器执行。
AI.motivation: 现有技能离散化多依赖聚类或重构目标，所得技能与“当前状态可提供什么”及“目标需要什么”缺乏直接关联，不利于长时程目标条件RL。
AI.method: 1) 对动作块进行量化时，优化以当前状态和动作为条件的下一状态预测目标，使技能按其对状态的影响被区分；2) 将所得技能作为离散动作词汇表，替代常见离线RL方法的连续actor头为离散选择头；3) 通过训练好的低层控制器将选定技能还原为连续动作以在环境中执行。
AI.result: 在导航与操作基准任务上，相较连续actor基线与基于重构的离散化方法，取得较大且一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 以状态效应为核心的量化目标能产生更具目标导向性和多样性的技能抽象，且可即插即用地增强现有离线RL方法，在长时程目标条件任务中表现更优。

title: Context Scaling: A New Frontier of AI Scaling
comment: Author-revised preprint; journal version published in AI Plus; 20 pages, 3 figures, and 3 tables; position paper and narrative survey
summary: Many failures of deployed AI arise not from weak inference but from a mismatch between the state a task depends on and the context available when the system acts. Relevant user state, repository revisions, tool traces, sensor readings, or environment changes may be unavailable, distorted, or poorly selected. We call the effort to reduce this bottleneck context scaling. We frame a model as $P_θ(d\mid c)$ within a system governed by three budgets: training $B_θ$, decision-time $B_d$, and context-infrastructure $B_c$. Pretraining scaling invests in $θ$; decision-time scaling searches, refines, or verifies decisions under supplied context; context scaling improves the system's capacity to acquire, represent, deliver, evaluate, and persist deployment state for model use. The three programs interact, but only $B_c$ targets what the system can make available before a decision. This view makes the model-infrastructure pair the unit of analysis. We define effective-context value as a task- and intervention-dependent attribution, separate deployment state from model-visible context, and identify availability, fidelity, selection, and utilization failures. We then organize current mechanisms through a five-operation context lifecycle and propose controlled budget interventions and utility-cost curves for evaluation. The resulting agenda centers on grounded reporting, interaction-data and full-cost infrastructure, and safety and governance for persistent, adaptive systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"上下文扩展"(context scaling)这一概念框架：AI部署失败多源于任务所需状态与系统决策时可用上下文之间的错配；作者以模型-基础设施二元组为分析单元，用训练预算B_θ、决策时预算B_d与上下文基础设施预算B_c三个预算刻画三类扩展范式，并给出上下文生命周期五操作、失败分类与评估方案。
AI.motivation: 部署AI的失败并非源于推理能力不足，而是任务所依赖的状态（用户状态、仓库版本、工具轨迹、传感器读数、环境变化）在系统行动时不可用、被扭曲或选择不当。现有研究聚焦预训练扩展与决策时扩展，缺乏针对"使状态可用"这一瓶颈的系统性框架与评估方法。
AI.method: 概念性/议程性工作。(1) 将模型形式化为 P_θ(d|c)，提出三类预算：训练 B_θ、决策时 B_d、上下文基础设施 B_c；(2) 指出仅 B_c 针对决策前系统可提供的内容，从而将模型-基础设施对作为分析单元；(3) 定义"有效上下文价值"为依赖任务与干预的归因，区分部署状态与模型可见上下文；(4) 归纳可用性、保真性、选择、利用四类失败；(5) 以五操作上下文生命周期组织现有机制；(6) 提出受控预算干预与效用-成本曲线作为评估工具。
AI.result: 提出统一的三预算视角与失败分类体系，明确上下文扩展与预训练/决策时扩展的边界与交互；给出有效上下文价值的可归因定义及部署状态与可见上下文的分离；提出五操作生命周期框架、受控干预实验设计与效用-成本曲线评估范式；研究议程指向有据可查的报告规范、交互数据与全成本基础设施、以及持久自适应系统的安全与治理。
AI.conclusion: 上下文扩展是独立于模型能力扩展的第三条扩展路径，其核心在于提升系统对部署状态的获取、表示、交付、评估与持久化能力。将模型与基础设施作为联合分析单元、并以预算干预和效用-成本曲线评估，可为该方向提供可比较、可治理的研究基础。

title: Confidence-Based Adaptive Retrieval Fails Where It Matters Most: A Paradox in Biomedical Question Answering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for biomedical question answering, but plausible incorrect answers remain a safety risk in clinical settings. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can ground responses in medical literature, while confidence-based adaptive RAG retrieves only when the model appears uncertain. We evaluate this routing strategy on three biomedical QA benchmarks of increasing difficulty and compare models across a broad range of parameter scales. The results reveal a paradox: confidence is well calibrated (AUROC 0.78--0.89) on standard medical exam questions where retrieval adds little value (+2.4\% to -1.4\%), yet becomes \emph{near-random} (AUROC 0.506) on specialist-level questions where retrieval helps most (+11.2\%). Five uncertainty signals---first-token probability, margin, entropy, consistency-based sampling, and verbalized confidence---show the same failure pattern. Five post-hoc calibration correction strategies, including density-ratio reweighting and rank-preserving transformation, do not recover a useful routing signal on hard questions (best AUROC: 0.507). Cross-model comparison shows that larger parameter scale and higher base accuracy do not guarantee reliable confidence-based routing under specialist-domain difficulty shift. These findings challenge the premise of confidence-based adaptive RAG: in high-stakes biomedical settings, defaulting to always-retrieve is safer and more accurate than confidence-based routing when calibration on the target domain is unknown.

AI.tldr: 在生物医学问答中，基于置信度的自适应RAG存在"悖论"：模型在检索无用（或有害）的标准医学考题上置信度校准良好（AUROC 0.78–0.89），但在检索收益最大（+11.2%）的专科难题上置信度近乎随机（AUROC 0.506）；五种不确定性信号与五种事后校准方法均无法修复该路由信号，最优AUROC仅0.507。因此在高风险场景下，当目标域校准未知时，"始终检索"比置信度自适应路由更安全、更准确。
AI.motivation: LLM用于生物医学问答时，看似合理的错误答案在临床场景中构成安全风险；检索增强生成（RAG）可将回答锚定于医学文献，而基于置信度的自适应RAG（仅在模型不确定时才检索）被视为降低开销的合理策略。然而该路由策略的前提——置信度能可靠指示"检索是否有益"——尚未在分层的生物医学难度尺度上被系统检验。
AI.method: 在三个难度递增的生物医学QA基准上评估该路由策略，并跨广泛参数规模的多个模型进行比较。比较五类不确定性信号：首token概率、margin、熵、基于一致性采样的不确定性、以及模型自述（verbalized）置信度；并测试五种事后校准修正策略，包括密度比重加权（density-ratio reweighting）与保序变换（rank-preserving transformation）。
AI.result: 呈现出"校准悖论"：在检索几乎无增益（+2.4% 至 -1.4%）的标准医学考试题上，置信度校准良好（AUROC 0.78–0.89）；而在检索收益最高的专科级问题（+11.2%）上，置信度退化为近乎随机（AUROC 0.506）。五类不确定性信号表现出一致的失败模式；五种事后校准修正策略均无法恢复有效的路由信号（最佳AUROC 0.507）。跨模型比较显示，更大参数规模与更高基座准确率并不能保证在专科域难度迁移下获得可靠的置信度路由。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果挑战了置信度自适应RAG的基本前提：在高风险的生物医学场景中，当目标域的校准情况未知时，默认"始终检索"比基于置信度的路由更安全、更准确。置信度校准的可靠性具有域依赖性，无法作为跨难度的可迁移路由依据。

title: Geophysics-informed invertible operator network for Bayesian geophysical inversion
summary: Geophysical inverse problems are inherently ill-posed because of sparse observations and measurement noise. Classical sampling-based Bayesian inference methods, such as Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC), are computationally prohibitive because they require many forward simulations. Data-driven machine-learning methods often struggle to produce physically consistent solutions when training data are limited. To address these issues, we propose a geophysics-informed invertible operator network (GI-ION) that integrates an invertible neural network (INN) within a deep operator-learning framework for efficient Bayesian geophysical inversion. The INN serves as the branch network and transforms the model parameters into branch coefficients that represent the forward solution and a latent variable that captures uncertainty in the inverse problem. By learning the forward operator and enforcing statistical independence between the branch coefficients and the latent variable, GI-ION enables efficient sampling from a learned conditional approximation, even with sparse boundary observations. We validated GI-ION on three representative cases: 1D surface-wave dispersion and travel-time tomography for a 2D synthetic random-field model and a seismic-slice model. Numerical experiments demonstrate robust performance across diverse problem settings and efficient conditional sampling.

AI.tldr: 提出地球物理信息可逆算子网络（GI-ION），将可逆神经网络（INN）嵌入深度算子学习框架，实现高效贝叶斯地球物理反演，可在稀疏边界观测下快速采样并给出不确定性。
AI.motivation: 地球物理反问题因观测稀疏与测量噪声而本质不适定。基于采样的经典贝叶斯方法（如MCMC）需大量正演模拟，计算代价过高；数据驱动的机器学习方法在训练数据有限时难以保证解的物理一致性。
AI.method: GI-ION由INN作为分支网络，将模型参数映射为分支系数，其中一部分表示正演解，另一部分为刻画反问题不确定性的潜变量；在深度算子学习框架中学习正演算子，并施加分支系数与潜变量之间的统计独立性约束，从而可从学习到的条件近似分布中高效采样。
AI.result: 在一维面波频散问题、二维随机场模型的走时层析以及地震剖面模型的走时层析三类代表性算例上进行验证，数值实验显示在多种问题设定下均具有稳健性能，并能实现高效条件采样。
AI.conclusion: 将可逆网络与算子学习结合可在稀疏观测条件下兼顾物理一致性与不确定性量化，为高效贝叶斯地球物理反演提供可行途径，并在多类反演任务中表现稳健。

title: Why Does Sensor Depth Fail Learned Manipulation Policies? Finding the Failure Mode with ACT
summary: Learned manipulation policies, from task-specific imitation policies to vision-language-action (VLA) models, rely primarily on RGB images. While some studies report gains from sensor depth, others avoid depth cameras because of measurement noise. Depth cameras introduce both noise and missing depth values (holes), whose relative effects remain unclear. In this study, we calibrate a sensor model using a real wrist-mounted stereo camera and separately evaluate noise and holes on RGB-D imitation policies with three visual encoders in simulation. We found that complete depth improves success by approximately ten percentage points, and most of this gain persists even at twenty times the camera's noise level. In contrast, holes covering about one-sixth of the wrist image eliminate the detectable benefit of depth. The validity mask strongly influences depth reliance: marking a small fraction of pixels as invalid reduces reliance, while filling holes and marking them valid restores most of the benefit. Policies trained on clean depth also lose performance when holes appear only at deployment, sometimes falling below RGB-only performance. These findings suggest that depth cameras for learned policies should therefore be judged by depth coverage more than measurement precision.

AI.tldr: 该研究在仿真中用真实腕部双目相机的标定传感器模型，分离评估深度噪声与深度缺失（空洞）对RGB-D模仿学习策略的影响，结论是深度覆盖度远比测量精度重要。
AI.motivation: RGB图像是学习型操作策略（含VLA模型）的主要输入。部分研究报告深度带来增益，另一些研究则因深度相机测量噪声而回避使用。深度相机同时引入噪声与空洞（缺失深度值），但二者的相对影响尚不明确，缺乏可指导硬件选型的量化依据。
AI.method: 基于真实腕部安装的双目相机标定传感器模型；在仿真中对RGB-D模仿学习策略分别独立施加噪声与空洞扰动；比较三种视觉编码器；并进一步分析有效掩码（validity mask）策略的影响，包括将少量像素标为无效、填充空洞并标为有效，以及仅在部署阶段引入空洞的分布偏移实验。
AI.result: 完整深度使成功率提升约10个百分点，且该增益在相机噪声放大至20倍时大部分仍能保持；而当空洞覆盖约六分之一腕部图像时，深度的可检测收益完全消失。有效掩码显著影响深度依赖：将小部分像素标为无效会降低对深度的依赖，而填充空洞并标为有效可恢复大部分收益。仅在部署时出现空洞会使基于干净深度训练的策略性能下降，有时甚至低于仅用RGB的基线。
AI.conclusion: 对学习型策略而言，深度相机的选择应以深度覆盖度而非测量精度为主要评判标准；策略训练与部署阶段应重视空洞处理与掩码一致性，以避免部署时的性能退化。

title: Constraint-Aware Test-Time Scoring for LLM and VLM Candidate Selection
summary: When an LLM or VLM produces several candidate answers, picking the best one usually relies on the model's own confidence, a learned judge model, or a domain check. Each has a known weakness: an answer can be fluent but insecure, mathematically plausible but physically infeasible, or rated highly by a judge while quietly breaking a task requirement. We propose a scoring framework that combines a small set of hard checks every answer must pass with a wider set of softer checks whose scores are blended into one number per candidate. This adaptive scoring framework consists of three components: a drafting model that produces the candidates, a configuring model that selects and weights the checks for each task, and scoring models that rate properties no grounded tool can compute. We apply our proposed method to four tasks: writing code that is both correct and secure (CWEval), generating robot manipulation plans (LIBERO with added safety variants), passing competitive-programming hidden tests (LiveCodeBench), and answering questions from retrieved documents (HotpotQA). An ablation study isolates the contribution of each component and finds that the largest gains come from combining hard checks with candidate comparison: on tasks where the first sampled answer is often broken or unsafe, this pairing lifts joint correctness-and-safety by up to +0.21 (retrieval-augmented QA) and code-generation safety by up to +0.28 (CWEval), with the size of the gain tracking how weak the first sample is, falling to near zero or slightly negative where it is already strong. The per-task layer that selects and weights the softer checks adds no measurable value over simpler alternatives. This builds a unified scoring framework, together with an ablation that identifies the grounded hard checks, not the soft-factor configuration, as the source of the gain.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自适应打分框架，将“必须通过的硬性检查”与“可加权融合的软性检查”结合，用于在多候选答案中择优；在四项任务上的消融实验表明增益主要来自硬性检查与候选比较的组合，而非软性检查的配置层。
AI.motivation: 现有择优方式各有缺陷：模型自身置信度可能偏好“流畅但不安全”的答案；学习型判官模型可能高评却违反任务约束；领域检查覆盖有限。因此需要一个能统一融合硬性约束与软性质量的打分框架。
AI.method: 框架由三部分组成：起草模型生成多个候选答案；配置模型为每个任务选择并加权检查项（软性检查的按任务配置）；打分模型评估无可靠工具可计算的属性。硬性检查为所有答案必须通过的门槛，软性检查分数被融合为单一分数用于候选比较。在CWEval（正确且安全的代码）、LIBERO含安全变体的机器人操作计划、LiveCodeBench隐藏测试、HotpotQA检索问答四项任务上评测，并做组件消融。
AI.result: 硬性检查与候选比较结合带来最大增益：联合正确性与安全性最高提升+0.21（检索增强问答），代码生成安全性最高提升+0.28（CWEval）；增益大小与首个采样答案的薄弱程度正相关，首样本已较强时增益趋近于零甚至略为负。按任务选择并加权软性检查的配置层相对更简单替代方案无可测增益。
AI.conclusion: 该工作构建了统一的打分框架，并通过消融指出增益来源是有工具支撑的硬性检查（配合候选比较），而非软性因子的配置机制，建议优先投入可验证的硬约束设计。

title: A comprehensive survey of deep face verification systems adversarial attacks and defense strategies
summary: Face Verification (FV) systems have exhibited remarkable performance in verification tasks and have consequently garnered extensive adoption across various applications, from identity duplication to authentication in mobile payments. However, the surge in popularity of face verification has raised concerns about potential vulnerabilities in the face of adversarial attacks. These concerns originate from the fact that advanced FV systems, which rely on deep neural networks, have recently demonstrated susceptibility to crafted input samples known as adversarial examples. Although imperceptible to human observers, adversarial examples can deceive deep neural networks during the testing and deployment phases. These vulnerabilities raised significant concerns about the deployment of deep neural networks in safety-critical contexts, prompting extensive investigations into adversarial attacks and corresponding defense strategies. This comprehensive survey provides a comprehensive overview of recent advances in deep face verification, encompassing a broad spectrum of topics such as algorithmic designs, database utilization, protocols, and application scenarios. Furthermore, we conduct an in-depth examination of state-of-the-art algorithms to generate adversarial examples and the defense mechanisms devised to mitigate such adversarial threats.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统梳理了深度人脸验证（FV）的最新进展与对抗攻击/防御研究，涵盖算法设计、数据集、评测协议与应用场景。
AI.motivation: 深度人脸验证因性能优异而被广泛部署（从身份去重到移动支付认证），但其依赖的深度神经网络已被证明对对抗样本脆弱；不可感知的对抗样本可在测试与部署阶段欺骗系统，对安全关键场景构成威胁，因此需系统梳理攻击生成与防御机制的研究现状。
AI.method: 采用综述（survey）方法：全面回顾深度人脸验证的算法设计、数据库使用、评测协议与应用场景；分类并深入分析当前最先进的对抗样本生成算法，以及为缓解对抗威胁而设计的防御机制。
AI.result: 形成了对深度人脸验证研究全貌的整合性梳理，并对先进对抗攻击算法与对应防御策略进行了深入对比与归纳（摘要未给出定量实验结果）。
AI.conclusion: 人脸验证的对抗脆弱性是其实用部署的关键隐患；该综述为人脸验证与对抗攻防的交叉研究提供了统一框架与参考，并为进一步提升安全关键应用中的鲁棒性指明方向。

title: Deep Learning-Based Mesoscopic Emission Modeling
comment: Submitted to Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies
summary: Traffic-related emissions are a major contributor to urban air pollution. However, existing emission models face a fundamental trade-off: macroscopic models are computationally efficient but rely on average speeds, leading to systematic errors, while microscopic models achieve high accuracy but are computationally prohibitive for large scale simulations. To bridge this gap, this study introduces Direct Emission Prediction (DEP), a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU)-based deep learning model. DEP was trained on over one million synthetic trips generated by coupling real-world GNSS speed profiles with the microscopic emission model MOBSim. By processing sequential link-level inputs, including vehicle characteristics, road attributes, and ambient temperature, DEP predicts CO$_2$ and NOx emissions. We integrated DEP into a MATSim-based workflow and applied it to the Ile-de-France region. DEP matches the accuracy of SPG-M, a hybrid mesoscopic-microscopic reference model, within 0.35% for CO$_2$ and 1.87% for NOx across both hot and cold-start scenarios, while reducing computational runtime to just 2.2%. Furthermore, validation against empirical remote sensing data confirms that DEP accurately reproduces real-world NOx emission levels across Euro 2-6 diesel vehicles, whereas traditional macroscopic tools like COPERT and HBEFA systematically underestimate them. Finally, DEP effectively captures the spatial distribution of cold-start emissions, identifying key hotspots in dense urban areas. This work demonstrates that deep learning-based mesoscopic frameworks can achieve microscopic accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost, enabling scalable, high-resolution urban emission modeling without relying on pre-computed emission factor databases.

AI.tldr: 提出基于GRU的深度学习中观排放预测模型DEP，以约2.2%的计算成本达到微观级精度，并优于传统宏观工具。
AI.motivation: 交通排放是城市空气污染的重要来源，但现有排放模型存在精度—效率的根本性权衡：宏观模型计算高效却依赖平均速度、存在系统性误差；微观模型精度高但难以支撑大规模仿真。
AI.method: 构建Direct Emission Prediction（DEP）模型：以GRU为骨干的深度序列模型，训练数据由真实GNSS速度轨迹与微观排放模型MOBSim耦合生成的一百余万条合成行程；输入为链路级序列信息（车辆属性、道路属性、环境温度），直接预测CO2与NOx排放；并将DEP嵌入基于MATSim的工作流，在法兰西岛大区开展应用。
AI.result: DEP在热启动与冷启动场景下均与混合介观—微观参考模型SPG-M精度相当（CO2误差0.35%以内、NOx误差1.87%以内），计算耗时仅为后者的2.2%；与实测遥感数据对比，DEP能准确复现Euro 2–6柴油车真实NOx水平，而COPERT、HBEFA等宏观工具系统性低估；同时能刻画冷启动排放的空间分布并识别高密度城区热点。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习中观框架可在极低计算成本下实现微观级排放精度，支持不依赖预计算排放因子数据库的可扩展、高分辨率城市排放建模。

title: FOCI: Trajectory Optimization on Gaussian Splats for Gaussian Robots
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has recently gained popularity as a faster alternative to Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) in 3D reconstruction and view synthesis methods. Leveraging the spatial information encoded in 3DGS, this work proposes FOCI (Field Overlap Collision Integral), an algorithm that is able to optimize trajectories directly on the Gaussians themselves. FOCI leverages a novel and interpretable collision formulation for 3DGS using the notion of the overlap integral between Gaussians. The formulation presented applies to different robot morphologies (e.g., fixed and mobile base manipulators, legged robots, UAVs) and handles both static and dynamic Gaussian-Splat environments. Contrary to other approaches, which represent the robot with conservative bounding boxes that underestimate the traversability of the environment, we propose to represent the environment and the robot as Gaussian Splats. This not only has desirable computational properties, but also allows for orientation-aware planning, allowing the robot to pass through very tight and narrow spaces. We extensively test our algorithm in both synthetic and real Gaussian Splats, showcasing that collision-free trajectories for legged, aerial and manipulator robots can be computed in seconds, even with hundreds of thousands of Gaussians making up the environment. The code is available at https://github.com/leggedrobotics/foci

AI.tldr: FOCI 提出一种基于高斯重叠积分的可解释碰撞公式，直接在 3DGS 表示上进行轨迹优化，实现秒级、方向感知的无碰撞规划。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 作为比 NeRF 更快的三维重建与视图合成方法日益流行，其编码的空间信息可用于机器人规划；但现有方法用保守包围盒表示机器人，低估环境可通行性，难以通过狭窄空间。
AI.method: 提出 Field Overlap Collision Integral（FOCI），利用高斯基元间重叠积分构造碰撞代价，将机器人与环境统一表示为高斯溅射并直接在 Gaussian 上优化轨迹；该公式对固定/移动基座机械臂、腿式机器人、无人机等多种形态通用，并支持静态与动态高斯环境。
AI.result: 在合成与真实高斯溅射场景中广泛测试，即使在数十万高斯的场景下，也能在数秒内为腿式、空中与机械臂机器人计算出无碰撞轨迹；方向感知规划使其可穿越极狭窄空间。
AI.conclusion: 以高斯溅射统一表示机器人与环境并结合重叠积分的碰撞建模，可在复杂大规模场景中实现快速、方向感知的无碰撞轨迹优化，代码已开源。

title: AutoformBench: A Lean Formalization Benchmark for Advanced Mathematics
comment: First authors listed in randomized order
summary: AI systems are increasingly capable of producing machine-checked Lean proofs of advanced mathematical results. Real mathematical formalization, however, is not isolated theorem proving: it requires building the definitions and intermediate lemmas that connect a result to a formal library. Existing evaluations often provide isolated theorem statements in settings where much of this supporting theory is already available in Mathlib. We introduce AutoformBench, a benchmark of 341 Lean 4 formalization tasks drawn from 24 advanced mathematical sources. Lean-experienced mathematicians formalized and audited each target statement, leaving the corresponding Lean proof to the evaluated agent. Each problem is embedded in a broader mathematical development: agents receive the informal proof but must translate it into Lean while constructing the missing definitions, intermediate lemmas, and supporting infrastructure. We compare the performance of frontier models on these problems. We find a largely shared difficulty frontier: success depends less on mathematical domain than on models' ability to construct missing formal infrastructure. Data and code at https://github.com/facebookresearch/autoformbench

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AutoformBench——包含 341 个 Lean 4 形式化任务、源自 24 个高等数学文献来源的基准，用以评估智能体在真实数学形式化中构建缺失定义、引理与基础设施的能力，而非孤立的定理证明。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 形式化能力评估多以孤立定理陈述为对象，且所需支撑理论大多已在 Mathlib 中具备，无法反映真实数学形式化中"把结果与形式化库连接起来"的核心难度。
AI.method: 由有 Lean 经验的数学家家对每个目标陈述进行形式化与审核，仅将对应的 Lean 证明留给被评估智能体；每个问题嵌入更大的数学开发中，智能体获得非形式化证明，但必须构造缺失的定义、中间引理与支撑基础设施，并在前沿模型间进行对比评测。
AI.result: 前沿模型呈现大致共同的能力难度前沿：成功率更多取决于构建缺失形式化基础设施的能力，而非数学领域本身。
AI.conclusion: 真实数学形式化的瓶颈在于支撑性基础设施的构建；AutoformBench 为评估这一能力提供了更贴近实践的标准，数据与代码已公开。

title: How Many Samples Is RL Worth? Best-of-N versus RL Post-Training for Text-to-Image Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) on a reward that can be checked automatically has become a common last step in the training of text-to-image models. A simpler way to get more correct images is best-of-N: draw N images from the base model and keep the one that a picker prefers. We ask how many base model samples one RL sample is worth, and call this number the exchange rate. We measure it for Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium and its public Flow-GRPO checkpoint on 398 new prompts in the style of GenEval, the benchmark behind the RL reward, with human labels on every prompt and two automatic judges other than the reward. The answer depends on the prompt. Four fifths of the prompts do not ask for a position (for example, one object left of another). On these, the base model catches up: best-of-16 with an off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM) as the picker is about as good as one RL image. A person who looks through up to 3 base images finds a correct one as often as one RL image is correct. On the prompts that ask for a position, RL is far ahead: a person finds a correct image among 8 base images for only 52% of the prompts, against 92% for one RL image. Over all prompts, our primary test, which we fixed in advance, finds best-of-16 with the VLM picker 9.3 points behind one RL image when both automatic judges must pass an image. People see a smaller gap, 5.5 and 6.5 points in two checks. FLUX.1-dev shows a similar gap in the same test. RL also solves 20 prompts that the base model misses in 128 tries, and 1,024 tries recover half of them. The automatic judges are wrong in opposite directions: a detector-based judge like the reward, as used in our primary test, reports a larger gap than people see, and VLM judges report little or none. Comparisons of RL with best-of-N should therefore check the selected images by hand.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"汇率"这一概念，量化一个RL样本相当于多少个基座模型样本：在多数不含位置约束的提示上，RL约等于best-of-16（VLM挑选）或人工查看至多3张；但在位置约束提示上RL优势巨大（52% vs 92%）。整体上自动评测会因判官偏向而高估或低估差距，建议人工核验。
AI.motivation: 基于可自动校验奖励的强化学习已成为文生图模型的常用后训练步骤，但best-of-N采样是一种更简单的替代方案。作者希望回答"一个RL样本值多少个基座样本"这一可解释的定量问题，并检验自动判官在比较RL与best-of-N时是否可靠。
AI.method: 在398条新构造的GenEval风格提示上，对比Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium基座与其公开Flow-GRPO检查点；对每条提示收集人工标注，并采用两个独立于训练奖励的自动判官。主检验为预先固定的设定：best-of-16配合现成VLM挑选，要求两个自动判官同时通过；另做人工核验检查，并在FLUX.1-dev上复现同类测试。
AI.result: 效果依提示类型强烈分化：约4/5不含位置关系的提示上，基座可追平——best-of-16（VLM挑选）约等于一张RL图像，人工查看至多3张即可达到同等正确率；位置类提示上RL远胜，人工在8张基座图中找到正确图的比例仅52%，而单张RL图像正确率为92%。全体提示上，主检验显示best-of-16落后一张RL图像9.3个百分点，人工评估的差距较小（两项检查分别为5.5与6.5个百分点）；FLUX.1-dev呈相似差距。RL还解决了基座128次采样均失败的20条提示，1024次采样可恢复其中一半。
AI.conclusion: "汇率"高度依赖提示类型，RL的优势主要体现在空间/位置约束类提示上。基于奖励的检测型判官会系统性放大RL与best-of-N的差距，VLM判官则几乎看不出差距，二者偏差方向相反。因此比较RL与best-of-N时必须对入选图像进行人工核验，单靠自动判官不足以下结论。

title: Neighbor Crowding Predicts Feature Stability in Sparse Autoencoders
comment: Accepted at the NeurReps Workshop (Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations), NeurIPS 2026, Proceedings track. 13 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) offer an approach to identify language model representations by breaking apart polysemantic features into more sparse, interpretable ones. Yet, it is challenging to identify which of the learned features are actually stable, rather than artifacts of initialization. One approach is to train multiple SAE seeds, and compare the learned features across seeds by cosine similarity, but this is notably costly. This raises the question of whether stable features can be identified without the computational expense of training multiple seeds. In this work, we examine cross-seed feature stability across differing levels of training tokens, and demonstrate that in TopK SAEs, it is highly predictable using six computationally cheap statistics derived from a single training run. Neighbor crowding, a geometric property of the dictionary, is the strongest single predictor, with features that sit in dense regions of the unit sphere more likely to be stable than isolated ones.

AI.tldr: 本文研究TopK SAE中特征的跨随机种子稳定性是否可在单次训练内被低成本预测，发现使用六个廉价统计量即可高精度预测，其中"邻居拥挤度"（字典的几何性质）是最强单指标预测因子。
AI.motivation: SAE通过将多义特征分解为稀疏、可解释特征来揭示语言模型内部表示，但难以区分哪些学到的特征是真正稳定的、哪些只是初始化产生的伪影。常规做法是训练多个不同种子的SAE再用余弦相似度比较特征，计算开销很大。因此作者希望回答：能否在不重复训练多个种子的情况下识别稳定特征。
AI.method: 在不同训练token规模下考察跨种子特征稳定性；对TopK SAE，从单次训练运行中提取六个计算成本低廉的统计量，回归/预测特征的跨种子稳定性；并分析各统计量的预测能力，特别是基于字典的单位球几何属性——邻居拥挤度（neighbor crowding）。
AI.result: TopK SAE的跨种子稳定性可由六个单次运行统计量高度可预测；邻居拥挤度是最强的单一预测因子——位于单位球密集区域的特征比孤立特征更可能稳定。
AI.conclusion: 稳定特征无需通过多次种子训练即可低成本识别；字典几何（邻居拥挤度）是稳定性的关键指示，为SAE特征可靠性评估提供了高效替代方案。

title: RoboARC: Physical Puzzles for Robotic Manipulation under Spatial Constraints
summary: Many hard manipulation tasks come down to a spatial constraint that only a few motions satisfy, such as passing a part through a gap barely wider than itself or separating two interlocked parts. These motions depend on the exact geometry of each scene, so demonstrations and skills recorded elsewhere rarely transfer. We therefore ask: when manipulation hinges on spatial constraints, can robots reason out the right motions? We introduce RoboARC, a benchmark of 90 tasks in six constraint types over rigid and soft materials, on three robots in MuJoCo. Every task is a frozen scene with a physics-based grader and a verified reference solution that replays bit-identically. Each task comes in a Privileged regime, with the full simulator state and resets, and a Standard regime with real-sensor inputs (camera images and proprioception) and a single attempt without resets. We evaluate seven coding agents and four VLA policies, none trained on these tasks. The strongest agent, GPT-6 Astra in Codex, solves 86% of the tasks in the Privileged regime and 43% in the Standard regime, and the four VLA policies, run zero-shot, solve none of their 18 one-arm puzzles. On 15 puzzles that GPT-6 Astra solved in the Privileged regime and failed in the Standard regime, object poses add 4 points and part geometry 13, but both together add 36, from 24% to 60%. Only 7% of the coding agents' failed runs pass more than half of a task, and 53% of the failed runs in the Standard regime are stuck on a single step. Frontier coding agents already reason out the right motions for many of these tasks once they know where the parts are and what shape they have. From their own sensors, in a single attempt, the strongest solves fewer than half of the tasks. The website can be found at https://roboarc.embodied-first-exam.ai

AI.tldr: 提出 RoboARC 基准：90 个受空间约束紧约束的操作任务（6 类约束、刚/柔材料、3 种机器人、MuJoCo），设 Privileged 与 Standard 双设置。最强编码智能体 GPT-6 Astra 在 Privileged 下解出 86%、Standard 下 43%；四个 VLA 零样本全部失败。消融显示物体位姿与零件几何信息互补，联合提供才大幅提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 许多高难度操作任务本质上是只有极少数运动可满足的空间约束（如穿过仅略宽于自身的缝隙、分离互锁零件），其可行运动高度依赖每个场景的精确几何，导致异地采集的示范与技能难以迁移。作者由此提出核心问题：当操作取决于空间约束时，机器人能否自己推理出正确运动？
AI.method: 构建 RoboARC 基准：90 个任务、6 类空间约束、覆盖刚性与柔性材料，在 MuJoCo 中跨 3 种机器人。每个任务为冻结场景，配基于物理的评分器与可比特级复现的参考解。设两种评测设置：Privileged（提供完整仿真器状态与重置）与 Standard（仅真实传感器输入即相机图像与本体感知，单次尝试、无重置）。评测 7 个编码智能体与 4 个 VLA 策略，均未在这些任务上训练；并做信息消融（物体位姿、零件几何）与失败轨迹分析。
AI.result: 最强智能体 GPT-6 Astra（Codex 中）在 Privileged 下解出 86%、Standard 下 43%；四个 VLA 策略零样本在其 18 个单臂谜题上全部失败。在 GPT-6 Astra 于 Privileged 成功而 Standard 失败的 15 个谜题上：仅给物体位姿提升 4 分，仅给零件几何提升 13 分，两者联合提升 36 分（24%→60%）。编码智能体失败运行中仅 7% 完成过半任务进度；Standard 设置下 53% 的失败运行卡在单一步骤上。
AI.conclusion: 前沿编码智能体在已知零件位置与形状的前提下，已能对多数此类任务推理出正确的受约束运动；但仅凭自身传感器、单次尝试时，最强方法解出不足一半任务。瓶颈主要在于从感知中获取可靠的位姿与几何表征，而非运动规划本身，这为后续研究指明方向。

title: General-Purpose Decision Models for AI Configuration Tuning
summary: AI configuration tuning searches for settings that improve the performance of AI systems under a limited budget. Existing tuners use different sampling and search policies, making the choice of decision strategy central to both tuning quality and cost. We investigate whether general-purpose decision models can guide tuning, using Jev as a deployed representative that returns structured choices and numeric scores across diverse tasks. To assess where it helps, we compare its use as an optimizer, performance predictor, and region guider against conventional methods and a large language model (LLM) on eight AI tuning tasks. Conventional optimizers attain rank 1 in six of eight comparisons. Similarly, established predictors outperform Jev in seven. Through region guidance, however, it finds configurations with lower perplexity than those selected by the native tuner, offering a quality gain when additional decision time and API fees are acceptable. These findings yield actionable recommendations on selecting the decision role, retaining conventional predictors, and balancing tuning quality against cost.

AI.tldr: 论文考察通用决策模型（以Jev为代表）能否指导AI配置调优，在8个调优任务上将其分别作为优化器、性能预测器和区域引导器，与传统方法及LLM对比，发现传统优化器与预测器多数占优，而Jev仅在区域引导角色下带来质量增益。
AI.motivation: 现有AI配置调优器采用不同的采样与搜索策略，决策策略的选择同时影响调优质量与成本，因此需要明确不同决策角色下何种决策模型更合适、何时值得付出额外决策成本。
AI.method: 在有限预算下，将已部署的通用决策模型Jev分别充当优化器、性能预测器和区域引导器三种角色，在8个AI调优任务上与传统方法及一个大语言模型（LLM）进行对比实验。
AI.result: 传统优化器在8项比较中的6项排名第一；成熟的预测器在7项中优于Jev；但在区域引导角色下，Jev找到的配置困惑度低于原生调优器所选配置，在可接受额外决策时间与API费用时带来质量提升。
AI.conclusion: 应依据任务选择合适的决策角色，保留传统预测器，并在调优质量与成本之间做权衡；通用决策模型的价值主要体现在区域引导而非直接优化或预测。

title: MonoQPM: Splitting Features into Concepts for Inherent Interpretability and Predictive Performance
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (10/2026). OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=8bQNRlFQhZ
summary: Alongside superposition, polysemanticity is one of the primary obstacles to achieving interpretable deep neural networks. While these phenomena are typically intrinsically linked, the Quadratic Programming Enhanced Model (QPM) naturally decouples them. By representing classes with a sparse binary assignment of very few features, QPM prevents superposition by design on its final features but still exhibits polysemanticity. However, measuring polysemanticity is an open problem. This work proposes a utility-focused approach to measuring polysemanticity by quantifying the decrease in interference-induced activation errors, which yields the practical utility of tighter prediction sets using Conformal Prediction (CP). We explicitly disentangle the polysemantic features of QPM into monosemantic concepts to create the Monosemantic QPM (MonoQPM). Because its features are disentangled, MonoQPM acts as a significantly more efficient Conformal Predictor. Additionally, we introduce CUBCars, a dataset providing ground truth information about shared concepts. Using this and other datasets, we demonstrate that polysemanticity emerges in QPM across all tested architectures, but is effectively alleviated by MonoQPM. For instance, MonoQPM guarantees 88% coverage using Adaptive Prediction Sets on ImageNet with just 66% of the frozen QPM's set size.

AI.tldr: 该文提出以"效用"为导向的多义性度量（用共形预测预测集大小的缩减来量化），并将QPM中的多义特征解耦为单义概念得到MonoQPM，从而获得更高效的共形预测器。
AI.motivation: 叠加与多义性是深度网络可解释性的两大障碍，二者通常耦合；QPM在最终特征上按设计避免叠加却仍表现出多义性，可作为解耦研究平台。但多义性的度量本身是开放问题，缺乏以实用效用为基础的量化指标。
AI.method: 提出以效用为导向的多义性度量：量化干扰导致的激活误差下降，并以共形预测（CP）中更紧预测集的实用收益体现。显式地将QPM的多义特征解耦为单义概念，构建MonoQPM；并引入CUBCars数据集，提供共享概念的真值标注。
AI.result: 在所有测试架构上QPM均出现多义性，而MonoQPM能有效缓解；在ImageNet上，MonoQPM使用自适应预测集（APS）在仅需冻结QPM预测集大小66%的情况下即可保证88%覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 多义性可用干扰诱导激活误差的降低来实用地度量，并直接对应共形预测集紧致度；将多义特征解耦为单义概念（MonoQPM）能显著提升共形预测效率，CUBCars为共享概念研究提供真值基准。

title: REI: Learning Ideation from Repository Evolution
summary: As AI systems become increasingly capable of executing and evaluating experiments, ideation is emerging as a bottleneck in automated scientific and engineering iteration. In many real-world domains, useful ideas are sparse and their validation is costly, making direct online exploration inefficient. We observe that repository evolution provides a scalable source of reusable technical experience: code changes record concrete technical hypotheses, while subsequent revisions, adoption, and reuse provide signals about their utility. Based on this observation, we propose REI, a Repository Evolution-driven Ideation framework that learns reusable ideation policies from repository evolution, injecting domain-specific technical experience into model parameters and reducing reliance on costly trial-and-error. We further identify a hidden failure mode in quality-driven ideation optimization: semantic diversity collapse. Although generated ideas can remain lexically diverse, they increasingly concentrate in a small number of dominant method families, limiting cross-task generalization and long-tail exploration. To address this problem, we introduce Semantic Prior Optimization and Debiasing (SPOD), a diversity-preserving alignment mechanism that makes method identity explicit, corrects category-level reward bias, and limits redundant accumulation within the same method family while retaining strong representatives. Experiments on public benchmarks and a real-world industrial setting demonstrate improvements in ideation quality, method diversity, cross-task generalization, and long-tail exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出REI框架，从代码仓库演化中学习可复用的想法生成策略，并识别与解决"语义多样性坍缩"问题（SPOD机制）。
AI.motivation: AI系统在实验执行与评估方面能力增强后，idea生成（ideation）成为自动化科研与工程迭代的瓶颈；真实场景中有价值想法稀疏且验证代价高，直接在线探索效率低。同时发现质量驱动的想法优化存在隐性失效模式——语义多样性坍缩：想法词面多样但集中于少数主导方法族，削弱跨任务泛化与长尾探索。
AI.method: 1) 观察：仓库演化是可扩展的可复用技术经验来源——代码变更记录具体技术假设，后续修订、采纳与复用提供效用信号；2) REI：从仓库演化中学习可复用的ideation策略，将领域特定技术经验注入模型参数，降低对高成本试错的依赖；3) SPOD（Semantic Prior Optimization and Debiasing）：显式化方法身份、校正类别级奖励偏差、限制同一方法族内的冗余累积并保留强代表样本的多样性保持对齐机制。
AI.result: 在公开基准与真实工业场景实验中，想法质量、方法多样性、跨任务泛化与长尾探索均取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 仓库演化可作为ideation的可扩展经验监督源；REI通过参数化注入技术经验提升生成质量，SPOD有效缓解语义多样性坍缩，二者结合实现高质量与高多样性的想法生成。

title: Best-of-$N$ Test-Time Steering Can Lead to Reward Hacking in Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: 17 pages, 11 figures, to be presented at 1st Workshop on Physical World AI at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise for general-purpose robotic manipulation, but adapting to changing environmental conditions still remains challenging. Recent test-time steering methods have shown promise in enabling adaptive VLA policies by utilizing additional computation during deployment. In this paper, we consider best-of-$N$ test-time steering for VLA models, where multiple action candidates are sampled from a fixed policy and a verifier is used to select the best one during deployment. We show that increasing $N$ does not always improve performance when the verifier is inaccurate, and can favor candidates whose scores exploit prediction errors, a form of reward hacking. We study this effect on 60 LIBERO-Safety task-level cases using a $π_{0.5}$ policy, with ten repetitions per case. We introduce controlled errors in a MuJoCo trajectory verifier and show that as $N$ increases, selected candidate rewards diverge from the accurate verifier rewards, leading to reward hacking. We also show that verifier calibration and softmax-based candidate selection can mitigate reward hacking in some settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究VLA模型在测试时best-of-N选择中的"奖励黑客"问题：当验证器不准确时，增大N并不总能提升性能，反而会偏向利用预测误差的候选动作；通过可控误差实验验证该现象，并表明验证器校准与softmax候选选择可部分缓解。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人操作上有潜力，但对环境条件变化的适应性不足；近期测试时引导（test-time steering）通过在部署阶段增加计算来提升自适应能力。然而best-of-N中验证器若不准确，增大N可能引入失败模式，这一风险尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 以best-of-N测试时引导为框架：从固定策略采样多个动作候选，由验证器挑选最优。在60个LIBERO-Safety任务级案例上，使用π_{0.5}策略、每案例重复10次，并在MuJoCo轨迹验证器中人为注入可控误差，观察N增大时被选候选奖励与准确验证器奖励的偏离程度；同时评估验证器校准与基于softmax的候选选择的效果。
AI.result: 随N增大，被选候选的验证奖励与准确验证器奖励逐渐发散，出现奖励黑客现象，即性能不随N单调提升；验证器校准与softmax式候选选择在部分设置下可缓解该问题。
AI.conclusion: best-of-N测试时引导的效果强依赖验证器准确性，验证器误差会被N放大并诱发奖励黑客；实际部署中需关注验证器校准与选择机制设计，而非盲目增大采样数量。

title: What, Who, and When: Structured Harm Assessment for Mental Health Safety via Short Reasoning
summary: The growing use of large language models (LLMs) for mental health support raises important safety concerns. Existing guard models primarily identify categories of harmful content, often overlooking the context needed to determine an appropriate response. We introduce a clinically grounded taxonomy that characterizes harm along three dimensions: what the harm is, who is involved, and when it occurs. It further separates harm characterization from intervention decisions, thus enabling safety policies to be specified outside the model weights through explicit, clinician-curated instructions that can be updated and audited. We validate the taxonomy with expert clinicians and validate a panel of LLM judges to scale annotation. Relabeling public benchmarks in this taxonomy shows that they rarely contain harm directed at the user, which accounts for nearly half of the harm in real conversations. We then train MindGuard2, a 35B-A3B reasoning-based guard model using supervised fine-tuning on short reasoning traces followed by reinforcement learning with a reasoning-length penalty, to minimize inference overhead while preserving the benefits of reasoning. On two public benchmarks and real-world conversations, MindGuard2 achieves balanced accuracy comparable to the substantially larger GLM-5.3 at approximately 10x lower median latency, advancing the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier. Furthermore, it achieves low false-positive rates at high recall, helping balance the need to detect unsafe situations against the risk of unnecessary interventions that may disrupt support and undermine user trust. We release a safety guardrail model with SOTA performance trained on synthetic data, together with synthetic conversations and annotations of public benchmarks in our taxonomy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个临床依据的三维危害分类体系，将危害表征与干预决策解耦，并据此训练轻量推理型守护模型 MindGuard2，在精度-时延上取得更优权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有守护模型多只识别有害内容的类别，忽略判断"应如何响应"所需的上下文；心理健康支持场景对误报与漏报都很敏感，且需要可审计、可更新的安全策略。
AI.method: 构建三维（危害是什么、涉及谁、何时发生）临床分类体系并将危害表征与干预决策分离；由临床专家验证体系、验证LLM评审面板以扩展标注；重新标注公开基准；用短推理轨迹SFT加带推理长度惩罚的强化学习训练35B-A3B推理型守护模型MindGuard2。
AI.result: 公开基准中针对用户的危害极少，而真实对话中约占一半；MindGuard2在两项公开基准与真实对话上平衡准确率与远大的GLM-5.3相当，中位时延约低10倍，并实现高召回下的低误报率。
AI.conclusion: 以显式、临床策展指令外置安全策略的守护模型可在保持低时延的同时提升准确性与误报控制，作者开源模型、合成对话及基准标注。

title: CriticalScenes: Scalable Photorealistic Critical-Scenario Generation for Closed-Loop Driving Adaptation
summary: Safety-critical interactions are rare in recorded driving data, leaving end-to-end driving planners with limited exposure to evasive behaviour during training. This lack of critical supervision can lead to unsafe behaviour and, in rare instances, collisions. To address this gap, we introduce CriticalScenes, a reconstruction-based framework that transforms ordinary recorded driving scenes into photorealistic safety-critical interactions with corresponding collision-avoidance supervision. Across 53 reconstructed source scenes, 979 of 1,060 attempted interactions yield feasible threat trajectories (92.4\%), while the inserted threat actors remain detectable in more than 95\% of non-occluded observations within 5--35\,m. Experiments with two structurally different end-to-end planners show that the generated supervision improves critical-scenario planning, while closed-loop transfer varies across planner architectures. SparseDrive achieves a 46.5\% relative reduction in collision rate on an independent photorealistic closed-loop benchmark, whereas UniAD shows only a modest closed-loop improvement despite substantial open-loop gains. The results further highlight the importance of closed-loop evaluation, as improvements in open-loop trajectory prediction do not necessarily translate into equivalent safety gains.

AI.tldr: 提出 CriticalScenes 框架，将普通行车记录场景重建为逼真安全关键交互并附带避碰监督，显著降低部分端到端规划器的碰撞率，同时强调闭环评测的必要性。
AI.motivation: 真实驾驶数据中安全关键交互稀少，端到端规划器缺乏规避行为的监督信号，易导致不安全行为甚至碰撞。
AI.method: 基于重建的框架：将普通记录场景转换为照片级真实的安全关键交互，并生成对应的避碰监督；在 53 个重建源场景上进行 1,060 次交互注入实验，并用于训练两种结构不同的端到端规划器。
AI.result: 1,060 次尝试中 979 次得到可行威胁轨迹（92.4%）；插入的威胁主体在 5–35 m 非遮挡观测中可检出率超过 95%。SparseDrive 在独立逼真闭环基准上碰撞率相对降低 46.5%；UniAD 开环增益明显但闭环提升有限。
AI.conclusion: 合成安全关键监督可提升关键场景规划能力，但跨架构的闭环迁移效果不一致；开环轨迹预测改进不必然转化为等量安全收益，凸显闭环评测的重要性。

title: Semantic Density Does Not Predict Agent-Memory Collapse
summary: Persistent textual memory can improve LLM agents, but repeated updates can erode task performance. We ask whether memory-store statistics warn before held-out accuracy declines. We registered mean pairwise cosine similarity ($ρ$) and 13 additional geometry, retrieval, and graph statistics on 805 snapshots from 13 memory methods across ALFWorld, AppWorld, ScienceWorld, WebShop, and two ARC-AGI settings. These methods store trajectories, rules, workflows, strategies, or linked records, using selective retrieval or whole-store prompting. No such statistic reliably predicted early signs of task accuracy decline, and $ρ$ had zero median lead. With the checkpoint after peak accuracy as a secondary decline point, measures of highly similar pairs and nearest-neighbor crowding changed earlier but did not consistently outperform stored-item count. We trained classifiers on this corpus and applied them unchanged to PropWorld runs of up to 5,000 crafting tasks. They falsely flagged 56.9% of checkpoints from size-limited stores with stable accuracy and detected only 18% of checkpoints after task success fell to zero. Thus, global semantic density did not provide a reliable warning, while local crowding did not transfer consistently across memory designs. In these long-horizon runs, size-limited stores remained stable, while the sole failure arose when unbounded whole-store prompting exceeded model input capacity, which token growth predicted directly.

AI.tldr: 本文检验"记忆库统计量能否在留出任务准确率下降前发出预警"这一问题，结论是否定的：全局语义密度与局部拥挤指标均不能可靠预测性能衰退，唯一稳健的预警信号是输入token增长。
AI.motivation: 持久化文本记忆可提升LLM智能体表现，但反复更新会侵蚀任务性能。作者希望找到一个廉价、无需持续评测即可监控的"早期预警"统计量，用于判断记忆库何时开始拖累智能体准确率。
AI.method: 预注册平均成对余弦相似度ρ及13个几何、检索、图结构统计量；在ALFWorld、AppWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop及两个ARC-AGI设置下采集13种记忆方法的805个快照（记忆内容涵盖轨迹、规则、工作流、策略、链式记录，检索方式含选择性检索与全库提示）。以峰值准确率为衰退起点（次要起点为峰值后首个检查点），比较各统计量的提前量；并在该语料上训练分类器，原样迁移至最多5,000个crafting任务的PropWorld长程运行。
AI.result: 无任一统计量能可靠预测准确率早期下降，ρ的中位提前量为0。以峰值后检查点为衰退点时，高相似对比例和最近邻拥挤度变化更早，但不能稳定优于"存储条目数"。迁移到PropWorld后，分类器对规模受限且准确率稳定的记忆库误报56.9%的检查点，而在任务成功率降至零后仅检出18%。长程运行中规模受限记忆库保持稳定，唯一失败来自无界全库提示超出模型输入容量，且该失败可由token增长直接预测。
AI.conclusion: 全局语义密度不能提供可靠的记忆衰退预警，局部拥挤指标也无法跨记忆设计稳定迁移；因此不主张推广基于记忆库统计量的预警方法。实际部署中，对记忆规模做上限约束即可保证稳定性，而真正的失效模式是上下文超限，用token增长监控即可直接防范。

title: An Adversarial Multi-Agent Pursuit Game for Locomotor Agility Pretraining
summary: Agile humanoid locomotion requires controllers that can adapt to rapidly changing motion demands while remaining stable and robust. Recent locomotion controllers are typically designed with either a dense reward that is carefully shaped to encourage steps and penalize falling, or by using a reference tracking reward which teaches the controller to follow predetermined motions. Once a behavior that maximizes the reward is discovered, the controller ceases to learn. While generally stable, reference tracking methods focus on motor control separately from motion generation. Self-play has been proven as an effective technique for superhuman performance on several multiagent games like Go, Starcraft, hide-and-seek, and capture-the-flag. We train neural networks to play the game of multiagent tag in a physics simulator to study if new motion generation and control strategies can emerge through sparse feedback and competitive self-play. We present MJTag, a task suite for role-conditioned locomotion during competitive pursuit-evasion. Our model is a role-conditioned policy for a low-level locomotion controller and optional planar velocity commands. MJTag's league-based play with sparse feedback enables a locomotion controller to adopt new strategies, including dodging, sprinting, and tackling.

AI.tldr: 提出MJTag任务套件，在多智能体“抓人”游戏中以稀疏反馈和竞争性自博弈训练角色条件化的下半身运动控制器，使机器人自发生成闪避、冲刺、擒抱等运动与控制策略。
AI.motivation: 现有敏捷人形运动控制器通常依赖精心设计的稠密奖励（鼓励迈步、惩罚摔倒）或参考动作跟踪奖励；一旦找到最大化奖励的行为便停止学习，且参考跟踪方法将运动生成与运动控制割裂。作者希望探索：能否通过稀疏反馈与竞争性自博弈，让运动生成与控制策略同时涌现。
AI.method: 借鉴Go、星际争霸、捉迷藏、夺旗等自博弈的成功经验，在物理仿真器中构建多智能体“抓人”（tag）游戏；提出MJTag任务套件，聚焦竞争性追逃中的角色条件化运动。模型为角色条件化的低层运动控制策略，可选平面速度指令；采用联赛式（league-based）训练与稀疏奖励反馈。
AI.result: 稀疏反馈下的联赛自博弈使运动控制器习得新策略，包括闪避（dodging）、冲刺（sprinting）与擒抱/扑倒（tackling）等行为。
AI.conclusion: 竞争性自博弈结合稀疏反馈可作为替代稠密奖励塑形与参考动作跟踪的范式，统一运动生成与控制，并持续产生新行为而不在奖励饱和后停滞；MJTag为研究此类涌现式敏捷运动提供了任务平台。

title: Certify What You Plant: Shortcut-Free Proof Depth in Logical Reasoning Data
summary: Procedurally generated logic problems are used to both evaluate and train reasoning in language models. Their difficulty is usually set by planting a proof, that is, by sampling a proof of the desired depth and stating its premises as the problem. However, a planted proof is only one possible proof. A problem can also have shorter proofs, or several unrelated ones, and its stated depth then overstates what solving it requires. We measure what a problem actually requires, relative to a stated set of inference rules. For each problem, we compute the steps every proof must make, the shortest proof, the number of minimal proofs and the indispensable premises, and export certificates that an independent checker verifies. Audits of eight datasets find depth that is forced (ProofWriter, Blocksworld), problems labelled depth 5 that require about two specific rule applications (FLDx2), and answers that need no particular step (ZebraLogic). We then construct problems whose every proof has a requested structure, using a catalog of shortcuts proved once per rule set. Every constructed problem is checked in full and comes with its own certificate. In training, the best data mixes depths and problem types. At equal size, such mixtures of certified problem types, including model-checking problems that forward generation does not produce, transfer better than FLDx2-style derivation data for Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 8B.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出"植入式证明"生成的逻辑题其标称深度会高估实际求解难度，提出以证明论分析量化问题的真实要求并生成带证书的可控结构问题，并发现混合多种已认证问题类型的数据在训练中迁移效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 程序化生成的逻辑题通常通过采样一条指定深度的证明并将其前提作为题目来设定难度，但这一条证明只是众多可能证明之一：题目可能存在更短的证明或多个互不相关的证明，因此标称深度会夸大解题所需的最小代价。需要一种客观度量"题目实际要求什么"的方法，并据此构造难度可控、可验证的训练与评测数据。
AI.method: 1) 相对于给定推理规则集，对每个问题计算：所有证明都必须经过的步骤（强制步骤）、最短证明、极小证明的数量、不可或缺的前提，并导出可由独立检查器验证的证书；2) 审计八个数据集（如 ProofWriter、Blocksworld、FLDx2、ZebraLogic）；3) 借助按规则集一次性证明的"捷径目录"，构造每条证明都具备指定结构的问题，并逐一全量核验并附证书；4) 在 Qwen3 0.6B–8B 上比较不同数据配方的训练迁移效果。
AI.result: 审计发现：ProofWriter 与 Blocksworld 的深度是"被强制的"；FLDx2 中标注深度为 5 的题目实际只需约两次特定规则应用；ZebraLogic 的答案不依赖任何特定步骤。训练实验表明，最佳数据混合同时覆盖多种深度与问题类型；在同等数据规模下，包含前向生成不会产生的模型检测类问题在内的"已认证问题类型混合"，对 Qwen3 各规模模型的迁移效果优于 FLDx2 风格的推导数据。
AI.conclusion: 标称证明深度不等于题目真实难度，应以相对固定规则集的证明论量（最短证明、强制步骤、极小证明数、必要前提）刻画并出具可验证证书；据此构造的结构化可控问题可作为更可靠的评测与训练资源，且多类型混合数据比单一推导式数据具有更好的迁移性。

title: Same Tokenizer, Better Tokens: Choosing Image Tokens by MAP Inference
summary:
Discrete visual tokens encode images for reconstruction and serve as training targets for autoregressive image generators. Vector-quantized tokenizers typically assign each encoder feature its nearest code independently. The decoder uses these codes jointly, so a sequence of individually nearest codes can reconstruct an image less faithfully than an alternative assignment. A local model of the reconstruction loss yields a closest-vector problem with a decoder-dependent target and metric. Reconstruction-only search improves PSNR across the frozen tokenizers we test. Different code sequences can achieve similar reconstruction quality, leaving room to favour more predictable ones.
  We introduce RecaP (Reconstruction and Predictability), which selects codes for a frozen tokenizer by balancing how faithfully they reconstruct the image with how likely their sequence is under a pretrained autoregressive prior. On ImageNet, LlamaGen GPT-B trained on RecaP tokens achieves lower early-checkpoint FID against training images than GPT-B trained on nearest-neighbour tokens. The difference is smaller against held-out images. On an ImageNet subset, the prior improves generation at comparable reconstruction FID. Our code is available at: https://github.com/gmum/recap

AI.tldr: 提出 RecaP 方法：通过联合优化重建保真度与序列可预测性，为冻结的 VQ 分词器选择码字，提升自回归图像生成效果。
AI.motivation: VQ 分词器通常对每个编码器特征独立取最近邻码字，但解码器是联合使用整条码序列的，因此逐个最近邻的码序列在重建上并非最优。同时，不同码序列可达到相近重建质量，为偏好更"可预测"（自回归先验下概率更高）的序列留出空间。
AI.method: 将重建误差局部建模，转化为以解码器相关目标与度量为特征的最近向量问题；在此基础上提出 RecaP，对冻结分词器进行码字搜索，在重建保真度与预训练自回归先验下的序列似然之间做权衡；并可退化为仅重建的搜索。
AI.result: 仅重建的搜索在所测冻结分词器上普遍提升 PSNR；在 ImageNet 上，用 RecaP 码训练的 LlamaGen GPT-B 在早期 checkpoint 上对训练图像的 FID 优于最近邻码版本，但对留出图像的差距较小；在 ImageNet 子集上，先验项在重建 FID 相当的情况下改善生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 码字选择应同时考虑重建与序列可预测性；RecaP 作为一种即插即用的冻结分词器码本重标注方案，可改善自回归图像生成的早期收敛与生成质量，但对泛化的增益有限。

title: KiRA: Kronecker Input-Gated Rank Adaptation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Pretrained Models
summary: Full fine-tuning of large pretrained models is expensive, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) is the standard alternative. Most PEFT methods use low-rank updates, whose rank lies far below that of full fine-tuning and is the same for every input. Input-adaptive variants vary the capacity per input but remain within the low-rank bottleneck, and whether a task benefits from input conditioning is not known before training. This paper introduces Kronecker input-gated rank adaptation (KiRA). Instead of the conventional low-rank product, the update $ΔW$ is the Kronecker product of a frozen random $p\times p$ matrix $A$ and a trainable factor $M(x)$, which overcomes the rank ceiling: because rank is multiplicative under this product, $A$ multiplies the rank of $M(x)$ by $p$ without adding trainable parameters. The factor $M(x)$ is further decomposed as $B_1\,\mathrm{diag}(g(x))\,B_2$, where the input gate $g(x)$, computed once per sample by a network shared across all adapted layers, adjusts the rank of the update to each input in steps of $p$. Where input conditioning is unnecessary, the gate is folded into $B_1$ at deployment. Because the gate changes the rank only in discrete steps, the benefit of input conditioning can be predicted before training from a few hundred labeled inputs. Across six medical imaging and language benchmarks, KiRA attains the highest mean score against five published baselines with 8.7--9.7 times fewer trainable parameters than low-rank adaptation, and the pre-training criterion agrees with the measured benefit of input conditioning on all six tasks.

AI.tldr: KiRA用Kronecker积代替低秩乘积，使冻结随机矩阵A将可训练因子M(x)的秩放大p倍而不增加可训练参数，并通过样本级输入门控g(x)以p为步长自适应调整更新秩；六个基准上以低秩适配1/8.7–9.7的可训练参数取得最高平均分，且训练前即可预测输入条件化是否有效。
AI.motivation: 全量微调大模型代价高昂，PEFT成为标准替代。但多数PEFT采用低秩更新，其秩远低于全量微调，且对所有输入相同；输入自适应变体虽按样本调整容量，仍受低秩瓶颈限制，且任务是否受益于输入条件化在训练前不可知。
AI.method: 提出Kronecker输入门控秩自适应（KiRA）：ΔW = A ⊗ M(x)，A为冻结的随机p×p矩阵，利用Kronecker积下秩的乘性，将M(x)的秩乘以p而不引入额外可训练参数，突破秩上限。M(x)分解为B1·diag(g(x))·B2，输入门g(x)由所有适配层共享的网络逐样本计算一次，以p为步长调整秩；当输入条件化无必要时，部署时门可折叠进B1。因门仅以离散步长改变秩，输入条件化的收益可用数百个标注样本在训练前预测。
AI.result: 在六个医学影像与语言基准上，相对五个已发表基线取得最高平均分，可训练参数比低秩适配少8.7–9.7倍；训练前判据在全部六个任务上与实测的输入条件化收益一致。
AI.conclusion: KiRA以冻结随机Kronecker因子解除低秩瓶颈，实现参数高效且输入自适应的微调，并提供了训练前判断输入条件化是否值得的可靠准则。

title: OnCue: Generating Safety-Critical Driving Scenarios under Occlusion with Temporal Control
summary: Occluded hazards challenge autonomous driving because visibility timing determines available avoidance actions. Existing scenario generators control hazard motion without jointly specifying exposure and reference-contact times. We propose OnCue, a framework that generates safety-critical encounters in real driving logs with these temporal conditions. Scene geometry provides hidden starts and timed waypoints for pedestrian, cyclist, and vehicle trajectory generation. An offline response oracle labels encounters as Reactive (avoidable after exposure) or Anticipatory (avoidable only with earlier visibility) and stores safe maneuvers as training demonstrations. On the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, 90.1-96.6% of valid trajectories meet both requested times within +/-0.2 s. OnCue matches the requested reaction window between them in 92.8% of shared vehicle requests versus at most 42.1% for adapted adversarial generators. Across matched cyclist encounters, longer windows lower PDM-Closed collision from 59.1% to 5.5%, while the learned planner LatentDriver shows the opposite trend. OnCue demonstrations reduce LatentDriver target collision by 54.8 points on held-out Reactive tests, but reduce overall no-target progress by 12.7 m. These results highlight the value of temporal control for evaluating and improving planners under occlusion.

AI.tldr: 提出 OnCue 框架：在真实驾驶日志中按"暴露时刻"与"参考接触时刻"双时间条件生成遮挡安全关键场景，并用离线响应 oracle 区分 Reactive/Anticipatory 场景、存储安全机动作为示范。
AI.motivation: 遮挡危险对自动驾驶的挑战在于"可见时机决定可用规避动作"。现有场景生成器只控制危险物运动，无法同时指定暴露时刻与参考接触时刻，因而无法系统评估规划器在遮挡下的时序敏感性。
AI.method: 1) 基于场景几何确定隐藏起点与定时路点，生成行人、骑行者、车辆轨迹；2) 离线响应 oracle 将遭遇标注为 Reactive（暴露后可规避）或 Anticipatory（需更早可见才可规避），并保存安全机动作为训练示范；3) 在 Waymo Open Motion Dataset 上验证时间精度，与适配的对抗生成器对比反应窗口匹配度；4) 在匹配的骑行者场景中比较 PDM-Closed 与 LatentDriver 随窗口变化的碰撞率；5) 用 OnCue 示范微调 LatentDriver 并测试迁移。
AI.result: 90.1–96.6% 的合法轨迹在 ±0.2 s 内同时满足两个请求时刻；共享车辆请求中 92.8% 能复现请求的反应窗口，而适配对抗生成器最高仅 42.1%。匹配骑行者场景下，窗口变长使 PDM-Closed 碰撞率由 59.1% 降至 5.5%，而 LatentDriver 呈相反趋势。OnCue 示范使 LatentDriver 在留出 Reactive 测试上目标碰撞下降 54.8 个百分点，但整体无目标进度减少 12.7 m。
AI.conclusion: 时序可控的场景生成对遮挡条件下的规划器评估与改进具有明确价值：能揭示不同规划器的时序敏感性差异；但示范训练在降低碰撞的同时带来进度代价，说明安全性与效率的平衡仍是后续待解问题。

title: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis in Jacobian-Space: Language and Vision Models Agree Approximately Up to a Rotation
summary: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) posits that AI models converge toward a shared representation of the world, even when trained on different data modalities. Previous work has found evidence for the PRH in the activations of vision and language models. In this work, we ask whether vision and language models also converge in how they act on these representations: precisely, in how these internal representations affect the models' output. At a chosen layer of a transformer, the Jacobian lens gives every word in the vocabulary (or class in an image classifier) a vector in the hidden state: the vector that most increases the model's tendency to generate that word, at that position or later, or to predict that class. Collectively, these vectors make up what is referred to as the model's J-space. We find evidence of the PRH in J-space across vision and language models, and furthermore, we find that J-spaces mostly converge up to a rotation. That is, a single rotation, fitted on a subset of words, approximately maps one model's J-space onto another's, and so applies to words and classes it was not fitted on. A word's vector, rotated from a text-only language model's J-space into the visual patch tokens of a vision-language model, changes the object the vision-language model says is in the image (and only in the image region where it is added). Rotated into an image generator's text conditioning, a word's vector changes the object in the generated image. Rotated into an ImageNet classifier (trained without text), it raises that object's class score above almost all others, and vice versa. This suggests that models converge not only in how they represent the world, but also in how they act on it.

AI.tldr: 论文将"柏拉图表示假说"从激活表示层面拓展到"作用方式"层面，提出并在J空间（各词/类别对隐藏态的雅可比方向集合）中验证了跨视觉与语言模型的收敛性，且这种收敛在旋转意义下成立，并通过跨模型向量移植实验证明其因果可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 已有工作仅在激活层面为柏拉图表示假说提供证据，即不同模态模型对世界的内部表征趋于一致；但尚不清楚模型是否在"如何依据这些表征产生输出"（即表征对输出的作用方式）上也收敛，这是对PRH更强、更具因果意义的一种检验。
AI.method: 在指定transformer层上用雅可比透镜为词表每个词（或图像分类器每个类别）构造隐藏态中的向量——即最能提升该词/类在该位置及之后生成倾向的方向，汇总为模型的J空间；随后跨视觉模型、语言模型、视觉-语言模型、图像生成器与ImageNet分类器比较J空间，并用Procrustes类旋转在词子集上拟合映射，检验其对未拟合词/类的泛化；最后做跨模型向量移植的干预实验。
AI.result: J空间层面存在PRH证据；不同模型J空间大多在相差一个旋转的意义下收敛，单一旋转即可在未参与拟合的词与类别上近似对齐。将纯文本语言模型中的词向量旋转后注入视觉-语言模型的图像patch token，可局部地改变模型所述图像物体（且仅影响注入区域）；旋转注入图像生成器的文本条件可改变生成图像中的物体；旋转注入无文本训练的ImageNet分类器，可使目标类别得分超过几乎所有其他类别，反向亦然。
AI.conclusion: 模型不仅在世界表征上收敛，也在对世界的作用方式上收敛；J空间为刻画跨模态、跨架构的功能对齐提供了可干预、可量化的工具，并为PRH提供了因果层面的支持。

title: JetDiffusion: Pushing the Speed Limits of Video Generation with NVFP4 Sparse Attention
summary: Attention over long sequences is a major computational bottleneck in video generation, which can be alleviated through sparsity and low-bit quantization. We propose JetDiffusion, a video generation system built on trainable Video Sparse Quantized Attention (VSQA), with custom inference kernels that combine native NVFP4 computation and kernel fusion. At 90% sparsity, VSQA accelerates attention by 8-29x compared with FlashAttention on different hardwares. To further accelerate video generation, we combine VSQA with NVFP4 linear quantization and step distillation. Although each technique can individually preserve generation quality, jointly adapting to all three remains challenging, particularly under aggressive NVFP4 quantization. Through empirical studies, we develop an effective staged training recipe that enables stable adaptation to quantization, sparsity, and few-step denoising. On Wan2.1-14B, the resulting model achieves 273x end-to-end video generation speedup on the RTX 5090 while maintaining comparable video quality.

AI.tldr: JetDiffusion：以可训练的VSQA（视频稀疏量化注意力）+自研推理内核（原生NVFP4计算与算子融合）为核心，结合NVFP4线性量化与步数蒸馏，实现长序列视频生成的高效加速，在RTX 5090上端到端最高加速273倍且画质可比。
AI.motivation: 长序列注意力是视频生成的主要计算瓶颈；稀疏化与低比特量化可缓解，但三者（稀疏、NVFP4量化、少步去噪）联合优化时难以保持生成质量，尤其在激进NVFP4量化下缺乏稳定适配方案。
AI.method: 1) 提出可训练的Video Sparse Quantized Attention（VSQA）；2) 设计自定义推理内核，融合原生NVFP4计算与kernel fusion；3) 将VSQA与NVFP4线性量化、步数蒸馏（step distillation）组合；4) 通过实证研究提出分阶段（staged）训练配方，实现量化、稀疏与少步去噪的稳定联合适配。
AI.result: 90%稀疏度下，VSQA相比FlashAttention在不同硬件上加速8-29倍；在Wan2.1-14B上，RTX 5090端到端视频生成加速273倍，视频质量保持可比。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏注意力、NVFP4量化与少步蒸馏可协同叠加；关键在于分阶段训练配方，使模型在激进量化下稳定适配，从而在保持质量的同时获得数量级的端到端加速。

title: Resource-Efficient Multimodal Fusion for Early Rice Blast Forecasting in Sustainable Agriculture
summary: Resource-efficient artificial intelligence has become increasingly important for sustainable agriculture, where timely disease forecasting must be achieved under computational and energy constraints. Early estimation of rice blast can enhance food security by optimizing crop management practices while reducing excessive pesticide use. However, existing frameworks often suffer from high computational overhead and limited capability to model the complex spectral-temporal dependencies present in heterogeneous meteorological and remote sensing data. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a lightweight multimodal fusion framework comprising an attentive positional encoding-based Transformer and a convolutional neural network (CNN)-embedded gated recurrent unit (GRU) for efficient spectral-temporal representation learning. The attention-enhanced positional encoding assigns adaptive importance to sequential meteorological tokens, enabling effective modelling of temporal characteristics. In parallel, the lightweight CNN extracts discriminative spectral features, while the GRU captures temporal dynamics from remote sensing imagery acquired over two time-instances. A multimodal fusion layer integrates these heterogeneous representations to forecast rice blast risk 5-10 days before symptom manifestation across diverse agro-climatic zones. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving a validation accuracy of 96.93% and an F1-score of 95.79%. In addition to its predictive performance, the lightweight multimodal architecture substantially reduces computational complexity, inference latency, and carbon emissions, making it an energy-efficient solution for large-scale disease forecasting. The proposed framework provides a practical foundation for resource-efficient artificial intelligence in sustainable agriculture.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量级多模态融合框架（注意力位置编码Transformer + CNN-GRU），在计算与能耗受限条件下实现稻瘟病提前5-10天的风险预测，验证准确率96.93%、F1 95.79%，并显著降低计算复杂度、推理延迟与碳排放。
AI.motivation: 可持续农业中的资源高效AI日益重要：稻瘟病早期预警可优化作物管理、提升粮食安全并减少农药滥用，但现有框架计算开销高，且难以建模异构气象与遥感数据中复杂的光谱-时序依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出轻量级多模态融合框架：1）基于注意力增强位置编码的Transformer，为序列气象token分配自适应重要性以建模时序特征；2）轻量CNN提取判别性光谱特征，GRU捕捉两个时间点遥感影像的时序动态；3）多模态融合层整合异构表征，实现跨不同农业气候区的症状显现前5-10天稻瘟病风险预测。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该框架优于现有最先进方法，验证准确率达96.93%，F1分数为95.79%；同时轻量架构显著降低计算复杂度、推理延迟和碳排放。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为可持续农业中的资源高效人工智能提供了实用基础，可作为大规模病害预测的节能解决方案。

title: Model Predictive Control of a Multirotor UAV with a Cable-Suspended Payload: A Comparison of Shifted and Transformer-Based Warm Starts
summary:
This study investigates model predictive control (MPC) of a multirotor drone (unmanned aerial vehicle, UAV) carrying a cable-suspended payload, comparing conventional shifted initialization with Transformer-based warm starting of a sequential convex programming (SCP) optimizer. The controller uses a coupled mechanical model with an elastic cable and a double-pendulum representation of the suspended load. Its formulation includes move-blocked control inputs, finite-difference sensitivities, constrained quadratic subproblems, and input-feasibility projection. A Transformer trained on expert SCP solutions predicts an initial control sequence, which is subsequently refined by the same optimizer used for the conventional methods. Numerical experiments compare zero, shifted, and Transformer initialization under identical controller settings. For independently solved MPC problems, Transformer initialization reduces computation time relative to zero initialization. In sequential closed-loop simulations, however, shifting the preceding optimized control sequence provides the lowest computation time, while all three methods produce similar tracking behavior. These findings emphasize the importance of comparing learned warm starts with conventional initialization methods that reuse previous MPC solutions. The measured optimization times exceed the control sampling period; consequently, real-time implementation is not demonstrated.
  Keywords: Model predictive control; sequential convex programming; Transformer; warm start; cable-suspended payload; multirotor drone.

AI.tldr: 该文研究多旋翼无人机吊挂负载的MPC，比较传统移位初始化与Transformer热启动对SCP优化器的影响；序贯闭环中移位法耗时最低，三种初始化跟踪性能相近。
AI.motivation: MPC+SCP求解耗时大，学习型热启动（Transformer）常与零初始化比较而获得优势结论，但缺少与"复用上一时刻优化解"这一传统移位初始化的公平对比；同时吊挂弹性绳、双摆负载的耦合模型使问题更具挑战性。
AI.method: 控制器采用含弹性绳与双摆负载的耦合动力学模型，MPC离散化为带move-blocked控制输入、有限差分灵敏度、约束二次子问题及输入可行性投影的SCP序列。用专家SCP解训练Transformer预测初始控制序列，再由同一优化器精化。实验在相同控制器设置下对比零初始化、移位初始化与Transformer初始化，分别考察独立求解与序贯闭环仿真两种场景。
AI.result: 独立求解的MPC问题上，Transformer初始化相对零初始化降低了计算时间；但在序贯闭环仿真中，移位前一优化序列的计算时间最低，且三种方法的跟踪行为相似。
AI.conclusion: 学习型热启动应与此前MPC解复用的传统初始化方法对比才有意义；实测优化时间超过控制采样周期，实时实现尚未验证，未来需提升求解速度（如更紧的热启动、代码生成或缩短时域）。

title: Brand Recall and Category Accuracy in Language Models: An Audit of 1,000 B2B SaaS Brands
summary: A language model can name a brand without classifying it correctly. This study measures these outcomes separately for 1,000 B2B SaaS brands across 333 product categories. On Gemma 4 12B, with no external retrieval, category prompts elicit 510 brands (51.0%). A separate five-candidate category probe ranks the reference label first for 787 brands, a distractor first for 194, and yields little separation for 19. Among the 981 separated rankings, the error rate is 19.8%. It falls to 3.5% for the 547 brands with a winner-to-runner-up log-probability margin above 0.6. These are within-cohort measurements, not calibrated confidence estimates. Exploratory regressions associate technical coverage with recall and an owned-properties composite with category accuracy, but the composites use different adjustment sets and do not establish causal effects. Across four Gemma generations, measured recall is 39.8%, 44.3%, 51.1% and 51.0%. A separate representation-based sentiment measure has little linear association with customer ratings (r=0.03, n=921). The findings support reporting recall and category accuracy separately. Failure to elicit a brand does not establish its absence from model parameters or training data.

AI.tldr: 该研究在 Gemma 4 12B 上对 1,000 个 B2B SaaS 品牌、333 个产品类别分别测量"品牌召回"与"类别准确率"，发现召回率仅 51.0%，而错误仅在置信边际高时可显著下降，主张两者应分开报告。
AI.motivation: "能说出品牌名"与"能正确归类品牌"是两个可分离的能力，但既有评估常混为一谈。作者希望厘清语言模型对 B2B SaaS 品牌的召回与类别判断是否应作为独立指标衡量，并检验技术内容覆盖、自有渠道等关联因素，而非直接假设单一指标即可代表品牌知识。
AI.method: 构建 1,000 个 B2B SaaS 品牌 × 333 个产品类别的评估集，在无外部检索条件下使用 Gemma 4 12B：①类别提示下的品牌召回测量；②五候选类别探针（含参考标签与干扰项）测得排序与错误率；③以获胜项与次优项的对数概率边际（>0.6）分层分析；④跨四代 Gemma 的纵向比较；⑤基于表征的情绪测度与客户评分做相关分析；⑥探索性回归关联技术覆盖度与自有渠道复合指标。
AI.result: 类别提示共召回 510 个品牌（51.0%）；五候选探针中 787 个品牌将正确标签排首位、194 个将干扰项排首位、19 个区分度不足。981 个可区分样本的错误率为 19.8%，而在 547 个边际>0.6 的品牌中降至 3.5%。四代 Gemma 召回率依次为 39.8%、44.3%、51.1%、51.0%。技术覆盖度与召回正相关、自有渠道复合指标与类别准确率相关，但两复合指标调整变量集不同，不具备因果解释。表征情绪测度与客户评分线性相关极弱（r=0.03，n=921）。
AI.conclusion: 品牌召回率与类别准确率必须分开报告；未召回品牌不等于其不存在于模型参数或训练数据中。对数概率边际虽可筛出低错误子集，但属于同队列内部度量，不能当作校准后的置信度估计。相关分析仅为探索性，不能主张因果。

title: CoSMo: A Compact Spectral Space of Body Motion in Video
summary: We introduce CoSMo, a compact spectral space of body motion in video, in which each motion is a single code that can be compared and edited without training, transferred to a new subject, interpolated, composed, scaled in intensity and detail, or sampled anew. Our encoder expresses how a clip's DINOv2 features change over time in a fixed temporal basis, the discrete cosine transform (DCT), and compresses this change into 384 numbers. Because each frequency band is the same cosine pattern in every code, codes are aligned in time, ordered from coarse to fine, and can be blended or added without matching frames. What stays constant over a clip cancels, and keeping fewer frequencies leaves less of the performer and scene. The encoder is trained on real videos and on synthetic motions of several characters, and lightweight adapters let a frozen image-to-video model render any code with any subject. On unseen videos, our code ranks the same motion on other bodies higher than DisMo, a per-frame representation, while its nearest neighbors show the same performer about 40% less often with a seven times more compact code. In generation, without per-motion training, CoSMo transfers motion more faithfully than FlexiAct and a text-prompt baseline, at least as faithfully as DisMo on automatic metrics and clearly better between humanoid bodies, and its blends keep much more of both source motions than DisMo's. Users rank CoSMo first nearly twice as often as DisMo for motion transfer (59% vs. 30%), place it top-two 94% of the time, and prefer it in 76% of the interpolation comparisons.

AI.tldr: 提出CoSMo——一个紧凑的身体运动频谱空间，每个运动被编码为单个可比较、可编辑的384维码，无需训练即可插值、组合、强度缩放与重采样，并可通过轻量适配器驱动冻结的图像到视频模型进行运动迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有逐帧运动表示（如DisMo）维度冗余、易纠缠表演者与场景信息，且需要逐运动的训练或帧对齐才能比较与编辑，难以支持运动检索、强度调整与跨主体迁移等操作。
AI.method: 用固定时间基（DCT）表达DINOv2特征随时间的相对变化，将运动压缩为384个系数；各频带在所有码中对应相同余弦模式，故码在时间上对齐、由粗到细有序，可无帧匹配地混合或相加；短帧内恒定成分被抵消，保留频带越少，表演者与场景残留越少。编码器在真实视频与多角色合成运动上训练，冻结的图像到视频模型配轻量适配器渲染任意码与任意主体。
AI.result: 在未见视频上，CoSMo对跨身体同一运动的排序优于逐帧表示DisMo；最近邻中同一表演者出现率降低约40%，码紧凑度提升7倍。生成方面无需逐运动训练，运动迁移保真度优于FlexiAct与文本提示基线，自动指标上不逊于DisMo且在类人身体间明显更好，混合保留两源运动信息更多。用户研究：运动迁移中59% vs 30%首选CoSMo，94%进入前二；插值比较中76%偏好CoSMo。
AI.conclusion: 以频谱基统一表达运动，可在单一紧凑码内同时获得可比较性、可编辑性与跨主体可迁移性，为运动检索、编辑与生成提供通用表示；局限在于依赖单一视觉编码器特征与离线DCT变换，尚未验证长时、多主体交互等复杂场景。

title: Sequential Testing on Complex and High Dimensional Data Streams Leveraging Unsupervised Model Errors
summary: We propose two general, distribution-free test statistics for binary Sequential Hypothesis Testing (SHT) and Sequential Change Point Detection (SCPD) respectively, in streaming environments where the data (e.g., network traffic metadata) are too complicated for the exact probabilistic modeling required by conventional likelihood ratio-driven tests. Our framework also addresses the challenge of information asymmetry, where data is available only from the null/pre-change regime and not from the alternative/post-change one such as zero-day attacks or emerging disease related regimes. The proposed statistics monitor the errors of a predictive or reconstructive machine learning model trained solely on null/pre-change data, relying on imperfect generalization (the model's performance will degrade when deployed on data from the alternative/post-change class). Under mild assumptions on the model's errors, we establish rigorous analytical guarantees: strict non-asymptotic error control for SHT, and explicit bounds on the Average Run Length (ARL) and the Expected Detection Delay (EDD) for SCPD. Extensive evaluations in target tracking, chaotic dynamical systems, and real-world network security datasets, demonstrate that our framework consistently satisfies prescribed constraints where existing algorithms succumb to inflated missed detections and/or false alarms. Finally, because our methods operate on scalar errors without requiring online retraining or kernel evaluations, they are highly scalable.

AI.tldr: 论文提出两个通用的免分布检验统计量，分别用于二值序贯假设检验（SHT）与序贯变点检测（SCPD），在数据复杂且仅有零假设/变点前数据（信息不对称）的流式场景下，利用仅在零假设数据上训练的机器学习模型的误差作为统计量，并给出严格的理论保证。
AI.motivation: 流式数据（如网络流量元数据）过于复杂，难以进行传统似然比检验所需的精确概率建模；同时存在信息不对称问题，即只能获得零假设/变点前 regime 的数据，无法获得如零日攻击或新兴疾病等替代/变点后 regime 的数据。
AI.method: 以仅在零假设/变点前数据上训练的预测或重构模型的误差作为检验统计量，利用模型泛化不完美（在替代类数据上性能退化）这一性质，构建两个免分布的 SHT 与 SCPD 统计量；在关于模型误差的温和假设下给出理论分析。
AI.result: 建立了严格的分析保证：SHT 具有严格的非渐近错误控制；SCPD 给出平均运行长度（ARL）与期望检测延迟（EDD）的显式界。在目标跟踪、混沌动力系统和真实网络安全数据集上的大量实验表明，该框架始终满足预设约束，而现有算法则出现漏检和/或虚警膨胀。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法仅依赖标量误差、无需在线重训练或核函数计算，因而具有高度可扩展性，并在理论与实验中均优于现有方法。

title: Skeptic: Grounding Failure Diagnosis for Robot Skill Discovery
summary: Robot agents discover reusable skills by revising programs from execution feedback and retaining experience for later tasks. This process can fail when an agent treats an unsuccessful program as evidence that the task is physically impossible, ending exploration with revision budget remaining. We study this failure in Qwen3.8-27B and examine two decisions that shape skill discovery: I) how execution failures are diagnosed, and II) which lessons enter the shared skill library. Failure diagnosis requires the agent to reconstruct physical action effects from multimodal traces, while independent reproduction of a proposed repair does not require adequate task performance from its source program. We introduce Skeptic, a training-free protocol that uses measured action outcomes to guide repair and measured task success to govern skill admission.
