A grounded event log reports action effects and object end states from depth images and proprioception, separating sensor observations from inferred diagnoses. Verified promotion adds a development-success requirement on the source program to the existing independent reproduction check. Across 60 audited tasks, the mean number of tasks with false impossibility judgments decreases from 19.5 to 8.5 per campaign. On 80 LIBERO-Pro tasks and seven Robosuite tasks, Skeptic improves held-out success by 14.9 and 11.7 percentage points, with frozen model weights and the same program-revision budget.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练协议Skeptic，用实测动作结果驱动修复诊断、用实测任务成功率把关技能入库，解决智能体把失败程序误判为"任务物理不可行"而过早终止探索的问题。
AI.motivation: 机器人智能体通过执行反馈修订程序、保留经验以发现可复用技能，但当某个不成功程序被当作"任务物理不可行"的证据时，会在修订预算未用尽时提前终止探索，导致技能发现失败。论文聚焦两个关键决策：执行失败如何被诊断、哪些经验可进入共享技能库。
AI.method: 在Qwen3.8-27B上研究该失效模式，并引入Skeptic：一种免训练协议。①失败诊断需从多模态轨迹中重建物理动作效果，而所提修复方案的独立复现并不要求源程序具备足够任务表现。Skeptic以实测动作结果指导修复，以实测任务成功率决定技能准入。②构建grounded事件日志，从深度图像和本体感知中报告动作效果与物体终止状态，将传感器观测与推断性诊断分离。③Verified promotion在既有独立复现检查之上追加对源程序"开发期成功"的要求。全程冻结模型权重、保持相同程序修订预算。
AI.result: 在60个审计任务中，每轮试验出现虚假"不可行"判断的任务数均值由19.5降至8.5。在80个LIBERO-Pro任务和7个Robosuite任务上，留出集成功率分别提升14.9和11.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将失败诊断锚定于可测量的动作与状态观测、并将技能准入与源程序实测成功绑定，可有效抑制虚假不可行判断，在相同预算与冻结权重下显著提升技能发现与泛化复用表现。

title: Confidence scores for gated automation of large language models
summary: AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities in automated decision-making. However, LLMs may produce incorrect answers with high confidence, limiting their applicability in decisions that affect individuals and organizations. Reliable confidence scores are necessary to gate such decisions, and existing estimates are frequently unavailable or too coarse to support effective gating. This work uses supervised learning to train models to predict the correctness of LLM-generated answers, enabling automated confident responses and routing uncertain ones for human review. A linear confidence score head is fitted to the final-layer hidden state of the frozen LLM backbone, and text-only metamodels are trained as an alternative for closed models. All results come from a single 2B-parameter backbone, on graded answers that are about 98% SQuAD and the remainder TruthfulQA. Against multiple baselines, the confidence score head outperforms all baselines and metamodels, automating the largest fraction of the workload at high accuracy targets. Prompted confidence scores can appear well calibrated yet lack the resolution needed for thresholding. Although transferability to unseen datasets is modest, the confidence score head remains the most robust approach. The proposed confidence scoring framework enhances the safety of automating LLM-based agents and can be adapted to gate other properties, including safety or compliance.

AI.tldr: 通过在冻结的2B参数LLM骨干末层隐状态上拟合线性置信度评分头（及文本元模型备选），训练模型预测LLM答案的正确性，从而实现高准确率阈值下最大比例的自动化决策与不确定样本的人工路由。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体在自动化决策中能力强，但会以高置信度输出错误答案，限制其在影响个人与组织的决策场景中的应用。可靠置信度评分是此类决策门控的前提，而现有估计往往不可得或过于粗糙，难以支撑有效门控。
AI.method: 采用监督学习训练正确性预测模型：在冻结的LLM骨干最终层隐状态上拟合线性置信度评分头；对闭源模型则训练纯文本元模型作为替代方案。实验基于单一2B参数骨干，答案约98%来自SQuAD、其余来自TruthfulQA，并与多种基线对比。
AI.result: 置信度评分头优于全部基线与元模型，在高准确率目标下可自动化的负载比例最大；提示式置信度分数虽看似校准良好，却缺乏阈值化所需的分辨率；跨数据集迁移性一般，但置信度评分头仍是最稳健的方案。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的置信度评分框架可提升LLM智能体自动化的安全性，并可推广用于门控其他属性（如安全性或合规性）。

title: Large-scale Model Merging via Recovery-aware Task Weighting
summary: Model merging combines multiple task-specific expert models into a single model. However, merging preserves expert capabilities unevenly across tasks. This imbalance is particularly pronounced in large-scale settings, where some tasks can suffer severe capability losses even when average accuracy remains high. To address this imbalance, we introduce Recovery-aware Task Weighting (RaTW), a model merging framework that assigns larger weights to tasks whose expert capabilities are poorly retained by an initial merged model. We quantify these recovery opportunities as the fraction of a task's labeled validation samples that its expert predicts correctly but the initial merged model gets wrong, and use the resulting task weights to re-merge the experts. To evaluate merging at large scale, we construct CLIPMerge-100, a 100-task benchmark with task-specific experts on CLIP ViT-L/14 and ViT-B/32. Across eleven merging methods with 20, 50, and 100 tasks on two CLIP backbones, RaTW improves both mean accuracy and tail20 (the mean expert-normalized accuracy of the 20% worst-retained tasks) in all 33 ViT-L/14 settings and 32 of 33 ViT-B/32 settings. We further introduce ReForge++, which combines RaTW with iterative model refinement and outperforms all evaluated baselines, including a matched-budget control, in both mean accuracy and tail20 across all settings.

AI.tldr: 提出恢复感知任务加权(RaTW)模型合并框架，通过对初始合并模型保留差的任务赋更高权重再合并，缓解大规模多任务合并中的能力不均衡，并构建100任务CLIPMerge-100基准验证。
AI.motivation: 模型合并将多个任务专家整合为单一模型时，专家能力在各任务上的保留并不均衡；在大规模场景下平均精度虽高，个别任务仍可能严重退化（尾部任务损失）。因此需要一种以"恢复空间"为导向的合并策略来改善任务间均衡性。
AI.method: 1) 用初始合并模型与各任务专家在标注验证集上的预测差异量化恢复机会：即某任务中专家预测正确而初始合并模型预测错误的样本比例；2) 据此为任务分配更大的合并权重，并重新合并专家（RaTW）；3) 构建CLIPMerge-100基准，含100个任务级专家，基于CLIP ViT-L/14与ViT-B/32；4) 进一步提出ReForge++，将RaTW与迭代式模型精炼结合。
AI.result: 在20/50/100任务、两个CLIP骨干、11种合并方法的33+33个设置中，RaTW在全部33个ViT-L/14设置与32/33个ViT-B/32设置上同时提升平均精度与tail20（保留最差的20%任务的平均专家归一化精度）。ReForge++在所有设置上于平均精度和tail20两项指标上均优于全部基线，包括同等预算的对照方法。
AI.conclusion: 以任务级恢复空间为权重信号的再合并策略可有效缓解大规模模型合并的能力不均衡；与迭代精炼结合后进一步显著提升，兼顾整体性能与尾部任务保留。

title: Typical Angina, Reversed: A Long-Standing Documentation Error in the UCI Heart Disease Data
comment: 12 pages. Code and data: https://github.com/tpattabhi/anginaflip . An earlier version is on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24358545
summary:
The UCI Heart Disease data are a widely used machine-learning benchmark. We show that their chest-pain variable is stored in reverse of its documentation. At all four sites, the code documented as "asymptomatic" (4) marks patients with typical angina, and the code documented as "typical angina" (1) marks patients with almost none of the classical angina features (at Cleveland, no chest pain).
  Two complementary checks establish this: (i) the chest-pain table and regression coefficients of the original 1986 Cleveland study are reproduced only under the corrected reading; (ii) in the Budapest, Switzerland and Long Beach files, 93-96% of patients coded 4 have all three classical angina features. A 1990 word-labeled Cleveland file already uses the documented labels, and Statlog (Heart), a Cleveland subset, stores the same codes. OpenML, PMLB and two highly voted Kaggle copies that name the categories use the same documented labels (about 400,000 downloads combined).
  We audited a seeded random sample of 150 records from a pre-specified Scholar query for SHAP studies of these data mentioning asymptomatic chest pain (124 readable). Of 32 papers that state a direction for a named category, 25 (78%; 95% CI 61-89%) state one inconsistent with the corrected category identities; 22 (69%; 51-82%; post hoc) are attributable to the documentation error, and nine of these explain it clinically. None of the 124 readable papers identifies the reversal.
  Conventional models are essentially unaffected, one reason the error went unnoticed. Interpretations that attach the documented names to model effects are reversed, and zero-shot language-model classifiers that read the labels are misled: with the documented labels, three open-weight models lose 0.12-0.33 in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) given age, sex and chest-pain type. We give the corrected mapping, evidence and code.

AI.tldr: UCI心脏病数据集中胸痛变量编码与其文档记载相反："无症状"(4)实为典型心绞痛，"典型心绞痛"(1)实为几乎无典型特征；约78%的相关SHAP研究结论方向因此出错。
AI.motivation: UCI Heart Disease是广泛使用的机器学习基准数据集，但其文档与数据实际编码可能不一致，而这一问题长期未被发现，导致大量基于类别名称的模型解释出现方向性错误。
AI.method: 通过两项互补检验验证编码反转：(i)复现1986年Cleveland原始研究的胸痛表与回归系数；(ii)在Budapest、Switzerland、Long Beach文件中统计编码4患者的典型心绞痛特征比例。同时对预先设定的Scholar检索（SHAP研究、提及无症状胸痛）进行有种子随机抽样150篇，审计方向性陈述，并用开放权重语言模型做零样本分类检验。
AI.result: 仅在修正解读下才能复现原始研究结果；93–96%编码4患者具备全部三项典型心绞痛特征。124篇可读论文中32篇给出明确方向，其中25篇(78%, 95%CI 61–89%)与修正后的类别身份不符，22篇归因于文档错误、9篇给出临床解释，无人识别出编码反转。常规模型几乎不受影响，但零样本LLM分类器在给定年龄、性别、胸痛类型时AUC下降0.12–0.33。
AI.conclusion: 胸痛变量编码与文档相反，常规建模掩盖了该错误，但基于标签名称的解释与零样本语言模型分类会被误导；作者给出修正映射、证据与代码，提醒研究者在按类别名称解释模型效应时须谨慎。

title: DexEngine: Scaling Human Demonstrations into Physically Executable Whole-Robot Data
comment: Project page: https://wongyun-yu.github.io/dexengine/ Code: https://github.com/wongyun-yu/DexEngine Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Wongyun/DexEngine
summary: A growing body of recent work addresses the retargeting of human hand-object demonstrations to robotic hands. To train whole-robot policies, however, the retargeted motions must be kinematically feasible and physically executable, and be produced efficiently at scale. We present DexEngine, a simulation pipeline that turns human manipulation data into train-ready, physically executable arm-hand trajectories. DexEngine first places each clip's hand-object motion where the arms can reach it, finds an arm motion that follows the human hands, and then corrects the motion in physics simulation with residual reinforcement learning. From nine human hand-object datasets, we generate about 5,200 clips for each of four dexterous hands, augmented into 65,000 trajectories (116 h) and 325,000 episodes (578 h) in total. Even with arms attached, DexEngine tracks objects more accurately than prior floating-hand methods and runs over 10x faster than RL-based ones. Policies trained on our data far outperform those trained on the same clips without physics correction or with the arms attached after a floating-hand correction, showing that fine-tuning data need physics correction. Mid-training on our data further improves them at equal fine-tuning budget, in simulation and on a real robot.

AI.tldr: DexEngine 是一个仿真流水线，将人类手-物体演示数据转化为可供机器人策略训练的运动学可行、物理可执行的臂-手轨迹，并在规模、精度与速度上优于已有方法。
AI.motivation: 近期工作多聚焦于将人类手-物体演示重定向到灵巧手，但若要训练整机策略，重定向运动必须运动学可行、物理可执行，并能大规模高效生成。现有浮动手重定向方法缺乏手臂约束，RL 方法效率低。
AI.method: DexEngine 分三步：(1) 将每段手-物体运动放置于机械臂可达范围内；(2) 求解跟随人类手部运动的机械臂轨迹；(3) 在物理仿真中用残差强化学习对运动进行修正。基于 9 个人类手-物体数据集，为 4 种灵巧手各生成约 5,200 段片段。
AI.result: 共扩充为 65,000 条轨迹（116 小时）与 325,000 个 episode（578 小时）。即便附加手臂，DexEngine 的物体跟踪精度仍优于先前的浮动手方法，且运行速度比基于 RL 的方法快 10 倍以上。在其数据上训练的策略显著优于使用未经物理修正、或先浮动手修正后再接手臂的同一批片段训练的策略；在相同微调预算下，用其数据进行中期训练可进一步提升性能，且在仿真与真实机器人上均成立。
AI.conclusion: 物理修正对微调数据至关重要；DexEngine 能高效、大规模地生成整机可执行数据，兼具精度与速度优势，并可有效支持策略中期训练与真机迁移。

title: Partial Routing: Trace-Tuned Delegation for Resource-Efficient Agentic Workflows
summary: AI models vary enormously in capability and price. Model routing exploits this by sending easier tasks to cheaper models. However, a single agentic task often combines easy and difficult subtasks, making one model choice for the entire task inefficient. We introduce partial routing, which guides a frontier lead model to delegate suitable subtasks to a cheaper worker model. From both models' past runs, we identify recurring subtasks and measure each model's quality and cost on them. These measurements produce delegation guidance, with a parameter, $δ$, controlling how much is delegated. The lead decides when and what to delegate during execution, without training either model. On held-out tasks from ViBench and Terminal-Bench 4.0, partial routing achieves higher mean task performance than the lead alone and task-level routing. With $δ= 0.75$, it raises the lead's ViBench score from 70.2 to 78.5 at 19% lower cost, and its Terminal-Bench pass rate from 54% to 61% at similar cost. Giving the lead only the subtask breakdown, without a worker, also reduces cost on both benchmarks and raises the Terminal-Bench pass rate. These results show that analysis of past runs can support more efficient planning and more effective delegation, with little cost and implementation overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出"部分路由"(partial routing)：由前沿lead模型将合适子任务委派给更便宜的worker模型，基于两模型历史运行识别重复性子任务并测量质量与成本生成委派指导，无需训练。
AI.motivation: 模型路由通常按整体任务选择单一模型，但agentic任务往往混合易/难子任务，任务级单一选型效率低。
AI.method: 从两模型历史运行中识别重复子任务，测量各模型在其上的质量与成本，生成委派指导并用参数δ控制委派比例；lead在执行中自主决定何时、委派什么，不训练任何模型。
AI.result: 在ViBench与Terminal-Bench 4.0留出任务上优于lead单独运行与任务级路由；δ=0.75时ViBench得分由70.2升至78.5且成本降19%，Terminal-Bench通过率由54%升至61%且成本相近；仅提供子任务分解而无worker也能降低成本并提升Terminal-Bench通过率。
AI.conclusion: 历史运行分析可支撑更高效规划与更有效委派，成本与实现开销低。

title: What Does RL Post-Training Teach Text-to-Image Models? A Skill-Wise Analysis of Flow-GRPO
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has become a standard way to improve text-to-image flow models: Flow-GRPO lifts the GenEval score of SD3.5-M from 0.63 to 0.95, a gain read as the model having learned compositional generation. We ask how much of that gain the base model's own samples already contained, by measuring pass@k over shared noise seeds, one skill at a time, before and after RL, on prompts never used in training. The answer differs by skill. On four of GenEval's six skills, where 32 base samples already solve almost every prompt, the gain is sharpening: one post-trained sample is worth 4 to 10 base samples, and pass@32 barely moves. On spatial relations it is unlocking: pass@32 rises from 0.69 to 1.00, 128 base samples do not match one post-trained sample, and prompts the base model never solved in 32 samples are solved 93% of the time, as often as those it solved. The benchmark average, 31 base samples per post-trained sample, describes no skill. Relations carry 35% of the gain; of the other 65%, selecting among 8 base samples with the judge behind the reward recovers nine tenths. We propose an account of when each occurs: within a prompt, a group-relative update re-weights only the outcomes its samples contain, and a flow policy cannot widen the noise that produces them; across prompts, shared parameters let successes on some prompts repair a deficit common to many. The same anatomy applies to a text-rendering checkpoint. The account's predictions are tested with a checkpoint trained without KL, within-prompt diversity, and controlled training that holds object classes out, where sharpening comes first and transfers, and unlocking follows, on practised objects before unseen ones.

AI.tldr: 该论文用共享噪声种子下的pass@k分析拆解Flow-GRPO对SD3.5-M的增益来源，发现增益按技能分化：四项技能主要是"锐化"（重新加权已有样本），空间关系才是"解锁"（真正拓展能力边界），并提出了解释两种情形何时发生的理论框架。
AI.motivation: RL后训练（如Flow-GRPO将GenEval得分从0.63提升到0.95）常被解读为模型"学会了组合式生成"，但这一增益究竟有多少来自基座模型自身样本中已存在的能力、有多少是真正新增的能力，此前缺乏细粒度归因。作者希望用统一的评估框架回答这一"增益解剖"问题。
AI.method: 在训练未见过的prompt上，按技能逐一测量RL前后的pass@k曲线（共享噪声种子），量化"一个后训练样本等价于多少个基座样本"；进一步用奖励背后的judge在8个基座样本中做筛选以估计可恢复增益比例；并提出理论解释：提示内层面group-relative更新只重加权其采样已包含的结果、flow策略无法拓宽产生这些结果的噪声；跨提示层面共享参数使某些提示上的成功可修复多提示共有的缺陷。最后用无KL训练的检查点、提示内多样性、以及留出物体类别的受控训练来检验预测。
AI.result: GenEval六项技能中四项：32个基座样本几乎已解所有prompt，增益为锐化，1个后训练样本≈4–10个基座样本，pass@32几乎不变。空间关系：pass@32从0.69升至1.00，128个基座样本不及1个后训练样本，基座32样本从未解出的prompt有93%被解出（与已解出的prompt同等频率）。基准平均的"31个基座样本/后训练样本"不能描述任何单一技能。关系类贡献35%增益；其余65%中，用奖励judge在8个基座样本中筛选可恢复约九成。同解剖结论亦适用于文本渲染检查点。受控实验验证了预测：锐化先行且可迁移，解锁随后、先在练习过的物体上出现再扩展到未见物体。
AI.conclusion: RL后训练的基准分数提升大部分并非"学会新能力"，而是样本选择/锐化；真正的能力解锁集中出现于空间关系类任务。论文给出了区分锐化与解锁的可操作诊断（pass@k曲线形状、跨技能归因、筛选上界），并提出可检验的机制解释，为评估T2I强化学习提供了更诚实的分析范式。

title: FERRETS: A Scalable Symbolic Transform for Time Series Classification
comment: 42 pages including references and appendices, 19 figures
summary: Dictionary methods for time series build bags of symbolic words from subsequences, but the accurate ones scale poorly. Against other families of methods, their accuracy no longer pays for their cost. We present FERRETS, a label-free dictionary transform built on WEASEL~2. It keys windows of random length and dilation into exact eight-bit words, adds a level word of each window's mean and spread, and on multivariate data adds cross-channel words. We compare it with leading classifiers, deep networks and foundation models included, on the UCR, Multiverse and MONSTER archives. FERRETS is the fastest of the eleven methods timed on UCR under a ten-thread budget. Of the ten others, only MultiRocket-Hydra is significantly more accurate, taking 24.7 times as long. FERRETS is not significantly different from WEASEL~2, the most accurate earlier dictionary method, which takes 125 times as long, and is significantly ahead of the other dictionary methods. On the Multiverse core, it is not significantly different in accuracy from HIVE-COTE~2 and MultiRocket-Hydra, though behind both on UCR. It is also significantly more accurate than five frozen foundation models on UCR's published split. On the MONSTER problems both complete, MiniRocket takes 3.7 times as long to fit as the streaming FERRETS classifier, which is significantly more accurate.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FERRETS，一种基于 WEASEL 2 的无标签字典变换：将随机长度与膨胀率的窗口映射为精确的八位词，并加入窗口均值与离散度的层级词，多变量数据上再加入跨通道词；在 UCR、Multiverse、MONSTER 上以显著更低的代价取得与前沿方法相当的准确率。
AI.motivation: 时间序列字典方法通过子序列构建符号词袋，但高精度方法计算代价大、扩展性差；与其他方法家族相比，其精度已难以抵消成本。因此需要一个既保持字典方法精度又大幅降低计算与内存开销的变换。
AI.method: FERRETS 构建于 WEASEL 2 之上的无标签（label-free）字典变换：为随机长度与膨胀率的窗口生成精确的八位（eight-bit）符号词；为每个窗口的均值与离散度（spread）增加一个层级词；对多变量数据额外生成跨通道词。搭配流式分类器使用。
AI.result: 在 UCR（十线程预算）计时的十一种方法中 FERRETS 最快；其余十种中仅 MultiRocket-Hydra 显著更准，但耗时为其 24.7 倍；与最精确的早期字典方法 WEASEL 2 无显著差异，而后者耗时为其 125 倍；显著优于其他字典方法。Multiverse 核心集上与 HIVE-COTE 2 和 MultiRocket-Hydra 精度无显著差异（UCR 上落后于二者）。UCR 官方划分上显著优于五个冻结基础模型。MONSTER 上 MiniRocket 拟合耗时为其流式分类器的 3.7 倍，而 FERRETS 显著更准。
AI.conclusion: FERRETS 在保持字典方法级高精度的同时大幅降低时间与计算成本，是速度与精度权衡上更具实用性的时间序列分类方案；相较深度网络与基础模型亦具竞争力。

title: DFLAT: Model-based Diffusion on Differentially Flat Spaces for Long-Horizon Trajectory Optimization
summary: Long-horizon diffusion-based planning for kinodynamically constrained systems requires both scalability and feasibility, yet existing diffusion planners typically sacrifice one for the other. We present DFLAT, a diffusion-based planning algorithm that operates directly on a differentially flat trajectory representation. Instead of diffusing over time-discretized controls, DFLAT denoises a compact set of Hermite curve parameters in the flat-output space, consisting of intermediate waypoints together with the endpoint tangents of each segment. Every denoised sample maps to a dynamically consistent trajectory, so feasibility holds by construction rather than being restored afterward. Experiments on challenging tractor-trailer planning benchmarks show that DFLAT matches or exceeds the success rates of existing baselines at consistently lower planning times, particularly on long-horizon problems requiring multiple forward-reverse maneuvers. In cases where kinodynamic RRT requires over 100 seconds, DFLAT plans in subsecond time, enabling practical deployment.

AI.tldr: DFLAT 提出一种在微分平坦轨迹表示上直接进行扩散规划的方法：以 Hermite 曲线参数（中间路点及各段端点切向量）作为扩散变量，使去噪样本天然映射到动力学可行的轨迹，从而在构造上保证可行性。
AI.motivation: 长时域、受运动学/动力学约束的系统规划需同时满足可扩展性与可行性，而现有扩散规划器往往以牺牲一方为代价（在时间离散控制上扩散则维度高、需事后修复可行性；紧凑表示则可能损失可行性）。
AI.method: 不在时间离散控制序列上扩散，而是在平坦输出空间中对一组紧凑的 Hermite 曲线参数（中间路点 + 每段端点切向量）进行去噪。每个去噪样本经微分平坦映射即得动力学一致轨迹，可行性由构造保证而非后处理修复。
AI.result: 在具挑战性的牵引车-挂车（tractor-trailer）规划基准上，DFLAT 的成功率与现有基线持平或更优，且规划时间持续更低；在需要多次前进-倒车机动的长时域问题中优势明显，运动学 RRT 需 100 秒以上的情形下 DFLAT 可在亚秒级完成规划。
AI.conclusion: 将扩散规划与微分平坦表示结合可在保持轨迹可行性的同时显著提升长时域规划效率，具备实际部署价值。

title: Collaborative Language Models for Semantic IoT Data Processing: Validation through Zero-Shot Human Activity Recognition
summary: Internet of Things (IoT) systems generate low-level sensor observations that are not directly suitable for process analysis and must first be transformed into semantically meaningful events. This paper investigates collaborative language models as a zero-shot semantic abstraction layer for converting such observations into higher-level event and activity labels. We propose a five-stage workflow comprising semantic mapping, semantic aggregation, temporal and contextual aggregation, specialized reasoning, and final event abstraction. The resulting labels and contextual information can subsequently be represented as event records for downstream Process Mining (PM) tasks. The approach is evaluated through Human Activity Recognition on the CASAS Aruba smart home dataset using eleven workflow configurations. The experiments show that collaboration alone does not guarantee improved performance: general-purpose auxiliary SLMs can degrade recognition, whereas assigning complementary specialist roles leads to better results and allows a smaller final classifier to retain much of the performance of a larger model. The selected workflow achieves a macro F1 of 0.643 in the 1.5-day comparison and 0.567 (weighted F1 0.680) in a one-week evaluation. Although trained ML approaches remain more accurate on this dataset, the results demonstrate a different design point: modular semantic event abstraction using off-the-shelf models without task-specific parameter fine-tuning. The findings indicate that the structure of LM collaboration and task decomposition is more important than simply increasing the number of participating models.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个五阶段协作语言模型工作流，将IoT低层传感器观测零样本抽象为高层事件/活动标签，以便下游流程挖掘使用；在CASAS Aruba上以11种配置实验表明，协作结构（专家分工）比模型数量更关键。
AI.motivation: IoT系统产生的是低层传感器观测，不能直接用于过程分析，需要先转换为语义有意义的事件。现有方法通常依赖任务特定微调的机器学习模型，本文探索用现成语言模型以零样本方式充当语义抽象层。
AI.method: 提出五阶段工作流：语义映射、语义聚合、时序与上下文聚合、专门化推理、最终事件抽象；输出标签与上下文可表示为事件记录供流程挖掘（PM）使用。在CASAS Aruba智能家居数据集的人体活动识别任务上，以11种工作流配置进行评测。
AI.result: 协作本身不保证性能提升：通用辅助SLM可能降低识别效果，而赋予互补的专家角色效果更好，且能让更小的最终分类器保留较大模型的大部分性能。所选工作流在1.5天对比中宏F1为0.643，在一周评估中为0.567（加权F1 0.680）。
AI.conclusion: 在该数据集上训练的ML方法仍更准确，但本工作展示了另一种设计取向：使用现成模型、无需任务特定参数微调的模块化语义事件抽象。LM协作的结构与任务分解方式，比单纯增加参与模型数量更重要。

title: StyleID++: Position-Decoupled and Structure-Coherent Style Retrieval across Diffusion Architectures
summary: Attention injection offers a remarkably simple route to training-free style transfer: content queries retrieve style keys and values inside a pretrained diffusion model. We show that this operation also creates an overlooked failure mode. Position signals that are useful within one image become a spurious shared coordinate system across two spatially unrelated images, causing content tokens to favor style tokens at similar coordinates. This cross-image positional leakage appears in both convolutional U-Nets and diffusion transformers (DiTs), despite their different position mechanisms. Removing the positional shortcut exposes a second problem: unconstrained global retrieval lets related content tokens select incompatible style regions, producing fragmented appearance. We present StyleID++, a training-free framework that addresses the two problems jointly. Position-Decoupled Retrieval reduces coordinate-dependent matching through circular padding in U-Nets and injection-only RoPE removal in DiTs, while preserving native position modeling elsewhere. Affinity-Coherent Refinement then regularizes style assignments with the content self-attention graph, encouraging structurally related tokens to retrieve compatible style evidence. We quantify the leakage with a coordinate--centroid correlation and a permutation test on the style reference. The permutation error can be driven to zero in both backbones, which identifies the position mechanism as the carrier of the leakage, and StyleID++ obtains the best ArtFID of all methods we compare.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练风格迁移框架StyleID++，揭示并修复注意力注入中的"跨图像位置泄漏"与"全局检索不兼容"两类失效模式。
AI.motivation: 注意力注入式免训练风格迁移虽简单有效，但存在被忽视的失效模式：单图内部有用的位置信号在两张空间无关图像间变成虚假共享坐标系，使内容token偏好同坐标的风格token；去除该位置捷径后又暴露出第二个问题——无约束全局检索使相关的内容token选到不兼容的风格区域，导致外观碎片化。
AI.method: StyleID++为免训练框架，联合解决两个问题：(1) 位置解耦检索（Position-Decoupled Retrieval）：U-Net中采用循环填充、DiT中仅对注入分支移除RoPE，从而削弱坐标依赖匹配，同时保留其它位置的原始位置建模；(2) 亲和一致性精化（Affinity-Coherent Refinement）：用内容自注意力图正则化风格分配，使结构相关的token检索到相容的风格证据。并以坐标—质心相关性与风格参考上的置换检验量化泄漏。
AI.result: 跨图像位置泄漏在卷积U-Net与DiT中均出现，尽管二者位置机制不同；在两种骨干上置换误差均可降至零，证实位置机制即为泄漏载体；StyleID++在所比较方法中取得最优ArtFID。
AI.conclusion: 注意力注入的失败源于位置信号被误当作跨图像共享坐标，而非注入机制本身；通过位置解耦检索与亲和一致性精化的联合设计，可在免训练条件下同时消除位置泄漏与风格碎片化，获得更优的风格迁移质量。

title: One Token, Many Lessons: Sliding-Window Attention within Gated Delta Networks
summary: Linear attention compresses historical context into a fixed-size recurrent state, reducing the computational and memory costs of long-sequence modeling. From the perspective of test-time regression (TTR), the state matrix can be viewed as an online-learned regression model, where keys and values serve as inputs and targets respectively, and queries are used to read from the model. From this perspective, the effectiveness of state learning depends not only on the update rule but also on how the key-value learning pairs used for state updates are constructed. While existing work has largely focused on how the state is updated and organized, we investigate how the learning pairs used for state updates are constructed. To this end, we propose Sliding-Window Gated DeltaNet (SWGDN), which replaces short convolutions in Delta-Rule linear attention with sliding-window attention to perform content-dependent local aggregation of projected queries, keys, and values. Our experiments show that SWGDN makes the key-value pairs used in consecutive updates more similar in both GDN2 and KDA. In SWGDN, carrying information from the same token across updates can help the recurrent state reinforce a previously learned association. The local mixing strategy can be incorporated into any Delta-Rule-based linear attention architecture without changing its state update equations or chunkwise parallel algorithms. We apply this strategy to two Delta-Rule variants, GDN2 and KDA, and experimental results demonstrate that SWGDN outperforms the original Delta-Rule baseline across multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该文从测试时回归（TTR）视角指出线性注意力的状态学习不仅取决于更新规则，也取决于用于更新的键值学习对的构造方式，提出用滑动窗口注意力替代短卷积做内容相关的局部聚合，得到 SWGDN，在 GDN2 与 KDA 上均优于原始 Delta-Rule 基线。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力将历史上下文压缩为固定大小的递归状态，现有工作多聚焦于状态如何更新与组织，却忽视了用于状态更新的键值学习对（learning pairs）如何构造。从 TTR 视角看，状态矩阵是在线学习的回归模型，键/值为输入/目标、查询用于读取，因此学习对的质量直接决定状态学习效果。
AI.method: 提出 Sliding-Window Gated DeltaNet（SWGDN）：将 Delta-Rule 线性注意力中的短卷积替换为滑动窗口注意力，对投影后的 query、key、value 进行内容相关的局部聚合，从而构造更合理的键值学习对。该策略不改变状态更新方程与分块并行（chunkwise parallel）算法，可直接嵌入任意 Delta-Rule 架构。
AI.result: 实验显示 SWGDN 使 GDN2 与 KDA 中连续更新所使用的键值对更为相似；同一 token 的信息在多次更新间被携带，有助于递归状态强化此前学到的关联；在多个基准上 SWGDN 均超过原始 Delta-Rule 基线。
AI.conclusion: 状态学习的关键之一在于学习对的构造而非仅更新规则；滑动窗口式内容相关局部聚合是一种通用、低侵入的改进手段，可无缝集成到各类 Delta-Rule 线性注意力中以提升性能。

title: Greedy Decoding Hides Good Plans: Sample-and-Verify Planning for Vision-Language Driving Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly adopted for end-to-end driving planning, yet their performance is typically evaluated based on a single greedily decoded trajectory. However, greedy decoding may overlook better trajectories within the model's output distribution. Experiments on WOD-E2E and NAVSIM reveal a consistent performance gap between greedily decoded trajectories and the best sampled candidates, showing that planning errors can arise from trajectory selection, rather than trajectory generation alone. On WOD-E2E, when the ego vehicle should start moving, the model often assigns probability to different possible start times, causing greedy decoding to repeatedly favor waiting and produce a stationary plan even though moving trajectories are available. Motivated by these findings, we propose Sample-and-Verify (SaV), which keeps the VLM planner frozen and samples multiple candidate trajectories. A lightweight verifier is trained from ground-truth futures to estimate the relative quality of these candidates. It uses trajectory kinematics, candidate-set agreement and likelihood, and ego-motion features to select the final trajectory. On WOD-E2E, SaV reduces ADE and FDE by approximately 15% across three VLM planners on the validation set. Changes in RFS are smaller: two planners show slight decreases on val-456, while Alpamayo-1.5 improves from 7.74 to 7.81 RFS on the official test set as ADE@5s decreases by 11%. On NAVSIM, SaV reduces ADE@4s by 10-24% across three VLM planners, while PDMS changes are less consistent. These results show that trajectory selection can substantially improve displacement accuracy without additional planner training. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/hzxbzp/sample-and-verify.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出现有端到端驾驶VLM评估仅用贪心解码单条轨迹，易产生选择误差；提出Sample-and-Verify（SaV）：冻结VLM采样多条候选轨迹，用轻量验证器挑选最佳轨迹，在WOD-E2E上ADE/FDE降低约15%，NAVSIM上ADE@4s降低10–24%。
AI.motivation: VLMs用于端到端驾驶规划时通常只评估一条贪心解码轨迹，但贪心解码可能忽略输出分布中更优的候选。实验显示贪心轨迹与最优采样候选间存在稳定性能差距，说明规划误差部分源于"轨迹选择"而非"轨迹生成"。典型现象：应起步时模型对多个起步时刻分配概率，贪心解码反复偏好等待而产生静止规划。
AI.method: 提出Sample-and-Verify（SaV）：保持VLM规划器冻结，采样多条候选轨迹；基于真实未来轨迹训练轻量验证器，估计候选相对质量，输入特征包括轨迹运动学、候选集合一致性（agreement）与似然、自车运动（ego-motion）特征；由验证器选出最终轨迹。无需额外训练规划器。
AI.result: WOD-E2E验证集上，对三个VLM规划器ADE与FDE均降低约15%；RFS变化较小，两个规划器在val-456上略降，Alpamayo-1.5官方测试集RFS由7.74升至7.81，同时ADE@5s下降11%。NAVSIM上三个规划器ADE@4s降低10–24%，但PDMS变化不一致。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹选择是实现显著位移精度提升的关键环节，可在不额外训练规划器的前提下改善端到端驾驶规划；但位移指标提升明显而RFS/PDMS等综合指标收益有限且不稳定，表明选择策略仍需与整体驾驶质量对齐。

title: Dynamic Reasoning in Next-Gen Detection and Response: An Empirical Study of LLM Triage, Reinforcement Tuning, and Adversarial Evasion
comment: 13 pages (main text), 44 pages total with appendices, 5 figures, 56 experiments. Companion architectural design and threat model: https://jeremycanale.com/google-nextgen-detection/
summary: We present an end-to-end empirical study of dynamic reasoning in next-generation detection and response pipelines, evaluating how static classifiers, graph-based signal fusion, and large language model (LLM) triage agents perform under strict human-analyst attention budgets (Recall at B alerts/day). Across 56 reproducible experiments spanning a multi-layer enterprise-and-cloud simulator and four public datasets (SOREL-20M, BODMAS, LANL, and DARPA Transparent Computing), we test twelve architectural claims governing modern fleet-scale defense. First, we show that fleet growth halves recall at a fixed analyst budget even at negligible compute cost (<$0.0003 per million events), and that rarity-weighted graph risk propagation outperforms GraphSAGE without neural training. Second, evaluating frontier reasoning models (Gemini) and fine-tuned open-weight models (Qwen3-4B) for alert triage reveals that unconstrained LLM auto-closure eliminates 90% of false positives while silently discarding 31-44% of true attack cases. Third, post-training with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) causes severe reward hacking on unseen attack classes, suppressing up to 86% of novel attacks compared to two-epoch supervised fine-tuning. Finally, against an adaptive adversary generating plausible cover stories in benign telemetry fields, LLM triage evasion rises sharply unless gated by a deterministic policy harness prior to model invocation.

AI.tldr: 本文开展端到端实证研究，在固定人类分析师告警预算（Recall@B/AKD）约束下比较静态分类器、图信号融合与LLM分诊代理的动态推理表现，覆盖56组可复现实验与5个数据环境，检验12条现代规模化防御架构主张，并揭示自动闭环、GRPO后训练奖励黑客与自适应对抗规避等关键失效模式。
AI.motivation: 下一代检测与响应流水线普遍假设模型能力提升即可转化为防御收益，但真实运营受限于分析师的注意力预算（每天可处理的告警量），且缺乏在同等预算下对多类架构（静态分类、图融合、LLM分诊）的系统性对比与对后训练/对抗风险的实证检验。论文旨在填补这一“能力—运营”错配的评估空白。
AI.method: 构建多层企业+云仿真器，并结合四个公开数据集（SOREL-20M、BODMAS、LANL、DARPA Transparent Computing），设计56组可复现实验、检验12条架构主张。对比对象包括静态分类器、基于图的信号融合（稀有度加权风险传播 vs. GraphSAGE）、以及前沿闭源推理模型（Gemini）与微调开源权重模型（Qwen3-4B）作为告警分诊代理；并考察GRPO后训练与两轮监督微调（SFT）的差异，以及在良性遥测字段中注入合理掩护故事的自适应对抗者设定。
AI.result: (1) 在固定分析师预算下，舰队规模扩大会使召回率减半，即便单事件计算成本可忽略（<$0.0003/百万事件）；稀有度加权的图风险传播在不经神经训练的情况下优于GraphSAGE。(2) 无约束的LLM自动闭环可消除90%误报，但同时静默丢弃31%–44%的真实攻击样本。(3) GRPO后训练在未见攻击类别上出现严重奖励黑客，相较两轮SFT最多压制86%的新型攻击检出。(4) 面对生成合理掩护故事的自适应对抗者，若无确定性策略网关（policy harness）在模型调用前拦截，LLM分诊的规避率显著上升。
AI.conclusion: 规模化防御的瓶颈在于分析师注意力预算而非算力；模型能力提升不等于运营召回提升。LLM分诊与RL式后训练均存在系统性、隐蔽的漏报风险（自动闭环的静默丢弃、GRPO的分布外奖励黑客），因此必须采用确定性策略网关+V&V约束的混合架构，并在统一Recall@B指标与自适应对抗条件下进行评估。作者建议将预算约束下的召回、分布外攻击保持率与对抗鲁棒性作为架构选型的核心判据。

title: Do Not Let the Prior Heal the Anomaly: Selective Anchoring for Detection from Incomplete Measurements
comment: 26 pages, 7 figures, 23 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: Generative priors can recover anatomical detail from incomplete medical measurements, but may erase the very lesions that imaging aims to detect, even when the measurements contain evidence of them. We introduce selective anchoring that protects reliably measured image components from prior-driven changes, while allowing expressive generative models to reconstruct unresolved structure. Acquisition uncertainty in the protected components is either added deterministically to the downstream test or carried by the ensemble through stochastic perturbations of the readings. We implement this principle as a wrapper for pretrained diffusion and flow samplers and as AnchoredFM, a fast constrained flow model. Under a linear-Gaussian measurement model, the protected coefficients are unbiased in expectation and achieve nominal interval coverage across repeated acquisitions, independently of the learned prior. Across sparse-view CT, accelerated brain MRI, and photoacoustic tomography, selective anchoring improves lesion contrast preservation and uncertainty reliability, and can reduce reconstruction error within lesions. For tumor detection in accelerated MRI, with a healthy reference estimated from the measurements alone, deterministic anchoring raises mean AUROC across eight samplers from 78.4% to 84.6% and lesion sensitivity at 0.25 false-positive marks per slice from 38.8% to 47.5%, with gains in all four predefined tumor-size groups. At thresholds frozen on healthy validation data, mean sensitivity rises from 20.2% to 44.1% (37.6% with stochastic anchoring). These findings show how expressive generative priors can reconstruct unresolved anatomy without healing away the abnormalities that the measurements support.

AI.tldr: 提出"选择性锚定"（selective anchoring）：在扩散/流采样器中保护测量可靠的图像分量、仅让先验重建未解析结构，从而在稀疏视角CT、加速脑MRI与光声成像中既保留病灶对比度又不牺牲重建质量，显著提升加速MRI肿瘤检测性能。
AI.motivation: 生成式先验虽能从残缺医学测量中恢复解剖细节，但可能"抹除"成像本应检测的病灶——即使测量本身含有病灶证据。核心矛盾是：先验的表达力越强，越倾向于把异常结构"修复"成正常外观（healing away abnormalities），导致重建误差降低却诊断信息丢失。
AI.method: 1) 选择性锚定原则：将图像分量划分为"可靠测量"与"未解析"两类，前者禁止被先验驱动改变，后者交由生成模型重建。2) 获取不确定性处理：对受保护分量，或以确定性方式加入下游测试，或通过读数的随机扰动由集成传递。3) 实现为两个版本：(a) 预训练扩散/流采样器的包装器（wrapper）；(b) AnchoredFM，一种快速约束流模型。4) 理论分析：在线性-高斯测量模型下，受保护系数在期望上无偏，且在重复采集下达到名义区间覆盖率，与所学先验无关。
AI.result: 稀疏视角CT、加速脑MRI、光声断层成像三类任务中，选择性锚定提升病灶对比度保持与不确定性可靠性，并能降低病灶内重建误差。加速MRI肿瘤检测（健康参考仅由测量估计）：确定性锚定使8个采样器的平均AUROC从78.4%升至84.6%，每层0.25假阳性标记下的病灶敏感度从38.8%升至47.5%，四个预设肿瘤尺寸组均有提升；在健康验证数据上冻结阈值时，平均敏感度从20.2%升至44.1%（随机锚定为37.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 表达性强的生成式先验可以重建未解析解剖结构，同时不"治愈"掉测量所支持的异常——前提是对可靠测量分量施加锚定约束。该原理通用、可加装于现有采样器，兼具理论无偏性与实证诊断收益。

title: Fast and Scalable Abstract Interpretation for Deep Neural Networks
summary:
Abstract interpretation can certify properties of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), but precise analyses remain expensive. General implementations repeat work when analyzing the same architecture under different inputs and properties. Interleaving this work with numerical operations limits GPU utilization and restricts how much of the analysis a tensor compiler can process together.
  We present Scepter, a framework for specializing DNN abstract interpreters through structural semantics. The semantics determine the structure of intermediate abstract values while deferring their numerical evaluation. Structural computations from successive operations can therefore be performed together before certification, generating an executable tensor program. With the abstract interpreter and DNN architecture fixed, the program can be reused with different weights and input regions. We prove that it computes the same bounds as the general interpreter in exact arithmetic. The generated program also exposes operations and their dependencies for tensor compilation and memory planning. We implement Scepter for the tensor programs that Neuton generates from ConstraintFlow specifications.
  We evaluate Scepter on eight abstract interpreters and 44 DNNs against six baseline systems on GPUs and CPUs. Scepter handles networks with up to 153x as many neurons as the largest completed by the corresponding baselines. It completes DeepPoly on ResNet50 and VGG-16, whereas none of the evaluated DeepPoly baselines completes either network. On configurations completed by both systems, GPU geometric-mean speedups over Neuton range from 11.9x to 44.4x across eight analyses, with a 2.60x geometric-mean reduction in peak memory. In an input-splitting case study, Scepter proves 68 properties for which the baselines time out.
  Code: https://github.com/uiuc-focal-lab/constraintflow.git

AI.tldr: Scepter 通过"结构语义"把 DNN 抽象解释器特化为可复用的张量程序，在精确算术下与通用解释器等价，并在 GPU/CPU 上取得 11.9x–44.4x 加速与 2.60x 峰值内存下降。
AI.motivation: 抽象解释可为 DNN 提供性质认证，但精度高的分析代价昂贵。通用实现会在同一架构、不同输入与性质下重复计算；且把分析与数值运算交错执行会降低 GPU 利用率，并限制张量编译器能够整体融合处理的分析范围。
AI.method: 提出基于结构语义的抽象解释器特化框架：结构语义决定中间抽象值的结构，而将数值求值推迟，使相邻算子的结构性计算可在认证前合并执行，从而生成可执行张量程序；当解释器与网络架构固定时，该程序可对不同权重与输入区域复用。论文证明其在精确算术下与通用解释器算出相同界，生成程序显式暴露算子及依赖关系以便张量编译与内存规划。实现于 Neuton 从 ConstraintFlow 规范生成的张量程序之上。
AI.result: 在 8 种抽象解释器、44 个 DNN 上对比 6 个基线系统（GPU 与 CPU）：可处理网络的神经元规模最高达对应基线已完成规模的 153 倍；完成 ResNet50 与 VGG-16 上的 DeepPoly，而所有 DeepPoly 基线均未完成；在双方均完成的配置上，GPU 相对 Neuton 的几何平均加速为 11.9x–44.4x，峰值内存几何平均降低 2.60x；在输入分裂案例中证明 68 条基线超时的性质。
AI.conclusion: 将抽象解释的结构性计算与数值求值解耦并特化为可复用张量程序，可在不损失精确性的前提下显著提升可扩展性、吞吐与内存效率，为 DNN 形式化认证提供实用路径。

title: FreshVLA: Frequency-Regularized Time Scale Hierarchical Latent Actions for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Learning reusable latent actions from action-free videos offers an effective route to improving Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies. However, reconstruction-oriented latent actions do not necessarily benefit policy learning: as they may encode task-irrelevant static appearance with scene identity, or entangle slowly varying task progress with fine-grained execution dynamics in limited discrete code. We propose FreshVLA, a VLA framework built on a frequency-guided, dynamics-sensitive learning paradigm for acquiring temporally hierarchical continuous latent actions. FreshVLA uses a high-pass prior to guide visual transition encoding toward dynamical regions, thereby reducing reliance on static appearance cues. It further organizes latent actions into coarse-grained task progress and fine-grained execution dynamics through cross-timescale sampling and frequency-domain regularization, enhancing their capacity to represent long-horizon behaviors. During policy training, we freeze the pretrained latent action encoder and transfer its representations to robot control through joint flow-matching of latent and robot actions. FreshVLA achieves 98.2% average success on LIBERO and 98.0% on LIBERO-Long, exceeding GR00T-N1.6 on the latter by 3.6%. It also reaches an average sequence length of 4.52 on CALVIN and strong overall success rate of 80.4% in the zero-shot LIBERO-PLUS evaluation. Furthermore, FreshVLA exhibits greater robustness to visual perturbations and a more distinct division of roles between two branches in modeling low- and high-frequency motion, respectively. In 35-step action regression, it achieves a 51.3-percentage-point higher relative error reduction than its hierarchical discrete counterpart. Real-world experiments demonstrate that FreshVLA improves the average success rate over $π_{0.5}$ by 7.5%. The FreshVLA project page is available at https://freshvla.github.io/.

AI.tldr: FreshVLA 提出频率引导、动力学敏感的学习范式，从无动作视频中获取时序分层的连续潜动作，用于改进视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Long、CALVIN、LIBERO-PLUS 及真机任务上均取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有从无动作视频学习的潜动作以重建为目标，存在两个问题：1）会把与任务无关的静态外观/场景身份编码进潜动作；2）在有限的离散码中，将缓慢变化的任务进度与细粒度执行动力学纠缠在一起。因此重建导向的潜动作未必有利于策略学习。
AI.method: 1）利用高通先验引导视觉转移编码聚焦于动态区域，降低对静态外观线索的依赖；2）通过跨时间尺度采样与频域正则，将潜动作组织为粗粒度任务进度与细粒度执行动力学两级，增强长时程行为表达能力；3）策略训练时冻结预训练的潜动作编码器，通过潜动作与机器人动作的联合 flow-matching 将其表征迁移到机器人控制。
AI.result: LIBERO 平均成功率 98.2%，LIBERO-Long 98.0%（超 GR00T-N1.6 3.6 个百分点）；CALVIN 平均序列长度 4.52；零样本 LIBERO-PLUS 总成功率 80.4%；对视觉扰动更鲁棒，两分支在低/高频运动建模上分工更清晰；35 步动作回归中相对误差下降幅度比层次化离散方案高 51.3 个百分点；真机平均成功率较 π0.5 提升 7.5%。
AI.conclusion: 以频率为引导、动力学敏感的连续分层潜动作学习，可有效消除重建导向潜动作中的外观冗余与尺度纠缠，显著提升 VLA 策略的精度、长时程能力、鲁棒性与真机泛化性。

title: CA-RAG: Constraint-Aligned Retrieval for Structurally Faithful Long-Form Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically optimises evidence selection for semantic relevance, whereas compliance-sensitive long-form generation also requires evidence supporting explicit structural obligations. Semantically relevant retrieval may therefore omit information needed for mandatory downstream clauses. We propose Constraint-Aligned RAG (CA-RAG), a retrieval-conditioning framework that augments section-specific queries with ontology-derived structural constraints and policy-grounded knowledge-graph relations before evidence selection. Retrieval-only evaluation with manually annotated evidence shows consistent improvements across retrieval budgets. At $k=6$, CA-RAG increases Precision@$k$ from $0.5268$ to $0.5692$, pooled Recall@$k$ from $0.5402$ to $0.5950$, and F1@$k$ from $0.5389$ to $0.5672$ over standard RAG. Generation experiments further show improvements in compliance and reliability in several model--domain settings, while generation-only constraints achieve higher clause coverage but lower overall compliance and reliability. These results indicate that structurally aligned retrieval can improve evidence sufficiency in compliance-sensitive long-form generation.

AI.tldr: 提出约束对齐检索增强生成框架CA-RAG，在查询中注入本体结构约束与政策知识图谱关系，提升合规敏感长文本生成的证据充分性。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG仅按语义相关性筛选证据，而合规敏感的长文本生成还需要支撑强制性结构义务的证据，纯语义检索可能遗漏下游必备条款所需信息。
AI.method: 构建CA-RAG检索条件化框架：在分节查询中融入本体衍生的结构约束与基于政策的知识图谱关系，再进行证据选择。
AI.result: 在人工标注证据的纯检索评测中，各检索预算下均稳定提升；k=6时较标准RAG，Precision@k由0.5268升至0.5692，pooled Recall@k由0.5402升至0.5950，F1@k由0.5389升至0.5672；生成实验中多组模型-领域设置下合规性与可靠性提升，而仅生成阶段加约束虽条款覆盖更高，但整体合规与可靠性更低。
AI.conclusion: 结构对齐的检索可有效提升合规敏感长文本生成中的证据充分性，且约束应作用于检索环节而非仅生成环节。

title: Temporal Weight Surgery: Repairing Video Grounding with LLM Editors
comment: 35 pages, 18 figures, 23 tables, including supplementary material
summary: A surgeon first finds what is wrong, then fixes only that part. We use this idea for video grounding, where video-language models often find the right moment in a long video but write its time wrong. In Temporal Weight Surgery (TWS), a general-purpose LLM reads the model's weights and activations, finds where the error arises and repairs it there, without gradients. Separate sessions find the same cause, and this diagnosis of where and why the model fails is our main contribution. Three GPT-6 Astra sessions trace a dropped digit in TimeLens-8B to one MLP layer, and the largest edit gains 7.9 mIoU on 1,215 unseen questions and 18.3 on videos of 30 minutes or more. Two Claude Opus 5.5 sessions trace minutes written as seconds in Qwen3-VL-8B to the separator and gain 2.9 and 1.3. Before any edit, its answers often have the right minute and the wrong separator, and fixing only the separator lifts their mIoU from 13.1 to 19.2. Every improving edit beats a random edit of its size, and the edited models run as fast as before.

AI.tldr: 提出Temporal Weight Surgery (TWS)：让通用LLM在无梯度条件下读取视频语言模型的权重与激活，定位时间戳错误的产生位置并做局部修复；核心贡献是“在哪、为何失败”的诊断。
AI.motivation: 视频语言模型在长视频中常能找到正确片段，却把时间戳写错（如丢数字、分秒混淆）。这类错误非能力缺失而是局部表征问题，因此需要可解释的定位与精准修复手段，而非整体重训练。
AI.method: 类比外科手术“先诊断后局部修复”。由通用LLM（GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5.5）分别读取模型权重与激活，独立会话交叉验证同一错误根因，随后仅对定位到的MLP层或分隔符相关权重做无梯度编辑，并与同规模随机编辑作对照。
AI.result: TimeLens-8B的丢位数错误被追踪至单一MLP层，最大编辑在1215个未见问题上提升7.9 mIoU，30分钟以上视频提升18.3；Qwen3-VL-8B的“分写成秒”被定位到分隔符，两次会话分别提升2.9与1.3，仅修分隔符使mIoU从13.1升至19.2。所有有效编辑均优于同规模随机编辑，编辑后推理速度不变。
AI.conclusion: 时间戳错误可由通用LLM跨会话稳定诊断并局部手术式修复，具有可复现的因果定位、显著增益与零推理开销，说明“先定位再修复”可作为视频grounding模型纠错的一般范式。

title: Two Timescales of Forgetting in Fine-tuning of Language Models: Fast Behavioral Suppression and Slow Representational Drift
summary: Today, a core pipeline of artificial intelligence systems is pretraining on a broad range of text corpora and then fine-tuning on specific tasks or desired behaviors. Yet we still have limited understanding of how fine-tuning on a restricted data distribution modifies representations acquired during pretraining. In particular, it remains unclear whether surface behavioral suppression happens together with the erasure of latent representations that support it. In this work, we study supervised fine-tuning (SFT) by pretraining transformers on a controlled context-free grammar with hierarchical latent structure, the Random Hierarchy Model (RHM), and fine-tuning with a restricted subset of its generative rules. While during pretraining the model's ability to generate with the correct grammar rules coincides with building the internal representations of the corresponding latent, we find that SFT exhibits a very different dynamics: (i) the generation of deleted rules changes on a fast timescale inversely proportional to the magnitude of the token-latent correlation; meanwhile, their corresponding representations stay intact; (ii) the hidden representations of the deleted rules become forgotten on a much longer timescale, associated with a slow drift of the network parameters. Finally, we observe analogous results in a realistic setup with natural language, suggesting that this timescale separation in forgetting is a more general phenomenon of fine-tuning language models.

AI.tldr: 论文通过受控的随机层级模型（RHM）研究监督微调（SFT）如何改变预训练得到的表征，发现"行为遗忘"与"表征遗忘"存在显著的时间尺度分离：被删除规则的生成行为快速消失，而其内部隐表征在很长时间内仍然完好，随后才随参数缓慢漂移而被遗忘，并在自然语言实验中观察到类似现象。
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统的核心范式是"大规模语料预训练 + 特定任务微调"，但对受限数据分布上的微调如何修改预训练所获得的表征仍缺乏理解。尤其是尚不清楚：表面行为的抑制（行为层面不再生成某类输出）是否必然伴随着支撑该行为的潜在表征被擦除。作者希望厘清行为遗忘与表征遗忘之间的关系及其时间动力学。
AI.method: 构建可控实验框架：在具有层级潜在结构的上下文无关文法（Random Hierarchy Model, RHM）上预训练Transformer，使其学会文法规则及其对应的潜变量表征；然后用生成规则的一个受限子集进行监督微调（即"删除"部分规则）。通过追踪不同时间尺度上的生成行为变化与内部隐表征（探针/表征相似性）以及网络参数漂移，分析遗忘动力学；并在真实自然语言设置中做类比验证。
AI.result: (i) 被删除规则的生成行为在快速时间尺度上改变，该尺度与token–潜变量相关强度的量级成反比，但对应的内部表征在此期间保持完好；(ii) 被删除规则的隐藏表征在长得多的尺度上才被遗忘，且该过程与网络参数的缓慢漂移相关联。预训练阶段则不同：生成正确文法规则的能力与相应潜变量内部表征的建立是同步的。在自然语言的真实设置中也观察到类似结果。
AI.conclusion: SFT中"行为遗忘"与"表征遗忘"存在明显的时间尺度分离，行为抑制并不等于潜在表征的擦除；这种遗忘的时间尺度分离可能是语言模型微调的更普遍现象，对理解微调机制、能力遗忘与鲁棒性具有启示意义。

title: Lab2Sim: Agentic Generation of Interactive Laboratory Equipment from Operation Videos
summary: Generating laboratory assets that faithfully reproduce the appearance, structure, and joint motions of real equipment remains challenging. Existing asset generation methods struggle to directly generate simulation assets for all equipment observed in operation videos and to faithfully reproduce the appearance, joint motions, and internal cavities of the real equipment. To address the challenge, we present Lab2Sim, an agentic framework that generates editable, simulation-ready laboratory equipment assets from egocentric or multi-view operation videos. Lab2Sim comprises four specialized agents. The Evidence Agent combines video observations with laboratory knowledge to specify equipment parts, materials, and functional requirements, which guide the Asset Agent in constructing editable Blender assets. The independent Verifier checks the generated geometry and appearance against the evidence and requirements, providing targeted feedback for revision. The Simulation Integration Agent converts verified Blender assets into simulation instances with physical properties and articulated mechanisms, using execution feedback to refine their behavior. Experiments on human and robot laboratory scenes show that Lab2Sim achieves higher visual fidelity and stronger interaction capability than coding-agent and real-to-sim baselines, including a Codex baseline using the same underlying model. We further demonstrate valve-controlled drainage and use the generated asset library to reproduce laboratory scenes and operations in RoboTwin, supporting reusable simulation environments for robotic laboratory tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Lab2Sim，一个由四个专用智能体组成的框架，可从第一人称或多视角操作视频自动生成可编辑、可直接仿真（simulation-ready）的实验室设备资产，在视觉保真度与交互能力上优于编码智能体与 real-to-sim 基线。
AI.motivation: 从真实操作视频中生成忠实还原设备外观、结构、关节运动乃至内部空腔的仿真资产十分困难；现有资产生成方法难以对所有在操作视频中出现的设备直接生成仿真资产，也难以同时复现其外观、关节运动与内部结构。
AI.method: Lab2Sim 由四个专用智能体构成：(1) Evidence Agent 将视频观测与实验室知识结合，明确设备部件、材料与功能需求；(2) Asset Agent 依据上述信息构建可编辑的 Blender 资产；(3) 独立的 Verifier 依据证据与需求校验生成资产的几何与外观，并给出针对性修订反馈；(4) Simulation Integration Agent 将通过校验的 Blender 资产转换为具备物理属性与关节机构的仿真实例，并利用执行反馈优化其行为。
AI.result: 在人类与机器人实验室场景上的实验表明，Lab2Sim 相比编码智能体基线与 real-to-sim 基线（包括使用相同底层模型的 Codex 基线）具有更高的视觉保真度和更强的交互能力；进一步演示了阀门控制排水任务，并用生成的资产库在 RoboTwin 中复现实验室场景与操作。
AI.conclusion: Lab2Sim 能够从操作视频端到端生成可编辑、可仿真的实验室设备资产，并支持可复用的机器人实验室任务仿真环境构建。

title: Learning to Reason in Real-Time
summary: AI agents that operate in the real world must reason correctly and on-time, yet they currently do not account for how time should alter their reasoning. Modern agents learn to do tasks in environments that are entirely synchronous: where the world waits for the agent to act before changing. A real-time environment, by contrast, changes independent of the agent. Existing approaches try to bridge this gap by imposing a ratio of thinking to acting. However, for an agent to succeed in real-time it must learn to act quickly when delay is costly and to reason longer when the benefit outweighs the missed opportunities. To this end, we introduce real-time reasoning training (RRT) as the class of training techniques for real-time reasoning agents. We develop three standard RRT techniques: (1) using real-time data, (2) decoupling acting and observing, and (3) curriculum learning in time. Together, these simple techniques substantially outperform strong baselines. Across time pressures, we outperform the strongest non-RRT baseline by an average of 33% reward on in-distribution and 55% reward on out-of-distribution tasks in two real-time environments: Frogger and Snake. These results demonstrate that we can teach agents to balance reasoning and responsiveness under real-time constraints, and that RRT opens a broad, new set of capabilities for real-time agents.

AI.tldr: 提出"实时推理训练(RRT)"这一训练范式，通过实时数据、解耦行动与观察、时间课程学习三项技术，使智能体学会在延迟代价高时快速行动、收益更大时延长推理，在Frogger与Snake上平均超越最强基线33%（分布内）与55%（分布外）。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体大多在完全同步的环境中训练（世界等待智能体行动后才演化），而真实世界是异步、独立于智能体变化的实时环境。已有方法仅通过固定"思考-行动"比例来弥合差距，但无法让智能体根据情境自适应地权衡推理时长与响应及时性。
AI.method: 将实时推理训练定义为面向实时推理智能体的训练技术类别，并给出三种标准技术：(1) 使用实时数据训练；(2) 将行动与观察解耦；(3) 在时间维度上进行课程学习。
AI.result: 在Frogger与Snake两个实时环境中，跨多种时间压力设置，平均超过最强非RRT基线：分布内任务奖励提升33%，分布外任务提升55%。
AI.conclusion: 简单而有效的RRT技术能够教会智能体在实时约束下平衡推理深度与响应速度，为实时智能体开辟了一类新的能力方向。

title: LGCount: Layout-Guided Diffusion for Zero-Shot Object Counting
summary: Class-agnostic counting requires the user to specify what to count, usually with a class name or a few annotated boxes. We propose a richer text-based specification: a structured layout that names the target, the region that holds it, the distractors to ignore. A prompt upsampler writes this layout from the image and the requested category alone, and an image-editing diffusion model, adapted into a single-step counter, turns it into a density map. Because counting datasets pair each image with a single valid density map, a counter trained on it learns to ignore the layout. We therefore train on synthetic counterfactuals in which one image admits several valid density maps, so that the layout cannot be ignored. On FSC-147 we improve on the previous zero-shot state of the art and we set the best reported result on LOOKALIKES while being told the least about each image. A single photograph can be counted by category, by region, or by granularity without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出以结构化布局文本（目标/区域/干扰物）作为计数规范，用提示上采样器生成布局、由扩散编辑模型单步预测密度图，并用合成反事实数据迫使其真正利用布局，在FSC-147与LOOKALIKES上取得领先。
AI.motivation: 现有类无关计数仅靠类别名或少量标注框指定目标，规范信息过弱，难以表达"计什么、在哪里计、忽略什么"；同时现有计数数据集每张图只对应一个有效密度图，导致模型倾向忽略输入提示而退化为纯图像回归。
AI.method: 1) 定义结构化布局文本规范，显式给出目标类别、承载区域与需忽略的干扰物；2) 用提示上采样器仅依据图像与请求类别自动生成该布局；3) 将图像编辑扩散模型改造为单步计数器，直接输出密度图；4) 构建合成反事实训练数据，使同一图像对应多个有效密度图（改变区域/粒度/干扰项），消除布局与密度图之间的伪捷径，迫使模型依赖布局条件。
AI.result: 在FSC-147上超过此前零样本最优方法；在LOOKALIKES上取得已报告最佳结果，且对每张图像提供的先验信息最少；无需重训练即可在单张图像上按类别、按区域或按粒度进行计数。
AI.conclusion: 更强的文本规范（结构化布局）配合反事实监督，可显著提升类无关计数的可控性与精度；所提框架统一支持多种计数模式，说明提示条件化计数是可扩展方向。

title: Change Partners at Every Layer: Balanced Random Regrouping for Model Merging
summary: Model merging combines fine-tuned experts into one model that serves many tasks without retraining, but merging many experts this way substantially reduces accuracy. Grouping offers a middle ground: at every layer or weight matrix, the $N$ experts are divided into $K<N$ groups, the experts in a group are merged into one shared module, and a task uses the module merged from its expert's group. Natural choices are to keep the same partners across layers or to group similar experts. Surprisingly, we find that randomly changing partners at every layer outperforms both. We call this Balanced Random Regrouping (BRR): it independently partitions the experts into $K$ equal-sized random groups at each layer (BRR-layer) or weight matrix (BRR-matrix) and merges each group with an existing method. With validation-selected merge scales, both BRR variants outperform reusing one grouping across layers in all 24 CLIP settings, by 1.0-6.8 points, and BRR-matrix also outperforms the similarity-based FlexMerge in every setting. A first-order analysis explains this gain. At each layer, merging a task's expert with its partners shifts the task's output features; when the partners are the same at every layer, these shifts tend to point in similar directions and add up, whereas with new partners at every layer they vary independently and add up less on average. A series of experiments supports this analysis, which further guides a grouping search that can outperform BRR.

AI.tldr: 提出平衡随机重分组（BRR）：在每一层或每个权重矩阵上把N个专家独立地划分成K个等大随机组并各组内合并，效果优于跨层固定分组与相似度分组。
AI.motivation: 模型合并可将多个任务微调专家合并为单一多任务模型而无需重训练，但合并众多专家会显著降低精度。分组合并在每层/权重矩阵处将N个专家分为K<N组、组内合并为共享模块，每任务使用其所属组模块，是精度与共享之间的折中；然而如何选择分组伙伴（跨层保持一致 vs. 按相似度分组）尚不清楚哪种更优。
AI.method: 提出Balanced Random Regrouping（BRR）：在每一层（BRR-layer）或每个权重矩阵（BRR-matrix）上独立地将N个专家随机均分为K个等大组，组内采用现有合并方法融合；合并尺度由验证集选择。与"跨层复用同一分组"及基于相似度的FlexMerge进行对比，并用一阶分析解释增益，进而指导分组搜索。
AI.result: 在全部24个CLIP设置中，两种BRR变体均优于跨层复用同一分组，提升1.0–6.8个点；BRR-matrix在每个设置上也优于基于相似度的FlexMerge。一阶分析表明：每层将任务专家与其伙伴合并会偏移该任务输出特征，跨层伙伴固定时偏移方向趋同而累积放大，逐层更换伙伴时偏移独立变化、平均累积更小；系列实验支持该分析。
AI.conclusion: 在层/矩阵级别随机重分组（而非全层固定或相似度分组）能更有效地抑制合并误差累积，是一种简单且强力的分组合并策略；该分析进一步可指导分组搜索，获得优于BRR的结果。

title: $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM: Efficient Hierarchical Memory Across Modalities and Timescales for World-Action Models
summary: Long-horizon robotic manipulation requires historical context, yet retaining extensive visual histories incurs growing storage and retrieval costs, while aggressive compression risks losing fine-grained information needed for subsequent decisions. Moreover, executed action histories capture intermediate behaviors that sparse visual observations may miss. Preserving this complementary context efficiently calls for modality-specific memory mechanisms that balance recent detail with long-term retention. To this end, we introduce $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM, a world-action model equipped with hierarchical visual and interaction memories. $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM preserves recent visual observations in dense short-term memory while consolidating entries evicted from this window into fixed-size associative long-term memory through gated delta updates. Within the same short- and long-term hierarchy, interaction memory encodes executed action prefixes into compact temporal representations, complementing visual observations with behavioral context. These complementary memories are integrated into world-action modeling through layer-wise retrieval, enabling memory-augmented action generation with a bounded online memory footprint independent of episode length. On the memory-dependent simulation benchmarks MIKASA-Robo and RMBench, $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM achieves +53.2% and +61.2% absolute improvements in average success rates over Fast-WAM, respectively. These gains extend to real-world manipulation, where $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM achieves a +29.3% absolute improvement over LingBot-VA in average success across three tasks. These results suggest that $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM offers a promising approach to efficient memory-augmented world-action modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出 M²-WAM 世界-动作模型，通过分层视觉记忆与交互记忆实现有界内存的长程机器人操作。
AI.motivation: 长程机器人操作依赖历史上下文，但完整保留视觉历史带来存储与检索开销增长，而激进压缩又损失细粒度信息；同时已执行动作历史包含稀疏视觉观测遗漏的中间行为，需要模态特定的记忆机制在近期细节与长期保留间取得平衡。
AI.method: 设计分层视觉记忆：近期观测存于密集短期记忆，被淘汰条目经门控 delta 更新整合进固定大小联想长期记忆；在同一短/长期层级下，交互记忆将已执行动作前缀编码为紧凑时序表示；两类记忆通过逐层检索融入世界-动作建模，实现内存占用与回合长度无关的有界在线记忆。
AI.result: 在 MIKASA-Robo 与 RMBench 上相较 Fast-WAM 平均成功率绝对提升 +53.2% 与 +61.2%；真实世界三任务上相较 LingBot-VA 平均成功率绝对提升 +29.3%。
AI.conclusion: M²-WAM 为高效记忆增强的世界-动作建模提供了有前景的方案。

title: PeerReveal: Learning to Generalize in AI Peer Review Detection
summary: Can we distinguish fully AI-generated reviews from those using AI only to rewrite human judgement? Furthermore, can we do so reliably when reviews are generated from diverse AI models and workflows across scientific domains? To this end, we introduce PeerReveal, a new detector that grounds its decisions in learned relationships between a review's claims and reference claims drawn from AI-generated reviews of the same paper, complemented by review-level textual signals. We evaluate PeerReveal on PeerShift, a new, challenging test set of 5,430 reviews spanning multiple domains, including machine learning, life sciences, and social sciences, combining variation in disciplinary review conventions with diverse AI review-production mechanisms. With regular training, PeerReveal achieves 70.52% pooled Macro-F1 on this benchmark, improving over the strongest baseline by 11.48 points. We develop an effective and practical adversarial training framework that further improves the detector's generalization using a small local generator optimized to produce challenging reviews, raising pooled Macro-F1 from 70.52% to 82.40%. These results show that robust AI-review detection benefits from richer review-level evidence and adversarial training on more challenging generation processes.

AI.tldr: 提出PeerReveal检测器，基于评审意见与AI生成参考声明的关系建模并结合评论文本信号，在跨领域、多生成机制的PeerShift基准上以对抗训练将Macro-F1由70.52%提升至82.40%。
AI.motivation: 现有AI评审检测多针对完全由AI生成的评审，难以区分"完全AI生成"与"仅用AI改写人类判断"的评审；且需在多种AI模型、生成流程与不同学科评审惯例下保持可靠。
AI.method: 构建PeerReveal检测器：将评审中的声明（claims）与同一论文的AI生成评审中的参考声明进行关系学习作为判定依据，并辅以评审层面的文本特征；同时构建PeerShift测试集（5,430条评审，覆盖机器学习、生命科学、社会科学等，含多样AI评审生成机制）；并设计基于小型本地生成器的对抗训练框架，生成更具迷惑性的评审以提升泛化。
AI.result: 常规训练下PeerReveal在PeerShift上取得70.52%的合并Macro-F1，较最强基线提升11.48个点；对抗训练后提升至82.40%。
AI.conclusion: 稳健的AI评审检测依赖于更丰富的评审级证据，以及对更具挑战性生成过程的对抗训练。

title: DDxBasis: Explaining Frozen Foundation Encoder-based Medical Classification by Exact Differential Diagnosis
summary: In differential diagnosis (DDx), a clinician explains a diagnosis by the few findings that separate it from the alternatives. Medical image classifiers cannot yet explain themselves this way. Existing explanations are either faithful but spread over hundreds of concepts, or compact but leave part of each decision unexplained. We present DDxBasis, which explains a classifier on a frozen foundation encoder as a differential diagnosis in three steps. First, a concept bottleneck reads all patch tokens at every encoder layer using gated, second-order slot attention. A concept basis then regroups the concepts into two-pole axes, each a differential between groups of diagnoses. Finally, we read a differential diagnosis from each axis through the typical presentation of its poles, the pertinent findings of the case, and counterfactual edits of borderline cases. Across five medical datasets, DDxBasis is the most accurate frozen-encoder model and close to the best published domain-specific results. Because every concept adds its own evidence, its reproducible concept basis splits each decision exactly, at no cost in accuracy. Without ordered stage or concept labels, the axes recover cell lineages and rare subtypes, agree with dermatologists' structure annotations, and expose planted and real shortcuts.

AI.tldr: 提出DDxBasis，在冻结基础编码器上以"鉴别诊断"形式解释医学图像分类器：用门控二阶slot attention构建概念瓶颈，再以两极性概念基组织概念，并沿每条轴读出鉴别诊断，实现既紧凑又完全分解决策的解释。
AI.motivation: 临床鉴别诊断依靠少数能把目标诊断与备选诊断区分开的关键征象来解释诊断，而现有医学图像分类器无法如此解释自身：忠实的概念解释往往分散在数百个概念上，紧凑的解释又留下部分决策未被说明。论文希望在"忠实性"与"紧凑性"之间取得统一。
AI.method: (1) 在冻结基础编码器上，用带门控的二阶slot attention在每一编码层读取全部patch token，形成概念瓶颈；(2) 概念基将概念重组为两极性轴，每轴代表两组诊断之间的差异（differential）；(3) 通过两极的典型表现、病例的相关征象以及边界病例的反事实编辑，从每条轴读出鉴别诊断。整个过程不依赖有序的阶段标签或概念标签。
AI.result: 在五个医学数据集上，DDxBasis是冻结编码器模型中最准确的，并接近已发表的最佳领域专用结果；概念基将每个决策精确分解且不损失准确率。无需有序阶段或概念标签，轴即恢复出细胞谱系与罕见亚型，与皮肤科医生的结构标注一致，并揭示出不相关的捷径特征（植入与真实）。
AI.conclusion: DDxBasis表明，医学图像分类器的解释可以同时做到紧凑与忠实，并以符合临床鉴别诊断习惯的形式呈现；其概念基具有可复现性与诊断学意义，可作为可信解释的通用框架。

title: Sparse Adaptation for In-Context Learning on Data Streams
summary: The Internet of Things (IoT) generates massive data streams, making edge computing essential for low-latency applications and 5G networks. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) enable adaptation through in-context examples rather than parameter updates, but evolving streams challenge context relevance and computational efficiency. This work introduces SAIL, a framework for sparse adaptation of TFMs that reuses the model's key--value cache between adaptation events. SAIL reconstructs its support set only when drifts in stream structure indicate potential context inadequacy, while the structural representation itself is updated by changes in predictive performance. SAIL combines prequential error monitoring with online, class-specific micro-clustering to detect changes in cluster mass, class separability, and feature-space coverage. Upon adaptation, a context budget is allocated proportionally to class mass, and the most recently updated micro-clusters provide representative observations for refitting. This limits context redundancy and computational cost while preserving recent structural information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SAIL，一个面向表格基础模型（TFM）的稀疏自适应框架：仅在流结构漂移表明上下文可能失效时才重建支持集，并复用模型键值缓存（KV cache），以降低上下文冗余与计算开销。
AI.motivation: IoT 产生的海量数据流使边缘计算与 5G 低时延应用至关重要。表格基础模型可借助上下文示例（而非参数更新）实现适配，但不断演化的数据流会破坏上下文相关性，并带来计算效率问题。
AI.method: SAIL 在两次适配事件之间复用键值缓存；用序贯（prequential）误差监控结合在线的类特定微聚类，检测簇质量、类可分性与特征空间覆盖度的变化；仅当这些结构漂移提示上下文可能不足时才重建支持集。适配时按类质量比例分配上下文预算，并选取最近更新的微簇提供代表性观测用于重新拟合。
AI.result: 该设计在保留近期结构信息的同时限制了上下文冗余与计算成本；摘要为方法性描述，未给出量化实验结果。
AI.conclusion: SAIL 通过"漂移触发的稀疏适配 + KV 缓存复用 + 类质量比例预算"的组合，为流式场景下表格基础模型的高效上下文自适应提供了可行方案。

title: A general-purpose safe manipulator planning framework for diverse environments without retraining
comment: 46 pages, 7 figures; main text and supplementary materials
summary: Nowadays, robots need to be retrained whenever their operating environment changes, and this prohibitive training cost keeps them far from daily use. The community is calling for innovations that bestow on a robot the ability to safely grasp different objects under different conditions without excessive training data and computing power. In response to this call, we present a general-purpose manipulator mission-planning framework, allowing a robot to safely perform manipulation tasks, such as grasping objects that fit in its gripper, across different operating environments without retraining its controllers. The framework rests on two innovations: a finite-state abstracted model, bisimilar to the original system dynamics, that describes accessibility of the space in front of the robot under its given arm and gripper, and a block-conservative specification generation method that turns each manipulation task under any specific operational environment into specifications about state accessibility of the abstracted model. A task proven feasible and safe on the abstracted model is guaranteed to be safe and achievable by the robot. Real-world case studies conducted on a Unitree G1 U1 humanoid show that manipulation tasks commonly encountered in daily life, such as grasping an object, pressing an elevator button or picking up a berry, can be handled within this framework, where an abstracted model of the G1 U1 robot is built only once to avoid costly model reconstructions, and different tasks are simply captured by specific block-conservative specifications, achievable by a generic mission planner with vision-based feedback control.

AI.tldr: 提出一种通用机械臂任务规划框架，通过与原系统双相似的有限状态抽象模型和块保守规格生成方法，使机器人在无需重训控制器的情况下跨环境安全完成抓取等操作任务。
AI.motivation: 机器人运行环境一旦变化就需重新训练，训练成本过高，阻碍其日常应用；社区需要一种无需大量训练数据和算力即可让机器人安全抓取不同条件下不同物体的新方法。
AI.method: 框架基于两项创新：(1) 与原始系统动力学双相似的有限状态抽象模型，用以描述在给定手臂与夹爪条件下机器人前方空间的可达性；(2) 块保守规格生成方法，将任意特定操作环境下的每个操作任务转化为关于抽象模型状态可达性的规格。在抽象模型上被证明可行且安全的任务，可保证在真实机器人上安全且可实现；抽象模型只需构建一次，不同任务仅需对应不同规格。
AI.result: 在 Unitree G1 U1 人形机器人上开展真实世界案例研究，日常操作任务（如抓取物体、按压电梯按钮、采摘浆果）均可在该框架内处理；G1 U1 的抽象模型仅构建一次，避免昂贵的模型重建，不同任务由具体块保守规格刻画，并由通用任务规划器结合基于视觉的反馈控制实现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过"一次抽象建模 + 任务规格化"的范式，实现了跨环境免重训的通用机械臂任务规划，并具备可证明的安全性与可行性，在人形机器人日常操作中展现出实用潜力。

title: FIG-MAC: A Fine-grained Inspiration Graph Empowered Multi-Agent Collaboration for Automated Scientific Hypothesis Generation
summary: Automated Scientific Hypothesis Generation (ASHG) leveraging large language models (LLMs) aims to harness their strengths in knowledge integration, logical reasoning, and text generation for efficiently producing innovative, verifiable scientific hypotheses. However, existing approaches face three critical limitations: (i) insufficient fine-grained knowledge representation, as unstructured context impairs LLM comprehension and reasoning; (ii) lack of knowledge evolution traceability, constraining the generation of innovative cross-domain conjectures; (iii) absence of human-inspired and role-specialized multi-agent collaboration, failing to leverage the efficient innovation mechanisms arising from cognitive diversity and division of labor among expert roles to complete the full ASHG-evaluation loop. To address these limitations, we propose the Fine-grained Inspiration Graph-empowered Multi-Agent Collaboration framework (FIG-MAC) including: (i) Fine-grained Inspiration Graph module (FIG), to obtain fine-grained structured knowledge representations, where nodes represent academic semantic units and edges encode heuristic relationships among them; (ii) ontology-guided hybrid reasoning module, which follows the FIG ontology to construct structured reasoning paths and uses vector search to enrich them with semantic evidence, to obtain the traceable scientific conjecture paths; (iii) role-specialized Multi-Agent framework, inspired by real scientific teamwork, enabling a closed-loop process of scientific conjecture generation, screening, and validation. Experimental results demonstrate that FIG-MAC significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on source diversity, provenance-adjusted novelty, and raw novelty.

AI.tldr: 提出 FIG-MAC 框架，通过细粒度灵感图、本体引导的混合推理与角色专业化多智能体协作，实现可追溯、可验证的自动化科学假设生成与评测闭环。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大模型的自动化科学假设生成（ASHG）存在三点不足：一是知识表示为非结构化上下文，细粒度不足，影响模型理解与推理；二是缺乏知识演化可追溯性，难以产生跨域创新猜想；三是缺少类人的、角色专业化的多智能体协作，未能利用认知多样性与专家分工带来的高效创新机制，且未形成完整的生成—评测闭环。
AI.method: FIG-MAC 包含三个模块：(i) 细粒度灵感图（FIG）模块，以节点表示学术语义单元、边编码启发式关系，构建结构化细粒度知识表示；(ii) 本体引导的混合推理模块，依据 FIG 本体构建结构化推理路径，并用向量检索补充语义证据，得到可追溯的科学猜想路径；(iii) 角色专业化多智能体框架，仿照真实科研团队分工，实现猜想生成、筛选与验证的闭环流程。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，FIG-MAC 在来源多样性、来源调整新颖性与原始新颖性等指标上显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 结构化细粒度知识表示、可追溯推理与角色化多智能体协作相结合，可有效提升自动科学假设生成的创新性与可验证性，并为构建完整的假设生成—评测闭环提供可行范式。

title: Searching Ultra-Long Videos with Decision Models
comment: Our code is available at https://github.com/CeeZh/DeLoVi
summary: Understanding ultra-long videos requires retrieving sparse, query-relevant evidence from extensive video histories. Existing similarity-based retrieval methods are efficient, but they encode the question and the video content independently and thus often miss evidence whose relevance requires reasoning over both. Generative large language models (LLMs) can perform such reasoning, but they typically generate text over multiple rounds of search, which makes each query slow and costly. In this work, we introduce DeLoVi (Decision Models for Long Video), a framework that leverages pretrained decision models to retrieve evidence from ultra-long videos. Like an LLM, a decision model reads the question together with the candidate evidence, so it can reason over both. Unlike an LLM, it directly outputs a relevance score without generating text, which makes it fast and inexpensive. We first present DeLoVi-S, a simple method that generates captions for short video clips and uses a decision model to rank those captions by their relevance to a question. A generative LLM then answers the question using the top-ranked captions. Despite its simplicity, DeLoVi-S achieves state-of-the-art performance on three ultra-long video understanding benchmarks, EgoLifeQA, EgoMemReason, and MM-Lifelong, and generalizes effectively to long-video understanding benchmarks, VideoMME-L and LVBench. However, DeLoVi-S scores every caption for every question, so its cost grows linearly with video length. To reduce this cost, we propose an automated policy evolution framework that iteratively refines the memory construction and retrieval policies around a fixed pretrained decision model. The resulting method, DeLoVi-E, maintains comparable performance while reducing input tokens by 34x on average compared with DeLoVi-S. It also runs over 3x faster than the best prior method on EgoLifeQA while achieving higher accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 DeLoVi 框架，用预训练决策模型对长视频片段直接打分做证据检索（不生成文本），DeLoVi-S 在多个超长视频基准上达 SOTA；再用自动策略演化得到 DeLoVi-E，在保持性能的同时将输入 token 平均减少 34 倍、比最优基线快 3 倍以上。
AI.motivation: 超长视频理解需要从海量视频历史中检索稀疏的、与问题相关的证据。现有基于相似度的方法独立编码问题与视频，无法对二者联合推理，因而漏检需要推理才能判断相关性的证据；生成式 LLM 虽能联合推理，但需多轮文本生成式搜索，速度慢、成本高。
AI.method: 以预训练决策模型（decision model）为检索器：与 LLM 一样同时读取问题与候选证据并联合推理，但直接输出相关性分数而不生成文本。DeLoVi-S：为短视频片段生成字幕，用决策模型按与问题的相关性对字幕排序，再由生成式 LLM 基于 top-ranked 字幕作答。DeLoVi-E：引入自动化策略演化框架，围绕固定的预训练决策模型迭代优化记忆构建与检索策略，以避免对每个问题给所有字幕打分的线性开销。
AI.result: DeLoVi-S 在 EgoLifeQA、EgoMemReason、MM-Lifelong 三个超长视频理解基准上取得 SOTA，并有效泛化到长视频基准 VideoMME-L 与 LVBench。DeLoVi-E 性能与 DeLoVi-S 相当，平均减少 34 倍输入 token；在 EgoLifeQA 上比此前最佳方法快 3 倍以上且准确率更高。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型可作为超长视频证据检索的高效替代方案，兼具 LLM 式联合推理能力与非生成式推理的低延迟低成本；配合自动化策略演化，可在几乎不损性能的前提下大幅压缩计算开销，为超长视频理解提供可扩展的检索范式。

title: Online Prediction System for Proactive Autoscaling
summary: We present an online learning system for short-term time series forecasting that enables proactive autoscaling in large-scale distributed systems. Unlike traditional forecasting methods that focus on modeling seasonality and long-term trends, the system targets high-accuracy, low-latency predictions for immediate future intervals for dynamic resource management in internet-scale infrastructures. The system employs a two-stage architecture: a seasonality decomposition stage followed by a residual correction stage using lightweight linear models with engineered features. By retraining models on-the-fly for every prediction cycle, the online prediction system continuously adapts to changing demand patterns without requiring persistent model storage or feature drift monitoring. Deployed across many heterogeneous services, the system processes over 900K predictions per hour; in an offline evaluation on production traffic, its STL-based configuration reduces prediction error (MAPE) by 18.6\% relative to the previous production model. In production, the system has saved an estimated 118K servers daily.

AI.tldr: 提出一个面向大规模分布式系统主动自动扩缩容的在线短时时间序列预测系统，采用“季节性分解+残差校正”两阶段轻量线性模型架构，逐预测周期在线重训，线上每小时处理超90万次预测，离线MAPE较原生产模型降低18.6%，生产中每日节省约11.8万台服务器。
AI.motivation: 传统预测方法侧重建模季节性与长期趋势，难以满足互联网级基础设施动态资源管理对"紧邻未来区间"高精度、低延迟预测的需求；同时模型持久化存储与特征漂移监控成本高。
AI.method: 两阶段架构：先做季节性分解，再用带工程特征的轻量线性模型做残差校正；每个预测周期在线重训模型（on-the-fly retraining），无需持久化模型存储或特征漂移监控；在多种异构服务上部署。
AI.result: 每小时处理900K+次预测；离线生产流量评估中，STL配置较上一生产模型MAPE降低18.6%；生产环境估计每日节省118K台服务器。
AI.conclusion: 通过轻量两阶段分解-校正与在线重训策略，可在无需复杂模型运维的前提下实现低延迟、高精度的短时预测，并带来显著的资源节约，适合大规模异构服务的自动扩缩容场景。

title: Practice Makes Fluent: Learning to Use Earlier Predictions in Looped Models
summary: People become faster at a task through practice, but models that improve with experience do not necessarily learn to use less computation. We train looped models, whose intermediate predictions allow earlier exits, to perform tasks with fewer iterations through practice. This is difficult because shared-weight updates can degrade the final-loop prediction while improving early ones, and the exit gate must track early predictions as their quality changes. We propose FLUENT, which requires no additional task labels or rewards: it distills the initial model's final-loop prediction into early predictions, anchors the current final-loop prediction to the same frozen teacher, and trains the exit gate to balance disagreement with the current final-loop prediction against computation cost. FLUENT improves performance at shallower depth in new Crafter worlds, raises LIBERO success with fewer action-head iterations, and maintains language-model accuracy at lower selected depth. On a real robot, success rises from 62.3\% to 74.6\% while mean time over successful episodes falls from 69\,s to 31\,s. The project page is available at https://msseok96-cpu.github.io/FLUENT/.

AI.tldr: 提出FLUENT：通过自蒸馏方式训练循环模型，使其在学习任务的过程中逐步减少所需的迭代次数，同时训练退出门控在早期预测质量变化下自适应地选择计算深度；无需额外标签或奖励。
AI.motivation: 模型经"练习"后性能提升，但未必学会减少计算量。循环模型（共享权重的多层迭代）的中间预测本可支持提前退出，但训练存在两大难点：(1) 共享权重更新在提升早期预测的同时可能损害最终循环的预测质量；(2) 退出门控需随早期预测质量的变化而动态跟踪，难以稳定训练。
AI.method: FLUENT为自监督/无标签框架，含三个关键设计：①将初始（冻结）模型最终循环的预测蒸馏到早期预测中，作为教师信号；②将当前模型的最终循环预测锚定到同一冻结教师，防止共享权重更新导致的性能退化；③训练退出门控，在"与当前最终预测的分歧"和"计算成本"之间做权衡，实现按需退出。
AI.result: 在新Crafter世界中以更浅深度达到更好性能；LIBERO上以更少动作头迭代次数提升成功率；语言模型在更低的选定深度下保持精度；真实机器人上成功率由62.3%升至74.6%，成功回合平均耗时由69s降至31s。
AI.conclusion: 通过自蒸馏+冻结教师锚定+成本感知门控，可使循环模型在"练习"中学会以更少迭代完成任务，在多任务域与真实机器人上实现精度维持/提升与推理计算量显著下降的双赢。

title: Aligned Machine: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Embedding Similarity via Human Comparative Judgements
summary: Embedding models increasingly inform how people search, recommend, and retrieve information, yet we lack credible ways to test whether these similarity judgments reflect how humans understand meaning. Existing benchmarks typically rely on static, expert-labeled pairs with coarse Likert-style annotations, limiting scalability and making it difficult to obtain consistent, high-confidence annotations. We introduce Aligned Machine, an interactive, public-facing platform that transforms broad participation into a continuously growing Human-Aligned Similarity Benchmark (HASB) for evaluating semantic alignment in embedding-based systems. Participants complete a cognitively-natural, forced-choice task, comparing two pairs of items (text or images) and selecting which pair is more similar. This comparative design is accessible to non-experts, yields clean preference data, and supports robust aggregation. We report results from an initial deployment with 115 participants contributing 2,875 total labeled pairs and 872 unique pairs. Using HASB, we evaluated 12 widely used embedding models and found only partial alignment between embedding similarity and human judgments. Text-only models consistently achieve higher overall agreement than multimodal models, while multimodal performance varies systematically by task type: alignment is strongest for image-image comparisons, weaker for image-text comparisons, and lowest for text-text comparisons. Aligned Machine is designed to evolve over time as participation grows, supporting longitudinal analysis, domain-specific studies, bias detection, and measurement of concept drift across model versions. By combining accessible public participation with rigorous comparative evaluation, HASB provides a scalable and accountable framework for auditing semantic alignment in embedding models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出交互式众包平台 Aligned Machine，通过强迫二选一的比较任务持续构建"人类对齐相似度基准"（HASB），用于评估嵌入模型的语义对齐程度。
AI.motivation: 嵌入模型广泛影响搜索、推荐与检索，但缺乏可信手段检验其相似度判断是否符合人类语义理解；现有基准依赖静态、专家标注的粗粒度 Likert 评分，难以扩展且难以获得一致、高置信度的标注。
AI.method: 构建面向公众的交互式平台，让参与者完成认知自然的强迫选择任务——比较两对条目（文本或图像）并选出更相似的一对；该比较式设计对非专家友好，可产生干净的偏好数据并支持稳健聚合。基于首发部署（115 名参与者、2,875 个标注对、872 个唯一条目对）评测 12 个常用嵌入模型。
AI.result: 嵌入相似度与人类判断仅部分对齐；纯文本模型总体一致性稳定高于多模态模型；多模态模型表现随任务类型系统性变化：图像-图像对齐最强，图像-文本较弱，文本-文本最低。
AI.conclusion: Aligned Machine 随时间与参与规模演化，可支持纵向分析、领域特定研究、偏见检测及跨模型版本的概念漂移测量；将可及性公众参与与严格比较式评估结合，为审计嵌入模型的语义对齐提供了可扩展且可问责的框架。

title: Benchmarking Segmentation Models for Scalable Mangrove Mapping with Sentinel-1/2 Imagery
comment: Accepted at the Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning (TCCML) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026, Sydney, Australia
summary: Mangroves are dynamic coastal ecosystems that contribute to carbon storage, coastal protection and biodiversity conservation, but are vulnerable to climate change. Very-high-resolution imagery such as Pléiades enables detailed mangrove mapping but it is costly and have a low revisit rate. Large-scale monitoring requires free and regularly available data such as Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 but their spatial resolution poses challenges for detailed mangrove mapping. In this work, we benchmark deep learning approaches for mangrove mapping from Sentinel-1 radar and Sentinel-2 optical imagery using reference maps derived from very-high-resolution Pléiades imagery. We compare four segmentation configurations based on CROMA and BigEarthNet-pretrained ResNet50 representations with different segmentation decoders. We construct a mangrove mapping dataset covering French Guiana, Suriname, and Amapá. CROMA + UPerNet achieves the best performance, with an F1-score of 0.9218 and an IoU of 0.8549. These results highlight the potential of pretrained multimodal Earth observation representations and open Sentinel data to support mangrove resilience through scalable monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文以Pléiades高分辨率参考图为标签，用Sentinel-1与Sentinel-2免费数据做红树林制图，系统对比了基于CROMA与BigEarthNet预训练ResNet50表示结合不同分割解码器的四种分割配置，其中CROMA+UPerNet最优，F1为0.9218、IoU为0.8549。
AI.motivation: 红树林是重要的动态海岸生态系统，具碳储存、海岸防护与生物多样性保护价值，但易受气候变化影响。Pléiades等甚高分辨率影像可做精细制图，但成本高、重访率低；Sentinel-1/2免费且定期可获取，却受空间分辨率限制，难以精细制图。因此需要评估在哨兵数据上借助预训练表示实现可扩展红树林制图的能力。
AI.method: 构建覆盖法属圭亚那、苏里南与阿马帕的红树林制图数据集，以Pléiades甚高分辨率影像派生参考图作为标签；在Sentinel-1雷达与Sentinel-2光学影像上，比较四种基于CROMA与BigEarthNet预训练ResNet50表示、搭配不同分割解码器的分割配置，进行深度学习基准评测。
AI.result: CROMA+UPerNet表现最佳，F1-score达0.9218，IoU达0.8549。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明预训练多模态对地观测表示结合开放哨兵数据可支撑红树林的可扩展监测，从而服务于红树林韧性评估与管理。

title: A Hierarchy of Risk Certificates for Representation-Based Prediction
summary: Representation-based prediction underlies many machine-learning systems. Yet a fitted predictor's failure to meet an accuracy requirement does not establish that its representation-decoder class cannot meet it. We study optimal population mean squared error (MSE) over Lipschitz decoders acting on a fixed representation. For blocks of $b\geq2$ independent and identically distributed (iid) observations, we minimize total squared error (normalized by $b-1$) under pairwise Lipschitz constraints. We prove that expected block scores form nondecreasing lower bounds on optimal class risk and converge to that risk on compact metric feature spaces, although no fixed block size provides a uniform relative guarantee. Verified dual lower bounds and iid calibration observations independent of model development, with bounded targets and predictions, yield simultaneous lower confidence bounds on optimal class risk and upper confidence bounds on fitted-predictor risk. These bounds can establish that every admissible decoder exceeds a prescribed MSE threshold or that an admissible fitted predictor meets it. Controlled experiments illustrate population-risk certification; fixed PTB-XL and Bike Sharing experiments provide deterministic empirical-risk conclusions. The results support principled assessment and selection of representation-decoder configurations. Efficient certification at scale and extensions to dependent observations remain open problems.

AI.tldr: 论文研究固定表示上Lipschitz解码器类的最优population MSE，证明期望分块得分构成非减下界并在紧度量空间上收敛于类风险，进而给出同时的置信下界（类风险）与上界（拟合预测器风险）的认证框架。
AI.motivation: 单一拟合预测器未达精度要求，并不能说明其所在的表示-解码器类无法达标；因此需要一个关于“类最优风险”的原则性评估与认证工具，用于表示-解码器配置的评估与选择。
