AI.method: 对b≥2的iid观测块，在成对Lipschitz约束下最小化归一化（除以b-1）的总平方误差；证明期望分块得分为最优类风险的非减下界且在紧度量特征空间上收敛。结合经核验的对偶下界与独立于模型开发的iid校准观测（有界目标与预测），构造最优类风险的同时置信下界与拟合预测器风险的上置信界。
AI.result: 分块得分是有效下界且渐近紧，但不存在对任意块大小的统一相对保证；置信界可判定“所有可行解码器均超过给定MSE阈值”或“某可行拟合预测器满足阈值”。受控实验展示population风险认证；PTB-XL与Bike Sharing固定实验给出确定性的经验风险结论。
AI.conclusion: 结果为表示-解码器配置的原则性评估与选择提供统计保证；大规模高效认证与相依观测下的推广仍为开放问题。

title: RoboJackVR: Turning Robot Tasks into VR Games for Scalable Demonstration Collection
summary: Scaling robot demonstration datasets requires collection systems that accommodate more participants and diverse tasks, yet teleoperation barriers and task-adaptation effort limit this expansion. We present RoboJackVR, a standalone virtual reality (VR) game in which players manipulate simulated robots to execute combat skills and contribute demonstrations. MuJoCo simulation and demonstration recording run locally on the headset, removing the need for an external PC or simulation server during collection. Tutorials, skill selection, combat consequences, and character progression organize repeated task attempts within a continuing game. Task contracts declare assets, controls, resets, success criteria, and recording semantics; separate game configurations specify guidance, attempt groups, skill effects, and course placement. Shared bindings connect these declarations to task execution, outcome handling, and recording, allowing tasks to reuse the game flow while retaining their control and success semantics. Batch tools package supported resources and generate configurations, with manual adaptation and review for new interfaces and unsupported predicates. We instantiate the approach with SO101-Nexus-derived and LIBERO tasks. On the 66 LIBERO-90 tasks covered by the collected data, ACT policies trained solely on VR demonstrations retain approximately 91% of the full-standard simulation-demonstration baseline's success rate on held-out initial states, averaged over four training seeds. These results support the utility of play-collected VR demonstrations for policy learning in this setting.

AI.tldr: RoboJackVR 是一个独立的 VR 游戏，玩家在头显本地运行 MuJoCo 仿真操控机器人完成战斗技能，从而在游戏化流程中采集机器人演示数据；通过"任务契约+游戏配置+共享绑定"的模块化设计实现任务复用，在 66 个 LIBERO-90 任务上仅用 VR 演示训练的 ACT 策略成功率约为标准仿真演示基线的 91%。
AI.motivation: 机器人演示数据集的规模化需要更多参与者和更多样化的任务，但遥操作门槛高、任务适配成本大，限制了数据采集的扩张。作者希望用消费级 VR 游戏降低参与门槛，并把重复尝试自然地组织进游戏循环中。
AI.method: 提出 RoboJackVR：头显端本地运行 MuJoCo 仿真与演示录制，无需外部 PC 或仿真服务器。以教程、技能选择、战斗后果与角色成长组织重复尝试。系统采用三层抽象：任务契约声明资产、控制、重置、成功判据与录制语义；游戏配置指定引导、尝试分组、技能效果与关卡布置；共享绑定将二者接入任务执行、结果处理与录制，使新任务可复用游戏流程而保留自身控制与成功语义。配套批处理工具打包资源并生成配置，新接口与不支持谓词需人工适配与审核。实验基于 SO101-Nexus 衍生任务与 LIBERO 任务。
AI.result: 在已采集数据覆盖的 66 个 LIBERO-90 任务上，仅用 VR 演示训练的 ACT 策略在留出初始状态上的成功率约为完整标准仿真演示基线成功率的 91%（四个训练种子平均）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明游戏化采集的 VR 演示在此设定下对策略学习具有实用价值；该框架通过声明式任务契约与共享绑定降低了新任务适配成本，为扩大演示采集参与者规模与任务多样性提供了可行路径。

title: Learning from Natural Images Untangles Number Sense
summary: Numerical cognition is a simple yet fundamental ability that remains challenging for modern vision-language models. Meanwhile, number sense is already present in numerically naïve animals, suggesting that it can emerge without explicit numerical learning. Deep neural networks provide a related observation, with numerosity-selective units appearing after training on unrelated natural-image tasks and even before any training. However, these findings leave unresolved whether visual learning contributes beyond the spontaneous emergence of numerical selectivity. Human development provides a clue, as children become better at making judgments in which numerosity and proportion conflict. Here, we introduce a geometric framework to trace how representations of these two quantities change across learning. Although untrained and pretrained networks exhibited similar unit-level numerosity selectivity and basic comparison performance, natural-image pretraining increased the angle between numerosity and proportion subspaces while reducing their overlap, supporting more robust readout under conflict. Direct manipulation of these geometric properties further demonstrated their functional contributions to decoding accuracy and functional independence. Importantly, conventional supervised pretraining was not essential for quantity separation, which also emerged through self-supervised learning without category labels and synthetic-image training without natural-image exposure. Together, our findings suggest that structured visual learning can refine spontaneously emerging number sense into robust and functionally independent quantity representations without explicit numerical training.

AI.tldr: 该论文用几何框架追踪学习过程中"数量(numerosity)"与"比例(proportion)"两种量表征的变化，发现自然图像预训练通过增大二者子空间夹角、减少重叠，提升了冲突情境下的稳健读码，且这种分离无需显式数字训练或类别标签。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉-语言模型在数字认知上仍显薄弱；而"数感"在未经数字学习的动物甚至未训练网络中即可自发出现。已有发现无法回答关键问题：视觉学习是否在"自发涌现的数字选择性"之外还有额外贡献。人类发展证据（儿童在数量与比例冲突的判断上逐渐变好）提供了线索。
AI.method: 提出一个几何框架，用于刻画数量与比例两种量表征在学习前后的变化；比较未训练网络与预训练网络的单元级数字选择性及基本比较表现；操纵表征几何属性以检验其功能作用；并测试不同训练范式（有监督预训练、无类别标签的自监督学习、无自然图像暴露的合成图像训练）下数量分离是否出现。
AI.result: 未训练与预训练网络在单元级数字选择性和基本比较能力上相似；但自然图像预训练增大了数量子空间与比例子空间的夹角并降低其重叠，从而支持冲突条件下更稳健的读码。直接操纵这些几何属性可证明其对解码准确性与功能独立性有因果贡献。数量分离并不依赖常规有监督预训练——自监督学习与合成图像训练同样能产生。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的视觉学习能够在无显式数字训练的情况下，将自发涌现的数感精炼为稳健且功能独立的量表征；关键在于表征几何（子空间角度与重叠度），而非单纯的单元级选择性。

title: MotifFlow: Training-Free, Self-Contained Style Transfer from Color to Motif in Rectified Flow Transformers
summary: Expressive style transfer must reproduce a painting's palette, brushwork, and characteristic motifs while retaining the content image's structure. Attention injection is effective in U-Net-based diffusion models, but adapting it to FLUX often transfers color without capturing the style's distinctive brushwork. Our analysis across backbones links this gap to how injected features are integrated across neighboring spatial locations. We introduce MotifFlow, a training-free, self-contained framework that combines style injection with style-alignment guidance in FLUX. Injection supplies style features during generation but does not explicitly encourage the model's native attention output to align with them. We therefore use the discrepancy between native and injected attention outputs to guide latent-space updates, encouraging the evolving image to develop the style's distinctive brushwork and motifs. Style encoding, guidance, and synthesis all use the same frozen backbone, without auxiliary image encoders or trained adapters. A single strength parameter controls the transition from color transfer to pronounced brushwork and motifs, with additional support for regional stylization and style mixing. Experiments on 1,000 content-style pairs show that MotifFlow better matches the local textures of the style image than baseline methods and produces more consistent stylization than injection alone. The same design extends to FLUX.2.

AI.tldr: MotifFlow：面向FLUX的无训练风格迁移框架，将风格注入与风格对齐引导相结合，用原生注意力与注入注意力输出的差异引导潜空间更新，从而在保留内容结构的同时复现风格图像的笔触与母题。
AI.motivation: 表达性风格迁移需同时复现调色板、笔触与特征母题，并保持内容图像结构。注意力注入在U-Net扩散模型中有效，但迁移到FLUX时往往只迁移了颜色而丢失风格特有的笔触。作者通过跨骨干分析指出，这一差距源于注入特征在相邻空间位置上被整合的方式。
AI.method: 提出MotifFlow，一个无需训练、自包含的框架，在FLUX中联合使用风格注入与风格对齐引导。注入在生成过程中提供风格特征，但并不显式促使模型原生注意力输出与之对齐；因此利用原生注意力输出与注入注意力输出之间的差异来引导潜空间更新，推动图像发展出风格特有的笔触与母题。风格编码、引导与合成均使用同一冻结骨干，无需辅助图像编码器或训练适配器。单一强度参数控制从颜色迁移到明显笔触/母题的过渡，并支持区域风格化与风格混合。
AI.result: 在1,000个内容-风格对上实验，MotifFlow相比基线方法更贴合风格图像的局部纹理，且相较仅用注入产生更一致的风格化效果；同一设计可扩展至FLUX.2。
AI.conclusion: 显式对齐原生注意力与注入注意力是FLUX上实现表达性风格迁移的关键，MotifFlow以训练-free、单骨干、单参数控制的方式达成该目标，具备良好的可扩展性。

title: FlowersBench: A FluidFlower-Inspired Dataset for Benchmarking Carbon Storage Surrogates Across Geological Structures
comment: 40 pages, 22 figures, 11 tables. Dataset available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24380326
summary: Machine learning surrogates are emerging as a computationally efficient tool for uncertainty quantification in geological carbon storage (GCS). Geological structure constitutes a major source of uncertainty; however, existing benchmark simulation datasets predominantly vary petrophysical and operational parameters within a fixed geological setting. Generalisation to unseen geological structures therefore remains largely unexplored. We introduce FlowersBench, a benchmark dataset of 5,000 two-dimensional, reservoir-scale CO$_2$ storage simulations across 244 structural geometries. The geometries are sampled from an in-house structural generator inspired by the FluidFlower experiments and Case B of the 11th Society of Petroleum Engineers Comparative Solution Project (SPE11B). Each simulation is run with Open Porous Media (OPM) Flow over a 50-year injection period and a 500-year post-injection monitoring period. Test geometries are withheld from training to assess generalisation to unseen structural geometries. Two additional subsets support evaluation under structural shift. The first extends the parameter ranges of the structural generator beyond those used for training, and the second introduces an unseen topology of multiple parallel faults. A baseline U-Net surrogate is trained to predict CO$_2$ gas saturation. In representative test cases, the surrogate recovers the main migration pathways, including lateral spreading beneath low-permeability layers and upward flow along fault damage zones, with errors concentrated near the plume boundary. Under both structural shifts, prediction error exceeds that on the held-out geometries, and the increase in relative error is greater for the unseen fault topology. FlowersBench is publicly available and provides a common basis for evaluating GCS surrogates across geological structures.

AI.tldr: 提出FlowersBench基准数据集：包含244种地质构造几何、5000个二维储层尺度CO2封存模拟，测试几何与训练隔离，并设两个结构偏移子集，用于评估机器学习代理模型对未见地质构造的泛化能力；基线U-Net在代表性案例中可还原主要运移路径，但在结构偏移下误差上升。
AI.motivation: 地质构造是地质碳封存（GCS）不确定性量化的主要来源，但现有基准模拟数据集多在固定地质背景下仅改变岩石物性与运行参数，代理模型对未见地质构造的泛化能力基本未被探讨，缺乏统一评估基准。
AI.method: 构建FlowersBench数据集：244种构造几何由内部结构生成器采样，灵感来自FluidFlower实验与SPE11B算例；每个算例用OPM Flow运行，包含50年注入期与500年注入后监测期，形成5000个二维储层尺度模拟。测试几何从训练集中剔除以评估对未见构造的泛化；另设两个子集支持结构偏移评估——其一将结构生成器参数范围扩展到训练范围之外，其二引入多平行断层的未见拓扑。以U-Net为基线代理模型，预测CO2气体饱和度。
AI.result: 代表性测试案例中，代理模型能还原主要运移通道，包括低渗层下方的侧向铺展与沿断层损伤带的向上流动，误差集中于羽流边界附近。在两种结构偏移下，预测误差均高于留出几何上的误差，且未见断层拓扑引起的相对误差增幅更大。
AI.conclusion: FlowersBench公开可用，为跨地质构造评估GCS代理模型提供共同基准；结果也表明现有代理模型在结构偏移（尤其是未见断层拓扑）下泛化能力有限。

title: PROVE: Predict-to-Specify and Observe-to-Verify for Human-Aligned Evaluation of Mobile Manipulation
summary: Judging open-world robot manipulation is hard because layouts, articulated fixtures, and valid goal configurations vary widely. On RoboCasa365, simulator predicates agree with human judgments on only 69.09\% of rollouts, and a frontier VLM judge on 86.12\%. We present \textbf{PROVE} (Predict-to-Specify, Observe-to-Verify), which first specifies what success should look like and then checks the outcome. PROVE refines success conditions from the instruction, the initial scene, a target-object reference image, and a generated goal image. The goal image only sharpens the conditions and never serves as evidence. On 6,500 human-annotated rollouts over 65 atomic actions, PROVE reaches \textbf{96.83\%} agreement. Applied to open-source policies, it reports far lower success than native checks and changes their ranking. To reduce evaluation overhead in policy learning, we distill PROVE into \textbf{PROVE-Lite}, a 4B evaluator that needs no reference images. In one forward pass, PROVE-Lite predicts the outcome and the terminal state of each task condition. It reaches \textbf{91.20\%} agreement while running about 38$\times$ faster than PROVE. Mapped to a severity-aware reward, its diagnoses improve PPO post-training over both simulator and binary rewards.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PROVE（Predict-to-Specify, Observe-to-Verify）开放式机器人操作成功判定框架：先用指令、初始场景、目标物体参考图和生成的目标图细化成功条件，再依据观察验证结果；在 6,500 条人工标注 rollout、65 种原子动作上达成 96.83% 一致率。并蒸馏出无需参考图、单次前向即可预测结果与终态的 4B 评估器 PROVE-Lite，一致率 91.20%、速度约快 38 倍，其严重度感知奖励可提升 PPO 后训练效果。
AI.motivation: 开放式机器人操作任务中，布局、铰接装置与合法目标构型高度多样，成功判定困难。现有仿真器谓词仅与人类判断一致 69.09%，前沿 VLM 判定器也只有 86.12%，且策略学习中的评估开销大。
AI.method: 1) PROVE：根据指令、初始场景、目标物体参考图与生成的目标图精炼成功条件，目标图仅用于锐化条件、不作为证据；随后观察 rollout 终态进行验证。2) PROVE-Lite：将 PROVE 蒸馏为 4B 评估器，去除参考图依赖，单次前向同时预测任务结果与各条件的终态，并映射为严重度感知奖励用于 PPO 后训练。
AI.result: PROVE 在 RoboCasa365 的 6,500 条人工标注 rollout（65 种原子动作）上一致率达 96.83%；用于开源策略评估时报告的成功率显著低于原生检查，并改变策略排名。PROVE-Lite 一致率 91.20%，速度约为 PROVE 的 38 倍，其奖励信号使 PPO 后训练优于仿真器奖励与二值奖励。
AI.conclusion: "先指定成功样态、再观察验证"的判定范式显著优于仿真谓词与通用 VLM 判定；蒸馏后的轻量评估器在保持高一致率的同时大幅降低评估开销，并能作为更有效的策略学习奖励来源。

title: Controllable CAD Generation and Interactive Editing of Fluid Rotors
summary: Computer-aided design (CAD) provides the geometric foundation for rotors in fluid rotating machinery. However, creating models for different rotors requires different modeling processes, making it difficult to control geometry through design intent and reuse existing models. We introduce VaneCraft, an agent-driven framework for rotor generation, inverse recovery, and editing through a unified analytical representation. The agent interprets design requests and invokes geometric modeling operations. The representation defines geometric controls through meridional geometry and independent boundary angle laws. An anisotropic partial differential equation (PDE) maps these controls to the blade surfaces. Geometric parameter correction (GPC) uses a joint geometric encoder and a parameter decoder to refine controls initialized from rotor category and dimensions. Inverse recovery maps existing CAD to the same geometric controls for reconstruction and continued editing. Experiments demonstrate that VaneCraft supports anisotropy control and parameter editing and outperforms representative baselines in rotor CAD generation tasks. Project page is available on \href{https://github.com/shenchen333/vanecraft}{GitHub}.

AI.tldr: VaneCraft：面向流体旋转机械转子的智能体驱动框架，基于统一解析表示实现转子生成、逆向恢复与编辑。
AI.motivation: 传统CAD建模不同转子需不同流程，难以通过设计意图控制几何、难以复用已有模型，建模效率与可控性受限。
AI.method: 智能体解析设计请求并调用几何建模操作；统一解析表示以子午几何与独立边界角律定义几何控制，用各向异性偏微分方程（PDE）将控制映射为叶片曲面；几何参数校正（GPC）采用联合几何编码器与参数解码器，从转子类别与尺寸初始化并精化控制参数；逆向恢复将已有CAD映射为同一组几何控制，支持重建与持续编辑。
AI.result: 实验表明框架支持各向异性控制与参数编辑，并在转子CAD生成任务上优于代表性基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 统一解析表示为转子建模提供设计意图可控、可复用、可逆的范式，智能体驱动流程可兼顾生成、恢复与编辑。

title: VersionGS: Compact and Motion-Robust Dynamic Gaussian Splatting via Versioned Gaussians
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Recent dynamic Gaussian splatting methods encode temporal change, either as smooth functions of time or as constrained updates between frames. We observe that their reconstruction quality degrades significantly under fast motion. In challenging dance sequences, their PSNR drops by 1.1-4.0 dB on high-motion frames compared to low-motion frames. To overcome this limitation, we propose VersionGS, a method that directly encodes per-frame Gaussian states and uses motion estimation only to guide reconstruction. Within each group of frames, unchanged Gaussians keep their current versions in a shared dictionary, while modified Gaussians are appended as new versions. To maximize version reuse, we introduce selective sequential construction, which refines the Gaussians selected by optical flow, photograph differences or rendering errors and leaves the others unchanged. The dictionary is then pruned, fine-tuned with simulated quantization and encoded as images. Adjusting the pruning ratio trades off storage and quality without rebuilding the dictionary. On the fast dance sequences of DanceNet3D, VersionGS improves foreground PSNR by 2.7 dB over the best baseline, and its PSNR decreases by less than 0.3 dB on the highest-motion frames. On N3DV and Technicolor, it requires 6.0x and 5.7x less storage than TAD-GS, the strongest baseline overall, while achieving even higher PSNR. Finally, playback is fast and requires no motion model or neural network, only a 3DGS rasterizer.

AI.tldr: VersionGS 直接编码每帧高斯状态、以运动估计仅作引导，通过共享字典与选择性顺序构建实现快速运动场景下的高保真动态高斯重建，并大幅降低存储。
AI.motivation: 现有动态高斯泼溅方法将时序变化建模为平滑时间函数或帧间受限更新，在快速运动下重建质量显著下降（高运动帧 PSNR 比低运动帧低 1.1–4.0 dB）。
AI.method: 提出 VersionGS：逐帧直接编码高斯状态，运动估计只用于引导重建。每组帧内，未变化高斯在共享字典中保留当前版本，变化的高斯追加为新版本；引入选择性顺序构建，仅对由光流、光度差异或渲染误差选出的高斯进行细化，其余保持不变以最大化版本复用；随后对字典剪枝、用模拟量化微调并编码为图像。
AI.result: 在 DanceNet3D 快速舞蹈序列上前景 PSNR 较最佳基线提升 2.7 dB，最高运动帧 PSNR 下降不足 0.3 dB；在 N3DV 与 Technicolor 上存储比最强基线 TAD-GS 分别少 6.0× 与 5.7×，且 PSNR 更高。
AI.conclusion: 通过调整剪枝比例即可在不重建字典的情况下权衡存储与质量；播放快速，仅需 3DGS 光栅化器，无需运动模型或神经网络。

title: Understanding Failure Patterns in LLM-Based Mathematical Optimization Modeling
summary: Industrial optimization involves complex constraints, making optimization modeling difficult to automate. Large language models (LLMs) have been explored for generating optimization models from natural language, but their reliability in end-to-end settings remains limited, often producing non-executable, infeasible, or feasible but incorrect solutions. In this work, we study failure modes in LLM-based optimization modeling by decomposing the process into three components: mathematical reasoning, solver usage, and domain knowledge, and constructing datasets that target each aspect. Using these datasets, we analyze how different components relate to errors and find that they are associated with different types of failure, although these relationships are not always strong or consistent. Furthermore, while combining these components improves execution reliability, feasible but incorrect solutions remain the dominant failure mode, suggesting a remaining gap between executability and correctness. These findings highlight limitations of current dataset designs and suggest the importance of data that better capture constraint completeness and formulation accuracy to enhance reliability.

AI.tldr: 该文将LLM优化建模过程分解为数学推理、求解器使用、领域知识三部分并构造对应数据集，分析各成分与错误类型的关系，发现三者关联不同失败类型但关系不强，组合后执行可靠性提升但"可行但错误"仍为主要失败模式。
AI.motivation: 工业优化约束复杂，优化建模难以自动化；LLM从自然语言生成优化模型在端到端场景下可靠性有限，常产生不可执行、不可行或可行但错误的解，需系统厘清失败来源。
AI.method: 将LLM优化建模流程分解为数学推理、求解器使用、领域知识三个成分，针对每个成分构建数据集，并据此分析各成分与不同失败类型的关联。
AI.result: 三成分与不同失败类型相关，但关联强度和一致性有限；组合多成分可提升执行可靠性，然而"可行但错误"仍占主导失败模式，显示可执行性与正确性之间存在差距。
AI.conclusion: 现有数据集设计存在局限，需要更能刻画约束完备性与建模准确性的数据，以提升LLM优化建模的端到端可靠性。

title: RegHarness: Regulating What Code-as-Policy Agents Keep from Steps to Skills
summary: Code-as-Policy agents generate, execute, and revise robot programs, but often lack explicit mechanisms to govern what persists across executions: which actions are retained within a trial and which code modifications carry over to subsequent runs. This leaves two critical aspects of agent behavior insufficiently controlled: step-level execution and cross-run adaptation. We present RegHarness, a two-level harness that governs both forms of persistence for the RATs agent team, without relying on a vision-language-action (VLA) policy or demonstrations. Within each trial, run-time governance evaluates each proposed step from a reset scene, replaying the committed steps, while a fixed-rule controller commits the step only when both RATs' verifier and a task-long LLM auditor approve it. Between runs, a coding agent uses logged failures to develop and test revisions to skills, primitives, and rules, which remain disabled by default until explicitly enabled by the authors. Using a single low-cost model across all run-time roles, RegHarness achieves an 87.8% success rate (158/180) on paired LIBERO-PRO trials, compared with 39.4% for RATs, and a 72.0% success rate on MolmoSpaces trials. A $2\times2$ ablation study of RegHarness's two levels shows that its skill refinement alone increases RATs' successful trials from 71 to 135, whereas run-time governance alone achieves 105 and RATs' native stepwise reset-and-replay mode achieves only 46. These findings suggest that, for Code-as-Policy agents operating with low-cost models, task success depends not only on how generated programs are executed, but also on the quality of the reusable skills they invoke and how those skills evolve across runs.

AI.tldr: RegHarness 是一个双层治理框架，为 Code-as-Policy 的 RATs 智能体团队显式控制"步级执行"与"跨运行适应"两类持续性：试验内用重放+双重审批提交步骤，试验间用编码智能体基于失败日志改写并测试技能/原语/规则，在低成本单一模型下于 LIBERO-PRO 达 87.8%、MolmoSpaces 达 72.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有 Code-as-Policy 智能体能生成、执行、修订机器人程序，但缺乏显式机制治理"什么该在执行间持续存在"——哪些动作在单次试验内被保留、哪些代码修改带入后续运行。这导致步级执行与跨运行适应两个关键维度控制不足，且方法往往依赖视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略或示教演示。
AI.method: 提出 RegHarness 双层 harness，用于 RATs 智能体团队，不依赖 VLA 策略与演示。(1) 试验内运行时治理：从 reset 场景出发评估每个提议步骤，重放已提交步骤；由固定规则控制器仅在 RATs 验证器与任务级 LLM 审计器均批准时才提交该步骤。(2) 运行间治理：编码智能体利用记录的失败日志开发并测试对技能、原语和规则的修订，修订默认禁用，须由作者显式启用以生效。全部运行时角色使用同一个低成本模型。
AI.result: 在配对 LIBERO-PRO 试验中成功率 87.8%（158/180），RATs 基线为 39.4%；MolmoSpaces 达 72.0%。2×2 消融（两层各自开关）：仅技能精炼将 RATs 成功试验数从 71 提升至 135；仅运行时治理达 105；RATs 原生逐步 reset-and-replay 模式仅 46。
AI.conclusion: 对使用低成本模型的 Code-as-Policy 智能体而言，任务成功不仅取决于生成程序如何被执行（运行时治理），也取决于其调用的可复用技能质量及这些技能跨运行如何演化（技能精炼）；两层治理各自带来显著增益，且联合使用效果最佳。

title: How Much Effort Does an AI Code Reviewer Need? Evidence from Claude 5.5 Models on Plausible-but-Wrong Patches
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures. Preregistered at https://osf.io/r8q2m. Data and code: https://github.com/trustmybot/research-artifacts
summary: AI coding agents write code faster than people can review it, so teams add AI reviewers. Reasoning models let such a reviewer trade cost for diligence through an effort setting. We asked how much effort a reviewer needs to catch plausible-but-wrong patches, which pass a benchmark's tests but fail stronger ones. Claude Opus 5.5 (preregistered), Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 (exploratory) each reviewed the same 90 agent-written Django patches from SWE-bench Verified at low, medium and high effort. By strengthened SWE-ABS tests, 55 patches were wrong and 35 correct. In every model, high effort accepted fewer wrong patches than low (false success .45 against .67 for Opus, .49 against .65 for Sonnet, .51 against .78 for Haiku), a supported difference for Opus and Haiku. For Opus, medium was non-inferior to high within 15 percentage points (difference .018, 95% CI [-.065, .108]) and cost 20% less, short of the preregistered 30%. For Sonnet and Haiku, medium cost 39% and 51% less than high but was not shown non-inferior. Opus at medium or high agreed best with the labels; Haiku at high cost about 8% as much per review as Opus at medium, accuracy difference unresolved. Exploratory coding showed that most rejections named the tested defect and that effort added such rejections. No setting is a strong gate: each accepted at least 45% of wrong patches. For 32 of the 55 wrong patches the issue may not require what the failing test checks; without them, neither accuracy hypothesis holds for any model.

AI.tldr: 研究比较了Claude系列三个模型在不同"努力程度"设置下作为AI代码审查者的表现，发现高努力能减少误放行错误补丁，但没有任何设置能成为强门控（错误补丁接受率均≥45%）。
AI.motivation: AI编码代理生成代码的速度超过人工审查能力，因此团队引入AI审查者；推理模型可通过effort设置权衡成本与严谨度，但不确定需要多少努力才能识别"看似合理实则错误"的补丁（能通过基准测试但无法通过更强测试），因此需要量化这一权衡。
AI.method: 预注册研究（Opus 5.5）加探索性研究（Sonnet 5.5、Haiku 5.5），三个模型分别在低、中、高effort下审查同一批90个由AI代理编写、来自SWE-bench Verified的Django补丁；以强化的SWE-ABS测试作为判定标签（55个错误、35个正确），比较假成功率和成本，并进行非劣效检验与探索性编码分析。
AI.result: 所有模型高effort的假成功率均低于低effort（Opus .45 vs .67；Sonnet .49 vs .65；Haiku .51 vs .78），其中Opus与Haiku差异获得统计支持。Opus的中等effort在15个百分点内非劣于高effort（差异.018，95% CI [-.065, .108]），成本仅低20%，未达到预注册的30%阈值；Sonnet与Haiku中等effort成本分别低39%和51%，但非劣效性未获证实。Opus的中/高effort与标签一致性最佳；Haiku高effort单次审查成本约为Opus中等effort的8%，准确率差异未决。探索性编码显示多数拒绝正确指出了被测缺陷，且提高effort主要增加了此类拒绝。敏感性分析：55个错误补丁中有32个"问题"可能并不需要失败测试所检查的内容，剔除这些样本后，任何模型的准确率假设均不成立。
AI.conclusion: 提高推理effort能稳定降低错误补丁被放行的比例，且Opus在中等effort下可实现近似高effort的效果并节省成本；但现有AI审查者均不能作为强门控，错误补丁接受率普遍偏高，且部分"错误"标签本身存在效度争议，因此部署时应结合更严格的测试或人工复核，并谨慎解读成本—准确性权衡。

title: DreamTour: Layout Steering for Training-Free World Exploration
summary: Video diffusion and world models generate plausible videos but do not reliably match the requested camera direction and travel distance. We present DreamTour, a training-free framework that generates camera tours from a single image with more accurate control over camera motion. DreamTour first uses a frozen image inpainting prior to extend the photograph beyond its original field of view while preserving the input pixels. Depth-based rendering of this extended scene along the requested camera path produces approximate target views that serve as spatial guidance. We introduce Layout Steering, which aligns early video latents with these views through decaying low-frequency corrections, leaving later denoising to refine appearance and dynamics. For longer tours, we autoregressively generate the video segments, repeating guidance construction from each segment's final frame to maintain camera control across the full trajectory. DreamTour improves directional accuracy and travel calibration on VBench while maintaining competitive video quality. On WorldScore, it strengthens camera control and scene consistency across chained movements. Together, these results demonstrate that training-free spatial guidance enables more accurate and consistent camera control in pretrained video diffusion and world models.

AI.tldr: DreamTour：一种无需训练、基于单张图像生成精确相机运镜视频的框架，通过深度渲染空间引导与布局引导（Layout Steering）实现方向与位移的准确控制。
AI.motivation: 现有视频扩散模型与世界模型虽能生成合理视频，但无法可靠地匹配所要求的相机方向与移动距离，缺乏精确的相机运动控制能力。
AI.method: DreamTour 分三步：(1) 用冻结的图像修复先验在保留原始像素的前提下将照片外扩至原始视场之外；(2) 沿指定相机路径对扩展场景做基于深度的渲染，得到近似目标视图作为空间引导；(3) 提出 Layout Steering，通过衰减式低频校正将早期视频潜变量与这些视图对齐，把外观与动态的细化留给后期去噪。对于长轨迹，按段自回归生成，并以每段末帧重新构建引导，从而在整个轨迹上保持控制。
AI.result: 在 VBench 上提升了方向准确性与位移标定（travel calibration），同时保持有竞争力的视频质量；在 WorldScore 上增强了链式运动中的相机控制与场景一致性。
AI.conclusion: 无需训练的空间引导可在预训练视频扩散与世界模型中实现更准确、更一致的相机控制。

title: The Marauder's Map: Bézier Manifolds Reveal Hidden Surfaces for Model Merging and Ensembling
summary: Neural circuits are famously more robust than deep networks. This is often explained through degeneracy, where structurally distinct configurations support the same function. However, real biological systems exhibit a more flexible form of degeneracy in which specialized circuits continually adapt towards new competencies through localized changes while preserving existing function. Deep learning studies degeneracy through mode connectivity, which connects same-task networks by low-loss curves, sheets, or volumes. However, the field lacks a counterpart to flexible degeneracy, which demands more than ordinary mode connectivity. Defining such an analogue requires asking whether many independently initialized models trained on distinct tasks can be connected by a high-dimensional region of multi-task solutions. We introduce $\textit{Nimbus}$, which learns a high-dimensional Bézier manifold connecting $N$ specialists, going beyond the one-dimensional paths and two-dimensional sheets of mode connectivity work. A naive parameterization would scale combinatorially with $N$, but $\textit{Nimbus}$ requires learning corrections of only 3 interaction orders, showing that the connecting manifold has surprisingly low complexity yet supports multi-task competencies. The resulting manifold forms a navigable "Marauder's Map" that connects specialist models through a shared geometry of competent solutions. Trained across vision and language domains, $\textit{Nimbus}$ produces manifolds that are functionally and locally weight-flat: ensembles sampled from them degrade more gracefully than baselines under input and weight perturbations, with the largest gains in NLL loss and calibration error. $\textit{Nimbus}$ supplies a deep learning interpretation of flexible degeneracy, recasting model connectivity from a low-dimensional path between distant solutions into a high-dimensional volume of nearby ones.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Nimbus，学习一个高维贝塞尔流形连接 N 个在不同任务上独立训练的专家模型，以极低复杂度（仅 3 阶交互修正）实现多任务解空间的高维连通体，从而在深度学习框架下刻画生物神经回路中"灵活简并"的概念。
AI.motivation: 生物神经回路的鲁棒性常归因于简并（degeneracy），即结构不同的配置支持同一功能；真实生物系统还具备更灵活的简并形式——专门化回路通过局部改变获得新能力同时保留原有功能。深度学习用模式连通性（mode connectivity，低损失曲线/曲面/体积）研究简并，但缺乏对应"灵活简并"的概念，其定义要求：多个独立初始化、训练于不同任务的模型能否被一个高维多任务解区域连接。
AI.method: 提出 Nimbus，学习连接 N 个专家模型的高维贝塞尔流形，超越模式连通性工作中一维路径与二维曲面的范式。朴素参数化会随 N 组合爆炸，因此 Nimbus 仅学习 3 阶交互修正（3 interaction orders），表明该连接流形具有出人意料的低复杂度，却能承载多任务能力；所得流形构成可导航的"Marauder's Map"，通过共享的胜任解几何连接各专家。
AI.result: 在视觉与语言领域训练后，Nimbus 产生的流形在功能与权重上均局部平坦：从中采样的集成在输入扰动与权重扰动下退化更平缓，相对基线在 NLL 损失与校准误差上收益最大。
AI.conclusion: Nimbus 为"灵活简并"提供了深度学习解释，将模型连通性从连接远处解的低维路径，重新表述为连接相邻解的高维体积。

title: FailPoint-X: A Policy-Matched, Failure-Anchored Benchmark for Offline VLA Post-Training from Human Takeovers
comment: 34 pages (8-page main paper, references, and 24-page supplementary material), 9 figures, 20 tables. Zirui Li and Yujie Yan contributed equally. Project page: https://lzrbit.github.io/FailPoint_X/ ; Code: https://github.com/yujieyan81/failpoint-x
summary: Human takeovers offer corrective supervision for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, but their contribution to offline post-training must be separated from that of continued optimization. We introduce FailPoint-X, a benchmark for offline VLA post-training with human takeovers. To represent uncertainty in failure onset, an annotator marks an interval for each failure, and training takeovers start at seeded frames sampled within it. From one fixed $π_{0.5}$ checkpoint, which also initializes post-training, we assemble 629 natural failures across 10 LIBERO-X task families at up to five difficulty levels. All 2,823 takeover attempts are logged; 2,400 are accepted recoveries, of which 2,320 are used for post-training. Evaluation restarts every method from the fixed midpoints of 384 held-out failure intervals. Under matched actor-update counts, we compare behavior cloning of recoveries, value-based offline learning on recoveries and failed rollouts, and continued training on existing demonstrations. Within 1,200 steps on the 240 L1-L3 held-out failures, cloning improves recovery by 29.4 percentage points (pp) over the demonstration-only control; the value-based learner does not establish a further gain (1.5 pp). In exploratory evaluation from L1-L5 nominal starts at the same horizon, cloning loses 30.0 pp of success relative to the base policy; mixing in demonstrations reduces the loss to 16.5 pp, a reduction that shrinks under a stricter, pre-specified horizon. Restorable failure states and a shared evaluator let all methods be compared from identical starts.

AI.tldr: 提出 FailPoint-X 基准，用于在固定 π0.5 检查点、匹配更新次数条件下，将"人类接管纠正"与"持续优化"对离线 VLA 后训练的贡献分离；结果显示行为克隆带来约 29.4pp 恢复增益，但会损失标称任务成功率，混入演示可缓解。
AI.motivation: 人类接管为 VLA 策略提供纠正性监督，但此前无法区分该监督的收益与单纯持续优化带来的收益；同时失败起始时刻存在不确定性，需要一个从固定起点、匹配算力出发的受控评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 FailPoint-X：在 10 个 LIBERO-X 任务族、最多 5 个难度级别上，从同一固定 π0.5 检查点收集 629 个自然失败；标注者为每个失败标记失败起始区间，接管训练从区间内采样的种子帧开始。共记录 2,823 次接管尝试（2,400 次被接受为恢复，2,320 条用于后训练）。方法对比在匹配 actor 更新次数下进行：恢复数据的行为克隆、基于价值的离线学习（恢复+失败轨迹）、以及在已有演示上的持续训练；评测统一从 384 个留出失败区间中点重启。
AI.result: 在 240 个 L1–L3 留出失败的 1,200 步内，克隆相对"仅演示"对照提升恢复率 29.4pp；价值型学习方法未带来进一步增益（1.5pp）。在同 horizon 下从 L1–L5 标称起点做探索性评测，克隆相对基础策略成功率下降 30.0pp，混入演示后损失降至 16.5pp，但在更严格的预设 horizon 下该缓解效果收缩。
AI.conclusion: 人类接管监督在恢复失败上高度有效，但单独使用会造成标称成功率回退，需与演示混合；可恢复失败状态与共享评测器使各方法可在相同起点下严格比较。FailPoint-X 为分离"接管监督"与"持续优化"效应提供了可复现的受控实验框架。

title: SlicePlanner: Logic-Guided Agentic AI for Online QoS-Aware Network Slicing in Open RAN
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures. Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the IEEE International Conference on Mobile Ad-Hoc and Smart Systems (MASS), October 21-23, 2026, Hong Kong SAR, China
summary: Adaptive network slicing in Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) demands reconfiguration decisions that respond to live traffic conditions while remaining safe with respect to Service Level Agreement (SLA) constraints, a combination that purely data-driven controllers cannot reliably guarantee without continuous retraining. We present SlicePlanner, a logic-guided closed-loop framework that treats each RAN reconfiguration as a controlled hypothesis: proposed from live and historical KeyPerformance Indicator (KPI) evidence, filtered through explicit SLA constraints and mined RAN control rules, and committed only when post-action measurements confirm improvement. SlicePlanner comprises two cooperating agents: SliceSense, which monitors live KPIs, retrieves context-conditioned evidence, and ranks candidate RAN actions through a surrogate-guided admissibility filter; and SliceGuard, which validates post-action KPI responses, rolls back harmful configurations, and refreshes rules under distribution drift. Validated over the air using OpenAirInterface, FlexRIC, and commercial Sierra Wireless 5G devices, SlicePlanner reduces SLA latency violations by up to 86% over static slicing and 50% over Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL)-based slicing, while maintaining comparable cell throughput and auditable decisions without online retraining.

AI.tldr: SlicePlanner 是一个逻辑引导的 O-RAN 闭环切片重配置框架，将每次重配置视为受控假设，经 SLA 约束与挖掘控制规则过滤、并在事后验证后才提交，实现无在线重训练下的安全自适应切片。
AI.motivation: O-RAN 自适应网络切片需要在响应实时流量变化的同时保证对 SLA 约束的安全性；纯数据驱动控制器若不持续重训练难以可靠保证这种组合。现有 DRL 方法存在安全不可保证、决策不可审计、需在线重训练等问题。
AI.method: 提出由两个协作智能体构成的闭环框架：SliceSense 监控实时 KPI、检索上下文条件化证据，并通过代理模型引导的可采纳性过滤器对候选 RAN 动作排序；SliceGuard 验证动作后的 KPI 响应、回滚有害配置，并在分布漂移下刷新规则。整体流程为"KPI 证据提出假设—SLA 约束与挖掘规则过滤—事后测量确认后提交"，基于 OpenAirInterface、FlexRIC 与商用 Sierra Wireless 5G 设备进行空口验证。
AI.result: 相比静态切片最多降低 86% 的 SLA 时延违规，相比基于 DRL 的切片降低 50%；同时保持相当的蜂窝吞吐量，并给出可审计决策且无需在线重训练。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑引导的"提出—过滤—验证—提交"闭环可以在不依赖持续重训练的前提下，把数据驱动动作与显式 SLA 约束和控制规则结合，兼顾安全性、可解释性与性能，在真实 O-RAN 测试床上验证了有效性。

title: ArtTet: Watertight Part Meshes of Articulated Objects from Rigid-Body Rules and Partitioned Marching Tetrahedra
summary: We present ArtTet, a method that reconstructs an articulated object from multi-view observations of two articulation states and outputs one watertight mesh per rigid part together with the joints that move them. Mesh splatting gives explicit triangles, but it treats the object as one scene. It extracts a single global surface and cannot keep the triangles of different parts apart; the mesh it exports is layered, self-intersecting, and full of holes. ArtTet follows a divide-and-conquer strategy instead. We first divide the object into rigid parts with dynamic- and geometric-constrained articulation and ownership inference. A multibody registration of the two states recovers the parts and their screw joints. Rigid-body rules on attachment, contact, and swept motion then correct joint types and part labels without any part annotation. We then divide space into part cells with an articulated tetrahedral partition, and conquer each cell with its own differentiable signed distance field on a shared tetrahedral grid. In these partitioned marching tetrahedra the fields are mutually exclusive by construction, so the extracted part meshes are closed and never overlap. All part meshes are optimized jointly from the images of both states through the recovered joints. On Articulate-100, ArtTet gives the most accurate axis directions, part motions, and part geometry over all objects among methods that use no part masks, and its part meshes have virtually no open boundary edges. We also show reconstructions of real captures from the SplArt dataset.

AI.tldr: ArtTet 从两个关节状态的多视角观测重建铰接物体，输出每个刚体部件的水密网格及运动它们的关节。方法采用分治策略：先用动态与几何约束的铰接推断和归属推断把物体分成刚体部件，并通过两状态多体重配准恢复部件及其螺旋关节，再用刚体规则（连接、接触、扫掠运动）在无部件标注下修正关节类型与部件标签；随后用铰接四面体划分把空间分成部件单元，在每个单元上于共享四面体网格中训练各自的可微符号距离场，由于场在构造上互斥，分区行进四面体提取的部件网格闭合且从不重叠。所有部件网格通过恢复的关节由两个状态的图像联合优化。
AI.motivation: Mesh splatting 虽能给出显式三角网格，但把物体当作单一场景，只提取一个全局表面，无法分离不同部件的三角形，导出的网格出现层叠、自交和大量孔洞。因此需要一个能保证各部件网格独立且闭合的重建方法。
AI.method: 分治策略。第一步：以动态与几何约束的铰接推断与归属推断划分刚体部件，对两个状态做多体重配准以恢复部件及其螺旋关节，并利用连接、接触与扫掠运动的刚体规则在无部件标注条件下修正关节类型和部件标签。第二步：用铰接四面体划分将空间分为部件单元，在每个单元上于共享四面体网格中学习各自的可微符号距离场，这些场构造上互斥，因此分区行进四面体提取的部件网格闭合且不重叠；所有部件网格经恢复的关节由两个状态的图像联合优化。
AI.result: 在 Articulate-100 上，ArtTet 在使用无部件掩码的方法中，对全部物体给出最准确的轴方向、部件运动和部件几何，且部件网格几乎不含开放边界边。此外还展示了 SplArt 数据集真实采集的重建结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式分区与互斥符号距离场的联合优化，可在无需部件标注和部件掩码的情况下获得闭合、互不重叠的部件网格以及准确的关节与运动估计，并在合成与真实数据上验证有效。

title: Discovering Explicit Magnetic Core-Loss Equations via Symbolic Sparse Identification
summary: Compact core loss equations are essential tools in magnetic component design, but existing approaches trade accuracy against interpretability. Empirical models such as the Steinmetz Equation (SE) yield compact expressions of limited accuracy, while machine learning methods achieve high accuracy as black-box predictors. This paper bridges the gap with a Symbolic Sparse Identification (SSI) framework, which casts core loss modeling as a data-driven symbolic regression problem and recovers unknown equations directly from measured data, without presuming a functional form. First, a comprehensively expanded library of symbolic candidate terms far richer than the SE is constructed. Second, the governing terms are isolated from this library by sparse regression. Third, the coefficients of the retained terms are refined with an AdamW optimizer to maximize accuracy and form an analytical equation. Experiments on Fair-Rite 78, 79, and 95 yield test mean absolute percentage errors of 1.89%, 1.01%, and 1.56%, respectively, with only 10, 10, and 7 active terms. Comparisons with empirical, numerical, and symbolic models quantify the resulting balance of accuracy and compactness. SSI thus provides an explicit and physically guided approach for high-frequency magnetic characterization and design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出符号稀疏辨识（SSI）框架，将磁芯损耗建模转化为数据驱动的符号回归问题，直接从实测数据中恢复紧凑且高精度的解析方程，兼顾精度与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 磁芯损耗建模中，紧凑性与精度难以兼得：Steinmetz方程（SE）等经验模型表达式简洁但精度有限，机器学习方法精度高但为黑箱预测器，缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: SSI框架分三步：(1) 构建远比SE更丰富的符号候选项库；(2) 通过稀疏回归从库中分离主导项；(3) 用AdamW优化器精修保留项的系数，形成解析方程；无需预设函数形式。
AI.result: 在Fair-Rite 78、79、95材料上的测试MAPE分别为1.89%、1.01%、1.56%，分别仅含10、10、7个活跃项；并与经验模型、数值模型及符号模型对比，量化了精度与紧凑性的平衡。
AI.conclusion: SSI为高频磁性表征与设计提供了一种显式、具有物理引导意义的方法，实现了高精度与可解释紧凑表达式的统一。

title: Triage Before Fine-Tuning: Feasibility-Gated Selection and Monitored Adaptation of Embodied Foundation Models for a Fixed Physical Platform
summary: Embodied foundation models are increasingly deployed by selection: a practitioner picks a public checkpoint by benchmark rank and fine-tunes it on local data. The platform is fixed before the model is chosen, with little or no local data. We ask what such a checkpoint loses on a fixed platform and which part of the loss local data can buy back. We split the gap by what can repair it. A sensing gap, information the sensors do not capture, cannot be closed with their data; a latency gap, output arriving after the control loop needs it, belongs to the loop, not the weights; only a distribution gap is fine-tuning's to repair. TRIAGE turns this into feasibility-gated selection and monitored adaptation in five stages: gates on the sensor contract and on end-to-end latency that no score can override, probes on ten minutes of local logs, a ranking by target-relevant score among the candidates that pass, and fine-tuning that is monitored and checked in closed loop before release. On driving benchmarks, a deadline below a leading closed-loop model's latency makes it collide on 80 to 90% of routes, and losing field of view moves plans 2.2 to 5.7 times more than losing resolution at equal pixels. Local frames close 75% of a stability gap but raise perturbation sensitivity at small budgets, and picking by score violates a gate in two of four deployment profiles. On a full-scale vehicle, the factory camera failed the sensing gate and an added camera repaired it. The latency gate removed the two highest-scoring candidates, neither of which completed a closed-loop trip. The selected model passed acceptance in 4 of 5 closed-loop trips, and the closed-loop check withheld a fine-tuned model that had improved offline. TRIAGE lets organizations that cannot train foundation models from scratch find out whether a public checkpoint can run on the robot or vehicle they own, and what to fix if not.

AI.tldr: 提出TRIAGE框架，将公开具身基础模型在自有平台上的性能差距拆分为感知差距、延迟差距与分布差距，实现可行性门控的选型与受监控的微调适配。
AI.motivation: practitioners按榜单排名挑选公开checkpoint再本地微调，但平台在选型前已固定且本地数据极少；需要回答固定平台上该模型损失了什么、本地数据能挽回哪部分。核心洞察是差距应按"能否被修复"来分类，而非笼统归为性能下降。
AI.method: TRIAGE五阶段流程：①传感器契约门控与端到端延迟门控（不可被任何分数覆盖）；②用十分钟本地日志做探测；③在通过门控的候选中按目标相关分数排序；④受监控的微调；⑤发布前闭环校验。差距分解为：感知差距（传感器未捕获的信息，本地数据无法弥补）、延迟差距（归属控制回路而非权重）、分布差距（唯一可由微调修复）。
AI.result: 驾驶基准：截止时间低于领先闭环模型延迟时，该模型在80–90%路线上碰撞；等像素下视野缩小的规划偏移是分辨率降低的2.2–5.7倍。本地帧弥合75%稳定性差距但小预算下提升扰动敏感性；按分数选型在两个（共四个）部署画像中违反门控。实车：原厂相机未通过感知门控，加装相机后修复；延迟门控剔除两个最高分候选（均未完成闭环行程）；最终模型5次闭环行程4次通过验收；闭环校验拦截了一个离线指标提升的微调模型。
AI.conclusion: TRIAGE让无法从零训练基础模型的组织判断公开checkpoint能否运行在自有机器人或车辆上，并在不能时明确该修什么。

title: Interactive Proofs as a Unified Framework for Evaluating and Leveraging Verifiable Proof Generation by LLM Agents
summary: Recent advances in LLM-assisted theorem proving and program verification have attracted widespread attention. Beyond determining whether a proposition is true, LLM agents must produce evidence that can be independently checked by humans or formal verification tools. To evaluate the underlying, protocol-agnostic ability of LLM agents to construct verifiable proofs-rather than their proficiency with any particular proof language or verification tool, we introduce Merlin-Bench. Drawing on interactive proof systems from computational complexity theory, we cast an LLM agent as the prover: under a designated protocol, the agent interacts with a formal verifier to substantiate its claimed answer to a problem instance. We develop an automated framework for constructing test cases and use it to create 100 cases across 15 problem families, each formulated within this prover-verifier framework. Experiments with 10 frontier LLMs across multiple agent harnesses show that reliably producing verifiable proofs in accordance with specified protocols remains a substantial challenge. Our case studies further provide actionable insights into improving agents' ability to generate verifier-accepted proofs: tool use is essential for completing practical proof tasks; different forms of guidance, ranging from engineering instructions to problem-specific knowledge, substantially affect success rates on interactive-proof tasks; and proof-solving experience distilled from abstract tasks can transfer to concrete, real-world verification tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Merlin-Bench，将 LLM 智能体置于交互式证明系统中充当证明者，在指定协议下与形式化验证器交互，以评估其构建可验证证明的“协议无关”底层能力；基于自建自动化框架生成覆盖 15 个问题族、共 100 个测试用例，对 10 个前沿 LLM 在多套 agent harness 下测评，发现可靠产出可验证证明仍是重大挑战，并给出工具使用、引导形式与经验迁移等方面的可操作结论。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 定理证明与程序验证研究多关注“命题是否为真”或特定证明语言/验证工具的熟练度，缺少对智能体在任意协议下构建可被独立检查的证明这一通用能力的评估。作者希望构建一个协议无关、可独立核查的评测基准，衡量智能体的“证明生产能力”而非语言或工具技巧。
AI.method: 借鉴计算复杂性理论中的交互式证明系统（IP），将 LLM 智能体建模为 prover，形式化验证器为 verifier，二者在指定协议下交互以证实问题实例的答案；设计自动化测试用例构造框架，据此生成 15 个问题族、100 个用例；在多种 agent harness 下评测 10 个前沿 LLM，并进行案例分析（工具使用、引导类型、经验迁移）。
AI.result: 实验表明，依据指定协议可靠生成可验证证明对当前前沿 LLM 仍是显著挑战；案例研究显示：（1）工具使用对完成实际证明任务不可或缺；（2）从工程指令到问题特定知识的不同引导形式显著影响交互式证明任务的成功率；（3）从抽象任务中提炼的证明求解经验可迁移到具体、真实世界的验证任务。
AI.conclusion: Merlin-Bench 提供了协议无关、可独立核查的证明能力评测范式，揭示 LLM 智能体在可验证证明生成上的能力缺口，并为提升验证器可接受证明的产出率提供实践指引（强化工具使用、优化引导设计、利用抽象任务经验迁移）。

title: Synchronizing Cameras via 3D Object Relationships
summary: In this paper, we synchronize multiple videos of the same dynamic event through object relationships. Driven by dynamic reconstruction and novel view synthesis, many recent synchronization methods rely on pixel-level evidence, such as point correspondences across views or the photometric losses of a reconstructed scene. In dynamic scenes, however, fast motion and occlusions make the moving regions that carry much of the timing information hard to match across views. We thus propose to bring back the traditional wisdom that objects are reliable cues for global reasoning about cameras. Measured in 3D, the relationships between objects, such as the distance between two people, are stable across all views up to scale; they can serve as cues for alignment. To compare these relationships across cameras, we only need the identity of each object in every view, as the cues are relational. We obtain these identities by giving a vision-language model a few frames of every camera and prompting it to identify the objects in the scene. We then segment and track each identified object through every video with an open-vocabulary segmentor. To obtain the 3D locations of objects, we use a pretrained depth estimator. Where depth or segmentation fails, we complement these 3D cues with 2D motion from point tracks. Finally, we synchronize the cameras by finding the temporal offsets at which the cues of different cameras agree best, first for each camera pair and then for all cameras jointly with robust optimization. We evaluate our method on four standard benchmarks, outperforming the state of the art.

AI.tldr: 提出以物体间的3D关系（如两人间距离）作为跨视角同步线索，借助VLM识别物体、开放词汇分割跟踪与预训练深度估计获得物体3D位置，缺失处用点轨迹的2D运动补充，先成对再联合鲁棒优化求时间偏移，在四个基准上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有动态视频同步方法依赖像素级证据（跨视角点对应或重建场景的光度损失），但在动态场景中快速运动与遮挡使承载时序信息的运动区域难以跨视角匹配，导致同步不可靠。
AI.method: 回归"物体是相机全局推理可靠线索"的传统思路：物体间的3D关系（如两人间距）在各视角下仅差尺度而稳定，且仅需各视角中物体身份即可比较。用视觉语言模型观看每相机少量帧以识别场景物体，用开放词汇分割器逐视频分割并跟踪；用预训练深度估计器获取物体3D位置；在深度或分割失效处以点轨迹的2D运动补充。通过在不同相机对间寻找使线索最一致的时间偏移，再用鲁棒优化对所有相机联合求解完成同步。
AI.result: 在四个标准基准上评测，性能优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 以物体3D关系为核心的跨视角时序对齐范式，可有效规避动态场景中像素级匹配的脆弱性，实现鲁棒的无需标定的多视频同步。

title: Federated Learning with Uncertainty Quantification on Pseudo Label Exchange
summary: In this work, we investigate federated stochastic operator learning for stochastic partial differential equations (SPDEs), with an emphasis on heterogeneous client data distributions and uncertainty quantification. Federated learning enables clients to collaboratively train models without exchanging their original solution data, but conventional federated averaging can suffer significant performance degradation when client distributions differ, particularly when their input function supports are disjoint. To address these challenges, we propose the Federated Stochastic Operator Network (FedSON), a two-phase framework that combines auxiliary data construction with stochastic operator learning. In the first phase, locally trained deterministic neural operators and their corresponding input functions are exchanged to generate pseudolabeled auxiliary data, enabling the federated model to learn across heterogeneous input distributions without sharing original solution trajectories. In the second phase, a stochastic operator network is trained on top of the frozen deterministic operator to characterize stochastic fluctuations and quantify uncertainty in the predicted solutions. Numerical experiments involving the heat equation, viscous Burgers' equation, and two-dimensional advection-diffusion equation demonstrate the FedSON substantially improves deterministic prediction accuracy under heterogeneous client distributions while producing uncertainty estimates comparable to those obtained through centralized training.

AI.tldr: 提出FedSON两阶段联邦随机算子学习框架：第一阶段交换本地确定性神经算子及输入函数生成伪标签辅助数据，第二阶段在冻结的确定性算子上训练随机算子网络以刻画不确定性，从而在异构客户端分布下实现高精度预测与可靠不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习可在不交换原始解数据的前提下协同训练模型，但传统联邦平均在客户端数据分布异构（尤其输入函数支撑集不相交）时会显著性能退化；同时SPDE求解还需不确定性量化。因此需要一种兼顾异构分布学习与不确定性量化的联邦算子学习方案。
AI.method: FedSON为两阶段框架：①辅助数据构建：客户端本地训练确定性神经算子，交换本地算子及其输入函数以生成带伪标签的辅助数据，使联邦模型能跨越异构输入分布学习而不共享原始解轨迹；②随机算子学习：在冻结的确定性算子之上训练随机算子网络，刻画解的随机波动并实现不确定性量化。
AI.result: 在热方程、粘性Burgers方程和二维对流扩散方程上的数值实验表明：在异构客户端分布下，FedSON显著提升确定性预测精度，且其不确定性估计与集中式训练相当。
AI.conclusion: FedSON通过辅助数据构建与随机算子学习的解耦设计，有效缓解了联邦平均在异构分布下的退化问题，并在不共享原始数据的前提下实现了与集中式训练可比的不确定性量化性能。

title: LSRP*-LA: Scalable and Anytime Multi-Agent Path Finding for Large Agents with Asynchronous Actions
comment: 8 pages, 10 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) seeks collision-free paths for multiple agents from their start locations to their goal locations while minimizing path costs. Most MAPF algorithms assume that each agent occupies a single vertex and that the actions of all agents are synchronized. These assumptions may limit the use of MAPF planners in practice. Existing planners that get rid of both assumptions either handle only a few agents or cannot improve their solutions. Recently, a planner called LSRP* was proposed, which is scalable and anytime with asynchronous actions, but still limited by that each agent occupies a single vertex. This paper develops a new planner called LSRP*-LA for MAPF for large agents with asynchronous actions (LA-MAPF-AA), where an agent can occupy several cells. LSRP*-LA is scalable and complete, and it keeps improving solution quality after the initial solution is obtained until the runtime budget depletes. We analyze the properties of LSRP*-LA and test it against several baselines with up to 800 agents on various maps. LSRP*-LA can handle twice as many agents as baseline methods and its solution cost is about half that of recent synchronous planners for large agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 LSRP*-LA，首个可扩展、完备且 anytime 的多智能体路径规划器，同时处理大尺寸智能体（占用多格）与异步动作（LA-MAPF-AA）。
AI.motivation: 多数 MAPF 算法假设智能体只占单顶点、所有智能体动作同步，这两条假设限制了实际应用；现有能同时摆脱两条假设的规划器或只能处理少量智能体，或无法持续改进解质量。
AI.method: 在可扩展、anytime、支持异步动作的 LSRP* 基础上，将单顶点占用推广到多格占用，构建 LSRP*-LA，并对其性质进行理论分析；在多种地图上与多个基线对比，智能体规模最多 800 个。
AI.result: LSRP*-LA 可处理的智能体数量约为基线方法的两倍；解代价约为近期面向大智能体的同步规划器的一半。
AI.conclusion: LSRP*-LA 在保留可扩展性与完备性的同时，可在获得初始解后持续优化直到时间预算耗尽，为大智能体异步 MAPF 提供了有效的求解方案。

title: Faster and Better Query (FBQ): Learning Future-Position Probes from the First Generated Token
summary: When a large language model (LLM) evicts prompt keys and values at the end of prefill, it must decide what to keep before it sees the queries from subsequent decoding steps. Generating a draft continuation can approximate those queries at the cost of extra autoregressive steps. Can we use the embedding of the first output token, already available from the final prefill logits, to construct low-cost pseudo queries that approximate future decoding queries? We start with FTQ-8, which places eight copies of the first token ID at consecutive future positions and reads their attention to the prompt in one causal forward pass. Each copy sees a different prefix, but a generic opening such as the offers a poor literal guess for seven successive tokens. Faster and Better Query (FBQ) preserves the first embedding and learns an additive offset at each of the seven remaining positions. We train these offsets to predict the average prompt attention of a full-cache continuation. On LongBench, FBQ performs comparably to eight-step Lookahead Q-Cache at the same cache budget, using a single forward pass to compute all probe queries.

AI.tldr: 提出FBQ：用预填充阶段最后一个logits中已得的首token嵌入，加上可学习的逐位置加性偏移，构造低成本伪查询，在单次前向中近似未来解码查询，用于KV cache淘汰决策。
AI.motivation: LLM在prefill结束时需在未见后续解码查询前决定淘汰哪些prompt的key/value；用草稿续写近似未来查询需额外的自回归步，代价高。因此希望复用首token嵌入以零额外解码成本获得伪查询。
AI.method: 先尝试FTQ-8：将首token ID复制八份置于连续未来位置，在一次因果前向中读取其对prompt的注意力；但通用开头词（如"the"）作为字面猜测对后续七个token预测效果差。提出FBQ：保留首个嵌入，在其余七个位置各学习一个加性偏移，并以全缓存续写产生的平均prompt注意力为监督目标训练这些偏移。
AI.result: 在LongBench上，相同cache预算下FBQ与八步Lookahead Q-Cache性能相当，且全部探针查询仅需一次前向传播即可计算。
AI.conclusion: 首token嵌入结合轻量学习偏移可有效替代多步草稿续写来估计未来解码查询的注意力，在保持效果的同时显著降低预填充期开销。

title: Measuring and Predicting Image-Token Repair Boundaries in Vision-Language Models
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, 17 tables; supplementary material included
summary: Degraded images make vision-language models answer wrongly. Using synthetic paired blur, noise, and low light, we trace which clean image states can still repair those answers from the vision encoder through the language model. In four encoder models, 12 to 23 ranked tokens recover half of the full-patch effect, whereas random orders require four to fifteen times as many; encoder-free Gemma needs 22.2 versus 53.1. Full-block repair expires at a model-specific language-model crossing. The matched reverse-direction intervention is algebraically identical to text-token restoration, so its gap from image restoration measures a redundancy band rather than an independent predictor. A clean-image gray-ablation crossing independently predicts held-out repair with 1.53-layer error, against 3.65 for shared depth. Gemma MMBench has the only large attention-to-repair point gap; Gemma GQA does not. Restormer provides a non-oracle consistency check on two models.

AI.tldr: 本文以合成配对退化（模糊、噪声、低光）为手段，追踪视觉编码器到语言模型各层中对修复VLM错误答案最关键的状态，发现少数排序靠前的视觉token即可恢复约一半的整块修复效果，且存在与模型相关的"交叉层"可独立预测held-out修复效果。
AI.motivation: 退化图像会使视觉-语言模型给出错误答案，但模型内部从视觉编码器到语言模型中，究竟哪些"干净图像状态"对纠正这些错误真正起作用尚不清楚；需要量化各层/各token对修复答案的贡献，并检验修复机制的冗余性与可预测性。
AI.method: 使用合成的成对模糊、噪声与低光退化图像；在编码器各层进行逐token排序与消融（如灰值消融），测量修复错误答案所需的token数量；对比随机顺序的基线；对四个编码器模型与无编码器的Gemma均做实验；设计匹配的反方向干预（与文本token恢复在代数上等价），用以界定冗余带；以干净图像灰值消融的"交叉层"作为held-out修复的预测指标；用Restormer做非oracle一致性检验。
AI.result: 在四个编码器模型中，仅12–23个排序token即可恢复整块修复效果的一半，而随机顺序需4–15倍数量；无编码器的Gemma为22.2 vs 53.1。整块修复在模型特定的语言模型层级"交叉点"处失效。反方向干预与文本token恢复代数等价，其与图像修复的差距反映的是冗余带而非独立预测因子。干净图像灰值消融的交叉层可独立预测held-out修复，误差1.53层，优于共享深度的3.65层。Gemma MMBench出现唯一较大的attention-to-repair点差，Gemma GQA则没有。Restormer在两个模型上提供了非oracle一致性验证。
AI.conclusion: VLM的答案修复高度集中于少量关键视觉token，存在可预测的层级交叉点，且修复机制中相当部分是冗余的；灰值消融交叉层可作为无需修复实验的廉价预测指标，为理解与改进退化鲁棒性提供了机制性依据。

title: Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge to Guide Continual Learning
comment: Published at fifth conference on lifelong learning agents
summary: The goal of continual learning (CL) is to adapt to new data (plasticity) while retaining the knowledge acquired from old data (stability). Existing methods are explicitly designed to focus on balancing stability and plasticity to mitigate the challenge of catastrophic forgetting while promoting learning. However, the impact of order and nature of samples from the new data that the network is trained on remains an under explored factor. We argue that a CL algorithm should have the ability to rank incoming samples in terms of their relationship with prior data and their effect on the learning process. In this work, we investigate if scoring and prioritizing incoming data based on their semantic relationships with the model's current knowledge can benefit CL. We propose SACK, short for Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge, a plug and play technique for continual learning methods. SACK dissects categorical knowledge of the model into fine-grained concepts, computes the relationships between previously learned concepts and new concepts in each experience, and uses this relationship knowledge for prioritizing new samples. Experiments across several types of CL methods (regularization, replay, and prompt based) in class incremental and task incremental settings demonstrate that integration of SACK not only improves accuracy and reduces forgetting but also handles long tail distribution, helps focus on semantically interpretable regions, and yields better calibrated and robust models compared to prior approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出SACK（Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge），一种即插即用方法：将模型的类别知识拆解为细粒度概念，量化新旧概念间的语义关系，并据此对新样本排序/优先级化，以提升持续学习性能。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习研究主要关注稳定性与可塑性的平衡以缓解灾难性遗忘，但忽略了新数据样本的顺序与性质这一因素。作者认为CL算法应能按样本与先验知识的关系及其对学习过程的影响对输入样本排序。
AI.method: SACK把模型的类别知识分解为细粒度概念；在每个经验(experience)中计算已学概念与新概念之间的关系；利用该关系知识对新样本进行优先级排序（scoring and prioritizing），作为插件接入现有CL方法。
AI.result: 在正则化、回放、基于prompt三类CL方法上，于类增量与任务增量设置中验证：集成SACK提升了准确率、降低遗忘，并能处理长尾分布、聚焦语义可解释区域，同时获得更好的校准性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 样本顺序与语义关系信息是被忽视的有效因素；基于概念级语义关系对样本排序的即插即用策略可普遍增强多种持续学习方法。

title: $\widetilde{\varepsilon}$: Does Initial Noise Induce Directional Bias in Vision-Language-Action Models?
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have widely adopted diffusion-based action generation for continuous robot motions, enabling fine-grained control across diverse tasks. However, recent studies have shown that their performance is highly sensitive to initial noise, with resulting action errors that make recovery difficult during execution. Existing approaches search for favorable noise initializations to improve performance, yet the action expert itself remains sensitive to noise. In this work, we reveal that initial noise induces a consistent directional bias in action space that closely aligns with the noise's temporal mean. We thus introduce a simple yet effective framework that improves robustness to initial noise through interventions during both training and inference. During training, we enforce consistent action predictions from antithetic noise pairs $(ε, -ε)$ and, at inference, remove the noise's temporal mean. Our method substantially reduces action deviation and improves task performance across simulation benchmarks. In real-robot experiments, our method increases the average task success rate of $π_{0.5}$ from 40% to 68%, with more stable and consistent execution.

AI.tldr: 揭示了扩散式动作生成对初始噪声敏感的原因在于噪声的时间均值会在动作空间引入一致的方向性偏差，并提出训练期反对称噪声对(ε, -ε)一致性约束与推理期去除噪声时间均值的简单框架，显著降低动作偏差并提升仿真与真机任务成功率（π0.5由40%提升至68%）。
AI.motivation: VLA模型广泛采用扩散式动作生成以实现连续精细控制，但其性能高度依赖初始噪声：噪声敏感导致动作误差难以在执行中恢复。现有工作通过搜索有利噪声初始化来缓解，但动作专家本身对噪声依旧敏感，未触及根本原因。
AI.method: 首先识别出初始噪声在动作空间诱发与噪声时间均值高度对齐的一致方向性偏差；据此在训练与推理两端施加干预：训练时对反对称噪声对(ε, -ε)施加一致的预测约束，推理时直接去除噪声的时间均值。
AI.result: 在多个仿真基准上大幅降低动作偏差并提升任务性能；真机实验中，将π0.5的平均任务成功率从40%提升至68%，执行更稳定一致。
AI.conclusion: 初始噪声敏感性的根源是噪声时间均值引起的系统性方向偏差，通过在训练目标与推理采样中对噪声做对称化与去均值处理即可高效提升VLA扩散策略的鲁棒性与成功率，方法简单、通用且无需搜索。

title: EVA: Evidence-seeking Visual Agent for Hallucination-Resistant Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Hallucinations in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often arise from visual assumptions that go unchecked. Self-reflection, multi-agent debate, and counterfactual verification can reinforce erroneous conclusions when they rely on the same unverified visual assumptions. External visual tools can provide verifiable evidence, but models may select the wrong tools, supply incorrect parameters, or ignore or contradict the evidence they obtain. In this work, we propose EVA, an Evidence-seeking Visual Agent that reframes multimodal reasoning as an explicit process of evidence acquisition and verification. At the core of EVA is a unified evidence-grounded execution pipeline designed to address the above challenges through two tightly coupled mechanisms. First, we introduce Iterative Tool Replanning, which dynamically refines tool selection and parameters based on intermediate observations, improving the reliability of tool usage. Second, we develop Evidence Consistency Verification, an answer validation mechanism that improves alignment between the final prediction and the collected evidence, mitigating evidence--reasoning inconsistencies. In addition, to balance robustness and efficiency, EVA incorporates Selective Evidence Routing, an adaptive fast--slow reasoning strategy that determines when external evidence is necessary. Visually straightforward queries are handled via direct reasoning, while complex or high-risk cases trigger tool-based evidence acquisition. By jointly addressing how to reliably acquire evidence and how to use it consistently, EVA transforms multimodal reasoning from passive answer validation into explicit evidence-backed decision making. Experimental results demonstrate that EVA achieves significantly improved reasoning reliability over direct VLM inference and multi-agent methods, while maintaining efficiency through selective tool invocation.

AI.tldr: 提出 EVA（Evidence-seeking Visual Agent），将多模态推理重构为显式的证据获取与验证过程，通过迭代工具重规划、证据一致性验证与选择性证据路由三项机制，提升工具使用可靠性、答案与证据一致性及推理效率。
AI.motivation: MLLM 幻觉常源于未经检验的视觉假设；自反思、多智能体辩论、反事实验证若共享同一未验证的视觉假设，反而会强化错误结论。引入外部视觉工具可提供可验证证据，但模型可能选错工具、给定错误参数，或忽略、抵触所获证据。因此需同时解决"如何可靠地获取证据"与"如何一致地使用证据"两个问题。
AI.method: EVA 的核心是统一的证据落地执行管线，含两个紧耦合机制：(1) Iterative Tool Replanning——依据中间观测动态修正工具选择与调用参数，提高工具使用可靠性；(2) Evidence Consistency Verification——答案验证机制，提升最终预测与所收集证据的对齐度，缓解证据—推理不一致。此外引入 Selective Evidence Routing，即自适应快—慢推理策略，判断何时需要外部证据：视觉上直观的查询走直接推理，复杂或高风险样本触发工具取证，以兼顾鲁棒性与效率。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比直接 VLM 推理与多智能体方法，EVA 显著提升推理可靠性，并通过选择性工具调用保持效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合处理证据获取的可靠性与证据使用的一致性，EVA 将多模态推理从被动的答案验证转变为显式的、有证据支撑的决策过程，在可靠性与效率之间取得较好平衡。

title: BreathSplat: Grounding One Smooth Motion in the Breathing Phase for 4D Cone-Beam CT
summary: Four-dimensional cone-beam computed tomography (4D-CBCT) images the anatomy of a breathing patient, but sees each breathing phase from only a few angles. Breathing, however, is a smooth motion that repeats; it has a phase. Existing methods exploit this either by reconstructing the anatomy as a function of the breathing phase, often through bins, or by estimating smooth dynamic motions in time. Yet none of these grounds one smooth motion in the phase. We thus propose to share projections across breathing phases with splines. Specifically, we represent the 4D volume with dynamic Gaussians whose motion uses B-splines in space and time. We ground the motion state in the respiratory phase, which we read from well-studied conventional surrogates. Projections at the same phase in different breathing cycles then constrain the same anatomy and motion. On simulated lung scans, our method, BreathSplat, outperforms recent dynamic methods in reconstruction and motion accuracy, including those given the ground-truth phase. We further show qualitatively, on two real patient scans, that our method provides clearer reconstructions than the state of the art.

AI.tldr: 提出BreathSplat：用时空B样条驱动的动态高斯表示4D体积，并以呼吸相位为锚定，将不同呼吸周期同相位投影共享，提升4D-CBCT重建与运动估计精度。
AI.motivation: 4D-CBCT每个呼吸相位仅有少量角度投影，属严重欠采样问题。现有方法或按相位分箱重建解剖，或在时间上估计平滑动态运动，但均未将"单一平滑运动"锚定到呼吸相位这一物理量上，因而无法有效跨呼吸周期共享投影约束。
AI.method: 以动态高斯（dynamic Gaussians）表示4D体积，其运动在空间与时间上均由B样条参数化；将运动状态锚定于从成熟传统替代信号（surrogate）中读取的呼吸相位；由此使不同呼吸周期中同一相位的投影约束同一解剖结构与同一运动状态，实现跨相位投影共享与联合优化。
AI.result: 在仿真肺部扫描上，BreathSplat在重建精度与运动精度上均优于近期动态方法，包括那些获得真值相位输入的方法；在两个真实患者扫描上，定性结果显示其重建结果较现有最优方法更清晰。
AI.conclusion: 将平滑运动以相位为锚、并用样条实现跨相位投影共享，是缓解4D-CBCT极端欠采样的有效途径；相位锚定的动态高斯表示在仿真与真实数据上均表现优越。

title: Temporal Selective Exploration for Reinforcement Learning-Guided Continuous-Discrete Flow Matching in 3D Molecular Design
summary: Flow matching has shown strong potential in generative tasks, while its optimization via Reinforcement Learning (RL) remains underexplored, especially in continuous-discrete mixed settings. Moreover, flow matching is formulated as an Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE), whose deterministic trajectories do not naturally support RL optimization. Introducing stochasticity by converting the entire trajectory into a Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) is a common practice. Nevertheless, not all timesteps contribute to the final outcomes, and redundant exploration introduces additional noise. Furthermore, in multi-objective settings, some objectives may dominate the optimization while others receive insufficient updates. In this study, we propose an RL-guided continuous-discrete flow matching framework with temporal selective exploration for 3D de novo molecular design. Specifically, our method jointly optimizes continuous and discrete flow matching for atomic coordinates and molecular identities, respectively, while restricting exploration to timesteps that primarily contribute to target properties, reducing ineffective exploration. We also introduce a reward-based advantage calibration mechanism to mitigate objective dominance in multi-objective optimization. The framework is applied to design inhibitors for both the well-studied target protein EGFR and the challenging Pin1 protein. We identify some novel candidate inhibitors, supported by in silico validation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种RL引导的连续-离散流匹配框架，结合时间选择性探索与奖励优势校准，用于3D从头分子设计，并在EGFR与Pin1抑制剂生成中验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 流匹配在生成任务中潜力显著，但其强化学习优化仍研究不足，尤其是连续-离散混合场景。流匹配以ODE形式建模，确定性轨迹难以直接支持RL优化；常见做法是将整条轨迹转为SDE引入随机性，但并非所有时间步都影响最终结果，冗余探索会带来额外噪声。此外多目标优化中易出现目标支配、部分目标更新不足的问题。
AI.method: 构建RL引导的连续-离散流匹配框架：分别对原子坐标（连续）与分子身份（离散）进行联合流匹配优化；将探索限制在对目标性质贡献主要的时间步上，以减少无效探索；同时引入基于奖励的优势校准机制，缓解多目标优化中的目标支配问题。
AI.result: 将该框架应用于针对成熟靶点EGFR与更具挑战性的Pin1蛋白的抑制剂设计，识别出若干新型候选抑制剂，并通过计算机模拟验证提供支持。
AI.conclusion: 时间选择性探索与奖励优势校准可有效提升流匹配的RL优化效率与多目标均衡性，验证了连续-离散流匹配在3D从头分子设计中的可行性；在EGFR和Pin1上获得的候选分子经in silico验证具有潜力。

title: Learning a Whole-Body Pivot-Walking Gait for Heavy-Box Transport with a Humanoid
comment: Accepted to IEEE-RAS Humanoids 2026. 8 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Project page: https://uni963.github.io/pivot-walking/ Video: https://youtu.be/8lKDYrlzyZ4
summary: Through pivot walking, humans can transport objects that are too heavy to lift. Previous humanoid studies have relied on planned sequences in which object manipulation and stepping are executed separately and the object is brought to rest between successive rotations. However, few studies have developed a single learned controller for humanoid pivot walking. In this paper, we propose a single reinforcement-learning policy that jointly coordinates stepping, balance control, and object manipulation. The policy is trained using rewards that promote alternating pivot motions and a phase reference that progresses according to the displacement of the object. In simulation, we confirmed that the humanoid can pivot a box. For deployment, we fine-tuned the policy into an object-blind version that follows a periodic clock instead of the progress reference. On the real robot, the deployed policy transported the box forward by more than 1 m in all five trials; each trial ended at a base-tilt safety stop. These results demonstrate that coordinated humanoid pivot walking can be learned with reinforcement learning and transferred to a physical humanoid robot without direct object-state sensing.

AI.tldr: 提出单一强化学习策略，联合协调迈步、平衡控制与物体操作，实现人形机器人枢轴行走（pivot walking）搬运重物，并成功迁移到实物机器人。
AI.motivation: 枢轴行走可搬运无法抬起的重物，但已有的人形研究依赖"操作与迈步分离、每次旋转间物体静止"的规划序列，缺乏单一学习型控制器。
AI.method: 设计单一强化学习策略联合优化迈步、平衡与物体操作；奖励函数鼓励交替枢轴运动，并以随物体位移推进的相位参考作为引导。部署时微调为"物体盲"版本，用周期性时钟替代进度参考，无需直接物体状态感知。
AI.result: 仿真中人形成功枢轴转动箱子；实机上部署策略在全部5次试验中均将箱子向前搬运超过1 m，每次试验均以基座倾角安全停止告终。
AI.conclusion: 协调式人形枢轴行走可通过强化学习习得，并能在无直接物体状态感知的情况下迁移至实物人形机器人。

title: P-FedSkill: A Personalized Federated Skill Learning Framework under Task Heterogeneity
summary: Skill learning has become an important way to improve agent performance. However, agent trajectories often contain sensitive information and cannot be shared across clients, hindering collaborative skill learning. To tackle this issue, federated skill learning (FSL) has emerged as a solution by distilling trajectories into compact skill representations and uploading them to a central server for sharing. However, existing FSL methods typically share skills based on skill similarity without considering their contributions to heterogeneous tasks across clients, thereby degrading agent performance. To address this challenge, we propose P-FedSkill, a personalized FSL framework that comprises three key components: local skill extraction (LSE), personalized skill selection (PSS), and task-aware skill routing (TASR). Specifically, LSE first extracts skill patches (i.e., task applicability conditions and execution strategies) and task execution outcomes from trajectories. PSS then uses these outcomes to evaluate each skill patch's performance on client tasks and incorporates its task applicability condition to construct a personalized skill set for each client. Finally, TASR adaptively selects a task-relevant subset of skill patches based on their applicability conditions to guide agent execution. We further provide a theoretical guarantee for personalized skill selection in P-FedSkill, and extensive experiments also demonstrate its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出个性化联邦技能学习框架P-FedSkill，通过局部技能抽取、个性化技能选择与任务感知技能路由，解决现有方法仅按相似度共享技能、忽略其对异构任务贡献的问题。
AI.motivation: 智能体轨迹含敏感信息难以跨客户端共享，联邦技能学习通过将轨迹蒸馏为紧凑技能表示来协作；但现有FSL方法仅基于技能相似性共享，未考虑技能对不同客户端异构任务的贡献差异，导致智能体性能下降。
AI.method: P-FedSkill包含三部分：(1) 局部技能抽取LSE，从轨迹中抽取技能补丁（任务适用条件与执行策略）及任务执行结果；(2) 个性化技能选择PSS，用执行结果评估各技能补丁在客户端任务上的表现，并结合任务适用条件为每个客户端构建个性化技能集；(3) 任务感知技能路由TASR，依据适用条件自适应选取与任务相关的技能补丁子集以指导智能体执行。此外给出个性化技能选择的理论保证。
AI.result: 提供个性化技能选择的理论保证；大量实验验证了P-FedSkill的有效性（摘要未给出具体数值结果）。
AI.conclusion: 在联邦技能学习中引入个性化选择与任务感知路由，可在保护轨迹隐私的同时提升异构任务下的智能体性能。

title: ArtKit: Motion-Driven Re-Segmentation and Link Re-Generation for Articulated Objects from RGB-D Video
summary: An RGB-D camera that films an object being moved, often from one viewpoint, sees one side of it and how its parts move. We present ArtKit, which takes such a video as input to create an articulated model with complete parts, a kinematic tree, and typed joints. Our central idea is generating the hidden geometry and verifying it against what the camera sees. A generative part prior proposes complete, part-decomposed geometry based on the first frame. Point tracks, grouped into rigid trajectories, split and merge the generated parts into links. We then fit revolute and prismatic joints, with a visibility-aware energy ensuring that the articulated model explains the depth observed across the video. A rule checks against the video to choose between synchronous group fits and per-frame chain fits, so that one pipeline serves a diverse range of articulated objects, such as household items and robotic hands. Finally, we regenerate each link of the chosen fit as one part and keep it wherever it agrees better with the observations. We evaluate on Articulate-100 and on HArt, a new benchmark of 60 PartNet-Mobility objects and 8 robotic hands and grippers rendered as RGB-D videos with ground-truth parts and joints. ArtKit reduces the axis and part motion errors of the strongest baseline by more than half on the objects, as well as the axis error on the hands. ArtKit also runs on real recordings and generated videos.

AI.tldr: ArtKit 以单视角 RGB-D 运动视频为输入，生成完整铰接模型（完整部件、运动学树、带类型关节）。核心思想：先生成被遮挡的几何，再用视频观测（深度、点轨迹）校验。方法包括生成式部件先验、刚性轨迹分割/合并成连杆、旋转/移动关节拟合与可见性感知能量、同步组拟合与逐帧链拟合的规则选择、以及按连杆重生成并择优。在 Articulate-100 与新基准 HArt（60 个 PartNet-Mobility 物体 + 8 只机械手/夹爪）上，物体上的关节轴与部件运动误差比最强基线降低一半以上，机械手上的轴误差也降低；并可用于真实录制与生成视频。
AI.motivation: 单视角 RGB-D 视频只能看到物体一侧及其部件运动，被遮挡部分的几何、部件完整性与关节结构均不可直接观测，导致现有方法难以恢复完整铰接模型。
AI.method: 1) 基于首帧的生成式部件先验，提出完整且已部件分解的几何；2) 用点轨迹聚类为刚性轨迹，对生成部件进行分割与合并形成连杆；3) 拟合旋转与移动关节，采用可见性感知能量使铰接模型解释全视频深度；4) 用规则在“同步组拟合”与“逐帧链拟合”间选择，以统一处理家居物品与机械手；5) 按选定拟合将每个连杆重生成为单部件，若与观测更一致则保留。
AI.result: 在 Articulate-100 与 HArt（60 个 PartNet-Mobility 物体、8 只机械手/夹爪的 RGB-D 视频，含真值部件与关节）上，物体上的关节轴误差与部件运动误差较最强基线降低超过 50%，机械手关节轴误差亦降低；方法可运行于真实录制与生成视频。
AI.conclusion: “生成隐藏几何 + 以视频观测校验”的范式可有效从单视角 RGB-D 视频重建完整铰接模型，且单一管线可适配多类铰接物体。

title: Yet Another Concept Drift Benchmark? A Principled Framework for Evaluating Drift Detectors
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data
summary: Concept drift detection is a fundamental component of data stream learning, yet its empirical evaluation remains based on loosely defined protocols, ambiguous alarm semantics, and inconsistent metrics. We propose a principled benchmark grounded in an explicit formulation of drift observability and alarm semantics. Our framework introduces finite detection windows and repeated alarms, enabling a clear separation between detection accuracy, timeliness, and stability, and employs a reproducible observer to provide a controlled and interpretable performance signal. Building on this formulation, we define normalized evaluation metrics and a composite score addressing limitations of existing measures. We validate the framework through a large-scale stress-testing evaluation of 10 detectors across 9 learner configurations and 16 datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于显式漂移可观测性与报警语义定义的概念漂移检测基准框架，引入有限检测窗口与重复报警机制，将检测准确性、时效性与稳定性解耦，并给出归一化指标与综合评分，通过10个检测器、9种学习器配置、16个数据集的大规模压力测试验证。
AI.motivation: 现有概念漂移检测的经验评估依赖定义松散的协议、含糊的报警语义和不一致的度量指标，导致检测器之间难以公平比较，性能信号不可控且难以解释。
AI.method: 1) 显式形式化漂移可观测性与报警语义；2) 引入有限检测窗口与重复报警，从而分离检测准确性、时效性与稳定性三个维度；3) 采用可复现的"观察者"（observer）提供受控、可解释的性能信号；4) 在此基础上定义归一化评估指标及综合评分以克服现有度量的局限。
AI.result: 在10个漂移检测器、9种学习器配置与16个数据集上开展大规模压力测试评估，验证了该框架的有效性与可复现性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为概念漂移检测提供了形式化、可复现且多维解耦的评估基准，弥补了现有评估协议在语义定义与度量一致性上的缺陷，可作为数据流学习领域标准化评测的基础。

title: Measuring the Value of One Shared Image at Robot Handoffs in Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: When the lead robot cannot continue, what should it send the teammate that must finish the route? We replay a frozen receiver at each contact under alternative messages. Across 3,920 autonomous departures in 106 environments, adding the view before the lead's last action block to its executed actions raised success by 7.51 percentage points (pp) per RxR handoff and 8.54 pp per SAGE handoff. Per departure the gains were 2.23 and 1.44 pp, respectively. The lead continuing in simulation defines the empirical full-history ceiling (Solo). At contact, the lead had accumulated a median of 41 frames. Sending one frame when available recovered 24% of the full-history advantage over actions alone in SAGE and 30% in RxR. Over an estimated progress cue in SAGE, the image rescued 100 routes and reversed 54 successes. Near-goal receivers finished outside less often (63.1% to 51.7%, post hoc). In secondary comparisons the earlier view outperformed the contact view by 6-7 pp per handoff. Exact-route specificity and image gains at controlled starts with mostly unknown progress or outside the goal region remained unresolved. Gains were detectable from about 7 kB per handoff. Random transmission matched within size bins nearly equaled the learned sender's team success. At a required handoff, a view of the approach to the last maneuver helps the receiver finish.

AI.tldr: 在机器人接力式导航中，前导机器人无法继续时，应向前导最后一次动作块之前的视角画面连同已执行动作一起发送给接手者；该做法在RxR与SAGE数据集上分别提升单次交接成功率7.51pp与8.54pp，单次出发提升2.23pp与1.44pp，且增益在约7kB/次即可检测到。
AI.motivation: 研究前导机器人无法完成任务时，向必须完成路线的队友发送何种信息最有效，即"消息内容设计"问题；已有工作多关注何时/是否发送，而对"发送什么"（动作、视角图像、进度线索）缺乏受控、可复现的量化比较。
AI.method: 采用"冻结接收者重放"（frozen receiver replay）受控实验：在每个接触点固定接收者策略，仅替换所传递的消息内容进行对照比较。数据为106个环境、3,920次自主出发，评测集为RxR与SAGE的手交接任务；对照条件包括仅动作、动作+前导最后动作块之前的视角帧、接触时刻视角、估计的进度线索、完整历史（Solo上限）以及随机传输/尺寸分箱对照。
AI.result: 加入最后动作块之前的视角帧，单次交接成功率提升7.51pp（RxR）与8.54pp（SAGE），单次出发提升2.23pp与1.44pp；接触时前导累计帧数中位数为41帧。发送可用的一帧可挽回全历史优势的24%（SAGE）与30%（RxR）。相对估计进度线索，图像救回100条路线并反转54次成功。接近目标的接收者最终位于目标外比例由63.1%降至51.7%（事后分析）。较早视角优于接触视角6–7pp/交接。增益在约7kB/交接即可检测；随机传输在相同尺寸分箱内几乎与学习到的发送者等效。
AI.conclusion: 必需交接时，提供"接近最后一次机动"的视角画面能帮助接收者完成路线；信息内容（尤其是空间视觉上下文）比精细的学习式消息编码更关键，单帧即接近饱和。精确路线特异性、受控起点下图像增益，以及进度未知或目标区域外的情形仍未解决。

title: PowerFix: Physics-Guided Iterative Repair for LLM-Assisted Power Converter Design
comment: 14 pages, 7 figures. Can Wang and Shi Qiu contributed equally
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly being explored for automated engineering design. However, repairing power-converter designs that fail engineering validation remains challenging: the system must identify physical causes, locate responsible design variables, and resolve violations without compromising other constraints. We introduce PowerFix, a physics-guided iterative repair framework that converts validation failures into structured diagnoses and executable patches while preserving topology and design requirements. PowerDiagGraph links failed checks to possible physical causes and constrains repair routes. An LLM prioritizes these routes, while a deterministic compiler translates selected repairs into authorized field-level edits. Candidates are validated on isolated design copies and committed only after all required engineering checks pass; failed validation can guide replanning. On our constructed 96-task flyback repair benchmark, comprising injected single faults, coupled faults, and held-out natural failures from our design generator, PowerFix achieves 78.7% verified repair success rate (VRSR), compared with 30.1% for the strongest of three LLM baselines. Three additional replanning rounds increase VRSR to 88.4%. These offline results provide pilot-stage evidence within a simulation-based design workflow, with hardware prototype validation and transfer to a second converter topology as the next steps toward deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PowerFix，一个物理引导的迭代修复框架，将电源变换器设计的工程验证失败转化为结构化诊断与可执行修补，在自建96任务反激变换器修复基准上实现78.7%的验证修复成功率（VRSR），三轮重规划后提升至88.4%。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体正被用于自动化工程设计，但修复未通过工程验证的电源变换器设计仍然困难：系统需识别物理成因、定位责任设计变量，并在不违反其他约束的前提下消除违规。现有LLM基线能力不足（最强仅30.1%）。
AI.method: PowerFix包含三部分：(1) PowerDiagGraph将失败的检查项关联到可能的物理成因并约束修复路径；(2) LLM对修复路径进行优先级排序，由确定性编译器将所选修复翻译为受权的字段级编辑；(3) 在隔离的设计副本上验证候选方案，仅在所有必需工程检查通过后提交，失败验证可触发重规划；全过程保持拓扑与设计需求不变。
AI.result: 在构建的96任务反激变换器修复基准（含注入单故障、耦合故障及设计生成器产生的留出自然故障）上，PowerFix的VRSR为78.7%，显著优于三个LLM基线中最强者的30.1%；增加三轮重规划后VRSR升至88.4%。
AI.conclusion: 结果为基于仿真的设计工作流中的试点阶段证据；后续需进行硬件原型验证并迁移至第二种变换器拓扑，以推进实际部署。

title: A Semantics-First Approach to Multimodal Video Captioning with Frozen Encoders and Stabilized Reinforcement Learning
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Preprint correcting minor typographical errors and clarifying baseline evaluation conditions from the SPIE Defense + Security 2026 proceedings
summary: We propose the Audio-Visual Query Transformer (AVQFormer), a highly efficient architecture built upon a 2.7B parameter LLM featuring a fixed-length $K=16$ semantic alignment module, stabilized via Adaptive Self-Critical Sequence Training (ASCST) with Entropy Regularization. Multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) often rely on global audio representations to compensate for inefficient, frame-based visual encoders. While our Phase 1 prompted evaluations demonstrate that the Multimodal Base Model achieves strong deep semantic alignment (scoring 0.889 on BERTScore F1), optimizing this architecture for legacy metrics reveals a performance gap. We explore this gap as a hypothesis we term temporal alignment friction: a conflict where global audio representations disrupt the chronological sequence of visual frames, leading to penalties under visually-focused evaluation metrics. Consequently, by stripping away the audio, our Video-Only ablation conforms more closely to this rigid syntax, achieving 63.0 CIDEr. While trailing larger models such as Qwen2.5-VL (67.4 CIDEr), this establishes a strong baseline for sub-3B parameter LLM-based models. This indicates that CIDEr, as applied to datasets such as MSR-VTT, may exhibit a bias toward visually grounded syntax, limiting its ability to fully capture multimodal semantic richness.

AI.tldr: 提出AVQFormer：基于2.7B LLM、固定长度K=16语义对齐模块并用ASCST+熵正则稳定训练的高效音视频架构；指出CIDEr等指标存在视觉偏向性。
AI.motivation: 多模态LLM常依赖全局音频表征来弥补低效的逐帧视觉编码器的不足，导致架构优化方向偏离；同时传统指标（如CIDEr）与多模态深层语义对齐之间存在性能落差，作者将其假设为"时序对齐摩擦"。
AI.method: 在2.7B参数LLM上构建AVQFormer，采用固定长度K=16的语义对齐模块压缩变长帧序列，并用自适应自批判序列训练（ASCST）结合熵正则化稳定训练。通过Phase 1提示式评测与Video-Only消融（去除音频）进行对比分析。
AI.result: Phase 1多模态基模型取得BERTScore F1=0.889的强深层语义对齐；去除音频的纯视觉消融在严格句法匹配下达到63.0 CIDEr，略低于Qwen2.5-VL的67.4，但构成sub-3B LLM类模型的强基线。
AI.conclusion: CIDEr应用于MSR-VTT等数据集时可能偏向视觉接地的句法表达，难以充分刻画多模态语义丰富度；时序对齐摩擦解释了指标落差，提示需重新审视评测体系。

title: Scalpel and Brush: Pruning and Targeted Weight Editing of a Small Language Model by a Single LLM Agent
summary: It has recently been shown that an LLM can itself edit the weights of a language model, yet it remains unclear which part of such a result is due to the agent and which part is reproduced by a random edit of the same shape, by an instruction in the prompt, or by a standard procedure without an LLM. We unify repair and pruning as sparse weight edits to optimize a metric we specify, using BLEU as an example: three tasks -- targeted weight repair ("brush"), structured MLP neuron pruning ("scalpel", zeroing pruned weights), and layer removal with repair - are assigned to a DeepSeek Harness agent powered by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, with up to 50 dev evaluations. We study Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct in three independent runs per task, with final evaluation on two hidden splits. On ordinary differential equations, changing at most 0.0084% of weights raised test BLEU by 24-32% on second-order equations and by a factor of 1.8-2.5 on equations with polynomial right-hand sides. An independent substitution check showed that higher BLEU reflects notation alignment rather than improved correctness. Masks that remove 12.5-15% of MLP neurons shrink the model by 9.4-11.2% with mean BLEU loss of at most 0.01 on both hidden splits, whereas standard pruning with equal shares per layer failed the constraint at all tested shares. On seven-class GoEmotions classification, edits raise macro-F1 from 0.100 to 0.396-0.451 on test and from 0.175 to 0.455-0.476 on holdout. A ridge-based classifier written into agent-selected weight rows yields macro-F1 of 0.424 and 0.464. Pruning search with the same evaluation limit removes 15.9% of neurons versus 14-21.4% for agent runs passing the hidden check.
