Standard procedures without an LLM reproduce much of the performance once given the location and form of intervention found by the agent; a comparison of agentic and non-agentic search remains open.

AI.tldr: 本文把"修复"与"剪枝"统一为稀疏权重编辑，在统一的BLEU/宏观F1指标下，用DeepSeek Harness agent完成刷子式权重修复、手术刀式MLP神经元剪枝、整层移除三类任务，并与随机同形编辑、提示词指令、无LLM标准流程对照，量化agent贡献。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明LLM可以自行编辑语言模型权重，但无法区分该结果中哪些来自agent的智能搜索，哪些可被同形状的随机编辑、prompt内指令或无LLM的常规流程复现，缺乏归因性对照。
AI.method: 将修复与剪枝统一为"在指定指标下优化稀疏权重编辑"的框架（示例指标为BLEU）；三类任务——定向权重修复（brush）、结构化MLP神经元剪枝（scalpel，被剪权重置零）、整层移除+修复——交给由DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash驱动的DeepSeek Harness agent，开发集评估上限50次。模型为Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct，每任务三次独立运行，最终在两个隐藏划分上评测；并设置替换检验、随机同形状编辑与无LLM标准剪枝（等比例分层）作为对照，另在GoEmotions七分类上验证。
AI.result: ODE任务：改动≤0.0084%权重使二阶方程测试BLEU提升24–32%，多项式右端方程提升1.8–2.5倍；但独立替换检验表明BLEU提升反映的是记号对齐而非正确性提升。剪枝：移除12.5–15% MLP神经元使模型缩小9.4–11.2%，两个隐藏划分上BLEU损失≤0.01，而按层等份额的标准剪枝在所有测试份额下均违反约束。GoEmotions七分类：宏观F1从0.100升至0.396–0.451（test）、从0.175升至0.455–0.476（holdout）；将岭回归分类器写入agent选定的权重行得0.424与0.464。同评估预算的剪枝搜索移除15.9%神经元，agent运行中通过隐藏检查者为14–21.4%。
AI.conclusion: agent能以极稀疏编辑实现定向修复与结构化剪枝，并优于等比例标准剪枝；但一旦告知干预位置与形式，无LLM的标准流程即可复现大部分性能，说明agent的主要贡献在于定位搜索。agentic与非agentic搜索的系统比较仍待开展。

title: Integration of Vision-Language-Action Control for Autonomous Forklift Unloading with Limited Real-World Data
summary: Forklifts play a critical role in warehousing and distribution, but existing automation systems remain limited in handling complex tasks that require sequential decision-making. Recently, vision--language--action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising approach for multi-step decision-making by directly generating control actions from visual observations and language prompts. Although VLA-based control has been extensively researched for manipulators, to the best of our knowledge, its application to forklifts remains unexplored. Therefore, this study demonstrates the integration of VLA control for an autonomous forklift unloading task with limited real-world data. Moreover, training VLA models typically requires large-scale datasets. As there is currently no public dataset for forklift operations, we use a VLA model pretrained primarily on robotic manipulator data and construct a training dataset via simulation, which can be scaled up at low cost. We then adapt the pretrained VLA model to forklift control using 9.38 h of simulation data and 0.8 h of real-world demonstrations, with the latter accounting for approximately 8% of the collected forklift data by duration. The integrated system was validated through 72 real-world trials across four model variants. The results show that the proposed system can accomplish an unloading task even with limited real-world data.

AI.tldr: 本文将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型引入叉车卸货任务，用仿真数据为主、少量真机数据微调的方式实现自主控制，并通过72次真机试验验证可行性。
AI.motivation: 叉车在仓储物流中作用关键，但现有自动化系统难以处理需要序贯决策的复杂任务；VLA模型已在机械臂上广泛研究，然而尚无针对叉车的应用探索。同时，叉车领域缺乏公开数据集，而VLA训练通常依赖大规模数据。
AI.method: 采用主要基于机械臂数据预训练的VLA模型，通过低成本可扩展的仿真构建叉车训练数据集，再利用9.38小时仿真数据与0.8小时真机示教数据（约占总数据时长的8%）将预训练模型适配到叉车控制上。
AI.result: 在四种模型变体上共进行72次真机试验，结果表明所提系统在真机数据有限的条件下仍能完成卸货任务。
AI.conclusion: VLA控制可迁移至叉车自主作业，仿真数据结合少量真机示教能有效降低数据依赖，为叉车等非机械臂平台的VLA应用提供了可行性证据。

title: KeyDeck: Multi-Paper-to-Slide Generation via Cross-Paper Synthesis and Reference-Guided Personalization
summary: Multi-paper-to-slide generation (multi-PTSG) is the task of constructing a unified presentation from multiple research papers by selecting, organizing, and synthesizing information across sources. This task introduces two main challenges: (i) combining multiple sources into a coherent narrative requires identifying cross-paper relationships and synthesizing their content, and (ii) the desired organization and emphasis varies substantially across presenters, making personalization essential for user satisfaction. Motivated by these challenges, we propose KeyDeck, the first multi-PTSG framework that integrates per-paper and cross-paper analysis to identify relationships among sources and synthesize their contributions into a coherent narrative, and reference-guided personalization to infer presenters' narrative, content, textual, and visual preferences and adapt slide generation accordingly. To evaluate generation quality, personalization adherence, and conversational goal satisfaction, we introduce KeyBench, a benchmark of 100 expert-authored multi-paper presentations, together with a comprehensive evaluation framework. Our results demonstrate that KeyDeck outperforms existing approaches in multi-PTSG quality, personalization adherence, and conversational goal satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 提出首个多论文到幻灯片生成框架 KeyDeck，融合单篇与跨篇分析与参考引导的个性化，并构建基准 KeyBench（100 份专家多论文演示）及评测框架，在三项指标上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 多论文到幻灯片生成（multi-PTSG）需跨源选择、组织与综合信息，面临两大挑战：(i) 需识别跨论文关系并将多源内容综合成连贯叙述；(ii) 不同讲者的组织方式与侧重点差异显著，个性化对用户满意度至关重要。
AI.method: KeyDeck 将 per-paper 与 cross-paper 分析整合，识别来源间关系并综合其贡献形成连贯叙述；同时引入 reference-guided personalization，从参考材料推断讲者的叙事、内容、文本与视觉偏好并据此调整幻灯片生成。配套提出 KeyBench 基准（100 份专家撰写的多论文演示）与综合评测框架。
AI.result: 实验表明 KeyDeck 在多论文到幻灯片生成质量、个性化遵循度与对话目标满足度上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 跨篇综合与个性化是 multi-PTSG 的关键，KeyDeck 与 KeyBench 为该任务提供了有效方法与标准化评测基础。

title: Beyond Random Starts: Amortized Initialization for Adversarial Attacks on Vision-Language Models
summary: Gradient-based transferable adversarial attacks achieve state-of-the-art attack success rates against black-box vision-language models (VLMs). However, they require hundreds of costly optimization steps for each image pair. One possible reason is that these attacks typically start from random perturbations that contain no information about the source or target image. In this work, we study whether amortized adversarial generation can provide better initializations for gradient-based attacks. By learning across many image pairs, amortization allows a generator to produce adversarial perturbations for new inputs without optimizing each perturbation from scratch. We introduce SPARK, a lightweight looped perturbation generator conditioned on both the source and target images. SPARK repeatedly applies the same network to refine a perturbation, producing effective adversarial attacks in a few forward passes without requiring gradients through surrogate vision encoders at inference time. We show that these perturbations provide effective warm starts for existing gradient-based attacks, substantially improving attack success rates while reducing the number of optimization steps required. These improvements generalize across different attack methods, VLMs, and unseen image categories. SPARK also produces effective standalone attacks at a fraction of the computational cost of gradient-based optimization. Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/Patchwork53/SPARK.

AI.tldr: SPARK 提出一种轻量级循环扰动生成器，以源图与目标图为条件，通过多次前向复用同一网络精化扰动，为基于梯度的迁移攻击提供高效热启动，也可作为独立的低成本攻击方法。
AI.motivation: 现有针对黑盒视觉语言模型（VLM）的基于梯度的迁移对抗攻击成功率虽高，但每对图像需数百次昂贵优化步骤；作者认为原因之一是这些攻击从无信息的随机扰动出发，因此探究摊销式对抗生成能否为梯度攻击提供更好的初始化。
AI.method: 提出 SPARK：一个轻量级的循环（looped）扰动生成器，同时以源图像和目标图像为条件，跨大量图像对学习；在推理时反复应用同一网络迭代精化扰动，仅需少量前向传播即可生成扰动，无需通过代理视觉编码器反传梯度；生成的扰动可作为现有梯度攻击的暖启动（warm start）。
AI.result: SPARK 生成的扰动作为暖启动可显著提升攻击成功率并减少所需优化步数，且改进在不同攻击方法、不同 VLM 及未见图像类别上均具泛化性；作为独立攻击，其计算成本仅为梯度优化的一小部分。
AI.conclusion: 摊销式对抗生成是提升黑盒 VLM 迁移攻击效率的有效途径；SPARK 以极少前向计算实现了兼具热启动增强与独立攻击能力的方案。

title: Fast Muscle-Driven Whole-Body Motion Tracking with a Differentiable World Model
summary: Tracking motion capture with a whole-body musculoskeletal model means coordinating hundreds of muscles through contact, and current controllers take hours to days of GPU time to train, so every tuning decision is expensive. SuperMimic trains a tracking policy by backpropagating through the rollouts of a learned world model. We extend it to MS-Human-700 (700 muscles) and MyoFullBody (354 muscles), with MuJoCo's activation dynamics inside the world model. To make its training fast, our recipe takes the speedups developed for the Unitree G1, replaces three of their settings that fail on muscles, and adds four changes of our own: observations without muscle geometry, data collection concurrent with the updates, Beta exploration noise that keeps every excitation in $[0,1]$, and 50 Hz control. On one RTX 5090 it trains MS-Human-700 in 6.3 minutes to the held-out return that SuperMimic's published hyperparameters reach in 3.9 hours, 37$\times$ sooner, and in 20 minutes to lower tracking errors than theirs after 10 hours. It trains MyoFullBody 34$\times$ sooner without retuning. Ablations show what is specific to muscles: a higher policy learning rate stalls half of the runs, and clipped Gaussian noise adds a tonic co-contraction that Beta noise avoids. Finally, refining the policy's actions through the world model at test time lowers the position error by a further 26% with no held-out clip failing, and reaches the same return after 5.1 instead of 6.3 minutes of training. Code, the training recipe and videos are on the project page https://muscle-supermimic.beanpow.top.

AI.tldr: 提出面向全身肌肉骨骼模型的快速跟踪控制训练方案，将 SuperMimic 扩展至 700 与 354 块肌肉的模型，单张 RTX 5090 上训练时间缩短 34–37 倍，并在测试时用世界模型精修动作进一步降低误差。
AI.motivation: 基于全身肌肉骨骼模型的动作捕捉跟踪需协调数百块肌肉并处理接触，现有控制器训练需数小时至数天的 GPU 时间，导致每次调参代价极高，难以迭代。
AI.method: 在 SuperMimic 框架（通过对学习到的世界模型 rollout 反向传播训练跟踪策略）基础上，将 MuJoCo 的肌肉激活动力学嵌入世界模型，并扩展到 MS-Human-700（700 肌肉）与 MyoFullBody（354 肌肉）。加速配方：沿用 Unitree G1 上的加速技巧，替换其中 3 项在肌肉模型上失效的设置，另加 4 项改进——去除肌肉几何信息的观测、数据采集与参数更新并发执行、保持激励在 [0,1] 内的 Beta 探索噪声、50 Hz 控制频率。测试时通过世界模型对策略动作进行精修。
AI.result: 单张 RTX 5090：MS-Human-700 用 6.3 分钟达到 SuperMimic 公开超参 3.9 小时才能达到的留出集回报（快 37 倍），20 分钟内跟踪误差低于其 10 小时结果；MyoFullBody 无需重新调参即快 34 倍。消融显示肌肉特有性质：较高策略学习率使半数运行停滞，裁剪高斯噪声引入强直性共收缩而 Beta 噪声可避免。测试时精修使位置误差再降 26%，无留出片段失败，且 5.1 分钟即达原 6.3 分钟的回报。
AI.conclusion: 合理的加速配方可使肌肉级全身跟踪训练在分钟量级完成，Beta 探索噪声与世界模型测试时精修是肌肉控制中关键且有效的设计；代码与训练配方已公开。

title: CoTAMP: Cooperative Task and Motion Planning for Quadruped Robots with Large Language Models
summary: Some environments cannot be traversed by a single quadruped robot, for example a ledge that one robot can climb only from its partner's back or a gap that must be bridged with boxes. Solving them requires cooperative task and motion planning (TAMP). Previous works are limited to the motions of a single robot or only select actions from a predefined set of skills. We propose a framework with two parts: task planning that invents motions not defined in advance, and motion generation that realizes the invented motions. Both parts consist of large language model (LLM)-based modules and code-based modules. Task planning divides the trajectory of the whole task into steps and fixes the robot poses at the step boundaries. Motion generation produces keyframes that describe the motion of each step and turns them into a continuous trajectory through kinematic synthesis. The code-based modules check every plan and motion and return failures to the LLM-based modules for correction. The whole trajectory is then refined by trajectory optimization to satisfy the dynamics. On three simulated courses with two RAIBO2 robot models, our framework produced kinematically valid references in all 30 trials, all of which converged in trajectory optimization. Compared with several baselines, our framework showed advantages in success rate, dynamic feasibility, execution time, and generation time and cost. Project page: https://woojin8098.github.io/CoTAMP/

AI.tldr: 提出CoTAMP框架，用LLM与代码模块协作完成多四足机器人协同任务与运动规划，可发明未被预先定义的动作，并在仿真中全部生成可行轨迹。
AI.motivation: 单台四足机器人无法通过某些环境（如需踩伙伴背部攀爬的台阶、需用箱子搭桥的沟壑），必须多机协同；而现有工作要么只处理单机器人运动，要么只能从预定义技能库中选择动作，无法创造新动作。
AI.method: 框架分为两部分：任务规划将整体轨迹划分为多个步骤并固定各步骤边界处的机器人位姿；运动生成产生每步关键帧，并通过运动学综合转为连续轨迹。两部分均由基于LLM的模块与基于代码的模块构成，代码模块校验每个计划与运动，将失败反馈给LLM模块进行修正；整体轨迹再经轨迹优化以满足动力学约束。
AI.result: 在两个RAIBO2机器人模型、三个仿真场景的30次试验中全部生成运动学有效的参考轨迹，且均在轨迹优化中收敛；与多个基线相比，在成功率、动力学可行性、执行时间、生成时间与成本上均具优势。
AI.conclusion: LLM负责开放式动作发明、代码模块负责可验证性校验的混合架构，是解决多机器人协同TAMP中"技能预定义受限"问题的有效途径，并可通过轨迹优化保证动力学可行性。

title: Asset4D-Bench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Editable 3D and 4D Reconstruction
comment: The first three authors contributed equally
summary: A cart can follow its reference trajectory while its cargo floats above the deck. Asset4D-Bench tests whether coding agents recover objects, motion and interactions from visual references as editable Blender scenes. Its 114 conditions span image editing, video reconstruction with matched full or partial starter assets, and independently selected from-scratch tasks. We independently reopen projects and measure them against native reference states. The 228 archived scores include original delivery outcomes and versioned measures of scene quality. On 24 from-scratch tasks, each model earns full dynamics credit on 14. Of these, three GPT-6.1-Sol and eight GPT-6-Astra reconstructions earn zero relation points. Under the fixed scoring weights, relations contribute 5.15 points to the 6.50-point Sol-minus-Astra difference in mean recovered fidelity. Differences in execution and recovery policy across archived runs preclude a causal estimate of starter-asset effects.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Asset4D-Bench，用于评测编码智能体能否从视觉参考中恢复物体、运动与交互，并将其输出为可编辑的 Blender 场景。
AI.motivation: 现有基准缺乏对"视觉参考→可编辑 4D 场景（含物体、运动、交互关系）"这一能力的系统评测，论文希望检验智能体能否产出可被独立重开、与原生参考状态逐步对照的场景资产。
AI.method: 构建 114 项评测条件，覆盖图像编辑、带完整或部分初始资产的视频重建，以及独立选取的从零构建任务；采用独立重开项目、与原生参考状态对照的测量方式，并归档 228 个分数（含原始交付结果与版本化场景质量度量）；在固定评分权重下分解各维度贡献。
AI.result: 在 24 个从零任务上，各模型均有 14 项获得完整动力学得分；但其中三个 GPT-6.1-Sol 与八个 GPT-6-Astra 重建在关系维度得分为零。固定权重下，关系维度为 Sol 与 Astra 之间 6.50 分的平均恢复保真度差异贡献 5.15 分。
AI.conclusion: 关系/交互建模是当前瓶颈：动力学可还原而物体间关系常被丢失，主导了模型间差异；由于各归档运行的执行与恢复策略不同，无法对初始资产效应作出因果估计。

title: Anatomy-Aware Pseudo-Labels and Homotopy-Annealed Hausdorff Supervision for Semi-Supervised Pancreas Segmentation
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to WACV 2027 Workshops (FABRIC). \c{opyright} 2027 IEEE
summary: Confidence-gated co-training assumes that pseudo-label errors are uncertain and concentrated at organ boundaries. We argue that for pancreas CT, where the target organ is a single connected structure and detached fragments are anatomically implausible, the dominant failures arise at three levels: where the organ is, what its boundary should look like, and how a correct boundary is penalized. Anatomical Rectification relabels implausible fragments of a teacher prediction as confident background, without adding any loss or parameter; an audit confirms that its rejections are overwhelmingly detached hallucinations and that thin, tail-like slices are not eroded. Boundary Grafting transplants labelled surface regions with their annotation into unlabeled volumes, replacing unreliable boundary pseudo-labels with ground truth. The residual error is coherent surface displacement, weakly penalized by permutation-invariant Dice and cross-entropy losses. Homotopy-Annealed Hausdorff (HAH) supervision anneals a distance-weighted penalty from an annotation-anchored objective that is convex in the prediction to a Hausdorff surrogate, admitting the prediction-dependent distance term only after the predicted surface becomes reliable. On NIH pancreas CT, under the standard semi-supervised split, the full method reaches 84.60% Dice and 4.97 voxels 95HD, improving all four metrics over compared methods; on MSD Task07, 78.90% Dice and 4.19 voxels 95HD. We further contribute PanTS-SSL, a semi-supervised evaluation protocol derived from the public 9,901-case PanTS corpus, with a curated 1,015-volume main pool, labelled tiers of 50, 100 and 250 volumes, an 80-case tumor track, shift probes for acquisition and anatomy change, and a fixed 901-volume test set. On it, the method exceeds the co-training baseline at 100 labels, scales to 85.29% Dice at 250 labels, and reaches 85.50% Dice at 100 labels with HAH.

AI.tldr: 针对胰腺CT半监督分割中伪标签误差集中在解剖学不可能出现的孤立碎片与边界处的问题，提出三层级"解剖学纠正"框架（解剖纠正重标定、边界移植、同伦退火Hausdorff监督），并贡献PanTS-SSL评测协议，在NIH、MSD Task07与PanTS-SSL上取得SOTA效果。
AI.motivation: 置信度门控协同训练假设伪标签误差不确定且集中于器官边界，但作者认为在胰腺CT中目标器官为单一连通结构、分离碎片在解剖上不成立，主导失效实际发生在三个层面：器官位置（where）、边界形态（what）、以及正确边界如何被惩罚（how penalized）。
AI.method: 1）Anatomical Rectification：将教师预测中解剖上不合理的碎片重标定为高置信背景，不增加损失项或参数；2）Boundary Grafting：把带标注的表面区域连同其真值标签移植进无标注体数据，用GT替换不可靠的边界伪标签；3）Homotopy-Annealed Hausdorff (HAH)：将距离加权惩罚从以标注为锚、对预测凸的目标，退火至Hausdorff代理目标，仅在预测表面可靠后引入依赖预测的距离项。
AI.result: NIH胰腺CT标准半监督划分下达84.60% Dice、4.97 voxels 95HD，四项指标全面优于对比方法；MSD Task07达78.90% Dice、4.19 voxels 95HD。自建PanTS-SSL（源自9,901例公开PanTS语料，含1,015体主池、50/100/250标注层级、80例肿瘤赛道、采集与解剖变化探针、固定901体测试集）上，在100标签时超过协同训练基线，250标签达85.29% Dice，100标签配合HAH达85.50% Dice。审计证实解剖纠正的拒斥对象绝大多数为孤立幻觉碎片，且薄尾状切片未被侵蚀。
AI.conclusion: 将伪标签失效按"位置—边界形态—惩罚方式"三层解耦并对症处理，可显著优于置信度门控协同训练；同时PanTS-SSL为胰腺半监督分割提供了可复现的多层级基准。

title: Differentially Private Policy Optimization in Linear MDPs with Adversarial Rewards
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) in personalized services often relies on sensitive interaction data. Motivated by the need to protect these data, we study differentially private (DP) policy optimization in episodic linear Markov decision processes (MDPs) with unknown transitions and adaptive adversarial linear rewards under full-information feedback. This setting poses two key challenges: past trajectories are repeatedly reused for policy evaluation, and reward choices may depend on previously released private statistics. The proposed algorithm combines batched proximal policy optimization (PPO) updates with optimistic policy evaluation, using private regression statistics and reward estimates to protect both trajectories and reward functions under joint differential privacy (JDP). With all other parameters fixed, our high-probability regret bound retains the same leading $\widetilde{O}\left(K^{3/4}\right)$ dependence on the number of episodes $K$ as the corresponding non-private bound for batched optimistic PPO. The additional privacy terms scale as $\widetilde{O} \left(K^{5/8}\right)$ and $\widetilde{O} \left(K^{1/2}\right)$. Thus, privacy incurs only lower-order additive costs in $K$, even under adaptive adversarial rewards.

AI.tldr: 研究回合制线性MDP中未知转移、自适应对抗性线性奖励、全信息反馈下的差分隐私策略优化，提出批量PPO+乐观策略评估的JDP算法，隐私代价仅为低阶加性项。
AI.motivation: 个性化服务中的强化学习依赖敏感交互数据，需在保护数据隐私的前提下进行策略优化。该设定存在两大挑战：历史轨迹会被反复用于策略评估；奖励选择可能依赖此前已发布的私有统计量。
AI.method: 将批量近端策略优化（PPO）更新与乐观策略评估相结合，使用私有回归统计量与私有奖励估计，在联合差分隐私（JDP）框架下同时保护轨迹与奖励函数。
AI.result: 高概率遗憾界在其余参数固定时保持与非隐私批量乐观PPO相同的主导阶 $\widetilde{O}(K^{3/4})$；额外的隐私项分别为 $\widetilde{O}(K^{5/8})$ 与 $\widetilde{O}(K^{1/2})$。
AI.conclusion: 即使面对自适应对抗性奖励，隐私保护也仅带来关于回合数 $K$ 的低阶加性代价，不影响主导遗憾阶。

title: X-World: Transferring Video Priors to Cross-Embodiment Robot Control
summary: Language-instructed manipulation requires robust closedloop policies, yet action-labeled robot trajectories are costly and limited in coverage. Human and robot videos provide complementary spatiotemporal priors for crossembodiment control. We propose X-World, which adapts pretrained video diffusion to variable views. A Q-Former compresses hidden states into tokens for a shared flowmatching expert that predicts action chunks. Datasetspecific projections map native states and actions. We adapt the backbone on large-scale robot and human videos, freeze it for action-only pretraining of the Q-Former and action expert, then post-train on the target platform. At inference, X-World responds at 20 Hz and overlaps updates with execution via asynchronous real-time chunking. X-World performs strongly on LIBERO and under zero-shot shifts on LIBERO-Plus. On hardware, it averages 81.7% success across six bimanual tasks on the side-mounted dual-arm UR5e, one of three real-robot configurations presented.

AI.tldr: 提出 X-World：将预训练视频扩散模型适配到可变视角，通过 Q-Former 压缩隐状态为 token 并输入共享 flow-matching 动作专家预测动作块；先在大规模机器人与人类视频上适配骨干、冻结后仅做动作预训练，再在目标平台后训练；推理以 20 Hz 异步实时分块运行。在 LIBERO 及 LIBERO-Plus 零样本迁移上表现强劲，真实双臂 UR5e 六任务平均成功率 81.7%。
AI.motivation: 语言指令驱动的操作需要鲁棒的闭环策略，但带动作标注的机器人轨迹采集成本高、覆盖有限；人类视频与机器人视频可提供互补的时空先验，用于跨本体控制。
AI.method: 1) 将预训练视频扩散模型适配为可变视角输入；2) 用 Q-Former 将隐状态压缩为 token，交由共享 flow-matching 专家预测动作块（action chunk）；3) 使用数据集特定的投影层映射各本体的原生状态与动作；4) 训练流程分三阶段：在大规模机器人与人类视频上适配骨干网络 → 冻结骨干，仅对 Q-Former 与动作专家做动作预训练 → 在目标平台后训练；5) 推理端采用异步实时分块，将更新与执行重叠，实现 20 Hz 闭环响应。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 基准上表现强劲，并在 LIBERO-Plus 的零样本分布偏移下保持良好性能；真实硬件上，在侧装双臂 UR5e 的六个双臂任务中平均成功率达 81.7%（该配置为其展示的三套真机配置之一）。
AI.conclusion: 以视频扩散先验为核心、结合跨本体投影与异步实时分块，X-World 能在低动作标注依赖下实现高频闭环的跨本体语言指令操作，并在仿真基准与多套真机配置上验证有效性。

title: JOVE ICE: Intent Guided Cloud Edge Device Collaboration for AI Glasses
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and LLM based agents have expanded the capabilities of AI glasses, enabling egocentric visual question answering, memory retrieval, and proactive assistance. These applications involve diverse inputs, including speech, images, and video, and range from simple device control to complex visual reasoning, posing challenges for efficient computation and communication. While video centric capabilities have received considerable attention, simple text based and device executable tasks remain underexplored despite their prevalence in daily interactions. Efficiently supporting diverse workloads within a unified assistant remains an open challenge. We propose JOVE ICE, an intent guided cloud, edge, and device collaborative framework that routes requests among AI glasses, a paired smartphone, and cloud servers according to user intent. JOVE ICE integrates hierarchical intent classification with dynamic subagent orchestration to select efficient execution paths and flexibly incorporate new applications through specialized subagents. Analysis of real world AI glasses requests reveals that simple device control tasks account for over 30% of interactions, which JOVE ICE handles directly on device to avoid unnecessary cloud computation and costs. Evaluations on three public benchmarks demonstrate that JOVE ICE reduces time to first token by approximately 13% and token usage by over 11% compared with conventional device and cloud architectures, while maintaining task quality. These results demonstrate the potential of intent guided collaboration to improve the efficiency and scalability of AI glasses.

AI.tldr: 提出 JOVE ICE——面向 AI 眼镜的"意图引导 + 云-边-端协同"框架，通过分层意图分类与动态子代理编排把请求路由到眼镜本体、配对手机或云端执行，在保持任务质量的前提下降低时延与成本。
AI.motivation: LLM 与 LLM Agent 使 AI 眼镜具备第一视角视觉问答、记忆检索与主动辅助能力，但输入模态多样（语音、图像、视频）、任务跨度大（从简单设备控制到复杂视觉推理），对计算与通信效率构成挑战。现有研究偏重视频类能力，而占比极高的简单文本类/设备可执行任务被忽视；如何在统一助手内高效支持异构负载仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 1) 分层意图分类：将用户请求按意图粒度逐级判定；2) 动态子代理编排：依据意图选择高效执行路径，并通过专用子代理灵活接入新应用；3) 云-边(手机)-端(眼镜)三级协同路由：简单设备控制类任务直接端侧执行，避免不必要的云端计算与开销；4) 结合真实 AI 眼镜请求日志分析与三个公开基准评测进行验证。
AI.result: 真实请求分析显示，简单设备控制任务占交互量 30% 以上，可由端侧直接处理；在三个公开基准上，相较传统"端 + 云"架构，首 token 时延(TTFT)降低约 13%，token 消耗降低 11% 以上，同时保持任务质量。
AI.conclusion: 意图引导的云-边-端协同能够有效提升 AI 眼镜助手的效率与可扩展性；将高频轻量任务下沉到端侧、以子代理机制扩展能力，是统一多模态助手的可行工程路径。

title: ViCARD: Visual Credit Assignment with Reward-Gated Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Visual reasoning requires models to identify relevant visual evidence and use it to derive correct answers. Outcomebased reinforcement learning (RL) faces two key challenges in this regime: it yields no learning signal when perceptual errors cause all sampled responses to fail, and it broadcasts a uniform advantage across every token within a response. Conversely, while visual self-distillation offers dense guidance from evidence-centered image crops, student learning from token distributions alone often fails to elicit correct final answers. Motivated by an audit of training rollouts that exposes these complementary failure modes, we introduce ViCARD (Visual Credit Assignment with RewardGated Distillation), which integrates per-token visual supervision with verified correctness rewards. For each rollout group, we leverage a teacher with its input image cropped to the relevant visual area, and use this to provide per-token supervision to the student while also valuing correctness. If all sampled rollouts fail, ViCARD samples an additional crop-teacher answer and activates on-policy distillation only if that answer is correct. Together, these mechanisms provide fine-grained visual credit within informative reward groups and a learning signal for otherwise uninformative all-fail groups. Extensive comparisons across model scales demonstrate that ViCARD improves fine-grained visual reasoning performance over RL and distillation baselines, while retaining broad visual reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: ViCARD 将逐 token 的视觉自蒸馏监督与经过验证的正确性奖励结合：在全部采样失败的组中，仅在裁剪图像教师答案正确时启用 on-policy 蒸馏，从而同时解决结果型 RL 的“零信号”和“统一优势广播”两大问题。
AI.motivation: 视觉推理要求模型定位相关视觉证据并据此推导答案。基于结果的 RL 在此存在两个关键缺陷：(1) 当感知错误导致所有采样回复都失败时，没有任何学习信号；(2) 将统一优势广播到回复中的每个 token，缺乏细粒度信用分配。而视觉自蒸馏虽能从以证据为中心的图像裁剪中提供稠密指导，但学生仅从 token 分布学习往往无法得到正确的最终答案。作者通过对训练 rollout 的审计揭示了这两类互补的失败模式，因而提出统一方案。
AI.method: ViCARD（Visual Credit Assignment with Reward-Gated Distillation）：对每个 rollout 组，使用以相关视觉区域裁剪图为输入的教师模型，为学生提供逐 token 监督，同时引入经过验证的正确性奖励；若组内所有采样回复均失败，则额外采样一次裁剪教师答案，仅当该答案正确时才激活 on-policy 蒸馏。
AI.result: 多模型规模的广泛对比实验表明，ViCARD 在细粒度视觉推理性能上优于 RL 与蒸馏基线，同时保持了广泛的通用视觉推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 逐 token 视觉监督与奖励门控的蒸馏互补结合，可在信息量丰富的奖励组内实现细粒度视觉信用分配，并为原本无信息量的全失败组提供学习信号，是一种兼顾细粒度与通用性的视觉推理训练范式。

title: The Geometry Is the Memory: Task-Density Routing for Continual LoRA
summary: Freezing older adapters does not ensure that a continual learner will select and use them properly at inference time. When multiple adapters exist, routing among them and identifying the adapter whose representation space matches the query's answer can be difficult. We propose CONTLORA, which replaces stored examples with compact class statistics for adapter selection and classification. Gaussian class models in a frozen representation select LoRA adapters, while accumulated feature moments exactly recover a class-balanced ridge classifier for fixed training features. Trained without retaining images or feature vectors, CONTLORA reaches 88.55% accuracy on 20-task CIFAR-100 and 86.99% on CUB-200. Across three benchmarks in the matched component study, its mean final accuracy differs from an independently trained stored-feature counterpart by at most 0.07 percentage points. Ablations show that improved task coverage need not improve classification and adapter composition also matters. On held-out classes, competitor-centered likelihood scores improve novelty AUROC over raw likelihood without altering routing ranks. These results support statistical memory as an alternative to example-retention approaches in the evaluated settings, while identifying task ambiguity as an ongoing limitation.

AI.tldr: CONTLORA用紧凑类别统计（高斯类模型+特征矩）替代存储样例，实现冻结LoRA适配器的选择与分类，在CIFAR-100、CUB-200等基准上达到与存储特征方法几乎等价的效果。
AI.motivation: 冻结旧适配器并不能保证持续学习者在推理时能正确选择与使用它们；存在多个适配器时，路由选择以及找到表示空间与查询答案匹配的适配器都很困难，而现有做法依赖保留样例。
AI.method: 以紧凑类别统计取代存储样例：在冻结表示中用高斯类模型选择LoRA适配器；用累积的特征矩（一/二阶矩）精确复原类平衡岭回归分类器，训练过程中不保留图像或特征向量。另对以竞争类为中心的似然分数做归一化用于新颖性检测。
AI.result: 20任务CIFAR-100达88.55%，CUB-200达86.99%；匹配组件研究中三个基准上与独立训练的存储特征对照方法最终平均精度差距≤0.07个百分点。消融显示任务覆盖提升未必带来分类提升，适配器组合亦有影响；在留出类上，竞争类中心化似然分数提升新颖性AUROC且不改变路由排序。
AI.conclusion: 在所评估设定下，统计记忆可作为样例保留范式的替代方案；任务歧义仍是持续性局限。

title: SEEK: Self-Evolution through Execution Knowledge for Agentic Robot Manipulation
summary: General-purpose multimodal foundation models enable robots to adapt during deployment from observations and execution feedback, without task-specific demonstrations or training. However, the robot retains what it learns only in the model's working context. Once the task ends, it loses this execution knowledge, such as how to carry a bowl between two grippers. On the next attempt at the task, the robot may take just as long and repeat the same mistakes. To avoid this repetition, robots must retain execution knowledge across attempts. Yet replaying past actions is insufficient, because their effects depend on the current conditions. Procedures that determine actions from the current scene address this, but when they meet conditions that earlier attempts did not cover, revising them requires the measured effects of earlier actions. We therefore propose SEEK, an agentic framework that retains both, enabling robots to improve across attempts while keeping the underlying model fixed. To adapt retained knowledge to the current scene, SEEK adopts a Self-Evolving Programmatic Policy (SEPP) that encodes manipulation as executable procedures and determines each action from current observations. As the robot executes these procedures, SEEK records the measured effects of its actions, including those from failed attempts, in a Persistent Action-Effect Bank (PAEB). Where a retained procedure applies, it acts without a model request; where it meets a condition it does not cover, this evidence guides its revision. On RoboDojo, knowledge retained over ten attempts raises SEEK's average task score from 27.0 to 54.4 and its success rate from 19.7% to 48.0% across all 42 tasks. On 34 of these tasks with GPT-6.2 Astra, SEEK reaches 80.1 after five attempts, against 49.6 for the same model acting directly, and uses 77.6% fewer model requests. https://zeyangguan.github.io/SEEK-Agentic-Robot-Manipulation/

AI.tldr: SEEK：在不更新模型参数的前提下，通过“可执行程序化策略+持久化动作效果库”让机器人跨尝试保留执行知识并持续改进。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态基础模型虽能让机器人零样本部署、依观察与执行反馈自适应，但所学仅存于工作上下文，任务结束即丢失执行知识，下次尝试会重复耗时与错误。单纯回放历史动作又因效果依赖当前条件而失效；以程序化方式从当前场景推导动作虽可缓解，但遇到此前未覆盖的条件时，修订需依赖先前动作的实测效果。
AI.method: 提出 SEEK 智能体框架，同时保留“过程”与“效果”两类知识：(1) 自演化程序化策略 SEPP，将操作编码为可执行程序，每步动作由当前观测决定；(2) 持久化动作-效果库 PAEB，在执行中记录动作的实测效果（含失败尝试）。匹配到已有程序时直接执行、不调用模型；遇到未覆盖条件时，以库中证据驱动程序修订；底层模型参数保持冻结。
AI.result: 在 RoboDojo 全部 42 个任务上，经十次尝试的知识积累将平均任务得分由 27.0 提升至 54.4，成功率由 19.7% 提升至 48.0%；其中 34 个任务使用 GPT-6.2 Astra，五次尝试后达 80.1，而同一模型直接执行仅 49.6，且模型请求量减少 77.6%。
AI.conclusion: 执行知识可跨尝试显式保留并复用，使冻结的基础模型也能获得持续改进能力；程序化过程与实测效果的结合是兼顾场景适应性与可修订性的关键，同时显著降低推理开销。

title: WhatIf: Counterfactual World Models over Action-Grounded Causal Graphs for Robotic Manipulation
summary: World models predict what happens under an action, but choosing between actions requires comparing their outcomes in the same physical situation. Factual transitions alone determine action-wise marginal futures and average effects, but not individual effects or the probability that switching actions causes harm. We introduce WhatIf, a counterfactual world model for manipulation that couples candidate futures through shared latent physics and transition noise inferred from factual history. Each candidate action induces a sparse object-factor causal graph describing the physical pathways it activates. Rolling out these graphs under the shared situation anchors predictions to observed outcomes and confines action contrasts to the objects each action reaches. Shared type-conditioned functions support varying numbers of objects, while a round-trip loss enforces action-invariant abduction without counterfactual labels. We show that replacing an individual effect with its conditional mean incurs mean-squared error equal to its conditional variance, motivating comparisons between coupled futures. Building on these comparisons, Counterfactual Advantage Planning (CAP) ranks plans by their advantage over an incumbent within shared situations and constrains the probability of harm. Paired advantages reduce estimator variance by a factor of $1-ρ$, where $ρ$ is the correlation between branch outcomes, and cancel model errors shared by both branches. Each executed transition provides hindsight advantages to update the physics posterior, the next plan, and an amortized policy without a learned critic. We further establish when observational transitions identify interventional dynamics. Paired simulator interventions evaluate counterfactual accuracy, graph recovery, compositional generalization, and decision quality.

AI.tldr: 提出反事实世界模型 WhatIf，通过共享潜在物理与转移噪声耦合候选未来，并据此构建 Counterfactual Advantage Planning（CAP），可约束伤害概率并降低估计方差。
AI.motivation: 单体事实性转移只能刻画动作的边际未来与平均效应，无法给出个体效应或“切换动作是否造成伤害”的概率；用条件均值替代个体效应会产生等于其条件方差的均方误差，因此必须对共享物理情境下的耦合未来进行比较。
AI.method: WhatIf 将候选未来通过共享潜在物理和从事实历史推断的转移噪声耦合起来；每个候选动作诱导稀疏的物体因子因果图，描述其激活的物理通路，并在共享情境下展开，使预测锚定于已观测结果、动作对比局限于可达物体；采用类型条件共享函数支持可变物体数，并用往返损失在无标签条件下实现动作不变的反事实推断（abduction）。在此之上提出 CAP：按对既有方案的优势对计划排序，约束伤害概率；成对优势可将方差降低 1-ρ 倍并抵消两分支共有的模型误差；每次执行转移提供事后优势，用于更新物理后验、下一计划与摊销策略（无需学习 critic）。还分析了观测性转移何时可识别干预动力学。
AI.result: 给出“条件均值替代个体效应的 MSE = 条件方差”的理论论证；成对方差缩减 1-ρ 且抵消共享模型误差；在成对仿真器干预下评估反事实精度、图结构恢复、组合泛化与决策质量。
AI.conclusion: 耦合的反事实世界模型加优势规划优于仅依赖事实性转移的做法：可实现动作差异的公平比较、伤害概率约束、方差与共模误差抑制，并在无 critic 的情况下持续在线改进；同时明确了观测数据识别干预动力学的条件。

title: HumblePRM: Improving VLM Abstention in Ambiguous Situations through Process Reward Modeling
summary: Reliable deployment of Vision Language Models (VLMs) requires that a model's expressed confidence remain grounded in what it can actually see, and that it recognize when the visual evidence is too ambiguous to commit to a confident response. Standard post-training uses outcome reward models (ORMs) that supervise only the final decision, rewarding a confident answer regardless of whether the image supports one, while existing methods either tend to detect uncertainty post-hoc or assume an objective verdict always exists. We instead split multimodal reasoning into two stages: perception, where the model must factually describe the scene, and calibration, where it must judge whether that evidence is sufficient to commit to a conclusion. We introduce HumblePRM, a lightweight process reward model (PRM) that scores each stage independently, rewarding agreement between evidence and expressed confidence rather than outcome correctness alone. Training with HumblePRM increases abstention due to uncertainty on ambiguous inputs considerably while leaving accuracy on clear images roughly unchanged. We also find that the improvement transfers to Gemma 4 E4B, a larger, popular edge model. Our findings show that process reward supervision is a promising route to VLMs with better calibrated abstention, ensuring more reliability rather than unpredictable behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出 HumblePRM：一个轻量级过程奖励模型，将多模态推理拆为"感知"与"校准"两阶段并分别打分，奖励证据与置信度的一致性而非仅结果正确性，从而显著提升 VLM 在歧义输入上的弃答率，同时基本保持清晰图像上的准确率，并具跨模型迁移性。
AI.motivation: VLM 可靠部署要求模型表达的置信度根植于其实际可见的视觉证据，并能在证据过于模糊时拒绝给出高置信回答。现有标准后训练使用结果奖励模型（ORM），仅监督最终决策，只要答案自信就给予奖励，不论图像是否支持；而已有不确定性方法多为事后检测，或假设客观结论总是存在。
AI.method: 将多模态推理分解为两阶段：感知阶段（模型须事实性地描述场景）与校准阶段（判断证据是否足以支撑结论）。据此提出 HumblePRM——轻量级过程奖励模型（PRM），对每个阶段独立评分，奖励证据与表达置信度之间的一致性，而非仅奖励结果正确性。
AI.result: 使用 HumblePRM 训练后，模型在歧义输入上因不确定性而弃答的比例大幅提升，而在清晰图像上的准确率基本不变；该改进还可迁移至更大规模的 Gemma 4 E4B 边缘模型。
AI.conclusion: 过程奖励监督是获得具有良好校准弃答能力的 VLM 的有效路径，可实现更高可靠性而非不可预测的行为。

title: Evaluation and Restoration of Safety in Reasoning-Tuned LLMs
comment: Main Paper: 10 Pages, 35 pages with references and appendix
summary: Open-source LLMs that are optimized for reasoning, such as VibeThinker, aim to democratize AI by bringing high-capability models to users with limited resources. They are broadly available but lack regulation and external guardrails; therefore, in order to integrate them safely into human society, it is critical that they perform in a safe manner. There are popular and intuitive arguments for why improved reasoning should improve safety, but recent evidence suggests that, in fact, the opposite may be true. This paper aims to characterize and mitigate this issue. First, it develops a metric for evaluating LLMs optimized for reasoning, and shows that increasing reasoning across multiple model families increases the unsafe rate in all cases. Second, it proposes a method for restoring safety by combining evolution strategies with a post-training guardrail (ESPG). Compared to alternative methods for safety post-training such as GRPO, ESPG is simple to implement, requires no GPU memory beyond that of inference, and works with remarkably few training samples (e.g.\ 30), yet makes the model significantly safer. The study thus establishes a path towards safe post-training of open-source AI models.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画并缓解"推理增强导致安全性下降"的问题：提出评估指标证明推理优化普遍提高不安全率，并提出ESP G方法恢复安全性。
AI.motivation: 开源推理优化LLM（如VibeThinker）广泛可得但缺乏监管与外部护栏，需确保其行为安全。业界直觉认为更强推理会提升安全性，但近期证据显示可能相反，本文旨在刻画并缓解这一问题。
AI.method: (1) 构建面向推理优化LLM的安全性评估指标，在多个模型族上量化推理程度与不安全率的关系；(2) 提出ESPG（Evolution Strategies + Post-training Guardrail），将进化策略与后训练护栏结合，无需超出推理的GPU显存，仅需极少训练样本（如30条）。
AI.result: 在所有测试的模型族中，推理能力提升均伴随不安全率上升；ESPG仅用约30个样本即显著提升模型安全性，且实现简单、显存开销低，优于GRPO等安全后训练替代方法。
AI.conclusion: 推理增强并非天然带来安全，需显式安全后训练；ESPG为开源AI模型的安全后训练提供了一条低成本、可复现的可行路径。

title: iMFPO: Improving Mean Flow Policy Optimization with Drift-Aware Velocity Alignment for Embodied Control
summary: Flow-based generative policies offer expressive action modeling for embodied control, yet achieving efficient one-step generation under reward-driven policy optimization remains challenging. In particular, evolving action distributions during online reinforcement learning may introduce inconsistencies between instantaneous-velocity learning and interval-averaged action generation. To address this challenge, we propose iMFPO, a one-step generative policy optimization framework with decoupled velocity learning and drift-aware velocity alignment. A shared interval-conditioned actor supports instantaneous-velocity supervision and interval-averaged action generation. JVP-corrected velocity regression is jointly optimized with reward-driven policy objectives, with action-level guidance from a frozen PPO teacher during training. At inference, iMFPO directly generates actions through interval-averaged velocity prediction, achieving one-step control without iterative flow integration. Across Go2, G1, H1, and Spot, zero-latent evaluation yields mean returns of 35.69, 34.44, 416.23, and 29.86. On Go2, action-generation latency drops from 15.57 ms to 0.41 ms relative to 64-step RFPO. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/iMFPO. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/iMFPO.

AI.tldr: iMFPO：解耦速度学习与漂移感知速度对齐的单步生成式策略优化框架，在保持流模型表达力的同时实现一步动作生成。
AI.motivation: 基于流的生成式策略表达力强，但在奖励驱动的策略优化下难以高效地实现一步生成。在线强化学习过程中动作分布不断演化，导致“瞬时速度学习”与“区间平均动作生成”之间出现不一致（漂移）问题。
AI.method: 提出iMFPO：1）共享的区间条件actor同时支持瞬时速度监督与区间平均动作生成；2）采用JVP（Jacobian-vector product）校正的速度回归，与奖励驱动的策略目标联合优化；3）训练时引入冻结的PPO教师提供动作级引导；4）推理时直接通过区间平均速度预测输出动作，无需迭代流积分，实现单步控制。
AI.result: 在Go2、G1、H1、Spot上，零潜变量评估的平均回报分别为35.69、34.44、416.23、29.86；在Go2上，动作生成延迟相比64步RFPO从15.57 ms降至0.41 ms。
AI.conclusion: 解耦速度学习与漂移感知对齐可有效缓解在线RL中动作分布演化带来的不一致，在多种具身平台上以单步推理取得有竞争力的回报，并将生成延迟降低约38倍，验证了高效一步生成式策略优化的可行性与实用性。

title: REFORGE: LLM-Assisted RTL Bug Repair with Structured Context and Verification Feedback
comment: Accepted at DATE 2027 (Design, Automation and Test in Europe); initial author version
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can write and repair RTL, but successful compilation or testbench execution does not establish defect removal, behavioral preservation, security, or implementation feasibility. Existing LLM-based RTL repair methods often report a single repair rate without retaining separate evidence for these properties, limiting reproducible comparison and integration into hardware design flows. We present REFORGE, which, to our knowledge, is the first LLM-assisted RTL repair framework that maintains and accumulates structured repair evidence across iterations, allowing it to generate fixes that satisfy multiple objectives simultaneously, including functionality, behavioral equivalence, security, and cost efficiency. REFORGE profiles buggy RTL, identifies structural and security-relevant features, localizes failing behavior, and uses verification-guided diagnosis to generate complete RTL repair variants. Each variant undergoes syntax checking, simulation, formal analysis, off-trigger preservation, security re-scan, and synthesis-based power, performance, and area analysis. We implement REFORGE as a backend-independent repair-and-verification flow and evaluate it in 288 runs across three LLM backends and three benchmark suites. On CirFix, the proposed context and diagnosis increase runs delivering a checked repair from 32/63 to 51/63, while every configuration repairs the Hack@DAC OpenTitan defect. Evidence records also show that a testbench-only criterion reports 3.9 times more repairs than the full set of applicable checks, security-clean outputs may lack functional verification, and different RTL repairs can implement equivalent hardware. These results show that LLM-generated RTL repairs require explicit multi-stage verification evidence rather than a single pass/fail outcome.

AI.tldr: REFORGE是首个在迭代中累积结构化修复证据的LLM辅助RTL修复框架，能同时满足功能、行为等价、安全与成本效率多目标，实验证明仅凭测试通过远不足以判定修复成功。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-based RTL修复工作仅报告单一"修复率"，未分别保留编译/仿真通过之外的缺陷消除、行为保持、安全性与可实现性证据，导致结果难以复现比较，也难以集成到硬件设计流程；而编译成功或测试台运行通过并不能证明这些性质。
AI.method: REFORGE对含缺陷RTL进行剖析，提取结构与安全相关特征，定位失效行为，并借助验证引导的诊断生成完整修复变体；每个变体依次经过语法检查、仿真、形式化分析、触发外保持性（off-trigger preservation）验证、安全重扫，以及基于综合的PPA（功耗、性能、面积）分析。框架实现为后端无关的修复-验证流程，在3个LLM后端×3个基准套件的288次运行中评估。
AI.result: 在CirFix上，所提上下文与诊断使产出"通过检查的修复"的运行数从32/63提升至51/63；所有配置均修复了Hack@DAC OpenTitan缺陷。证据记录显示：仅以测试台为准的判据报告的修复数比完整适用检查集多3.9倍；安全洁净的输出可能缺乏功能验证；不同的RTL修复可实现等价硬件。
AI.conclusion: LLM生成的RTL修复需要显式的多阶段验证证据，而非单一通过/失败结论；结构化证据累积对于可复现比较和设计流程集成至关重要。

title: Recovering What Matters, Transferring Only What Is Reliable: Toward Precise Reference-Based Super-Resolution
summary: Reference-based super-resolution (RefSR) aims to recover missing details from high-quality references. However, existing methods face two fundamental challenges. First, perceptual plausibility does not guarantee content fidelity. Existing methods often produce visually convincing details without faithfully recovering reference-specific information, such as text, codes, and identity cues. Second, faithful reference reading does not guarantee reliable information transfer. Increasing reference utilization also exposes the restoration process to misleading content, as global semantic relevance does not necessarily imply local correspondence consistency. To address these challenges, we propose PreciseRef, a reference-aware generative framework for faithful and reliable RefSR. At its core, Asymmetric Twin-Attention (ATA) allows target and reference images to participate in a unified attention space while the reference keeps its own shape. By letting their image tokens interact directly through joint attention, ATA facilitates fine-grained reference information retrieval without explicit image alignment. To ensure reliable information transfer, we introduce Dual-Scale Reference Gating (DRG), which combines Semantic Relevance Gating (SRG) to filter globally irrelevant reference context and Bidirectional Consistency Gating (BCG) to suppress unreliable local correspondences. Furthermore, we establish VeriRef, a benchmark evaluating exact reference-dependent content recovery and robustness to mismatched references. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves 85.6% character accuracy and 76.3% exact code decoding, compared with 17.4% and 0% for existing methods, while effectively suppressing erroneous reference transfer. It also achieves state-of-the-art perceptual quality on CUFED5 and WR-SR.

AI.tldr: 提出 PreciseRef：以非对称双生注意力 ATA 实现免对齐的细粒度参考信息检索，配合双尺度参考门控 DRG 抑制误导性内容，并构建 VeriRef 基准，显著提升参考相关内容的忠实恢复与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有 RefSR 方法存在两个根本问题：(1) 感知合理性不等于内容忠实性，生成看似逼真的细节却未真实还原参考中的特定信息（文字、编码、身份线索等）；(2) 忠实读取参考不等于可靠信息传递，提高参考利用率会引入误导性内容，因为全局语义相关并不保证局部对应一致。
AI.method: 提出参考感知生成框架 PreciseRef。核心组件包括：Asymmetric Twin-Attention (ATA)，让目标图像与参考图像共享统一注意力空间但参考保持自身形状，通过联合注意力使图像 token 直接交互，实现无需显式对齐的细粒度参考检索；Dual-Scale Reference Gating (DRG)，其中 Semantic Relevance Gating (SRG) 过滤全局无关参考上下文，Bidirectional Consistency Gating (BCG) 抑制不可靠的局部对应。同时构建 VeriRef 基准，用于评测精确的参考依赖内容恢复及对错配参考的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 字符准确率达 85.6%、精确编码解码率 76.3%，而现有方法仅为 17.4% 与 0%；同时有效抑制错误的参考信息传递，并在 CUFED5 与 WR-SR 上取得最先进的感知质量。
AI.conclusion: PreciseRef 在保证感知质量的同时显著提升参考相关内容恢复的忠实性与传递可靠性，配合 VeriRef 基准为 RefSR 的忠实评估提供了新范式。

title: A Perturbation-Driven Framework for Sensitivity Analysis of Dimensionality Reduction
comment: This manuscript is currently under review
summary: Low-dimensional representations produced by dimensionality reduction (DR) are commonly evaluated using distortion measures such as trustworthiness and continuity. In this paper, we study the sensitivity of DR methods to plausible input variations by quantifying changes in structural preservation and visually diagnosing how these changes manifest in the resulting representations. This perspective reflects the fact that real-world datasets are finite, noisy samples of an underlying distribution, and DR should not produce substantially different structures under small data changes. We introduce a model-agnostic, perturbation-driven sensitivity evaluation framework that treats perturbations as controlled probes of plausible data variation. Across multiple perturbation families and strength levels, we repeatedly perturb the input, apply a DR method, and evaluate the resulting low-dimensional representations using a set of distortion measures to derive sensitivity profiles for each DR method. We demonstrate the utility of our framework through case studies on DR method comparison, behavior analysis, and robustness improvement. We find that methods performing well according to conventional distortion measures (e.g., t-SNE) can still exhibit substantial sensitivity, leading to instability in visually salient structures such as trajectories and clusters, while certain methods (e.g., multidimensional scaling) may exhibit improved structural preservation under specific perturbations. These results highlight the importance of sensitivity analysis for comparing DR methods, diagnosing perturbation-sensitive visual patterns, and guiding the development of more robust DR methods toward trustworthy visual analytics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种与模型无关、以扰动为驱动的降维敏感性评估框架，通过在多种扰动族与强度下重复"扰动输入—降维—计算失真度量"，为每种降维方法构建敏感性画像，揭示常规失真度量表现良好的方法（如t-SNE）仍可能对微小数据变化高度敏感。
AI.motivation: 现实数据集是潜在分布的有限、含噪样本，降维方法不应在数据微小变化下产生显著不同的结构；然而现有评估主要依赖trustworthiness、continuity等失真度量，仅衡量静态结果的结构保持，缺乏对输入合理变化下结果稳定性的量化与可视化诊断。
AI.method: 构建与模型无关的扰动驱动敏感性评估框架：将扰动视为对合理数据变化的受控探针；在多个扰动族与强度水平下，反复对输入施加扰动、执行降维方法，并用一组失真度量（如trustworthiness、continuity）评估所得低维表示的结构保持变化，从而为每种降维方法导出敏感性画像；并通过案例研究（方法比较、行为分析、鲁棒性改进）及可视化诊断展示框架效用。
AI.result: 实验发现：按传统失真度量表现良好的方法（如t-SNE）仍可能表现出显著敏感性，导致轨迹、簇等视觉显著结构不稳定；而某些方法（如多维缩放MDS）在特定扰动下反而呈现更好的结构保持。框架可用于比较降维方法敏感性、诊断对扰动敏感的视觉模式，并指导更鲁棒降维方法的开发。
AI.conclusion: 敏感性分析应成为降维方法比较与视觉分析可信度评估的必要补充维度；该扰动驱动框架可量化结构保持的稳定性并定位不稳定的视觉模式，为开发面向可信可视分析的鲁棒降维方法提供指导。

title: Beyond the Happy Path: Generalizing Robot World Models from Simulated Failures
summary: Robot world models are increasingly used to evaluate and plan policies, yet robot training data are dominated by successful demonstrations. Off the happy path, when a grasp is misaligned or mistimed and the object is pushed, tilted, or slips, their predictions break down. Across five pretrained action-conditioned models, object-motion error is at most 10.4% lower than that of a static baseline that copies the first frame, and two models are worse than this baseline. We present WorldReforge, which teaches world models what happens when manipulation goes wrong. We construct the Reforge dataset of 62k simulated trajectories by perturbing reference grasps in position, orientation, and closure timing, recording each resulting push, slip, or failed pickup with ground-truth object pose, contact, and surface points. WorldReforge turns this ground truth into two training signals without additional inference cost. Interaction Alignment focuses reconstruction on the small object and contact regions that a global loss underweights, and Surface Correspondence trains backbone features to follow the same physical surface points across frames. On Cosmos3 Nano, WorldReforge reduces object trajectory error by 28.2% overall and by 35.0% on unseen objects, and it lowers the error in predicting how two actions' outcomes diverge by 43.3%. Although trained only in simulation, it also improves reconstruction on DROID and on real failure videos. Controlled data studies show that failed contact and successful holding teach complementary physics: failed contact teaches how objects respond, and holding teaches how a grasped state persists. Our code, data, and models are available at aim-uofa.github.io/WorldReforge/.

AI.tldr: 现有机器人世界模型因训练数据以成功演示为主，在抓取错位、时机不当等"失败/接触异常"场景下预测严重失效（对象运动误差至多仅比复制首帧的静态基线低10.4%，两个模型甚至更差）。作者构建Reforge数据集并提出WorldReforge方法，通过交互对齐与表面对应两种训练信号注入失败物理知识，在Cosmos3 Nano上将对象轨迹误差降低28.2%（未见物体35.0%），动作结果分歧预测误差降低43.3%。
AI.motivation: 机器人世界模型被广泛用于策略评估与规划，但其训练数据由成功演示主导，缺乏"偏离理想路径"的交互经验（抓取错位、倾斜、滑移、推挤等）。这导致模型在失败场景下物理预测崩溃，甚至不如简单的静态基线，限制了其在真实部署中的可靠性。
AI.method: 1) 构建Reforge数据集：通过扰动参考抓取的位置、朝向与闭合时序，生成62k条仿真轨迹，记录推挤、滑移、抓取失败，并标注真值物体位姿、接触与表面点；2) 提出WorldReforge，将真值转为两种无额外推理成本的训练信号：Interaction Alignment 将重建损失聚焦于被全局损失低估的小物体与接触区域；Surface Correspondence 训练主干特征跨帧跟踪同一物理表面点。
AI.result: 在五个预训练动作条件模型上验证了基线缺陷；在Cosmos3 Nano上，WorldReforge整体降低对象轨迹误差28.2%，未见物体上降低35.0%，两动作结果分歧预测误差降低43.3%；仅在仿真训练，却在DROID及真实失败视频上提升重建质量。消融表明失败接触与成功持握提供互补物理知识：前者教物体如何响应，后者教抓取状态如何保持。
AI.conclusion: 失败交互数据是世界模型缺失且关键的一环；以低成本训练信号（区域聚焦+表面点对应）注入失败物理，可显著提升动作条件预测的鲁棒性与泛化性，且具备从仿真到真实的迁移能力。

title: TransHarness: From Benchmark Overfitting to Transferable Harness Evolution
comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, including references and appendices
summary: Harness evolution offers a path to improving coding agents without updating model weights. However, existing methods can overfit their evolution benchmarks, producing gains that fail to carry over to new tasks. To address this challenge, we introduce Transferable Harness Evolution (TransHarness), which evolves harness intervention policies from same-task success-failure contrasts. These policies couple execution-context triggers with diagnostic guidance, enabling task-dependent checks and corrections beyond the source executions. Cross-task replay and independent semantic selection retain policies that intervene selectively and ground corrections in current-task evidence rather than source-specific solutions. We further curate an independent evolution set for cross-distribution transfer and conduct a cross-benchmark evaluation covering multiple strong models and a range of lightweight and mature harnesses. Experiments show that, with only 300 source trajectories from outside the test distribution, TransHarness further improves strong agents across distinct target benchmarks, demonstrating transferable harness evolution beyond benchmark overfitting. Specifically, TransHarness achieves state-of-the-art scores of 76.4% on DeepSWE v1.1 and 95.5% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, surpassing the strongest baseline model, GPT-6 Astra, by 2.4 and 5.6 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出 TransHarness（可迁移 Harness 演化），利用同任务成功-失败对比演化出可迁移的干预策略，仅用测试分布外的 300 条源轨迹即在 DeepSWE v1.1 与 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上分别取得 76.4% 与 95.5% 的 SOTA 成绩。
AI.motivation: Harness 演化可在不更新模型权重的情况下提升编码智能体性能，但现有方法容易过拟合其演化基准，导致的收益难以迁移到新任务。作者因此希望解决"演化收益不可迁移"的问题。
AI.method: 1) 从同任务的成功-失败轨迹对比中演化 harness 干预策略；2) 策略由"执行上下文触发器 + 诊断性指导"耦合构成，支持任务相关的检查与纠错，超出源执行场景；3) 采用跨任务重放与独立语义选择，保留"选择性干预"且以当前任务证据为依据（而非源任务特定解法）的策略；4) 额外构建独立演化集以支持跨分布迁移。
AI.result: 仅使用测试分布外的 300 条源轨迹，即可在多个目标基准上进一步提升强智能体表现；在 DeepSWE v1.1 上达 76.4%、Terminal-Bench 2.1 上达 95.5%，分别超过最强基线模型 GPT-6 Astra 2.4 与 5.6 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 实验覆盖多款强模型以及多种轻量与成熟 harness，验证了 harness 演化可以超越基准过拟合、实现跨基准迁移，为无需更新模型权重的智能体能力提升提供了可行路径。

title: Playfulness as Feedback for Agentic Game Development
summary: Coding agents can generate runnable games from natural-language descriptions. However, a runnable game does not guarantee an excellent gameplay experience for players. In our view, a playful game should provide 1) reliable core functionality, 2) appealing visual design and assets, and 3) rich gameplay that supports exploration and progression. How agents can improve these aspects of playfulness remains underexplored. In our work, we propose Play2Evolve, a recursive game development framework with three stages: Initialization, Refinement, and Evolution. Using playfulness as feedback, agents playtest the game and diagnose issues in its functionality, visual presentation, and gameplay. Their feedback guides bug fixes and asset improvements. It also helps agents propose new gameplay and aesthetic goals for continued game evolution. To enrich game materials, we combine a video generation model with code to create appealing static and dynamic assets and integrate them into interactive gameplay. Finally, Play2Evolve achieves state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods, scoring 60.05 on GameCraft-Bench compared with 50.81 after Game Initialization and 52.46 for Play2Code. Human overall-quality ratings reach 3.67, compared with 2.38 and 2.43, respectively. Our code will be released at https://github.com/showlab/Play2Evolve.

AI.tldr: Play2Evolve：以"可玩性"为反馈的递归式游戏开发框架，分初始化、精修、进化三阶段，结合视频生成模型与代码制作静态/动态素材，实现游戏持续自我演化。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体虽能由自然语言生成可运行游戏，但"可运行"不等于"好玩"。作者认为可玩性应包含三点：可靠的核心功能、有吸引力的视觉设计与素材、以及支持探索与成长进程的丰富玩法。现有工作对如何让智能体提升这些可玩性维度研究不足。
AI.method: 提出 Play2Evolve 递归框架，含三个递归阶段：Initialization（初始化）、Refinement（精修）、Evolution（进化）。以可玩性作为反馈信号，智能体试玩（playtest）并诊断功能、视觉呈现与玩法方面的问题；反馈既指导 bug 修复与素材改进，也驱动智能体提出新的玩法与美学目标以推动持续演化。素材方面，将视频生成模型与代码相结合，生成有吸引力的静态与动态资产并嵌入交互式玩法。
AI.result: 在 GameCraft-Bench 上取得所评估方法中的最优成绩：60.05，对比仅做游戏初始化的 50.81 与 Play2Code 的 52.46。人类整体质量评分达 3.67，对比上述两者的 2.38 与 2.43。
AI.conclusion: 以可玩性为反馈的"试玩—诊断—修复/进化"递归闭环，能有效同时提升功能可靠性、视觉表现与玩法深度，显著优于一次性初始化与 Play2Code 基线，说明将游戏开发视为持续演化过程是提升生成游戏品质的有效途径。

title: Deletion You Can Check: Auditing LLM Unlearning
comment: Accepted at 4th International Conference on Foundation and Large Language Models (FLLM2026)
summary: A common indication that a fine-tuned model has forgotten a deleted record is a membership-inference score near chance (ROC-AUC $\approx 0.5$). This reading is sound only if the comparison population represents how the record should behave after a valid deletion---a counterfactual that is rarely validated. We test this premise in a controlled $2\times2$ study pairing two membership-inference benchmarks, ArxivMIA and BookMIA, with two language models, Llama-3.2-1B and Qwen2.5-1.5B. Exact retraining validates the membership reference: it lies within the prespecified chance band on ArxivMIA but reaches $0.122$ on BookMIA, causing the same metric to reject an empirical deletion reference. A post-hoc BookMIA/Qwen diagnostic replaces benchmark label-0 records with same-pool, never-fine-tuned records and moves the reference from $0.257$ to $0.523$, supporting population mismatch in that cell. Each approximate-unlearning checkpoint is judged jointly on membership removal, deletion-targeted shift beyond non-deletion variation, and utility. On the admitted ArxivMIA/Llama axis, no tested configuration of gradient ascent with retain descent (GA+GD), negative-preference optimization with retain training (NPO-RT), or teacher--student unlearning (SCRUB) passes. A score near chance is not evidence of forgetting until a reference establishes what chance means.

AI.tldr: 论文检验"成员推断分数接近随机(AUC≈0.5)即代表删除成功"这一常用判断前提，发现该分数只有在参考总体有效时才可靠；在BookMIA上参考值偏离随机带导致误判，且三种近似遗忘方法在有效设定下均未通过。
AI.motivation: 现有近似遗忘(unlearning)评估普遍以成员推断ROC-AUC≈0.5作为"模型已遗忘被删记录"的证据，但这一解读隐含假设：用于对比的总体(参考)能正确刻画合法删除后记录应有的行为，而这种反事实参考极少被验证。作者希望直接检验该前提是否成立。
AI.method: 采用受控2×2设计：两个成员推断基准(ArxivMIA、BookMIA)×两个语言模型(Llama-3.2-1B、Qwen2.5-1.5B)。用精确重训练(exact retraining)建立并验证成员推断参考；事后在BookMIA/Qwen格子上以同池、从未微调的记录替换标签0记录作为诊断。对每个近似遗忘检查点从三方面联合评估：成员移除、超出非删除波动的删除目标偏移、效用保持。测试方法包括GA+GD、NPO-RT、SCRUB。
AI.result: 精确重训练参考在ArxivMIA上落在预设随机带内，但在BookMIA上达到0.122，导致同一指标反而"拒绝"经验性删除参考。BookMIA/Qwen诊断将参考从0.257移至0.523，支持该格子存在总体不匹配问题。在通过验证的ArxivMIA/Llama轴上，GA+GD、NPO-RT、SCRUB的任何测试配置均未通过三项联合判据。
AI.conclusion: 接近随机的成员推断分数本身不构成遗忘证据，必须先由有效参考界定"随机"的含义；未经验证的参考会导致对遗忘方法的误判。评估近似遗忘应联合成员移除、删除目标偏移与效用三项指标。

title: Targeted Adaptation of World-Action Models via Interaction and Motion Heads
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) are a promising new paradigm of robot manipulation policies that jointly generate future video and actions. Successful manipulation requires both identifying where to interact and modeling how the robot and objects move. Yet standard adaptation methods, such as full fine-tuning and LoRA, do not explicitly select parameters aligned with these manipulation-specific capabilities. Motivated by this challenge, we discover two functionally specialized families of attention heads: Next-Interaction Heads, which localize upcoming grasp-and-release targets, and Motion Heads, which track movement across frames. Furthermore, we introduce HeadLight, a parameter-efficient refinement method that jointly adapts Next-Interaction Heads and Motion Heads. On RoboTwin tasks unseen during fine-tuning, HeadLight achieves 62.28% success, compared with 57.89% for full fine-tuning and 58.66% for LoRA, while updating only 1.1% of parameters. Inference-time ablations further validate the functional importance of these heads: ablating Motion Heads reduces manipulation success from 57.89% to 0.94%, while ablating Next-Interaction Heads lowers it to 40.61%, both substantially more than ablating equally many random heads. Finally, we show that our approach is effective across multiple WAM architectures and real-robot manipulation settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现WAM策略中的注意力头存在两类功能专化（Next-Interaction Heads定位抓取目标、Motion Heads建模运动），并提出仅微调这两类注意力头的参数高效方法HeadLight，在未见RoboTwin任务上以1.1%可调参数取得62.28%成功率，优于全量微调与LoRA。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作策略需同时"定位交互位置"与"建模机器人和物体的运动"，而全量微调和LoRA等标准适配方法并未显式选择与这些操作能力对齐的参数，导致适配效率与泛化性能受限。
AI.method: 先在WAM的注意力头中识别出两类功能专化头：Next-Interaction Heads（定位即将发生的抓取/释放目标）与Motion Heads（跨帧跟踪运动）；随后提出HeadLight方法，联合适配这两族注意力头，实现参数高效精调（仅更新约1.1%参数）。
AI.result: 在微调阶段未出现的RoboTwin任务上，HeadLight成功率达62.28%，高于全量微调57.89%与LoRA 58.66%，仅更新1.1%参数。推理时消融显示：移除Motion Heads使成功率由57.89%降至0.94%，移除Next-Interaction Heads降至40.61%，降幅均显著大于消融同数量随机头。方法在多种WAM架构与真实机器人场景下同样有效。
AI.conclusion: WAM中的注意力头具有可解释的功能专化，针对性地适配这些头可在极低参数开销下获得优于全量微调与LoRA的泛化性能，消融实验验证了其功能重要性，且方法可跨架构与真实机器人迁移。

title: Improving Building Energy Efficiency with an Indoor Environmental World Model and Counterfactual Adaptive Learning
summary: Optimizing indoor climate systems plays a critical role in achieving the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals 11 and 13. However, indoor delayed thermodynamic responses and partial observability severely hinder existing reinforcement learning (RL) methods, which are primarily limited by implicit thermal inertia, occupancy dynamic prediction, and cumulative prediction errors during long-horizon rollouts. Thus, we propose a novel occupant-centric indoor climate control framework. It develops indoor environmental world models to predict future physical thermal baselines and dynamic occupancy, explicitly capturing latent thermal inertia. By formulating adaptive regulation as counterfactual advantage learning against future environments via a Branching Dueling Q-Network, and integrating a Held-Action TD-λ target, it effectively mitigates delayed credit assignment. Additionally, a proposed physics-aligned smoothness regularization suppresses high-frequency actuator fluctuations, potentially extending equipment service life. Experiments on SemiBuildingSim and Sinergym demonstrate that our method achieves a superior multi-objective trade-off. Compared to the best-performing methods, it further reduces energy consumption by 11.2%, occupant discomfort by 44.2%, and action fluctuation by 47.3%, achieving better sample efficiency and cross-region effectiveness. This interdisciplinary study offers an energy-efficient, occupant-centric AI solution for control science, building science, and energy sustainability.

AI.tldr: 提出以室内环境世界模型+反事实优势学习的以人为中心室内气候控制框架，显著降低能耗、不适度与动作波动。
AI.motivation: 室内气候系统优化对SDG 11/13意义重大，但室内热力响应存在延迟、状态部分可观测，现有强化学习方法受隐性热惯性、 occupancy动态难预测及长时程滚动累积误差限制，导致信用分配困难。
AI.method: 构建室内环境世界模型，预测未来物理热基线并显式刻画潜在热惯性与动态occupancy；将自适应调节建模为针对未来环境的反事实优势学习，采用Branching Dueling Q-Network，并引入Held-Action TD-λ目标缓解延迟信用分配；另加物理对齐的平滑正则抑制执行器高频波动。
AI.result: 在SemiBuildingSim与Sinergym上取得更优多目标权衡：相较最优基线，能耗降低11.2%，occupant不适度降低44.2%，动作波动降低47.3%，并具备更好样本效率与跨区域有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该跨学科工作为控制科学、建筑科学与能源可持续性提供了一种节能、以人为中心的AI解决方案。

title: FoamSurf: A Voronoi-Surfel Representation for Differentiable Rendering
summary:
Scenes inside a scattering medium contain solid surfaces, such as the seabed or rocks, and a semi-transparent medium, such as water, fog, or smoke. Recent Gaussian-based methods produce realistic images of scenes in scattering media, but traces of the medium can remain visible in surface-only renders. Neural fields separate surfaces and medium more accurately, but they are slow to train and difficult to edit. Both approaches evaluate the medium only along camera rays, so its effects along reflected and refracted rays are not modeled. These limitations prevent reliable surface recovery, independent editing of surfaces and the medium, and consistent rendering of inserted objects. We present FoamSurf, a hybrid representation that models surfaces with planar Gaussian surfels and the medium with space-filling Voronoi cells. A single differentiable ray tracer composites both along arbitrary rays, while training priors keep them separate without segmentation masks. Across real underwater scenes, synthetic scenes, and dense fog, FoamSurf achieves image quality on par with the state of the art and the most accurate surface-medium separation among the compared methods. The recovered components can be removed, edited, or stylized independently, and the same reconstruction supports inserted mesh objects with attenuation and scattering along both direct and reflected or refracted rays. Together, these capabilities enable scene restoration, editing, and composition within a single reconstructed model.
  Project page: https://grzegorzwilczynski.com/foamsurf/

AI.tldr: FoamSurf 提出一种混合表示：用平面高斯面元（planar Gaussian surfels）建模固体表面，用空间填充的 Voronoi 单元建模散射介质，并用单一可微光线追踪器在任意光线上合成两者，在无分割掩码条件下实现表面与介质的准确解耦。
AI.motivation: 散射介质（水体、雾、烟）中的场景同时包含固体表面与半透明介质。现有基于高斯的方法虽能渲染逼真图像，但表面渲染中仍残留介质痕迹；神经场解耦更准确，却训练慢、难编辑。此外，两类方法仅在相机光线上评估介质，未建模反射/折射光线上的介质效应，导致表面恢复不可靠、表面与介质无法独立编辑、插入物体渲染不一致。
AI.method: 采用混合场景表示：表面由平面高斯面元表示，介质由空间填充的 Voronoi 单元表示；使用单个可微光线追踪器沿任意光线对两类组件进行合成；结合训练先验（priors）在无需分割掩码的情况下保持表面与介质的分离。
AI.result: 在真实水下场景、合成场景与浓雾场景上，图像质量与当前最优方法相当，并在所比较方法中取得最准确的表面–介质分离。恢复的各组件可独立移除、编辑或风格化；同一重建结果支持插入网格物体，并在直接光线以及反射/折射光线上同时建模衰减与散射。
AI.conclusion: FoamSurf 在单一重建模型中统一了场景复原、编辑与合成能力，克服了以往方法在介质分离与任意光线介质建模上的局限。

title: Casper: A Projection-Based Neurosymbolic Layer for Scalable & Guaranteed Constraint Satisfaction
summary: Many real-world problems demand exact constraint satisfaction to be meaningfully solved, yet existing neurosymbolic methods face a stark trade-off: those that guarantee satisfaction fail to scale, while those that scale must resort to approximation. Meanwhile, traditional deep learning approaches offer no satisfaction guarantees at all. In this paper, we propose Casper, a neurosymbolic layer that simultaneously (i) guarantees constraint satisfaction, (ii) scales at inference time, (iii) is fully automated, requiring no problem-specific engineering, and (iv) is fully differentiable, making it composable with any neural predictor both at training and at inference time. Casper casts constraint satisfaction as a closed-form Euclidean projection onto the constraint-feasible region, computable in a single forward pass. Experiments across MNIST arithmetic (up to 1024 digits), Sudoku solving, and Warcraft pathfinding show that Casper is the only method that produces guaranteed-valid outputs at scale: on $30\times30$ Warcraft grids, exact baselines time out and approximate ones produce valid paths less than 7% of the time, while Casper produces them 100% of the time.

AI.tldr: 提出Casper神经符号层，将约束满足表述为闭式欧几里得投影，单次前向即得严格可行解，兼顾可保证性与可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现有神经符号方法存在尖锐权衡：保证约束满足的方法无法扩展，可扩展的方法只能近似；传统深度学习方法完全不提供满足性保证。实际问题往往需要精确约束满足才有意义。
AI.method: Casper是一个神经符号层，同时满足四点：(i) 保证约束满足；(ii) 推理时可扩展；(iii) 全自动、无需问题特定工程；(iv) 完全可微，训练与推理阶段均可与任意神经预测器组合。核心技术是把约束满足转化为对约束可行域的闭式欧几里得投影，可在单次前向传播中计算。
AI.result: 在MNIST算术（至多1024位）、数独求解与Warcraft寻路任务上验证：Casper是唯一在大规模下产出保证有效输出的方法。在30×30 Warcraft网格上，精确基线超时，近似方法有效路径产出率不足7%，而Casper达100%。
AI.conclusion: Casper通过闭式投影统一了约束满足保证、可扩展性与可微性，并免去问题特定工程，为神经符号约束求解提供了实用范式。

title: QK-Bench: Benchmarking Quantitative Kinematic Understanding for Dynamic Spatial Intelligence
summary: Spatial intelligence concerns both scene structure and its temporal evolution. Yet a semantically correct description can conceal a quantitative error: recognizing that objects are approaching does not determine their closing speed or whether they will meet. Such errors are critical in collision avoidance, trajectory tracking, and reactive grasping, where actions depend on motion magnitude, timing, and relative geometry. We study quantitative kinematic understanding in multimodal large language models (MLLMs): resolving motion magnitude, rate, reference-frame dependence, and future spatial evolution from visual evidence. We introduce the Quantitative Kinematics Benchmark (QK-Bench), comprising 2,341 multiple-choice QA pairs from 379 videos and 17 tasks spanning Object-Centric Kinematics, Camera Ego-Motion Kinematics, and Multi-Object Kinematic Relations. Hidden geometric and temporal signals support trajectory construction and filtering, while fixed kinematic rules map physical quantities to verifiable answers, including categorical labels. Trajectory and question validation ensure target reliability and sufficient visual support in the sampled frames. All models receive a unified monocular RGB input. Evaluations of proprietary, open-source, and spatial MLLMs reveal substantial limitations: the strongest model achieves only 41.2\% overall accuracy, and spatial MLLMs show no consistent advantage. These findings indicate that current advances in spatial intelligence do not reliably transfer to quantitative kinematic understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出QK-Bench基准，系统评估多模态大模型在定量运动学理解上的能力，发现最强模型总体准确率仅41.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有空间智能研究多关注场景结构与时序演化的定性描述，语义正确的描述可能掩盖定量错误（如识别物体在接近但无法给出接近速度或是否相撞）。这类定量误差对碰撞规避、轨迹跟踪、反应式抓取等依赖运动幅度、时序与相对几何的任务至关重要。
AI.method: 构建Quantitative Kinematics Benchmark（QK-Bench），含379个视频、2,341个多项选择问答对，覆盖17项任务，分为物体中心运动学、相机自运动运动学、多物体运动学关系三类；利用隐藏的几何与时序信号支持轨迹构建与筛选，以固定运动学规则将物理量映射为可验证答案（含分类标签）；通过轨迹与问题验证保证目标可靠性与采样帧的视觉支撑；所有模型统一使用单目RGB输入。
AI.result: 在闭源、开源及空间MLLM上的评测显示普遍存在明显局限：表现最好的模型总体准确率仅41.2%，且空间专用MLLM并无一致优势。
AI.conclusion: 当前空间智能的进展并不能可靠迁移到定量运动学理解，模型在该能力上仍有显著缺口。

title: CHD-Bench: Diagnosing Congenital Heart Disease through Interactive Examination
comment: 21 pages (8 main + references + appendix), 9 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://github.com/Maitri-Labs-Amrita/CHD-Bench
summary: Diagnosis of congenital heart disease (CHD) requires understanding the spatial relationships between cardiac structures, which clinicians assess by scrolling through CT or cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) slices and rotating 3D reconstructions. Although automated methods have advanced cardiac segmentation, identifying congenital heart defects from volumetric scans remains an open challenge. The two existing approaches rely on handcrafted diagnostic rules limited to static anatomical abnormalities. We introduce CHD-Bench, the first benchmark for interactive CHD diagnosis, defining a multi-label task and evaluation protocol over 247 CT and MRI scans from three cohorts covering 38 CHD types. We also present CHD-Harness, open-source software that runs a VLM in a 3D Slicer environment through 22 tools, manages each examination, and records the resulting diagnosis and supporting views. We evaluate off-the-shelf medical, open weight, and closed weight VLMs and compare them with a 3D CNN classifier and published rule-based results. Gemini 4 Argon with CHD-Harness achieves the highest macro F1 across all three cohorts (0.63, 0.63, and 0.43). Allowing for interactive examination raises its macro F1 by up to 20 points over static views. These results establish CHD-Bench and CHD-Harness as a foundation for developing and evaluating VLMs for interactive CHD diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个交互式先天性心脏病（CHD）诊断基准 CHD-Bench 与配套的开源工具 CHD-Harness，使视觉语言模型（VLM）能在 3D Slicer 环境中通过 22 个工具交互式阅片，并在 247 例 CT/MRI（覆盖 38 类 CHD）上评估多种 VLM，最佳 macro F1 达 0.63/0.63/0.43，交互式检查相较静态视图可提升至多 20 个点。
AI.motivation: CHD 诊断依赖对心脏结构空间关系的理解，临床需滚动浏览 CT/MRI 切片并旋转 3D 重建。现有自动方法虽在心脏分割上有进展，但从体扫描中识别 CHD 缺陷仍是开放难题；且已有两类方法依赖仅针对静态解剖异常的手工诊断规则，缺乏交互式诊断的评测基础。
AI.method: 发布 CHD-Bench：首个交互式 CHD 诊断基准，定义多标签任务与评测协议，覆盖三个队列共 247 例 CT 与 MRI 扫描、38 类 CHD；并开源 CHD-Harness，通过 22 个工具让 VLM 在 3D Slicer 环境中运行，管理每次检查并记录诊断结果与支撑视图。实验对比现成医疗 VLM、开放权重与闭源权重 VLM，以及 3D CNN 分类器和已发表规则方法结果。
AI.result: Gemini 4 Argon 结合 CHD-Harness 在三个队列上取得最高 macro F1（分别为 0.63、0.63、0.43）；允许交互式检查后，其 macro F1 相较静态视图最高提升 20 个点。
AI.conclusion: CHD-Bench 与 CHD-Harness 为开发与评测面向交互式 CHD 诊断的 VLM 奠定了基础。

title: OrdiHand-GS: Ordinal-Guided Tracking and Hand-Refined Gaussian Avatars for Digital Signers
summary: Digital signers, also known as signing avatars, convey sign language through animated virtual humans, where visual fidelity and linguistic intelligibility hinge primarily on the hands. When one hand crosses over the other, two failure modes dominate. First, monocular expressive-human tracking suffers from ordinal depth ambiguity: either hand can satisfy the same 2D landmarks, and the baseline tracker orders wrists at chance level on 365 annotated overlapping frames from How2Sign. Second, hand appearance remains blurred in neural rendering even after geometry is corrected. We propose OrdiHand-GS to address these errors separately. Relative depth from a video depth estimator and apparent hand size vote, with confidence weighting and abstention, for a front-back relation, which enters expressive-human tracking as a hinge on median hand-surface depth. A source-conditioned residual head then refines the local positions of hand-associated UV Gaussians with the avatar backbone and renderer frozen. We instantiate the framework with GUAVA. Against matched unconstrained refinement, wrist-order accuracy rises from 32.9% to 77.3% at a cost of 0.39 pixels of reprojection error, while a random-sign placebo gives no balanced-accuracy gain. A 2x2 factorial evaluation attributes most of the interaction-rendering improvement to tracking-stage refinement, with a smaller additional benefit from the residual.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OrdiHand-GS，针对数字手语人（signing avatars）手部交叉遮挡场景下的两类失效模式，分别用"腕部前后序深度投票+铰链约束"和"源条件残差头微调手部 UV 高斯"来纠正，使腕序准确率从 32.9% 提升到 77.3%。
AI.motivation: 数字手语人的视觉保真度与语言可懂度主要取决于手部。当双手交叉时出现两类失效：(1) 单目表达性人体跟踪存在序数深度歧义——同一组 2D 关键点可由任一只手满足，基线跟踪器在 How2Sign 的 365 帧标注重叠数据上腕序判定仅达随机水平；(2) 即使几何被纠正，神经渲染中手部外观仍然模糊。二者需分别处理。
AI.method: 1) 融合视频深度估计器的相对深度与手部表观尺寸进行投票，带置信度加权与弃权机制，得到前后关系，并以"中位手部表面深度铰链"形式注入表达性人体跟踪；2) 设计源条件残差头，在冻结 avatar 主干与渲染器的前提下，精调与手部关联的 UV 高斯局部位置。框架以 GUAVA 实例化。
AI.result: 与匹配的无约束精调相比，腕序准确率由 32.9% 提升至 77.3%，代价为 0.39 像素的重投影误差；随机符号安慰剂实验未带来平衡准确率提升。2×2 因子实验表明，交互渲染改善主要来自跟踪阶段修正，残差头带来较小增益。
AI.conclusion: 将"序数深度判定"与"手部外观精调"解耦处理是有效策略；跟踪阶段的前后序约束是渲染质量提升的主要来源，残差精调为次要增益，且该方案不引入显著几何代价。

title: DiffER$^2$: Diffusion Ensembles for Retrosynthesis Prediction with SMILES Adapted Particle Guidance
summary: Computational retrosynthesis prediction has the potential to reduce development time for newly discovered drugs by automatically generating potential reactions for a target product. Data-driven approaches commonly treat this as a sequence-to-sequence generation task on SMILES strings. In this work, we construct ensembles of discrete-time and continuous-time diffusion models for molecular generation and incorporate guidance mechanisms for improved output diversity. We propose an adaptation of particle guidance to SMILES sequence generation which significantly improves the number of unique molecules generated by diffusion ensembles while increasing top-k accuracy. These results further expand the efficacy of discrete diffusion for SMILES generation, and our empirical analyses offer new insights into the capabilities of diffusion models for chemical retrosynthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文将逆合成预测作为SMILES序列生成任务，构建离散时间与连续时间扩散模型的集成，并引入粒子引导（particle guidance）适配SMILES序列生成，在提升唯一分子数量的同时提高top-k准确率。
AI.motivation: 计算逆合成预测有望缩短新药研发周期，但现有数据驱动方法通常将任务简化为SMILES序列到序列生成，输出多样性不足；作者希望借助扩散模型及其集成与引导机制改善生成多样性与准确性。
AI.method: 将逆合成视为SMILES上的条件序列生成；分别构建离散时间与连续时间扩散模型并做集成；引入面向SMILES序列生成的粒子引导机制，以引导采样提升输出多样性。
AI.result: 适配的粒子引导显著提升扩散集成生成的唯一分子数，同时提高top-k准确率，且消融/实证分析揭示了扩散模型在化学逆合成中的能力与特性。
AI.conclusion: 粒子引导有效增强离散扩散在SMILES逆合成生成中的实用性，为扩散模型用于逆合成提供新经验证据与方向。

title: Aegis-VLA: Reliability-Gated Action Refinement via a Trajectory World Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation
summary: Dynamic object manipulation requires maintaining spatial and temporal alignment with targets that continue to move during inference and execution. Although future prediction can inform action correction, an accurate forecast does not establish whether modifying an existing action would be beneficial. We present Aegis-VLA, a world-model-guided vision-language-action (VLA) framework that generates predictive action corrections and separately determines whether and how strongly to apply them. A Trajectory World Model combines kinematic extrapolation with learned residual dynamics to predict object motion and estimate positional uncertainty. Discrepancy-Guided Action Refinement uses differences between history-only and base-action-conditioned end-effector forecasts to propose bounded arm corrections. A Reliability Gate learns when to admit corrections based on demonstration-relative improvements over base actions, and regulates their application during inference using predictive uncertainty and anticipated object--end-effector proximity. Rejected corrections preserve the corresponding base actions. Aegis-VLA introduces only approximately 2.45M trainable parameters. On the simulated Dynamic Object Manipulation (DOM) benchmark, Aegis-VLA achieves 56.72\% success over 1,800 evaluation trials, exceeding our reproduced DynamicVLA baseline of 45.44\% by 11.28 percentage points.

AI.tldr: Aegis-VLA：以世界模型生成预测性动作修正，并用可靠性门控决定是否及多强地施加修正，在动态物体操作基准上以约2.45M可训练参数取得56.72%成功率，比复现的DynamicVLA基线高11.28个百分点。
AI.motivation: 动态操作需在推理与执行过程中与持续运动的目标保持时空对齐。未来预测虽可指导动作修正，但准确预测并不等于"修改现有动作有益"，因此需要额外判断修正是否应被采纳及其强度。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：(1) 轨迹世界模型，结合运动学外推与学习式残差动力学预测物体运动并估计位置不确定性；(2) 差异引导动作精化，用"仅历史"与"以基础动作为条件"的末端执行器预测之差提出有界机械臂修正；(3) 可靠性门控，基于相对示范的改进学习何时接纳修正，并在推理时用预测不确定性和预期物体—末端执行器接近度调节施加强度，被拒绝的修正保留原基础动作。
AI.result: 仅引入约2.45M可训练参数；在仿真动态物体操作（DOM）基准的1800次评估试验中成功率达56.72%，较复现的DynamicVLA基线45.44%提升11.28个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将"预测"与"是否采纳预测"解耦，配合轻量世界模型与门控机制，可在极低参数开销下显著提升动态操作鲁棒性；但结论目前限于仿真DOM基准，真实场景泛化与基线复现一致性仍待验证。

title: InterGenEHR$^+$: An Interactive Framework for Natural Language-Conditioned Generation of Longitudinal Patient Trajectories
comment: 31 pages including appendices, 2 figures. Author-accepted version of an article published in IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering
summary:
Objective: To develop and validate InterGenEHR$^+$, an interactive framework for natural language-conditioned generation of synthetic tabular electronic health records (EHRs) and longitudinal trajectories for scenario-based evaluation of machine learning models.
  Methods: An optional large language model (LLM) parser converts clinical requests into structured constraints. Conditional variational autoencoders and diffusion models generate single-time-point records, while diffusion models generate longitudinal trajectories. We evaluate parsing, distributional fidelity, imputation, clinical-constraint adherence, mortality prediction, and clinical plausibility using a multi-institutional cohort of 874 patients receiving venovenous extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VV-ECMO).
  Results: Gemma 3 4B with few-shot prompting achieves the highest parsing performance with a low spurious slot rate. IGE-TabDDPM and IGE-PMVAE perform well in single-time-point generation; IGE-CSDI, IGE-FGTI, and IGE-MTSCI lead on different longitudinal fidelity metrics. Across five random seeds and three classifiers, synthetic cohorts retain predictive utility for mortality prediction on real test data. Clinician ratings support trajectory plausibility and alignment with requested scenarios.
  Conclusion: InterGenEHR$^+$ supports clinician-specified generation of EHR trajectories with statistical fidelity and downstream predictive utility in the evaluated VV-ECMO cohort. Extension to other clinical settings requires further validation.
  Significance: The framework supports scenario-based evaluation of machine learning models in data-sparse critical care settings.

AI.tldr: 提出并验证交互式框架InterGenEHR$^+$，可由自然语言条件生成合成表格EHR及纵向轨迹，用于面向场景的ML模型评测。
AI.motivation: 数据稀缺的重症监护场景下，缺少可定制、可复现的合成EHR来开展场景化模型评测，需要按临床需求（自然语言）可控生成表格记录与纵向轨迹。
AI.method: 可选LLM解析器将临床请求转为结构化约束；条件VAE与扩散模型生成单时点记录，扩散模型生成纵向轨迹。在874例VV-ECMO多机构队列上评估解析质量、分布保真度、插补、临床约束遵循度、死亡预测与临床合理性。
AI.result: Gemma 3 4B少样本提示解析性能最佳且虚假槽位率低；IGE-TabDDPM与IGE-PMVAE在单时点生成表现好，IGE-CSDI、IGE-FGTI、IGE-MTSCI分别在纵向保真度不同指标上领先。5个随机种子×3个分类器下，合成队列在真实测试数据上保持死亡预测效用；临床医师评分支持轨迹合理性与场景一致性。
AI.conclusion: InterGenEHR$^+$可在VV-ECMO队列中实现统计保真且具下游预测效用的临床医生指定式EHR轨迹生成；推广至其他临床场景仍需进一步验证。框架支持数据稀缺重症场景下ML模型的场景化评测。

title: SplatWAM: Splatting World Action Models for Real-Time 3D Imagination
summary: World models typically predict future observations in pixel or latent space, limiting their ability to directly represent true 3D scene evolution. We present SplatWAM (Splatting World Action Model), a generative world model that learns action-conditioned dynamics directly over compact 3D Gaussian primitives. A tokenizer SplatWAM-T first encodes a variable number of unposed views into a fixed budget of Gaussian tokens. A dynamics model SplatWAM-D then predicts future Gaussian states in a single forward pass per action, using log-Euclidean covariance coordinates and differentiable rendering supervision to facilitate learning in an explicit 3D space. Each predicted state can be rasterized from arbitrary viewpoints, enforcing a shared 3D representation across views by construction. On OGBench Scene, SplatWAM renders novel views 12x faster than video world models (~80 FPS on an RTX 5090) with up to 2.0 dB higher PSNR. We further introduce SplatWAM-P, a lightweight flow-matching policy head jointly trained with the dynamics model. Across 8 task suites, model-free Gaussian-token policies outperform pixel-based counterparts by up to 24.8 percentage points. SplatWAM-P improves over Latent Particle World Model (LPWM) by 12 percentage points and matches HIQL without a learned value function. On LIBERO, our ~1B model outperforms WorldVLA (~7B) and the robot-pretrained OpenVLA (~7B), while matching OpenVLA-OFT when both are trained without large-scale robot pretraining. Code and checkpoints will be released.

AI.tldr: SplatWAM 是一个直接在紧凑的 3D 高斯原语上学习“动作条件动力学”的生成式世界模型，通过高斯 token 化器与动力学模型预测未来三维高斯状态，可实现任意视角光栅化，并在渲染速度、重建质量及下游策略性能上优于像素/潜空间世界模型。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型多在像素空间或潜空间中预测未来观测，难以直接表征真实三维场景的演化，也缺乏跨视角一致的三维表示。作者希望让世界模型显式地在 3D 空间中学习动作驱动的动态。
AI.method: 方法由三部分组成：(1) SplatWAM-T 分词器将可变数量的无位姿视图编码为固定预算的高斯 token；(2) SplatWAM-D 动力学模型对每个动作单次前向预测未来高斯状态，采用对数欧氏协方差坐标，并以可微渲染监督促进显式 3D 空间学习；(3) SplatWAM-P 轻量流匹配策略头，与动力学模型联合训练。预测状态可从任意视角光栅化，从而在构造上强制跨视角共享 3D 表示。
AI.result: 在 OGBench Scene 上，新视角渲染速度比视频世界模型快约 12 倍（RTX 5090 上约 80 FPS），PSNR 最高提升 2.0 dB。在 8 个任务套件上，无模型的高斯 token 策略比像素方法最高提升 24.8 个百分点；SplatWAM-P 比 LPWM 提升 12 个百分点，并在无学习价值函数情况下与 HIQL 持平。在 LIBERO 上，约 1B 参数的模型优于 WorldVLA（约 7B）与机器人预训练的 OpenVLA（约 7B），在均不使用大规模机器人预训练时与 OpenVLA-OFT 持平。
AI.conclusion: 以 3D 高斯作为世界模型的显式状态表示，兼顾渲染效率、跨视角一致性与策略学习效果，是一种可替代像素/潜空间世界模型的高效三维动态建模范式；代码与权重将开源。

title: Trigger-Invariant Contrastive Unlearning for Backdoor Removal
comment: An extended version of the short paper published at CIKM 2026 (https://dl.acm.org/doi/abs/10.1145/3799682.3839969)
summary: Backdoor attacks pose a severe threat to modern NLP models by embedding hidden triggers that induce malicious behavior at inference time. Recent unlearning methods such as gradient ascent (GA) attempt to remove backdoors by maximizing the loss on poisoned samples; however, these methods can suffer from a critical limitation: they may shift the trigger's influence to other classes rather than eliminating it. In this work, we propose Trigger-Invariant Contrastive Unlearning (TICU), a framework for mitigating textual backdoor behavior by enforcing prediction and representation invariance to trigger insertion. TICU constructs clean and trigger-inserted counterfactual pairs, then fine-tunes the model so that both inputs produce consistent output distributions and aligned hidden representations.
