To preserve clean-task performance, TICU also retains the supervised classification loss on clean data and constrains parameter drift from the original model. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets, model architectures, and attack settings show that TICU improves triggered accuracy and reduces trigger-induced prediction shifts compared with existing baselines, while maintaining competitive label-flipping performance and limiting clean-task degradation.

AI.tldr: 提出TICU（Trigger-Invariant Contrastive Unlearning）框架，通过对触发器插入保持预测与表征不变性来消除文本后门，在多个数据集、模型架构与攻击设置下优于梯度上升类遗忘基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于梯度上升（GA）的后门遗忘方法虽在中毒样本上最大化损失以移除后门，但存在关键缺陷：触发器影响可能被"迁移"到其他类别而非真正被消除，导致触发后的预测偏移仍然存在。
AI.method: 1) 构建"干净样本—触发器插入样本"的反事实配对；2) 微调模型使两者输出分布一致、隐层表征对齐（表征不变性+预测不变性）；3) 保留干净数据上的监督分类损失以维持正常任务性能；4) 约束参数相对原始模型的漂移幅度。即一种对比式遗忘+正则化框架。
AI.result: 在多数据集、多模型架构、多攻击设置的广泛实验中，相比现有基线：触发器生效时准确率（triggered accuracy，越低越好）改善、触发器引起的预测偏移减少；同时标签翻转（label-flipping）性能具竞争力，干净任务性能退化有限。
AI.conclusion: 不依赖单纯最大化中毒样本损失，而从"触发器不变性"角度约束模型，是更有效的文本后门缓解思路；在去除后门与保持清洁性能之间取得较好平衡。

title: Hetero-Associative Visuomotor Memory: Soft Recall as a Base for Learned Residuals in Few-Demonstration Imitation
summary:
Retrieve-and-correct policies typically refine the nearest retrieved demonstration chunk, the
  readout that works best when executed directly. We study what a demonstration memory should
  supply to the corrector instead and find that a smooth, softmax-weighted recall over the whole
  memory is a much better base. On ALOHA cube transfer (40 human demonstrations), soft recall is
  no better to execute alone than the nearest chunk; however, with keys, candidates, and training
  fixed, correcting it raises success by 22.4 points on fresh resets with new encoders and by 7.4
  against a closed-loop-tuned top-1 corrector. On robomimic Square, it leads by 7.9 points with
  the two better operators and by 6.7 on a label-free draw of equal size. This gain holds on
  sparse, varied demonstrations under an action-aware key and leave-one-demonstration-out
  training, and fades or slightly reverses on dense, scripted, or generated data. Building on this
  finding, our hetero-associative visuomotor memory (HAVM, 14M parameters) trains offline in about
  five minutes, including a learned retrieval temperature $β$, and runs in 1.1 ms. Across six
  fresh ALOHA encoders, it reaches 76.4% within 24 s, comparable to a 264M Diffusion Policy
  trained for 6.7 h (78.8%) and ahead of ACT (71.7%) and fine-tuned VLAs (65.2-75.2%), while
  leading every 40-demonstration baseline within the benchmark's 8 s limit (74.6%; +6.5 over
  Diffusion Policy, +15.1 over ACT). On LIBERO, one 40-task memory reaches 92.2% and loses far
  less than SmolVLA to rewording; on a real SO-101 arm, it sustains 30 Hz control without
  stalling. Unlike pretrained foundation policies aimed at zero-shot generalization to unseen
  tasks and workspaces, HAVM trades broad out-of-distribution generalization for rapid adaptation
  to the available demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 提出异源联想视觉运动记忆HAVM：用softmax加权软回忆替代top-1检索作为纠错基础，14M参数、5分钟离线训练、1.1ms推理，在多基准上以40条演示超越Diffusion Policy、ACT与微调VLA。
AI.motivation: 现有retrieve-and-correct策略默认只精修最近检索到的单个演示片段（top-1 chunk），这一读出方式仅在"直接执行"时最优，却未回答"演示记忆应以何种形态供给纠错器"这一根本问题。作者旨在研究记忆供给方式本身，并进一步构建能快速适配已有演示的高效策略，而非追求零样本泛化。
AI.method: 对比top-1最近块与全记忆softmax加权软回忆两种基础读出，在键、候选与训练条件固定下评估纠错增益；引入动作感知键（action-aware key）与leave-one-demonstration-out训练；据此实现异源联想视觉运动记忆HAVM（14M参数），含可学习检索温度β，离线训练约5分钟。
AI.result: 软回忆单独执行不优于最近块，但作为纠错基础显著更优：ALOHA cube transfer上新鲜reset提升22.4点，较闭环调优的top-1纠错器提升7.4点；robomimic Square提升7.9点（同等规模无标签抽样为6.7点）。增益在稀疏多样演示下保持，在密集、脚本化或生成数据上消失或反转。HAVM在六个新ALOHA编码器上24s内达76.4%，接近训练6.7h的264M Diffusion Policy(78.8%)，超过ACT(71.7%)与微调VLA(65.2–75.2%)；8s限制下达74.6%(+6.5/+15.1)；LIBERO单一40任务记忆达92.2%，抗改写退化优于SmolVLA；真实SO-101实现30Hz不掉帧。
AI.conclusion: 演示记忆的价值在于提供平滑的软回忆基底而非单一最近块，纠错器的收益来源于此。HAVM以极小参数量与极低训练/推理成本，在有限演示条件下超越大模型基线，其定位是以快速适配换取广域分布外泛化能力。

title: ExtractBench Pro: The Long Tail of Document Extraction
summary: We present ExtractBench Pro, a schema-guided document extraction benchmark that tests six challenging modes of extraction underrepresented in existing datasets. It is created following a framework for synthetic document generation, in which deterministic document generators assemble challenging components into documents that are designed to be difficult at a level calibrated for frontier systems. We synthesize 100 realistic documents spanning a diverse range of styles. On this data, we evaluate ten coding agents and eight extraction API configurations for accuracy, grounding, and their ability to perfectly extract documents. No extraction system extracts more than 61% of documents error-free. The strongest general-purpose coding agents, Claude Code Opus 5.5 and Codex GPT-6 Astra, outperform specialized extraction APIs on both perfect-document rate and Value F1, but at a higher cost per page. Among specialized extraction APIs, LlamaExtract spans the lower-cost frontier, with Agentic Plus Max Effort approaching the strongest coding agent on both perfect-document rate and Value F1 at lower cost per page. Our analysis of coding agent traces identifies intelligent image processing and programmatic reasoning, but also failures in applying document-specific definitions and recovering relationships from diagrams. We release ExtractBench Pro and these evaluation results as resources for the future development of improved frontier extraction systems.

AI.tldr: 提出 schema 引导的文档抽取基准 ExtractBench Pro，覆盖六类现有数据集少见的抽取模式，用确定性生成框架合成 100 篇风格多样的困难文档，评测 10 个编程智能体与 8 种抽取 API；无系统整篇零错误率超 61%，最强通用编程智能体在完美文档率与 Value F1 上优于专用抽取 API 但单页成本更高。
AI.motivation: 现有抽取数据集对若干高难度抽取模式覆盖不足，缺少能校准到前沿系统能力上限、并同时衡量准确率、grounding 与整篇完美抽取率的评测资源，因此需要构建更具挑战性的 schema 引导基准。
AI.method: 遵循合成文档生成框架，由确定性生成器将困难组件组装成难度经校准的文档，合成 100 篇风格多样的逼真文档；在该数据上评测 10 个编程智能体与 8 种抽取 API 配置，指标包括准确率、grounding 与整篇零错误抽取率（完美文档率、Value F1），并分析编程智能体的执行轨迹。
AI.result: 没有任何抽取系统能对超过 61% 的文档实现零错误抽取；最强通用编程智能体 Claude Code Opus 5.5 与 Codex GPT-6 Astra 在完美文档率与 Value F1 上均超过专用抽取 API，但单页成本更高；专用 API 中 LlamaExtract 处于低成本前沿，Agentic Plus Max Effort 以更低单页成本接近最强编程智能体的表现。轨迹分析显示其擅长智能图像处理与程序化推理，但在应用文档特定定义、从图表中恢复关系方面存在失败。
AI.conclusion: ExtractBench Pro 揭示了前沿抽取系统在高难度 schema 引导抽取上的显著差距，通用编程智能体与专用 API 存在性能—成本权衡；基准与评测结果将公开，用于推动更强前沿抽取系统的发展。

title: Streaming Tax: Can Streaming VLMs Replace Their Offline Parents?
summary: Most vision-language models (VLMs) specialize in offline video understanding; in contrast, their post-trained versions, streaming VLMs, can perform live interactions. We investigate whether streaming VLMs can replace their offline parent models on offline tasks. Such replacement could reduce deployment costs and improve efficiency. We propose Streaming Tax to systematically evaluate streaming VLMs on offline tasks. Our exploration spans three core dimensions: understanding, trustworthiness, and generalization across 15 benchmarks. Our findings reveal a critical gap between offline capability preservation and practical replaceability. This gap emerges at two stages: streaming adaptation can alter trustworthy behavior even when offline understanding is largely preserved, while the native streaming protocol can introduce further performance losses. Our analyses show that some of these losses arise from restricted access to historical visual evidence and failures to deliver usable responses. Importantly, regarding safety, streaming models often leave both harmful and legitimate requests unanswered rather than genuinely refusing unsafe ones. We then propose Stream++, a training-free plugin to improve streaming VLMs on offline tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Streaming Tax 评测框架，系统量化流式 VLM 相对离线父模型在离线任务上的能力损失，并揭示损失源于流式适配与原生流式协议两个阶段；作者进而提出免训练插件 Stream++ 以缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 流式 VLM 具备实时交互能力且部署成本更低，若能替代离线父模型处理离线任务可显著提升效率；但此前缺乏对"流式模型能否真正替代离线模型"的系统性评估，离线能力保留与实际可替代性之间的关系尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出 Streaming Tax 评测体系，围绕理解、可信性、泛化性三个核心维度，覆盖 15 个基准对两代模型（离线父模型 vs 流式版本）进行对比。分析损失来源：历史视觉证据访问受限、响应可用性失败；并提出免训练插件 Stream++ 用于改进流式 VLM 的离线任务表现。
AI.result: 发现离线能力保留与实际可替代性之间存在关键鸿沟，且呈现两阶段特征：流式适配在理解能力基本保持时仍会改变可信行为；原生流式协议进一步带来性能损失。安全方面，流式模型对有害与合法请求常一并"不回应"，而非真正的安全拒答。
AI.conclusion: 流式 VLM 目前尚不能直接替代离线父模型；需区分"能力保留"与"可替代性"两个概念，并从流式适配与流式协议两层面分别改进。Stream++ 作为免训练插件提供了可行的低成本改进路径。

title: Amortizing Exact Orthogonality: Drift-Triggered Restoration for Orthogonal Fine-Tuning
summary: Orthogonal finetuning (OFT) adapts a pretrained weight by an orthogonal transform and preserves its singular values and row angles, but existing methods construct an exact or approximate orthogonal transform at every optimization step. We measure how far a transform $A$ is from orthogonal by its orthogonality defect $\|A^\top A-I\|_2$. For OFTv2, which truncates a Cayley-Neumann series, we show that the truncation order does not determine the defect. At its default order, block defects in checkpoints from the reference implementation span five orders of magnitude. We propose Restarted Tangent Orthogonal Finetuning (RTOFT), which uses the first-order update $W(I+S)$ of a weight $W$ with a skew-symmetric $S$ and restores exact orthogonality by a polar decomposition only when the drift $\|S\|_2$ reaches a tolerance $τ$. The defect of $I+S$ is exactly $\|S\|_2^2$. Therefore, reading the drift after every update and restoring before the next forward pass guarantees a defect of at most $τ^2$ in every forward pass, independently of the loss, data, model, and optimizer. A final restoration makes the returned transform exactly orthogonal. On GLUE, RTOFT reduces the training time of block-diagonal, subspace, and butterfly parameterizations from $1.10$-$1.58\times$ to $0.97$-$1.13\times$ that of LoRA, and its block-diagonal version exceeds LoRA by $1.98\pm0.39$ points on the six-task average over five seeds. At $τ=0.10$, the largest drift read during training stays between $0.10$ and $0.12$ across DeBERTaV3, Qwen, and diffusion models, whereas it ranges from $0.17$ to $1.65$ when restoring once per epoch. In all seven settings of our ablation, the tangent update is worse without restoration than with it, and restoring after every step yields no measurable accuracy gain over restoring at the tolerance and costs $4.5$-$27.5\%$ more per step.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出OFTv2的截断阶数并不能控制正交性缺陷，提出RTOFT：使用一阶切向更新W(I+S)（S反对称），并仅在漂移‖S‖₂达到容差τ时通过极分解恢复精确正交性，从而把每次前向的缺陷上界严格控制在τ²，同时降低训练开销并提升精度。
AI.motivation: 现有正交微调（OFT）在每个优化步骤都构造精确或近似的正交变换，计算代价高；而OFTv2通过截断Cayley-Neumann级数来近似正交变换，作者发现截断阶数与正交性缺陷并无确定关系——在默认阶数下，参考实现检查点中的块缺陷跨越五个数量级。这说明"每步精确/近似正交化"既昂贵又缺乏可控性，因此需要一种能显式控制缺陷且开销更低的方案。
AI.method: 以正交性缺陷‖AᵀA−I‖₂衡量变换偏离正交的程度。RTOFT对权重W采用一阶切向更新W(I+S)，其中S为反对称矩阵，此时I+S的缺陷恰为‖S‖₂²。算法在每次更新后读取漂移‖S‖₂，仅当漂移达到容差τ时才用极分解恢复精确正交性，并在训练结束时做一次最终恢复，使返回的变换严格正交；因此每次前向的缺陷上界为τ²，且与损失、数据、模型和优化器无关。方法可推广到块对角、子空间和butterfly参数化。
AI.result: 在GLUE上，RTOFT将块对角、子空间与butterfly参数化的训练时间从LoRA的1.10–1.58倍降至0.97–1.13倍；块对角版本在六任务平均上以五个随机种子优于LoRA 1.98±0.39分。τ=0.10时，DeBERTaV3、Qwen与扩散模型训练中读取的最大漂移稳定在0.10–0.12之间，而每epoch仅恢复一次时为0.17–1.65。消融的七个设置中，无恢复的切向更新均劣于带恢复版本；每步恢复相比按容差恢复没有可测量的精度提升，却使每步开销增加4.5–27.5%。
AI.conclusion: 正交性缺陷应由漂移‖S‖₂显式控制，而非依赖级数截断阶数。RTOFT以"按容差触发的极分解恢复"替代每步精确正交化，在理论上保证每次前向缺陷≤τ²且与训练要素无关，在实验中同时获得更低训练开销与更优精度，说明惰性、容差驱动的正交恢复是正交微调更高效且更可控的设计范式。

title: Ask to Land: Learning a Mask-Conditioned Open-Vocabulary Landing Policy via Differentiable Physics
summary: Existing drone landing systems, whether model-based or learning-based, typically rely on predefined visual markers (e.g., ArUco tags) or are trained for specific platform categories, and often assume structured target motion. Recent open-vocabulary studies enable text-prompted target selection, but integrating this capability with learned closed-loop landing control remains underexplored. To this end, we present \textit{Ask to Land}, a mask-conditioned framework that enables a quadrotor to land on various platforms described by a user in natural language, including randomly moving platforms. The core of our approach is the integration of a frozen state-of-the-art open-vocabulary perception frontend (YOLO-World with MobileSAM) and a control policy learned by differentiable physics. By providing real-time, task-agnostic semantic segmentation masks as policy inputs, our framework enables the drone to land on prompt-selected targets without target-specific fine-tuning while continuously tracking dynamic target motion during descent. The frozen frontend processes the prompt, while the policy receives the mask without text embeddings or category labels. To efficiently optimize the control policy, we leverage differentiable physics learning via Backpropagation-Through-Time (BPTT), and employ a carefully designed reward that enforces visual alignment with the landing target and altitude-adaptive descent speed, together with stable control. Real-world deployments validate that our approach achieves landings on diverse user-specified objects, including static and moving platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出"Ask to Land"：将冻结的开词汇感知前端（YOLO-World + MobileSAM）与可微物理学习的掩码条件控制策略结合，使四旋翼能够凭自然语言提示降落于任意静态或随机运动平台，无需目标特定微调。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机降落系统多依赖预定义视觉标记（如ArUco）或针对特定平台类别训练，且通常假设目标运动结构化；虽有开词汇研究支持文本提示选择目标，但将其与学习式闭环降落控制结合仍研究不足。
AI.method: 提出掩码条件框架：冻结的SOTA开词汇感知前端（YOLO-World + MobileSAM）实时输出任务无关的语义分割掩码作为策略输入；策略不接收文本嵌入或类别标签，仅以掩码为条件；利用可微物理学习、通过时间反向传播（BPTT）高效优化控制策略，并设计奖励函数，联合约束与降落目标的视觉对齐、高度自适应下降速度与稳定控制。
AI.result: 真实世界部署验证表明，该方法可对多样化的用户指定物体实现降落，包括静态平台与运动平台，并在下降过程中持续跟踪动态目标运动。
AI.conclusion: 将开词汇感知与可微物理学习的掩码条件策略解耦组合，可在无需目标特定微调的情况下实现文本提示驱动的通用无人机降落，为语言引导的闭环降落控制提供可行范式。

title: Keep or Roll Back? Out-of-Loop Judges for Self-Improving VLA and End-to-End Embodied Policies
summary: Self-improvement is now a practical recipe for embodied policies: a policy collects experience, is retrained, and is kept when a judge rates it higher. However, the judge is usually trained or chosen inside the same loop, so its evidence is not independent of the policy. We introduce SealedLoop, an evaluation framework that adds a sealed judge: an evaluator outside the loop that the improver cannot see or optimize against. A new policy is kept only when a sequential test on the sealed judge confirms the gain, with a bounded probability of keeping a worse one. Running the same loop under each judge, we separate two sources of a false gain, which we call judge error (the loop's judge is wrong on its own data) and transfer gap (a real gain there does not carry over to unseen conditions). We evaluate on LIBERO manipulation, NAVSIM driving, and a full-scale real vehicle. In manipulation, a success classifier accepted 65 of 196 failures in one generation. In driving, policies that gain on the loop's own frames lose in an unseen city, so even an exact in-loop judge would keep 8/15 of them. When the sealed test decides, a driving loop built to improve ends with a better policy than under its own critic (0.674 against 0.649 PDMS, from 0.638), and on driving pairs with known sealed gain the test accepted 11 of 12 real gains and none of 59 losses. In a real-world field experiment on a published improvement step, the reinforced version drove further into a curve than the version it started from in all 6 blind pairs, though neither completed it. These results show that evidence from inside the loop, however accurate, is not enough to decide whether a policy has improved. SealedLoop offers a foundation for trustworthy self-improvement of embodied policies, in which progress is judged by evidence the improving system cannot influence.

AI.tldr: 提出 SealedLoop 评估框架，用"循环外、改进者不可见"的密封评测器配合序贯检验来判定自改进策略是否真正提升，并在 LIBERO 操作、NAVSIM 驾驶与真实车辆实验中将虚假增益拆解为"评审误差"与"迁移差距"两类来源。
AI.motivation: 具身策略的自改进依赖"评审器给分更高就保留"的循环，但评审器通常在循环内训练或选择，其证据与策略不独立，导致把噪声或错误当成真实提升。作者需要区分并量化这种虚假增益的来源，并给出不依赖循环内证据的判定方法。
AI.method: 提出 SealedLoop：引入密封评审器（循环外、改进者无法看到或针对其优化），新策略只有在密封评审器上的序贯检验确认增益时才被保留，并带有"保留更差策略"的有界概率。在同一循环下分别使用循环内评审器与密封评审器对照，把虚假增益分解为 judge error（评审器在自身数据上判断错误）与 transfer gap（局部真实增益无法迁移到未见条件）。在 LIBERO 操作、NAVSIM 驾驶及全尺度真实车辆上验证。
AI.result: 操作任务中，成功分类器在一代内把 196 个失败中的 65 个判为成功；驾驶任务中，在循环自身帧上增益的策略在未见城市失效，即使评审器完全准确也会保留 8/15 个；由密封检验裁决时，驾驶自改进循环得到优于自身评审器的策略（PDMS 0.674 vs 0.649，起点 0.638）；在已知密封增益的驾驶配对上，检验接受 12 个真实增益中的 11 个，且未接受 59 个损失中的任何一个；真实车辆盲测中，强化版本在全部 6 对盲配对里比初始版本驶入弯道更远（两者均未完成）。
AI.conclusion: 来自循环内部的证据无论多准确，都不足以判定策略是否真正改进；可信的具身自改进必须以改进系统无法影响的独立证据为准，SealedLoop 为此提供了评估基础。

title: Memory as the Backbone: A Dual-Store Associative Memory Architecture for Visual Recognition
summary: We investigate whether explicit memory can serve as the organizing principle of a general-purpose visual backbone. Inspired by the interaction between working and long-term memory in human cognition, we introduce DuSAM (Dual-Store Associative Memory), a hierarchical memory-native visual backbone coupling image-local working memory (WM) with a fixed-capacity persistent semantic memory (PM). WM organizes local visual evidence into compact, spatially anchored states that are updated and transported across stages, then read back to refine dense features. PM consolidates semantic evidence from training images and annotated regions into prototypes, whose retrieved content enriches the same working states. With these memory operations in place of self-attention or state-space blocks, DuSAM achieves competitive performance relative to representative, similarly sized backbones on ImageNet-1K classification, ADE20K semantic segmentation, and COCO object detection and instance segmentation. Ablations show contributions from both stores, with PM particularly benefiting class groups with fewer annotated training pixels. At $2048\times2048$, the complete DuSAM-based UPerNet segmentor achieves $2.36\times$ the throughput of the evaluated DeiT-S/16 counterpart while using $59.5\%$ less GPU memory, and $1.24\times$ the throughput of the linear-complexity VMamba-T. Memory analyses reveal spatially selective WM access and semantic associations between retrieved prototypes and training regions. Class-targeted removal and restoration further demonstrate that category-specific experience can be replenished through state updates without changing network parameters. These results establish explicit memory as a viable organizing principle for visual backbones and provide a foundation for jointly designing contextual computation and addressable semantic memory.

AI.tldr: 提出DuSAM——一种"双存储联想记忆"视觉主干网络，用图像局部工作记忆(WP)与固定容量持久语义记忆(PM)的显式记忆操作替代自注意力/状态空间模块，在分类、分割、检测等任务上与同规模代表性主干性能相当，并在高分辨率下显著提升吞吐、降低显存。
AI.motivation: 探索"显式记忆"能否作为通用视觉骨干的组织原则。受人类认知中工作记忆与长时记忆交互机制启发，希望在网络结构中直接引入可寻址的记忆系统，而非依赖自注意力或状态空间等隐式上下文计算。
AI.method: DuSAM由两类记忆构成：(1) 工作记忆(WM)，将局部视觉证据组织成紧凑、空间锚定的状态，在各级阶段间更新与传递，并可回读以精炼稠密特征；(2) 持久语义记忆(PM)，固定容量，将训练图像与标注区域的语义证据固化为原型(prototypes)，检索到的内容用于增强同一工作状态。整个网络中以此类记忆操作替代自注意力或状态空间块，并用UPerNet等解码器完成下游任务。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K分类、ADE20K语义分割、COCO检测与实例分割上与同规模代表性主干性能相当。消融显示两类存储均有贡献，PM尤其有利于标注像素较少的类别。2048×2048分辨率下，完整DuSAM+UPerNet分割器吞吐为DeiT-S/16的2.36倍且显存少59.5%，为线性复杂度VMamba-T的1.24倍。记忆分析揭示WM访问具有空间选择性，检索原型与训练区域存在语义关联；类别定向移除与恢复实验表明类别特定经验可通过状态更新补充，无需改变网络参数。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了显式记忆作为视觉主干可行组织原则的地位，为上下文计算与可寻址语义记忆的联合设计提供了基础。

title: State Space Attention: Learning Context-Dependent Memory Retention
summary: Standard attention's key-value cache grows linearly with context length. Bounding it raises the question of what a sequence model should retain for long-context reasoning. We argue this choice should be learned, and introduce State Space Attention (SSA), which learns to keep a bounded set of past representations and reads them with standard attention. A learned scorer rescores every chunk against newly arriving context and the rest of memory. A fixed-context Transformer is then the special case that always keeps the most recent tokens. We train the scorer and reader jointly, either moving gradually from a differentiable soft weighting of memories to hard retention, or with hard retention from the start. To produce signal for the scorer, we generate supervised samples during training, a technique we call recovery. We compare SSA with recurrent models, bounded-memory attention methods, and full-attention Transformers across retrieval, variable tracking, multi-hop reasoning, and language modeling. On our retrieval and reasoning benchmarks, SSA matches or comes within a few points of full attention on most tasks, far outperforms a Transformer with the same readable budget on every long-context retrieval task we evaluate, and matches or outperforms one with about 4 times that budget, while using constant inference memory. The largest remaining gap to full attention at small language model scale is on RULER. SSA makes a fixed number of tokens useful over a longer context, and since it reads memory with standard attention, we propose that it can be stacked with KV cache eviction methods. We also pretrain and post-train 400M-parameter models and measure how SSA's training and inference costs scale with context length and model size. Together, these experiments examine the capabilities and limitations of learned memory retention for long-context sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出 State Space Attention (SSA)，用可学习的打分器决定保留哪些历史表示，并以标准注意力读取有界记忆库，从而在恒定推理内存下逼近全注意力性能。
AI.motivation: 标准注意力的 KV cache 随上下文长度线性增长，而有界缓存又引出"序列模型在长上下文推理中应保留什么"的问题。作者主张这一保留策略应当被学习，而非依赖"只保留最近 token"这类固定规则。
AI.method: SSA 学习维护一个有界的过去表示集合，用标准注意力从中读取。(1) 可学习打分器对每个 chunk 结合新到上下文与其余记忆重新打分；(2) 固定上下文 Transformer 被视为"永远保留最近 token"的特例；(3) 打分器与读取器联合训练，可从可微软加权渐进过渡到硬保留，或从一开始即硬保留；(4) 训练时生成监督样本为打分器提供信号，称为 recovery 技术。
AI.result: 在检索、变量跟踪、多跳推理与语言建模上与循环模型、有界记忆注意力方法及全注意力 Transformer 对比：多数任务上 SSA 匹配全注意力或仅差几个点；在每个长上下文检索任务上显著优于同等可读预算的 Transformer，并匹配或超过约 4 倍预算的 Transformer，同时推理内存恒定；小规模语言模型下与全注意力最大差距出现在 RULER。另预训练与后训练了 400M 参数模型，测量训练/推理成本随上下文长度与模型规模的变化。
AI.conclusion: SSA 使固定数量的 token 在更长上下文中保持有用，并因采用标准注意力读取记忆而可与 KV cache 驱逐方法叠加；实验整体刻画了学习式记忆保留在长上下文序列建模中的能力与局限。

title: WISER-RL: A Wake-Sleep Learning Mechanism for Robot Reinforcement Learning from One Demonstration
summary: A robot learning from one human demonstration may rarely succeed on its own, leaving reinforcement learning (RL) with little reward feedback. We introduce WISER-RL ({W}ake--sleep policy improvement loop, {I}mitation, and {S}elective {E}xperience {R}eplay), a composite reinforcement learning framework that turns assisted practice into autonomous control. During wake, GPTDAgger monitors disagreement among actions sampled by a diffusion policy. When disagreement crosses a threshold, a frozen GPT controller uses retrieved experience to continue the episode. During sleep, Conflict-Aware Experience Reweighting (CAER) compares visually matched successful trajectories and downweights conflicting action windows with more steps remaining to success. The policy imitates the reweighted successes and learns from both successes and failures through offline advantage-guided RL before collecting the next round. After final online PPO refinement, the autonomous policy succeeded in 100% evaluations on each of six LIBERO tasks and 100% trials on each of two real-robot tasks.

AI.tldr: WISER-RL是一个"醒—睡"式复合强化学习框架：清醒期用GPTDAgger在扩散策略动作分歧超阈值时由冻结GPT控制器接管续跑，睡眠期用冲突感知经验重加权(CAER)降权剩余步数更多的冲突动作窗口，再结合模仿与离线优势引导RL训练，最终在线PPO微调。六个LIBERO任务与两个真机任务均达100%成功率。
AI.motivation: 单次人类示范训练的机器人策略难以独立成功，导致强化学习几乎得不到有效奖励反馈，缺乏可用的探索与经验来源。
AI.method: 提出WISER-RL（Wake–sleep策略改进循环、模仿与选择性经验回放）。清醒阶段：GPTDAgger监测扩散策略采样动作间的不一致性，超过阈值时由冻结的GPT控制器基于检索经验接管回合；睡眠阶段：CAER将视觉匹配的成功轨迹与冲突轨迹对比，对剩余到达成功步数更多的冲突动作窗口降权；策略模仿重加权后的成功样本，并通过离线优势引导RL同时利用成功与失败数据，再进行下一轮采集；最后用在线PPO精炼。
AI.result: 经最终在线PPO精炼后，自主策略在六个LIBERO任务上评估成功率均为100%，并在两个真机任务上试验成功率均为100%。
AI.conclusion: 将辅助式练习转化为自主控制的"醒—睡"闭环结合选择性经验重加权，可有效解决单示范下奖励稀疏与数据冲突问题，实现仿真与真机的高成功率自主操作。

title: Ensuring Deployment-Time Safety of Neural Network Controlled Systems via Localized Certificate Repair
summary: Barrier certificates provide formal safety guarantees for neural network controlled systems by ensuring that system trajectories avoid unsafe regions over time. However, after deployment, previously unseen obstacles or constraint changes may introduce new unsafe regions, invalidating the original certificate and potentially leading to unsafe behavior. We address this setting with adaptive piecewise barrier certificates, which preserve the original certificate and policy in unchanged regions while introducing localized updates around newly emerged unsafe regions. The central question is how to perform such updates efficiently during system execution without retraining from scratch. Our key idea is to cast deployment-time adaptation as a localized certificate repair problem and reduce it to an optimization task that leverages the learned structure of previous barrier certificates, enabling fast updates without global retraining. We further design a staged repair framework that progressively transitions from localized repair to joint policy-certificate updates and, when necessary, localized retraining. Empirical results on four benchmarks with five new obstacles show that our method succeeds in all cases and completes within tens of seconds on average, whereas retraining from scratch fails in most cases. On instances where retraining succeeds, our method is 17.3$\times$ faster on average. It incurs only 16.2% performance degradation relative to the original policy.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应分段屏障证书，将部署时适应建模为局部证书修复优化问题，结合分级修复框架实现快速更新，无需全局重训练。
AI.motivation: 神经网络控制系统部署后可能出现未见障碍或约束变化，产生新的不安全区域，使原有屏障证书失效并导致不安全行为；而从零重训练耗时且常常失败。
AI.method: 将部署时适应转化为局部证书修复问题，并归约为利用已有屏障证书学习结构的优化任务；设计分级修复框架，依次从局部修复过渡到策略—证书联合更新，必要时进行局部重训练；未变化区域保留原证书与策略，仅在新出现的不安全区域附近做局部更新。
AI.result: 在四个基准、五个新障碍的实验中全部成功，平均数十秒内完成；从零重训练在多数情形下失败，在重训练成功的实例上本方法平均快17.3倍，相对原策略性能仅下降16.2%。
AI.conclusion: 自适应分段屏障证书能够在不全局重训练的前提下高效恢复形式化安全保证，兼顾更新速度与策略性能，为部署时安全适应提供可行方案。

title: EvOrderBench: When do sampled frames establish event order?
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are often asked which of two actions in a video happened first, given only a few sampled frames. Such frames can show that both actions occurred without showing which came first, so a reliable model should state an order only when the frames establish it. Forced-choice temporal benchmarks treat every input as answerable and reward lucky guesses, while answerability benchmarks do not separate frames that miss an action from frames that show both actions but not their order. We introduce EvOrderBench, a real-video benchmark of 579 event families. Each family fixes an episode and a question and varies only the frames: of two four-frame inputs, only one establishes the order, and two six-frame inputs extend the other one with either the frames that resolve the order or frames that do not. Every input is labeled for whether its frames establish each action and their order. Across sixteen open-weight configurations and three closed-source references, the best open models order nearly as accurately as the references when the frames establish the order, but withhold correctly on at most 83% of the inputs where they do not, against at least 90% for every reference; forced-choice accuracy cannot reveal this gap. Open models withhold mainly when the frames show neither action; once the frames show one or both, most of them commit to an order. Thinking narrows the gap, even when it is switched on within a single checkpoint, mainly by separating sufficient from insufficient evidence rather than by making models more cautious overall. Accurate ordering thus does not imply knowing when the frames fall short, and benchmarks should reward withholding alongside ordering.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EvOrderBench 真实视频基准（579 个事件族），通过固定同一 episode 与问题、只改变采样帧，检验模型能否仅在帧足以确立两个动作的先后时才给出顺序。实验显示开源模型在"可判定"输入上排序接近闭源参考，但在"不可判定"输入上的正确拒答率至多 83%，明显低于所有参考模型（≥90%），说明排序准确率无法反映证据充分性判断能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型常被要求在仅采样少量帧的视频中判断两个动作谁先发生，但帧可能同时展示两个动作却不展示其先后。强制二选一的时间基准把所有输入视为可回答，奖励运气猜测；而现有可回答性基准又未区分"漏掉某个动作"与"展示了两动作但未展示顺序"这两类不可判定情形。因此需要一个能严格隔离"顺序证据"变量的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 EvOrderBench：579 个事件族，每族固定 episode 与问题、仅变换输入帧。设计包括两组四帧输入（其中仅一组能确立顺序），以及两组六帧输入（在另一组基础上分别加入能/不能解决顺序的帧）。每条输入均标注其帧是否确立了每个动作及其顺序。评测 16 个开源权重配置与 3 个闭源参考模型，并考察思维链（thinking）开关的影响。
AI.result: 在可判定输入上，最佳开源模型排序准确率接近闭源参考；但在不可判定输入上的正确拒答率最高仅 83%，而所有参考模型均 ≥90%。强制选择准确率无法揭示这一差距。开源模型主要在"两个动作均未出现"时才拒答；一旦出现一个或两个动作，多数模型便强行给出顺序。开启 thinking 可缩小差距，且在同一 checkpoint 内切换即可生效，其作用主要在于区分证据充分与不充分，而非整体变得更谨慎。
AI.conclusion: 准确的顺序判断并不意味着模型知道帧何时证据不足；时序基准应同时奖励"正确拒答"与"正确排序"，而非仅以强制选择准确率衡量能力。

title: Pretraining for Forecasting in Relational Databases
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems: From Forecasting to World Modeling
summary: Real-world forecasting increasingly relies on asynchronous transaction logs in relational databases rather than uniformly sampled arrays. While relational deep learning (RDL) models can forecast from these complex histories, they are typically trained separately for each specific target and root entity type. We introduce Query-Conditioned Relational pretraining (QCRP), a self-supervised framework that enables a standard RDL backbone to act as a universal forecaster across a database. QCRP generates diverse forecasting objectives using a structured temporal query grammar and interleaves them through a shared conditional predictor. This produces a robust, frozen encoder reusable for downstream tasks via lightweight predictors or a zero-shot interface. Evaluated on large-scale RelBench databases, QCRP learns frozen representations that support competitive forecasting across tasks and entity types. Furthermore, a single unified QCRP model checkpoint is competitive with isolated, entity-specific specialists. We demonstrate promising results for reusing the learned representations from standard RDL backbones for forecasting tasks in relational databases.

AI.tldr: 提出Query-Conditioned Relational pretraining（QCRP），一种自监督框架，使标准RDL主干网络成为整个关系数据库的通用预测器，单一冻结编码器即可跨任务、跨实体类型竞争性预测。
AI.motivation: 现实预测任务的数据常以关系数据库中的异步事务日志形式存在，而非均匀采样数组。现有关系深度学习（RDL）模型需为每个特定预测目标和根实体类型单独训练，无法共享知识，成本高且泛化受限。
AI.method: QCRP利用结构化时序查询语法自动生成多样化预测目标，并通过共享的条件预测器（conditional predictor）交错训练，得到稳健的冻结编码器；下游任务可用轻量预测头微调，或通过零样本接口直接推理。
AI.result: 在RelBench大规模数据库上评估，QCRP学到的冻结表示在跨任务、跨实体类型预测中具竞争力；单个统一QCRP检查点与各实体特定专家模型性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 验证了复用标准RDL主干所学表示用于关系数据库预测任务的可行性，为关系数据库上的通用预训练预测提供了新范式。

title: End-to-End Image-Goal Navigation for Agile Quadrotors via Recurrent State Distillation
summary: Image-goal navigation asks a robot to reach the viewpoint of a target photograph without a map or goal pose. In three dimensions, this requires not only recognizing the goal but also estimating 3D displacement and generating continuous control actions to approach and settle at the target view. This is difficult because the same visual difference between current and goal image can require very different actions depending on the robot's velocity, yet monocular images alone reveal neither metric scale nor body motion. As a result, existing image-goal policies are limited to planar action spaces and rely on a state estimator for flight control. Policies that map directly from images to low-level control commands have been demonstrated for agile flight, but not toward goal images in unseen environments. We present the first image-goal navigation policy that directly commands thrust and angular rates for agile quadrotor flight in unseen 3D environments, without relying on state estimation (e.g., SLAM, VO, or SfM) or a separate velocity controller. We train a recurrent vision-based policy through a four-stage pipeline that combines geometric and motion supervision with privileged-teacher distillation and end-to-end reinforcement learning fine-tuning. On 1000 held-out flights in unseen environments, the policy achieves an 82.3% success rate with a mean terminal position error of 0.10m across successful flights. Deployed zero-shot on a real quadrotor, the policy reaches an 84% success rate over 25 trials in an unseen indoor environment.

AI.tldr: 提出首个直接输出推力与角速度指令的图像目标导航策略，在无地图、无状态估计条件下实现四旋翼在未知三维环境中的敏捷飞行。
AI.motivation: 图像目标导航需在三维空间中识别目标并估计位移、生成连续控制。同一视觉差异在不同速度下对应不同动作，而单目图像既无度量尺度也无本体运动信息，导致现有策略局限于平面动作空间且依赖状态估计（SLAM/VO/SfM）或速度控制器。
AI.method: 采用循环视觉策略，通过四阶段训练流水线：几何与运动监督、特权教师蒸馏、端到端强化学习微调，直接映射图像到推力与角速度指令。
AI.result: 在未知环境的1000次留出飞行中成功率82.3%，成功飞行平均终点位置误差0.10m；真实四旋翼零样本部署于未知室内环境，25次试验成功率84%。
AI.conclusion: 无需状态估计和独立速度控制器的端到端图像目标导航策略在仿真与实机上均可行，验证了直接低层控制用于目标图像导航的有效性。

title: Spectral Optimal Transport for Dynamics-Aware Sign Language Generation
summary: Sign language generation (SLG) translates spoken-language text into pose sequences that convey its meaning. Recently, flow-based models with optimal transport (OT) have become a strong SLG baseline by handling the one-to-many nature of text-to-sign. While classifier-free guidance (CFG) could be applied to further strengthen the semantic alignment theoretically, its training involves conditional and unconditional training, which may contradict the pose-space OT, thus reducing the generation quality. Under the condition dropout, one noise sample can be paired with target motions exhibiting incompatible motion dynamics, interfering with the semantic guidance when the text condition is present. To address this issue, we propose Spectral Optimal Transport (SOT), which augments the pose-space cost with a spectral feature distance, reweighting the coupling toward the temporal-frequency structure of the target motions, thereby improving the performance when using CFG. The quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出谱最优传输（SOT），在姿态空间代价中引入谱特征距离，改善使用无分类器引导（CFG）时的条件-无条件训练与姿态空间OT的冲突，提升手语生成质量。
AI.motivation: 基于流模型与最优传输（OT）的方法已成为手语生成（SLG）的强基线，能处理文本到手语的"一对多"映射。理论上CFG可进一步增强语义对齐，但其训练需同时进行条件与无条件训练，可能与姿态空间OT相矛盾，导致生成质量下降。具体而言，在条件丢弃（condition dropout）下，同一噪声样本会与运动动态不兼容的目标动作配对，从而在文本条件存在时干扰语义引导。
AI.method: 提出Spectral Optimal Transport（SOT）：在原有姿态空间代价基础上增加谱特征距离（spectral feature distance），使传输耦合（coupling）的重加权朝向目标动作的时频结构，从而在CFG下获得更合理的噪声—动作配对。
AI.result: 定量与定性实验均验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将谱域结构信息纳入OT代价，SOT缓解了CFG训练与姿态空间OT之间的冲突，提升了手语生成在使用CFG时的表现，为SLG中的条件引导提供了有效改进。

title: A 3D Simulator for Passive SPAD Imaging
summary: Passive single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) cameras provide short-exposure observations for low-light perception, but collecting task annotations for these sensors remains difficult, and annotated datasets are scarce. We present a 3D simulation pipeline that generates realistic photon detections together with camera-motion and semantic labels, enabling perception models to be trained on synthetic SPAD observations and applied directly to real-world data. The pipeline couples controllable scene geometry and motion with a sensor-informed observation model that accounts for photon shot noise, dark counts, and spatial crosstalk. We evaluate the pipeline through calibrated photon-count comparisons and zero-shot sim-to-real transfer across three downstream perception tasks. We show that classifiers trained only on synthetic SPAD data achieve high accuracy on real low-light recordings at illumination levels less than 2 lux, without real-data fine-tuning. Similarly, we apply models trained entirely on simulated camera sweeps to real-world camera-rotation estimation and achieve mean absolute rotation errors of less than 1 degree on real 20-degree and 30-degree sweeps at 0.5 and 5.0 lux, when deployed zero-shot. We additionally train semantic segmentation models on synthetic data with automatically generated dense labels and perform direct inference on real-world low-light recordings; the results further demonstrate the usefulness of synthetic dense supervision for real low-light perception. Our simulator thus provides a practical source of annotated training data for real SPAD perception.

AI.tldr: 提出一个3D SPAD仿真流水线，生成带相机运动与语义标注的真实感光子探测数据，实现低光感知任务的仿真到真实零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 被动式SPAD相机适合低光短曝光感知，但其任务标注采集困难、标注数据集稀缺，制约了监督学习式的感知模型训练。
AI.method: 构建3D仿真流水线：将可控的场景几何与运动与传感器观测模型耦合，建模光子散粒噪声、暗计数和空间串扰，同步输出稠密语义与相机运动标签；并做标定后的光子计数对比验证。
AI.result: 仅用合成数据训练的分类器在<2 lux真实低光录像上零样本达到高准确率；纯合成扫视训练的模型在0.5与5.0 lux的20°/30°真实旋转上平均绝对旋转误差<1°；合成稠密标注训练的语义分割模型可直接推理于真实低光数据。
AI.conclusion: 该仿真器可为真实SPAD感知提供实用的带标注训练数据源，支持零样本sim-to-real迁移与稠密监督。

title: The Danger of Double Precision: Working Precision as a Hidden Constraint in Gaussian Process Maximum Likelihood
summary: Gaussian process (GP) hyperparameters are routinely fitted by maximizing the marginal likelihood in IEEE double precision, although for smooth kernels and noiseless data the covariance matrix is often more ill conditioned than double precision can resolve. For a squared-exponential kernel on a design with a Bayesian-optimization cluster, refits over a range of significand widths, judged against a high-precision reference, show that the double-precision fit is a different model and that fits converge only once the width exceeds the base-2 logarithm of the covariance condition number, about 70 bits. Cholesky failure acts as an implicit conditioning constraint, caused mostly by rounding of the kernel entries; the constrained solution predicted from the working precision alone is within 20% of the best Powell fits at five of the six precisions from 40 to 64 bits, with a local expansion proved for the idealized problem. Across 43 kernels, designs and problem settings, including negative controls that double precision already resolves, the bits needed follow the log condition number at the reference optimum plus a tolerance-dependent offset, and at the loosest tolerance double precision suffices for the Matern 1.5 kernel but not for the squared-exponential kernel on clustered designs. Double-precision hyperparameters overstate the posterior standard deviation near the design cluster and, on a quadratic objective whose likelihood heads to the flat limit, stall closed-loop active learning. Promoting the whole likelihood to 80 significand bits recovers the reference accuracy on every fixed design tested, whereas a fixed jitter trades failures for a posterior bias.

AI.tldr: 浮点精度不足使GP超参数拟合实际得到不同模型：在聚类设计上需约70位有效位才能收敛，Cholesky失败可视为隐式条件数约束。
AI.motivation: GP超参数通常以双精度最大化边际似然，但对光滑核与无噪声数据，协方差矩阵的条件数已超出双精度可分辨范围，因此需要量化"究竟需要多少位精度"以及精度不足的后果。
AI.method: 以高精度解为参照，在不同有效位宽下重复拟合平方指数核（含贝叶斯优化聚类设计）；分析Cholesky失败作为隐式条件数约束（主要由核矩阵元素舍入造成），并从工作精度出发预测受约束解，对理想化问题给出局部展开证明；在43组核、设计与问题设置（含负对照）上检验所需位数与对数条件数的关系。
AI.result: 双精度拟合相当于另一个模型，位宽超过协方差条件数的以2为底对数（约70位）后才收敛；仅由精度预测的约束解在40–64位中六分之五情形与最优Powell拟合相差20%以内；所需位数≈参考最优处对数条件数+依赖容差的偏移；双精度会高估聚类附近后验标准差，并在趋于平坦似然的二次目标上使闭环主动学习停滞；将整个似然提升至80位可在所有测试固定设计上恢复参考精度。
AI.conclusion: GP超参数拟合精度需求由协方差对数条件数决定；双精度在光滑核与聚类设计下不足且会损害不确定度估计与主动学习；提升有效位宽优于固定抖动（后者以失败换后验偏差）。

title: xFORM: Accelerating Fixed-Lag LiDAR Odometry with Exact Factor Compression
summary: Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) sensors are increasingly popular for state estimation because of their precision, long range, and high measurement rate. Unfortunately, LiDAR Odometry (LO) systems incur substantial computational cost when processing large point clouds, particularly those that jointly refine a window of scan poses. While our prior LO work FORM is real-time, the costs of feature extraction, correspondence search, and the evaluation and linearization of residuals during pose optimization can introduce significant latency. This latency makes downstream tasks such as control and path planning difficult. To overcome this, we present xFORM, which accelerates the three stages of FORM. xFORM uses factor compression to reduce an optimization problem involving hundreds of thousands of feature matches to 34 scalar residuals per scan pair, while preserving the original objective and Gauss-Newton system in exact arithmetic. We integrate this optimizer into two variants: xFORM-CPU, which additionally parallelizes feature extraction on the CPU, and xFORM-GPU, which accelerates feature processing, correspondence search, and factor compression on the GPU. Across fifteen complete sequences from three datasets, xFORM-CPU and xFORM-GPU achieve overall speedups of 1.1-1.4$\times$ and 2.0-4.0$\times$ over FORM, respectively, with no numerically significant differences to the original implementation.

AI.tldr: xFORM通过因子压缩将每对扫描的数十万特征匹配压缩为34个标量残差，并分别在CPU（并行化特征提取）和GPU（加速特征处理、对应搜索与因子压缩）上实现，相比FORM在15条完整序列上分别加速1.1–1.4倍和2.0–4.0倍，且数值结果与原实现无显著差异。
AI.motivation: LiDAR里程计（LO）在处理大规模点云、尤其是联合优化窗口内多帧位姿时计算开销巨大。虽然先前的FORM已达到实时性，但特征提取、对应搜索以及位姿优化中残差的评估与线性化仍带来显著延迟，影响控制与路径规划等下游任务，因此需要进一步加速。
AI.method: 提出xFORM，加速FORM的三个阶段。核心是因子压缩（factor compression）：将涉及数十万特征匹配的优化问题压缩为每对扫描仅34个标量残差，同时在精确算术下保持原目标函数与Gauss-Newton系统不变。据此实现两个变体：xFORM-CPU在CPU上额外并行化特征提取；xFORM-GPU在GPU上加速特征处理、对应搜索与因子压缩。
AI.result: 在来自三个数据集的15条完整序列上，xFORM-CPU与xFORM-GPU相对FORM的总体加速分别为1.1–1.4倍与2.0–4.0倍，且与原始实现相比无数值上的显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 因子压缩可在不改变优化问题的前提下大幅削减残差规模，结合CPU并行与GPU加速能有效降低LO延迟；xFORM在保持FORM精度的同时实现显著加速，适用于对实时性要求更高的下游任务。

title: RadOncGym: An Agent-Based Framework for Radiotherapy Dose-Mimicking Optimization
summary: AI dose-prediction models generate patient-specific 3D dose distributions from patient anatomy, providing an important intermediate representation for automated radiotherapy planning. However, an AI-predicted dose must undergo downstream optimization to produce a physically constrained treatment plan, a process that requires balancing competing planning objectives. We present RadOncGym, an agent-based framework that enables an LLM agent to iteratively tune 12 planning-objective weights for dose-mimicking optimization. To reduce iterative evaluation cost, RadOncGym incorporates a surrogate verifier that provides rapid feedback while allowing the agent to decide when to request a full planning solve within a fixed solve budget. We evaluate RadOncGym on 60 OpenKBP head-and-neck patients, each paired with 10 predictions from OpenKBP-Opt dose-prediction sets, yielding 600 patient-prediction contexts per experimental configuration. Under RadOncGym's 16-turn setting with a three-solve budget, a GPT-5.6 Sol agent reduces mean clinical-criterion violation by 0.6131 Gy and improves DVH and dose scores by 0.5986 and 0.2204 Gy relative to leaving all 12 weights fixed at 1, outperforming all evaluated non-agent weight-tuning methods under the same solve budget. It remains competitive with the 16-solve variants of these methods while requiring 75.0-77.6% less normalized runtime. RadOncGym demonstrates the potential of LLM agents as optimization planners in downstream radiotherapy plan optimization and provides a public testbed for their systematic evaluation. Code and configurations are available at https://github.com/miaot-usc/RadOncGym.

AI.tldr: RadOncGym 是一个基于 LLM 智能体的框架，可在剂量模仿优化中迭代调节 12 个计划目标权重，并引入代理验证器以降低评估成本；在 600 个 OpenKBP 头颈患者-预测上下文上，它以仅 3 次求解预算超越所有非智能体调权方法，并与 16 次求解变体相当而运行时间减少约 75%–78%。
AI.motivation: AI 剂量预测模型输出的 3D 剂量分布必须经过下游优化才能转化为物理可行的治疗计划，而该过程需在多个相互竞争的计划目标之间权衡。传统权重调优依赖人工经验且迭代评估成本高，缺乏系统化、可复现的自动化方案。
AI.method: 构建 agent-based 框架 RadOncGym：LLM 智能体在固定求解预算下，通过交互迭代调节 12 个计划目标权重以驱动剂量模仿优化；引入 surrogate verifier 提供快速反馈，由智能体自主决定何时调用完整计划求解。实验设置：60 例 OpenKBP 头颈患者 × 每例 10 个 OpenKBP-Opt 剂量预测 = 600 个患者-预测上下文；基线为全部权重固定为 1，以及相同求解预算下的非智能体调权方法。
AI.result: 在 16 轮交互、3 次求解预算设置下，GPT-5.6 Sol 智能体相较固定权重基线将平均临床准则违反量降低 0.6131 Gy，DVH 分数与剂量分数分别改善 0.5986 Gy 和 0.2204 Gy；优于所有同预算的非智能体方法，并与这些方法的 16 次求解变体竞争力相当，同时归一化运行时间减少 75.0%–77.6%。
AI.conclusion: RadOncGym 证明了 LLM 智能体可作为下游放疗计划优化中的优化规划者，并提供了可公开获取的系统评测测试床（代码与配置见 https://github.com/miaot-usc/RadOncGym）。

title: Separating Environment and Sensor Shift from Acquisition Protocol in Physical Vision Benchmarks
summary: In real-world deployments, vision systems must operate under varying environmental conditions, such as illumination changes. Recent work has explored adaptive sensing strategies that select camera parameters according to the current environment and downstream task to improve task performance. Reliable physical benchmarks are therefore essential for evaluating such strategies. We study ImageNet-ES-Diverse, a physical benchmark that evaluates the adaptive exposure control strategy Lens by recapturing printed ImageNet images under varying illumination conditions. We construct four controlled acquisition pipelines that vary printed-image scale and camera zoom, and conduct a pilot study with directly captured physical objects. We find that the acquisition choices substantially change benchmark difficulty on all downstream baselines. Moreover, the average classification-accuracy advantage of Lens over auto exposure observed on the original benchmark does not persist in either our collected pipelines or real-object pilot study. Oracle exposure selection nevertheless retains substantial gains, indicating remaining potential for sensor control. These findings highlight acquisition protocol as an important factor in physical benchmark evaluation and motivate explicit protocol reporting and evaluation across multiple acquisition setups when assessing adaptive-sensing benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文审视物理基准 ImageNet-ES-Diverse 中自适应曝光策略 Lens 的有效性：更换采集流程与使用真实物体后，Lens 相对自动曝光的优势不再成立，说明采集协议显著影响基准结论。
AI.motivation: 实际部署中视觉系统需应对光照变化等环境条件，近期研究提出按环境与下游任务选择相机参数的自适应感知策略，因此需要可靠的物理基准来评估这类策略。作者质疑现有基准（ImageNet-ES-Diverse）的采集协议是否会左右结论。
AI.method: 构建四条受控采集流水线，改变打印图像尺度与相机变焦，并补充以真实物理对象直接拍摄的预实验；在这些设置下比较 Lens（自适应曝光控制）与自动曝光等下游分类基线，并加入 oracle 曝光选择作为上界参照。
AI.result: 采集选择在所有下游基线上显著改变基准难度；Lens 相对自动曝光的平均分类精度优势在原基准之外的新流水线与真实物体预实验中均不复现；但 oracle 曝光选择仍保留可观增益，说明传感器控制仍有潜力。
AI.conclusion: 采集协议是物理基准评估的重要影响因素，评估自适应感知收益时应明确报告协议，并在多种采集设置下进行评价，而非依赖单一基准结论。

title: PRIOR: Pre-Call Reasoning in SFT and Its Influence on Tool-Use Retention under RL
summary: Tool use learned during supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is not always retained during reinforcement learning (RL). We study how properties of SFT data may affect this retention by constructing Low, Medium, and High SFT datasets with approximately matched token budgets but different tool-call depths. Under the same RL recipe, the three initializations reach similar RL training accuracy yet exhibit markedly different tool-use dynamics: tool initiation increases in Low, declines in Medium, and collapses in High. We observe that these datasets also differ substantially in the amount of reasoning preceding each tool call. In particular, High trajectories contain considerably less pre-call reasoning, motivating the hypothesis that pre-call reasoning may affect how well tool use is calibrated and, consequently, whether the corresponding behaviors are retained during RL. An idealized theoretical analysis provides a selective-retention view of this process: advantages in overall and tool-conditioned accuracy can be preserved under outcome-only optimization, while tool initiation increases only when tool-using trajectories are more successful than the tool-free alternative. Guided by this analysis, we rank the original High trajectories by average pre-call reasoning length and retain the highest-ranked examples while approximately matching cumulative SFT token exposure. This simple filtering strategy improves post-RL accuracy and tool-conditioned final-answer success without consistently increasing tool initiation across multiple benchmarks. These results suggest that pre-call reasoning is a useful dimension of SFT supervision for understanding and improving tool-use retention under downstream RL.

AI.tldr: SFT阶段学到的工具使用能力在下游RL中不一定能保留。作者构建了token预算匹配但工具调用深度不同的Low/Medium/High三组SFT数据，发现RL后工具发起行为分别上升、下降、崩溃，并将其归因于工具调用前推理量的差异；理论分析给出选择性保留视角，据此提出按"调用前推理长度"筛选High轨迹的简单策略，提升了RL后准确率而不再一味增加工具发起率。
AI.motivation: 监督微调（SFT）获得的工具使用能力在强化学习（RL）阶段常被丢失（工具发起率下降甚至崩溃），但原因不明。作者希望从SFT数据性质的角度解释并改善这种保留问题，尤其是考察"工具调用前推理"这一维度。
AI.method: (1) 构建Low、Medium、High三组SFT数据集，token预算近似匹配、工具调用深度不同；(2) 用同一RL配方从三组初始化训练，比较工具使用动态（发起率、准确率）；(3) 统计各数据集工具调用前推理长度差异，提出"调用前推理影响工具使用校准与保留"的假设；(4) 理想化理论分析，给出选择性保留视角；(5) 依据分析，按平均调用前推理长度对High轨迹排序，在近似匹配累计SFT token暴露的条件下保留排名最高的样本作为过滤策略。
AI.result: 三组初始化在RL训练准确率上相近，但工具发起动态差异显著：Low上升、Medium下降、High崩溃；High轨迹的调用前推理显著更少。理论分析表明：整体准确率与工具条件准确率的优势在仅基于结果（outcome-only）的优化下可被保留，而工具发起率只有在含工具轨迹比无工具替代更成功时才会上升。按调用前推理长度筛选取High轨迹后，在多个基准上提升了RL后准确率与工具条件最终答案成功率，且未持续推高工具发起率。
AI.conclusion: 工具调用前推理是SFT监督中一个有用且可操作的维度：它既有助于理解工具使用能力在RL中保留/丢失的机制，也可通过简单的数据筛选（优先保留高调用前推理样本）在固定token预算下改善下游RL后的准确率与工具条件成功率，而不必依赖增加工具发起频率。

title: CoTacWAM: Joint Modeling of Vision and Touch for Robotic Manipulation
summary: We present CoTacWAM, a world-action model that learns shared contact semantics between wrist vision and touch, achieving the best observed performance in our nominal manipulation and missing-input evaluations. The two modalities observe the same local interaction through different signals: wrist images reveal nearby geometry, while touch records physical contact. Our approach connects their common contact meaning while preserving the evidence unique to each modality, giving the policy a joint description of interaction across available input combinations. This representation supports predictive action learning alongside head-view scene context and conditions corrections after an independent detector confirms a failed attempt. Experiments across four real-world tasks demonstrate improved manipulation performance over the evaluated baselines, robustness to missing local observations, and further gains from autonomous retries.

AI.tldr: 提出 CoTacWAM 世界-动作模型，学习腕部视觉与触觉之间的共享接触语义，在真实操作任务与缺失输入场景中取得最佳表现。
AI.motivation: 腕部视觉与触觉是两种信号，但都反映同一局部交互过程；单独使用任一模态在遮挡或缺失输入时信息不足，需将二者统一到共同的"接触"语义上，同时保留各自独有的证据。
AI.method: 构建腕部图像与触觉的共享接触语义表示，联合利用模态共性并保留模态特有信息，形成跨输入组合的联合交互描述；该表示用于预测式动作学习，并结合头部视角场景上下文；当独立失败检测器确认失败后触发条件化修正（自主重试）。
AI.result: 在四项真实世界任务上，操作性能优于所评估基线；对局部观测缺失具有鲁棒性；自主重试带来进一步性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 共享接触语义的多模态世界-动作建模能有效融合腕部视觉与触觉，提升真实操作性能、缺失输入鲁棒性与失败恢复能力。

title: MetaDecomp: Adaptive Task Decomposition via Meta-Learned Procedural Memory
summary: Reusing past experience in long-horizon tasks requires more than storing successful procedures: Language agents must distinguish which procedures apply and what work remains as execution progresses. We introduce MetaDecomp, an in-context meta-learning framework for adaptive task decomposition that jointly learns a task-relative state space and reusable procedures. Its outer loop builds procedural memory from successful training executions, representing task progress as abstract states and procedures between states as directed acyclic graphs of operations and dependencies. As new progress distinctions are learned, MetaDecomp revisits historical execution evidence to reassess state assignments and reorganize the procedures they support. With memory fixed at test time, the inner loop refines an initial decomposition and revises it from environmental feedback, combining applicable procedure fragments with task-specific steps missing from memory. Evaluated on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld over three seeds, MetaDecomp achieves the highest mean performance among the compared methods in four of five settings, for example, an 86.3% success rate on ALFWorld with Qwen3-4B. Fixing the initial schema or omitting historical reprojection reduces performance in component ablations. MetaDecomp also uses fewer inference tokens than ReAct and AutoRefine in all five settings. Cross-benchmark analysis identifies a low-performance area where partial coverage degrades success relative to hidden memory; high coverage improves success, while low coverage changes little. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: MetaDecomp：面向长程任务的语言智能体上下文元学习框架，联合学习任务相对状态空间与可复用过程，实现自适应任务分解。
AI.motivation: 仅存储成功的执行过程不足以支持长程任务复用经验；语言智能体需在执行进程中判断哪些过程适用、还剩多少工作，因此需要显式刻画任务进度与可复用过程之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用上下文元学习双环结构：外环从成功训练执行中构建过程记忆，将任务进度表示为抽象状态，并把状态间的过程表示为操作与依赖的有向无环图；当学到新的进度区分时，回溯历史执行证据重新评估状态归属并重组相应过程。测试时记忆固定，内环基于环境反馈初始化并修正分解，将可用的过程片段与记忆缺失的任务特定步骤结合。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 与 ScienceWorld 上（三个随机种子），五个设置中有四个取得最高平均性能，如 ALFWorld + Qwen3-4B 成功率 86.3%；消融显示固定初始 schema 或去掉历史重投影均导致性能下降；五种设置下推理 token 均少于 ReAct 与 AutoRefine；跨基准分析发现部分覆盖会低于隐记忆区域表现、高覆盖提升成功率而低覆盖影响甚微。
AI.conclusion: 联合学习状态空间与过程记忆、并配合测试时反馈修正的元学习框架，可在提升长程任务成功率的同时降低推理开销；但过程记忆的覆盖程度是非单调影响性能的关键因素，需关注部分覆盖带来的退化风险。

title: ArtLang-4D: Articulation-Aware Dynamic Language Fields from Monocular Videos
summary: Language that describes an articulated object is often about its state: the drawer pulled out the furthest, the door opened halfway, push the drawer all the way in. Existing 3D language fields attach one feature to each point and cannot tell these descriptions apart, and 4D language fields condition on video time, which has no kinematic meaning and cannot be set by a user. We present ArtLang-4D, which reconstructs an articulated object from a single monocular RGB-D video and equips it with a dynamic language field indexed by articulation time t, the normalized state of its joints, instead of video time. The geometry is a canonical triangle field whose triangles follow typed screw joints, discovered from the video without any joint initialization. The language field is supervised by a t-tagged caption bank that describes each part with comparative state phrases in a whitened open-vocabulary text space. A free-form query is answered by maximizing part relevance jointly over parts and states, which returns both the part and the articulation state it describes; a command is then executed by moving only that part along its recovered joint. On the 100 objects of Articulate-100, ArtLang-4D recovers more accurate joints and part geometry than reconstruction and articulation baselines, retrieves the queried state far more reliably than a state-agnostic language field, and executes language commands with lower motion error.

AI.tldr: ArtLang-4D 从单目 RGB-D 视频重建铰接物体，并构建以「关节状态」而非视频时间索引的动态语言场，支持按部件与状态联合检索并执行语言指令。
AI.motivation: 描述铰接物体的语言多涉及状态（如抽屉拉出最远、门开一半），而现有点级 3D 语言场每点仅一个特征，无法区分状态；4D 语言场以视频时间条件化，时间无运动学含义且用户不可设定。
AI.method: 用规范三角面片场作为几何表示，三角面片沿从视频中无初始化发现的带类型螺旋关节运动；语言场以关节归一化状态 t 为索引，由带 t 标签的对比式状态短语描述字幕库监督，文本空间经白化处理并支持开放词表；查询通过在部件与状态上联合最大化相关性作答，同时返回部件与状态，指令则仅沿恢复的关节移动该部件。
AI.result: 在 Articulate-100 的 100 个物体上，关节与部件几何精度优于重建和铰接基线；状态检索可靠性显著高于状态无关语言场；语言指令执行的运动误差更低。
AI.conclusion: 以运动学状态而非视频时间索引语言场是可行且有效的，可在单一单目视频下统一重建、状态感知检索与指令执行。

title: Self-supervised Clipped-objective Reinforcement Leaning Framework for Risk-aware Portfolio Management
summary: Portfolio management involves balancing diverse financial assets, a critical yet challenging task in quantitative trading. Although deep reinforcement learning has emerged as an active research domain for solving complex sequential decision-making problems over the past decade, deploying reinforcement learning frameworks in non-stationary financial markets raises formidable difficulties. Most existing reinforcement learning-based portfolio management models fail to account for tick-level intraday market dynamics (e.g., order flow imbalances and liquidity fluctuations), which reflect rapid capital movements. Simultaneously, these models suffer from unstable learning processes due to reinforcement learning's inherent high variance. This paper presents a Self-supervised Clipped-objective Portfolio management framework (SCP), which addresses these limitations through a two-phase architecture. Market feature integration phase (application contribution) integrates micro-level market microstructure patterns with macro-level financial indicators to enhance sensitivity to intraday asset trend dynamics. Policy optimization Phase (AI contribution) employs intermediate asset state representations to derive optimal portfolio allocations via a self-supervised clipped-objective policy-learner, ensuring both effectiveness and computational efficiency. Extensive evaluations on three major index datasets from China's A-share market demonstrate that SCP's superior performance in balancing risk-return trade-offs compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Exploratory and ablation studies further validate the contributions of SCP's key components.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自监督裁剪目标投资组合管理框架SCP，通过"市场特征融合"与"策略优化"两阶段架构，融合微观市场结构特征与宏观金融指标，并利用自监督裁剪目标策略学习器输出最优资产配置；在三个A股指数数据集上优于SOTA基线。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习已用于投资组合管理，但在非平稳金融市场中部署面临两大困难：一是现有模型多忽略tick级日内市场动态（如订单流不平衡、流动性波动）所反映的资金快速流动；二是强化学习固有高方差导致训练过程不稳定。
AI.method: 提出两阶段架构SCP。阶段一"市场特征融合"：将微观市场结构模式与宏观金融指标相结合，提升对日内资产趋势动态的敏感度。阶段二"策略优化"：基于中间资产状态表示，通过自监督裁剪目标（clipped-objective，类PPO式）策略学习器推导最优投资组合权重，兼顾有效性与计算效率。
AI.result: 在中国A股市场三个主要指数数据集上进行广泛评估，SCP在风险-收益权衡上优于现有最优基线；探索性与消融实验进一步验证了各关键组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: SCP通过多尺度特征融合与稳定的裁剪目标策略优化，有效缓解了日内微观信息缺失与学习高方差问题，提升了非平稳市场下投资组合管理的表现与稳定性。

title: WAtcher: Watching Ahead for Safe Robotic Manipulation with Efficient World-Action Models
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://zyshan0929.github.io/WAtcher
summary: World-action models (WAMs) couple future imagination with action generation, but they execute every action chunk while ignoring the potential risk. To fill this gap, we present WAtcher, a safety-aware world-action framework in which the policy imagines the outcome of the candidate chunk before execution. For fast future preview, WAtcher builds on a compact WAM whose video expert imagines the visual outcome in only two denoising steps. In addition, we propose Safe-Guard, a lightweight module kept outside the WAM that scores each candidate chunk from its imagined outcome and triggers a bounded retreat when the risk is high. Safe-Guard is detachable and can be applied to other WAMs. To train Safe-Guard, we build an autonomous pipeline to collect hazard data from RoboTwin, LIBERO, and a real robot. Specifically, the pipeline perturbs expert demonstrations and labels each candidate chunk from the physical events recorded when it is executed, such as contacts and losses of support. Using the ~25,000 labeled windows from this pipeline, Safe-Guard reaches 92.1% balanced accuracy on a blind set, and cuts hazardous closed-loop trials on training tasks from 27.0% to 10.8% without lowering task success. On a held-out 300-question benchmark, it scores 94.2%, against 72.5% and 63.3% for zero-shot GPT-6-Astra and Claude Opus 5.5. WAtcher also reaches 90.4% and 82.4% average success on RoboTwin 2.0 and ManiSkill3, on par with or above leading WAMs, and 74.0% on five real-world tasks with Safe-Guard on, against 59.5% for $π_{0.5}$. Project page: https://zyshan0929.github.io/WAtcher

AI.tldr: 提出WAtcher安全感知世界-动作框架：执行动作片段前先"预演"其结果，并用轻量可插拔模块Safe-Guard对想象结果打分、高风险时触发有界退避。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型（WAMs）虽能耦合未来想象与动作生成，但会无条件执行每个动作片段而忽略潜在风险，缺少安全前置评估机制。
AI.method: 1) 基于紧凑WAM，视频专家仅用两步去噪即可快速想象候选片段的视觉结果；2) 提出Safe-Guard，置于WAM之外的轻量模块，对每个候选片段的想象结果打分，高风险时触发有界退避，且可拆卸、可迁移至其他WAM；3) 构建自主数据流水线，在RoboTwin、LIBERO与真实机器人上扰动专家演示，并依据执行时记录到的物理事件（接触、失去支撑等）为候选片段打标签，得到约25,000个标注窗口用于训练。
AI.result: Safe-Guard在盲测集上达到92.1%平衡准确率；训练任务闭环试验的危险率由27.0%降至10.8%且不降低任务成功率；在留出的300题基准上得94.2%，对比零样本GPT-6-Astra的72.5%与Claude Opus 5.5的63.3%；WAtcher在RoboTwin 2.0与ManiSkill3上平均成功率90.4%与82.4%，与领先WAM相当或更优；五个真实任务开启Safe-Guard后达74.0%，对比π_0.5的59.5%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在动作执行前引入基于想象结果的风险评估与有界退避，WAtcher以轻量、可插拔的方式显著提升WAM安全性，同时保持或提升任务成功率，并具备跨模型与真实场景的迁移能力。

title: Can Its Own Misses Teach an MLLM to Find Small Brain Metastases?
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are becoming general readers of medical images, yet they remain weak at locating small abnormalities. Brain metastases expose this gap: at 384 px a 0.1 mL lesion covers less than a quarter of one visual token, and at one false positive per scan frontier MLLMs find fewer than 30% of lesions of 0.1-1 mL. Fine-tuning on one dataset helps but transfers poorly, and improving it further is slow trial and error steered by a single score. We introduce LANTERN (Lesion-finding AgeNt Through Error-driven Recursive learNing), a framework in which an MLLM improves recursively from its own misses. LANTERN recasts model development as an error-driven loop: a failure census attributes every missed lesion to one of four causes, an LLM mentor revises one of four levels (evidence acquisition, visual representation, learning policy, decision aggregation) per round, and a rule frozen before the first round decides what is kept, without test data and with every tool call audited. Over 15 unattended rounds, LANTERN raises a fine-tuned 4B MLLM from finding 75% to 94% of lesions at one false positive per scan on BraTS-MET, and 91% of those of 0.1-1 mL, compared with at most 51% and 29% for five frontier MLLMs read under the starting protocol; the gains hold on an external cohort (89%) and on unseen meningiomas (77%). These results show that an MLLM's own misses, attributed to their causes, can drive its reliable recursive self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出LANTERN框架，让MLLM依据自身漏诊的错误进行递归式自我改进，在脑转移瘤检测中将小病灶召回率从75%提升至94%（约1 FP/扫描）。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态大模型在医学图像上定位微小异常的能力很弱：0.1 mL病灶在384 px下不足一个视觉token的四分之一，前沿MLLM在约1 FP/扫描下对0.1–1 mL病灶的检出率不足30%。单数据集微调迁移性差，且改进过程依赖单一指标的缓慢试错。
AI.method: LANTERN将模型开发重构为错误驱动的递归闭环：①失败普查（failure census）把每个漏检病灶归因于四类原因之一；②由LLM导师每轮修改四个层级之一（证据获取、视觉表征、学习策略、决策聚合）；③由首轮前冻结的规则决定保留与否；全程不使用测试数据，每次工具调用均可审计。共进行15轮无人值守迭代。
AI.result: 在BraTS-MET上，微调的4B MLLM在1 FP/扫描下检出率由75%升至94%，0.1–1 mL病灶达91%；五个前沿MLLM在初始协议下最高仅51%与29%。增益在外部队列（89%）和未见脑膜瘤（77%）上同样成立。
AI.conclusion: 将模型自身的漏诊归因到具体原因，可驱动MLLM可靠地实现递归自我改进，且具备跨数据集与跨病种的泛化性。

title: AVERT: Anomalous Value Erasure with Response Testing against Visual Prompt Injection
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are vulnerable to visual prompt injection, in which an adversarially perturbed image forces the model to respond with the attacker's chosen content, such as malicious tool calls, website links, or advertisements, sometimes regardless of the user's question. Existing defenses, such as diffusion-based purification and image-token masking, mitigate these attacks at a substantial cost to the model's utility on benign inputs. To address this challenge, we propose AVERT, which removes adversarial feature directions only when the model's answer depends on them. Our key procedures involve identifying anomalous value subspaces and detecting answer dependence. To identify the anomalous value subspace, we compare the statistics of each input's attention-head outputs with those of clean images and extract the directions along which the input deviates the most. We then project out these directions to remove the injected content. Because the same directions also carry benign visual information, we apply the removal only to answers that depend on them, namely answers whose likelihood collapses once the directions are removed or that are as likely under unrelated questions as under the user's question. Against white-box attacks on four VLMs (Qwen2-VL, Qwen2.5-VL, LLaVA, InternVL2.5) and four injection benchmarks, AVERT lowers average attack success from 86-90% to at most 0.6% while retaining at least 96% of undefended utility averaged over thirteen benchmarks. Its defense-utility F-score ($F_{DU}$), the harmonic mean of attacks stopped and utility retained, is 98.0-99.1 and the highest among all compared defenses on every model.

AI.tldr: 提出AVERT，一种仅在模型答案依赖对抗特征方向时才进行剔除的视觉提示注入防御方法，在白盒攻击下将攻击成功率从86-90%降至≤0.6%，同时保留≥96%的良性效用。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型易受视觉提示注入攻击，对抗扰动图像可迫使模型输出攻击者指定内容（恶意工具调用、链接、广告），甚至无视用户问题。现有防御（扩散净化、图像token掩码）在良性输入上效用损失过大，需在防御强度与模型效用间取得更好平衡。
AI.method: AVERT包含两个关键步骤：(1) 识别异常值子空间——将每个输入注意力头输出的统计量与干净图像比较，提取输入偏离最大的方向；(2) 检测答案依赖性——仅对依赖这些方向的答案执行投影剔除，判据为：剔除该方向后答案似然崩塌，或该答案在无关问题下的似然与在用户问题下相当。由于相同方向也承载良性视觉信息，故采取条件化剔除。
AI.result: 在4个VLM（Qwen2-VL、Qwen2.5-VL、LLaVA、InternVL2.5）与4个注入基准的白盒攻击下，平均攻击成功率由86-90%降至最高0.6%；在13个基准上平均保留至少96%的无防御效用；防御-效用F-score（F_DU）为98.0-99.1，在每个模型上均优于所有对比防御方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将对抗特征方向的移除限制在答案依赖该方向的条件下，AVERT实现了近乎完备的攻击阻断与极低效用损失的兼顾，验证了"条件化干预"思路在视觉提示注入防御中的有效性，并在多模型多基准上取得当前最优的防御-效用权衡。

title: Flipping the Coins: Training Physical Simulators through Hard Switches
summary: Hybrid simulators embed learnable components such as neural networks in physical solvers and train them on reference trajectories. Many scientific solvers feature hard switches, such as a tripping power line, an igniting grid cell, or depolarizing brain tissue, where the loss exhibits discrete jumps across switch flips, leaving standard automatic differentiation to capture only its smooth part. Existing training paradigms face a fundamentally challenging trade-off, as gradient-based relaxations smooth the switches and introduce bias across jumps, whereas derivative-free methods treat the solver as a black box and discard path gradients of the continuous dynamics. Here we introduce EventFlip, which flips a near-threshold switch from a stored state, replays the original solver, and measures the loss difference between the two runs, in effect a finite difference across the switch. By perturbing every threshold with small Gaussian noise, we cast each switch as a stochastic binary decision and derive an unbiased gradient estimator that combines the continuous path gradient with a jump term constructed from these counterfactual rollouts. EventFlip-Rand optimizes this noise-averaged objective, whereas EventFlip-Hard operates on the deterministic hard-switch simulator used at deployment and provably targets the complete discontinuous loss. Under an identical forward evaluation budget, we benchmark EventFlip against twelve baselines across a power-grid cascade, a detonation wave, and cortical spreading depolarization, achieving the lowest error on every task and reducing the strongest baseline's error by factors of 1.5, 1.4, and 1.4, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出EventFlip，通过"翻转近阈值开关+重放求解器"的有限差分与高斯噪声随机化，构造包含跳变项的无偏梯度估计器，在电力网连锁故障、爆轰波、皮层扩散性去极化三类硬开关混合仿真任务上取得最低误差。
AI.motivation: 混合仿真器将神经网络等可学习组件嵌入物理求解器并在参考轨迹上训练，但许多科学求解器含硬开关（跳闸、点火、去极化），损失在开关翻转处出现离散跳变。自动微分只捕获光滑部分；现有范式面临两难：基于梯度的松弛会平滑开关并引入跨跳变偏差，无导数方法把求解器当黑箱而丢弃连续动力学的路径梯度。
AI.method: EventFlip从存储状态翻转近阈值开关并重放原求解器，用两次运行的损失差实现跨开关的有限差分；通过对每个阈值施加小幅高斯噪声，将每个开关建模为随机二值决策，导出由连续路径梯度与反事实 rollout 构造的跳变项组合而成的无偏梯度估计器。变体EventFlip-Rand优化噪声平均目标；EventFlip-Hard在部署用的确定性硬开关仿真器上运行，可证明地针对完整不连续损失。
AI.result: 在相同前向评估预算下，与十二个基线方法在电力网级联、爆轰波与皮层扩散性去极化三个任务上对比，EventFlip在每项任务上误差最低，分别将最强基线误差降低约1.5、1.4、1.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过反事实重放把离散开关处的跳变纳入梯度估计，EventFlip统一了路径梯度与跳变梯度，兼顾无偏性与部署一致性，为含硬开关的科学混合仿真器提供了有效且通用的训练范式。

title: WorldPhy: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Physical Plausibility of World Models in Robotics
summary: World models are increasingly used in robotics to improve the performance of embodied models. Compared with general-purpose video generation, robotics places more stringent requirements on world models. Generated videos must satisfy fine-grained physical constraints on robot motion and object interactions. However, existing world model benchmarks can overlook robotics specific physical details and struggle to assess them accurately. To address this problem, we introduce WorldPhy, a world model benchmark for accurate, fine-grained evaluation of physical plausibility in robotics. Our benchmark contains 300 tasks, each consisting of an initial-frame image and a task instruction, covering diverse robotics scenes, task categories, viewpoints, and robot configurations. We further collect over 12K high-quality human annotations, and use them to train WorldPhyReward to accurately provide scores and reasons across six fine-grained physical dimensions and an instruction-following dimension. Comparisons with general VLMs and existing reward models show that WorldPhyReward better aligns with human ratings. We system- atically evaluate 13 frontier open and closed-source world models. The results reveal that current world models struggle to consistently maintain fine-grained physical plausibility across different robotics scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/chuziyuan139/ WorldPhy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WorldPhy——面向机器人世界模型的细粒度物理合理性评测基准，含300个任务与12K+人工标注，并训练奖励模型WorldPhyReward；系统评测13个前沿世界模型，发现其在细粒度物理合理性上普遍不足。
AI.motivation: 机器人场景对世界模型要求远高于通用视频生成：生成视频须满足机器人运动与物体交互的细粒度物理约束。然而现有世界模型基准常忽略机器人特有的物理细节，且难以准确评估这些细节。
AI.method: 构建WorldPhy基准：300个任务，每个含初始帧图像与任务指令，覆盖多样机器人场景、任务类别、视角与机器人构型；收集超12K高质量人工标注，训练奖励模型WorldPhyReward，在六个细粒度物理维度及一个指令遵循维度上给出评分与理由。
AI.result: 与通用VLM及现有奖励模型相比，WorldPhyReward与人类评分对齐更好；用其对13个开源/闭源前沿世界模型进行系统评测，结果显示当前世界模型难以在不同机器人场景中持续保持细粒度物理合理性。
AI.conclusion: 现有世界模型在机器人细粒度物理合理性上仍存在明显短板，WorldPhy为准确、可解释的评测提供了基准、标注数据与奖励模型。

title: FORK: Co-Evolving Safe Disclosure and Decision Skills Against Attackers Who Read Every Refusal
summary: When a guardrail rejects an LLM agent's action, its message reaches any attacker observing the trajectory: a fixed refusal leaves benign users unable to recover, whereas an explanation can tell the attacker what to try next. We study this as safe disclosure: explaining rejections so that authorized tasks recover without increasing adaptive attack success. Safe disclosure depends on both the decision and the message: what the guardrail blocks and what it reveals to the agent and the attacker. Because hand-written rules alone cannot anticipate how adaptive attackers probe decisions or use messages, we introduce FORK, which co-evolves a guardrail's natural-language decision and disclosure skills with an attacker that reads every public message. Each exploited message and permissive decision gives FORK evidence for a gradient-free revision of its natural-language skill library. We evaluate FORK on four benchmarks. Averaged over three agents on FORK-World, FORK cuts attack success rate (ASR) under adaptive attack from 78.4% to 14.1% and keeps utility above 85%, outperforming baselines on both ASR and utility. Notably, on MT-AgentRisk, whose environments and tasks are unseen in training, FORK lowers ASR from 70.6% to 9.1% with 93.1% benign utility.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"安全披露"(safe disclosure)问题：护栏拒绝LLM智能体动作时的说明既要让授权用户可恢复任务，又不能给攻击者提供试探线索；据此提出FORK，让护栏的自然语言决策技能与"读取全部公开消息的自适应攻击者"共同进化，在四个基准上将自适应攻击成功率从78.4%降至14.1%，同时保持85%以上的正常效用。
AI.motivation: 护栏的拒绝消息会进入轨迹，被观察轨迹的攻击者看到。固定式拒绝会让良性用户无法恢复任务；而过度解释又会泄露信息，指引攻击者下一步如何试探。因此需要在"可恢复性"与"不提升自适应攻击成功率"之间取得平衡，且仅靠人工规则难以预判自适应攻击者如何探测决策与利用消息。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为"安全披露"，同时涵盖决策与消息两个维度：护栏拦截什么、向智能体与攻击者披露什么。提出FORK方法，在无梯度的条件下，以"被攻击者利用的消息"和"过度放行的决策"作为反馈证据，迭代修订护栏的自然语言技能库（skill library），实现护栏决策/披露技能与一个能读取所有公开消息的自适应攻击者的协同进化。
AI.result: 在FORK-World上，对三个智能体取平均，自适应攻击下ASR由78.4%降至14.1%，效用保持85%以上，在ASR与效用上均优于基线；在训练中未见其环境与任务的MT-AgentRisk上，ASR由70.6%降至9.1%，良性效用达93.1%，显示出较好的泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 拒绝说明的措辞本身构成攻击面，护栏设计须将"决策"与"披露"联合优化；通过以攻击者反馈驱动的自然语言技能库共进化，可在不牺牲良性可用性的前提下显著降低自适应攻击成功率，并在未见过环境上保持有效。

title: Frame geometry, fascicle extrapolation and leaderboard overfitting in muscle ultrasound
comment: 38 pages (20 main text, 18 supplement), 13 figures, 21 tables. Code, trained weights, notebooks and derived data are public on Kaggle (user soheilkooklan) and in the ancillary files
summary: Automated readings of pennation angle, fascicle length and muscle thickness from B-mode ultrasound depend on the geometry of the stored frame and on how fascicles that leave the image are extended, and challenge entries add settings chosen on a small public leaderboard. This study measures all three in one entry of the UMUD Challenge, which scored 309 frames from six screen layouts, 103 on a public and 206 on a private leaderboard. The pipeline applies layout-specific values of scale and pixel aspect, resamples each frame to square pixels, segments aponeuroses and fascicle fragments with U-Nets and measures the three readings geometrically; the submitted entry blended its angle and length with public notebooks. Because the score is additive, 65 single-change contrasts from 13 base entries measured each decision on both splits. The primary selected entry scored 0.27608 on the private split, the 69th reported position of 690 teams. Reading every frame with square pixels cost 0.029 public and 0.037 private. Of 20 late-stage corrections, 9 kept the sign of their effect on the private split. An audit of the UMUD expert benchmark found that 26 of its 35 frames share their tissue with training images of both DL_Track_US and the challenge. On the 9 frames with no detected match in either set or orientation, the recipe scored 0.213, two experts against two others 0.218 and DL_Track_US 0.263 (0.209, 0.196 and 0.259 when both raters of a reference pair are required), with no difference established. Frame geometry and the extension rule moved readings as much as the choice of model, and small corrections tuned on about 100 public frames did not carry over.

AI.tldr: 该研究参加UMUD Challenge，用U-Net分割肌腱膜与肌束片段并结合几何测量，从B超图像自动提取羽状角、肌束长度与肌肉厚度；结果显示仅帧几何（方形像素重采样）与肌束延伸规则的影响即可比肩模型选择，而在约100张公开帧上调出的小修正无法迁移到私有榜。
AI.motivation: B型超声自动化测量羽状角、肌束长度和肌肉厚度高度依赖存储帧的几何属性以及离图肌束的延伸外推方式；同时参赛者往往只能依据规模很小的公开排行榜挑选超参数，缺乏对上述因素影响的系统量化。
AI.method: 在UMUD Challenge单一track上评测（309帧、6种屏幕布局；公开榜103帧、私有榜206帧）。流程：对每种布局施加特定的尺度与像素纵横比参数，将帧重采样为方形像素，用U-Net分割肌腱膜与肌束片段，再几何化计算三项指标；提交版本还将角度与长度与公开notebook结果做了融合。由于评分为加性，基于13个基线方案构造65个单变量对比，在公开与私有两个划分上分别量化每项决策的效应；另对UMUD专家基准做数据泄漏审计（与DL_Track_US及挑战训练图像的软组织匹配）。
AI.result: 入选方案私有榜得分0.27608，在690支队伍中列第69位。全部按方形像素读图分别损失公开榜0.029、私有榜0.037。20项后期修正中仅9项在私有榜上保持效应符号。专家基准35帧中有26帧的软组织与DL_Track_US及挑战训练图像均存在匹配；在9帧无匹配帧上，本方案得分0.213，专家两两对比为0.218，DL_Track_US为0.263（要求参考对两位标注者均有效时分别为0.209、0.196、0.259），差异未达统计学显著。
AI.conclusion: 帧几何处理与肌束延伸规则对读数的影响与模型选择相当，说明数据预处理决策是被低估的误差来源；在约100帧公开数据上调出的细微修正不具备跨划分泛化性，公开榜易导致过拟合；此外现有专家基准存在训练集软组织重叠，需谨慎解读基准比较。

title: Understanding Mode Collapse in Diffusion Models under Classifier-Free Guidance
summary: The use of classifier-free guidance in diffusion and flow models has proven critical to their empirical success, as it allows for the controllable generation of lower-temperature and higher-fidelity samples. Despite its widespread use, classifier-free guidance remains both empirically and theoretically poorly understood, owing to the difficulty of solving the associated transport equations for arbitrary normalizing flows. In this paper, we observe that the effects of classifier-free guidance arise from a mismatch between the representation capabilities of the conditional and unconditional distributions, wherein the conditional distribution exhibits higher complexity and fidelity. We propose an analytical model to capture this observation: the conditional distribution is a Gaussian mixture whose means lie on an ellipsoid, and the unconditional distribution is a single Gaussian approximating the mixture. The flows arising from this mixture are closed under scaling, enabling us to derive analytic closed-form solutions for the guided distribution at all noise scales and guidance levels. Our analytic solution shows that classifier-free guidance induces (a) a shift along a mean-axis direction and (b) a persistent skew toward, and concentration around, a singular point corresponding to the conditional sample starting from zero noise. We validate our theoretical predictions on pretrained, large-scale image diffusion models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个解析模型来解释无分类器引导（CFG）的作用机理：条件分布为均值位于椭球上的高斯混合，无条件分布为近似该混合的单一高斯，该混合诱导的流在缩放变换下封闭，从而可对任意噪声尺度与引导强度下的引导分布给出闭式解析解。
AI.motivation: CFG在扩散与流模型中广泛使用且对经验成功至关重要，但由于对任意归一化流求解相应传输方程困难，其经验与理论理解都很不足。作者观察到CFG效果源于条件分布与无条件分布表征能力的不匹配：条件分布复杂度与保真度更高。
AI.method: 构造解析可解的模型：条件分布取均值位于椭球上的高斯混合，无条件分布取近似该混合的单一高斯，二者复杂度不匹配。该混合诱导的流在缩放（scaling）下封闭，由此可在所有噪声尺度与引导层级上推导引导分布的解析闭式解。
AI.result: 解析解表明CFG产生两类效应：(a) 沿均值轴方向的平移；(b) 持续向且聚集于一个奇异点的偏斜，该奇异点对应于从零噪声出发的条件样本。并在预训练的大规模图像扩散模型上验证了理论预测。
AI.conclusion: CFG的作用可归因于条件与无条件分布表征能力的不匹配，并通过一个在缩放封闭的高斯混合解析模型得到闭式刻画，理论预测在大规模图像扩散模型上得到实证支持。

title: Ground Your Steps: Optimizing Sampling Schedules in Flow Matching Robot Policies
summary: Flow matching robot policies generate action chunks by integrating a learned velocity field at inference. However, under a fixed budget of neural function evaluations (NFEs), the integration result depends on the sampling schedule. This motivates optimizing the schedule to bring the generated action distribution closer to the demonstrations and improve task success. We propose Ground Your Steps (GYS), a training-free method that optimizes the sampling schedule by matching the generated and demonstrated chunk distributions at each observation. GYS applies truncated fractional differencing along each arm joint's action sequence and compares two types of pairwise differences between action chunks at each observation: differences of a generated chunk against a demonstration, and differences of two independent generated chunks against each other. After fractional differencing, these two pairwise-difference distributions coincide exactly when the distributions of generated and demonstrated action chunks match. GYS minimizes the energy distance between these distributions to obtain an improved schedule for each task and NFE budget. Compared with the uniform grid, GYS brings the generated chunk distribution closer to the demonstrated distribution and raises the success rate through the sampling schedule alone. On RoboTwin 2.0 benchmarks, GYS improves success rates at nearly every budget, with gains of 2.8 percentage points for both $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.7. The gains also transfer to three real-world manipulation tasks, reaching up to 3.3 percentage points. Code is available at https://github.com/D-Robotics-AI-Lab/GroundYourSteps.

AI.tldr: GYS是一种免训练方法，通过在训练后优化flow matching策略推理时的采样时间表（sampling schedule），使生成的动作块分布更接近示教分布，从而在固定NFE预算下提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: flow matching机器人策略在推理时通过积分学习到的速度场生成动作块，在固定NFE（神经函数评估次数）预算下，积分结果依赖于采样时间表。因此有动机优化采样时间表，使生成的动作分布更接近示教数据并提升任务成功率。
AI.method: GYS沿每个手臂关节的动作序列施加截断分数阶差分（truncated fractional differencing），在每次观测下比较两类成对差分分布：生成块与示教块之间的差分，以及两个独立生成块之间的差分。理论上，当生成分布与示教分布匹配时，分数阶差分后这两种成对差分分布严格一致。GYS通过最小化二者之间的能量距离（energy distance）来为每个任务和NFE预算求解更优的采样时间表，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 相比均匀网格采样，GYS仅通过采样时间表即拉近了生成块与示教块分布的距离并提升成功率。在RoboTwin 2.0基准上，几乎所有NFE预算下成功率均有提升，π_{0.5}与GR00T N1.7均提升2.8个百分点；增益还可迁移到三个真实机器人操作任务，最高提升3.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 采样时间表是固定NFE下flow matching机器人策略被忽视的重要自由度；通过分布匹配准则离线优化时间表，可在不改变模型与参数的前提下稳定提升生成质量与任务成功率，且效果可跨仿真与真实场景迁移。

title: EATS: Scaling Tool-Use Experience for Medical Reasoning Agents
summary: Medical reasoning agents combine large language model (LLM) reasoning with clinical workflows and specialized neural tools. However, general-purpose LLMs receive limited training exposure to domain-specific medical tools, and the uncertainty and distributional shifts of neural tool outputs make selecting tools from simple descriptions significantly more challenging than in deterministic settings such as calculators or dictionary lookups. In this paper, we propose EATS, an experience-augmented tool selection strategy that leverages accumulated tool-use trajectories to improve tool selection in medical reasoning agents. EATS constructs a memory of past interactions, including queries, tool choices, arguments, and self-evaluated feedback, and retrieves relevant experiences to guide tool selection for new queries. As memory construction does not require ground-truth supervision, EATS scales naturally with test-time experience. We evaluate EATS on tool-augmented medical reasoning tasks, including closed-ended visual question answering and free-form report generation. Experiments on four public datasets, ChestAgentBench, CheXbench, MIMIC-CXR, and SLAKE-VQA, across three multimodal LLMs, Qwen3-VL 2B, Qwen3-VL 32B, and GPT-5.5, show consistent gains in tool selection behavior and downstream medical reasoning performance. Code is available at https://github.com/Limingyuan001/EATS.

AI.tldr: 提出EATS：利用累积的工具使用轨迹构建记忆并检索相关经验，以改进医疗推理智能体的工具选择。
AI.motivation: 通用LLM缺乏对领域专用医疗工具的训练暴露，且神经工具输出具有不确定性与分布偏移，使仅凭简单描述选择工具比在计算器等确定性场景中更难。
AI.method: 构建包含查询、工具选择、参数与自评估反馈的交互记忆，检索相关经验指导新查询的工具选择；记忆构建无需真值监督，可随测试时经验自然扩展。
AI.result: 在ChestAgentBench、CheXbench、MIMIC-CXR、SLAKE-VQA四个公开数据集上，跨Qwen3-VL 2B、Qwen3-VL 32B、GPT-5.5三个多模态LLM，工具选择行为与下游医疗推理性能均获一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 经验增强的工具选择可有效提升医疗推理智能体在闭式VQA与自由式报告生成任务上的表现，且具备免监督、可扩展的优势。

title: EgoCARBS: Egocentric Video Meets Active Acoustics for Kitchen Action Understanding
comment: 36 pages (12 main paper and references, 24 supplementary material). Project page: https://saif-mahmud.github.io/projects/ego-carbs
summary: Egocentric video records what a person looks at, but often misses what their body does: the hands leave the frame, and arm motion goes unseen. An exocentric camera recovers this context, but it must be installed wherever the activity happens. Active acoustic sensing can recover it from the wearables themselves: a device's speaker emits inaudible chirps, and its microphone senses the motion of the hands, arms, and nearby objects from their echoes. Yet no public dataset pairs it with egocentric video. We present EgoCARBS, with two deliverables. The first is a multimodal dataset and benchmark: 15 participants cook unscripted meals in their own kitchens wearing camera glasses and an off-the-shelf smartwatch that both sense with active acoustics, synchronized with egocentric and exocentric video and the watch's audio and IMU, with 4,019 verb-noun action annotations in 11.4 hours.
