The second is a study of what the wearables add to egocentric video. On verb recognition, they add at least as much as an exocentric camera for participants seen in training, and even more for new participants, for whom the exocentric camera does not help. Active acoustics alone provides most of this gain, and helps most where the camera does not see the hands. Trimmed action recognition, detection, and anticipation remain open. We will release the data, our data collection and annotation tools, and pre-trained models.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoCARBS：首个将主动声学感知（智能手表/眼镜扬声器发出不可闻chirp、麦克风接收回声）与第一人称视频配对的多模态数据集与基准，含15名被试、11.4小时、4,019条动宾动作标注，并证明可穿戴声学感知对动词识别的增益可与外置相机相当甚至更强。
AI.motivation: 第一人称视频只记录"看到什么"，常丢失"身体做了什么"（手出画、手臂运动不可见）；外置相机（exocentric）可补足该上下文，但需在活动场所预先部署，缺乏可移动性。主动声学感知可由穿戴设备自身恢复手、臂及附近物体的运动，但此前没有将其与第一人称视频配对的公开数据集。
AI.method: 构建EgoCARBS数据集：15名被试在自家厨房不设脚本地烹饪，佩戴摄像眼镜与现成智能手表，两者均具备主动声学感知能力；同步采集第一人称视频、外置视频、手表音频与IMU；共标注4,019条动词-名词动作，时长11.4小时。在此基础上开展基准研究，比较可穿戴声学感知与外置相机对第一人称视频的补充效果，并进行消融（仅用主动声学）与遮挡分析（手不在画面内时）。
AI.result: 动词识别上，可穿戴感知对训练中出现过的被试带来的增益至少与外置相机相当；对未见过的被试增益更大，而此时外置相机无帮助。该增益主要来自主动声学单独使用，且在手部离开相机视野时收益最大。裁剪后的动作识别、检测与预测任务仍具挑战，尚待解决。
AI.conclusion: 可穿戴主动声学感知是比外置相机更实用、且在跨被试场景下更有效的第一人称视觉补充模态，尤其适用于手部出画的场景。论文将公开数据、采集与标注工具及预训练模型，为多模态第一人称动作理解提供新基准。

title: CovNovBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Time Series Foundation Models under Covariate Novelty
comment: 22 pages, 2 figures, 11 tables. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems: From Forecasting to World Modeling (FMTS)
summary: Covariate-aware time-series foundation models (TSFMs) condition their forecasts on additional input variables, called covariates, that are supplied over the future horizon. This capability makes them appealing for interventional forecasting, in which a target is predicted under a planned action such as a new product pricing policy or a new patient treatment schedule. We refer to covariates that encode such actions as treatment covariates. Current covariate-aware TSFMs, however, are trained on observed patterns, and their behavior is unclear when future treatment covariates fall outside the range seen in the history. Examples include a numerical treatment that leaves its historical range and a categorical treatment that takes a previously unseen policy. We call this practically common setting covariate novelty, and note that it is not systematically represented in existing benchmarks. We introduce an operational definition of covariate novelty and use it to construct CovNovBench, a benchmark of 88,476 evaluation series generated or filtered from four simulator-based and real-world datasets. The benchmark spans categorical and numerical treatment covariates as well as stable and trending targets. We evaluate six covariate-aware TSFMs zero-shot using point and directional accuracy metrics. No model is consistently reliable in our benchmark: point error almost always increases under covariate novelty, directional performance changes non-uniformly, and the best observed model varies across datasets and metrics. CovNovBench provides a systematic testbed for developing TSFMs that forecast more reliably under covariate novelty.

AI.tldr: 论文指出协变量感知时间序列基础模型在"协变量新颖性"（未来干预协变量超历史范围或出现未见过类别）下行为不可知，提出操作性定义并构建CovNovBench基准，评测六个模型发现无一可靠。
AI.motivation: 协变量感知TSFM可用于干预式预测（如新定价政策、新治疗安排），但现有模型基于观测模式训练，当未来治疗协变量超出历史取值范围或取未见过的类别时，行为不明确；且该常见场景在现有基准中缺乏系统体现。
AI.method: 给出协变量新颖性的操作性定义，并据此从四个基于模拟器与真实世界的数据集中生成/筛选出88,476条评测序列，构建CovNovBench；覆盖类别型与数值型治疗协变量、平稳与趋势型目标；以零样本方式评测六个协变量感知TSFM，使用点预测与方向准确率指标。
AI.result: 无模型在本基准上持续可靠：协变量新颖性下点误差几乎总是上升，方向性能变化不一致，最优模型随数据集和指标而变化。
AI.conclusion: CovNovBench为开发在协变量新颖性下更可靠预测的TSFM提供了系统化测试平台。

title: Autonomous Vineyard Exploration using LiDAR Sensing: A Field Evaluation on Legged-Wheeled Quadruped Robot
summary: Autonomous navigation in vineyards presents significant challenges due to uneven terrain, sparse vegetation, and the repetitive geometric nature of vineyard rows. This paper evaluates a LiDAR-based autonomous exploration system deployed on a Unitree Go2 Wheeled quadruped robot. Our approach utilizes an iterative RANSAC-based line detection pipeline to identify vineyard rows and a finite-state navigation strategy to govern row selection and traversal. Field evaluations conducted at Denbies Vineyard (UK) demonstrate the system's ability to perform sustained autonomous row following, completing a 370m up-and-down traversal without intervention. We analyze the failure modes encountered, specifically focusing on line detection instability in sparse vegetation and the trade-offs of spatial filtering. The results suggest that, while RANSAC provides a robust geometric primitive, additional temporal filtering and adaptive perception are required for reliable lane-to-lane transitions in commercial vineyard environments. A video of the experimental results is available at: youtu.be/1om1HFGF4ps

AI.tldr: 本文在Unitree Go2轮式四足机器人上部署基于LiDAR的自主探索系统，用迭代RANSAC直线检测识别葡萄园行、有限状态机导航完成行选择与遍历，在Denbies葡萄园实现370m无干预往返自主跟随并分析失败模式。
AI.motivation: 葡萄园自主导航受地形不平、植被稀疏及行间几何高度重复等因素制约，需要评估LiDAR方案在真实商业葡萄园中识别并沿行自主导航的可行性与局限。
AI.method: 构建基于LiDAR的自主探索系统并部署于Unitree Go2轮式四足机器人：采用迭代RANSAC直线检测流水线提取葡萄园行几何结构，配合有限状态机导航策略管理行选择与穿越，并在英国Denbies葡萄园开展实地测试。
AI.result: 系统实现持续自主沿行跟随，完成370m往返遍历且无需人工干预；同时记录了失败模式，重点为稀疏植被下的直线检测不稳定及空间滤波的权衡问题。
AI.conclusion: RANSAC可提供鲁棒的几何基元，但在商业葡萄园环境中实现可靠的行间切换仍需引入时间滤波与自适应感知策略。

title: EGSE: Evidence-Grounded Skill Evolution for Medical Reasoning Agents
summary: Medical reasoning agents combine foundation models with specialized tools to interpret medical images, yet reusing their historical experience remains challenging. A correct final answer can conceal flawed reasoning or tool use, synthesized advice may lack source support, and superficially similar cases may require different diagnostic procedures. In this paper, we propose EGSE, an evidence-grounded skill evolution framework that distills historical dialogues from similar cases into reusable conditional workflows and progressively refines a multi-faceted skill library through supported and validated updates to improve medical agents. EGSE evaluates intermediate reasoning and tool use and contrasts repeated successful and failed rollouts to extract useful practices and evidence-supported avoidance guidance. These experiences are synthesized into workflows with applicability conditions and checks traceable to source dialogues. Library additions and merges require source-grounded review and execution validation. At inference time, EGSE routes queries to skill nodes organized by imaging modality, question task type, and disease category, then retrieves and selects applicable workflows based on their conditions, the current images, and the question to guide evidence acquisition and interpretation. Experiments across four chest X-ray benchmarks show that EGSE outperforms representative medical agents and skill evolution methods in reasoning accuracy while reducing tool calls. It also delivers consistent accuracy gains across seven foundation models and supports skill transfer across datasets.

AI.tldr: EGSE：将相似病例的历史对话提炼为带适用条件的可复用工作流，并通过有证据支持、经验证校验的更新逐步演进多面技能库，从而提升医学推理智能体的准确率并减少工具调用。
AI.motivation: 现有医学推理智能体虽结合基础模型与专用工具解读医学图像，但历史经验复用存在三大问题：最终答案正确可能掩盖推理或工具使用错误；合成建议缺乏来源支撑；表面相似的病例可能需不同的诊断流程。
AI.method: 提出证据落地（evidence-grounded）的技能演化框架EGSE：(1) 评估中间推理与工具调用，对比重复成功与失败的 rollout，抽取有效做法与有证据支撑的规避指引；(2) 将其合成为带适用条件、且可追溯至源对话的检查项的工作流；(3) 技能库的增补与合并须经基于来源的审查与执行验证；(4) 推理时将查询路由至按影像模态、问题任务类型、疾病类别组织的技能节点，并结合适用条件、当前图像与问题检索选择工作流以指导证据获取与解读。
AI.result: 在四个胸部X光基准上，EGSE在推理准确率上优于代表性医学智能体与技能演化方法，同时减少工具调用次数；在七个基础模型上均取得一致的准确率提升，并支持跨数据集技能迁移。
AI.conclusion: 通过证据落地的条件化工作流与经校验的技能库演化，可有效复用医学智能体的历史经验，兼顾准确率、工具效率与可迁移性。

title: ProPolar: Progressive Polar Decomposition for Implicit Neural Representations
summary: Implicit neural representations (INRs) capture global low-frequency structure during the early stage of training and then refine localized high-frequency details, afterwards. However, standard optimizers are agnostic to the coarse-to-fine learning behavior of INRs. Such optimizers accumulate a gradient matrix in momentum buffer and retain components misaligned with the dominant low-frequency directions in the early stage. We propose a progressively growing rank scheduler and a rank-aware learning-rate scheduler for enhancing a subspace-based momentum optimization, where a momentum matrix is updated within a low-rank subspace. The rank schedule expands the subspace during training, and the scheduler holds the peak learning rate through rank growth so that the added subspace contributes to fine-detail recovery. Experiments on image fitting, single-image super-resolution (SISR), and neural radiance field optimization show that the proposed method improves convergence and peak reconstruction quality over competitive optimizers. The largest gains appear in the high-frequency refinement stage, mirroring the coarse-to-fine progression that the rank schedule targets. A significant study on hyperparameter optimization (HPO) on NeRF further confirms that these gains persist under matched search budgets.

AI.tldr: 针对隐式神经表示（INR）从低频到高频的粗到细学习特性，提出逐步增长秩的调度器与秩感知学习率调度器，配合子空间动量优化，提升收敛速度与重建质量。
AI.motivation: INR在训练早期主要拟合全局低频结构，后期才细化局部高频细节；而标准优化器对此粗到细行为无感知，会在动量缓冲区中累积梯度矩阵，并在早期保留与主导低频方向不对齐的分量，从而妨碍后期高频细节恢复。
AI.method: 基于低秩子空间中的动量矩阵更新（子空间动量优化），引入两个组件：(1) 逐步增长秩调度器，在训练过程中扩张动量子空间秩；(2) 秩感知学习率调度器，在秩增长阶段维持峰值学习率，使新增子空间分量能有效贡献于细粒度细节恢复。
AI.result: 在图像拟合、单图像超分辨率（SISR）与神经辐射场（NeRF）优化实验中，相较有竞争力的优化器，方法在收敛速度与峰值重建质量上均有提升；最大增益出现在高频细化阶段，与秩调度所针对的粗到细进程一致；NeRF上的超参数优化（HPO）研究在匹配搜索预算下进一步证实增益的稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 使优化器的动量子空间秩与INR的粗到细频谱学习进程对齐，可有效改善高频细节重建；秩增长与学习率维持的协同设计是性能提升的关键，且在多种任务与公平HPO预算下具有一致性。

title: Don't Waste the Population: Post-Anneal Refinement for Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Parallel annealers generate diverse candidate solutions; yet, conventional post-processing typically refines only the best, leaving much of the population's potential untapped. We introduce Iterative Path-Relinking Polish (I-PRP), a deterministic, training-free method that exploits this diversity to discover better solutions without modifying the underlying annealing process. I-PRP selects promising candidates, explores cost-guided paths between locally optimized solutions, and refines intermediate states to uncover better local minima. Newly discovered improvements are iteratively incorporated into the population, enabling further exploration. We theoretically guarantee that I-PRP never degrades solution quality relative to conventional single-candidate polishing on the same population and converges in finitely many iterations. Experiments across challenging combinatorial optimization benchmarks, including MaxCut, MaxClique, and graph coloring, demonstrate substantial improvements in several instances. Paired evaluations confirm non-degradation, while matched-runtime comparisons show that exploiting existing population diversity can outperform additional annealing. These results establish I-PRP as an effective and reliable refinement strategy for parallel annealing.

AI.tldr: I-PRP：一种确定性、免训练的迭代路径重连后处理方法，利用并行退火群体的多样性发现更优解，理论保证不减质且有限步收敛。
AI.motivation: 并行退火器会产生大量多样化的候选解，但传统后处理通常只精修其中最好的一个，浪费了群体中其余解所蕴含的潜力。
AI.method: 提出 Iterative Path-Relinking Polish（I-PRP），不改变底层退火过程：先挑选有前景的候选解，在局部优化解之间沿成本引导路径进行探索（路径重连），并对中间状态进行精修以发现更优局部极小；新发现的改进解被迭代地纳入种群，以支持进一步探索。
AI.result: 理论上证明 I-PRP 相对于对同一群体进行传统单候选精修不会降低解质量，并在有限次迭代内收敛。在 MaxCut、MaxClique、图着色等困难组合优化基准上，多个实例取得显著提升；配对实验验证了非退化性，等运行时对比表明利用已有群体多样性可优于额外增加退火时间。
AI.conclusion: I-PRP 是一种有效且可靠的并行退火精修策略，说明充分挖掘群体多样性是提升解质量的高性价比途径。

title: CamAct: Learning Robotic Manipulation from In-the-Wild Videos via Camera Motion
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models benefit from large, diverse datasets for robotic manipulation, yet collecting robot demonstrations remains costly. Recent work has explored egocentric videos as a source of supervision, primarily drawing on demonstrations of human-object interaction. We show that in-the-wild videos can improve robotic manipulation even when they contain no demonstrations of object manipulation. Specifically, camera motion recovered from these videos provides an additional source of motion supervision that complements robot demonstrations. Building on this finding, we introduce CamAct, which incorporates this camera-motion supervision into VLA policies alongside robot demonstrations, extending the use of human videos for manipulation learning beyond object interactions. Experiments show that incorporating this video supervision during fine-tuning improves success rates from 96.40% to 98.10% on LIBERO and from 22.96% to 29.32% on RoboCasa 365. The resulting policy also demonstrates strong results in out-of-distribution generalization on LIBERO-Plus and real-world manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 CamAct，将野外视频中恢复的相机运动作为额外的运动监督信号，与机器人演示共同注入 VLA 策略微调，从而把人类视频的利用范围从"物体交互演示"扩展到"无操作行为的视频"。在 LIBERO 上成功率由 96.40% 提升至 98.10%，RoboCasa 365 上由 22.96% 提升至 29.32%，并在 LIBERO-Plus 与真实机器人任务上展现出较强的分布外泛化能力。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型依赖大规模多样化数据，但机器人示教采集成本高。已有工作多以第一人称人类视频作为监督来源，且主要依赖含人-物交互演示的片段，可用数据范围受限。作者的核心洞察是：即使视频中不含任何物体操作演示，其中的相机自运动仍能提供有价值的运动监督，与机器人示教互补，从而大幅拓宽可用视频的边界。
AI.method: 1）从野外视频中估计相机运动（camera motion），将其构造为运动监督信号；2）提出 CamAct，把该监督与机器人演示数据联合用于 VLA 策略的微调，形成多源监督训练框架；3）相机运动作为与任务无关的几何/运动先验，补充机器人数据中稀缺的视角与运动多样性。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 基准上，引入视频监督后微调成功率从 96.40% 提升到 98.10%；在更复杂的 RoboCasa 365 上从 22.96% 提升到 29.32%（相对提升显著）。此外在 LIBERO-Plus 的分布外设定及真实世界操作任务上均取得较强表现，说明该监督不仅提升同分布精度，也改善泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 相机运动是一种低成本、易获取且与操作能力互补的监督信号；人类/野外视频对机器人操作学习的价值并不局限于物体交互演示。CamAct 为在 VLA 训练中规模化利用无标注视频提供了新路径，其收益在仿真基准与真实任务上均得到验证。

title: What Does Skill Lift Actually Measure? A Source-Code-Level Audit and Noise-Aware Reanalysis of SkillsBench
comment: 2 figures, 6 tables. Code, audit ledgers, and reproduction scripts: https://github.com/rrrrr4788/skillsbench-lift-reanalysis
summary: Agent skills are directories of instructions, reference materials, and scripts loaded on demand by coding agents. According to SkillsBench, although human-curated skills can raise the passing rate by about 16.6 percentage points (pp) on average, they have actually reduced the results for some tasks. Later research has started to gate or eliminate skills according to the above per-task gains. We have audited the above benchmark at the source-code level and analysed 7,554 public trials to form 1,421 paired "(configuration, task) cells". Source-code audit identified two controlled-verified cases of grader dependence and one operational definition gap; the average lift on these three tasks was 74.6 pp, and the overall average lift for the full set was 18.7 pp. The audit also found that four tasks contained placeholder skill directories, and a certain execution harness additionally added 48 built-in skills in most runs. No task-level reduction achieved statistical significance in the pooled reanalysis with multiple-testing correction. As there were at most three runs per condition for each cell, the observed negative differences are very susceptible to run-sampling noise, and arithmetically, 58% of the cells could not have shown a decrease. Therefore, the raw numbers of negative cells cannot show that skills cause harm. A gating strategy based on the skill-free score seems to improve by 2-3 pp in the logs; however, even after shuffling condition labels to remove any skill effect, it still achieves an increase of 4-7 pp. On the held-out runs not used for fitting and decision-making, there was no statistically significant improvement. The audit ledger and analysis scripts have been published by us.

AI.tldr: 本文对 SkillsBench 进行源代码级审计并重新分析 7,554 条公开试验（1,421 个配对 cell），发现所谓"技能有害"的负增益主要来自评测器依赖、操作性定义缺口、占位技能目录与执行框架内置技能等混杂因素，以及运行采样噪声；基于无技能分数的技能门控策略在打乱标签后仍显示 4–7 pp 假提升，故其真实收益不成立。
AI.motivation: 已有工作（SkillsBench）报告人工整理技能平均提升约 16.6 pp，但部分任务出现负增益，后续研究据此提出按任务增益对技能进行门控或剔除。作者认为这些结论可能建立在未经验证的基准数据之上，因此需要从源头审计基准与统计推断的有效性，判断"技能有害"是否为真实效应。
AI.method: (1) 对 SkillsBench 进行源代码级审计；(2) 从 7,554 条公开 trial 构建 1,421 个配对"(配置, 任务)"cell；(3) 识别评测器依赖（grader dependence）与操作性定义缺口等受控验证缺陷；(4) 检查占位技能目录与执行 harness 内置技能；(5) 对任务级差异做带多重检验校正的合并重分析；(6) 以置换/打乱条件标签的方式检验门控策略的增益是否来自真实技能效应；(7) 在未参与拟合与决策的留出运行上验证。
AI.result: 全样本平均提升 18.7 pp，但三个存在审计问题的任务平均提升高达 74.6 pp，明显主导整体数值。审计发现 4 个任务含占位技能目录，某执行框架在多数运行中额外注入 48 个内置技能。多重检验校正后无任何任务级下降达到统计显著；每 cell 每条件至多 3 次运行，负差异极易受运行采样噪声影响，且算术上 58% 的 cell 本就不可能表现出下降。基于无技能分数的门控策略在日志中提升 2–3 pp，但在打乱条件标签后仍提升 4–7 pp；在留出运行上无统计显著改善。
AI.conclusion: 现有基准中观察到的技能负增益不足以证明技能有害，相关门控策略的表面收益可由混杂与噪声解释。作者公开审计台账与分析脚本，呼吁在技能门控与消除类研究中使用更严格的基准审计、配对设计与多重检验校正。

title: DoseSteer: Steering diffusion-based dose prediction models towards clinical targets via Dual-Response Guidance
summary: AI dose-prediction models generate patient-specific 3D dose distributions from patient anatomy. Yet these predictions can still miss structure-level clinical dose targets. Once deployed, most existing predictors offer no direct mechanism to correct such deviations, deferring target enforcement to downstream plan optimization. We introduce DoseSteer, an inference-time framework that steers frozen diffusion-based dose prediction models towards specified clinical targets without retraining. To meet clinical targets while preserving overall dose prediction quality, we propose Dual-Response Guidance (DRG), a structure-centric algorithm that probes the model's responses to perturbations in each structure's noisy dose and context and jointly solves for per-structure steering strengths. Across five dataset-model configurations spanning three diffusion architectures and three datasets, DRG outperforms 12 training-free baselines under identical reference-derived target proxies, removing at least 97% of the target error, reducing the official dose error by 7.8% on average, and improving dose fidelity outside the steered structures. DoseSteer reconciles learned anatomical dose priors with explicit structure-level targets at test time, establishing a principled, training-free mechanism to refine AI dose predictions prior to plan optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/csp2002/DoseSteer.

AI.tldr: DoseSteer：一种免重训练的推理时框架，通过双响应引导（DRG）将冻结的扩散式剂量预测模型导向指定临床结构级靶区目标。
AI.motivation: 现有AI剂量预测模型虽能由解剖结构生成患者特异性3D剂量分布，但预测结果仍可能偏离结构级临床剂量目标；且模型部署后缺乏直接纠偏机制，只能把目标约束推给下游计划优化。
AI.method: 提出推理时引导框架DoseSteer，不重训练即可操控冻结的扩散剂量预测模型。核心为Dual-Response Guidance（DRG）：一种以结构为中心的算法，先探测模型对各结构噪声剂量与上下文扰动的响应，再联合求解每个结构的引导强度，从而在满足临床目标的同时保持整体剂量预测质量。
AI.result: 在覆盖3种扩散架构与3个数据集的5种"数据集-模型"配置上，DRG在相同参考衍生目标代理下优于12个免训练基线：消除至少97%的目标误差，官方剂量误差平均降低7.8%，并改善被引导结构之外的剂量保真度。
AI.conclusion: DoseSteer在测试阶段协调了学习到的解剖剂量先验与显式的结构级目标，为在计划优化之前精修AI剂量预测提供了有原则的免训练机制。

title: On Grokking and the Dynamics of Generalization
summary: We extend the signal-channel theory of grokking introduced by Litman and Guo by relating training dissipation and evaluation transfer to population risk. For preconditioned gradient flows with time-dependent kernels, we distinguish two sources of limited evaluation visibility, namely small cumulative dissipation and weak transfer. We obtain quantitative bounds for task visibility and establish their stability under signal filtering and changes of evaluation distribution. We describe how task directions enter the effective signal channel through spectral activation or transport. We establish necessary and sufficient conditions for the transferred signal to decrease squared population risk and derive classification error bounds under margin assumptions. These results yield sufficient conditions for the same training trajectory to generalize under one evaluation distribution while failing under another. We show that differences in spectral learning rates can produce arbitrarily long delays between low training loss and low population risk. By relating classification accuracy to the distribution of margin crossing times, we construct a family of gradient flows in which the generalization delay tends to infinity, while both the duration of the transition from zero to full accuracy and the corresponding variation of population risk tend to zero. These phenomena occur without feature evolution during training. Finally, we prove that the occurrence and timing of generalization cannot generally be inferred from training dynamics alone, but depend on the geometry of evaluation transfer and its relation to the target.

AI.tldr: 本文将 Litman 与 Guo 提出的 grokking 信号通道理论推广到总体风险层面，把训练耗散与评估迁移联系起来，给出任务可见性的定量界，并证明泛化能否发生、何时发生无法仅由训练动力学推断，而取决于评估迁移的几何性质。
AI.motivation: 原信号通道理论缺乏与总体风险（population risk）的直接联系，且无法解释同一训练轨迹在不同评估分布下一个泛化、一个失败，以及训练损失很低而总体风险长期不降等泛化延迟现象。作者希望厘清"评估可见性"受限于哪些因素，并给出泛化必要性/充分性条件。
AI.method: 考虑带时变核的预条件梯度流，将评估可见性受限分解为两个来源：累积耗散过小与迁移过弱；推导任务可见性的定量界，并研究其在信号滤波与评估分布改变下的稳定性；刻画任务方向经谱激活或传输进入有效信号通道的机制；给出迁移信号降低平方总体风险的充要条件，并在间隔（margin）假设下推导分类误差界；通过谱学习率差异与 margin 穿越时间分布构造反例族。
AI.result: 得到迁移信号降低平方总体风险的充要条件及 margin 下的分类误差界；给出同一轨迹在一种评估分布下泛化、另一种下失败的充分条件；证明谱学习率差异可造成任意长的"低训练损失—低总体风险"延迟；构造一族梯度流，其泛化延迟趋于无穷，而准确率从零到满的过渡时长与总体风险变化量均趋于零，且这些现象无需特征演化；最后证明泛化的发生与时机一般不能仅由训练动力学推断。
AI.conclusion: Grokking/泛化延迟本质上是评估迁移几何与目标函数关系所决定的现象，而非训练动力学的内在属性；信号通道理论下"可见性 = 累积耗散 × 迁移强度"的分解为理解训练损失与总体风险脱钩提供了统一框架。

title: Escapingthe instruction blackhole of vision-language-action policies via optimal-transport wormholes
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies are trained to follow a fixed instruction, yet people change their minds while the robot acts. We identify the instruction black hole: once a VLA policy commits to a task, new instructions are absorbed and the robot completes the old task or freezes. We quantify it with a transmission ratio and an event horizon and prove it is a blind spot of static imitation, which cannot distinguish a policy that listens from a deaf one once the execution state reveals the task. We propose Wormhole, a training-free plug-in that relocates the robot instead of re-instructing it: optimal transport selects an approach-phase state of the new task, a rate-limited traversal carries the robot there, and the unmodified policy takes over. On LIBERO,Wormhole raises committed-switch success of pi to and pi0.5 from at most 1.2% to 93.1%, matching or exceeding scripted retreat-and-restart with one fifth of its action discontinuity.

AI.tldr: 论文识别出Vision-language-action (VLA)策略的"指令黑洞"现象：策略一旦投入某任务，新指令被吞没，机器人要么完成旧任务要么卡死；提出免训练的即插即用方法Wormhole，通过"迁移机器人状态"而非"重新下达指令"来实现任务切换。
AI.motivation: 人们在实际操作中会中途改变意图，但现有VLA策略被训练为遵循固定指令，无法响应中途插入的新指令，形成"指令黑洞"。作者用"传输比"与"事件视界"量化该现象，并证明它是静态模仿学习的固有盲点：一旦执行状态已暴露任务，静态模仿无法区分"会倾听"和"听不见"的策略。
AI.method: 提出Wormhole，一种无需训练、即插即用的模块。核心思路是把机器人"搬到"新任务的合适状态，而不是"重新指令"它：(1) 用最优传输（optimal transport）在新任务中选择一个接近阶段（approach-phase）的状态；(2) 以带速率限制的路径遍历将机器人迁移到该状态；(3) 由未经修改的原策略接管继续执行。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准上，Wormhole将π与π0.5在"已投入任务后的切换成功率"（committed-switch success）从最高1.2%提升至93.1%，效果达到或超过脚本化的"撤退-重启"（scripted retreat-and-restart）基线，同时动作不连续性仅为后者的约五分之一。
AI.conclusion: VLA策略的任务切换失败源于表征/训练范式层面的结构性盲点，而通过状态迁移（而非指令重述）的方式可在不改动原策略、不额外训练的前提下有效实现中途指令切换，且切换过程更平滑。

title: Should Service Requirements Be Scalarized or Constrained When Minimizing Costs? A Case Study on HVAC Control
summary: Automated decision systems, from learned policies to model-based optimizers, often minimize costs such as energy or resource use while meeting a service requirement, for example the quality of service (QoS) specified in a service level agreement (SLA), a comfort band, or a safety margin. The requirement can be scalarized with the costs into a single objective, with a fixed or an adaptively tuned (Lagrangian) weight, or it can be imposed as a constraint. We study this choice in the Smart Buildings Challenge, in which a single policy controls the heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) of previously unseen buildings and is evaluated by a weighted sum of comfort, energy cost and carbon emissions. With all other components fixed, we compare the two treatments in model-based optimization, represented by model predictive control (MPC) with the requirement as a hard or a soft (l1-penalized) constraint, and in learned policies, represented by proximal policy optimization (PPO) with a fixed or a Lagrangian penalty in the reward or a projection layer on the action. In MPC, the soft constraint reproduces the hard one once its weight exceeds the requirement's shadow price, which the challenge's comfort weight exceeds approximately fourfold; below this weight, comfort is sacrificed, and under a metric that values comfort below its shadow price the soft constraint outperforms the hard one by up to 28%. A weight tuned on the training buildings is 3.9% worse than the hard constraint on 48 unseen buildings, because the shadow price varies across buildings. In PPO, the projected policy satisfies the requirement from the outset and leads early in training; with longer training, the Lagrangian policy overtakes it while the projected policy deteriorates, and the fixed penalty does not learn to satisfy the requirement.

AI.tldr: 该文在Smart Buildings Challenge中系统比较"标量化权重惩罚"与"约束投影/硬约束"两种处理服务需求的方式，涵盖MPC与PPO两类方法，并分析影子价格与跨建筑泛化的影响。
AI.motivation: 自动决策系统常在满足服务需求（QoS、舒适带、安全裕度）的同时最小化能耗或资源成本。需求可被标量化加权（固定或Lagrangian自适应），也可作为显式约束施加。作者希望在同一基准中、其余组件固定的前提下，厘清这一建模选择的实际后果。
AI.method: 以Smart Buildings Challenge为环境，单一策略控制未见建筑的HVAC，评价指标为舒适度、能耗成本与碳排放的加权和。在基于模型的最优化侧比较MPC的硬约束与软（l1惩罚）约束；在学习策略侧比较PPO的固定惩罚、Lagrangian惩罚与动作投影层。
AI.result: MPC中软约束权重超过需求影子价格后等价于硬约束，而挑战赛的舒适权重约为该影子价格的4倍；低于该权重时舒适度被牺牲，在舒适估值低于影子价格的度量下软约束反超硬约束最多28%。在训练建筑上调好的权重用于48栋未见建筑时比硬约束差3.9%，因影子价格随建筑变化。PPO中投影策略自始满足需求并在训练早期领先；训练更久后Lagrangian策略反超，投影策略性能退化，固定惩罚则学不会满足需求。
AI.conclusion: 需求的处理方式（权重标量化 vs. 约束）并非无关紧要的工程细节：软约束的有效性取决于其权重与随建筑变化的影子价格的关系，固定权重难以跨建筑泛化；学习策略中约束投影利于早期可行性，Lagrangian自适应在长期训练中更优。建议依据影子价格的分布与评价度量选择处理方式。

title: LLMVC: Large Language Model-Guided Generative Video Compression
summary: Recent generative video methods achieve strong perceptual compression by encoding videos into compact latent representations and reconstructing them with powerful generative decoders. However, visual encoders must compress both high-level semantics and dense visual details into a unified latent space, which complicates entropy coding and decoding and may cause semantic drift under aggressive compression. In this work, we propose Large Language Model-Guided Video Compression (LLMVC), which leverages the summarization capability of frozen video large language models (Video-LLMs) to generate compact semantic tokens aligned with temporal latent slices for guiding video compression. Specifically, Hybrid Bidirectional Bimodal Attention (HBBA) enables bidirectional interactions between visual and semantic features during encoding and decoding. Semantic-Conditioned Cross-Attention (SCCA) incorporates semantic features into probability modeling during entropy coding. These semantic features provide high-level guidance throughout the pipeline, improving representation quality and encouraging semantic consistency through a transmitted text side channel. Experiments on UVG, MCL-JCV, and HEVC show that LLMVC consistently improves compression performance over traditional and recent neural video compression methods in terms of LPIPS and DISTS, while also achieving better fidelity than recent perceptual codecs.

AI.tldr: LLMVC利用冻结的视频大语言模型生成紧凑语义token，作为文本侧信息引导神经视频压缩的编解码与熵编码，在感知质量指标上优于传统和近期神经视频压缩方法。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式视频压缩将高层语义与稠密视觉细节压缩进统一潜在空间，导致熵编码与解码复杂化，并在激进压缩下产生语义漂移。
AI.method: 用冻结Video-LLM的摘要能力生成与时间潜在切片对齐的紧凑语义token；提出混合双向双模态注意力（HBBA）实现编码与解码中视觉与语义特征的双向交互；提出语义条件交叉注意力（SCCA）将语义特征引入熵编码的概率建模，并通过传输的文本侧信道提供全过程高层引导。
AI.result: 在UVG、MCL-JCV和HEVC数据集上，LLMVC在LPIPS和DISTS指标上稳定优于传统及近期神经视频压缩方法，同时保真度也优于近期感知编解码器。
AI.conclusion: 语义引导的文本侧信道可有效提升表示质量与语义一致性，为生成式视频压缩提供有效的先验增强路径。

title: FEAST: Fair and Efficient Adaptive Sampling for Task-Free On-Policy Learning
summary: Language agents trained from self-generated experience must allocate a limited rollout budget across heterogeneous capabilities. A common strategy is to prioritize capabilities with strong current learning signals, but in on-policy learning these signals are endogenous: past allocation changes the policy and therefore the evidence available for future allocation. This can create a feedback loop in which under-trained capabilities receive increasingly fewer opportunities to improve. We formalize this effect through the Quota-Efficiency Law (QEL), which shows that allocation history can change learning efficiency even under matched capability-specific exposure. Motivated by this, we introduce FEAST, a task-free adaptive sampling framework that separates opportunity allocation from compute allocation. FEAST dynamically discovers capability clusters while preserving their learning histories, maintains continued sampling opportunities across clusters, and reserves a rollout budget for each selected cluster. Within each budget, it progressively concentrates computation on prompts with informative reward variation. Across GURU-18K and SMC, FEAST improves average performance over competitive adaptive sampling baselines under matched rollout budgets, while better preserving learning progress on weaker capabilities. Ablation studies further support the complementary roles of cross-cluster opportunity protection and within-cluster selective allocation. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 论文指出自生成经验训练的语言代理在有限 rollout 预算下，按当前学习信号分配任务会形成内生反馈回路，导致弱能力被持续边缘化；据此提出配额-效率律（QEL），并给出 FEAST——将"机会分配"与"算力分配"解耦的自适应采样框架。
AI.motivation: 语言代理需在异质能力间分配有限 rollout 预算。常见做法是优先采样当前学习信号强的能力，但在 on-policy 学习中该信号是内生的：历史分配会改变策略，从而改变未来可用于分配的证据，形成正反馈——欠训练的能力获得的机会越来越少，难以改进。作者希望形式化这一效应并加以缓解。
AI.method: 1) 提出 Quota-Efficiency Law（QEL），形式化表明：即使各能力获得的能力特定曝光量相同，分配历史本身也会改变学习效率，即配额（机会）历史具有独立影响。2) 提出 FEAST，一种 task-free（无任务标签）自适应采样框架，核心是将机会分配与算力分配分离两层：跨簇层动态发现能力簇并保留各簇的学习历史，维持对各簇的持续采样机会，并为每个被选中的簇预留 rollout 预算；簇内层在该预算内逐步将计算集中到奖励方差大（信息量高）的 prompt 上。
AI.result: 在 GURU-18K 与 SMC 上，在匹配 rollout 预算的条件下，FEAST 相较多个有竞争力的自适应采样基线取得更高的平均性能，同时在较弱能力上更好地保持了学习进展。消融实验支持"跨簇机会保护"与"簇内选择性分配"两个组件具有互补作用。
AI.conclusion: 预算分配不应仅依据当前学习信号，因为信号本身受分配历史塑造；通过保护跨簇采样机会并在簇内做信息量驱动的算力集中，可在同等预算下兼顾整体性能与弱能力的持续进步。代码将在录用后公开。

title: DataForgeVLA: Fully Synthetic Manipulation Demonstrations for Vision-Language-Action Training
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Dataset available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/mws-physical-ai/dataforgevla-340
summary: We present a dataset of 340 fully synthetic manipulation demonstrations generated from real seed data for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) training. The corpus contains 32,340 frames with synchronized RGB and actions across eight object categories, represented as LeRobot v2.1 episodes with H.264 video, per-frame robot states and pose-valued action labels, language task annotations, summary statistics and quality decisions. Each synthetic demonstration is produced without additional teleoperation: a LoRA-fine-tuned Cosmos-3 model generates a manipulation video, and RoboHaMeR recovers the corresponding robot trajectory from RGB. Quality screening accepted 300 of 340 episodes for policy fine-tuning. As preliminary evidence of feasibility, a pretrained GR00T N1.6 policy fine-tuned exclusively on the 300 accepted episodes reaches 16/20 (80%) real-world pick-and-place success on the Oreo-package task. A policy fine-tuned on 105 real teleoperated episodes achieved 18/20 (90%) under the same protocol. These results are based on one object and 20 trials per policy and are therefore reported as preliminary evidence rather than a general performance claim.

AI.tldr: 用一个 LoRA 微调的 Cosmos-3 视频生成模型配合 RoboHaMeR 从 RGB 恢复机器人轨迹，构建了 340 条全合成操作演示数据（32,340 帧、8 类物体、LeRobot v2.1 格式），质量筛选后 300 条合格；仅用该合成数据微调 GR00T N1.6 策略，在真实 Oreo 包装盒抓取放置任务上达到 16/20（80%）成功率，接近用 105 条真实遥操作数据微调的 18/20（90%），作为可行性初步证据。
AI.motivation: Vision-Language-Action（VLA）策略训练高度依赖昂贵的真实遥操作数据，采集成本高、规模受限。作者希望验证"无需额外遥操作"即可生成可用操作演示的可行性，以降低数据获取成本、扩展训练语料规模。
AI.method: 以真实种子数据为条件，用 LoRA 微调的 Cosmos-3 模型生成操作视频，再由 RoboHaMeR 从 RGB 视频中反解出对应的机器人轨迹，从而构成"视频生成 + 状态/动作恢复"的合成数据流水线；数据组织为 LeRobot v2.1 episode（H.264 视频、逐帧机器人状态、位姿形式动作标签、语言任务标注、统计摘要与质量判定）。随后对 340 条 episode 做质量筛选，保留 300 条用于策略微调，并在 GR00T N1.6 预训练策略上做单物体真机评测。
AI.result: 数据集含 340 条合成演示、32,340 帧，覆盖 8 类物体，RGB 与动作同步；质量筛选通过 300/340。真机"Oreo 包装盒"拾取放置任务上，仅用 300 条合成数据微调的策略成功 16/20（80%）；对照组仅用 105 条真实遥操作数据微调的策略为 18/20（90%），评测协议相同。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持"全合成演示可用于 VLA 策略微调"的可行性，合成数据在少量真实数据之外提供了有竞争力的替代/补充方案。但结论限于单一物体、每策略 20 次试验，作者明确将其定位为初步证据而非普适性能主张；后续需多物体、大样本与统计显著性验证。

title: PatternMiner: Automated Mathematical Discovery Through LLM-Guided Training and Interpretation of Small Models
comment: 46 pages. Code and experiment records are available at https://github.com/uw-math-ai/PatternMiner. Comments welcome!
summary: There are several approaches to AI-driven mathematical discovery. One of these involves the use of large language models (LLMs) to resolve well-specified conjectures via text-based reasoning, while another uses narrow models and interpretability for more open-ended, human-in-the-loop exploration using object-based mathematical data. The latter is limited in its ability to move beyond simple empirical pattern detection while the former is not well-designed for direct, open-ended exploration of large mathematical datasets. In this paper we introduce PatternMiner, a system that combines these two paradigms. In PatternMiner, an LLM agent generates mathematical datasets based on an initial broad question, trains narrow machine learning models on them, uses interpretability techniques to extract patterns from these trained models, and uses these patterns to formulate conjectures. Once an initial conjecture has been formulated, PatternMiner instructs the agent to search for counterexamples using calls to mathematical software. If a set of counterexamples can be found, these are used as feedback for conjecture refinement or another round of training and interpretability. The conjecture progressively evolves through this iterative sequence with the agent allowed to try to prove it at any point. We describe the results of applying PatternMiner to five well-known positivity problems in algebraic combinatorics. PatternMiner proves several new theorems related to Schubert positivity and projection, a character-row evaluation formula, a restricted version of the Kazhdan--Lusztig combinatorial invariance conjecture, and Schur positivity for a family of immanant coefficients. We end by analyzing the most common routes to conjecture generation that are used by PatternMiner in our case studies as well as documenting the most common failure modes.

AI.tldr: PatternMiner 将"LLM 文本推理"与"窄模型+可解释性"两种数学发现范式结合，构建"生成数据集—训练模型—可解释性抽取模式—形成猜想—搜索反例—迭代精化"的闭环，在五个代数组合学正性问题上证明了若干新定理。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 驱动数学发现的两条路径各有局限：基于 LLM 的文本推理擅长处理明确表述的猜想，但不适合对大规模数学数据集做直接、开放式探索；而基于窄模型与可解释性的对象级探索虽适合人在回路的开放式研究，却难以超越简单的经验模式检测。作者希望把二者互补结合。
AI.method: 提出 PatternMiner 系统：LLM agent 依据一个宽泛的初始问题生成数学数据集；在其上训练窄机器学习模型；用可解释性技术从训练好的模型中抽取模式；据此形式化猜想。猜想形成后，agent 调用数学软件搜索反例；若找到反例集合，则将其作为反馈用于猜想精化，或触发新一轮训练与可解释性分析。猜想在迭代中逐步演化，agent 可在任意阶段尝试证明。
AI.result: 在五个著名代数组合学正性问题上应用：证明了与 Schubert 正性及投影相关的新定理、一个特征行求值公式、Kazhdan–Lusztig 组合不变性猜想的一个受限版本，以及一族 immanant 系数的 Schur 正性。
AI.conclusion: 将 LLM agent 与窄模型可解释性结合的迭代式框架可有效产出新数学结果；作者进一步总结了案例中最常见的猜想生成路径与主要失效模式。该工作为"LLM 推理 + 数据驱动模式发现"的混合式数学发现提供了可复用的流程范式。

title: SEEL: Towards End-to-End 3D Sign Generation with Language Models
summary: 3D sign language generation aims to produce signing motion from written text. Motivated by the linguistic nature of sign language, recent methods combine a motion tokenizer with a language model to predict motion tokens from text. However, both components are optimized through a two-stage pipeline with mismatched objectives: the tokenizer minimizes reconstruction error in isolation, while the generator learns from rigid one-hot reference tokens. A straightforward end-to-end extension bridges discrete token selection with straight-through estimators (STE), suffering from biased gradients and codebook collapse. To address these limitations, we propose SEEL, an end-to-end framework that aligns tokenization and generation with motion quality through two complementary mechanisms. First, to overcome rigid one-hot supervision, reconstruction-aware generation decodes candidate tokens in context and converts their 3D motion errors into soft targets, guiding the generator with physical motion quality. Second, to propagate generation feedback without STE, generation-aware tokenization passes continuous codebook expectations through the frozen generator, routing generated-motion gradients to the tokenizer to prevent codebook collapse. Combining both mechanisms enables the tokenizer and generator to co-evolve, achieving state-of-the-art performance on CSL-Daily, How2Sign, and Phoenix-2014T. Code and models will be released to facilitate future research.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端框架SEEL，通过重建感知生成与生成感知分词两个互补机制，对齐分词器与生成器的优化目标，实现手语动作token与生成器协同演化，在CSL-Daily、How2Sign、Phoenix-2014T上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有"运动分词器+语言模型"两阶段流程目标不匹配：分词器孤立地最小化重建误差，生成器则依赖刚性one-hot参考token监督；直接端到端接入STE会带来有偏梯度和码本坍缩。
AI.method: 重建感知生成：在上下文中解码候选token，将其3D运动误差转化为软目标，以物理运动质量引导生成器；生成感知分词：不经STE，把连续码本期望通过冻结的生成器，将生成运动的梯度回传至分词器以防止码本坍缩。
AI.result: 两个机制联合使分词器与生成器共同演化，在CSL-Daily、How2Sign和Phoenix-2014T三个数据集上达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 以运动质量为核心的端到端对齐可有效替代刚性one-hot监督与STE，实现分词与生成的协同优化；代码与模型将开源。

title: Mitigating Overgeneralization in RND via Spectral Target Design
summary: Random Network Distillation (RND) is a scalable novelty signal for RL based on a fixed random target network and a trained predictor. However, it can overgeneralize: the predictor extrapolates the random target off the data manifold, causing novelty scores to collapse on unfamiliar inputs. This paper analyzes this failure through a kernel-theoretic lens. Under a GP target model and an NTK-regime predictor, we show that the RND novelty score is a cross-kernel residual variance: it is governed jointly by the target covariance kernel and the predictor NTK, rather than by either one alone. This identifies overgeneralization as spectral under-excitation. Motivated by this view, we formulate spectral target design as a principle for shaping RND novelty geometry. As a concrete instance, we replace the implicit random-network target with a bandwidth-controlled Random Fourier Feature (RFF) target, redistributing residual signal toward modes less attenuated by the predictor. Experiments on offline D4RL, online Atari, and Fetch manipulation benchmarks show improved novelty discrimination and downstream RL performance. The code for the RL implementation is available at https://github.com/tuuktuc86/RFF-RND.

AI.tldr: 该文从核理论视角分析RND新奇度信号失效机制，将其归因为"谱激发不足"，并提出谱目标设计原则与带宽可控的RFF目标实现，在离线D4RL、在线Atari与Fetch操作任务上提升新奇度判别与RL性能。
AI.motivation: RND以固定随机目标网络加可训练预测器构造可扩展的新奇度信号，但存在过度泛化问题：预测器会将随机目标外推到数据流形之外，导致陌生输入上的新奇度分数塌缩，即新颖性无法被识别。
AI.method: 在GP目标模型与NTK区制预测器假设下进行核理论分析，证明RND新奇度分数等价于一个交叉核残差方差，由目标协方差核与预测器NTK共同决定，而非二者任一单独决定；据此把过度泛化刻画为谱激发不足，并提出"谱目标设计"原则来塑造RND的新奇度几何，具体以带宽可控的Random Fourier Feature（RFF）目标替代隐式随机网络目标，将残差信号重新分配到被预测器衰减较少的模态上。
AI.result: 在离线D4RL、在线Atari与Fetch操作三类基准上，所提方法在新奇度判别能力与下游RL性能两方面均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: RND新奇度的本质是目标核与预测器NTK共同决定的交叉核残差方差，过度泛化源于谱激发不足；通过谱目标设计（如带宽可控RFF目标）可有效重塑新奇度几何并提升RL表现，代码已开源。

title: Rehearse in 3D, Render in 2D: Physically Consistent and Editable Robot World Models
summary: Embodied world models aim to predict future interactions that are both visually realistic and physically consistent. Yet explicit 3D motion prediction alone does not guarantee that object structure and contact relationships are preserved. Beyond motion prediction, 3D representations provide an explicit state space for imposing structural and physical constraints. Building on this insight, we introduce RehearsalWorld, an editable robot world model driven by 3D Interaction Rehearsal (3DIR). Given an initial RGB-D observation and robot actions, Interaction-Consistent Rehearsal (ICR) uses a pretrained 3D point-flow model as a motion prior. It refines the predicted trajectories through response-aware object grouping, persistent grasp memory, and contact structure refiner, preserving scene stability, object structure, and grasp attachments. Rehearsal-Aligned Video Generation (RAVG) then uses geometric projections of the rehearsal as temporal conditioning. We fine-tune a video generator on projection-video pairs to synthesize realistic interaction videos. Thanks to the decoupling of physical response from visual synthesis, RehearsalWorld also supports independent editing of material properties and camera viewpoints. Compared with PointWorld on real DROID grasping sequences, RehearsalWorld reduces gripper-relative offset by approximately 79% to 84% across deformable, articulated, and rigid objects and lowers reference motion error. For video prediction, it achieves a PSNR of 23.92 dB and an FVD of 149.

AI.tldr: 提出RehearsalWorld：以3D Interaction Rehearsal（3DIR）为核心的机器人世界模型，先在3D显式空间用点流先验+结构/接触约束修正交互轨迹，再将几何投影作为时序条件驱动视频生成，实现物理一致且可编辑的交互视频预测。
AI.motivation: 现有具身世界模型追求视觉逼真与物理一致，但仅做显式3D运动预测无法保证物体结构与接触关系（如抓取附着）被保持；3D表示可提供显式状态空间以施加结构与物理约束。
AI.method: 1) Interaction-Consistent Rehearsal (ICR)：以预训练3D点流模型为先验，通过响应感知物体分组、持久抓取记忆、接触结构细化器修正预测轨迹，保持场景稳定、物体结构与抓取附着；2) Rehearsal-Aligned Video Generation (RAVG)：将排练结果的几何投影作为时序条件，在投影-视频对上微调视频生成器；物理响应与视觉合成解耦，支持材质属性与相机视角的独立编辑。
AI.result: 在真实DROID抓取序列上，相比PointWorld，对可变形、铰接与刚体物体的夹爪相对偏移降低约79%–84%，参考运动误差下降；视频预测PSNR 23.92 dB、FVD 149。
AI.conclusion: 将物理响应建模与视觉渲染解耦、并在3D显式空间施加交互约束，可显著提升机器人交互世界模型的物理一致性与生成质量，同时获得可编辑性。

title: Honest but Wrong: Formalizing Retraction in the Ethics of Speech Acts
comment: To appear in Proceedings of the Workshop on Verifying Law and Ethics, and Legal Autoformalisation (VLE-LEGATO 2026), JURIX 2026
summary: A speaker who asserts honestly may later discover that its assertion was false. Such erroneous truths are not lies, yet they raise the question of whether, and on which moral grounds, the speaker must retract them. Using the FIPA-ACL performative disconfirm, we extend a belief-based framework that evaluates speech acts under deontologism and consequentialism to the case of retraction. We prove that the honesty duty of deontologism, which bears on utterances when they are made, never requires retracting an erroneous truth, and add a persistent one, which forbids letting the addressee believe what the speaker no longer believes. On a legal-advice case implemented in Answer Set Programming, we show that deontologism and consequentialism both require the retraction, but that consequentialism no longer does once it comes too late to prevent harm.

AI.tldr: 论文用FIPA-ACL的disconfirm语用行为，将基于信念的言语行为评价框架（义务论与后果论）扩展到"撤回"情形；证明义务论的诚实义务从不要求撤回"错误真理"，并补充一条"持续性义务"；在ASP实现的法律咨询案例中表明两种伦理框架都要求撤回，但后果论在撤回已过晚、无法防止损害时不再要求撤回。
AI.motivation: 诚实断言者可能事后发现其断言为假。此类"错误真理"并非谎言，但引发一个规范性问题：说话者是否必须撤回、依据何种道德理由撤回。既有基于信念的言语行为评价框架只处理断言发出时刻，未覆盖撤回这一后续行为。
AI.method: 以FIPA-ACL的disconfirm言语行为建模撤回；将原框架（在义务论与后果论下评价言语行为）扩展至撤回情形；对义务论诚实义务进行形式化证明，并引入"持续性义务"（禁止让听者继续相信说话者已不再相信的内容）；用Answer Set Programming实现一个法律咨询案例进行检验。
AI.result: 证明义务论的诚实义务仅作用于话语发出之时，因而从不要求撤回错误真理；加入持续性义务后可推导出撤回要求。案例实验显示：义务论与后果论均要求撤回；但当撤回过晚、无法防止损害时，后果论不再要求撤回，两者出现分歧。
AI.conclusion: 撤回义务不能由断言时刻的诚实义务推出，需额外的持续性义务；义务论与后果论在"及时撤回"上一致，在"过晚撤回"上分化，说明伦理框架选择对撤回规范判断具有实质影响。

title: VivaWorld: Long-Horizon Video World Model With Compositional 3D Priors
summary: Long-horizon video generation is key to interactive world modeling, physical intelligence, and spatial reasoning, yet maintaining geometric consistency and accurate camera control remains challenging without 3D grounding. We introduce \textbf{VivaWorld}, a framework for generating geometry- and view-consistent long videos from an image. We first construct a compositional hybrid 3D representation that combines reconstructed point clouds, which preserve observed scene geometry and appearance, with generated textured meshes, which provide complete object geometry across $360^\circ$ novel views. We also introduce a connected-region filter removing inconsistent floating components for robust cross-view reconstruction and propose a hybrid camera embedding that combines global and object-anchored Plücker rays to capture both scene-level camera motion and camera-object relationships, and inject it together with the visual guidance into a video generation model via a control adapter. Extensive experiments show VivaWorld achieves state-of-the-art visual quality and camera control, while supporting controllable novel-view synthesis, long-horizon scene exploration, and physical AI. Project page is available at: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/sil/projects/vivaworld/

AI.tldr: VivaWorld：从单张图像生成几何一致、视角可控的长视频，通过混合3D表示（重建点云+生成纹理网格）与混合相机嵌入实现长时程场景探索。
AI.motivation: 长时程视频生成对交互式世界建模、物理智能与空间推理至关重要，但缺乏3D grounding时难以保持几何一致性与精确相机控制。
AI.method: 1) 构建组合式混合3D表示：重建点云保留已观测场景几何与外观，生成式纹理网格补全360°新视角下的物体几何；2) 引入连通区域滤波去除不一致的悬浮组件，提升跨视角重建鲁棒性；3) 提出混合相机嵌入，将全局与物体锚定的Plücker射线结合，同时刻画场景级相机运动与相机-物体关系，并与视觉引导一起通过控制适配器注入视频生成模型。
AI.result: 大量实验表明VivaWorld在视觉质量与相机控制上达到SOTA，并支持可控新视角合成、长时程场景探索及物理AI应用。
AI.conclusion: 以混合3D表示为几何先验、以混合相机嵌入强化可控性，可有效实现图像到长视频的几何与视角一致生成。

title: Normalizing Flows are Capable World Models
comment: An earlier version of this work was accepted at the Workshop on Learning Effective Abstractions for Planning (LEAP) at CoRL 2026
summary: A world model lets an agent anticipate the consequences of its actions and use imagined futures to make decisions. We introduce Normalizing-Flow World Model (NFWM), which pairs an invertible observation encoder with an action-conditioned probabilistic predictor. Because the encoder is invertible, the predicted distribution over latent states defines a distribution over future observations. Maximizing the exact conditional likelihood of those observations therefore trains the representation and dynamics jointly. An agent can plan directly in the learned latent space and decode sampled trajectories to inspect possible futures. On Teleport, these samples capture the two possible outcomes of the same action. In Flappy Bird, a world model trained by likelihood alone supports reward-based planning that reaches 100 pipes in all ten evaluated games. For goal-conditioned control, an auxiliary inverse-dynamics objective shapes the coordinates used to compare predicted states with a goal. On LIBERO, NFWM uses this distance to select successful action sequences more often than LeWM and SMWM. In Atari Boxing, training on imagined trajectories improves a policy beyond its behavior-cloned initialization. Together, these results establish normalizing flows as capable world models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出归一化流世界模型（NFWM），用可逆观测编码器配合动作条件概率预测器，通过最大化观测的精确条件似然联合训练表示与动力学，并在多个任务上验证其在规划与目标条件控制中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 世界模型需要让智能体预判动作后果并借助想象未来做决策。关键在于如何让潜空间动力学与观测空间保持严格的概率对应关系，从而使表示学习和动力学学习能够以统一的目标联合优化，而不是依赖重构损失或对比损失的近似。
AI.method: 采用可逆（归一化流）观测编码器与动作条件概率预测器配对：由于编码器可逆，潜状态上的预测分布经由可逆映射精确诱导出未来观测分布，因此可直接最大化观测的精确条件似然来联合训练表示与动力学。智能体在学到的潜空间中直接规划，并解码采样轨迹以可视化可能的未来。在目标条件控制中，引入辅助逆动力学目标来塑造用于比较预测状态与目标的坐标度量。
AI.result: Teleport 任务中，采样能捕获同一动作对应的两种可能结果；Flappy Bird 中仅用似然训练的世界模型支撑基于奖励的规划，在全部十局评估中均到达 100 根管道；LIBERO 上，NFWM 借助逆动力学塑形的距离比 LeWM 和 SMWM 更频繁地选出成功动作序列；Atari Boxing 中，基于想象轨迹的训练使策略性能超越行为克隆初始化。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明归一化流可作为能力强、可靠的世界模型：精确似然训练即可支撑长程规划，逆动力学辅助目标有助于构建有效目标距离度量，想象轨迹还能进一步提升策略。作者据此主张归一化流是构建世界模型的可行且有力的选择。

title: BOT-Scale: A Traceable Evaluation Methodology for Robotic Manipulation
summary: A successful manipulation rollout can still involve a mid-task object drop or a placement deviation. Existing evaluators reduce such deviations to a single score or attach explanations computed separately; the score itself explains neither its basis nor what to fix. We show that a manipulation score becomes traceable when defined as the sum of outcome-conditioned penalties over retained behavioral-factor records. Explanation and score share the same computation, so each factor-level deduction names an inspectable deviation. BOT-Scale applies this principle by adapting behavioral assessment scales from medicine. It organizes twelve candidate factors into four assessment layers; each factor is tied to observable evidence and an explicit decision criterion. Reference calibration fixes a penalty per factor, and a closed-form rule aggregates the factor records into a score with per-factor contributions. We developed BOTScorer, an automatic scoring system based on the seven factors retained by data-driven screening, to validate this methodology. We provide BOT-Events, a dataset with eight-rater quality scores and factor-event annotations, alongside the traceable, interpretable score. The code will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 提出BOT-Scale可追溯评分框架，将操作任务评分定义为保留行为因子记录上的结果条件惩罚之和，并开发自动评分系统BOTScorer与数据集BOT-Events进行验证。
AI.motivation: 现有评估器把任务中的物体掉落、放置偏差等问题压缩为单一分数，或另行附加解释；分数本身既不能说明依据，也无法指出需改进之处，缺乏可追溯性。
AI.method: 借鉴医学行为评估量表，将12个候选因子组织为4个评估层，每个因子绑定可观测证据与明确判定准则；通过参考校准为每个因子固定惩罚值，并用闭式规则将因子记录聚合为含逐因子贡献的分数。基于数据驱动筛选保留的7个因子开发自动评分系统BOTScorer，并构建含8位评分者质量分数与因子事件标注的数据集BOT-Events。
AI.result: 评分与解释共享同一计算过程，每个因子级扣分都对应一个可检查的偏差；BOTScorer实现自动化评分，BOT-Events提供多评分者标注与可追溯、可解释分数，用于方法验证。
AI.conclusion: 将操作评分定义为因子级条件惩罚之和，可使分数与解释统一、可追溯且可解释，为操作任务评估提供可落地的自动化方案；代码将公开发布。

title: Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision-Language Models via Agentic Model Editing
summary: Few-shot adaptation transfers pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to new domains using a small set of labeled images. Most methods fit prompts, representations, or classifiers within an adaptation procedure specified in advance. Yet the visual distinctions needed for recognition can differ substantially across domains, motivating the question: Can an LLM agent use few-shot examples and model observations to design the adaptation procedure itself? We propose Agentic Model Editing (AME), an agentic framework that jointly designs input transformations, encoder edits, feature computation, and classifier fitting as an executable, domain-customized adaptation program. The agent inspects images, class semantics, model parameters, intermediate representations, and activations to formulate hypotheses about the target task. It implements and tests candidate programs on the support set, with aggregate validation accuracy guiding refinement and selection. Each program fits a complete domain model that is fixed before testing. The agent and its tools are shared across domains, while each domain receives its own adaptation program. Across eleven datasets with CLIP ViT-B/16, AME achieves the highest average accuracies of 81.2% without back-propagation and 81.9% with back-propagation among the compared methods. Further experiments demonstrate applicability across VLM backbones and LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 提出Agentic Model Editing (AME)框架，让LLM智能体利用少样本示例与模型内部观测，自主设计并实现面向特定领域的适配程序（涵盖输入变换、编码器编辑、特征计算与分类器拟合），在11个数据集上取得81.2%（无反向传播）/81.9%（有反向传播）的平均最高准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有少样本适配方法（提示微调、表征适配、分类器拟合）均依赖预先固定的适配流程，但目标识别所需的视觉判别信息在不同领域差异显著，预定义流程难以通用，因此需要一种能针对领域自动定制适配流程的方案。
AI.method: AME是一个智能体框架：LLM智能体检查图像、类语义、模型参数、中间表征与激活，形成关于目标任务假设；将输入变换、编码器编辑、特征计算、分类器拟合联合设计为可执行的领域定制适配程序；在support set上实现并测试候选程序，以聚合验证准确率指导迭代改进与选择；每个程序在测试前拟合出完整领域模型；智能体与工具跨领域共享，但每个领域获得各自独立的适配程序。
AI.result: 在CLIP ViT-B/16上的11个数据集中，AME在所比较方法中取得最高平均准确率：无反向传播81.2%，有反向传播81.9%；进一步实验验证了其在不同VLM骨干与不同LLM智能体上的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将适配流程本身交由智能体自动设计是可行且有效的，能超越预先指定流程的少样本适配范式，并具备跨VLM骨干和跨智能体的可迁移性。

title: What Is Redundant at High Resolution? Efficient Attention and Feed-Forward Design for All-in-One Image Restoration
summary: Multi-scale architectures are widely adopted in all-in-one image restoration (AIO-IR) to capture larger-scale context at low-resolution stages and refine details at high-resolution (HR) stages. However, processing spatially large feature maps at HR stages incurs substantial computational costs and memory traffic, making efficient HR processing challenging. To address this challenge, we propose High-resolution Global-Local Restoration (HiGLR), an efficient multi-scale AIO-IR network grounded in an analysis of spatial redundancy in self-attention and convolutional feed-forward networks (ConvFFNs). Specifically, this analysis identifies three key redundancies: per-query readout at the finest-scale stage, key routing across neighboring queries at intermediate stages, and spatial mixing in the expanded feature spaces of ConvFFNs. Accordingly, HiGLR replaces costly self-attention at the finest-scale stage with a learned input-independent kernel. At intermediate stages, we propose a Block-Routed Hybrid Attention, which combines coarse-scale dense attention with fine-scale block-sparse attention over value residuals relative to coarse summaries, and shares routing indices across neighboring queries. We further introduce a Dual-Space FFN that performs spatial mixing in a compact space and pointwise nonlinear transformation in an expanded space, enabling efficient kernel fusion. Combining these designs, HiGLR achieves state-of-the-art performance while delivering up to a $4.24\times$ inference speedup over existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HiGLR，一种基于空间冗余分析的高效多尺度一体化图像复原网络，通过消除自注意力与ConvFFN中的三类冗余，在达到SOTA性能的同时实现最高4.24倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 多尺度架构在AIO-IR中广泛用于在低分辨率阶段获取大尺度上下文、在高分辨率阶段精修细节，但在高分辨率阶段处理大空间特征图的计算与访存开销巨大，高效HR处理困难。
AI.method: 基于对自注意力与卷积前馈网络（ConvFFN）中空间冗余的分析，识别出三类冗余：最细尺度阶段的逐查询读出、中间阶段相邻查询间的键路由、以及ConvFFN扩展特征空间中的空间混合。据此设计三项模块：(1) 最细尺度阶段用与输入无关的可学习核替代昂贵的自注意力；(2) 中间阶段提出Block-Routed Hybrid Attention，将粗尺度稠密注意力与基于相对粗摘要的值残差的细尺度块稀疏注意力结合，并在相邻查询间共享路由索引；(3) 提出Dual-Space FFN，在紧致空间做空间混合、在扩展空间做逐点非线性变换，从而支持高效核融合。
AI.result: HiGLR达到SOTA性能，相较现有方法取得最高4.24倍推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 对空间冗余的显式建模与重构是提升多尺度AIO-IR高分辨率处理效率的有效途径，可在不牺牲复原质量的前提下显著降低计算与访存成本。

title: Random Voronoi Networks
summary: Nearest-neighbor methods are local, simple, and interpretable, but their non-parametric form makes them memory-intensive, expensive at inference, and difficult to integrate into differentiable neural architectures. We introduce Random Voronoi Networks (RVNs), a family of structured three-layer MLPs that express nearest-neighbor geometry through sampled Voronoi comparisons. The first layer computes Random Voronoi Features (RVF) from affine pairwise separators between selected training samples, the second layer aggregates these comparisons into Voronoi cells or top-k neighborhood scores, and the readout layer produces classification or regression predictions. We show that, when all samples and pairwise comparisons are included, step RVNs recover exact Euclidean k-NN, while ReLU RVNs provide a violation-score realization for 1-NN that can be relaxed into a differentiable soft weighting. Subsampling yields approximate RVNs with explicit control over the number of cells and features. We study several unsupervised sampling methods that trade off random coverage, directional diversity, coordinate sparsity, and empirical feature variance. Empirically, RVFs produce a highly effective data encoding strategy, providing performance boosts to downstream methods ranging from linear to modern tabular deep learning models. Finally, we showcase that RVF provides an interpretable feature map due to its k-NN based construction and ties to pairwise local directions. These results position our Random Voronoi formulation as a bridge between nearest-neighbor rules, random features, and modern tabular models.

AI.tldr: 提出随机Voronoi网络（RVNs）：以采样Voronoi比较构造三层结构化MLP，其第一层随机Voronoi特征（RVF）在全样本、全比较时可精确复现欧氏k-NN，子采样则得到可控的近似版本，并可作为通用表格数据的有效、可解释特征编码。
AI.motivation: 最近邻方法局部、简单、可解释，但非参数形式导致内存开销大、推理代价高，且难以嵌入可微神经网络架构；作者希望在最近邻规则、随机特征与现代表格模型之间建立桥梁。
AI.method: 设计三层MLP结构：第一层由选定训练样本间的仿射成对分离器计算随机Voronoi特征（RVF）；第二层将比较结果聚合为Voronoi单元或top-k邻域得分；读出层输出分类/回归。理论上证明全样本全比较时阶跃型RVN等价于精确欧氏k-NN，ReLU型RVN给出1-NN的违背分数实现并可松弛为可微软加权；通过子采样得到单元数与特征数显式可控的近似RVN，并研究兼顾随机覆盖、方向多样性、坐标稀疏性与经验特征方差的多种无监督采样策略。
AI.result: RVF作为数据编码策略效果显著，可提升从线性模型到现代表格深度学习模型等下游方法的表现；同时由于基于k-NN构造并与成对局部方向相关，RVF提供可解释的特征映射。
AI.conclusion: 随机Voronoi表述将最近邻规则、随机特征与表格模型统一起来，兼具精确性（全量情形下等价k-NN）、可扩展性（子采样近似）与可解释性，是一种有前景的表格数据表示与建模框架。

title: Co-World Model for Human-Video-to-Robot Transfer via Co-Constructed Shared Latent Dynamics
summary: Human videos are abundant and cheap to obtain, whereas robot trajectories remain scarce and costly, making zero-shot skill transfer from a single human demonstration an appealing route to scalable robot learning. Existing methods, however, either retarget human-specific geometry or match only static visual goals, and thus stumble over the cross-embodiment dynamics mismatch and the ungrounded action execution. We present the Co-World Model (CoWM), a predictive framework jointly optimized from paired yet unsynchronized human and robot streams. To bridge the cross-embodiment dynamics gap, CoWM disentangles each observation into a shared object-relation state and embodiment-specific context. It aligns latent actions across embodiments using effect-swap and action-sensitivity objectives,such that actions are matched by their predicted effects on the manipulated objects rather than by embodimentdependent kinematics. For grounded execution, a phase-aware receding-horizon controller estimates demonstration progress, projects the inferred human action prior onto the robot action-support density, and translates the resulting latent dynamics into executable robot commands. Extensive experiments in simulation and on two physical robot platforms demonstrate the effectiveness of CoWM, its cross-platform generalizability, and the contribution of each component. See the demo video in the supporting information for details.

AI.tldr: 提出Co-World Model（CoWM），一种从配对但不同步的人类视频与机器人轨迹联合优化的预测框架，通过对齐跨具身潜动作与阶段感知滚动时域控制，实现单次人类演示的零样本技能迁移。
AI.motivation: 人类视频廉价易得而机器人轨迹稀缺昂贵，从单次人类演示做零样本迁移是通往可扩展机器人学习的理想路径；但现有方法要么重定向人类特有几何，要么只匹配静态视觉目标，因而受困于跨具身动力学失配与动作执行缺乏落地（ungrounded）。
AI.method: CoWM以配对但不同步的双流数据联合优化：将观测解耦为共享的物体关系状态与具身特有上下文，以弥合跨具身动力学差距；通过effect-swap与动作敏感性目标对齐跨具身潜动作，使动作按其对被操作物体的预测效果而非具身相关运动学来匹配；执行端采用阶段感知滚动时域控制器，估计演示进度，将推断出的人类动作先验投影到机器人动作支撑密度上，并把潜动力学翻译为可执行机器人指令。
AI.result: 在仿真环境与两台实体机器人平台上的大量实验表明：CoWM具有有效性、跨平台泛化能力，且各组件均有可验证贡献。
AI.conclusion: 通过"效果对齐"替代"运动学/视觉对齐"、并以阶段感知控制器保证落地执行，CoWM为单次人类演示的零样本跨具身技能迁移提供了可行且可泛化的预测式方案。

title: Budget, Readout or Reasoning? Where Small Reasoning Models Lose Value in Auction Bidding
comment: 19 pages, 2 figures, 23 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/DataismLab/bid-reasoning
summary: Ad platforms and marketplaces show bidders a bid landscape, the estimated chance of winning at each candidate bid, and increasingly let agents built on reasoning language models choose the bid. We give six open reasoning models of 4B to 14B parameters such landscapes, with win curves from eBay closing prices and from a simulated advertising market (AuctionNet), and score their bids on held-out auctions against an exact calculator. Because the agent is handed the estimates, the lost value can be split by cause. Two failures belong to the models. They pass over the best option even when the values written in their own trace already rank it first, and their wrong answers lean toward the highest bid on the menu. The lean is about the bid's size, not its place in the list, and it survives sampling. At 768 forced tokens on eBay, under pay-your-bid pricing, the wrong answers cost bidders 7-17% of the surplus the calculator's bids earn. Arithmetic errors are rare. Two further losses come from operator choices. A token cap cuts traces short: allowed to stop on their own within 4,096 tokens, five models recover 91-100% of the calculator's lead over a model that does no reasoning. Asking for the answer while the reasoning block is still open misreads it: closing the block first lifts the weakest model from 42% to 84% on eBay and from 24% to 81% on AuctionNet. Finally, an audit that flags bids disagreeing with the trace's own numbers, and overrides them with the calculator's bid, raises the share of the calculator's lead recovered at 768 forced tokens from 42-85% to 84-100% on eBay under nested cross-validation, and the same reader settings transfer from eBay to AuctionNet.

AI.tldr: 该论文让6个4B-14B开源推理模型基于出价景观（bid landscape）直接给出竞价，并与精确计算器对比，将价值损失按原因分解为两类模型失误（忽视自身轨迹中已排序为最优的选项、错误答案偏向菜单上最高价）与两类操作者选择失误（token上限截断推理、推理块未闭合就索取答案）。
AI.motivation: 广告平台与交易市场日益让基于推理语言模型的智能体直接选择出价，但其在给定win curve下的决策质量与误差来源尚缺乏可归因的量化评估。
AI.method: 向6个4B-14B参数的开源推理模型提供来自eBay成交价与模拟广告市场AuctionNet的win curve，在留出拍卖上用精确计算器为其出价打分；利用"估计值已给定"的条件将损失按成因拆分；另设4,096 token自主停止实验、闭合推理块前后对比，以及交叉验证下的审计器（标记与轨迹数字不一致的出价并用计算器出价覆盖）。
AI.result: 在eBay、pay-your-bid定价、768强制token下，错误答案使竞标者损失计算器出价所获剩余的7-17%，算术错误罕见；错误偏向最高出价约与出价绝对大小相关而非列表位置，且在采样下仍然存在。允许在4,096 token内自主停止时，5个模型可恢复计算器相对无推理模型领先优势的91-100%；先闭合推理块使最弱模型在eBay从42%升至84%、AuctionNet从24%升至81%；审计覆盖机制在嵌套交叉验证下将768 token时恢复比例从42-85%提升至84-100%，且读取设置在eBay与AuctionNet间可迁移。
AI.conclusion: 推理模型竞价的损失可清晰归因：一部分源于模型层面的系统性偏差（如向高价倾斜），可通过审计覆盖纠偏；另一部分源于操作者层面的推理预算与解析设置，仅需闭合推理块或放宽token上限即可大幅回收价值。该归因框架为可靠部署LLM竞价智能体提供了可操作的改进路径。

title: CariesBench: A Hierarchical Multi-view Benchmark for Dental Caries Screening and Diagnostic Reasoning from 3D Intraoral Scans
summary: Dental caries assessment is a structured clinical process requiring lesion localization, identification of the affected tooth and surface, and severity grading rather than simple image-level recognition. 3D intraoral scans (IOS) preserve detailed dental geometry and surface morphology and support standardized rendering from complementary viewpoints, enabling fine-grained visual assessment while introducing a distinct need for anatomically grounded multi-view reasoning. Despite recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and dental vision-language benchmarks, existing evaluations do not jointly assess hierarchical arch-to-tooth-to-surface reasoning, cross-view evidence integration, and surface-level caries assessment. To address this gap, we introduce CariesBench, a hierarchical benchmark constructed from 5,932 3D IOS, comprising 85,455 standardized multi-view renderings and 133,994 clinically grounded visual question answering instances with expert quality control. CariesBench comprises three complementary task families: Arch-level Clinical Screening (ACS), Tooth-level Diagnostic Reasoning (TDR), and Structured Clinical Decision-Making (SCD). Using the CariesBench training set, we further fine-tune Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct to obtain IntraoralGPT. Extensive evaluation of 24 representative baseline MLLMs reveals a substantial benchmark-level performance disparity between arch-level screening and tooth-level diagnostic reasoning, with higher accuracy on ACS than on TDR. CariesBench-specific supervision substantially improves the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct baseline, increasing the 19-task macro-average clinical accuracy from 52.7% to 69.5% and TDR Overall from 34.4% to 44.7%.

AI.tldr: 提出CariesBench——基于5,932例3D口内扫描、含85,455张多视角渲染图与133,994条临床问答的分层龋病评估基准，并微调得到IntraoralGPT；24个MLLM基线显示牙弓级筛查优于牙位级诊断，专用监督将19任务宏平均准确率从52.7%提升至69.5%。
AI.motivation: 龋病评估是有结构的临床流程，需完成病变定位、受累牙位与牙面识别及严重度分级，而非图像级简单识别。3D口内扫描（IOS）保留牙体几何与表面形态，支持标准化多视角渲染，因而既提供细粒度视觉信息，也要求具备解剖学基础的多视角推理能力。尽管多模态大模型与牙科视觉语言基准已有进展，现有评测未能同时考察"牙弓—牙位—牙面"分层推理、跨视角证据整合与牙面级龋病评估，存在评测空白。
AI.method: 构建CariesBench分层基准：数据源为5,932例3D IOS，经标准化多视角渲染生成85,455张图像，并配套133,994条具临床依据的VQA实例，经专家质控。任务族包括牙弓级临床筛查（ACS）、牙位级诊断推理（TDR）与结构化临床决策（SCD）。另利用其训练集微调Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct，得到IntraoralGPT。
AI.result: 对24个代表性基线MLLM的大规模评测显示，牙弓级筛查与牙位级诊断推理之间存在显著的基准级性能落差，ACS准确率高于TDR。CariesBench专用监督显著改善Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct基线：19任务宏平均临床准确率由52.7%升至69.5%，TDR Overall由34.4%升至44.7%。
AI.conclusion: CariesBench填补了分层解剖推理、跨视角证据整合与牙面级评估联合评测的空白，可作为3D口内扫描龋病诊断的标准化测试平台；结果表明显式分层监督有效，但牙位级细粒度诊断仍是当前MLLM的主要短板，留有较大提升空间。

title: The Gradient Difference Induced by Detaching the Denominator in QK Normalization
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Yuanqi Zhang and Haocheng Wang contributed equally
summary: QK normalization divides each query and key by its own RMS norm before the attention scores are computed. Treating this denominator as a constant during backpropagation leaves the forward pass unchanged but alters the parameter gradients. We derive a closed form for the difference between the gradient under this detached rule and the gradient under the standard rule. For a single token, this difference is parallel to the token's own query; it changes only the query norm and has no first-order effect after normalization. The queries, however, are computed by a projection matrix $W_Q$ shared across all tokens. The gradient difference on $W_Q$ therefore equals $W_Q$ right-multiplied by a weighted second moment of the inputs, and it decomposes exactly into three components: a radial component that changes only the norm of $W_Q$, a tangential component that changes the query directions of other tokens, and an upstream component that changes the gradient passed to earlier layers. Under AdamW, the radial component drives $W_Q$ to a larger equilibrium norm and reduces its angular update per step. Paired experiments on a small Transformer language model are consistent with this analysis. Detaching the query denominator consistently raises the test loss, and the gap persists across hardware, evaluation datasets and learning rates. All three components remain non-negligible throughout training, with the tangential component the largest. Norm growth and the smaller angular update appear only on the detached projection matrix, while the other projection matrix is essentially unchanged. With a learnable scale, however, we observe no resolvable loss gap.

AI.tldr: 本文将QK归一化中分母的梯度处理方式（detach与否）作为研究对象，推导出detached梯度与标准梯度的闭式差值，证明其对W_Q的梯度差可精确分解为径向、切向和上游三个分量，并解释AdamW下该差异导致W_Q范数增大、角度更新减小；小规模Transformer实验与理论一致，detach会持续抬高测试loss，但引入可学习缩放后差距不可分辨。
AI.motivation: QK归一化在实现中常把每个query/key自身的RMS范数当作常数对待（detach），前向不变但改变了参数梯度。这种常见工程做法究竟带来何种函数层面的影响缺乏理论刻画与实证验证，作者因此希望给出梯度差的闭式表达并量化其后果。
AI.method: 对单token推导detached规则与标准规则梯度差的闭式形式，揭示其与自身query平行、仅改变query范数且在一阶意义上无影响；再利用W_Q跨token共享，导出W_Q上梯度差等于W_Q右乘输入加权二阶矩，并精确分解为径向（改变W_Q范数）、切向（改变其他token的query方向）和上游（改变传向浅层梯度）三部分；结合AdamW分析范数与角度更新的动力学；在小型Transformer语言模型上做配对实验，跨硬件、评测数据集与学习率检验。
AI.result: detach query分母会一致抬高测试loss，且差距在硬件、数据集与学习率变化下持续存在；三个分量在整个训练过程中均不可忽略，其中切向分量最大；范数增长与角度更新减小只出现在被detach的投影矩阵上，另一投影矩阵基本不变；但当引入可学习缩放时，未观察到可分辨的loss差距。
AI.conclusion: detach QK归一化分母并非无害的数值实现细节，它通过共享的W_Q耦合到整个优化轨迹，改变范数与更新几何从而损害性能；可学习缩放可消除该差距，提示其与归一化尺度自由度相关。研究为QK-norm的实现选择提供了理论依据与实践建议。

title: LUDIUS: A Benchmark for Embodied Social Intelligence in Everyday Human-Robot Interactions
summary: Social intelligence in a robot requires interpreting a situation from the perspectives of the people involved and using that understanding to decide when and how to act. We introduce LUDIUS, a benchmark for evaluating how vision-language models exercise this judgment through a robot's verbal responses and actions, organized around 15 social intelligence skills drawn from social psychology, sociology, and cognitive science. LUDIUS comprises six editions, each a collection of episodes spanning one simulated week. Three editions each cover all 15 skills in a different household. The other three focus on interactions involving multiple people, safety, and context-specific norms, respectively. We evaluate frontier models and a smaller model finetuned on social-interaction data we generated, using a common evaluation harness. The harness supplies each model with the robot's camera views and residents' reactions, retrieves relevant interaction history, and converts the model's tool calls into robot verbal responses and actions. Models tend to perform worse when they must reason about what a resident saw or heard earlier, reconcile competing interests, or fulfill a request within safety constraints and household rules. Beyond the home setting, LUDIUS's design pipeline offers a way to construct social intelligence benchmarks by translating social intelligence skills into context-specific judgments and observable robot behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出 LUDIUS 基准，通过机器人的语言回应与行动来评测视觉-语言模型的社会智能，覆盖15项社会智能技能，含6个版本（3个跨家庭全技能版 + 多人/安全/情境规范3个专题版），每个版本为模拟一周的episode集合。
AI.motivation: 机器人社会智能要求从当事人视角解读情境并据此决定何时、如何行动；现有基准缺乏对VLM在此类判断上（尤其是多视角心理状态推理、利益协调、安全与家规约束）的系统评测手段。
AI.method: 从社会心理学、社会学与认知科学归纳15项社会智能技能；构建6个edition的episode集（各模拟一周）；统一评测框架向模型提供机器人相机视角与居民反应、检索相关交互历史，并将模型的工具调用转换为机器人的语言回应与动作；评测前沿模型及在自生成社会交互数据上微调的小模型。
AI.result: 模型在需推理"居民此前看到/听到什么"、协调相互冲突的利益、或在安全约束与家庭规则下完成请求时表现明显下降。
AI.conclusion: LUDIUS不仅提供家庭场景评测，其设计流水线也给出将社会智能技能转译为情境特定判断与可观测机器人行为、从而构建社会智能基准的通用方法。

title: Not Every Input Needs Everything: Unifying Expert Gating, Model Cascades, and Agent Orchestration
summary: Executing monolithic neural weights, frontier foundation models, or entire multi-agent workflows uniformly on every input incurs substantial computational, latency, and monetary overhead. Conditional computation mitigates this cost by deciding dynamically which internal experts, model endpoints, or specialized agents to invoke per request. Yet token-level gating in sparse neural architectures, query-level model cascades, and task-level multi-agent coordination have largely progressed in disconnected research silos, obscuring recurring system failures and transferable fixes. In this systematic review, we synthesize 2,289 studies published between 2017 and September 2026 (selected from 13,884 unique records) across 20 methodological families under a unified two-step inspect-then-allocate framework. Discrete hard selection accounts for 70%, 83%, and 91% of token-, query-, and task-scale literature respectively, and computational overhead appears as a top operational bottleneck across every layer. Engineering safeguards remain sharply asymmetric: intra-layer gating prioritizes load balancing while rarely incorporating uncertainty estimation, whereas model selection and agent orchestration rely on confidence thresholds and budget rules while confronting miscalibration and cascading errors. At the same time, publication volume is accelerating fastest in agentic task delegation, where routing mechanisms are least often isolated experimentally and methodological bias risk is highest.

AI.tldr: 本文对2017—2026年间2,289篇条件计算研究进行系统综述，提出统一的"先检查、后分配"（inspect-then-allocate）两步框架，将token级稀疏门控、query级模型级联与task级多智能体协调三个割裂方向整合，揭示了跨尺度反复出现的系统性失效与可迁移的补救措施。
AI.motivation: 在单一输入上无差别地运行完整权重、基础模型或多智能体工作流会带来巨大的计算、延迟与金钱开销；条件计算通过动态决定调用哪些专家、模型端点或专门智能体来降低成本。但token级门控、query级级联与task级协调长期在各自研究孤岛中发展，导致共性问题被遮蔽、经验难以迁移。
AI.method: 系统性综述：从13,884条唯一记录中筛选出2,289项2017年至2026年9月发表的研究，归纳为20个方法学族，并在统一的"检查—分配"两步框架下进行跨尺度对比分析，统计各尺度的离散硬选择比例、运行瓶颈与工程保障措施。
AI.result: 离散硬选择在token、query、task三个尺度分别占70%、83%、91%；计算开销在每一层级都是最主要的运行瓶颈之一。工程保障呈显著不对称：层内门控侧重负载均衡而极少引入不确定性估计；模型选择与智能体编排依赖置信度阈值和预算规则，却面临校准偏差与级联错误。发表量增长最快的是智能体任务委派方向，而其路由机制最少被实验隔离、方法学偏倚风险最高。
AI.conclusion: 条件计算各尺度存在可迁移的共性失效模式，亟需以统一框架开展跨尺度研究；尤其是智能体委派方向的方法学严谨性不足，应加强路由机制的实验隔离与偏倚控制。

title: Linear-Time Online Visual Geometry Transformer with Hybrid Architecture
summary: Transformer-based 3D reconstruction models such as VGGT and $π^3$ predict cameras, depth and point maps directly from many input views. Causal attention models such as StreamVGGT extend them to online video but cache all past tokens, so their total compute grows quadratically with the stream length. Recurrent models such as CUT3R and TTT3R keep a fixed-size state at constant cost, but they progressively forget early geometry. We present LinearVGGT, a hybrid model distilled from StreamVGGT, which uses Mamba2 layers for efficient sequence modeling in three of every four global layers. The remaining layers use register-guided sparse attention to retrieve a few relevant past frames, compensating for the limited exact long-range recall of Mamba2. Our distillation needs only 9\% of the GPU hours and 31\% of the training frames that StreamVGGT uses to learn from VGGT. LinearVGGT keeps an almost constant latency of 27 ms per frame over 1,024 frames and is on average $12 \times$ faster than StreamVGGT. It outperforms its teacher and is competitive with the state-of-the-art streaming model LingBot-Map, while running $2.5\times$ faster and using $2.7\times$ less memory.

AI.tldr: LinearVGGT：从StreamVGGT蒸馏的混合架构流式3D重建模型，用Mamba2层替代3/4的全局层，并以寄存器引导的稀疏注意力补偿长程精确召回，实现近恒定每帧27ms延迟、平均比StreamVGGT快12倍。
AI.motivation: 现有流式3D重建存在两难：因果注意力模型（如StreamVGGT）缓存全部历史token，总计算随流长度二次增长；循环模型（CUT3R、TTT3R）虽以固定状态保持常数开销，却会渐进遗忘早期几何。作者希望在保持长序列精确几何记忆的同时获得近常数计算。
AI.method: 提出LinearVGGT，一个从StreamVGGT蒸馏的混合模型。每四个全局层中三层替换为Mamba2层，用于高效序列建模；剩余层使用register-guided稀疏注意力，检索少量相关历史帧，以弥补Mamba2在精确长程召回上的不足。蒸馏仅需StreamVGGT学习VGGT所用GPU时数的9%与训练帧数的31%。
AI.result: 在1,024帧上保持约27ms/帧的近恒定延迟，平均比StreamVGGT快12倍；性能优于其教师模型StreamVGGT，并与当前最优流式模型LingBot-Map竞争力相当，同时速度快2.5倍、内存少2.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 以线性序列模型为主体、辅以少量稀疏注意力的混合架构，可在流式3D重建中兼顾效率与长程几何一致性，并以较低蒸馏成本超越教师模型。

title: On the Learnability of Model Reprogramming: A Reachability and Relabeling Perspective
summary: Model reprogramming adapts a frozen source model to a target task by wrapping it in a learnable input transformation from target input to the source-model input space, and an output mapping from source-model outputs to target predictions. Despite extensive empirical progress, the finite-sample learnability of the induced wrapper hypothesis class $\mathcal{F}_{\rm MR}$ remains underexplored. We address this for source models that expose hard source labels and analyze it through the wrapper structure: on any target samples, the input transformation selects reachable source labels that the output mapping relabels. Through this lens, we answer two questions: (1) how many target samples are needed to approach the best predictor in $\mathcal{F}_{\rm MR}$, and (2) what gap remains between the optimum over $\mathcal{F}_{\rm MR}$ and the target Bayes risk. For (1), the wrapper structure factorizes the sample-wise complexity of $\mathcal{F}_{\rm MR}$ into a reachability term counting reachable source-label patterns, and a conditional relabeling term counting their relabelings. This yields an agnostic-PAC bound on the estimation error, with sample complexity scaling additively in the two terms; this bound becomes closed-form on additive input transformations and is matched by a lower bound on an explicit binary classification construction. For (2), the same structure decomposes the approximation error exactly into the source-label information loss and output-mapping restriction with a source-conditional upper bound on this gap. We extend the approximation analysis to logit-exposing source models, where the upper bound is empirically estimable. The wrapper-side analysis localizes both errors to specific components, giving a structural view of reprogramming practice.

AI.tldr: 本文从wrappers结构视角分析了模型重编程假设类 F_MR 的有限样本可学习性，给出加性样本复杂度的PAC上界（并由二分类构造的下界匹配），并把近似误差精确分解为源标签信息损失与输出映射限制两部分。
AI.motivation: 模型重编程经验上进展丰富，但其诱导的wrapper假设类 F_MR 的有限样本可学习性（样本复杂度与逼近误差）缺乏理论刻画。
AI.method: 针对输出硬源标签的源模型，利用wrapper结构（输入变换选择可达源标签、输出映射对其重标签）将样本级复杂度分解为"可达性项"（可达源标签模式计数）与"条件重标签项"（其重标签计数）；对加性输入变换推出闭式PAC界，并用显式二分类构造给出匹配下界；对近似误差做精确分解并扩展到暴露logit的源模型，使其上界可经验估计。
AI.result: (1) 得到估计误差的agnostic-PAC界，样本复杂度在两项上加性增长，加性输入变换下为闭式且被下界匹配；(2) 近似误差被精确分解为源标签信息损失+输出映射限制，给出源条件上界，logit情形下该上界可经验估计。
AI.conclusion: wrapper侧分析将估计误差与近似误差分别定位到具体组件，为模型重编程的实践提供了结构性理论解释。

title: Beyond Natural-Language Instructions: Temporal Logic as a Task Language for VLA Models with Visual-Logical Fusion
summary: Robotic tasks combine object relations, logical dependencies, and temporal requirements, which robot planning and industrial control commonly specify in temporal logic (TL). We introduce TL-VLA, a vision--language--action framework that replaces natural-language task instructions with temporal logic, making this spatiotemporal structure explicit. A typed graph encoder and visual--logical fusion condition continuous actions on the task specification and the current observations. To prepare a general vision--language backbone for this interface, we develop TL-aware robot pretraining with separate semantic and structural readouts: a frozen language teacher aligns task semantics, the structural readout encodes TL syntax to support complex, long-horizon tasks, and autoregressive action prediction connects the graph representation to robot behavior. Downstream policies inherit the pretrained backbone and TL encoder and learn new fusion and action modules. On CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D, our TL-aware initializer reaches \textbf{3.800} average chain length and \textbf{62.3\%} five-task success, compared with 3.578 and 54.5\% for a FAST initializer pretrained on the same data and 3.485 average chain length for a Qwen+NL baseline. On LIBERO-10, TL-aware initialization improves success from \textbf{91.2\% to 95.8\%}. On LIBERO-Mem, our policy reaches \textbf{65.0\%} success without observation history, compared with 45.0\% for a Qwen+NL reference. On held-out Panda planning specifications, it reaches \textbf{59.6\%} at Success@256 over three generation seeds, versus 48.4\% for Qwen+TL and 37.0\% for Qwen+NL. These results support explicit logical task conditioning and transferable TL-aware representations for robot action learning.

AI.tldr: TL-VLA 用时序逻辑（TL）替代自然语言任务指令，通过类型化图编码器与视觉-逻辑融合实现动作生成，并经 TL 感知预训练获得可迁移表征，在 CALVIN、LIBERO 及 Panda 规划任务上显著优于 NL/FAST 基线。
AI.motivation: 机器人任务天然包含物体关系、逻辑依赖与时间约束，而现有 VLA 多以自然语言下达指令，难以显式表达时空逻辑结构；作者希望让任务规格的结构化逻辑直接成为动作条件的输入。
AI.method: 提出 TL-VLA 框架：以 TL 形式化任务规格；用类型化（typed）图编码器编码 TL 语法，并与视觉观测做视觉-逻辑融合以条件化连续动作。预训练阶段构建 TL 感知机器人预训练，采用分离的语义与结构读出——冻结语言教师对齐任务语义、结构读出编码 TL 句法以支撑长时程任务、自回归动作预测将图表征连接到机器人行为；下游策略继承预训练骨干与 TL 编码器，仅学习新的融合与动作模块。
AI.result: CALVIN ABC→D：平均链长 3.800、五任务成功率 62.3%，优于同数据预训练 FAST 初始化器（3.578 / 54.5%）与 Qwen+NL 基线（链长 3.485）。LIBERO-10：成功率由 91.2% 提升至 95.8%。LIBERO-Mem：无观测历史下达 65.0%，Qwen+NL 为 45.0%。Panda 规划规格 Success@256：59.6%（三个生成种子），Qwen+TL 48.4%，Qwen+NL 37.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持显式逻辑任务条件化以及可迁移的 TL 感知表征在机器人动作学习中的有效性，表明结构化逻辑接口可替代自然语言指令并带来稳定的跨任务泛化收益。

title: Letting Models Manage Their Own Context: Where We Stand
summary: Agent harnesses today manage context on the model's behalf: when the window fills, the harness triggers a compaction that summarizes the history. We study the alternative, \emph{model-driven} context management, in which the model itself decides when and what to compact through a context API. We gave models control over their own context in \nooa, NVIDIA's open source agent harness, and compared the two strategies on document research and machine learning engineering across context budgets from 8K to 512K tokens. Models that use the context API effectively reach higher accuracy, often with fewer input tokens, especially at tight budgets: \textbf{GPT 6.1 nearly triples its score at a 32K budget} on OfficeQA Pro v2 (21\%~$\rightarrow$~56\%), and \textbf{Kimi gains with up to 41\% fewer input tokens}. Models differ widely, however, in how often they use the API, how aggressively they compact, and when they start compacting, and prompt changes shift that timing. Finally, we show that \textbf{inference engines can make model-driven edits cheaper}: by reusing the KV cache of the unchanged suffix after an edit, \textbf{we cut prefill compute by up to 15\% per request with no measurable change in accuracy}. Together, these results point to a new co-design frontier: models trained to manage their own context, served by inference engines that support KV cache editing.

AI.tldr: 论文研究"模型自主上下文管理"（model-driven context management）：在NVIDIA开源agent harness nooa中让模型通过context API自主决定何时压缩、压缩什么，并与harness代为管理上下文的压缩策略对比；发现善用该API的模型准确率更高、输入token更少，且推理引擎可通过KV cache编辑降低开销。
AI.motivation: 现有agent harness在窗口填满时由harness触发compaction、代模型摘要历史，模型对自身上下文无控制权。作者希望探究模型自主管理上下文的替代方案是否更优，以及推理引擎能否让这种编辑更廉价。
AI.method: 在nooa（NVIDIA开源agent harness）中赋予模型context API控制权；在文档研究与机器学习工程两类任务上，于8K–512K token的上下文预算范围内对比harness驱动与模型驱动两种压缩策略；并实验通过复用编辑后未变后缀的KV cache来降低prefill计算。
AI.result: 有效使用context API的模型准确率更高且常伴更少输入token，紧预算下尤为明显：GPT 6.1在32K预算下于OfficeQA Pro v2上从21%提升至56%（近三倍）；Kimi最多节省41%输入token。但模型在API调用频率、压缩激进程度、起始时机上差异显著，prompt变化会改变压缩时机。KV cache复用使每请求prefill计算最多降低15%，准确率无可测变化。
AI.conclusion: 模型自主上下文管理优于harness代管，指向新的协同设计前沿：训练模型自我管理上下文，并由支持KV cache编辑的推理引擎提供服务。

title: Fine-Grained Ego-Vehicle Action Recognition from Driving Video
summary: Fine-grained ego-vehicle action recognition turns large-scale driving video into structured, searchable driving scenarios, providing a foundation for discovering critical maneuvers and systematically developing and evaluating autonomous driving models. However, large-scale driving videos often lack explicit ego-action labels, and existing datasets vary in action definitions, annotation granularity, and available supervision. We introduce EgoManeuver, a unified benchmark of 16 lateral and 6 longitudinal actions constructed from seven public driving datasets.
