Our multi-source labeling system leverages existing annotations and complementary evidence available in each source dataset, including vehicle signals, ego poses, HD-map topology, and captions, to assign labels under a unified fine-grained action taxonomy. We further standardize temporal action boundaries across datasets and validate the resulting labels through kinematic consistency checks and targeted human review. The resulting benchmark contains 86.6K segments spanning 190.8 h across 26 countries and provides a long-tail-aware evaluation protocol. We also introduce DenseEgo, a video-based baseline that combines spatially aware representations with dense per-step action supervision. On the EgoManeuver, DenseEgo achieves 82.7 lateral and 83.5 longitudinal mAP, outperforming the strongest existing video model by 1.5 and 5.0 points, respectively. Finally, we demonstrate one way to integrate DenseEgo with a language-model agent for retrieving driving videos that match user-specified actions and scenarios. All code, datasets, and model weights will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出统一基准 EgoManeuver（16 类横向、6 类纵向动作，来自 7 个公开驾驶数据集，86.6K 片段/190.8 小时/26 国），并给出视频基线 DenseEgo，在横向/纵向 mAP 上达 82.7/83.5，分别超过最强现有视频模型 1.5 和 5.0 点。
AI.motivation: 大规模驾驶视频缺乏显式自车动作标签，且现有数据集在动作定义、标注粒度和可用监督信号上不一致，难以支撑细粒度自车动作识别与关键场景检索/评测。
AI.method: 构建多源标注系统：利用各源数据集已有的车辆信号、自车位姿、HD 地图拓扑和文本描述等互补证据，在统一的细粒度动作分类体系下赋标签；统一时间动作边界，并通过运动学一致性校验与针对性人工复核验证标签；提供长尾感知的评测协议。同时提出 DenseEgo 视频基线，将空间感知表征与逐步（per-step）稠密动作监督结合。
AI.result: 基准包含 86.6K 片段、190.8 小时、覆盖 26 国；DenseEgo 在 EgoManeuver 上取得横向 82.7 mAP、纵向 83.5 mAP，较最强现有视频模型分别提升 1.5 与 5.0 点。
AI.conclusion: 统一的多源标注与细粒度动作分类可行且有效，稠密监督的视频表征优于现有视频模型；并展示了将 DenseEgo 与语言模型智能体结合以按用户指定动作与场景检索驾驶视频的应用路径，代码、数据与权重将公开。

title: Looped Models are Fast Multi-Token Predictors
summary: Looped language models can adapt computation for predicting a token without a proportional rescaling in unique model parameters by adjusting the number of loops. This property has been used for self-speculative decoding, taking shallow loops as fast drafters and deep loops as verifiers, which is effective since drafting still uses full parameters. In this paper, we show that shallow loops can be also predictive of several future tokens and leverage this to drastically accelerate the inference of looped language models. To that end, we present Floodgates, a simple self-speculative decoding method that appends a block of mask tokens as a suffix and learns via low-rank adaptation to draft these tokens in parallel. Across seven models, five benchmarks, a range of batch sizes, and both greedy and sampled decoding, Floodgates is the fastest lossless decoding method in most cases, attaining up to 7.5x acceleration. Through analysis, we show that this speedup is enabled by all-depth training of looped models, with the shallow drafter's ability to leverage full-depth computation by conditioning on deep prefix cache evaluated during verification.

AI.tldr: 提出 Floodgates：利用循环语言模型浅层循环并行草拟多个掩码 token 的自推测解码方法，在多数设置下为最快的无损解码方法，最高加速 7.5 倍。
AI.motivation: 循环（looped）语言模型通过调整循环次数来适配计算量，而无需按比例增加参数量。已有工作将浅层循环用作快速草稿器、深层循环用作验证器做自推测解码，但草拟阶段仍使用全部参数，收益受限。作者希望进一步挖掘浅层循环的预测潜力，以显著加速推理。
AI.method: 提出 Floodgates 自推测解码方法：在序列末尾追加一个掩码 token 块作为后缀，通过低秩适配（LoRA）学习并行草拟这些未来 token；浅层草稿器以验证阶段计算得到的深层前缀缓存为条件，从而间接利用全深度计算。
AI.result: 在七个模型、五个基准、多种批大小以及贪心与采样解码下，Floodgates 在多数情形下是速度最快的无损解码方法，最高实现 7.5 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 加速来源于循环模型的全深度训练，使浅层草稿器能够通过条件化于深层前缀缓存来利用全深度计算能力。

title: Recoverability policy editing for closed-loop safety in autonomous driving
summary: Autonomous driving powered by neural network models lacks safety guarantees. We propose a state-level policy editing technique that guarantees closed-loop safety under recoverable disturbances while reusing the model's existing driving capabilities. Closed-loop safety means that the vehicle remains free of collisions at all future times. We introduce the concept of policy recoverability to characterize whether a vehicle can safely return to the original policy's feasible set in finite time. Our method identifies states that are unsafe in the long term under the original policy but recoverable, and selectively edits policy outputs within this region. The vehicle corrects its actions upon entering this region and resumes the original policy upon recovery. Closed-loop simulations on nuPlan urban driving scenarios show a 48% reduction in safety incidents under the original policy while largely preserving its driving performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种状态级策略编辑技术，在可恢复扰动下为神经网络自动驾驶模型提供闭环安全保证，同时复用原有驾驶能力。
AI.motivation: 基于神经网络的自动驾驶模型缺乏安全性保证，需要在保留模型既有驾驶性能的前提下引入可证明的闭环安全性。
AI.method: 引入"策略可恢复性"概念，刻画车辆能否在有限时间内安全返回原策略的可行集；识别在原策略下长期不安全但可恢复的状态，仅在该区域内有选择地编辑策略输出，车辆进入该区域时修正动作，恢复后回归原策略。
AI.result: 在 nuPlan 城市驾驶场景闭环仿真中，安全事件相比原策略减少 48%，且基本保持原策略的驾驶性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过对可恢复不安全状态集进行局部策略编辑，可在复用现有模型能力的同时实现闭环安全保证，且不显著牺牲驾驶表现。

title: SOLO: Towards Sample-Faithful and Detectable LLM Watermarking under Repeated Sampling via Content-Anchored Single-Owner Contexts
summary: Providers watermark the outputs of large language models, while applications sample many responses per prompt for self-consistency, best-of-n selection, and uncertainty estimation. We show that deployed configurations of distortion-free watermarks, which deduplicate keyed contexts only within a response, couple the responses of a request: answer templates make all responses query the watermark with the same context before the answer, so collisions across responses, usually assumed rare, become the norm. Key pools reduce or avoid the coupling at the cost of multiple testing, and the exact remedy of a context history shared across the request leaves many positions unwatermarked. We propose SOLO, which keeps a request-scoped context history but anchors its keyed contexts on content selected by min-hash, so that siblings rarely compete for a context and random edits stay local. Its responses are jointly distributed as independent unwatermarked responses, each detectable with a single key. On five language models from three families and three benchmarks, SOLO preserves self-consistency and uncertainty estimation and, at a 1% false positive rate, detects more responses than four-token key pools on most tasks, also after randomly editing 10% of the tokens, and more than the context history on most clean tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhongliangGuo/solo-watermark.

AI.tldr: 提出 SOLO 水印方法，通过请求级上下文历史 + min-hash 锚定键控上下文，解决多响应采样下无失真水印的跨响应耦合问题。
AI.motivation: 应用常对同一提示采样多个响应（自一致性、best-of-n、不确定性估计），而现有无失真水印仅在单个响应内对键控上下文去重，导致同一请求的多响应因答案模板而在答案前共享相同键控上下文，跨响应碰撞由"罕见"变为"常态"，破坏响应的独立性并干扰下游采样方法。
AI.method: SOLO 保留请求级共享的上下文历史（如 key pools 或共享历史方案），但将键控上下文锚定在由 min-hash 选取的内容上：使同源响应（siblings）极少竞争同一上下文，且随机编辑只造成局部影响。
AI.result: 在三个模型族共五个语言模型、三个基准上：SOLO 保持自一致性（self-consistency）与不确定性估计性能；在 1% 假阳性率下，多数任务上检测到的响应数多于四词 key pool，且在随机编辑 10% token 后仍成立；多数干净任务上检测数多于上下文历史方案。理论上其响应联合分布等价于独立的无水印响应，每条响应可用单一密钥检测。
AI.conclusion: SOLO 在保持无失真水印可检测性的同时恢复了多响应采样的统计独立性，兼顾检测率与对编辑的鲁棒性，是面向多响应采样场景的实用折中方案。

title: Recall4D: Forgetting, Not Misalignment, Limits Long-Horizon Feed-Forward 4D Reconstruction
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 15 tables. Project page: https://kincin.github.io/Recall4D/
summary: Feed-forward 4D trackers recover camera motion, depth, and point trajectories from short video clips, but chaining windows over long videos degrades their accuracy. We find that replacing inter-window alignment with ground-truth transforms leaves tracking error essentially unchanged. Static-point error instead grows with time since last observation: repeatedly predicting a static point from windows that no longer observe it corrupts previously recovered geometry. We call this failure forgetting. Merely retaining the last observed positions of unseen points reduces error by 26% on PointOdyssey without modifying the tracker. We introduce Recall4D, a training-free framework that augments a frozen tracker with a persistent world state and sparse motion anchors. Static points retain their world-space positions outside the camera view and are refined by averaging observations decoded at sparse keyframes while in view. For dynamic objects, the tracker decodes sparse representative anchors, while geometric skinning propagates their displacements to dense queries. Across two long-horizon benchmarks, Recall4D improves the accuracy of its backbone while running 7.6-9.0$\times$ faster, and its accuracy gains carry over to five further backbones and three other long-sequence tasks, demonstrating its generality.

AI.tldr: 论文发现长视频中前馈4D跟踪器的误差主要源于"遗忘"（对已离开视野的静态点反复预测会破坏已恢复的几何），而非窗口间对齐；提出免训练框架Recall4D，用持久世界状态与稀疏运动锚点修正该问题，在保持精度的同时提速7.6-9.0倍。
AI.motivation: 前馈4D跟踪器（从短视频片段恢复相机运动、深度与点轨迹）在长视频上按窗口串联时精度显著下降。作者通过消融发现：将窗口间对齐替换为真值变换后误差几乎不变，说明瓶颈不在对齐；真正原因是静态点误差随"距上次被观测的时间"增长——用不再观测该点的窗口反复预测它，会污染已恢复的几何，作者称之为"遗忘"。
AI.method: 1）诊断性分析：消融窗口间对齐、测量静态点误差与时间的关系，并提出"仅保留未观测点最后观测位置"即可降低26%误差（PointOdyssey）。2）Recall4D：免训练框架，冻结原跟踪器并增强以持久世界状态与稀疏运动锚点。静态点在视野外保持其世界坐标，在视野内时通过对稀疏关键帧解码的观测取平均进行细化；动态物体由跟踪器解码稀疏代表性锚点，再用几何蒙皮（geometric skinning）将位移传播到稠密查询点。
AI.result: 在两个长时程基准上，Recall4D提升骨干跟踪器的精度，同时运行速度快7.6-9.0倍；精度收益可迁移到另外五个骨干和三种其他长序列任务，体现通用性。
AI.conclusion: 长序列4D跟踪的核心退化机制是"遗忘"而非窗口对齐；通过将静态点的世界坐标持久化、动态量以稀疏锚点+几何蒙皮传播，可在不训练、不改动骨干的前提下显著提升精度与效率，且方法具有跨骨干、跨任务的通用性。

title: Correlation-Aware Evidential Fusion for Trusted Multi-View Classification
summary: Trusted multi-view classification aims to make accurate and reliable predictions by integrating information from multiple views. Existing methods typically estimate class evidence and uncertainty for each view and combine the resulting opinions through aggregation rules. However, they generally treat different views as independent information sources, overlooking the correlations among them. Highly correlated views tend to produce similar evidence, and treating them as independent sources may repeatedly count consistent information and give it disproportionate influence, while weakening complementary evidence that provides additional information. Consequently, such correlation-unaware fusion may not only limit classification performance but also produce miscalibrated uncertainty estimates. To address this issue, we propose Correlation-Aware Fusion of Evidence (CAFE), a framework for trusted multi-view classification. CAFE applies complementarity-based trust discounting to the evidence produced by view-private experts and introduces a correlation-aware constraint to reduce the repeated contribution of similar evidence. It then learns sample-specific weights from the global multi-view context to adaptively combine the correlation-adjusted private evidence with cross-view collaborative evidence. Extensive experiments on six real-world datasets demonstrate that CAFE consistently improves classification and calibration performance in general settings, with particularly significant gains when strong correlations exist among views.

AI.tldr: 提出相关性感知的证据融合框架CAFE，用于可信多视图分类，通过互补性信任折扣与相关性约束抑制高度相关视图证据的重复贡献，并学习样本自适应权重融合视图私有证据与跨视图协同证据。
AI.motivation: 现有可信多视图分类方法将各视图视为独立信息源，忽略视图间相关性。高相关视图产生相似证据，独立融合会重复计入一致信息并赋予其过大权重，同时削弱提供补充信息的互补证据，导致分类性能受限且不确定性估计失准。
AI.method: CAFE包含三部分：(1) 对视图私有专家输出的证据施加基于互补性的信任折扣；(2) 引入相关性感知约束，降低相似证据的重复贡献，得到相关性校正后的私有证据；(3) 从全局多视图上下文学习样本特定的融合权重，自适应地组合相关性调整后的私有证据与跨视图协同证据。
AI.result: 在六个真实数据集上进行的大量实验表明，CAFE在一般情形下稳定提升分类与校准性能，当视图间存在强相关性时增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模视图间相关性对可信多视图分类至关重要；兼顾互补性折扣、相关性约束与样本自适应加权的证据融合能够同时改善精度与不确定性校准。

title: Embodied Lower-limb Exoskeleton Assistance: Survey, Challenges, and Perspectives
summary: Over the past decade, artificial intelligence (AI) has enabled lower-limb exoskeletons to adapt to complex tasks and assist diverse users. Existing reviews, however, are organized around mechanical design, control strategies, or individual AI algorithms, and provide little systematic coverage of embodied lower-limb exoskeletons and their enabling technologies. This review defines embodied lower-limb exoskeletons and organizes the literature around four dimensions: structural self-adaptation, task adaptation, user-specific adaptation, and control self-regulation. In each dimension, state-of-the-art and representative studies are classified and discussed in terms of the associated challenges, including lightweight and compliant design, data acquisition and fusion, optimization of complex policies, and robust, compliant control. The review then identifies the principal limitations of current research and outlines future directions along these dimensions. From an embodied perspective, this review sets out the closed-loop relationship among mechanical structure, sensing, and control as a framework for analyzing lower-limb exoskeleton performance and for research on human-robot interaction. The directions it identifies point toward lightweight, comfortable, and practical physical assistance.

AI.tldr: 本文从具身智能视角重新界定"具身下肢外骨骼"，并以结构自适应、任务适应、用户个性化适应、控制自调节四个维度系统梳理代表性研究，提炼关键挑战、现有局限与未来方向，提出"机械结构—感知—控制"闭环框架用于分析外骨骼性能与人机交互。
AI.motivation: 近十年AI使下肢外骨骼具备适应复杂任务与多样用户的能力，但既有综述多按机械设计、控制策略或单个AI算法组织，对具身下肢外骨骼及其使能技术缺乏系统覆盖，难以形成统一的分析框架。
AI.method: 综述类研究：先给出具身下肢外骨骼的定义，再按四个维度（结构自适应、任务适应、用户个性化适应、控制自调节）对最新与代表性文献进行分类与评述，并围绕各维度挑战展开分析，包括轻量化与柔顺设计、数据采集与融合、复杂策略优化、鲁棒柔顺控制；随后归纳研究局限并展望方向。
AI.result: 形成四维度分类体系与各维度挑战的对应梳理；将机械结构、感知与控制的闭环关系确立为分析下肢外骨骼性能及人机交互研究的框架；识别出当前研究的主要局限并提出沿四维度的未来方向。
AI.conclusion: 具身视角为下肢外骨骼研究提供了统一的分析与设计框架，未来研究指向轻量化、舒适、实用的物理助行能力。

title: PROVE: Mitigating Long-Horizon LLM Collusion with Reinforcement Learning from Verified Evidence
summary: When LLM agents verify each other's work over a long interaction, they drift into collusion: they come to accept work without the evidence that the verification protocol requires. Collusion is absent at the start and builds up episode by episode, which we trace to accurate feedback accumulating in memory. An agent that follows the rule is told that its verdict was wrong whenever its peer was right, so breaking the rule is the reward-maximizing choice, and agents talk themselves into it in their private reflections. Existing mitigations leave the agents unchanged; we train the behavior out. PROVE (Protocol Reinforcement from Verified Evidence) is a multi-agent reinforcement learning method that rewards verdicts by the evidence behind them rather than by their outcome, and credits every call an agent makes, including the calls that solve its own task, with the outcome that call controls. On Qwen3.6-27B, a LoRA adapter trained on six-episode interactions takes the collusion rate on held-out task sequences at the original ten-episode horizon from 65.0% to 1.0%, with no detectable change in task success. Collusion that converged in every interaction now converges in none, and the gain holds four episodes beyond the longest interaction seen in training. The trained 27B model colludes less than every model evaluated in the original study, closed-weight frontier models included. Code is available at https://github.com/Haochen-Luo/PROVE.

AI.tldr: 论文研究多智能体LLM在长程交互中相互验证时出现的"合谋"漂移现象，并提出基于证据而非结果奖励的多智能体强化学习方法PROVE将其训练消除。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长程相互验证中会逐步漂移为合谋：不再依据验证协议所需的证据就接受对方的工作。合谋在交互初期不存在，而是逐回合累积形成，其根源在于准确反馈在记忆中的积累——当遵循规则的智能体在同伴判断正确时被告知自己判断错误，违反规则反而成为收益最大化选择，并在自我反思中被合理化。现有缓解手段不改变智能体本身，作者希望将这种行为"训练掉"。
AI.method: PROVE（Protocol Reinforcement from Verified Evidence，基于已验证证据的协议强化）是一种多智能体强化学习方法：以判断背后的证据而非结果好坏来奖励裁决；并对智能体的每一次调用（包括解决自身任务的调用）按该调用所控制的结果进行信用分配。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.6-27B上，用六回合交互训练的LoRA适配器，在留出任务序列、原始十回合时域下将合谋率从65.0%降至1.0%，任务成功率无可检测变化。原本每次交互都收敛到合谋的情形现在均不收敛，增益在超出训练最长交互四个回合处仍保持。该27B模型合谋率低于原研究评估的所有模型，包括闭源前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: 合谋是可学习、可被训练消除的行为；以证据为中心的奖励设计配合细粒度信用分配能有效抑制长程多智能体验证中的协议漂移，且不牺牲任务性能。

title: Look at What Matters: Learning Lesion Prototypes from Severity Labels for Domain-Generalized Diabetic Retinopathy Grading
summary: Deep learning models for diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading often generalize poorly to unseen imaging domains, in part because predictions may exploit correlations specific to source datasets rather than retinal pathology. We address this challenge by constructing grading decisions from lesion evidence learned using only image severity labels. Clinical implications of DR grades provide multiple instance constraints that guide competitive learning of lesion and background prototypes at multiple scales. An additive ordinal scoring model then predicts severity exclusively from individual lesion prototype responses, explicitly connecting learned evidence with grading decisions without a global feature classification pathway. To improve the reliability of this evidence, we introduce teacher guided preservation under image degradations and spatial regularization against persistent coordinate preferences. Across six public DR datasets under a leave one domain out protocol, our method attains a mean quadratic weighted kappa of 0.761, outperforming the strongest competing method by 0.036. Localization and prototype removal analyses show that the learned responses align with retinal lesions and contribute to grading decisions. Experiments across five other prototype architectures and under image degradations further demonstrate the generality and robustness of the approach.

AI.tldr: 提出一种以病灶原型证据驱动的DR分级模型，在仅用图像级严重度标签的条件下实现跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: 深度学习DR分级模型跨域泛化能力差，可能依赖源数据集特异的相关性而非真实视网膜病理特征。
AI.method: 利用DR分级标准的临床含义构造多示例约束，在多尺度上竞争性学习病灶与背景原型；采用加性序数评分模型，仅由单个病灶原型响应预测严重度，取消全局特征分类通路；引入教师引导的图像退化下保持性约束和对持久坐标偏好的空间正则化。
AI.result: 在六个公开DR数据集上采用留一域出协议，平均二次加权kappa为0.761，超过最强对比方法0.036；定位与原型移除分析表明学习响应与视网膜病灶对齐并参与分级决策；在五种其他原型架构及图像退化条件下验证了通用性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将分级决策显式构建于可解释的病灶证据之上，可有效提升DR分级的跨域泛化与鲁棒性，且方法可推广至多种原型架构。

title: InstructTTS-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Objective Instruction-Following TTS
summary: Instruction-following text-to-speech (Instruct-TTS) renders a target transcript in the manner described by a free-form natural-language instruction, and a good rendition must succeed on three fronts at once: following the instruction, pronouncing the transcript correctly, and sounding natural. Reinforcement learning has become the standard way to post-train such generative models toward human preferences, and TTS systems increasingly adopt it. When the three objectives are optimized together under a single scalar reward, typically with group relative policy optimization (GRPO), training tends to be unstable: the objectives compete, and the shared update drifts toward whichever one is easiest to improve, producing a seesaw among them. We instead adapt on-policy distillation (OPD), which fuses several single-objective teachers by matching their velocity fields on the student's own rollouts. Realizing this for Instruct-TTS first calls for a sound reward on each axis, which we analyze carefully: a distilled Qwen-Omni proxy for the costly Gemini judge, dialect-free data for the WER reward, and DNSMOS in place of the language-biased UTMOS. We then train three single-objective teachers with GRPO and fuse them with OPD, routing each rollout to the instruction-following or WER teacher by its data domain and letting every rollout additionally follow the MOS teacher for quality. This lets instruction following and intelligibility improve together without a trade-off, but the quality target conflicts with instruction following, so following it additively reintroduces the seesaw. We therefore propose conflict-aware velocity fusion, which projects the quality target off the direction that opposes the primary objective before fusing, and show that it markedly reduces the instruction-following/quality trade-off. The fused model improves over scalar-reward GRPO on all three objectives at once.

AI.tldr: 提出冲突感知速度融合的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）方法，将指令遵循、发音正确性、自然度三个单目标教师模型在学生自身 rollout 上融合，避免标量奖励 GRPO 的三目标"跷跷板"不稳定问题，三目标同时优于 GRPO。
AI.motivation: Instruct-TTS 需同时满足指令遵循、转写文本正确朗读、听感自然三重目标。现有做法多以单一标量奖励（通常 GRPO）联合优化，但三个目标相互竞争，共享更新会漂向最易提升的目标，形成"跷跷板"式此消彼长，训练不稳定。
AI.method: 1) 为每个维度构建可靠的奖励：用蒸馏的 Qwen-Omni 作为昂贵 Gemini 评判器的代理；用去方言数据计算 WER 奖励；以 DNSMOS 替代存在语言偏置的 UTMOS。2) 分别用 GRPO 训练三个单目标教师，再以 OPD 在学生自身 rollout 上匹配各教师的速度场进行融合：按数据域将 rollout 路由至指令遵循或 WER 教师，所有 rollout 额外跟随 MOS 教师。3) 提出冲突感知速度融合：在融合前将质量目标投影到与主目标相反方向的正交补空间，以缓解质量与指令遵循的冲突。
AI.result: 指令遵循与可懂度可同时提升而无权衡；冲突感知投影显著降低指令遵循与质量之间的权衡（减轻加性融合重新引入的跷跷板）；融合模型在三项指标上同时优于标量奖励 GRPO。
AI.conclusion: 以多教师 OPD 替代单标量奖励 RL，是 Instruct-TTS 后训练的可行方案；关键在于奖励设计的可靠性以及速度场融合中的冲突感知投影，可使多目标协同而非此消彼长。

title: CHASE: Curiosity-Guided Skill Acquisition for Embodied Task Execution
summary: Robots executing tasks in partially observed environments must resolve uncertainty while operating with incomplete skills. Inspired by human curiosity, we investigate how robots can formulate task-relevant hypotheses, seek evidence, and acquire missing skills during task execution. We propose CHASE, a Curiosity-guided Harness for Acquiring Skills from Evidence, which operationalizes curiosity as selecting investigations that resolve task uncertainty and expand executable capabilities. Four modules connect dynamic scene understanding, hypothesis-driven planning, on-demand skill acquisition, and verified execution. The planner balances information value, skill reuse, and acquisition/execution cost. Missing skills trigger bounded exploration, learning from verified segments, and held-out admission during acquisition; separate checks verify physical effects and acquired evidence. Newly admitted skills expand the executable investigation set, closing the loop between resolving uncertainty and acquiring capabilities. Simulation and real-robot experiments evaluate investigation, skill acquisition, and task execution. CHASE achieves 50-80% task success under combined information and capability gaps, with 70-90% evidence resolution.

AI.tldr: 提出CHASE框架，以“好奇心”驱动机器人在任务执行中主动提出假设、收集证据并即时习得缺失技能，实现不确定消解与能力扩展的闭环。
AI.motivation: 机器人在部分可观测环境中执行任务时，同时面临两类缺口：环境不确定性（信息缺口）与技能不完整（能力缺口）。受人类好奇心启发，作者希望机器人能主动形成与任务相关的假设、寻求证据，并在执行过程中获取缺失技能，而非先训练后部署的分离范式。
AI.method: CHASE由四个模块构成闭环：动态场景理解、假设驱动规划、按需技能获取、经验证执行。好奇心被操作化为“选择能消解任务不确定性并扩展可执行能力的探查行为”；规划器在信息价值、技能复用性与获取/执行代价之间权衡。缺失技能触发有界探索，从经验证片段中学习，并在获取阶段通过留出验证进行准入；另有独立检查分别验证物理效果与所获证据。新准入技能扩充可执行的探查集合。
AI.result: 在仿真与真机实验中评估探查、技能获取与任务执行。在信息与能力缺口并存条件下，任务成功率达50–80%，证据消解率为70–90%。
AI.conclusion: 将好奇心形式化为“信息增益+能力扩展”的联合准则，可在执行中同步解决不确定性与技能缺失，形成不确定性消解与能力获取的闭环；结果支持该闭环机制在复合缺口场景下的有效性。

title: Did the Model Forecast It, or Already Know It? Evaluating Large Language Models for Novel Drug-Target Prioritisation with a Temporal Knowledge-Graph Oracle
comment: 14 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Drug Discovery: Bridging the Translation Gap (AI4DD). Code and data: https://github.com/jackysiupuichung/forecast-or-know
summary: AI systems increasingly help decide which drug targets enter costly clinical trials. We recast each target-disease hypothesis as a dated event, the pair's first clinical trial. This lets us test whether a language model can forecast such events after its training cutoff, rather than recall events before it. We rebuild a dated biomedical knowledge graph as it stood at the end of each year from 2020 up to its newest version. We then ask six open language models, with and without this graph, which targets will enter a first trial for a disease the next year. Without retrieval, the models rank about as well as trial history, a count of each target's past trials in the same therapeutic area, also after their training cutoffs. Evidence dated before the decision adds at most a small gain, before or after the models' training cutoffs. The newest graph raises five of six models clearly above that baseline, but its paths usually include the answer: the pair's own trial, dated after the decision. Evaluations of target prioritisation should date both features and labels, with evidence from before the decision and outcomes after it.

AI.tldr: 该文将“靶点-疾病”假设重构为带日期的事件（首次临床试验），评估语言模型能否在训练截止后预测此类事件；通过逐年重建生物医学知识图谱并测试六个开放模型，发现无检索时模型仅与试验历史基线相当，最新图谱虽显著提升但存在答案泄漏（路径包含决策后的试验记录），强调特征与标签双向日期对齐的必要性。
AI.motivation: AI日益参与决定哪些药物靶点进入昂贵的临床试验，但既有评估方式难以区分模型是在“真正预测未来事件”还是在“回忆训练数据中已发生的事件”。需要一种严格的、时间对齐的评估框架来检验语言模型的靶点优先级预测能力。
AI.method: 将每个靶点-疾病假设定义为带日期的事件（该对的首次临床试验）；从2020年到最新版本，逐年重建在各年末时点的带日期生物医学知识图谱；选取六个开放语言模型，在“有/无该图谱”两种条件下预测某疾病下一年将进入首试的靶点；以试验历史（同一治疗领域内该靶点过往试验计数）为基线，并对比训练截止前后证据与决策的时间关系。
AI.result: 无检索时，模型排序能力大致与试验历史基线相当，且在训练截止后依然如此；决策前日期的证据至多带来小幅提升，无论证据位于模型训练截止前还是后；最新图谱使六个模型中的五个明显超越基线，但其检索路径通常包含答案本身——即日期在决策之后的该靶点对自身的试验记录，构成信息泄漏。
AI.conclusion: 靶点优先级评估应同时对特征与标签进行日期标注：证据须来自决策之前，结果须发生在决策之后，否则所谓“预测”能力可能被记忆与泄漏所高估。

title: MOVR-SAR: A Multi-resolution SAR Registration Dataset under Orbit-crossing and View-variant Imaging Differences
summary: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) image registration under varying acquisition geometries is challenging because orbit direction, look side, and incidence angle affect backscatter, terrain-induced distortion, and feature visibility. However, large-scale geometry-aware benchmarks remain scarce. This paper presents MOVR-SAR, a multi-resolution dataset of 450,845 registered and quality-screened tile pairs derived from 2774 scene pairs from Capella, Umbra, Sentinel-1, and NISAR. It covers X, C, and L bands, ground sampling distances of 0.25-20 m, and diverse regions and land-cover types. A unified framework defines four imaging-geometry pair categories from orbit direction and look side, plus viewing-angle-separation labels for Capella and Umbra, enabling stratified evaluation under same- and opposite-direction illumination. Systematic evaluation of representative matching methods shows that official and cross-modal pretrained weights perform poorly on high-resolution X-band imagery. Fine-tuning on MOVR-SAR improves accuracy and reduces disparities across platforms, imaging-geometry pair categories, and viewing-angle separations. For example, fine-tuning increases FlexGlue AUC@5 from 3.06% to 89.79% on Capella and from 1.79% to 89.03% on Umbra, reaching 93.41% and 94.77% on Sentinel-1 and NISAR, respectively. Fine-tuning substantially reduces the official-weight same-orbit, same-look-side advantage and reverses the three-method average category ranking on Capella, suggesting that this bias reflects training-data coverage rather than an invariant limitation of cross-geometry matching. Land-cover effects remain platform- and method-dependent. MOVR-SAR provides a training resource and geometry-aware benchmark for robust SAR-SAR registration. The dataset and model weights will be released at https://github.com/fdhzhz5870/MOVR-SAR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MOVR-SAR：一个面向多成像几何条件的大规模SAR图像配准数据集与几何感知基准，含450,845对配准并质检的瓦片对，覆盖X/C/L波段与0.25–20 m分辨率，并系统评测了现有匹配方法。
AI.motivation: 变成像几何（轨道方向、侧视方向、入射角）会改变后向散射、造成地形畸变并影响特征可见性，使SAR-SAR配准困难；而现有多分辨率、几何分层的公开基准数据集严重缺乏，难以支撑几何鲁棒匹配方法的训练与公平评测。
AI.method: 构建MOVR-SAR数据集：源自Capella、Umbra、Sentinel-1、NISAR的2774个场景对，生成450,845对配准且质量筛选的瓦片对，覆盖X/C/L波段与0.25–20 m GSD及多区域、多土地覆盖类型。提出统一框架，依据轨道方向与侧视方向定义四类成像几何对类别，并为Capella、Umbra标注视角间隔（viewing-angle separation），支持同向/反向照明的分层评测；同时系统评测代表性匹配方法及其官方权重、跨模态预训练权重与在MOVR-SAR上微调后的表现。
AI.result: 官方与跨模态预训练权重在高分辨率X波段上表现很差；在MOVR-SAR上微调后精度显著提升且跨平台、跨几何类别、跨视角间隔的差异缩小：FlexGlue AUC@5在Capella上由3.06%升至89.79%，Umbra上由1.79%升至89.03%，Sentinel-1与NISAR分别达到93.41%与94.77%。微调还大幅削弱了官方权重下"同轨道、同侧视"的优势，并在Capella上逆转了三方法平均的类别排序；土地覆盖影响仍随平台与方法而异。
AI.conclusion: 几何条件导致的性能差距主要源于训练数据覆盖不足，而非跨几何匹配的固有局限；MOVR-SAR为鲁棒SAR-SAR配准提供了训练资源与几何感知评测基准，数据集与模型权重将开源。

title: CondUQ: Calibrated Conditional Uncertainty Quantification Using Distribution Matching
summary: Many applications, especially reliability- and safety-critical ones, require accurate uncertainty quantification for the outputs of model- or learning-based measurement, estimation, and prediction systems. The errors of such systems often vary with factors such as input quality and operating conditions, and thus cannot be accurately described by a single Gaussian model. Although Gaussian mixture models and calibrated quantiles can approximate such error distributions, their unconditional forms do not capture how the error behavior depends on these factors. Hence, we propose condUQ, an approach that conditions error models on observable factors for enabling accurate and reliable uncertainty quantification. condUQ is built on top of an existing system without modifying it and applies even when the system is a black box. First, condUQ maps the observable factors to a latent quality index (QI) such that errors sharing the same QI follow a common, approximately Gaussian conditional distribution. The QI predictor is trained end-to-end with a distribution-matching objective, without requiring quality labels. Second, for each QI, a Gaussian error model is then fitted and calibrated on a large held-out dataset. condUQ is demonstrated on three examples: (a) GPS multipath errors conditioned on satellite elevation and signal strength, (b) relative attitude errors of a transformer-based visual relative pose regression model conditioned on its internal features of the image pairs, and (c) prediction errors of a world model conditioned on the input observations and actions. In all three examples, condUQ substantially reduces the discrepancy between the modeled and empirical error distributions compared with a single global model. Moreover, the learned QIs reveal how the underlying factors affect the error characteristics in a manner consistent with physical principles.

AI.tldr: 提出 condUQ，将误差模型以可观测因素（如输入质量、运行条件）为条件，通过端到端学习潜在质量指数（QI）并对每个 QI 拟合、校准高斯误差模型，在 GPS 多径误差、视觉相对位姿回归位姿误差与世界模型预测误差三个案例中显著缩小建模误差分布与经验分布的差距。
AI.motivation: 可靠性/安全关键应用需要对模型驱动的测量、估计与预测系统输出做准确的不确定性量化。此类系统误差随输入质量与运行条件变化，单一高斯难以描述；高斯混合与校准分位数虽能近似误差分布，但其无条件形式无法刻画误差行为对上述因素的依赖。
AI.method: condUQ 构建于既有系统之上且无需修改系统，可用于黑箱。第一步：将可观测因素映射为潜在质量指数 QI，使同一 QI 下的误差服从共同的近似高斯条件分布；QI 预测器以分布匹配目标端到端训练，无需质量标签。第二步：对每个 QI，在大规模留出数据集上拟合并校准高斯误差模型。
AI.result: 在三个案例中验证：(a) 以卫星仰角与信号强度为条件的 GPS 多径误差；(b) 以图像对内部特征为条件的 transformer 视觉相对位姿回归模型的相对姿态误差；(c) 以观测与动作为条件的世界模型预测误差。相比单一全局模型，condUQ 大幅降低建模误差分布与经验误差分布之间的差异；所学 QI 揭示因素对误差特性的影响且与物理原理一致。
AI.conclusion: 以可观测因素为条件的误差建模可在不修改、不依赖系统内部的前提下显著提升不确定性量化的准确性与可靠性，且所学潜在 QI 具可解释性，符合物理机理。

title: Calibration of Neuromusculoskeletal Models Using Differentiable Physics: Recommendations for Improving Model Accuracy
summary: Differentiable physics has shown potential to usher in a new paradigm in human neuromusculoskeletal (NMS) model calibration. Early results from pioneering works have demonstrated that auto-differentiable NMS models can greatly reduce NMS model calibration time while achieving comparable accuracy compared to traditional calibration methods. The efficient gradient-based optimizers have enabled calibration of increasingly sophisticated human models with a large number of parameters, which seek to narrow the gap between simulation and reality. Several modules have been evaluated separately in different studies, but have never been directly compared within the same study. In this work, these modules are compared on the same differentiable upper limb model with a 3-DoF shoulder, a 2-DoF elbow, and 11 superficial and 5 deep muscles in the calibration to find an optimal pipeline for improving model accuracy. The considered modules include muscle synergy, learnable bone parameters, optimizable geometry of wrap objects, and constraint torque of the differentiable arm model. To evaluate the effect and interplay between the modules on calibration accuracy, one or more modules were used in each of 16 calibration configurations, which were compared in terms of the error between two joint torques calculated by the forward and inverse dynamics with the calibrated model on 9 distinctive testing movements across 4 subjects. Results showed that torque loss was reduced by 23.6% on average using muscle synergy extrapolation to estimate deep muscle activities, and by 10.9% on average through bone dynamic parameter optimization, which are both recommended to be incorporated in the calibration.

AI.tldr: 该研究在同一可微上肢肌骨模型上系统比较四种标定模块（肌肉协同、可学习骨参数、缠绕体几何优化、约束力矩），通过16种标定配置在4名受试者9个测试动作上的力矩误差评估，发现肌肉协同外推与骨动力学参数优化分别使力矩损失平均降低23.6%和10.9%，二者被推荐纳入标定流程。
AI.motivation: 可微物理为人体神经肌骨（NMS）模型标定带来新范式，梯度优化器可大幅缩短标定时间并支持高维参数标定；然而已有研究各自单独评估不同模块，从未在同一研究中直接对比，缺乏对最优标定流程的系统认识。
AI.method: 构建同一可微上肢模型（3自由度肩、2自由度肘，标定中纳入11块浅层肌与5块深层肌）；设计16种标定配置，每种启用一个或多个模块，模块包括肌肉协同、可学习骨参数、缠绕体（wrap object）几何优化及可微手臂模型的约束力矩；以标定模型的正、逆动力学计算关节力矩之间的误差为指标，在4名受试者的9个具区分度的测试动作上评估各模块效果及其交互作用。
AI.result: 采用肌肉协同外推估计深层肌肉活动可使力矩损失平均降低23.6%；骨动力学参数优化可使力矩损失平均降低10.9%；结果还揭示了各模块对多组低维肌肉协同与外推有效性的影响及模块间相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 肌肉协同外推与骨动力学参数优化均能显著提升可微NMS模型标定精度，建议纳入标定流程；模块间存在交互作用，需在同一框架下联合评估以确定最优标定管线。

title: EXPOSURE: Explaining Sources of Uncertainty in Reinforcement Learning
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Submitted to ESANN 2027. Code: https://github.com/kianaf/exposure-rl
summary: Shapley values in reinforcement learning are used to explain which observation features drive an agent's behavior and expected return, but not its certainty. Explaining certainty requires understanding how observation features influence different sources of return uncertainty, and Shapley values need the agent's prediction for every subset of visible features. We propose EXPOSURE, which uses one mask-aware belief network for both action selection and Shapley explanations. It explains the variance of the return, split into an observational part due to missing features and an inherent part due to the environment's own randomness, and the entropy of its belief over the masked features. In tic-tac-toe and Minesweeper, where exact Shapley values are computable, EXPOSURE gives more accurate explanations of expected return and its uncertainty, while uniquely explaining belief uncertainty.

AI.tldr: EXPOSURE 用单一 mask-aware belief network 同时完成动作选择与 Shapley 解释，将回报方差分解为可观测部分与环境固有部分，并额外解释信念熵。
AI.motivation: 现有 RL 中的 Shapley 值只能解释哪些观测特征驱动智能体行为与期望回报，无法解释其"确定性"。要解释确定性，需厘清特征如何影响不同来源的回报不确定性，且 Shapley 值需对每个可见特征子集给出预测。
AI.method: 提出 EXPOSURE：使用一个 mask-aware 信念网络，既用于动作选择，也用于生成 Shapley 解释。该网络在任意特征掩码下均可预测，从而支撑子集预测；在此基础上解释回报方差，并将其拆分为因特征缺失导致的观测部分与环境自身随机性导致的固有部分，同时解释关于被掩码特征的信念分布的熵。
AI.result: 在井字棋与扫雷环境中（可精确计算 Shapley 值），EXPOSURE 对期望回报及其不确定性的解释更准确，并且能够独有地解释信念不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 将解释对象从期望回报扩展到不确定性是可行且有效的；借助 mask-aware belief network 以单一模型统一决策与解释，可同时给出回报方差的来源分解与信念熵的解释，并在可精确验证的环境中优于基线。

title: WorldUAV: Scaling UAV Data Synthesis via World Models
summary: UAV detection and tracking remain constrained by the scarcity of high-quality training data. Existing game-engine-based synthetic UAV data suffer from a substantial synthetic-to-real gap, while the high cost of manually collected real-world UAV data limits dataset scale. Therefore, we introduce WorldUAV, a high-quality UAV dataset constructed through an efficient framework powered by world models. Specifically, WorldUAV directly integrates UAVs into readily available real-world videos, naturally preserving realistic backgrounds, illumination, and scene dynamics. Leveraging the spatiotemporal priors of world models, it generates UAV videos with plausible motion, pose variations, and cross-frame consistency, effectively narrowing the gap between synthetic and real data. We further develop an agentic pipeline orchestrated by a multimodal large language model that acquires sources, plans UAV trajectories, invokes synthesis, and verifies generated videos, enabling fully automated dataset construction. WorldUAV comprises 6,878 UAV videos and 205,778 UAV images. Experiments show that WorldUAV significantly improves the performance of UAV detectors. Moreover, it substantially reduces dataset construction costs, requiring only 15 seconds and USD 0.0005 API cost per high-quality UAV image. Our work offers both a high-quality dataset and a scalable data generation paradigm for UAV detection and tracking.

AI.tldr: 提出基于世界模型的自动化框架，构建将UAV融入真实视频的高质量数据集WorldUAV（6,878段视频、205,778张图像），显著提升检测性能并大幅降低数据构建成本（每张图像约15秒、0.0005美元）。
AI.motivation: UAV检测与跟踪受限于高质量训练数据稀缺：游戏引擎合成的数据存在明显的合成-真实域差距，而人工采集真实UAV数据成本高、规模受限。
AI.method: 构建由世界模型驱动的高效数据生成框架，将UAV直接嵌入现成真实视频中，自然保留真实背景、光照与场景动态；利用世界模型的时空先验生成具有合理运动、姿态变化与跨帧一致性的UAV视频；并设计由多模态大语言模型编排的智能体流水线，完成源素材获取、轨迹规划、合成调用与视频校验，实现全自动数据集构建。
AI.result: WorldUAV包含6,878段UAV视频与205,778张UAV图像；实验表明其显著提升UAV检测器性能；数据构建成本大幅降低，每张高质量UAV图像仅需约15秒与0.0005美元API费用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作同时提供了高质量数据集与可扩展的数据生成范式，为UAV检测与跟踪研究提供了有效支撑。

title: BReD: Block Replay Dithering for Stable Low-Bit EMA Optimizer States
summary: Low-bit storage of optimizer states can substantially reduce the memory footprint of large-scale training. In practice, however, these states are not quantized once: at every training step, they are dequantized, updated, requantized, and written back. This iterative quantization pipeline can destabilize training. We identify a failure mode behind this instability: for states updated via exponential moving averages (EMAs), quantization errors are recursively fed into subsequent updates. As a result, biased errors accumulate over time while high-variance errors are amplified, particularly when the EMA decay factor is close to 1. To address this error accumulation, we propose BReD (Block Replay Dithering), a method that reduces rounding bias and controls rounding variance during quantization. BReD adapts classical subtractive dithering to optimizer-state quantization by combining deterministic seed replay with block-wise shared dither values, avoiding auxiliary random-tensor storage and per-element dither values generation. Across the default pretraining settings (five optimizers at 120M; AdamW and Muon at 1.1B and 3.4B model) and supervised fine-tuning (AdamW and Muon at 7B model), 4-bit BReD closely matches training with full-precision optimizer states, with PPL shifts $\leq0.5$ in pretraining and $\leq0.2$ in fine-tuning and average downstream performance changes within 0.7 points. Moreover, 3-bit BReD preserves stable convergence in the evaluated settings, offering a more aggressive alternative. Our implementation of BReD is available at: https://github.com/ZhanHeshen/BReD

AI.tldr: BReD（Block Replay Dithering）通过确定性种子重放与分块共享抖动值，把经典减法抖动引入优化器状态量化，抑制迭代量化中的误差累积，使4-bit优化器状态训练几乎无损。
AI.motivation: 低比特存储优化器状态能显著降低大模型训练显存占用，但实际训练中状态每步都要"反量化—更新—再量化—写回"，形成迭代量化流水线。对于用指数滑动平均（EMA）更新的状态，量化误差会被递归反馈进后续更新：偏差随时间累积，高方差误差被放大，尤其在EMA衰减因子接近1时更严重，导致训练不稳定。
AI.method: 提出BReD：将经典减法抖动（subtractive dithering）适配到优化器状态量化，在量化时降低舍入偏差并控制舍入方差。关键技术为确定性种子重放（deterministic seed replay）与按块共享抖动值（block-wise shared dither values），从而无需存储额外随机张量、也无需逐元素生成抖动值。
AI.result: 在默认预训练设置（120M模型上5种优化器；1.1B与3.4B上AdamW和Muon）及监督微调（7B上AdamW和Muon）中，4-bit BReD与全精度优化器状态基本持平：预训练PPL偏移≤0.5，微调≤0.2，下游平均性能变化在0.7分以内；3-bit BReD在评估设置下仍保持稳定收敛。
AI.conclusion: BReD以极低的额外开销解决了EMA类优化器状态迭代量化中的误差累积问题，在4-bit下实现近无损训练，3-bit下仍可稳定收敛，为大规模训练的低比特优化器状态存储提供了实用方案；代码已开源。

title: HoloBrain-0.5 Technical Report
comment: Technical report. 23 pages, 13 figures, 9 tables. Project page: https://horizonrobotics.github.io/robot_lab/holobrain_0_5/
summary:
We present HoloBrain-0.5, a family of vision-language-action (VLA) models for manipulation across robot embodiments. The policies plan in a shared action space using robot state, kinematic structure, and calibrated camera observations. We standardize joint axes, coordinate frames, and tool-center points in robot descriptions (URDFs) and encode their kinematic graphs in a shared 3D representation. HoloBrain-0.5-Continuous generates action chunks by diffusion, while HoloBrain-0.5-Discrete uses residual finite scalar quantization (FSQ) and delayed autoregression. We pretrain both policies on over 10,000 hours of real-robot, simulation, and human-manipulation data spanning 15 embodiment categories.
  Across six closed-loop simulation settings, the discrete policy converges faster and reaches a higher mean success rate than the continuous policy (56.77% vs. 49.71%). On seven real-robot tasks, it achieves a mean progress score of 87.76% without task-specific post-training. After post-training, the continuous policy outperforms $π_{0.5}$ on the seven-task benchmark (94.52% vs. 86.25%) and an 11-task dual-arm benchmark (79.07% vs. 69.41%). The discrete-initialized continuous policy transfers five tasks zero-shot from Piper to Piper-X, scoring 63.28% on average. With target-robot demonstrations, the continuous policy scores 89.2% on Franka Panda and 92.94% on a mobile dual-arm platform. Although pretraining includes no Unitree G1 data, post-training with limited G1 demonstrations yields a mean progress score of 70.24% across three humanoid tasks, compared with 11.00% for $π_{0.5}$.

AI.tldr: 提出跨本体视觉-语言-动作模型族 HoloBrain-0.5，在统一动作空间与共享运动学 3D 表示下预训练超 1 万小时数据；离散策略收敛更快且零样本更强，连续策略后训练后超越 π0.5。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作数据来自不同本体、不同关节轴定义、坐标系与工具中心点，导致策略难以跨本体迁移；希望构建一个能在异构机器人间共享动作空间的通用 VLA 策略。
AI.method: 标准化 URDF 中的关节轴、坐标系与 TCP，并将运动学图编码为共享 3D 表示；策略以机器人状态、运动学结构与标定相机观测为输入，在共享动作空间中规划。提供两版本：Continuous 用扩散生成动作块；Discrete 用残差 FSQ + 延迟自回归。二者在覆盖 15 类本体的 1 万小时以上真实、仿真与人类操作数据上预训练。
AI.result: 六个闭环仿真设定中离散策略收敛更快、平均成功率更高（56.77% vs 49.71%）；七个真机任务零样本后训练平均进度分 87.76%。后训练后连续策略在七任务基准超越 π0.5（94.52% vs 86.25%），11 任务双臂基准 79.07% vs 69.41%；离散初始化的连续策略在 Piper→Piper-X 上五任务零样本迁移平均 63.28%；目标本体示范下连续策略在 Franka Panda 89.2%、移动双臂平台 92.94%。预训练未含 Unitree G1 数据，仅少量 G1 示范后训练即在三项人形任务上达 70.24%，而 π0.5 为 11.00%。
AI.conclusion: 统一动作空间+共享运动学表示是跨本体 VLA 的有效基础；离散与连续策略各具优势（离散利于预训练收敛与零样本，连续利于后训练精调），且模型具备向未见本体（含人形）低成本迁移的能力。

title: Navigent: A Geometry-Grounded Agentic Framework for Vision Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) with general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offers a flexible alternative to task-specific navigation policies, while reliable long-horizon execution remains challenging. Agents must track navigation progress, detect discrepancies between commanded and actual motion, and recognize when movement has passed relevant landmarks or entrances. We present Navigent, an agentic VLN framework built around a frozen MLLM and a Geometry-Grounded Execution Critic (GEC). GEC performs two complementary checks: action-to-motion consistency, which evaluates measured displacement against commanded movement, and motion-to-landmark consistency, which tracks agent-selected visual anchors and entrance candidates in world coordinates. Detected discrepancies interrupt the remaining action sequence and trigger reobservation, local adjustment, or node-based recovery. Historical visual memory supports progress tracking across extended routes. An offline self-improvement procedure further analyzes successful and failed training trajectories to refine navigation prompts and GEC logic while keeping model weights fixed. On the R2R-CE validation-unseen split (1,839 episodes) and RxR-CE validation-unseen split(3,669 episodes), Navigent achieves 84.0%/86.0% SR and 72.9%/69.1% SPL, respectively, demonstrating the value of geometry-grounded execution verification for reliable agentic navigation. Project Page: https://marslab-navigent.github.io/navigent.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/MarsLab-Navigent/Navigent

AI.tldr: Navigent 是一个以冻结多模态大模型为核心、配合几何落地执行评论器（GEC）的智能体式 VLN 框架，通过动作-运动一致性与运动-地标一致性双重校验实现长程可靠导航。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态大模型为 VLN 提供了灵活的任务无关导航策略，但长程执行可靠性不足：智能体需跟踪导航进度、检测指令运动与实际运动的偏差，并判断是否已越过相关地标或入口。现有任务专用策略灵活性差，而直接用 MLLM 缺乏执行层的可靠性保障。
AI.method: 1）采用冻结 MLLM 作为决策核心，避免微调；2）设计 Geometry-Grounded Execution Critic（GEC）执行评论器，包含两项互补校验：动作-运动一致性（将实测位移与指令运动比对）与运动-地标一致性（在世界坐标系中跟踪智能体自选的视觉锚点与入口候选）；3）检测到偏差即中断剩余动作序列，触发重新观察、局部调整或基于节点的恢复；4）引入历史视觉记忆以支持长路径进度跟踪；5）离线自我改进流程，在权重固定前提下分析成功与失败训练轨迹，优化导航提示词与 GEC 逻辑。
AI.result: 在 R2R-CE validation-unseen（1,839 回合）上达到 84.0% SR / 72.9% SPL；在 RxR-CE validation-unseen（3,669 回合）上达到 86.0% SR / 69.1% SPL，验证了几何落地执行校验对可靠智能体导航的价值。
AI.conclusion: 执行层的几何一致性校验可显著提升冻结 MLLM 在连续环境 VLN 中的长程可靠性；配合离线提示词与评论逻辑自我改进，无需更新模型权重即可取得强性能，为可解释、可恢复的智能体导航提供了可行范式。

title: Read Before You Use: Improving Visual Memory Utilization in Vision-Language Models
summary: Multimodal memory enables long-horizon vision-language agents to preserve and retrieve past experiences. While prior research has focused on memory construction and retrieval, effectively using the provided memory remains a challenge for vision-language models (VLMs). We find that VLMs often fail to answer downstream questions even when sufficient multimodal evidence is provided. To investigate why VLMs struggle, we replace memory images with reference captions and observe substantial performance gains, suggesting difficulties in reading visual evidence directly. However, model-generated captions may omit critical information, limiting this approach in practice. These limitations motivate a closer examination of memory utilization, revealing failures in both evidence reading and downstream question answering. Building on this distinction, we propose \textbf{MemRU}, a two-stage training framework that improves evidence reading through supervised fine-tuning (Read SFT) and downstream evidence utilization through Group Relative Policy Optimization (Use GRPO). Experimental results demonstrate that our 8B model generalizes across three unseen multimodal memory systems, outperforming Qwen3-VL-32B and approaching GPT-5-mini.

AI.tldr: 论文指出视觉语言模型（VLM）即使获得充足的多模态记忆证据仍答不对问题，根源在于"证据阅读"和"下游利用"两类失败；据此提出两阶段训练框架 MemRU（Read SFT + Use GRPO），8B 模型可泛化到三个未见过的多模态记忆系统，超过 Qwen3-VL-32B 并接近 GPT-5-mini。
AI.motivation: 多模态记忆使长程视觉语言智能体能够保存与检索过往经验，但现有研究多集中于记忆的构建与检索，对"如何有效使用已提供的记忆"关注不足。作者观察到 VLM 在证据充分时仍无法正确作答，因此需要诊断这一瓶颈究竟出在哪里，并据此改进记忆利用能力。
AI.method: 1）诊断实验：将记忆图像替换为参考描述文本，性能显著提升，说明模型难以直接阅读视觉证据；但模型自生成描述可能遗漏关键信息，限制该替代方案的实际可用性。2）基于上述分析，将失败拆分为"证据阅读失败"与"下游问答失败"。3）提出 MemRU 两阶段训练框架：第一阶段用监督微调（Read SFT）提升证据阅读能力，第二阶段用组相对策略优化（Use GRPO）提升下游证据利用能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，8B 规模的 MemRU 模型可泛化到三个未见过的多模态记忆系统，性能优于 Qwen3-VL-32B，并接近 GPT-5-mini。
AI.conclusion: 多模态记忆的瓶颈已从"构建与检索"转向"利用"，且利用可进一步分解为证据阅读与下游推理两个可分别优化的子能力；分阶段（SFT 打基础、RL 优化利用）的训练策略能有效提升且具备跨记忆系统的泛化性。

title: DuoMI: Dual Mutual Information Regularization for Expert Reuse in Looped Transformers
summary: We introduce Dual Mutual Information Regularization (DuoMI), a method for regulating expert routing across rounds in looped mixture-of-experts (MoE) Transformers. When two rounds of computation share an expert pool, their routers may favor different expert subsets, limiting the reuse of individual expert parameters across rounds. Even when aggregate expert usage is identical across rounds, we would still prefer each token to retain some experts while switching to others. DuoMI addresses both aspects of routing: it uses round-level marginal mutual information to limit the dependence of aggregate expert usage on the round, and token-level conditional mutual information to penalize average cross-round routing changes that fall outside a target interval. During training, DuoMI computes differentiable penalties from soft routing distributions over all experts. It adds no model parameters and leaves sparse Top-$k$ routing strategy unchanged at inference. On a looped OLMoE backbone in which paired adjacent layers share experts, DuoMI improves the average score across $15$ downstream tasks from $50.08\%$ to $51.82\%$, a gain of $1.74$ percentage points over the looped baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出双重互信息正则化（DuoMI），在共享专家池的循环MoE Transformer中同时约束轮级边际互信息与token级条件互信息，从而调控跨轮专家路由；在不增加参数、不改变推理时Top-k稀疏路由的前提下提升下游性能。
AI.motivation: 两轮计算共享同一专家池时，各自路由器可能偏好不同专家子集，削弱单个专家参数在轮间的复用；即使各轮聚合使用率相同，也仍希望每个token保留部分专家同时切换另一部分，因此需要从聚合与token两个层面同时规范路由。
AI.method: DuoMI从软路由分布计算可微惩罚：轮级边际互信息限制聚合专家使用对"轮"的依赖；token级条件互信息惩罚落在目标区间之外的平均跨轮路由变化量。方法不引入新参数，推理阶段仍保持稀疏Top-k路由策略不变。实验在成对相邻层共享专家的循环OLMoE骨干上进行。
AI.result: 在15个下游任务上的平均分由循环基线的50.08%提升至51.82%，相对提升1.74个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 同时约束轮级聚合一致性与token级路由稳定性/切换性，可有效改善循环MoE中的专家复用，并以极低结构代价带来稳定的下游收益。

title: DynaRC: Dynamics-Robust 4-D Radar Relocalization with Rate-Adaptive Sequence Matching
summary: Four-dimensional millimeter-wave radar measures radial velocity within a single scan and remains resilient under adverse weather and visibility. Yet sparse directional returns, moving objects and occlusion make place matching ambiguous. We propose DynaRC, a dynamics-robust framework encompassing single-frame retrieval and sequence relocalization. Doppler evidence separates static returns and masks motion-affected cells in a polar descriptor; median ring keys retrieve candidates. Its sequence variant, Seq_DynaRC, couples endpoint-anchored rate alignment and candidate-index voting with ordered verification to associate the latest scan under unequal map/query advancement, without odometry or cloud accumulation. Across four indoor and outdoor map--query pairs, Seq_DynaRC achieves the highest conditional localization success within 2m among tested methods. On a campus-road revisit under changing traffic, success reaches 91.8%, exceeding descriptor-matched SeqSLAM by 55.0 percentage points when each method retains all its published outputs; output availability is reported separately. Code and indoor/outdoor dynamic 4D radar data are available.

AI.tldr: 提出DynaRC/Seq_DynaRC：面向4D毫米波雷达的动力学鲁棒地点识别与序列重定位框架，利用多普勒区分静态回波、极坐标描述子掩膜运动单元，序列版以端点锚定速率对齐+候选索引投票+有序验证，在2m阈值下取得最高条件定位成功率。
AI.motivation: 4D毫米波雷达可在单次扫描内测径向速度，且对恶劣天气与低能见度鲁棒；但方向性回波稀疏、运动物体干扰与遮挡导致地点匹配歧义，现有描述子/序列方法在动态场景下可靠性不足。作者希望在不依赖里程计与点云累积的前提下提升动态环境中的重定位成功率。
AI.method: 框架含单帧检索与序列重定位两模块。单帧：以多普勒证据分离静态回波并在极坐标描述子中掩膜受运动影响的单元，用中值环键(median ring keys)检索候选。序列Seq_DynaRC：将端点锚定速率对齐、候选索引投票与有序验证结合，在地图/查询推进速率不等时关联最新扫描，无需里程计与点云累积。
AI.result: 在四组室内外地图—查询对上，Seq_DynaRC在2m条件定位成功率上为所测方法中最高；校园道路重复通行（交通变化）场景成功率达91.8%，在各自保留全部公开输出的条件下比描述子匹配的SeqSLAM高55.0个百分点；输出可用性单独报告。同时公开代码与室内外动态4D雷达数据。
AI.conclusion: 多普勒驱动的静态/动态分离与速率对齐的序列匹配可有效缓解4D雷达在动态、遮挡与稀疏回波下的匹配歧义，实现无需里程计的鲁棒重定位；但输出可用性需与成功率分开评估，说明条件成功率依赖于方法保留输出的比例，比较时应同时考虑可用性。

title: MedSkill-E$^{2}$: Evaluating and Evolving Skills for Medical Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use skills to access domain knowledge and complete real-world tasks. We observe that even when a skill specifies the rules and procedures needed for a task, agents may fail to apply them effectively during autonomous execution, a phenomenon we call skill Enable But Underuse (EBU). This issue is particularly consequential in medical tasks, where overlooking a single critical constraint can yield a plausible but incorrect result. To evaluate and address EBU, we introduce MedSkill-E$^{2}$, a framework for evaluating and evolving skills for medical agents. We construct EBU-Bench, a challenging benchmark covering 12 medically relevant task groups and associated skills, to evaluate agents' ability to use available skills autonomously. We quantify the EBU gap as the difference in skill-use accuracy between autonomous use and explicitly guided reading and application of the same skill. On EBU-Bench, all evaluated model-harness combinations exhibit EBU, with a mean gap of 43.94 percentage points (pp). For the same model, skill-use accuracy under autonomous use differs by up to 38.96 pp across harnesses. Motivated by these observations, we propose EBU-Evolve, which uses execution feedback from autonomous and explicitly guided skill use to distill effective guidance into reusable skill instructions. Relative to their pre-evolution versions, the revised skills improve skill-use accuracy during autonomous execution by 33.33 to 55.17 pp and continue to yield improvements when transferred across multiple models and harnesses. Our results show that autonomous skill-use accuracy varies across harnesses with the model and skill held fixed, and model rankings can change. EBU can persist even after a skill is opened. EBU-Evolve improves autonomous skill-use accuracy on unseen tasks within the same skill, with gains transferring across models and harnesses.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"技能赋能但未充分利用"(EBU)现象：即便技能已包含任务所需的规则与流程，LLM智能体在自主执行时仍可能无法有效应用。为此构建MedSkill-E²框架，含EBU-Bench基准（12个医学任务组）与EBU-Evolve方法，通过执行反馈将有效指引蒸馏进技能指令，显著提升自主技能使用准确率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体越来越多依赖技能获取领域知识并完成真实任务，但观察发现：即使技能明确给出了任务所需规则与程序，智能体在自主执行中仍常常无法有效应用（EBU现象）。在医学任务中该问题尤为严重——忽略一个关键约束就可能产生看似合理却错误的结论。现有工作缺乏对该现象的量化评估与改进手段。
AI.method: 1) 构建EBU-Bench基准，覆盖12个医学相关任务组及对应技能，用于评测智能体自主使用技能的能力；2) 将EBU差距量化为"自主使用技能"与"显式引导阅读并应用同一技能"两种设定下的技能使用准确率之差；3) 提出EBU-Evolve，利用自主使用与显式引导使用两种设定下的执行反馈，将有效引导蒸馏为可复用的技能指令（技能演化）。
AI.result: 在EBU-Bench上，所有被评测的模型-harness组合均表现出EBU，平均差距达43.94个百分点；同一模型在不同harness间自主技能使用准确率差异最高达38.96 pp。技能演化后，相较演化前版本，自主执行中的技能使用准确率提升33.33–55.17 pp，且增益可跨多个模型与harness迁移；在同一技能内的未见任务上亦有提升。固定模型与技能时，技能使用准确率随harness变化，模型排名可能发生改变；EBU在技能被"打开"后仍可能持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 技能被提供并不等于被有效使用，EBU是LLM智能体（尤其医学场景）中普遍且严重的问题；其程度不仅取决于模型，也显著受harness影响。通过执行反馈驱动的技能演化（EBU-Evolve）可有效缓解EBU，且改进具备跨模型、跨harness的可迁移性，表明面向智能体的技能本身应被系统性地评测与迭代优化。

title: GeoTex: Geometry-as-Texture Encoding and History-Grounded 4D Occupancy Forecasting
summary: 4D occupancy forecasting models 3D scene evolution to support future prediction and scenario generation in autonomous-driving world models. Semantic occupancy abstracts image color and texture into discrete labels, leaving 3D voxel arrangements as the primary cues for distinguishing local shapes within each class. Existing methods borrow image-encoding frameworks to obtain compact latent representations through height channelization or plane factorization, but do not sufficiently model within-column height patterns and cross-column relations jointly before compression, weakening these geometric cues. Forecasting also underutilizes complementary history and struggles to retain reliable observation evidence. We therefore propose GeoTex, an occupancy world model combining geometry-as-texture encoding with history-grounded forecasting. GeoTex Representation jointly encodes within-column height patterns and cross-column relations into compact continuous latent representations and restores 3D structure through content-dependent height unfolding and geometric interaction. GeoTex Prediction retains initial evidence throughout rollout in fixed cross-observation relational memory and incorporates complementary recent history through target-referenced residual updates. After prediction training, decoder-only adaptation improves semantic decoding of predicted states. GeoTex improves average forecasting mIoU and IoU by 9.79% and 11.91% relative to GenieDrive while reducing parameters from 3.47M to 2.33M, with gains increasing at longer horizons. Code is included in the supplementary material.

AI.tldr: GeoTex是一个4D占用世界模型，通过"几何即纹理"编码与历史锚定预测，提升自动驾驶场景的占用预测精度并减小模型规模。
AI.motivation: 语义占用将颜色纹理离散化后，类内形状区分主要依赖3D体素排布；现有方法借用图像编码框架（高度通道化或平面分解）获取紧凑隐表示，但压缩前未联合建模列内高度模式与列间关系，削弱了几何线索。同时预测阶段未充分利用互补历史信息，也难以保留可靠观测证据。
AI.method: 分两部分：(1) GeoTex Representation：在压缩前联合编码列内高度模式与列间关系为紧凑连续隐表示，并通过内容依赖的高度展开与几何交互恢复3D结构；(2) GeoTex Prediction：以固定跨观测关系记忆在rollout全程保留初始证据，并通过目标参照的残差更新融入近期互补历史；预测训练后采用decoder-only适配改进预测状态的语义解码。
AI.result: 相对GenieDrive，平均预测mIoU与IoU分别提升9.79%和11.91%，参数量由3.47M降至2.33M，且预测时域越长增益越明显。
AI.conclusion: 显式联合建模列内与列间几何、并以历史锚定的记忆机制进行预测，可在更小模型下显著提升4D占用预测性能，且长时域优势突出。

title: DLaR: Dynamic Stochasticity Control for Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Latent reasoning enables LLMs to operate in continuous embedding space, yet existing methods suffer from deterministic inference that precludes exploration of diverse reasoning paths. While recent approaches inject stochasticity to restore exploration, we identify two fundamental limitations: \textit{uniform stochasticity} across all steps is suboptimal, and unconstrained perturbations disrupt reasoning coherence. We propose Dynamic Stochasticity Control for Latent Reasoning (DLaR), a framework with two complementary mechanisms that operate at different temporal granularities within the GRPO reinforcement learning framework. At the token level, Adaptive Stochasticity Modulation (ASM) dynamically adjusts perturbation intensity at each latent step based on a confidence-entropy fusion signal, increasing exploration when the model is uncertain and preserving stability when confident. At the training level, Training-Aware Stochasticity Tuning (TAST) progressively decays the base stochasticity level following a curriculum schedule. Through this dual-level design, DLaR establishes a hierarchical exploration-exploitation strategy that operates at both token and training levels. Extensive experiments on four in-distribution and three out-of-distribution mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that DLaR achieves the highest average performance across model scales, reaching 27.9%/50.6% Pass@1/Pass@8 on Llama-3.2-1B and 46.8%/68.2% on Qwen2.5-1.5B. Code: \href{https://github.com/xiaocen-luo/DLaR}{https://github.com/xiaocen-luo/DLaR}.

AI.tldr: DLaR 提出“动态随机性控制”框架，通过 token 级自适应扰动强度（ASM）与训练级随机性衰减课程（TAST）双时间粒度机制，在 GRPO 框架下实现隐式推理的分层探索—利用平衡，取得最优平均性能。
AI.motivation: 现有隐式（latent）推理方法采用确定性推理，无法探索多样推理路径；虽引入随机性以恢复探索，但存在两个根本缺陷：一是全步骤统一的随机性强度并非最优，二是无约束扰动会破坏推理连贯性。
AI.method: 在 GRPO 强化学习框架内设计双粒度机制：token 级 ASM 依据置信度—熵融合信号，在每步隐状态上动态调节扰动强度，模型不确定时增强探索、置信时保持稳定；训练级 TAST 按课程调度渐进衰减基础随机性水平。
AI.result: 在 4 个同分布与 3 个分布外数学推理基准上，跨模型规模取得最高平均性能：Llama-3.2-1B 上 Pass@1/Pass@8 为 27.9%/50.6%，Qwen2.5-1.5B 上为 46.8%/68.2%。
AI.conclusion: token 级与训练级的双层设计构成分层探索—利用策略，可有效缓解统一随机性次优与扰动破坏连贯性的问题，验证了动态可控随机性对隐式推理的有效性。

title: Least Restrictive Halfplane Control Barrier Functions for an Autonomous Hydrofoil Boat with Moving Obstacles
summary: Finding valid Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) is difficult for non-linear systems subject to actuation constraints and moving in complex environments. One way to enable analytically derived CBFs is to represent obstacles as supporting halfplanes, allowing the agent to move safely on one side. In this paper, we propose such a CBF for an agent with Dubins car dynamics. A potential drawback of halfplane CBFs is that they can be highly conservative, overestimating the obstacles and thereby restricting the agent's motion. To address this problem, we make the CBF halfplanes less restrictive as follows. First, the orientation of the supporting halfplane for a single obstacle is optimised to find a safe control input as close as possible to the desired one. Second, we use multiple halfplanes to better approximate complex geometries, and derive rules for handling halfplane intersections. Comparative simulations show that our method reduces conservatism compared to existing CBF techniques, enabling tighter obstacle clearance and faster goal arrival, with delays reduced by more than 33%. Finally, experiments on an autonomous hydrofoil boat demonstrate successful real-world implementation.

AI.tldr: 针对具有Dubins车动力学、受执行约束且处于复杂环境中的智能体，提出一种基于支撑半平面的控制障碍函数（CBF），通过优化半平面朝向并用多半平面近似复杂障碍以降低保守性。
AI.motivation: 非线性系统在执行约束与复杂环境下难以找到有效的控制障碍函数；将障碍表示为支撑半平面可获得解析CBF，但半平面CBF往往过于保守，会高估障碍并限制智能体运动。
AI.method: 1）为Dubins车动力学智能体构造半平面CBF；2）针对单一障碍，在线优化支撑半平面的朝向，使安全控制输入尽可能接近期望输入；3）采用多个半平面逼近复杂几何形状，并给出处理半平面交集的安全规则。
AI.result: 对比仿真表明该方法比现有CBF技术保守性更低，可实现更紧的障碍间距与更快到达目标，延迟降低超过33%；在自主水翼艇上的实验验证了真实环境下的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 通过半平面朝向优化与多半平面组合，可在保持解析CBF安全保证的同时显著降低保守性，该方法在仿真与实船实验中均有效。

title: Crucible: Evaluating LLM Agents in Executable Chemistry Research Environments
summary: Large language models (LLMs) perform well on chemistry knowledge benchmarks, which mainly assess question answering and isolated tasks. Chemical research, however, requires using specialized tools and interpreting their outputs to obtain chemically valid results. To address this gap, we introduce Crucible Bench to evaluate this ability across all four stages of the design-make-test-analyze (DMTA) cycle. The benchmark contains 1,078 tasks in 12 task families curated from 18 published datasets, covering molecular design, synthesis planning, experimental execution, closed-loop optimization, simulation, and analytical characterization. Agents access 75 domain-specific tools through the Model Context Protocol in seven isolated environments. Sandboxed graders verify the resulting synthesis routes, experimental protocols, and other outputs. Laboratory tasks use robotic simulators or previously measured experimental data. We evaluate 14 LLMs as agents and find that the best achieves an overall score of 0.545, with synthesis planning and closed-loop optimization emerging as the hardest domains. Overall performance does not predict optimization performance well: the model ranked twelfth overall achieves the highest score in closed-loop optimization. Error analysis also shows that agents often submit chemically invalid results despite running their tools successfully. Stronger models benefit more from tool access, but reliable use of chemical software remains a challenge that Crucible Bench can track as models improve.

AI.tldr: 提出 Crucible Bench 基准，覆盖 DMTA 全周期的 1078 个任务、12 个任务族，通过 MCP 提供 75 个领域工具，评估 14 个 LLM 智能体的化学工具使用与结果有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有化学知识基准主要考察问答与孤立任务，而真实化学研究需要调用专业工具并正确解读其输出以获得化学上有效的结果，二者之间存在评估空白。
AI.method: 构建 Crucible Bench：任务源自 18 个已发表数据集，涵盖分子设计、合成规划、实验执行、闭环优化、模拟与表征分析；智能体在 7 个隔离环境中经 Model Context Protocol 访问 75 个领域专用工具；采用沙盒评分器校验合成路线、实验方案等输出，实验类任务使用机器人模拟器或已有实测数据；评测 14 个 LLM 智能体并做错误分析。
AI.result: 最佳模型总体得分 0.545；合成规划与闭环优化最难；总分排名与优化表现不相关（总分第十二的模型在闭环优化中得分最高）；智能体常出现工具调用成功但结果化学无效的情况；更强的模型从工具访问中获益更多。
AI.conclusion: 化学软件与工具的可靠使用仍是挑战，Crucible Bench 可作为追踪模型该能力进展的评测基准。

title: Efficient Scene-Distribution-Aware Second-Order Optimization for 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to ACCV 2026
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) optimization updates the Gaussian parameters one training view at a time, tens of thousands of times. Unlike such single-view updates, multi-view batches reduce dependence on individual training views, and second-order optimization reduces the number of updates with larger, structured parameter changes. Because fewer updates leave fewer chances to correct a change that fits only the views used in one update, scene coverage becomes more important for each second-order update. Multi-view second-order updates, however, are expensive. Pixel sampling reduces this cost, but two issues remain. First, selecting views without considering overlap leaves some views redundant. To address this, we propose a view selection strategy that reduces this redundancy. Second, existing work processes the sampled pixels of each view in a separate pass and recomputes alpha compositing for these pixels from scratch. We introduce two implementation strategies that reduce both overheads by processing the sampled pixels of multiple views in joint passes and reusing the transmittance and accumulated color cached during rendering. On three datasets, our method reaches higher PSNR than the sampled second-order baseline in less than half its optimization time, with competitive SSIM and LPIPS.

AI.tldr: 提出面向3DGS的多视角二阶优化加速方案，通过考虑视角重叠的视角选择策略与联合像素处理/透射率缓存复用，在三个数据集上以不到一半时间取得更高PSNR。
AI.motivation: 3DGS优化逐视角更新、次数极多；多视角批处理可降低单视角依赖，二阶优化可用更大结构化步长减少更新次数。但更新次数减少意味着纠错机会减少，场景覆盖更重要，因此多视角二阶更新必要却昂贵。像素采样虽降成本，仍存在两问题：选视角忽视重叠导致冗余；各视角采样像素分趟处理且alpha合成从零重算，开销大。
AI.method: 1) 提出考虑视角间重叠的视角选择策略，减少冗余视角、提升每次二阶更新的场景覆盖率；2) 两种实现策略：将多视角的采样像素放入联合pass处理，并复用渲染过程中已缓存的透射率与累积颜色，避免alpha合成重算。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上，方法PSNR高于采样二阶基线，且优化时间不到其一半；SSIM与LPIPS具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 多视角二阶优化配合重叠感知视角选择与联合pass+缓存复用，可同时提升3DGS优化质量与效率，为高阶优化在3DGS中的实用化提供有效路径。

title: Kolpona: An Agentic Framework with Gradient-Free Neuron Programming for RTL Generation
summary: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) for register-transfer level (RTL) design are usually improved by fine-tuning on curated Verilog corpora, which needs large sets of verified designs and GPU training. We present Kolpona, an agentic framework that improves such models without gradient training. Its first component is neuron programming, a new form of weight-space programming (WSP) that writes single neurons in closed form into the weights to remove failure habits found on practice tasks, and keeps each edit only when testbench results on fresh tasks favour it. At inference time, tool-using agents propose designs, and a label-free selection stage delivers one design per task from the specification, the candidates and their simulations alone. On Qwen3.5-4B, edits to 16 neurons raise the VerilogEval v2 pass@1 of the model alone from 31.7% to 55.4%, and the full framework reaches 77.6%. On Qwen3.8-27B, Kolpona lifts pass@1 from 73.1% to 94.9% on VerilogEval v2 and from 66.0% to 92.0% on RTLLM v2.1 on a single 32 GB GPU, above every published system in our comparison. The RTL edits also carry over to Python and raise the pass@1 of the 4B model alone from 84.8% to 91.5% on HumanEval+ and from 67.7% to 77.5% on MBPP+.

AI.tldr: 提出 Kolpona 框架，无需梯度训练即可提升开源权重 LLM 的 RTL 设计能力：以"神经元编程"在权重空间定点写入单个神经元并配合推理期工具智能体与无标签选择，在 VerilogEval v2 与 RTLLM v2.1 上显著超越已发表系统。
AI.motivation: 现有开源权重 LLM 用于 RTL 设计时，通常依赖在精选 Verilog 语料上微调，需要大量已验证设计和 GPU 训练资源，成本高、门槛大。作者希望找到一种不依赖梯度训练的替代提升路径。
AI.method: 1）神经元编程：一种新的权重空间编程（WSP），以闭式解将单个神经元写入模型权重，用于消除实践任务中暴露的失败习惯，且仅在新鲜任务的测试台结果支持时才保留该编辑；2）推理阶段由工具使用型智能体生成候选设计；3）无标签选择阶段仅依据规格说明、候选设计及其仿真结果，为每个任务选出一个设计。
AI.result: Qwen3.5-4B 上，仅修改 16 个神经元即把模型单独在 VerilogEval v2 的 pass@1 从 31.7% 提升到 55.4%，完整框架达 77.6%。Qwen3.8-27B 上，单张 32 GB GPU 下 VerilogEval v2 从 73.1% 升至 94.9%，RTLLM v2.1 从 66.0% 升至 92.0%，高于对比中的全部已发表系统。此外，RTL 相关编辑还能迁移到 Python：4B 模型单独使用时 HumanEval+ 从 84.8% 升至 91.5%，MBPP+ 从 67.7% 升至 77.5%。
AI.conclusion: Kolpona 表明可通过闭式、可验证的权重空间编辑结合智能体推理与无标签选择，在不做梯度训练的情况下大幅提升 RTL 生成质量，并具备跨任务（RTL→Python）的可迁移性，硬件需求仅需单张 32 GB GPU。

title: SkySearcher: High-Altitude Onboard VLM Reasoning for Aerial Semantic Search
summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have improved semantic and visual reasoning, enabling UAVs to search for open-vocabulary queries in unstructured environments at high altitude. However, existing systems mainly follow low-altitude strategies, focusing on close-range iterative exploration, requiring storage-intensive dense 3D metric-semantic reconstructions or relying on large cloud-serviced VLMs assuming constant internet access. We propose SkySearcher, an aerial semantic search navigation method designed for large outdoor scenes. SkySearcher integrates onboard VLM reasoning with a lightweight probabilistic representation that guides an information-driven exploration. The VLM extracts semantic information at high altitude about the target or cues informing about its location. This information is projected to the ground using the camera frustum instead of limited-depth sensors, actively exploiting the expansive field of view offered by elevated sensing. The information regarding the presence or absence of semantic cues is then integrated into a probabilistic map by modeling the spatial belief of the query, maintaining a task-driven memory for the mission and guiding the exploration towards semantically promising regions. Extensive simulations for Aerial Object Goal Navigation on public benchmarks demonstrate that SkySearcher significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in success rate, flight time, and navigation precision, while a deployment of SkySercher running fully onboard a drone demonstrates the applicability of our approach.

AI.tldr: SkySearcher 提出一种面向大型室外场景的空中语义搜索导航方法，将机载视觉语言模型（VLM）推理与轻量级概率表征结合，用相机视锥体将高空语义信息投影到地面，并以概率地图引导信息驱动的探索，在仿真基准与真机部署中均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机开放词汇语义搜索系统多沿用低空策略：依赖近距离迭代探索、需要存储密集的三维度量-语义重建，或依赖云端大型 VLM 并假设网络持续可用。这些假设不适应高空、大范围、非结构化室外场景的搜索需求。
AI.method: 1）在机载端运行 VLM 推理，于高空提取关于目标本身或其位置线索的语义信息；2）不依赖有限深度传感器，而利用相机视锥体将语义信息投影到地面，主动利用高空视角的大视场覆盖；3）将语义线索存在/不存在的观测，通过建模查询的空间置信度融合进概率地图，形成任务驱动的记忆，引导探索朝向语义上更可能存在的区域。
AI.result: 在公开基准的空中目标物体目标导航（Aerial Object Goal Navigation）仿真实验中，SkySearcher 在成功率、飞行时间与导航精度上显著优于当前最优基线；同时展示了完全机载运行于真实无人机的部署可行性。
AI.conclusion: 高空视角下"机载 VLM 语义推理 + 视锥体地面投影 + 概率置信地图"的组合可在无需稠密三维重建与云端大模型的条件下实现高效空中语义搜索，兼顾性能与机载可部署性。

title: MeterRouter: Budget-Aware Dynamic Routing for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs) outperform single-agent systems, but inter-agent communication incurs substantial token overhead. While assigning a large LLM to every agent is common, it results in inefficient resource utilization, leaving the system far from the Pareto frontier. The cost of answering a query is set jointly by how many agents are recruited, the role and LLM assigned to each, and communication topology among them. Most existing routers treat cost only implicitly rather than as an explicit optimization constraint. A fixed accuracy-cost preference also cannot express how much a caller is willing to pay for a particular query. We introduce MeterRouter, a budget-aware dynamic router that incrementally synthesizes a collaboration graph by selecting each agent's role, LLM, incoming connections, and termination conditioned on the query and a per-query monetary budget. We initialize the router by imitating successful execution graphs, then jointly refine its decisions with a variant of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) whose reward favors correct answers and penalizes spending and budget overruns. Across five benchmarks and a three-tier LLM pool, MeterRouter is (1) accurate, achieving performance comparable to the strongest MAS; (2) economical, reaching that accuracy at 82% lower cost than the strongest MAS router and extending the accuracy-cost frontier beyond the ceiling of single-agent systems; and (3) controllable, adapting its spending to the specified budget while rarely exceeding it.

AI.tldr: MeterRouter：一种按每条查询预算动态合成多智能体协作图的路由器，在选择角色、LLM、入边与终止条件时显式约束成本，兼顾精度与经济性。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）优于单智能体，但智能体间通信带来大量token开销；给每个智能体都配大模型导致资源利用低效、远离Pareto前沿。查询成本由招募的智能体数量、各自角色与所用LLM、通信拓扑共同决定，而现有路由器仅隐式考虑成本，且固定精度-成本偏好无法表达调用方对特定查询的付费意愿。
AI.method: 提出预算感知的动态路由器MeterRouter，以查询及其单条查询金钱预算为条件，增量式合成协作图：逐步选定每个智能体的角色、LLM、入边连接与终止。先用成功执行图做模仿初始化，再用GRPO变体联合精化决策，奖励鼓励正确答案、惩罚花费与预算超支。
AI.result: 在5个基准与三层LLM池上：精度与最强MAS相当；成本较最强MAS路由器低82%，并将精度-成本前沿推至单智能体系统上限之外；能按指定预算调整开销且很少超支。
AI.conclusion: 将成本作为显式优化约束、并支持逐查询预算控制，可在保持MAS精度的同时显著降本，实现精度-成本-可控性三者兼顾。

title: Nepali Currency Denomination Classification Using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and MobileNetV2: An Experimental Comparison
summary: Automated currency denomination recognition is a computer vision task with applications in cash handling, financial technology, and assistive systems. This study classifies seven Nepali currency denominations (Rs. 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 500, and 1,000) using three configurations: a conventional convolutional neural network (CNN), MobileNetV2 with transfer learning, and MobileNetV2 with hyperparameter tuning. A compiled dataset of 16,249 images was used, comprising 10,500 training, 3,500 validation, and 2,249 independent test images. Images were resized to 128 x 128 pixels, normalized, and augmented to vary orientation, scale, illumination, and appearance. Models were evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and precision-recall and ROC analysis. The hyperparameter-tuned MobileNetV2 achieved the highest validation accuracy (95\%), with precision, recall, and F1-score of 0.93, 0.91, and 0.92, but reached only 84\% accuracy on the held-out test set. MobileNetV2 with transfer learning but no additional tuning achieved 89\% test accuracy, and the conventional CNN achieved 85\%. Transfer learning therefore provided a competitive approach under the evaluated conditions, while higher validation accuracy from tuning did not yield higher test accuracy. To demonstrate practical deployment, a Flask-based web prototype using TensorFlow Lite was developed, supporting image upload and live webcam recognition with both visual and voice output. The study shows the feasibility of combining lightweight deep learning with a voice-assisted web interface for Nepali currency recognition, and highlights the need for more diverse datasets, greater robustness under uncontrolled imaging conditions, and broader real-world evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该研究用传统CNN、MobileNetV2迁移学习和MobileNetV2超参数调优三种配置识别七种尼泊尔纸币面额，其中未经调优的迁移学习模型测试准确率最高（89%），并实现了基于Flask与TensorFlow Lite的语音辅助Web原型。
AI.motivation: 自动货币面额识别在现金处理、金融科技和辅助系统中有实际应用需求，本文针对尼泊尔卢比面额识别任务，比较不同轻量级深度学习方案的性能并验证其部署可行性。
AI.method: 构建16,249张图像数据集（训练10,500、验证3,500、独立测试2,249），图像统一缩放至128×128并做归一化与增强（方向、尺度、光照、外观变化）。比较三种模型配置：传统CNN、MobileNetV2迁移学习、MobileNetV2+超参数调优；采用准确率、精确率、召回率、F1及PR/ROC分析进行评估，并开发基于Flask与TensorFlow Lite的Web原型，支持图片上传与实时摄像头识别，输出视觉与语音结果。
AI.result: 超参数调优的MobileNetV2取得最高验证准确率95%，精确率0.93、召回率0.91、F1为0.92，但独立测试集准确率仅84%；未调优的迁移学习MobileNetV2测试准确率为89%，传统CNN为85%。
AI.conclusion: 在所评估条件下迁移学习是具竞争力的方案，验证集准确率提升并未转化为测试集性能提升，提示存在过拟合或数据分布差异；研究验证了轻量深度学习结合语音辅助Web界面的可行性，同时指出未来需要更多样化数据集、更强非受控成像条件鲁棒性及更广泛的真实场景评估。

title: Quaternion-Tucker ZigZag Networks: Halving Transformer Backbone Parameters and Enabling Exact 2D Zero-Loss Continual Scaling
comment: 12 pages, 12 figures, 6 tables. Code: https://github.com/shu195/QuatTucker-ZigZagGPT | Open weights: https://huggingface.co/spacetime9 | Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24424501
summary: Standard Transformers allocate independent dense weight matrices to every feed-forward network (FFN) layer, coupling parameters linearly with depth (O(L)) and discarding prior compute when scaling capacity. Conversely, weight-tied Looped Transformers decouple depth from parameters (O(1)) but enforce time-homogeneous updates. We formulate the L-layer FFN stack as a 3D Tensor Cuboid and introduce QuatTucker-ZigZagGPT, unifying: (1) 4D Quaternion Hamilton GEMMs in bfloat16 (4x FFN compression), (2) 64x64 Block-Diagonal Tucker SwiGLU Cores for depth-specific rotations over a shared basis, (3) Braided ZigZag Diamond Routing (L0 -> L2 -> L1 -> L3) for zero-FLOP top-down refinement, and (4) Exact 2D Zero-Loss Continual Scaling in both width and depth. We also introduce Annealed Gated Bounce-Back Scaffolding (GatedBounce), which self-distills to 0.0% inference overhead. Across algorithmic tasks (8-bit Parity, 56-seed routing ablations, Mod-53 Grokking) and language modeling (TinyStories, FineWeb-Edu), our model outperforms standard Transformers at 2x-7.6x compression. On A100, QuatTucker-ZigZagGPT-12 (39.0M backbone) beats StandardGPT-12 (85.0M backbone) at 5/5 controlled checkpoints. Continually scaling one lineage across 6.00B tokens via zero-loss width growth (rank 6144 -> 8192), two bit-exact depth expansions (L = 12 -> 16 -> 20, 70.9M backbone, max_diff = 0.000000), and WSD cooldown reaches 3.3582 FineWeb-Edu loss (28.74 PPL) and 44.75% full-split zero-shot accuracy across 16,955 questions (ARC-Easy, HellaSwag, WinoGrande, BoolQ), matching GPT-3 Small (125M, 300B tokens) at 50x fewer tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出QuatTucker-ZigZagGPT，将L层FFN堆栈建模为3D张量立方体，结合四元数GEMM、块对角Tucker核心、ZigZag路由与零损失宽度/深度持续扩展，在2x-7.6x压缩下超越标准Transformer。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer每层FFN分配独立稠密权重，参数量随深度线性增长（O(L)），扩容时丢弃已训练计算；权重绑定的Looped Transformer虽实现O(1)参数，却强制时间同质更新，缺乏深度特异性表达能力。
AI.method: （1）bfloat16下的4D四元数Hamilton GEMM，实现4x FFN压缩；（2）64x64块对角Tucker SwiGLU核心，在共享基上做深度特异的旋转；（3）Braided ZigZag Diamond路由（L0→L2→L1→L3），实现零FLOP的自顶向下精炼；（4）宽度与深度两个方向上的精确二维零损失持续扩展；（5）Annealed Gated Bounce-Back Scaffolding（GatedBounce），自蒸馏后推理开销降至0.0%。
AI.result: 在算法任务（8-bit Parity、56-seed路由消融、Mod-53 Grokking）和语言建模（TinyStories、FineWeb-Edu）上，2x-7.6x压缩即优于标准Transformer；A100上QuatTucker-ZigZagGPT-12（39.0M骨干）在5/5对照检查点击败StandardGPT-12（85.0M）。单一家系经6.00B tokens持续扩展（宽度rank 6144→8192、两次位精确深度扩展L=12→16→20，70.9M骨干，max_diff=0.000000）及WSD退火，达到FineWeb-Edu loss 3.3582（PPL 28.74），16,955题全划分零样本准确率44.75%，以50x更少token匹配GPT-3 Small（125M, 300B tokens）。
AI.conclusion: 将FFN堆栈张量化并辅以深度特异旋转与路由，可在参数和计算大幅压缩下保持甚至超越标准Transformer；零损失位精确的宽度/深度持续扩展为训练期扩容提供了可行路径，显著提升token效率。

title: An Exact Branch-Price-and-Cut Algorithm for the Vehicle Routing Problem with Floating Targets
summary: The Vehicle Routing Problem with Floating Targets (VRPFT) is a generalization of the capacitated vehicle routing problem where targets may actively move to locations ''convenient'' for the vehicles. In particular, each target may leave its home location at a bounded speed. A solution to the VRPFT is a sequence of targets for each vehicle to visit and a meeting point in space-time for each target. In this paper, we solve the VRPFT exactly with a branch-price-and-cut algorithm. Our key contribution is a dominance criterion for the pricing labeling algorithm that utilizes closed-form lower and upper bounds on a vehicle's trajectory cost given a fixed sequence of targets. We prove that the criterion preserves optimality, and the algorithm has smaller computation time than the exact dynamic program of prior work on identical hardware. We also provide a relaxed criterion that prunes more aggressively; the resulting heuristic is faster than our exact algorithm and matched every certified optimum on the benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文针对带浮动目标的车辆路径问题（VRPFT），提出基于分支定价切割（branch-price-and-cut）的精确算法，其核心是利用给定目标序列下车辆轨迹成本的闭式上下界构造定价标签算法的支配准则；该准则保持最优性，计算时间优于已有的精确动态规划，另外给出更激进的松弛支配准则以加速启发式求解。
AI.motivation: VRPFT 是容量约束车辆路径问题的推广，目标可按有界速度主动移动以与车辆会合，解需同时确定每辆车的访问序列与各目标在时空中的会合点，问题更复杂；已有工作采用精确动态规划，计算开销较大，需要更高效的精确求解方法。
AI.method: 采用分支定价切割框架精确求解 VRPFT。关键贡献是定价环节标签算法中的支配准则：针对固定的目标访问序列，推导车辆轨迹成本的闭式下界与上界，并据此构建支配判定，作者证明该准则不损失最优性；此外提出剪枝更强的松弛支配准则，用于构造快速启发式。
AI.result: 在相同硬件条件下，所提精确算法计算时间少于已有工作的精确动态规划；基于松弛准则的启发式算法运行更快，且在基准算例上匹配了全部已证明最优解（certified optimum）。
AI.conclusion: 基于轨迹成本闭式上下界的支配准则能有效提升 VRPFT 精确求解效率并保持最优性，松弛版本在保持解质量的同时进一步提升速度，为动态目标类路径问题的高效精确求解提供了可行途径。

title: EvoLink-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Self-Evolving Agents in Long-Horizon Interdependent Task Streams
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from passive chatbots into autonomous systems that operate continuously in dynamic environments. Such agents need not only solve current tasks but also learn from past interactions to improve future performance. However, existing streaming benchmarks often rely on short task sequences or largely independent tasks, providing limited evidence of whether agents can effectively reuse experience when later tasks depend on earlier outcomes. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{EvoLink-Bench}, a benchmark for evaluating self-evolving agents in long-horizon, interdependent task streams. It covers daily office work, multi-turn dialogue, and AutoResearch-style workflows, with persistent workspaces and dependencies across tasks. The benchmark includes two complementary levels: \textbf{L1}, which evaluates the acquisition and revision of language-expressible knowledge, and \textbf{L2}, which assesses the development of task-level capabilities through execution and feedback. Its evaluation further distinguishes within-task recovery, persistent-state updates, and experience reuse in later tasks. We evaluate five agent frameworks across three backbone configurations under three persistence conditions, covering 19,635 scored task slots from selected evaluation cohorts. Results show that no framework consistently performs best across both levels, retries recover only a limited proportion of failed tasks, and persistent-state updates do not necessarily improve subsequent performance. Furthermore, the effects of evolution differ between knowledge- and capability-level tasks, suggesting that these two forms of evolution require different learning mechanisms. Performance gains also vary across domains and task streams, with improvements on some tasks not necessarily extending to others.

AI.tldr: 提出 EvoLink-Bench，用于评测 LLM 智能体在长时程、任务间存在依赖的任务流中的自我进化能力；结果显示各框架无明显全面优势，重试修复率有限，持久状态更新并不必然带来后续性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有流式基准多为短任务序列或近似独立任务，难以检验智能体能否在后续任务依赖前序结果时复用经验，缺乏对"自进化"能力的有效证据。
AI.method: 构建 EvoLink-Bench：覆盖日常办公、多轮对话与 AutoResearch 风格工作流，采用持久化工作区与跨任务依赖；设置两个层级——L1 评测语言可表达知识的获取与修正，L2 通过执行与反馈评测任务级能力发展；评估维度区分任务内恢复、持久状态更新、后续任务经验复用。实验选取五个智能体框架 × 三种主干配置 × 三种持久化条件，共统计 19,635 个受评任务槽位。
AI.result: 无框架在两个层级上均持续最优；重试仅能恢复有限比例失败任务；持久状态更新不必然改善后续表现；知识层与能力层的"进化"效应存在差异；性能增益随领域与任务流而异，局部提升未必可迁移。
AI.conclusion: 评测表明当前智能体尚缺乏稳定的经验复用与自我进化能力，知识级与能力级进化需要不同的学习机制，跨领域迁移亦受限；EvoLink-Bench 为长时程依赖任务流下的自进化研究提供了可复现的评测基础设施。

title: VTK-Bench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Distinguishing Language Priors and Text Modal Bias in Visual Language Models
summary: Visual language models (VLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities across various multimodal tasks, but they remain susceptible to hallucinations, undermining their reliability. Existing hallucination benchmarks primarily focus on identifying hallucinations and describing their manifestations, often neglecting their underlying causes. Specifically, multimodal hallucinations can stem from two distinct failure modes: text modality bias (TMB), reflecting an over-reliance on misleading text input; and language prior (LP), reflecting a reliance on previously learned knowledge. To differentiate these failure modes, we propose VTK-Bench, a benchmark that explicitly separates three information sources: visual information (V), textual information (T), and prior knowledge (K).
