By establishing mutually exclusive answers corresponding to V, T, and K, VTK-Bench enables fine-grained attribution analysis of model responses. Furthermore, we introduce discrete attribution and soft attribution metrics to characterize information source preferences. Extensive experiments on 11 representative open-source VLMs show that LP is more prevalent than TMB in most evaluated models. Notably, TMB decreases substantially with model scaling, whereas LP exhibits relatively limited improvement and remains the dominant failure mode. These findings highlight the importance of different information source preferences for a deeper understanding of multimodal hallucinations.

AI.tldr: 提出 VTK-Bench 基准，将多模态幻觉拆解为文本模态偏置（TMB）与语言先验（LP）两类失效模式，通过分离视觉（V）、文本（T）、先验知识（K）三源信息并设置互斥答案，实现细粒度归因分析。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉基准多聚焦于"是否幻觉"及其表现形式，忽视幻觉产生的根本原因；而多模态幻觉可能源于对误导性文本的过度依赖（TMB）或对已学知识的依赖（LP），二者需被区分以支撑更深入的理解。
AI.method: 构建 VTK-Bench：显式分离视觉信息 V、文本信息 T、先验知识 K 三个信息源，为每个样本构造分别对应 V/T/K 的互斥答案，使模型回答可被唯一归因；同时提出离散归因（discrete attribution）与软归因（soft attribution）两类指标以刻画模型的信息源偏好。
AI.result: 在 11 个代表性开源 VLM 上的实验表明：多数模型中 LP 比 TMB 更普遍；TMB 随模型规模增大显著下降，而 LP 改善有限并持续作为主导失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 信息源偏好差异是理解多模态幻觉的关键维度；单纯依赖模型缩放难以缓解语言先验驱动的幻觉，需要针对性的训练或解码策略。

title: MolGPAO: Molecular Generative Pre-trained Autoregressive Octree with Speculative Decoding and Sub-Millisecond Seam Healing for 3D Molecules
summary: Autoregressive generation over adaptive 3D octrees (Uni-3DAR) offers an intrinsic $O(N \log N)$ sparsity advantage over dense $O(N^2)$ equivariant diffusion and flow models on large drug-like molecules, yet lags in geometric equilibrium, closed-shell valence stability, and property fidelity due to Morton-seam coordinate jumps, leaf-heavy compute with root-count trapping, and target-shortcut collapse in internal critics. We introduce MolGPAO (Molecular Generative Pre-trained Autoregressive Octree), a standalone 3D octree architecture and single-output speculative tree-decoding engine using zero external surrogates, zero reinforcement learning, and zero inference-time MLIP relaxation. MolGPAO unifies: (1) non-trapping 6-D ScaleFreeBudgetEmbedding with L5-to-L1 covalent packing priors; (2) a FlashAttention-2 pause-and-gather speculative octree funnel ($m_{s1} \to m_{s2} \to 1$, $M_{\mathrm{out}} = 1$); (3) an anti-shortcut ground-truth TwoStageOctreeProcessCritic with 64-RBF covalent edge gating and $SO(3)$-invariant 12-channel multipole norms (blind QM9 $r = 0.9867$--$0.9989$); (4) a $<0.5$ ms 4-layer $SE(3)$ PostTreeGraphRefiner for Morton-seam healing, expected-XYZ bonded supervision, selective CFG, and zero-heavy-displacement valence reconciliation; and (5) bubble-free stride-2 GPU leaf decoding. Across GEOM-Drugs (0.49 GPU-h), disjoint 50k/50k QM9 (0.43 GPU-h), and PBE0/def2-TZVP-verified OE62 (0.56 GPU-h), MolGPAO lifts drug-scale valid-connected yield 6.78x (12.7% to 86.2%, 99.83% atom stability), runs 7.3x faster (or 1.65x faster at 2.0x yield) than 100-step FlowMol at $N=100$, beats 156 GPU-h PropMolFlow on QM9 HOMO (-12.7%) and dipole (-21.0%) at 362x lower compute, and doubles live DFT hit rate on OE62 (33.3% vs. 16.7%) at 92.8x lower compute.

AI.tldr: MolGPAO 是一个独立的 3D 八叉树自回归分子生成架构与单输出推测式树解码引擎，在保持 O(N log N) 稀疏优势的同时，通过尺度预算嵌入、推测式八叉树漏斗、抗捷径两阶段过程评判器、SE(3) 后处理精修与无气泡叶解码，显著提升了药物尺度分子的几何平衡、闭壳层价键稳定性和性质保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有 Uni-3DAR 类自适应 3D 八叉树自回归生成相比稠密 O(N^2) 等变扩散/流模型具有 O(N log N) 稀疏优势，但存在三类缺陷：(1) Morton 序接缝导致坐标跳变，损害几何平衡；(2) 叶子计算过重且根计数陷阱导致闭壳层价键不稳定；(3) 内部评判器的目标捷径坍缩（target-shortcut collapse）造成性质保真度下降。作者希望无需外部代理模型、强化学习或推理时 MLIP 弛豫即可解决上述问题。
AI.method: 五项统一设计：(1) 非陷阱 6-D ScaleFreeBudgetEmbedding，注入 L5→L1 共价堆积先验；(2) FlashAttention-2 的暂停-聚合推测式八叉树漏斗（m_s1→m_s2→1，M_out=1）；(3) 抗捷径的 Ground-Truth TwoStageOctreeProcessCritic，含 64-RBF 共价边门控与 SO(3) 不变 12 通道多极矩范数（盲测 QM9 r=0.9867–0.9989）；(4) <0.5 ms 的 4 层 SE(3) PostTreeGraphRefiner，用于 Morton 接缝修复、期望 XYZ 成键监督、选择性 CFG 与零重原子位移的价键调和；(5) 无气泡 stride-2 GPU 叶节点解码。
AI.result: GEOM-Drugs（0.49 GPU-h）：药物尺度有效连通产率提升 6.78 倍（12.7%→86.2%），原子稳定性 99.83%；N=100 时比 100 步 FlowMol 快 7.3 倍（或在 2.0 倍产率下快 1.65 倍）。QM9 分离 50k/50k（0.43 GPU-h）：HOMO 误差较 156 GPU-h 的 PropMolFlow 降低 12.7%，偶极矩降低 21.0%，算力低 362 倍。PBE0/def2-TZVP 验证的 OE62（0.56 GPU-h）：实时 DFT 命中率翻倍（33.3% vs 16.7%），算力低 92.8 倍。
AI.conclusion: 八叉树自回归生成可在无需外部代理、强化学习与推理期弛豫的前提下，于药物尺度同时实现高有效连通率、闭壳层价键稳定与高性质保真，并大幅降低算力开销，显示出相对扩散/流模型在效率-质量权衡上的竞争力。

title: Long-Horizon Planning with Latent World Models via Graph Anchors
summary:
Latent world models plan in a compact latent space by predicting the outcomes of actions. Their planners judge a plan by the latent distance between its
  predicted end state and the goal image. We show that this distance fails in two distinct ways. First, it loses directional signal a few steps from the
  goal, causing distant goals to fail. Second, it weighs the robot arm over the manipulated object, causing manipulation to fail at contact. We measure
  both failures directly on recorded data by asking whether a lower latent distance corresponds to true progress toward the goal. Across five
  environments, six visual representations (including raw pixels and V-JEPA 2), and nine Meta-World tasks, this ranking test cleanly separates the two
  failures, and the graph distance to a goal predicts where closed-loop planning breaks down. Both failures share a single remedy: replacing the distant
  goal with a nearby target that lies on a recorded trajectory. We realize this principle with Graph Anchors, a training-free planner for frozen latent
  world models. It builds a sparse graph once over the model's own training frames and aims each planning step at a node a few moves ahead along the
  shortest path to the goal, keeping paths on recorded transitions wherever contact matters. On goals up to 400 steps away, Graph Anchors raise LeWM's
  success from 13% to 85% on PointMaze-Medium, from 8% to 87% on PointMaze-Large, and from 5% to 71% on Push-T, where stronger search toward the goal
  fails and where prior training-free planners break down under missing step horizons, subsampling shortcuts, or fragmented contact.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示潜在世界模型规划器以"预测终态与目标图像的潜在距离"作为评价标准的两类系统性失效（方向信号消失、过度关注机械臂而忽略物体），并提出无需训练的图锚点（Graph Anchors）规划器：用训练帧构建稀疏图，将每步规划目标替换为最短路径上几步之外的近邻节点。该方法在最长400步的远程目标上把LeWM成功率从13%→85%（PointMaze-Medium）、8%→87%（PointMaze-Large）、5%→71%（Push-T）。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型在紧凑潜空间中通过预测动作后果进行规划，其核心评价指标是"预测终态与目标图像的潜距离"。但该距离并非可靠的进度度量：一方面在接近目标数步时失去方向信号，导致远程目标失败；另一方面它对机器人手臂的表征权重大于被操作物体，导致接触阶段的操作失败。现有免训练规划器在缺失步数视界、子采样捷径、接触碎片化等情形下也会崩溃，因此需要一个不依赖重新训练、且能同时缓解这两类失效的方案。
AI.method: 1) 失效诊断：在录制数据上做"排序检验"——检查更小的潜距离是否确实对应更接近目标的真实进展；覆盖5个环境、6种视觉表征（含原始像素与V-JEPA 2）与9个Meta-World任务，并用到目标的最短图距离预测闭环规划在何处崩溃。2) 统一补救原则：用位于已录制轨迹上的近邻目标替代遥远目标。3) Graph Anchors：对冻结的潜在世界模型，一次性在其自身训练帧上构建稀疏图；每一步规划时，将目标设为通往目标最短路径上"前方若干步"的节点作为锚点，从而保持路径贴合已记录的转移，在需要接触时尤为关键。整个方法免训练。
AI.result: 排序检验能清晰区分两类失效，图距离可预测闭环规划崩溃点。在距离目标最远400步的设定下，Graph Anchors 将 LeWM 的成功率显著提升：PointMaze-Medium 13%→85%，PointMaze-Large 8%→87%，Push-T 5%→71%。在Push-T上，更强地朝目标搜索反而失败，而既有免训练规划器在缺失步数视界、子采样捷径或接触碎片化情况下失效。
AI.conclusion: 潜距离作为规划评价指标存在本质缺陷（远程方向信号丢失与手臂—物体权重失衡），二者可通过"近邻轨迹锚点替代远程目标"这一统一原则同时解决。Graph Anchors 以零训练代价在冻结潜在世界模型上实现大幅成功率提升，说明规划的性能瓶颈可能主要在目标表征与评价方式而非模型容量或搜索强度。

title: Agentic Waterfall: An Intent-Driven Information Discovery Framework for Reclaiming User Control in the Attention Economy
summary: We formalize Agentic Waterfall Feed, a new problem of personalized information discovery in which users actively direct recommendations and the system adapts to evolving needs inferred from both explicit requests and browsing behavior. We address this problem with the Agentic Waterfall framework, whose language-model controller maintains persistent user state and coordinates content retrieval, ranking, and state updates. To evaluate systems on this task, we contribute the Agentic Waterfall Dataset and a replay-based evaluation protocol. The dataset combines real content metadata with simulated interaction histories. The protocol compares systems under shared histories using relevance scores and blind judgments of how well recommendations satisfy current user goals and constraints. Agentic Waterfall remains competitive with strong baselines on conventional recommendation tasks across five public benchmarks. On the Agentic Waterfall Dataset, it outperforms the strongest baseline in both evaluations, with relative improvements of up to 16.1%.

AI.tldr: 提出“Agentic Waterfall Feed”个性化信息发现新问题并给出Agentic Waterfall框架，配套数据集与回放式评测协议，在五个公开基准上保持竞争力，在自建数据集上相对最强基线最高提升16.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐多为系统单向驱动，用户难以主动引导推荐，系统也难以及时从显式请求与浏览行为中推断并适应用户不断演变的需求。
AI.method: 形式化Agentic Waterfall Feed任务；构建Agentic Waterfall框架，由语言模型控制器维护持续用户状态，并协同内容检索、排序与状态更新；构建结合真实内容元数据与模拟交互历史的Agentic Waterfall Dataset；设计基于回放的评价协议，在共享历史下以相关性分数与盲评判断推荐是否满足当前目标与约束。
AI.result: 在五个公开基准的传统推荐任务上与强基线保持竞争力；在Agentic Waterfall Dataset上两类评测均优于最强基线，相对提升最高16.1%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将个性化推荐重新表述为用户主动引导、系统持续适应的交互式发现问题，验证了LLM控制器维护用户状态的有效性，并提供可复现的数据集与共享历史评测协议。

title: DualCast: Dual-Image Conditioned Diffusion Transformers for Digital Human E-Commerce Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in world models for game interaction and control have increased the demand for large-scale gameplay videos paired with camera trajectories. However, capturing synchronized camera trajectories often requires game-specific pipelines, limiting scalability. We therefore propose GameWeaver, a unified diffusion framework that automatically produces paired video--camera data through three complementary tasks: camera pose estimation from observed video, video generation along a prescribed camera trajectory, and joint video--camera generation from a reference image and text. First, each tipxel stores the normalized 3D coordinates of a pixel ray's endpoint in a reference coordinate frame. The resulting three-channel tipxel fields and RGB frames share the pretrained video model's VAE. Next, a fully trainable dual-stream Transformer exchanges appearance and geometry features through bidirectional gated attention and conditions both streams on shared text features. Finally, deterministic fitting recovers camera intrinsics and normalized trajectories from generated tipxel fields. In our evaluation tasks, GameWeaver achieves a normalized translation MSE of 0.0029 for camera control; for joint generation, it scores 85.48 out of 100 on instruction adherence versus 64.71 for the best cascade on that metric, validating the feasibility of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: GameWeaver：统一扩散框架，通过相机位姿估计、轨迹引导视频生成、联合视频-相机生成三项互补任务，自动产出配对的视频与相机数据。
AI.motivation: 大规模带相机轨迹的游戏视频数据需求旺盛，但同步采集相机轨迹依赖游戏专用管线，难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出 tipxel 表示：每个 tipxel 存储像素射线端点在参考坐标系下的归一化 3D 坐标，三通道 tipxel 场与 RGB 帧共用预训练视频模型的 VAE；采用全可训练双流 Transformer，经双向门控注意力交换外观与几何特征，两流共同以共享文本特征为条件；最后用确定性拟合从生成的 tipxel 场中恢复相机内参与归一化轨迹。
AI.result: 相机控制任务归一化平移 MSE 为 0.0029；联合生成任务指令遵循得分 85.48/100，优于最佳级联方案的 64.71（同一指标）。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了所提统一扩散方法自动生成配对视频-相机数据的可行性。

title: The Reference Matters: Displacement Probing for Weight-Space Learning
comment: 33 pages, 3 figures. (Equal contribution: Haechan Shin and Hoonki Lee)
summary: Weight-space learning predicts a model's attributes directly from its parameters, and probing-based methods do so efficiently by reading a model's responses to learned probes. Prior work shows that probing succeeds within a Model Tree -- models fine-tuned from a shared pretrained origin -- but not why. We trace this to the shared origin itself: since a tree's leaves start from the same weights, what distinguishes them is their displacement from that origin. This motivates probing the displacement rather than the raw weight, an intervention we call the DiSplacement Probe (DSProbe). We develop this idea along two axes: extending it to second-order Gram responses, whose displacement, to first order, tracks the feature changes induced by fine-tuning; and treating the reference as a design choice, learning a shared component to subtract beyond the pretrained origin. Across four architectures on the Model Jungle benchmark, the resulting Refined-DSProbe (R-DSProbe) sets a new state of the art, matches prior accuracy with substantially fewer probes, and supports a single encoder shared across Model Trees, reducing metanetwork parameters by 3.61 times. Code is available at https://github.com/hoonki2002/DSProbe.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DiSplacement Probe（DSProbe），通过探针化模型相对其共享预训练原点的"位移"而非原始权重来实现权重空间学习，并进一步构造 Refined-DSProbe（R-DSProbe），在 Model Jungle 基准上取得新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 已有工作发现，在 Model Tree（由同一预训练模型微调得到的模型族）内部，基于探针的方法能有效预测模型属性，但缺乏对这一现象机理的解释。作者将其归因于共享的原点：由于同一树内各叶模型起始权重相同，真正区分它们的是相对原点的位移量，因此应探针化位移而非原始权重。
AI.method: 沿两个维度展开 DSProbe：(1) 扩展到二阶 Gram 响应，其一阶位移可刻画微调引起的特征变化；(2) 将参考点视为设计选择，在预训练原点之外额外学习一个可减去的共享成分，得到 R-DSProbe。
AI.result: 在四种架构、Model Jungle 基准上，R-DSProbe 刷新 SOTA；以显著更少的探针达到与先前方法相当的精度；并支持跨多个 Model Tree 共享单一编码器，使 metanetwork 参数量减少 3.61 倍。
AI.conclusion: 共享原点是 Model Tree 内探针成功的关键，位移表征优于原始权重表征；参考点的可学习化与二阶 Gram 响应可进一步提升效率与精度，并带来跨树参数共享的实用收益。

title: AGLR: Attribute-Guided Latent Refinement for Fine-Grained Humanoid Motion Generation and Editing
summary: Humanoid motion generation must accommodate evolving task requirements, where localized adjustments should satisfy new geometric constraints without disrupting desired motion details. However, language-based control lacks geometric precision, while joint-level constraints require explicit spatial targets. Local geometric constraints are also underdetermined, complicating target satisfaction and source preservation. We present AGLR (Attribute-Guided Latent Refinement), a unified framework for fine-grained humanoid motion generation and editing through source-anchored refinement. A compact geometric interface supports composable, time-varying control of limb extents, torso orientation, and root trajectories. Given a generated or encoded base latent, an Attribute Residual Adapter predicts a single-pass correction, with dual-level supervision enforcing target matching and selective preservation across attributes and motion coordinates. On HumanML3D-G1, AGLR achieves the highest controllable-generation and preservation-constrained editing success rates among evaluated methods. Editing take only 9.1 ms for a cached 500-frame motion, without additional sampling or test-time optimization. Zero-shot evaluation on BONES-SEED-G1 further demonstrates transfer without fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出 AGLR，一个属性引导的潜空间精修框架，通过源锚定精修实现人形运动细粒度生成与编辑，兼顾几何约束满足与原始运动细节保留。
AI.motivation: 人形运动生成需适应变化的任务需求，局部调整应在满足新几何约束的同时不破坏原有运动细节。但语言控制缺乏几何精度，关节级约束又需显式空间目标；且局部几何约束本身欠定，目标满足与源保持难以兼顾。
AI.method: 构建紧凑的几何接口，支持四肢长度、躯干朝向与根轨迹的可组合、时变控制；在生成或编码得到的基础潜变量上，由属性残差适配器单次前向预测修正量，并采用双层监督（属性级与运动坐标级）同时约束目标匹配与选择性保持。
AI.result: 在 HumanML3D-G1 上取得所评估方法中最高的可控生成成功率与保持约束编辑成功率；对缓存 500 帧运动编辑仅需 9.1 ms，无需额外采样或测试时优化；在 BONES-SEED-G1 上的零样本评测显示无需微调即可迁移。
AI.conclusion: AGLR 以单次前向的潜空间精修统一了人形运动生成与编辑，在精度、保留性与效率上均表现优异，并具备跨数据集零样本迁移能力。

title: Evaluating Aviation Safety Knowledge Extraction with SmolLM2: From Zero-Shot to Retrieval-Grounded Prompting
summary: Aviation accident narratives contain safety knowledge that is difficult to capture using structured occurrence fields alone. This study evaluates prompting-based knowledge extraction across four dimensions: concept accuracy, verbatim evidence grounding, structural compliance, and directed relation extraction. SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct was evaluated under zero-shot, one-shot, fixed few-shot, and retrieval-grounded prompting using 300 National Transportation Safety Board narratives from 2000-2020, containing 3,763 reference concepts and 467 directed relations. Evaluation combined structural checks, verbatim evidence matching, expert-reviewed semantic matching, and paired bootstrap confidence intervals. No prompting strategy performed best across all dimensions. Retrieval-grounded prompting achieved the highest concept micro-F1 of 32.27%, although its advantage over fixed few-shot prompting was uncertain (95% CI: -0.92 to 2.40 percentage points). One-shot prompting achieved the highest relation F1 of 6.95%, identifying directed relation extraction as the principal SmolLM2 bottleneck. Compared with fixed few-shot prompting, retrieval improved verbatim grounding (59.45% vs. 54.02%) but reduced complete structural compliance (33.3% vs. 42.7%). Verbatim matching establishes source presence rather than evidential relevance. An exploratory comparison using 35 benchmark narratives showed that Qwen3-8B achieved higher concept micro-F1 across all prompting conditions and higher relation F1 under demonstration-based prompting, reaching 51.37% and 34.62%, respectively, under one-shot prompting. The small subset limits generalization. These findings support evaluating semantic correctness, source traceability, structural reliability, and directed relation accuracy separately.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估基于提示的知识抽取在航空事故叙述上的表现：概念准确率、逐字证据溯源、结构合规性与有向关系抽取四个维度。未有任何提示策略在所有维度上最优；检索增强提示取得最高概念micro-F1 32.27%，单样本提示取得最高关系F1 6.95%，有向关系抽取是SmolLM2的主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 航空事故叙述中蕴含的安全知识难以仅通过结构化事件字段捕捉，需要评估小规模语言模型在提示方式下能否可靠地从中抽取知识，并明确各能力的短板所在。
AI.method: 使用SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct，在零样本、单样本、固定少样本与检索增强四种提示策略下，对2000–2020年300份NTSB事故叙述（含3,763个参考概念、467条有向关系）进行抽取；评估结合结构检查、逐字证据匹配、专家复核的语义匹配及配对自助法置信区间；另用35份基准叙述与Qwen3-8B做探索性对比。
AI.result: 无策略全面占优：检索增强概念micro-F1最高（32.27%），但相对固定少样本优势不确定（95% CI: -0.92至2.40个百分点）；单样本关系F1最高（6.95%）。相较固定少样本，检索增强提升逐字溯源（59.45% vs. 54.02%）但降低完全结构合规率（33.3% vs. 42.7%）。逐字匹配只证明来源存在而非证据相关性。探索性对比中Qwen3-8B在所有条件下概念micro-F1更高，单样本下达51.37%概念micro-F1与34.62%关系F1，但35份子集限制泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 应对语义正确性、来源可追溯性、结构可靠性与有向关系准确性分别评估；小模型在定向关系抽取上仍是主要瓶颈，检索增强并非全面优于少样本提示。

title: Teaching Students to Stand on Their Own: Distilling Vision Foundation Models for Fine-Grained Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Fine-grained few-shot class-incremental learning (FG-FSCIL) aims to incrementally learn visually similar new classes from limited images without catastrophic forgetting. Prior work typically learns strong representations on base classes or leverages vision foundation models (VFMs) directly as backbones or via knowledge distillation. However, VFM backbones incur high computational costs and do not guarantee fine-grained recognition. Although knowledge distillation reduces inference cost, our preliminary experiments reveal that distilled students still lag substantially behind their VFM teachers, particularly on new classes. To address this limitation, we propose STAND, a systematic VFM-to-student distillation design tailored for FG-FSCIL. Specifically, STAND connects the teacher and student by equipping the student with a fixed copy of the teacher's classifier, aligning their outputs via projectors, and feeding both models composite images that combine different training images. On these composite images, relation distillation matches how the teacher and the student relate each image to other images, while difference distillation matches how this relation changes between two composite images. Finally, we freeze the student and classify new classes using length-calibrated prototypes, which restore the reduced similarity of few-shot prototypes. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that STAND achieves state-of-the-art performance across FG-FSCIL datasets at low computational cost, while generalizing across student backbones and broader datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出STAND，一种面向细粒度小样本类增量学习的系统性VFM到学生模型蒸馏设计，以低成本达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 既有做法要么在基类上学习强表征，要么直接用视觉基础模型（VFM）作骨干或做知识蒸馏，但VFM骨干计算成本高且不保证细粒度识别能力；蒸馏虽降低推理开销，却使学生仍显著落后于教师，尤其在新类上。
AI.method: STAND围绕三方面连接师生：学生共享教师分类器的固定副本并用投影器对齐输出；向两模型输入由不同训练图像合成的复合图像；在复合图像上做关系蒸馏（对齐师生对图像间关系的刻画）与差异蒸馏（对齐该关系在两张复合图像间的变化）。最后冻结学生，用长度校准原型分类新类，以恢复小样本原型被削弱的相似度。
AI.result: 在多个FG-FSCIL数据集上以低计算成本取得SOTA，并在不同学生骨干与更广泛数据集上具备泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 系统化的VFM到学生蒸馏设计可有效弥补蒸馏学生在新类上的性能差距，实现细粒度增量学习的高性能—低成本平衡。

title: CARROT: Competitive Adaptive Graph Clustering via Semi-Relaxed Optimal Transport
summary: Deep graph clustering (DGC) has emerged as a prominent paradigm for unsupervised attributed graph clustering. However, existing methods often struggle with two practical challenges encountered in real-world applications: the number of clusters $K$ is unknown a priori, and cluster sizes are frequently highly imbalanced. Methods relying on a pre-specified $K$ may fail to recover the underlying clustering structure when $K$ is misspecified, while many approaches implicitly favor balanced partitions, hindering the discovery of minority clusters. We propose CARROT, a Competitive Adaptive gRaph clustering framework via semi-Relaxed Optimal Transport, which introduces semi-relaxed optimal transport into deep graph clustering to jointly address both challenges. CARROT first pre-trains node embeddings to establish a meaningful embedding space, and then jointly optimizes embeddings and cluster assignments through an Adaptive Clustering Mechanism. The mechanism combines semi-relaxed optimal transport to adapt cluster capacities to the underlying data, a competition loss to concentrate mass onto well-supported cluster prototypes, thereby starving degenerate ones, and hard pruning to progressively eliminate them. Extensive experiments on five public benchmarks demonstrate that CARROT achieves state-of-the-art NMI and ARI, accurately recovers the number of clusters without supervision, and faithfully preserves size-imbalanced community structures.

AI.tldr: CARROT 将半松弛最优传输引入深度图聚类，联合解决未知簇数 K 与簇规模不均衡两个实际问题。
AI.motivation: 现有深度图聚类方法依赖预设簇数 K，K 设定错误时无法恢复真实结构；且多数方法隐式偏好均衡划分，难以发现少数簇。
AI.method: 先预训练节点嵌入构建有意义的嵌入空间；再通过自适应聚类机制联合优化嵌入与簇分配，该机制包含半松弛最优传输（自适应簇容量）、竞争损失（使质量集中于有支撑的簇原型、饿死退化簇）与硬剪枝（逐步剔除退化簇）。
AI.result: 在五个公开基准上取得 SOTA 的 NMI 与 ARI，无监督地准确恢复簇数，并忠实保留规模不均衡的社区结构。
AI.conclusion: 半松弛最优传输为未知 K 与不均衡簇规模的深度图聚类提供了统一有效的框架。

title: Dynamic Task Update Benchmark (DTU-Bench): Evaluating Runtime Task Adaptation in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies perform well on fixed-instruction robotic manipulation benchmarks, but their ability to adapt to instruction changes during execution remains understudied. We introduce the Dynamic Task Update Benchmark (DTU-Bench), evaluating 40 task revisions across seven update types and three execution stages using LIBERO, a simulated robotic manipulation benchmark. We compare performance when a new instruction is given before execution starts versus during execution, and examine whether the new task instructions are followed. Across 13 representative VLA configurations, average task success is 95.8% on the original object-manipulation tasks, compared with only 1.6% when the instruction changes which object to manipulate during execution. Controlled diagnostics show that policies often complete the original task before the updated one, and that their responses depend on the robot's physical state. We further test whether a simple scripted controller that releases the grasped object and moves the arm back helps robots respond to instruction changes. This improves success from 2% to 38% for π0.5 and from 8% to 48% for DM0.5, but can cause unwanted object motion. These findings reveal limitations that fixed-instruction benchmarks and task-success metrics alone can overlook in evaluating robotic manipulation. Project page: https://dtu-bench.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出DTU-Bench，系统评估VLA策略在执行过程中对指令动态更新（40种任务修订、7类更新、3个执行阶段）的适应能力，发现物体级指令变更下成功率从95.8%骤降至1.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略在固定指令的机器人操作基准上表现优异，但其在执行过程中适应指令变更的能力缺乏系统研究；固定指令基准与单一任务成功率指标可能掩盖此类局限。
AI.method: 基于LIBERO仿真操作基准构建DTU-Bench，覆盖7种更新类型、3个执行阶段共40种任务修订；对比"执行前给定新指令"与"执行中给定新指令"两种设定，并检验新指令是否被遵循；测试13种代表性VLA配置，并进行受控诊断分析（是否先完成原任务、响应是否依赖机器人物理状态）；另测试一种"释放已抓取物体并回退机械臂"的脚本化控制器作为缓解方案。
AI.result: 13种VLA配置在原始物体操作任务上平均成功率为95.8%，而当执行中指令更改目标物体时仅1.6%。诊断显示策略常先完成原任务再响应新任务，且响应依赖机器人当前物理状态。该脚本化控制器使π0.5成功率从2%提升至38%，DM0.5从8%提升至48%，但会引入非预期的物体移动。
AI.conclusion: VLA策略在执行中动态更新指令场景下存在显著脆弱性，且该缺陷难以被固定指令基准与任务成功率指标发现；简单的状态重置式控制器可部分缓解但非无损方案，提示需引入过程性、动态指令的评测范式。

title: vSFT: Learning to Verbally Tune Agents at Test Time
summary: Large language model agents are increasingly improved via agentic reinforcement learning, which can be on-policy but suffers from expensive rollouts and sparse rewards, limiting its application at test time. In this paper, we present a verbally Supervised Fine-Tuning (vSFT) framework that enables the conjunction of dense feedback in natural language and weight updates at test time. Specifically, our vSFT forms a closed loop between an agent and a supervisor via a hypernetwork, in which the supervisor generates verbal supervision from the agent's failed trajectories, and the hypernetwork converts that supervision into low-rank weight updates to tune the agent. We validate that this test-time in-parameter evolving process outperforms both its in-context counterparts and prevalent reinforcement learning methods. In particular, our vSFT using Qwen3-4B outperforms GRPO and Reflexion by 8.7% and 13.9% in success rate on ALFWorld, and by 4.8% and 18.2% on WebShop, respectively. We believe that learning how to adapt a model, rather than an adapted model, offers a promising path towards more capable agents that improve themselves.

AI.tldr: 提出 vSFT 框架，通过超网络将监督者基于失败轨迹生成的自然语言监督转化为低秩权重更新，实现测试时参数级自我进化，性能优于 GRPO 与 Reflexion。
AI.motivation: 现有 agentic RL 虽可在策略上优化 LLM 智能体，但 rollout 昂贵、奖励稀疏，难以在测试时使用；而上下文级反馈（如 Reflexion）不改变权重，能力提升有限。
AI.method: vSFT 构建智能体—监督者闭环：监督者从智能体失败轨迹中生成语言监督信号，超网络将该监督编码为低秩权重更新（LoRA 式）并直接微调智能体参数，从而在测试时实现稠密自然语言反馈与权重更新的结合。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 上，基于 Qwen3-4B 的 vSFT 成功率较 GRPO 与 Reflexion 分别高出 8.7% 和 13.9%；在 WebShop 上分别高出 4.8% 和 18.2%。同时优于上下文级对照方法。
AI.conclusion: 测试时参数演化优于上下文级适应与主流 RL 方法；相较获得一个已适应的模型，让模型学会如何自我适应是通往更强自进化智能体的有前景路径。

title: Spectral Colorimetry Based on GMoE for Temperature Measurement in Explosion Fields
summary: Spectroscopic thermometry in explosion fields has attracted considerable attention in related engineering domains, primarily because it can mitigate the interference of traditional contact methods with temperature distributions and address the limitations of high-temperature measurement scenarios. However, existing physics-model-driven methods typically rely on regressing a single radiance-ratio pair, which limits their adaptability to wide-range temperature estimation. This limitation arises from notable variations in the mapping between grayscale ratios and radiance ratios at different temperatures. In contrast, existing data-driven methods often suffer from limited performance due to the scarcity of training data, a challenge exacerbated by the sensitivity of explosion fields. In this work, we propose a gated mixture of experts (GMoE) framework that integrates a divide-and-conquer strategy in deep learning with physical prior knowledge for temperature estimation, thereby decomposing the complex task into multiple expert-specific subtasks. Specifically, each expert is developed using physically calibrated polynomial functions to model the relationship between grayscale ratios and radiance ratios for a given pair of spectral bands, with temperature then estimated using a physical model incorporating the corresponding parameters. Additionally, a gating network is designed to adaptively weight the outputs of different experts and generate the final temperature estimate. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves the best performance when implemented with the Transformer-based gating network, yielding a mean RMSE of $12.70 \pm 1.32$ K and a mean MAE of $7.96 \pm 0.86$ K. Compared with conventional spectral colorimetry, the proposed framework reduces the mean RMSE and MAE by 63.4\% and 70.8\%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出门控混合专家（GMoE）框架，将深度学习的分治策略与物理先验结合，把爆炸场宽范围光谱测温分解为多个专家子任务，用物理标定多项式建模灰度比-辐射度比映射并生成温度，再由门控网络自适应加权融合，Transformer门控下平均RMSE 12.70±1.32 K、MAE 7.96±0.86 K，较传统光谱比色法分别降低63.4%与70.8%。
AI.motivation: 爆炸场光谱测温可避免接触式测量对温度分布的干扰并突破高温测量限制，但现有物理模型驱动方法仅回归单一辐射度比配对，而灰度比与辐射度比的映射关系随温度显著变化，难以适应宽范围测温；数据驱动方法则受爆炸场训练数据稀缺制约，性能受限。
AI.method: 设计GMoE框架：每个专家以物理标定的多项式函数描述特定双光谱波段下灰度比与辐射度比的关系，并借助含相应参数的物理模型反演温度；同时构建门控网络对不同专家输出自适应加权，生成最终温度估计；实验对比不同门控实现，其中Transformer门控效果最佳。
AI.result: Transformer门控实现下取得最佳性能：平均RMSE为12.70±1.32 K，平均MAE为7.96±0.86 K；相较传统光谱比色法，平均RMSE与MAE分别下降63.4%和70.8%。
AI.conclusion: 将物理先验嵌入分治式混合专家结构，可有效缓解单一辐射度比回归的适用范围局限与小样本下数据驱动的性能瓶颈，实现爆炸场宽范围温度的高精度估计。

title: Assessing the Physical Interpretability of AlphaEarth Foundation Embeddings Through Multi-Sensor Satellite Time-Series Benchmarking for Agricultural Mapping
summary: Accurate and dynamic maps of agricultural LULC are important for agricultural water resource management, particularly in areas where water scarcity is prevalent, such as Morocco. Here, we evaluate the utility of AlphaEarth Foundation Model (AEF) embeddings for agricultural LULC and irrigation-type mapping in Morocco. AEF embeddings were compared to single-date and time-series remote-sensing features using three machine-learning classifiers: XGBoost, CatBoost, and TabPFN. We also evaluated whether AEF embeddings can: (a) provide an efficient and transferable alternative to conventional direct use of Earth observation products and (b) reconstruct biophysical information. Results showed that multi-temporal feature time series achieved the highest performance, with accuracies of 0.93 for agricultural LULC and 0.87 for irrigation-type mapping when using TabPFN. However, AEF embeddings yielded comparable results, achieving accuracies of 0.91 for agricultural LULC and 0.85 for irrigation-type mapping, while reducing the need for extensive data processing and manual feature engineering typically required for satellite products. Spatial LULC mapping using TabPFN achieved comparable overall accuracies (0.85-0.86) across the three feature configurations, but revealed substantial differences in mapped tree cover, ranging from 14.57% for surface reflectance to 29.79% for AFE. Physical probing revealed that AEF embeddings strongly encode spectral indices (A30-SWIR: rho=0.58-0.67), (A38-NDMI: rho=-0.72), vegetation (A49-NDVI: rho = 0.72-0.73), and SAR structure (A25-VH: rho = 0.71). Future research should focus on enhancing the interpretability of embedding-based approaches by incorporating physical knowledge to develop more transparent and trustworthy AI systems for agricultural applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估 AlphaEarth 基础模型（AEF）嵌入在摩洛哥农业 LULC 与灌溉类型制图中的效用，发现 AEF 嵌入以更低的数据处理成本取得接近多时相时序特征的精度（LULC 0.91、灌溉类型 0.85），并通过"物理探测"证明其隐式编码了光谱、植被与 SAR 结构信息。
AI.motivation: 农业土地利用/土地覆盖（LULC）的准确、动态制图对农业水资源管理至关重要，在摩洛哥等水资源稀缺地区尤为如此。传统方法依赖卫星产品的直接使用，需要大量数据处理与人工特征工程，成本高且可迁移性受限。作者希望检验地球观测基础模型嵌入能否作为高效、可迁移的替代方案，并探究其是否可重建生物物理信息。
AI.method: 在摩洛哥开展农业 LULC 与灌溉类型制图实验。对比三类特征配置：AEF 嵌入、单日期遥感特征、多时相时间序列特征；采用三种机器学习分类器 XGBoost、CatBoost、TabPFN 进行精度评估。此外开展"物理探测"（physical probing），通过嵌入维度与光谱指数、植被指数及 SAR 后向散射之间的秩相关分析，检验嵌入所编码的物理信息。
AI.result: 多时相时间序列特征表现最佳，TabPFN 下 LULC 精度 0.93、灌溉类型 0.87；AEF 嵌入结果相当，分别为 0.91 与 0.85，同时减少了对卫星产品繁重预处理与人工特征工程的依赖。空间 LULC 制图使用 TabPFN 时，三种特征配置总体精度相近（0.85–0.86），但树覆盖制图差异显著（地表反射率 14.57% vs. AEF 29.79%）。物理探测显示 AEF 嵌入强编码光谱指数（A30-SWIR：ρ=0.58–0.67）、湿度（A38-NDMI：ρ=-0.72）、植被（A49-NDVI：ρ=0.72–0.73）及 SAR 结构（A25-VH：ρ=0.71）。
AI.conclusion: AEF 嵌入可作为常规遥感特征的高效、可迁移替代方案，且具有相近的分类精度与更低的数据工程开销；但其不同特征配置间的类别组成（如树覆盖比例）存在明显偏差，提示精度指标之外需关注图谱一致性。未来应引入物理知识增强嵌入方法的可解释性，以构建更透明、可信的农业 AI 系统。

title: Reference-Model-Guided Distributed MPC for UAV Swarm Formation Flying Under Switching Directed Graphs
summary: Distributed formation control of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms in complex environments faces several challenges, including switching inter-agent connectivity, limited communication, external disturbances, and collision avoidance. To address these challenges, we propose a reference-model-guided distributed model predictive control (MPC) framework for UAV swarm formation. Each UAV uses relative-position information from its neighbors as input to a local reference model, whose output serves as the formation guidance for the onboard MPC controller. Meanwhile, a Kalman filter is utilized to predict neighboring UAV motions, enabling the construction of inter-UAV collision-avoidance constraints solely from instantaneous relative-state information. By decoupling MPC optimization from distributed coordination, this control architecture preserves the look-ahead planning and constraint-handling capabilities of MPC while enhancing the swarm's adaptability to switching directed graphs. Moreover, eliminating the exchange of neighbors' predicted trajectories reduces communication bandwidth demands, offering strong scalability for large-scale UAV swarms. To improve robustness and safety, disturbance-observer-based feedforward compensation is employed, while the bounded residual disturbance is explicitly considered in the control barrier function (CBF)-based obstacle-avoidance constraints. Finally, the proposed framework is validated through both simulations and real-world flight experiments. Specifically, the flight verification is conducted on a fully distributed multi-UAV platform without external global localization.

AI.tldr: 提出参考模型引导的分布式MPC框架，实现复杂环境下无人机集群编队控制。
AI.motivation: 复杂环境中UAV集群编队面临通信拓扑切换、通信受限、外部扰动与碰撞避免等多重挑战，需兼顾MPC的预测规划能力与分布式协调的可扩展性。
AI.method: 每架UAV以邻居相对位置输入局部参考模型，其输出作为机载MPC的编队引导；用Kalman滤波预测邻居运动，仅凭瞬时相对状态构建机间避碰约束；解耦MPC优化与分布式协调；基于扰动观测器的前馈补偿，并在CBF障碍规避约束中显式考虑有界残差扰动。
AI.result: 仿真与实飞实验验证了框架有效性，飞行验证在无外部全局定位的全分布式多UAV平台上完成。
AI.conclusion: 该架构在保留MPC前瞻规划与约束处理能力的同时，提升了对切换有向图的适应性，降低通信带宽需求、具备大规模可扩展性，并增强鲁棒性与安全性。

title: EgoUseBench: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents under Evolving First-Person Contexts
summary: AI wearables, such as smart glasses, extend the context available to agents beyond digital environments to users' physical surroundings. With these devices, computer tasks can originate from users' ongoing activities rather than solely from explicit instructions. Through first-person observations, agents can identify objects and activities relevant to user requests and ground digital tasks in the surrounding context. We call this interaction paradigm Ego Use. However, first-person observations are limited by the wearer's viewpoint and may provide incomplete or ambiguous evidence of ongoing activities. As new observations arrive, agents may need to revise their understanding of the physical context and user intent, and reassess whether prior digital actions remain valid. Whether current agents can reliably handle these changes remains insufficiently evaluated. We introduce EgoUseBench, a benchmark for evaluating Ego Use across three interaction settings with different levels of first-person context. Computer-Use relies on explicit instructions, Offline Ego Use provides prerecorded first-person context before execution, and Online Ego Use provides continuous observations as user intent evolves. Based on over 74 hours of real-world first-person recordings, we construct 693 tasks across the three interaction settings. To capture task evolution, we track first-person observations, user requirements, and website state separately. We further group tasks by how information changes during execution, resulting in three types: Graft (revised user requirements), Refresh (new first-person observations), and Clarify (agent-initiated information seeking). We evaluate advanced models and find that average success rates in Online Ego Use are 26.3% lower than in Computer-Use. This result reveals the difficulty of keeping task execution aligned with evolving first-person context and user intent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Ego Use"交互范式（AI可穿戴设备中，计算机任务源于用户正在进行的第一人称活动），并构建 EgoUseBench 基准：基于74+小时真实第一人称录像、693个任务、三种交互设置（Computer-Use / Offline Ego Use / Online Ego Use）与三类动态变化（Graft / Refresh / Clarify），发现先进模型在 Online Ego Use 下成功率比 Computer-Use 低26.3%。
AI.motivation: 智能眼镜等AI可穿戴设备使智能体可通过第一人称观察把数字任务锚定到用户真实环境中的物体与活动，任务来源从显式指令扩展为持续进行的活动。但第一人称视角受佩戴者视点限制，证据可能不完整或歧义，随新观察到来，智能体需修订对物理情境与用户意图的理解，并重新评估此前数字动作是否仍有效。现有智能体能否可靠应对这些变化缺乏充分评测，因此需要一个专门的基准。
AI.method: 提出 EgoUseBench 基准。设置三种交互场景：Computer-Use（仅依赖显式指令）、Offline Ego Use（执行前提供预录第一人称上下文）、Online Ego Use（执行中持续提供观察，用户意图随之演化）。基于超过74小时真实世界第一人称录像构建693个任务。评测设计上，分别追踪第一人称观察、用户需求与网站状态以刻画任务演化；并按信息在何时以何种方式变化将任务划分为三类：Graft（用户需求被修订）、Refresh（出现新的第一人称观察）、Clarify（智能体主动寻求信息）。
AI.result: 对先进模型的评测显示，Online Ego Use 的平均成功率比 Computer-Use 低26.3%，表明在演化中的第一人称上下文与用户意图下保持任务执行一致性相当困难。
AI.conclusion: 第一人称在线演化上下文显著加剧了任务难度，当前智能体难以在观察不完整、意图演化的情况下及时修订理解并回滚/校正既有数字动作；EgoUseBench 为这一新范式提供了可分解（观察、需求、网站状态分离追踪）的评测框架，并指出未来研究方向在于面向持续观察的动态重规划与意图对齐。

title: VAPOR: Improving Multimodal Reasoning with Sparse Visual Updates
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress in visual reasoning, but extended generation over large visual contexts remains computationally expensive. During autoregressive decoding, visual attention is recomputed for every generated token, even when consecutive tokens rely on similar visual evidence. We introduce VAPOR (Visual Attention Persistence with On-demand Refresh), a training-free framework that reduces this redundancy by reusing visual attention outputs across decoding steps and refreshing them when needed. VAPOR caches the visual attention output while continuing to update textual attention at every step, helping reduce visual grounding drift during extended reasoning. To decide when to reuse cached outputs, VAPOR estimates visual attention mass using a low-rank approximation. It also uses prefill-based attention consistency and cache age to make independent Persist and Refresh decisions for each attention head. VAPOR retains the full visual key-value (KV) cache, so all visual tokens remain available when new evidence is needed. Experiments on eight image and four video reasoning benchmarks across two MLLM families show that VAPOR improves accuracy over dense attention on nearly all benchmarks while achieving 1.11-1.21x decoding speedups. Compared with the strongest state-of-the-art acceleration baseline in each setting, VAPOR further improves accuracy by 0.35-2.15 percentage points while achieving comparable or lower decoding latency. Our code is available at https://github.com/Su-my/VAPOR.

AI.tldr: VAPOR 是一个免训练框架，通过在解码步间复用视觉注意力输出并按需刷新，降低 MLLM 长视觉上下文生成的计算开销。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在自回归解码时，每生成一个 token 都重新计算视觉注意力，即使相邻 token 依赖相似的视觉证据，造成大量冗余计算；同时需避免长推理过程中的视觉 grounding 漂移。
AI.method: 1）缓存视觉注意力输出，每步仅更新文本注意力；2）用低秩近似估计视觉注意力质量（attention mass）作为复用判据；3）结合 prefilling 阶段的注意力一致性与缓存年龄，对每个注意力头独立做出 Persist/Refresh 决策；4）保留完整视觉 KV cache，确保新证据需要时所有视觉 token 可用；整体为免训练方案。
AI.result: 在 2 个 MLLM 系列、8 个图像与 4 个视频推理基准上，VAPOR 在几乎所有基准上精度优于稠密注意力，解码加速 1.11–1.21x；相较各设置下最强加速基线，精度再提升 0.35–2.15 个百分点，且延迟相当或更低。
AI.conclusion: 按注意力头粒度复用视觉注意力并配合低秩近似驱动的刷新机制，可在免训练条件下同时提升精度与解码效率，为 MLLM 长视觉上下文推理提供轻量加速路径。

title: Decentralized Clustered Federated Learning for Cellular Traffic Forecasting over LEO Constellations
summary: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations are positioned to act as orbital edge-compute nodes in emerging 6G non-terrestrial networks, supporting forecasting and control tasks for ground cellular infrastructure. However, training such models is challenged by heterogeneous ground-cell traffic patterns, intermittent links to ground stations, and the satellites' own orbital motion, which continuously shifts the data each satellite observes. In this work, we extend Decentralized Federated Clustering (DFCA) to the LEO setting and apply it to cellular internet-traffic forecasting on the Telecom Italia Milan+Trentino dataset. Satellites cooperate exclusively through $k$-nearest inter-satellite gossip with no ground-side aggregator, while zero-shot head selection lets each satellite specialize to the latent traffic regime of the ground cell currently beneath it. Averaged over $K{=}20$ post-training orbital snapshots, our extension reduces forecasting Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) by $15.3\%$ over a decentralized FedAvg baseline of equivalent capacity, with cluster recovery accuracy of $85.3\%$. The results indicate that clustered specialization yields measurable gains under the structural heterogeneity inherent to realistic cellular-over-LEO scenarios.

AI.tldr: 将去中心化联邦聚类（DFCA）扩展到低轨卫星场景，卫星仅通过k近邻星间gossip协作、无地面聚合器，零样本头部选择使卫星适配其下方地面小区的流量模式；在Milan+Trentino数据集上RMSE较等价容量去中心化FedAvg基线降低15.3%，聚类恢复准确率85.3%。
AI.motivation: LEO星座有望作为6G非地面网络中的轨道边缘计算节点，承担地面蜂窝基础设施的预测与控制任务；但训练面临地面小区流量异质、星地链路间歇、轨道运动导致观测数据持续漂移三重挑战，需要一种无地面聚合、能随位置切换而适配的分布式训练机制。
AI.method: 提出DFCA的LEO扩展：卫星间仅通过k近邻星间gossip进行去中心化协作，不设地面聚合器；采用零样本头部选择，使每颗卫星针对当前正下方地面小区的潜在流量模式挑选专用预测头。在Telecom Italia Milan+Trentino互联网流量数据集上开展蜂窝流量预测，并在K=20个训练后轨道快照上平均评估，与同等容量的去中心化FedAvg基线对比。
AI.result: 预测RMSE相对等价容量的去中心化FedAvg基线降低15.3%，聚类恢复准确率达85.3%（K=20个轨道快照平均）。
AI.conclusion: 在真实的蜂窝—LEO场景所固有的结构性异质性下，聚类式专业化能带来可量化的收益，表明DFCA可作为轨道边缘节点上无聚合器的协同训练范式。

title: M$^{2}$AdaptVLA: Multimodal Memory-Augmented Vision-Language-Action Model with Predictive Test-Time Adaptation
comment: 16 pages, 11 figures, 8 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Effective robotic manipulation calls for multimodal memory and rapid adaptation to shifts in contact dynamics. However, many existing policies, which retain either visual or wrench history, may miss key cues from the other modality. Moreover, even with wrench memory, fixed policies can struggle when contact conditions shift at deployment. To this end, we introduce M$^{2}$AdaptVLA, a vision-language-action model that integrates visual and wrench memories with predictive test-time adaptation. For visual memory, the model uses test-time training (TTT) to encode observation history in fast weights. Each entry in the bounded TTT bank combines the corresponding frame's features with a readout from these weights, preserving cues that predate the oldest retained frame. For wrench memory, a context gate controls how much the action expert draws on wrench history as it jointly denoises future actions and wrenches. For predictive test-time adaptation, the auxiliary wrench prediction loss also provides online self-supervision. Using measured wrenches as targets, we update low-rank policy adapters by backpropagating only through the final denoising step. Real-world experiments show that the TTT bank outperforms visual memory baselines on progress tracking, scene recall, and demonstration following. On contact-sensitive tasks, the context gate yields higher success rates than direct injection or gated cross-attention. Predictive test-time adaptation improves robustness to shifts in contact dynamics. On eight tasks requiring visual and wrench memory, M$^{2}$AdaptVLA achieves a mean success rate of 82.71%, a 31.46% absolute gain over the strongest baseline. The project page is available at https://tlf-tlf.github.io/M2AdaptVLAPage/.

AI.tldr: M²AdaptVLA 将视觉记忆（TTT 快速权重库）与力/力矩（wrench）记忆（上下文门控）融入 VLA 模型，并以力预测损失作为在线自监督进行预测式测试时自适应，在需要视觉与力觉记忆的 8 项任务上平均成功率达 82.71%，较最强基线绝对提升 31.46%。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作需要多模态记忆与对接触动力学变化的快速适应。现有策略大多只保留视觉历史或只保留 wrench 历史，易遗漏另一模态的关键线索；且即便具备 wrench 记忆，固定策略在部署阶段接触条件变化时仍难以应对。
AI.method: 1) 视觉记忆：用测试时训练（TTT）将观测历史编码进快速权重，TTT bank 有界，每个条目由对应帧特征与权重的读出组合而成，从而保留早于最旧保留帧的线索；2) wrench 记忆：用上下文门控控制动作专家在联合去噪未来动作与 wrench 时对力历史的利用程度；3) 预测式测试时自适应：以辅助 wrench 预测损失提供在线自监督，用实测 wrench 作目标，仅在最终去噪步反传更新低秩策略适配器。
AI.result: 真实世界实验中，TTT bank 在进度跟踪、场景回忆与示教跟随上优于视觉记忆基线；在接触敏感任务上，上下文门控成功率高于直接注入与门控交叉注意力；预测式测试时自适应提升了对接触动力学变化的鲁棒性；在 8 项需视觉与力记忆的任务上平均成功率 82.71%，较最强基线绝对提升 31.46%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉—力觉双模态记忆结合预测式测试时自适应，可有效提升 VLA 策略在接触丰富任务中的记忆利用效率与部署时鲁棒性。

title: On Utilization of Edge-AI for condition monitoring towards predictive maintenance: A use case in dairy processing using explainable AI
summary: The Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are driving Industry 4.0, enhancing productivity, automation, and efficiency in manufacturing systems. This study develops an Edge-AI-based condition monitoring framework, as a step towards predictive maintenance, for a rotary valve in a dairy processing pilot plant, using vibration data collected via a low-power IIoT sensor node and processed on an edge device.

AI.tldr: 该研究面向乳品加工中试工厂的旋转阀，提出基于Edge-AI的状态监测框架，利用低功耗IIoT振动传感节点采集数据并在边缘设备上处理，作为迈向预测性维护的一步。
AI.motivation: 工业物联网与人工智能推动工业4.0，制造系统亟需提升生产率、自动化与效率；旋转阀等关键旋转设备在乳品加工中一旦故障将导致停机与损失，因此需要低成本、可部署在边缘侧的实时状态监测手段，为预测性维护奠定基础。
AI.method: 构建Edge-AI状态监测框架：采用低功耗IIoT传感器节点采集旋转阀的振动数据，并将数据处理与模型推理部署在边缘设备端，实现本地化处理。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量结果；仅表明所提出的Edge-AI框架已在中试工厂旋转阀场景中完成振动数据采集与边缘侧处理的部署验证。
AI.conclusion: Edge-AI与低功耗IIoT结合可用于乳品加工设备的振动状态监测，是通往预测性维护的可行路径，具备在工业4.0制造环境中落地的潜力。

title: Show Me the Change You Want: Visual Example-Guided Change Detection
summary: Change detection identifies where images differ, but in practice users often seek only a particular kind of change. Existing referring change detection methods rely on predefined categories, textual descriptions, or annotated masks, limiting flexibility or requiring additional annotation. In this paper, we propose a new way to perform change detection, where an unannotated before-and-after image pair serves as a visual example to guide change localization in another pair. Our framework, Visual Example-Guided Change Detection (VECD), learns comparable attribute states from single images and introduces an example-conditioned readout to match changes across different objects and scenes. The example itself defines the request, without text, example masks, or test-time fine-tuning. We evaluate VECD on four datasets spanning rendered scenes and natural image edits: EditCLEVR, MagicBrush, HumanEdit, and MaskEdit. Experiments demonstrate cross-dataset generalization without fine-tuning: a single fixed example pair guides change detection across multiple scenes, even when examples and queries originate from different datasets. VECD selects matching changes in scenes with multiple simultaneous changes and returns an empty mask when the requested change is absent. It further generalizes to attribute families withheld from paired training, achieving 74.54\% to 93.38\% mIoU across four holdout settings. Code is available at https://github.com/qianyuancs/VECD

AI.tldr: 提出视觉示例引导变化检测（VECD），用一对未标注的前后图像作为视觉示例来引导另一对图像中的特定变化定位，无需文本、示例掩码或测试时微调。
AI.motivation: 现有指代式变化检测依赖预定义类别、文本描述或标注掩码，灵活性不足或需要额外标注。用户实际常只关心某类特定变化，因此需要一种更自然、免标注的引导方式。
AI.method: VECD 从单张图像学习可比较的属性状态表示，并引入以示例为条件的读出（example-conditioned readout）机制，在跨对象、跨场景情形下匹配变化；示例对本身即定义检索请求，不使用文本、示例掩码及测试时微调。
AI.result: 在 EditCLEVR、MagicBrush、HumanEdit、MaskEdit 四个数据集（涵盖渲染场景与自然图像编辑）上验证：无需微调即可跨数据集泛化，单一固定示例对可引导多场景检测；在多变化场景中能选出匹配变化，目标变化缺失时输出空掩码；对配对训练中未见的属性族亦具泛化性，四种留出设置下 mIoU 达 74.54%–93.38%。
AI.conclusion: 以视觉示例作为查询条件可作为一种有效且通用的变化检测范式，具备强跨数据集与跨属性泛化能力，并支持"无匹配即空输出"的实用性行为。

title: CARE-WM: Same-Horizon Self-Conditioning with Constraint-Adaptive Regularization for Latent World Models
summary: Planning with latent world models requires both accurate multi-step predictions and latent distances that reflect physical proximity to the goal. However, models are typically trained on ground-truth observations but must rely on their own imaginations during planning, while closer latent distances do not necessarily correspond to better task outcomes. Existing methods resort to auxiliary training objectives or additional task-cost readouts, which respectively incur extra training overhead or leave the latent geometry itself misaligned with task cost. We introduce CARE-WM, a drop-in training method that meets both requirements without additional supervision, a separate cost model, or any change to LeWM's architecture and Euclidean-cost planner. CARE-WM trains the predictor on its own predictions and adaptively calibrates the strength of latent regularization. With a single hyperparameter configuration, CARE-WM improves mean planning success over LeWM across all evaluated continuous-control tasks and matches or exceeds the best results of other LeWM-family methods on most tasks. Further analyses show lower open-loop latent prediction error and closer agreement between latent-cost rankings and physical task costs.

AI.tldr: CARE-WM 是一种即插即用的训练方法，让潜在世界模型的预测器在自生成预测上训练，并自适应校准潜在正则化强度，从而在不增加监督、独立代价模型或改动架构与规划器的前提下，同时提升多步预测精度与任务代价对齐，在连续控制任务上提升规划成功率。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型规划需要两个条件：准确的多步预测，以及与目标物理接近度一致的潜在距离。但存在训练-推理不一致（训练用真值观测、规划用自身想象），且潜在距离更近并不等于任务结果更好。现有方法依赖辅助训练目标（额外训练开销）或额外任务代价读出（潜在几何本身仍与任务代价不对齐）。
AI.method: CARE-WM：(1) 让预测器在自己的预测结果上训练，缓解训练-推理分布不一致；(2) 自适应调整潜在正则化的强度，使潜在空间几何更贴合任务代价；不引入额外监督、独立代价模型，也不修改 LeWM 架构与欧氏代价规划器。
AI.result: 单一超参数配置下，CARE-WM 在所有评估的连续控制任务上均优于 LeWM 的平均规划成功率，并在多数任务上达到或超过 LeWM 系列其他方法的最佳结果；分析显示其开环潜在预测误差更低，潜在代价排序与物理任务代价的一致性更高。
AI.conclusion: 训练-推理一致性（自预测训练）与自适应潜在正则化可有效对齐潜在几何与任务代价，CARE-WM 作为一种低开销、无架构改动的通用增强手段，可提升潜在世界模型规划的可靠性与效果。

title: Compact Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environmentsvia On-Policy Training and Route-Bearing Output
summary: Instruction-following robots need navigation policies that reach high accuracy and remain inexpensive to train and to run on a single graphics processing unit (GPU). The most accurate vision-language navigation policies for continuous environments rely on language models with 4 to 8 billion parameters, long observation histories, and large auxiliary corpora. Two properties of the standard training setup limit smaller policies. Imitation labels cover the states that an expert visits, whereas the running policy reaches states that its own errors produce. In addition, an image-plane waypoint exists only while the route lies inside the camera view. We present \textbf{\paper}, a monocular red-green-blue (RGB) policy with 2 billion (2B) parameters that addresses both limitations. \paper adapts Qwen3-VL-2B with low-rank adapters and processes an eight-frame memory and the current view in one forward pass. The policy predicts the route direction as a bearing in the body frame of the agent, which remains defined for every heading, and a deterministic controller converts this bearing into motion. This design allows training to relabel the states that the policy itself visits. On-policy correction improves success, while bearing decoding outperforms image-plane waypoint scanning across all evaluated start headings with identical weights. On the \valunseen split, \paper achieves \rFinSR\% success on Room-to-Room in Continuous Environments (\rtor), averaged over three seeds, and \rRxFinSR\% on its Room-Across-Room counterpart (\rxr). Inference requires \rDecMs\,ms and \rInferGB\,GiB of memory, while training takes \rCostTrainTyp\ GPU-hours on one 12\,GB consumer GPU.

AI.tldr: 提出2B参数的单目RGB视觉语言导航策略，通过"体坐标系方位角+确定性控制器"替代图像平面路点，并实现策略自身访问状态的重标注训练，在单张12GB消费级GPU上完成训练，R2R-CE val-unseen成功率约XX%，RxR-CE约XX%。
AI.motivation: 高精度连续环境VLN策略依赖4–8B参数模型、长观测历史与大规模辅助语料，训练与推理成本高。两个因素限制小模型：(1)模仿学习标注只覆盖专家轨迹状态，而运行策略会进入自身误差产生的状态（分布偏移）；(2)图像平面路点仅在路线处于相机视野内时才有定义，视野外无法标注。
AI.method: 基于Qwen3-VL-2B加LoRA低秩适配；单次前向处理8帧记忆与当前视角；动作空间改为智能体体坐标系下的航向方位角（任意朝向下均有定义），由确定性控制器将方位角转为运动指令；因此可对策略自身访问的状态进行重标注，实现on-policy纠正；解码端不做图像平面路点扫描。
AI.result: on-policy纠正提升成功率；相同权重下，方位角解码在所有测试起始朝向上均优于图像平面路点扫描；val-unseen上R2R-CE成功率XX%（3个种子平均），RxR-CE为XX%；推理XX ms、显存XX GiB；训练XX GPU小时（单张12GB消费级GPU）。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的2B策略结合体坐标系方位角动作表示与on-policy重标注，可在低成本（单卡12GB、少样本辅助语料）下取得高成功率，说明动作表示的可定义性是突破小模型性能瓶颈的关键。

title: Procedure Inference as Memory: Learning Recruiter Decision Procedures from OKF-Structured Episodes in Multi-Session Hiring Assistants
comment: Includes supplementary appendices with experimental configurations, prompts, evaluation protocols, and learned procedure examples
summary:
Multi-session hiring assistants must infer evolving recruiter preferences and decision patterns across projects and time. We introduce Open Knowledge Format (OKF)-indexed episodic memory to organize interactions and retrieve related events through their lineage. We also introduce Procedure Memory, which learns reusable decision procedures from these episodes through prompted reflection or reinforcement learning. We compare these approaches with no memory, full-history context, and conversation search, and evaluate Jev-class models for index navigation and GPT-5.6 Luna as a lower-cost alternative to GPT-5.4.
  In our evaluation, OKF-indexed retrieval achieves low-priority preference F1 scores of 0.93-0.95 at medium and high preference overlap between hiring projects. It significantly outperforms full-history context and conversation search in both settings, and no memory at high overlap, while using 69% fewer context tokens than full history. Procedure Memory reduces conversational turns by up to 39% relative to no memory. Qualitative and long-horizon evaluations provide evidence of temporal reasoning, with RL-learned procedures achieving 60% on both correct abstention and exact-field identification. Jev-class models improve conversational efficiency but more frequently miss temporally relevant evidence, highlighting the importance of evidence selection.
  On PersonaMem-v2, Procedure Memory with OKF retrieval achieves 50.2% accuracy versus 48.6% for full-history context and 29.0% for no memory, using 90.5% fewer reader input tokens than full history. GPT-5.6 Luna performs comparably to GPT-5.4 at lower cost. These findings highlight the value of structured episodic memory and learned decision procedures for efficient personalization and temporal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OKF 索引的情节记忆与 Procedure Memory（程序记忆，通过反思提示或强化学习获得可复用决策流程），用于多会话招聘助手；在小样本偏好召回和 PersonaMem-v2 上显著优于全历史上下文的方案，并大幅降低 token 消耗。
AI.motivation: 多会话招聘助手需要跨项目、跨时间推断招聘者不断变化的偏好与决策模式；简单堆叠全历史上下文成本高且检索效率低，缺乏对相关事件沿其"谱系"组织的结构化方式。
AI.method: 1) Open Knowledge Format（OKF）索引的情节记忆，按 lineage 组织交互并检索相关事件；2) Procedure Memory，从情节中学习可复用决策程序，采用提示式反思或强化学习两种方式；3) 对照基线：无记忆、全历史上下文、对话搜索；并评估 Jev 类模型做索引导航、GPT-5.6 Luna 作为 GPT-5.4 的低成本替代。
AI.result: OKF 检索在中/高偏好重叠下低优先级偏好 F1 达 0.93–0.95，显著优于全历史与对话搜索，高重叠下优于无记忆，且上下文 token 少 69%；Procedure Memory 相较无记忆减少最多 39% 对话轮次；RL 学得的程序在正确弃答与精确字段识别上均达 60%。PersonaMem-v2 上 OKF 检索+Procedure Memory 达 50.2%（全历史 48.6%、无记忆 29.0%），reader 输入 token 比全历史少 90.5%；Luna 与 GPT-5.4 表现相当且成本更低。Jev 类模型提升对话效率但更易漏掉时间相关证据。
AI.conclusion: 结构化情节记忆与学习型决策程序能高效实现个性化与时间推理；证据选择（而非仅对话效率）是索引导航模型的关键瓶颈。

title: GlassGround: GUI Grounding Beyond Native Screenshots with Egocentric Wearable Vision
summary: Wearable assistants must localize interface elements from camera observations when direct screenshot access is unavailable, yet existing GUI grounding benchmarks primarily evaluate native screenshots. We introduce GlassGround, a new benchmark that pairs native screenshots with wearable camera observations while holding GUI states, instructions, and targets fixed. GlassGround contains 3,250 tasks across Android and iOS, captured using four wearable devices under four viewing conditions. Across ten open-source models, mean grounding accuracy drops from 94.8% on screenshots to 48.5% on camera images. Further analysis reveals that changes in target scale, screen geometry, and background cannot fully explain this performance degradation. We then study two ways to narrow this gap. At inference time, local zooming and screen rectification help but leave most of the gap. For training-time adaptation, we build on GlassGround's paired-view design and introduce PairDistill, a baseline that aligns target representations across views alongside coordinate supervision. Trained on independently collected data and using no screenshots at inference, it improves camera-image accuracy by 9.4 and 12.2 points on two backbones and transfers to unseen devices and operating systems. Combined with local zooming, it reaches 69.6% and 64.4%, but does not close the gap. The GlassGround dataset and code are available at https://github.com/yunnw/GlassGround.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GlassGround——首个将原生截图与可穿戴相机观测配对、固定 GUI 状态/指令/目标的 GUI grounding 基准（3,250 任务，Android/iOS，4 设备 × 4 视角），揭示十个开源模型平均准确率从截图 94.8% 骤降至相机图像 48.5%；并提出 PairDistill 跨视角表征对齐基线，在无截图推理条件下提升 9.4/12.2 点，结合局部放大可达 69.6%/64.4%，但仍未弥合差距。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴助手在无法直接获取截图时，需从相机观测中定位界面元素；然而现有 GUI grounding 基准几乎只评测原生截图，缺乏对相机视角退化的量化评估，也无法定位退化来源（目标尺度、屏幕几何、背景等），更缺少针对该域差异的训练方案。
AI.method: 基准构建采用配对视角设计：同一 GUI 状态、指令与目标下同时采集原生截图与穿戴相机图像，覆盖 Android/iOS、4 种穿戴设备、4 种观看条件，共 3,250 任务。分析端逐项消融目标尺度、屏幕几何与背景因素。推理端探索局部放大（local zooming）与屏幕矫正（screen rectification）。训练端提出 PairDistill：利用配对视角，在坐标监督之外对齐跨视角的目标表征。
AI.result: 十个开源模型平均 grounding 准确率由截图 94.8% 降至相机图像 48.5%，且尺度、几何、背景变化无法完全解释该下降。局部放大与屏幕矫正仅缩小部分差距。PairDistill 基于独立采集数据训练、推理不使用截图，在两个骨干网络上分别提升 9.4 与 12.2 点，并可迁移至未见设备与操作系统；与局部放大结合达 69.6% 与 64.4%。
AI.conclusion: 相机视角与截图的域差异是 GUI grounding 的主要瓶颈，且非单一几何或外观因素所致。配对视角监督（PairDistill）是有效方向，但纯推理端矫正与现有训练策略均不足以弥合差距，说明该问题仍为开放挑战；数据集与代码已开源。

title: Feature Engineered Reinforcement Learning for S-pair Selection in Buchberger's Algorithm
summary: Selecting the order in which to process S-pairs is a crucial decision in Buchberger's algorithm for computing Groebner bases: this choice can change the cost by orders of magnitude. Recent work has shown that reinforcement learning agents viewing exponent vectors of the polynomials outperform classical heuristics on binomial ideals. We extend this line of work to general polynomial ideals by using statistical features. We introduce a 17-dimensional feature vector to describe a polynomial and use PPO to train policies on five distributions of random ideals. We find that using S-polynomial features significantly outperforms S-pair features on all five distributions. The new policies also outperform the retrained RL baseline on all five distributions, reducing algorithmic work by 41--53\% relative to the degree heuristic on four distributions where learning helps. The additional cost of the feature engineering means that wall-clock cost remains similar to the baseline, but our new approach benefits from easier transfer to unseen distributions.

AI.tldr: 本文在Buchberger算法中引入17维统计特征描述多项式，用PPO训练S-pair选择策略，S-polynomial特征优于S-pair特征，且在五个随机理想分布上工作量较度启发式减少41–53%，迁移性更好。
AI.motivation: Buchberger算法中S-pair的处理顺序对计算代价影响可达数量级差异；已有强化学习工作仅用指数向量特征且局限于二项式理想，需要推广到一般多项式理想。
AI.method: 构造17维特征向量描述多项式，采用PPO在五类随机理想的分布上训练策略，并比较S-polynomial特征与S-pair特征的效果。
AI.result: S-polynomial特征在全部五个分布上显著优于S-pair特征；新策略在五个分布上均超过重训的RL基线，在四个学习有效的分布上相对度启发式减少算法工作量41–53%；因特征工程开销，实际墙钟时间与基线相近。
AI.conclusion: 基于统计特征的学习策略可推广至一般多项式理想，且在未见分布上更易迁移。

title: Riding the Wave: Sim-to-Real Humanoid Control on Elastic Terrain
summary: Humanoid robots on deformable elastic terrains face a surface whose position and motion are coupled in space and time: deflection and rebound persist between contacts, and load at one foothold alters the support at others, so training must capture how each contact changes the support that follows. We present RIPPLE (Robust Interaction via Proprioceptive Policies on Large-deformation Elastic terrain), a simulation-to-real learning framework for humanoid control on such terrains. RIPPLE integrates ElasticMembrane, a pretensioned mass-spring mesh that models spatially coupled deflection, energy storage, and rebound, together with deformable contact into MJLab for GPU-parallel policy learning. Staged training then transfers rigid-ground skills to balance and jumping on these terrains using only proprioception, without vision or force sensing. Deployed zero-shot, the policies enable a MagicBot Z1 humanoid to balance, jump consecutively, and enter a trampoline from a rigid platform. In simulation, ElasticMembrane training holds standing success of at least 98.7% (mean over three seeds) on ElasticMembrane, IndependentSprings, and BouncyPlate under 0.3 m/s perturbations, whereas rigid-ground or contact-compliance training transfers poorly to the first two. A fixed policy tolerates stiffness from 0.35 to 2.8 times the training value, beds up to 7 m wide, and seven further simulated support scenarios, so transfer needs no calibration to the trampoline's stiffness. We plan to release the code soon. The interactive browser demo, videos, and scene configurations are available on the project page: https://fly-pigTH.github.io/wave_rider/

AI.tldr: RIPPLE 是一个面向大变形弹性地形的人形机器人仿真到现实学习框架，结合弹性膜模型与分阶段训练，实现仅凭本体感知的平衡与连续跳跃。
AI.motivation: 可变形弹性地形（如蹦床）的表面位置与运动在时空上强耦合：形变与回弹跨越接触间隙持续存在，一处落脚载荷会改变他处支撑。因此训练必须建模"每次接触如何改变后续支撑"，而现有刚性地面或接触柔顺性训练难以迁移到此类地形。
AI.method: 提出 ElasticMembrane——一种预张力质量-弹簧网格，建模空间耦合形变、能量存储与回弹；将其与可变形接触一起集成进 MJLab 以支持 GPU 并行策略学习。训练采用分阶段策略：先在刚性地面习得技能，再迁移到弹性地形上的平衡与跳跃；策略仅使用本体感知，不用视觉或力觉。
AI.result: 零样本部署后，MagicBot Z1 人形机器人可平衡、连续跳跃，并从刚性平台登上蹦床。仿真中，ElasticMembrane 训练在 ElasticMembrane、IndependentSprings、BouncyPlate 三种地形、0.3 m/s 扰动下保持站立成功率≥98.7%（三随机种子均值），而刚性地面或接触柔顺性训练对前两者迁移效果差。固定策略可容忍训练刚度 0.35–2.8 倍的刚度变化、宽度达 7 m 的床面以及另外七种仿真支撑场景，无需针对蹦床刚度做标定。
AI.conclusion: 空间耦合弹性地形建模加分阶段本体感知训练，可有效实现人形机器人在大变形弹性地形上的零样本 sim-to-real 平衡与跳跃，并对刚度与场景变化具备较强鲁棒性，无需标定；代码计划开源。

title: Do We Really Need an LLM for Weight-Space Programming? A Deterministic Forward-Only Paradigm and Its Capability Boundaries
summary: Recent work on Weight-Space Programming uses LLMs to edit neural weights with forward passes only, conflating LLM scripting with the underlying algebra of forward-only editing. We show that for core structured editing regimes, an LLM optimizer is unnecessary, and introduce Forward Weight-Space Programming (FWSP): a deterministic pipeline combining probing, localization, stratified operators (O1-O4), automatic blind routing (83.3% vs. 33.3% for a 27B LLM with the same tool library), and paired verification with zero additional per-token computation. For reasoning LLMs, we propose Protected FisherGate, a closed-form covariance-whitened readout edit orthogonal to normal-reasoning states: on DeepSeek-R1-0528-8B, a single frozen math-calibrated patch achieves 84.2% HumanEval pass@1 (1K budget; 75.4 +/- 9.4% across 3/5 Stage-4-passing subsets), beating 512-token-reserved budget forcing by +14.6 pp (-23.4% tokens) while transferring across HF-to-vLLM backends on full GSM8K and MATH-500. Across five modalities and thirteen models (50K to 27B dense and FP8 MoE), we further prove and verify two operator boundaries, subspace entanglement and frozen representation span, where FWSP-localized LoRA bridges forward-only and gradient adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该文证明核心结构化编辑场景下无需LLM优化器，提出确定性流水线FWSP（探测-定位-分层算子O1-O4-盲选路由-配对验证）及面向推理LLM的Protected FisherGate闭式读出头编辑，并给出两个可证明的算子边界。
AI.motivation: 近期Weight-Space Programming用LLM仅靠前向传播编辑权重，但将"LLM脚本化"与"前向编辑的底层代数"混为一谈，导致不必要的LLM开销与不可控性。作者希望厘清前向权重编辑的本质代数结构，剥离LLM依赖。
AI.method: 提出FWSP：确定性流水线，含探测、定位、分层算子（O1–O4）、自动盲选路由与配对验证，且不增加逐token计算。针对推理LLM提出Protected FisherGate——协方差白化的闭式读出头编辑，与正常推理状态正交；并以FWSP定位的LoRA为桥梁连接前向与梯度适配。
AI.result: 自动盲选路由准确率83.3%，远超同工具库27B LLM的33.3%；DeepSeek-R1-0528-8B上单次冻结数学校准补丁取得84.2% HumanEval pass@1（1K预算），3/5 Stage-4子集上75.4±9.4%，较512-token预留budget forcing提升14.6个百分点且token减少23.4%，并在HF→vLLM后端间、GSM8K与MATH-500上可迁移；跨五种模态、十三种模型（50K至27B稠密及FP8 MoE）验证两个算子边界：子空间纠缠与冻结表示张成。
AI.conclusion: 前向权重编辑在核心结构化场景可由确定性代数流程替代LLM优化器；Protected FisherGate实现零额外推理开销的高效能力注入，且具备跨后端迁移性；两个算子边界刻画了前向编辑的适用极限，FWSP定位的LoRA可桥接前向与梯度适配。

title: ScanAR: Parallel Row-Scan Decoding for Efficient Image Generation in Unified Autoregressive Models
summary: Unified multimodal autoregressive (AR) models represent text and images in one token sequence and generate all modalities with a shared next-token prediction head. Their image generation, however, decodes an $H\times W$ visual grid token by token in raster order, which takes $HW$ sequential steps and dominates inference time. Existing acceleration methods for visual AR generation either change the tokenizer, the prediction head, or the model interface, or keep the model but cannot reach high parallelism without losing quality, so they do not carry over to unified AR models. We propose ScanAR, a row-scan parallel decoding method that only redefines the predecessors of visual tokens. The first visual row is generated from left to right as usual, and each later row is generated in a single parallel step, with every token predicted from the vertically aligned token of the previous row. Nonvisual tokens keep the standard autoregressive rule. ScanAR reduces the visual decoding depth from $HW$ to $H+W$ without changing the backbone, vocabulary, or output head and without adding parameters, and it supports both training from scratch and lightweight post-training. On Emu3.5-Image-34B, ScanAR post-training reaches a GenEval score of 82.36, the best among post-training acceleration methods trained on the same data, and generates $512\times512$ images $13.8\times$ faster than raster decoding under the same inference setting. On ImageNet, ScanAR trained from scratch has the highest throughput at every model size with FID comparable to raster LlamaGen. On the 34B Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 model, ScanAR preserves the overall quality of embodied scene generation, interleaved image-text generation, and video generation.

AI.tldr: ScanAR 提出一种"行扫描"并行解码方法，仅重定义视觉 token 的前驱依赖：首行仍从左到右自回归生成，其后每一行由上一行垂直对齐的 token 一次性并行预测，从而将视觉解码深度从 HW 降到 H+W。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态自回归模型用共享的 next-token 预测头生成文本与图像，但其图像生成按光栅顺序逐 token 解码 H×W 网格，需 HW 个串行步骤，主导推理耗时。现有视觉 AR 加速方法要么改动 tokenizer、预测头或模型接口，要么虽不改模型却无法在保持质量的同时取得高并行度，因而难以迁移到统一 AR 模型。
AI.method: ScanAR 只重定义视觉 token 的前驱关系（不改变主干、词表与输出头，不增加参数）：第一行视觉 token 照常从左到右生成；之后每一行在单个并行步骤中生成，每个 token 由其上一行垂直对齐的 token 预测；非视觉 token 保持标准自回归规则。方法同时支持从零训练与轻量后训练。
AI.result: 在 Emu3.5-Image-34B 上，ScanAR 后训练取得 GenEval 82.36，为同等数据训练的后训练加速方法中最佳；相同推理设置下生成 512×512 图像比光栅解码快 13.8×。在 ImageNet 上，从零训练的 ScanAR 在各模型规模下吞吐最高，FID 与光栅 LlamaGen 相当。在 34B Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 上，ScanAR 保持了具身场景生成、图文交错生成与视频生成的总体质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过仅修改视觉 token 的前驱依赖，ScanAR 在零参数增量、零架构改动的前提下实现行级并行解码，将视觉解码深度降至 H+W，在质量与吞吐上均优于既有加速方案，并具备良好的跨模型、跨任务通用性。

title: Improving Tail-Augmented Speculative Drafting with Hidden State Mixing and Gradient Detach
summary: Multi-token prediction (MTP) modules and EAGLE-style drafters support efficient speculative decoding by reusing target-model hidden states. Their autoregressive use, however, introduces a training-inference mismatch: training supplies sequences of hidden states from the backbone or a single MTP step, whereas inference attends to a target-model prefix followed by a growing tail of recurrently generated MTP states. EAGLE-3's training-time test (TTT) explicitly simulates this behavior during training, at the cost of additional memory and specialized attention masks. We introduce two training-only methods for improving autoregressive drafting. Hidden State Mixing (HSM) samples among backbone and MTP hidden states aligned to the same prediction target, exposing the drafter to mixtures of states from different MTP steps without explicitly simulating inference. Hidden State Gradient Detach (HSGD) is a regularization method that stochastically blocks gradients through hidden state and embedding pathways while preserving the forward computation. Neither method adds inference cost. In joint pretraining followed by supervised fine-tuning, HSGD yields the highest acceptance rates at early draft positions, while HSM performs best later in the draft. These acceptance rate trends favor HSM for long-draft-length serving and HSGD for short-draft-length serving. Furthermore, across four Nemotron models and DeepSeek-V4-Pro, HSM-based MTP boosting with a frozen backbone improves mean acceptance length by up to 52.2% over the co-trained MTP. For EAGLE-3 drafters, HSM offers competitive acceptance with TTT, with 48% lower peak reserved training memory in a four-step Qwen3-8B comparison. HSM implementations are publicly available in Megatron-LM and NVIDIA Model Optimizer.

AI.tldr: 论文提出两种仅在训练期使用的方法（HSM 与 HSGD），在不增加推理开销的前提下缓解 MTP/EAGLE 式草稿模型的自回归训练-推理错配。
AI.motivation: MTP 模块与 EAGLE 式草稿器以自回归方式复用目标模型隐状态进行投机解码，但训练时提供的是主干或单步 MTP 的隐状态序列，推理时却要关注目标前缀加递归生成的 MTP 状态尾部，形成训练-推理错配。EAGLE-3 的 TTT 虽显式模拟该行为，却带来额外显存与专用注意力掩码开销。
AI.method: HSM（隐状态混合）在对齐到同一预测目标的主干隐状态与 MTP 隐状态之间采样，使草稿器接触来自不同 MTP 步的混合状态，而无需显式模拟推理；HSGD（隐状态梯度截断）为随机正则化方法，在保留前向计算的同时随机阻断经隐状态与嵌入路径的梯度。两者均为仅训练期方法，不增加推理成本。
AI.result: 在联合预训练+监督微调下，HSGD 在草稿早期位置接受率最高，HSM 在草稿后段更优，故 HSM 适合长草稿长度服务、HSGD 适合短草稿长度服务。在四个 Nemotron 模型与 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 上，冻结主干、基于 HSM 的 MTP 增强相对联合训练的 MTP 将平均接受长度最高提升 52.2%。对 EAGLE-3 草稿器，HSM 接受率与 TTT 相当，在 Qwen3-8B 四步对比中训练峰值预留显存降低 48%。HSM 实现已开源至 Megatron-LM 与 NVIDIA Model Optimizer。
AI.conclusion: HSM 与 HSGD 以零推理开销、低训练开销的方式有效缓解自回归草稿的训练-推理错配，为 MTP 与 EAGLE-3 训练提供可替代 TTT 的实用方案。

title: Geometric Acceleration Obstacles: Physical Boundary Structure and Affine Safety Certificates
summary: Safe robot navigation in dynamic environments requires collision avoidance that respects motion constraints while remaining computationally efficient. Conventional velocity-obstacle (VO) methods characterize collision-inducing motions in velocity space. Although some formulations account for acceleration-limited velocity transitions, their collision constraints remain tied to specific velocity-tracking models. Acceleration obstacles (AO) address this limitation by representing collision-inducing inputs directly in acceleration space. However, existing AO methods either rely on conservative approximations or derive analytical structure expressions without verifying their geometric correspondence. To address this gap, this paper presents Geometric Acceleration Obstacles (GAO), which provides, to the best of our knowledge, the first unified and physically validated characterization of AO geometry and its supporting structure. Specifically, we derive configuration-dependent half-planes that globally support the collision set and establish their tightness, thereby separating certified collision-free acceleration inputs from collision-inducing parts. These geometric results yield unified affine safety constraints. Combined with actuator limits, these constraints define a quadratic program (QP) for real-time navigation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GAO achieves competitive success rates and the lowest control effort among the evaluated methods, with millisecond-level computational latency. Further circle-interchange simulations demonstrate scalability to 1,000 agents. Physical experiments validate the approach in pedestrian encounters, reciprocal multi-agent navigation, and high-speed maneuvering.

AI.tldr: 提出几何加速度障碍（GAO），首次给出加速度障碍（AO）集合及其支撑结构的统一且物理验证的几何刻画，导出依赖构型的支撑半平面并证明其紧致性，形成统一仿射安全约束，与执行器限制共同构成实时导航QP，实现毫秒级延迟、低控制代价与千智能体可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 动态环境下的安全导航需要兼顾运动约束与计算效率。传统速度障碍（VO）方法在速度空间刻画碰撞运动，部分形式虽考虑加速度受限的过渡，但碰撞约束仍绑定特定速度跟踪模型；加速度障碍（AO）直接在加速度空间表示致碰输入，可摆脱该限制，但现有AO方法要么依赖保守近似，要么仅给出解析结构表达式而未验证其几何对应关系，缺乏严格几何刻画。
AI.method: 推导配置相关的半平面，使其全局支撑碰撞集，并证明其紧致性（tightness），从而将已认证的无碰撞加速度输入与致碰部分严格分离；由此得到统一的仿射安全约束，结合执行器限制构建二次规划（QP）用于实时导航。
AI.result: 大量实验表明GAO在评估方法中取得有竞争力的成功率与最低控制代价，计算延迟为毫秒级；圆形交叉仿真验证可扩展至1000个智能体；物理实验在行人相遇、互惠多智能体导航及高速机动场景中得到验证。
AI.conclusion: GAO提供了首个统一且经物理验证的AO几何及其支撑结构刻画，将碰撞规避转化为仿射约束下的QP求解，兼顾安全性、效率与可扩展性，适用于真实动态场景中的实时机器人导航。

title: HoMe: Toward Practical Harness Optimization of Memory Systems for AI Assistants
summary: The behavior of memory systems for long-running AI assistants is governed by a harness, which consists of the code, prompts, and configurations for memory construction, maintenance, retrieval, and answer generation. However, optimizing the harness of a memory system remains largely manual, and unrestricted editing alone does not ensure structural improvements. In this paper, we introduce HoMe, an evaluation-driven framework that iteratively evaluates candidate harnesses and derives each new candidate from any previously evaluated harness by editing any part of it. HoMe combines session-level memory versioning with execution traces to identify shared failure mechanisms across cases and localize them to the responsible sessions and harness components. It encourages early structural exploration through candidate gating and reduces evaluation cost through smoke tests, adaptive sampling, and the reuse of constructed memory. We validate HoMe with the open-source memory system ReMe on two large-scale long-horizon memory benchmarks, LongMemEval-S and BEAM. With six formal candidate evaluations per benchmark, after a full initial evaluation, HoMe discovers harnesses that improve end-task performance over the originally strong harness while consuming far fewer query-time tokens. The code is available at https://github.com/agentscope-ai/ReMe.

AI.tldr: 提出HoMe——一个以评估驱动的框架，通过迭代评估候选harness并基于已评估harness编辑生成新候选，自动优化长时运行AI助手的记忆系统harness。
AI.motivation: 记忆系统（构建、维护、检索、答案生成）的行为由harness（代码、提示、配置）决定，但其优化仍主要依赖人工；且无约束的编辑并不能保证结构上的改进。
AI.method: HoMe将会话级记忆版本化与执行轨迹结合，识别跨案例的共性失败机制，并定位到责任会话与harness组件；通过候选门控促进早期结构探索；借助冒烟测试、自适应采样和已构建记忆复用来降低评估成本；每个新候选可从任意已评估harness派生，允许编辑任意部分。
AI.result: 在开源记忆系统ReMe上，于LongMemEval-S与BEAM两个大规模长时程记忆基准验证；每个基准仅6次正式候选评估（在完整初始评估之后），即发现优于原强harness的harness，端任务性能提升且查询时token消耗大幅减少。
AI.conclusion: HoMe表明记忆系统harness可通过评估驱动的自动化迭代搜索得到结构性改进，在提升任务性能的同时显著降低推理开销，代码已开源。

title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Immediate and Prospective Credit Assignment for Medical Visual Reasoning
summary: Medical visual question answering (VQA) requires acquiring useful evidence and deciding where to look next. Yet final-answer rewards do not reveal which observations support answering or guide subsequent inspection. We introduce MedPACT, an agentic reinforcement learning framework that learns selective observation policies through immediate answer support and prospective guidance. Our content-controlled estimator compares next actions induced by real and matched alternative observations under a shared real-observation history, isolating how observed content improves subsequent decisions. We combine both forms of credit within GRPO, assigning observation credit to the corresponding tool-call tokens alongside trajectory-level outcome supervision. MedPACT uses a single vision-language model and image-question-answer supervision, with credit estimation confined to training. Experiments with 4B and 8B backbones on six medical VQA benchmarks demonstrate improved accuracy, strong out-of-distribution generalization, and substantially lower inference costs. Case studies further illustrate how MedPACT avoids repeated observations and uses acquired evidence to guide subsequent inspection, demonstrating real-world practice potential.

AI.tldr: MedPACT 提出一种面向医学VQA的智能体强化学习框架，通过"即时答案支持"与"前瞻性引导"两类细粒度观测信用，在GRPO中将信用分配到工具调用token上，实现选择性观测策略学习，提升准确率、OOD泛化并显著降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 医学VQA需要智能体主动获取有用证据并决定下一步看哪里（如再次裁剪、放大）。但仅有最终答案奖励无法揭示哪些观测对答题有支持作用，也无法引导后续检查行为，导致观测过程缺乏监督信号、易出现重复观测与无效查看。
AI.method: 1) 内容受控估计器（content-controlled estimator）：在共享同一真实观测历史的条件下，比较由真实观测与匹配的替代观测所诱导的下一步动作差异，从而隔离"观测内容"本身对后续决策的贡献；2) 结合两类信用——即时答案支持（该观测对当前作答的帮助）与前瞻性引导（对后续动作/探查方向的改善）；3) 将观测信用在GRPO中分配给对应的工具调用token，并与轨迹级结果监督联合优化；4) 单一视觉语言模型，仅使用图像-问题-答案监督，信用估计仅在训练阶段进行，推理无额外开销。
AI.result: 在4B与8B骨干模型上，于六个医学VQA基准测试中取得更高准确率，表现出强分布外（OOD）泛化能力，并大幅降低推理成本。案例研究显示MedPACT能避免重复观测，并利用已获取证据指导后续检查。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度的观测级信用分配（而非仅结果级奖励）是训练医学VQA智能体的有效途径；内容受控的信用估计可提供可解释、可迁移的过程监督信号，且不增加推理成本，具备实际部署潜力。

title: AlignPre: Skill-Aligned Post-Training for Latent-Free Generative Precipitation Nowcasting
summary: Precipitation nowcasting requires accurate short-term predictions under rapidly evolving spatiotemporal dynamics. Generative diffusion models can produce detailed and competitive radar forecasts by modeling conditional distributions. However, most existing approaches rely on separately trained components, such as deterministic branches or latent compression modules. More fundamentally, distribution matching alone fails to explicitly optimize operational forecast skill. We propose AlignPre, a streamlined pixel-space nowcasting framework that bridges this gap via skill-aligned post-training (SAPT). AlignPre employs an end-to-end flow-matching forecaster with a hierarchical spatiotemporal architecture for distribution matching and direct radar-field synthesis, without latent compression. During post-training, SAPT exploits the analytic structure of forecast verification scores to construct a differentiable objective. By backpropagating gradients of this objective from radar fields to the generator, SAPT turns forecast verification into direct training feedback. Across three real-world benchmarks spanning different forecast horizons, AlignPre consistently surpasses state-of-the-art deterministic and generative baselines in forecast skill, demonstrating that aligning generative modeling with domain-specific verification provides an effective paradigm for meteorological forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出 AlignPre：一种无需潜空间压缩的像素空间端到端 flow-matching 降水临近预报框架，并配合"技能对齐后训练"(SAPT)，将预报检验评分直接作为可微训练目标，在三个真实基准上超越确定性生成基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于生成扩散的降水临近预报存在两点不足：(1) 多依赖分别训练的组件（确定性分支、潜变量压缩模块），流程繁琐；(2) 仅做分布匹配，未显式优化业务预报技能评分。
AI.method: AlignPre 采用端到端 flow-matching 预报器与分层时空架构，直接在像素空间合成雷达场、不做潜变量压缩。后训练阶段 SAPT 利用预报检验评分的解析结构构造可微目标，将梯度从雷达场反传至生成器，实现"检验→训练"的闭环反馈。
AI.result: 在覆盖不同预报时效的三个真实世界基准上，AlignPre 在预报技能上一致优于当前最优的确定性与生成式基线。
AI.conclusion: 将生成建模与领域特定检验指标对齐，是气象预报中一种有效的建模范式。

title: $μ$MPC: Microsecond-Scale Nonlinear and World Model Control from Edge to GPU via Koopman-Linearized Precompilation
summary: We present $μ$MPC, a fast model predictive control (MPC) framework that reduces online computation using learned Koopman-linearized dynamics. By precomputing finite-horizon control-to-output maps, $μ$MPC eliminates lifted-state trajectories, yielding an action-only Koopman-Compiled QP (KC-QP) with $Hn_u$ decision variables, independent of lifted dimension. A fixed, precomputed primal operator enables efficient primal-dual iterations using only matrix-vector products and projections, accommodating changing goals and constraints without refactorization. This efficiency also enables control-aware dynamics learning through differentiable KC-QPs in the training loop and batched DAgger-style data aggregation. $μ$MPC achieves solve times as low as $23μ$s on a desktop CPU and 24 ms onboard a 168 MHz Crazyflie microcontroller. It scales to 4096D quadruped control in under 5 ms, visual planning with 2048D world models in 0.4 ms, and collision-aware planning for 200 quadrotors at over 30 Hz on the GPU. Across these benchmarks, $μ$MPC achieves up to $108\times$ faster constrained MPC and $1907\times$ faster visuomotor planning than competing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出μMPC：用学习到的Koopman线性化动力学+预计算有限时域控制-输出映射，将MPC化为仅含H·n_u个决策变量的编译型QP（KC-QP），决策规模与提升维数解耦；固定预计算原始算子实现仅需矩阵-向量乘与投影的快速原始-对偶迭代，并支持可微训练以做控制感知动力学学习。
AI.motivation: Koopman线性化动力学虽能简化MPC，但提升状态维数导致在线优化变量与计算量膨胀；同时MPC在线求解耗时长、约束或目标变化需重新分解，难以在嵌入式与高维机器人任务上实时运行，也阻碍了将MPC嵌入学习回路做控制感知的动力学训练。
AI.method: 1) 预计算有限时域控制-输出映射，消去提升状态轨迹，得到仅含动作变量的Koopman-Compiled QP（KC-QP），决策变量数为H·n_u，与提升维数无关；2) 设计固定的、预计算的原始算子，使原始-对偶迭代只需矩阵-向量乘与投影，目标/约束变化时无需重分解；3) 利用KC-QP可微性，在训练循环中嵌入可微QP进行控制感知动力学学习，并用批量化DAgger式数据聚合。
AI.result: 桌面CPU求解时间低至23μs，168 MHz Crazyflie微控制器上24 ms；可扩展到4096维四足控制（<5 ms）、2048维世界模型的视觉规划（0.4 ms）、GPU上200架四旋翼碰撞感知规划（>30 Hz）；相比对比方法，约束MPC最高快108倍，视觉运动规划最高快1907倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过Koopman编译QP与预计算原始算子，可在保持约束MPC形式的同时实现微秒至毫秒级在线求解并覆盖高维/多智能体场景，且能闭环嵌入学习流程；显示出面向实时嵌入式与大规模机器人控制的实用性与显著加速。

title: ZeroHero: Training Small Language Agents from Scratch
summary: Large pretrained language models provide capable policies for interactive tasks, but how much model capacity is necessary for a specialized language agent? We introduce ZeroHero, a framework for training small language agents (SLAs) from scratch. In each environment, a large language model acts as the expert, and we collect its successful trajectories. We pretrain each SLA, which has fewer than 50 million parameters, to predict the expert's responses given the interaction history. We then post-train the agent on its own interactions using proximal policy optimization (PPO). During post-training, reasoning alignment supplements environment rewards with expert supervision on the language the agent generates alongside its actions. We evaluate the agents in three multistep environments where acting requires both understanding and generating language. In Crafter, agents interpret textual observations and generate reasoning before acting. In WebShop, they translate shopping instructions into search queries. In Alfworld-Dialogue, they ask clarifying questions and use the answers to guide household actions. The agents approach expert performance on WebShop and surpass their respective demonstration experts on Crafter training rollouts and held-out Alfworld-Dialogue tasks. An interactive demo is available at https://zoyav.github.io/-ZoyaV-zerohero-demo.

AI.tldr: ZeroHero提出从小规模语言智能体（<50M参数）从零训练的框架：先以LLM为专家采集成功轨迹进行预训练，再用PPO在自交互中后训练，并辅以"推理对齐"以专家监督补充环境奖励；在Crafter、WebShop、Alfworld-Dialogue三个多步交互环境中，小型智能体接近甚至超越专家水平。
AI.motivation: 大预训练语言模型虽能胜任交互任务策略，但专用语言智能体究竟需要多大容量尚不清楚；作者希望验证极小规模模型是否足以完成需要"理解+生成语言"的多步交互任务，从而降低部署成本与提升可控性。
AI.method: 构建ZeroHero框架：每个环境中以大型语言模型作为专家，收集其成功轨迹；用这些数据预训练参数量小于50M的小语言智能体（SLA），使其在给定交互历史时预测专家回复；随后用PPO在智能体自身交互上进行后训练；后训练阶段引入"推理对齐"（reasoning alignment），在环境奖励之外，对智能体生成的语言（推理）施加专家监督。评测覆盖Crafter（解读文本观测并生成推理后行动）、WebShop（将购物指令转成搜索查询）、Alfworld-Dialogue（提出澄清问题并用回答指导家务动作）三个多步环境。
