AI.result: 在WebShop上接近专家性能；在Crafter训练rollout与留出的Alfworld-Dialogue任务上超过各自的示范专家；整体表明不足50M参数的小智能体在需要语言理解与生成的交互任务中具备竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 专用语言智能体不必依赖超大模型容量：通过"LLM专家轨迹预训练 + PPO自交互后训练 + 推理对齐"即可让小规模模型获得强交互能力，并在部分任务上超越示范专家，为轻量级、可部署的语言智能体提供了可行路径。

title: DuoWM:Integrating Dual 6-DoF Visual Flows into Action-Conditioned Drone World Model
summary: Action-conditioned video world models generate future observations from an initial frame and a camera trajectory, but often fail to align camera commands with visual dynamics or represent full 6-DoF scene transformations. We present DuoWM, a first-person drone video world model with two complementary visual conditions. Action flow projects future camera positions and orientations into each target frame, while Object flow forward-warps the initial observation and overlays local 6-DoF transformations to ground the induced scene motion. We further introduce transform-aware pretraining, which pairs object appearance with explicit transformation axes before standard RGB video training. On Sekai-drone dataset, DuoWM achieves the best results across video quality, 3D consistency, and trajectory following. Compared with Captain Safari, the state-of-the-art method, our approach reduces real-domain FVD and LPIPS by 17.2\% and 21.6\%, respectively, while improving game-domain AUC@30 from 0.5003 to 0.5719 and AUC@15 from 0.3088 to 0.3747.

AI.tldr: DuoWM：双流视觉条件的无人机第一人称视频世界模型，通过Action flow与Object flow对齐相机轨迹与场景动态，并引入变换感知预训练，在Sekai-drone上取得最优视频质量、3D一致性与轨迹跟随性能。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件视频世界模型难以将相机指令与视觉动态对齐，且缺乏完整6-DoF场景变换表征，导致生成结果与给定轨迹不一致、三维一致性差。
AI.method: 提出DuoWM，包含两种互补视觉条件：Action flow将未来相机位置与朝向投影到每个目标帧；Object flow对初始观测做前向变形并叠加局部6-DoF变换以锚定场景运动。另引入变换感知预训练，在标准RGB视频训练前将物体外观与显式变换轴配对。
AI.result: 在Sekai-drone数据集上，视频质量、3D一致性与轨迹跟随均最优。相比SOTA方法Captain Safari，真实域FVD降低17.2%、LPIPS降低21.6%；游戏域AUC@30由0.5003提升至0.5719，AUC@15由0.3088提升至0.3747。
AI.conclusion: 双流条件与变换感知预训练可有效提升动作条件视频世界模型的相机可控性与几何一致性，且跨真实域与游戏域均具优势。

title: Do Machine Learning Ensembles Beat Published Quotas? Target Parameterization, Censored Baselines, and Conformal Intervals Under Admissions Reform
summary: Public admission capacity caps published prior to matriculation are widely used by ministries and institutional analysts as default intake projections in centralized postsecondary clearinghouses. Using an audited 2022 to 2026 Vietnamese undergraduate panel (26,895 program-year records across 309 universities) linked to strictly lagged t-1 occupational vacancy signals, this paper evaluates machine learning, multilevel, and censored econometric estimators against published quotas across 5,385 continuing 2024 programs (five-fold university-grouped cross-validation) and 3,348 matched (2,179 grain-consistent) 2025 programs strictly out of time. Because 62.8% of 2024 programs enroll their exact published quota, unanchored log-growth ensembles degrade accuracy, while the worst 5% generate half of total quota error via unfilled "phantom capacity." Controlled target ablations, including a single-factor test under widened non-binding clipping, show that parameterizing the log fill ratio ln(D_it / S_it) instead of log growth reduces 2024 MAE by 21.5% (14.86 to 11.67), aligns ML with Tobit, Cragg, REML HLM, and capped L1 baselines, and lifts combined tuition and institutional-tier TreeSHAP attribution from 2.5% to 45.8%. Hurdle stacking attains the lowest full-census 2024 MAE (H-Hard 11.29; H-Soft 11.32 vs. 12.35, p = 0.022, clearing 10% not 5% FDR; fold-overlap p = 0.134), whereas continuous QA-Stack outperforms H-Soft on mixed-reporting campuses, Tobit (median) ties H-Soft across both 90% MCS sets, and interior-only Cragg-ML lowers RMSE to 28.1. Under Vietnam's 2025 unified-clearing reform, exact filling falls to 10.4%, H-Soft and capped L1 tie quotas (p = 0.979), and 90% cluster-weighted conformal coverage drops from 89.3% to 74.6%. Across 257 reporting campuses, reconciled 2026 national totals (627,114 to 629,256) lie squarely within 604,533 to 662,044.

AI.tldr: 本文以越南2022–2026年本科招生面板数据检验：将目标变量参数化为对数填充率ln(D_it/S_it)而非对数增长率，可显著提升入学人数（配额）预测精度，并使ML与Tobit、Cragg、REML HLM等方法对齐；分层堆叠模型取得最低MAE，但在2025统一招生改革后预测稳定性与符合性覆盖明显下降。
AI.motivation: 各部委与院校分析者普遍将入学前公布的招生容量上限（配额）直接当作默认入学人数预测值，但该做法隐含"配额即实际录取数"的强假设，缺乏系统验证。作者希望检验在集中化招生清算（clearinghouse）情境下，何种估计量与目标参数化方式能更准确地预测实际入学规模，并考察招生政策改革（2025年越南统一清算改革）对预测性能与不确定性量化的冲击。
AI.method: 构建经审计的2022–2026年越南本科面板（26,895条专业-年记录、309所高校），并联结严格滞后一期（t-1）的职业岗位空缺信号。评估机器学习、多层模型与截断/删失计量估计量；采用按高校分组的五折交叉验证，在2024年5,385个延续专业上评估，并在2025年3,348个匹配专业（其中2,179个口径一致）上做严格样本外检验。设置受控目标消融实验（含加宽非约束截断的单因子检验），比较ln(D_it/S_it)与对数增长率两种参数化；使用TreeSHAP归因分析；构建Hurdle堆叠（H-Hard、H-Soft）与连续型QA-Stack；以Tobit、Cragg、REML HLM、capped L1为基线；采用90%蒙特卡洛模拟置信集、聚类加权保形预测评估覆盖率。
AI.result: 62.8%的2024专业恰好录取其公布配额，导致未锚定的对数增长集成模型精度下降，最差5%的专业贡献了总配额误差的一半（源于未填满的"幽灵容量"）。改用对数填充率目标后，2024年MAE下降21.5%（14.86→11.67），ML与Tobit、Cragg、REML HLM及capped L1基线对齐，学费与院校层级TreeSHAP总归因从2.5%升至45.8%。全样本2024年MAE最低者为Hurdle堆叠（H-Hard 11.29；H-Soft 11.32，对比12.35，p=0.022，仅通过10%而非5% FDR；折间重叠p=0.134）；连续QA-Stack在混合上报校园优于H-Soft；Tobit（中位数）在两套90% MCS上与H-Soft持平；interior-only Cragg-ML将RMSE降至28.1。2025年改革后精确填满率降至10.4%，H-Soft与capped L1持平（p=0.979），90%聚类加权保形覆盖率由89.3%降至74.6%。2026年257个上报校园的校准全国总量（627,114–629,256）位于604,533–662,044区间内。
AI.conclusion: 目标参数化的选择（对数填充率而非增长率）比估计量族的选择更为关键，是实现ML与删失计量模型性能对齐的核心机制，并显著提升可解释性归因。Hurdle堆叠在改革前的全样本中精度最佳，但优势统计上脆弱（FDR仅10%）；统一清算改革后配额几乎不再被精确填满，模型间差异消失，且保形预测覆盖率显著低于名义水平，提示政策变迁下需重新校准不确定性量化与预测基准，不可默认将公布配额当作入学预测。

title: Nav4Manip: From Navigation to Dexterous Mobile Manipulation through Co-Evolution
summary: Dexterous mobile manipulation is essential for robots to perform useful tasks in complex, unstructured environments. However, existing systems face two challenges. First, navigation remains too coarse for downstream manipulation, which often requires a precise base position and approach orientation rather than merely reaching a meter-scale goal region. Second, navigation and manipulation are commonly trained in isolation, lacking a feedback loop that enables the two capabilities to co-evolve. These limitations prevent current systems from reliably executing long-horizon dexterous mobile-manipulation tasks in real-world environments. To address them, we introduce Nav4Manip, a bidirectionally coupled co-evolution system for long-horizon dexterous mobile manipulation. It comprises two complementary architectures: Nav4Manip-N learns long-horizon navigation and refines its policy through manipulation feedback, while Nav4Manip-M trains a world-action model (WAM) for downstream dexterous manipulation. We train Nav4Manip-N in three stages: multi-task co-tuning learns navigation behavior and manipulation-aware affordance prediction; rejection sampling fine-tuning (RFT) rejects low-quality policy-generated paths and fine-tunes the model on retained trajectories; and reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) uses counterfactual preferences to further improve navigation decisions. To support this framework, we establish the Nav-N-Manip benchmark and construct Nav4Manip-Pairs from benchmark rollouts, providing large-scale paired navigation--manipulation trajectories and affordance supervision. Extensive experiments on public vision-language navigation (VLN) benchmarks and Nav-N-Manip demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, while real-world evaluations show that Nav4Manip completes diverse dexterous mobile-manipulation tasks. Project website: https://nav4manip.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出 Nav4Manip，一个导航与操作双向耦合、协同进化的长时序灵巧移动操作框架，含导航策略 Nav4Manip-N 与操作世界-动作模型 Nav4Manip-M，并构建 Nav-N-Manip 基准与 Nav4Manip-Pairs 配对数据，在 VLN 基准与真实任务上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有系统存在两个问题：(1) 导航粒度太粗，仅以实现米级目标区域为终点，缺乏下游操作所需的精确基座位置与接近朝向；(2) 导航与操作通常被孤立训练，缺少使二者协同进化的反馈闭环。二者共同导致难以在真实环境中可靠完成长时序灵巧移动操作任务。
AI.method: 1) Nav4Manip-N：三阶段训练——多任务协同微调（同时学习导航行为与操作感知的可供性预测）、拒绝采样微调 RFT（剔除低质量策略生成路径并在保留轨迹上微调）、基于 AI 反馈的强化学习 RLAIF（利用反事实偏好改进导航决策）；2) Nav4Manip-M：训练面向下游灵巧操作的世界-动作模型 WAM；3) 二者构成双向耦合的协同进化闭环，导航策略由操作反馈精化；4) 数据支撑：构建 Nav-N-Manip 基准，并从基准 rollout 构造 Nav4Manip-Pairs，提供大规模导航-操作配对轨迹与可供性监督。
AI.result: 在公开视觉语言导航（VLN）基准与 Nav-N-Manip 上达到 SOTA 性能；真实世界实验表明 Nav4Manip 能完成多样化的灵巧移动操作任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过将导航细化到操作所需的精度、并以操作反馈驱动导航策略共同进化，Nav4Manip 有效缓解了粗粒度导航与割裂训练两大瓶颈，为真实环境中的长时序灵巧移动操作提供了可行方案；配套的基准与配对数据亦为该方向提供评测与训练基础。

title: REE: A Scientific Research Entrance Exam for AI Agents
summary: Autonomous research agents are emerging as a promising approach to scientific problem-solving across disciplines, owing to their growing ability to improve a solution through repeated experiments. Evaluating this ability requires benchmarks that pose open-ended research problems and measure improvements over established scientific methods. We introduce REE (Research Entrance Exam), a benchmark that tests AI agents on scientific research. It consists of 100 open-ended research problems spanning five broad scientific areas and 23 domains. To ensure high quality, every problem is drawn from active research in its field and individually reviewed by domain experts. Each problem is posed as a task of iterative improvement: an agent has up to 12 hours to improve a working starter solution, and REE scores the result on a common scale against an established expert solution evaluated under comparable conditions. By this measure, two of the four frontier agents we evaluate, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol, outperform the expert solutions on 86% and 81% of problems, across all five scientific areas. Their runs also show how they do so: both agents surpass the expert solutions within the first two hours on average, and their best solutions mostly tailor or combine established methods of the field. REE thus provides a unified framework for evaluating autonomous scientific research, capturing both improvements over established methods and the research processes behind them.

AI.tldr: 提出 REE（Research Entrance Exam）基准，用 100 个跨 5 大科学领域、23 个子领域的开放式科研问题，以迭代改进和与专家方案在同一尺度对比的方式评测自主科研智能体。
AI.motivation: 自主科研智能体通过反复实验持续改进解的能力日益增强，但缺少能提出开放式科研问题、并以既定科学方法为参照衡量改进幅度的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 REE 基准：每个问题源自领域内活跃研究并由专家逐一审核；任务设定为在最多 12 小时内改进一个可运行的初始解；结果在统一尺度上与在可比条件下评测的专家解对比打分。
AI.result: 评测四个前沿智能体，其中 Claude Opus 5.5 与 GPT-6.1 Sol 分别在 86% 和 81% 的问题上超越专家解，且覆盖全部五个科学领域；两者平均在最初两小时内即超过专家解，其最优解多为对领域既有方法的定制或组合。
AI.conclusion: REE 为自主科研提供统一评测框架，既能衡量相对于既定方法的改进幅度，也能刻画其背后的研究过程。

title: Bridging Transferability and Discriminability via Positive-Unlabeled Domain Adaptation for Building Damage Mapping Across Disaster Events
summary: Mapping the damage to buildings following natural and human-caused disasters is essential for disaster response and humanitarian assistance. However, differences in hazard types, geographic environments, building characteristics, and imaging conditions cause cross-event distribution shifts that limit the generalization of deep learning models to new disaster events, even for geospatial foundation models (GFMs) pretrained on extensive Earth observation data. Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) can mitigate these shifts, but adaptation remains challenging when damage-proportion and damage-appearance shifts coexist and interact. We identify enhancing target-domain discriminability as key to addressing this challenge. To this end, inspired by positive-unlabeled (PU) learning, we introduce positive-unlabeled domain adaptation, a paradigm that incorporates PU weak supervision to enhance target-domain discriminability, requiring only a few labeled damaged buildings in the target domain. Building upon this straightforward intuition, we develop Positive-ANchored Domain Adaptation (PANDA), comprising two complementary and mutually reinforcing components: Pairwise Alignment with Intra-class Robustness (PAIR) for discriminative representation learning and Refine Gate and Verifier (RAV) for supervision refinement. On a global-scale multi-disaster benchmark, PANDA generally outperforms representative domain adaptation and PU learning methods. Results on the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires show its effectiveness in new disaster scenarios with few labeled damaged buildings. Further experiments demonstrate the potential of integrating PANDA with GFMs for cross-event adaptation. These findings highlight PANDA's practical potential for rapid, reliable, and cross-event building damage mapping.

AI.tldr: 提出正样本锚定的无监督域自适应方法PANDA，通过引入正-无标签(PU)弱监督提升目标域判别性，解决跨灾害事件建筑损毁制图中的复合分布偏移问题。
AI.motivation: 灾害类型、地理环境、建筑特征与成像条件差异导致跨事件分布偏移，即使是地理空间基础模型(GFM)也难以泛化到新灾害事件。无监督域自适应(UDA)虽可缓解偏移，但当"损毁比例偏移"与"损毁外观偏移"共存并相互耦合时，自适应仍具挑战。作者将提升目标域判别性视为关键。
AI.method: 受正-无标签(PU)学习启发，提出positive-unlabeled domain adaptation范式，仅需目标域少量带标签的损毁建筑即可提供PU弱监督。据此构建PANDA框架，含两个互补互促模块：PAIR(Pairwise Alignment with Intra-class Robustness)，用于判别性表征学习；RAV(Refine Gate and Verifier)，用于监督信号精炼。
AI.result: 在全球尺度多灾种基准上，PANDA总体优于代表性域自适应与PU学习方法；在2025年洛杉矶野火数据上验证了在仅有少量标注损毁建筑的新灾种场景中的有效性；进一步实验表明PANDA可与GFM结合用于跨事件自适应。
AI.conclusion: PANDA在快速、可靠、跨事件的建筑损毁制图方面具有实际应用潜力。

title: SysBio-SR: Benchmarking Symbolic Regression for Trajectory Fidelity and Mechanism Recovery in Systems Biology
summary: Symbolic regression seeks to discover interpretable governing equations for dynamical systems from data. In systems biology, however, accurately reproducing system trajectories does not necessarily imply recovery of the underlying reaction mechanisms. Existing benchmarks evaluate numerical accuracy, expression complexity, or equation-level similarity, but not agreement between recovered reactions and reference mechanisms in biological systems. We introduce SysBio-SR, a benchmark of 198 literature-based biological ODE systems with reaction annotations spanning mass action, Michaelis--Menten, Hill, and complex kinetics. Trajectory fidelity is evaluated across all systems under in-distribution reconstruction and out-of-distribution (OOD) extrapolation, while mechanism recovery is assessed on the subset of 161 systems. We evaluate trajectory fidelity across 11 symbolic-discovery methods and assess mechanism recovery for three reaction-based methods. Joint analysis across systems highlights how severely trajectory-based evaluation overestimates true mechanism recovery. Motivated by these findings, we develop KineSelect, a framework that searches candidate reaction topologies under biologically grounded kinetic laws to select optimal mechanisms that balance trajectory fidelity with structural parsimony. Compared with the strongest baseline, KineSelect improves aggregate OOD extrapolation \(R^2\) by 19.2\% and overall reaction F1 score by 14.3\%.

AI.tldr: 提出生物符号回归基准SysBio-SR（198个带反应注释的生物ODE系统），揭示轨迹精度严重高估机制恢复；并开发KineSelect，在生物合理动力学律下搜索反应拓扑，兼顾轨迹保真与结构简约，OOD R²提升19.2%、反应F1提升14.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有符号回归在系统生物学中仅评估数值精度、表达式复杂度或方程级相似度，但轨迹拟合良好并不等于恢复了真实反应机制；缺乏以"反应机制一致性"为标准的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建SysBio-SR基准：198个基于文献的生物ODE系统并附反应注释（质量作用、Michaelis–Menten、Hill及复杂动力学）；全部系统评估分布内重建与OOD外推的轨迹保真度，其中161个系统评估机制恢复；评测11种符号发现方法与3种基于反应的方法。在此基础上提出KineSelect，在生物合理动力学律约束下搜索候选反应拓扑，以轨迹保真度与结构简约性的联合目标选择最优机制。
AI.result: 联合分析显示基于轨迹的评测显著高估真实机制恢复能力。相较最强基线，KineSelect的聚合OOD外推R²提升19.2%，整体反应F1提升14.3%。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹保真不能作为生物机制恢复的充分代理指标，需引入机制级评测；结合生物先验动力学律的拓扑搜索（KineSelect）可同时改善外推性能与机制识别准确性。

title: FeaXDrive2: Body-Scene Spatial Grounding for Feasibility-Aware Generative Driving
summary: Generative driving planners may produce trajectories that appear feasible at their reference points but violate environmental constraints over the full vehicle body. We propose FeaXDrive2, an end-to-end generative planning framework that enhances vehicle-embodied spatial feasibility (VESF) through body-scene spatial grounding. The proposed method constructs spatial queries from actual vehicle-body corners and dynamically updates visual sampling locations using evolving trajectory estimates across Flow steps. Retrieved local visual features condition subsequent Action Flow-DiT velocity predictions, allowing trajectory generation to guide spatial information retrieval. Rollout-Consistent Safety Fine-Tuning (RC-F) combines high-risk trajectory supervision with reference behavior preservation, followed by planning-supervised VLM-Action Alignment. Vehicle-geometry counterfactual analysis reveals safety differences under identical trajectories but varying vehicle geometry. On NAVSIM, FeaXDrive2 reduces at-fault collisions by 36.5% relative to the base planner and improves PDMS from 87.0 to 88.8. Under NAVSIM v2 evaluation, EPDMS increases from 86.5 to 88.3. Ablation and body-clearance analyses further demonstrate the safety benefits of body-scene spatial grounding.

AI.tldr: 提出FeaXDrive2端到端生成式驾驶规划框架，通过车身-场景空间接地增强车辆本体空间可行性（VESF），在NAVSIM上降低36.5%责任碰撞并将PDMS由87.0提升至88.8。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式驾驶规划器仅在轨迹参考点（如车心或后轴中心）上评估可行性，忽略了完整车身外廓与环境约束的冲突，导致轨迹看似可行却实际发生擦碰。核心动机是将空间可行性从"单点"扩展到"整车几何"。
AI.method: 从真实车身角点构造空间查询（spatial queries），并在Flow采样的各步中利用演进中的轨迹估计动态更新视觉采样位置；检索到的局部视觉特征用于条件化后续Action Flow-DiT的速度预测，实现轨迹生成反向引导空间信息检索。提出Rollout-Consistent Safety Fine-Tuning（RC-F），将高风险轨迹监督与参考行为保持相结合，随后进行规划监督的VLM-Action对齐；并引入车辆几何反事实分析。
AI.result: NAVSIM上相对基座规划器责任碰撞降低36.5%，PDMS从87.0升至88.8；NAVSIM v2下EPDMS从86.5升至88.3。消融实验与车身间隙分析进一步验证车身-场景空间接地的安全收益；车辆几何反事实分析显示相同轨迹下不同车身几何存在显著安全差异。
AI.conclusion: 以车身角点为查询单元的显式空间接地可有效弥补参考点级可行性评估的缺陷，配合一致性安全微调与VLM-Action对齐，可在不牺牲参考行为的前提下提升端到端规划的安全性与综合指标。

title: A Failure-Driven Data Flywheel for Post-Training Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models rarely satisfy all behavioral requirements of a new platform, and teams without a large deployed fleet lack the data to address the resulting failures. We propose a failure-driven data flywheel for post-training such models. It constructs target scenarios absent from the available data by inserting task-relevant entities into reconstructed real-world scenes, and evaluates the model against each behavioral requirement of the target task. Failure rates form a failure map across task conditions and difficulty levels, which is re-evaluated after each round and assigns larger data generation quotas to conditions where the model still fails. We instantiate the framework in autonomous driving for occluded-pedestrian emergence and yielding at stop-sign-controlled intersections, and evaluate it on two VLA models and one non-VLA planner in simulation and on a real vehicle. For occluded-pedestrian emergence, five rounds of post-training improve the critical-phase collision-free rate on the sealed test set from 0.261 to 0.579 for AutoVLA and from 0.390 to 0.765 for ReCogDrive, while the unnecessary braking rate in paired control scenarios never exceeds 0.013. On a full-scale vehicle without real-world training, post-trained ReCogDrive achieves 4 of 5 safe passages, versus 1 of 5 for the base model. Fine-grained evaluation reveals a pattern obscured by the collision-free rate alone: both VLA models learn anticipatory deceleration before reaching the occluding vehicle, while braking after pedestrian emergence remains limited. For stop-sign yielding, the stop-before-line rate rises from 0.100 to 0.897 for AutoVLA and from 0.000 to 0.667 for ReCogDrive. With sequential training from the pedestrian-capability models, it reaches 0.599 and 0.358, respectively, while the pedestrian collision-free rate decreases by at most 0.032.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种“故障驱动的数据飞轮”框架，用于对预训练VLA模型进行后训练。该方法在重建的真实场景中插入任务相关实体构造目标场景，按行为要求评估模型并生成“故障地图”，据此分配数据生成配额并迭代重评估。在自动驾驶的遮挡行人涌现与停车标志让行任务上验证，五个轮次后AutoVLA关键阶段无碰撞率由0.261升至0.579、ReCogDrive由0.390升至0.765，停车线前停车率分别升至0.897与0.667，实车5次中安全通过4次（基线1次）。
AI.motivation: 预训练VLA模型难以同时满足新平台的全部行为要求，而缺乏大规模部署车队数据的团队无法针对失败情形收集数据，存在“失败—数据缺口”的闭环缺失问题。
AI.method: 构建故障驱动的数据飞轮：在重建的真实场景中插入任务相关实体，合成数据中缺失的目标场景；对目标任务的每项行为要求分别评估模型，统计各任务条件与难度层级下的失败率形成故障地图；每轮结束后重新评估，对仍失败的条件分配更大的数据生成配额，迭代后训练。在自动驾驶遮挡行人涌现与停车标志让行两个任务上，以两个VLA模型和一个非VLA规划器在仿真与实车上进行验证。
AI.result: 遮挡行人涌现任务：五轮后训练使密封测试集关键阶段无碰撞率AutoVLA由0.261升至0.579、ReCogDrive由0.390升至0.765，配对对照场景不必要制动率不超过0.013；实车无真实数据训练下ReCogDrive安全通过4/5，基线1/5。细粒度评估显示两模型均学会在到达遮挡车前预期性减速，但行人出现后的制动仍有限。停车标志让行任务：停车线前停车率AutoVLA由0.100升至0.897、ReCogDrive由0.000升至0.667；从行人能力模型顺序迁移训练后分别为0.599与0.358，行人无碰撞率下降不超过0.032。
AI.conclusion: 故障驱动的数据飞轮可在缺乏实车数据条件下有效提升VLA模型的目标行为表现，故障地图驱动的配额分配实现了数据高效迭代；细粒度评估揭示了聚合指标掩盖的能力结构差异（预期性减速优于事后制动）；顺序训练存在任务间权衡，新任务提升伴随旧能力小幅退化，说明后训练需在能力保持与新增行为间做显式权衡。

title: Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology via Topology-Informed Graph Attention and Gene-Semantics Conditioning
summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) profiles gene expression with spatial context but remains costly, motivating models that infer expression from H&E images. Existing approaches face three key limitations: (i) a single patch embedding is often insufficient: morphologically similar regions can exhibit distinct expression due to spatial context, while naive neighborhood aggregation can over-smooth boundaries; (ii) conventional fixed, gene-indexed output heads treat genes independently and cannot directly support strict zero-shot prediction for unseen genes; and (iii) common metrics under-measure spatial pattern fidelity and boundary resolution. To address these challenges, we propose TIGEM, a topology-informed, gene-conditioned framework for histology-to-ST inference. TIGEM learns topology-aware spot representations by regularizing graph attention with tissue-level topology and morphology cues to avoid cross-compartment smoothing, and uses gene semantic modulation to replace gene-indexed heads, enabling zero-shot prediction for unseen genes. We also introduce Graph Spectral Correlation (GSC) to evaluate spatial pattern fidelity and boundary resolution complement to PCC/MSE. Across three large-scale ST datasets, TIGEM achieves overall state-of-the-art performance and significantly improved boundary prediction resolution, and further demonstrates the ability to predict expression patterns for genes unseen during training, extending prior zero-shot histology-to-ST efforts with topology-aware spatial propagation and PLM-based gene conditioning.

AI.tldr: 提出TIGEM：一个拓扑感知、基因条件化的H&E图像到空间转录组（ST）推断框架，通过组织拓扑正则化的图注意力学习spot表征、以基因语义调制替代基因索引输出头实现未见基因零样本预测，并提出图谱相关性（GSC）指标衡量空间模式保真度与边界分辨率。
AI.motivation: ST测量成本高，促使从H&E图像推断表达。现有方法有三点不足：(i) 单一patch嵌入信息不足——形态相似区域因空间上下文而有不同表达，而朴素邻域聚合会造成边界过度平滑；(ii) 固定、基因索引式输出头将基因视作独立类别，无法支持严格意义上的未见基因零样本预测；(iii) 常用指标（PCC/MSE）对空间模式保真度和边界分辨率刻画不足。
AI.method: TIGEM由两部分构成：(1) 拓扑感知spot表征：用组织级拓扑与形态线索对图注意力进行正则化，抑制跨组织分区的平滑；(2) 基因语义调制：以基于预训练语言模型（PLM）的基因语义条件替代基因索引式head，实现未见基因的零样本预测。此外引入图谱相关性（GSC），作为PCC/MSE的补充指标，评估空间模式保真度与边界分辨率。
AI.result: 在三个大规模ST数据集上取得整体SOTA性能，边界预测分辨率显著提升；并验证了可预测训练中未出现基因的表达模式，相较既往零样本histology-to-ST工作在拓扑感知空间传播与PLM基因条件化两方面有所推进。
AI.conclusion: TIGEM表明：显式建模组织拓扑结构 + 基因语义条件化，是提升histology-to-ST推断精度、边界分辨率和零样本泛化能力的有效路径；同时凸显了现有评价体系对空间结构刻画不足的问题，GSC可作为补充评估工具。

title: Unstable Action Boundaries in Lethal Drone Agents
summary: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents raise safety risks that are not captured by text-only refusal behavior, especially when tools can trigger high-impact actions. This concern is salient in military settings, where autonomous weapons raise the possibility of delegating force decisions to software agents. In this work, we study whether a drone agent's action boundary is stable under changes to the target descriptor. We evaluate recent and popular LLMs in a simulated perception-action pipeline over real-world drone imagery, where models can localize requested targets and invoke a simulated lethal tool. We find two concerning failure modes. First, some LLM agents invoke the lethal tool for ordinary generic descriptors such as \emph{people}, requiring no jailbreak at all. Second, an agent that initially appears conservative under protected descriptors can become unsafe under a simple semantic target shift.

AI.tldr: 本文研究工具调用型LLM智能体的“动作边界”是否对目标描述词的变化保持稳定，发现在无人机感知—动作仿真流水线中，部分模型对“people”等普通泛化描述即直接调用致命工具，且看似保守的模型在简单语义替换后即变得不安全。
AI.motivation: 纯文本拒答行为无法刻画工具调用带来的安全风险，尤其当工具可触发高影响动作（如自主武力决策）时；因此需要检验智能体在目标描述变化下行动边界是否稳定。
AI.method: 基于真实无人机影像构建仿真感知—动作流水线，让近期主流LLM对指定目标进行定位并可调用模拟致命工具；通过系统性改变目标描述词（从受保护描述到普通泛化描述及语义偏移）评测其动作边界。
AI.result: 发现两类失效模式：一是部分LLM智能体对“people”等普通描述词即在无越狱提示情况下调用致命工具；二是初始在受保护描述下表现保守的智能体，在简单的目标语义偏移下转为不安全。
AI.conclusion: 工具型LLM智能体的安全对齐在动作层面脆弱，文本拒答不足以衡量风险；需以动作边界稳定性作为评测维度，并警惕单纯语义变化即可绕过安全约束。

title: Autonomous Ergodic Robotic Palpation for Elastic Mapping of Curved Soft Tissues
summary:
Autonomous robotic palpation offers repeatable, quantitative
  estimates of tissue properties for stiff inclusion
  localization. However, existing methods often rely on prior mesh
  models or planar surface assumptions that do not generalize to
  complex human anatomy. We propose an ergodic palpation framework that
  operates directly on curved soft surfaces using point cloud
  data. Central to our approach is the Laplace--Beltrami operator,
  which grounds both online estimation and exploration in the surface
  intrinsic geometry. We estimate local viscoelastic parameters using
  an Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) and fuse them into a surface-aware
  Gaussian Process (GP). This probabilistic model drives a
  diffusion-based ergodic motion planner, generating a continuous
  exploration trajectory that feeds the new informative samples back
  to the GP in a closed loop. Throughout this process, a hybrid
  force-impedance controller regulates interaction forces to maintain
  contact. We evaluate the approach against existing methods in
  simulation and validate it in physical experiments on
  tissue-mimicking silicone phantoms with varying geometries and
  viscoelastic properties, demonstrating geometry-consistent mapping
  and stiff inclusion localization under contact-rich conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出基于点云与Laplace–Beltrami算子的各态遍历（ergodic）触诊框架，直接在曲面软组织上估计黏弹性并定位硬性病灶，仿真与硅胶仿体实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有自主机器人触诊依赖先验网格模型或平面表面假设，难以泛化到复杂的人体解剖曲面；需要在无需网格先验的情况下直接在曲面上进行组织属性估计与探索。
AI.method: 以点云为输入，用Laplace–Beltrami算子将在线估计与探索统一到曲面内蕴几何上；用无迹卡尔曼滤波（UKF）估计局部黏弹性参数，并融合进表面感知高斯过程（GP）；由该概率模型驱动基于扩散的ergodic运动规划器生成连续探索轨迹，闭环地将新信息样本反馈给GP；全过程用混合力-阻抗控制器维持接触力。
AI.result: 在仿真中与现有方法对比，并在不同几何与黏弹性性质的仿组织硅胶体模上进行物理实验，实现几何一致的属性建图，并在富接触条件下完成硬性包块定位。
AI.conclusion: 基于曲面内蕴几何的ergodic触诊框架可摆脱网格/平面假设，实现曲面软组织的黏弹性建图与硬性病灶定位，具备向复杂解剖表面推广的潜力。

title: From Shared Patterns to Individual Evidence: Two-Stage Reasoning for Emerging Entities in Temporal Knowledge Graphs
summary: Temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) continually introduce emerging entities whose interaction histories evolve from zero-shot debuts into sparse, bursty few-shot trajectories. However, current paradigms are fragmented: pattern-transfer methods lack catalog-wide event memory, whereas online memory models suffer from endpoint-role asymmetry that degrades unseen-answer ranking. Furthermore, sparse early interactions exhibit both long-range dispersion and local redundancy under skewed distribution. To address these challenges, we propose INSPIRE (Integrating Shared Patterns and Individual Evidence for Reasoning), a two-stage forecasting framework over a known catalog. In Stage I, INSPIRE learns an availability-aware shared-pattern predictor that fuses event-updated memory across the full candidate catalog while applying coordinated query- and catalog-side masking. Subsequently, Stage II freezes this predictor and optimizes a lightweight individual-evidence adapter (EA) combining textual semantic priors with correlation-weighted long-range event statistics under support- and role-balanced co-answer supervision with prior-odds debiasing and soft residual alignment. In addition, we decompose evaluation by endpoint roles and track longitudinal emerging-answer cohorts via query-micro and answer-entity macro metrics. Across four benchmarks based on the ICEWS and GDELT event datasets, INSPIRE improves Emerging MRR by 16.73%-88.83% over the strongest baselines. Relative to paired Stage I predictors, EA further increases Emerging MRR by 8.28%-32.63%, Answer-new MRR by 7.81%-41.24%, and cohort macro MRR by 9.64%-39.94%, gains attributed to semantic priors and candidate-level score competition suppressing mismatched established competitors without zero-support prior shortcuts. The official code is publicly available at https://github.com/KcAcoZhang/INSPIRE.

AI.tldr: INSPIRE：面向已知实体目录的两阶段时序知识图谱预测框架，先学可用性感知的共享模式预测器，再冻结后训练个体证据适配器，显著提升新兴实体/新答案的排序性能。
AI.motivation: 时序知识图中新实体不断出现，其交互历史从零样本首现演化为稀疏、突发的小样本轨迹。现有方法割裂：模式迁移方法缺乏目录级事件记忆；在线记忆模型存在端点角色不对称，损害未见答案的排序；且稀疏早期交互在偏斜分布下兼具长程离散与局部冗余。
AI.method: 两阶段框架，限定在已知候选目录内推理。阶段一：可用性感知的共享模式预测器，在全候选目录上融合事件更新记忆，并施加查询侧与目录侧的协同掩码。阶段二：冻结该预测器，优化轻量个体证据适配器（EA），融合文本语义先验与相关性加权的长程事件统计，采用支持度与角色平衡的共现答案监督，并配以先验几率去偏与软残差对齐。评估上按端点角色分解，并用查询-微观与答案实体-宏观指标追踪纵向新兴答案队列。
AI.result: 在基于ICEWS与GDELT事件数据集的四个基准上，Emerging MRR较最强基线提升16.73%–88.83%；相对配对的阶段一预测器，EA进一步使Emerging MRR提升8.28%–32.63%、Answer-new MRR提升7.81%–41.24%、队列宏观MRR提升9.64%–39.94%。增益归因于语义先验与候选级分数竞争抑制了错配的已确立竞争者，且未使用零支持先验捷径。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享模式记忆与个体证据的两阶段解耦设计，并辅以角色分解与队列化宏观评估，可有效缓解新兴实体稀疏突发轨迹下的端点角色不对称问题，在多个事件基准上取得一致且显著的提升；代码已开源。

title: SprintGS: Eliminating Redundancy for Fast 3D Gaussian Splatting Training
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) renders photorealistic novel views in real time, but its per-scene training (optimization) remains slow. Recent fast training methods such as FastGS shorten training to a few minutes by reducing the number of Gaussians. Profiling FastGS, we find two costs that remain even in its compact model. First, rasterization is still the largest cost, and redundant work remains in it. Second, the loss computation does not shrink with the number of Gaussians, so its share of the training time grows as the model becomes compact. We present SprintGS, a training framework built on FastGS that keeps the model compact and reduces both costs. For rasterization, scheduled tile culling limits each Gaussian to the tiles where it matters, using a coarse footprint that is annealed to the exact one before training ends; convergence-aware pruning removes converged, nearly transparent Gaussians; and a shuffle-efficient backward pass reduces the data exchanged between GPU threads. For the loss, a fused loss computes the loss and its image gradient in the forward pass without a loss map, removing most of its cost. SprintGS trains 2.15x faster than FastGS at comparable quality, and 1.81x faster in its high-quality setting. It also accelerates other fast training methods and dynamic, sparse-view, and surface reconstruction.

AI.tldr: SprintGS 是一个基于 FastGS 的 3DGS 训练加速框架，通过调度式 tile 剔除、收敛感知剪枝、shuffle 高效反向传播与融合损失计算，在保持可比质量下取得 2.15× 加速（高质量设置下 1.81×），并可推广到其他快速训练方法与动态/稀疏视角/表面重建等任务。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 可实时渲染高真实感新视角，但逐场景优化训练仍很慢。FastGS 等快速训练方法通过减少高斯数量将训练缩短到数分钟，但对 FastGS 的剖析显示：即便在紧凑模型下仍存在两类开销——(1) 光栅化仍是最大开销，且其中存在冗余计算；(2) 损失计算不随高斯数量缩减，模型越紧凑，其在训练时间中的占比越大。
AI.method: 该文提出 SprintGS，保持模型紧凑并同时降低两类开销。光栅化方面：调度式 tile 剔除（scheduled tile culling），用粗糙 footprint 将每个高斯限制在其真正重要的 tile 上，并在训练结束前退火至精确 footprint；收敛感知剪枝（convergence-aware pruning）移除已收敛且近乎透明的高斯；shuffle 高效反向传播减少 GPU 线程间数据交换。损失方面：融合损失（fused loss）在前向传播中直接计算损失及其图像梯度，无需构造 loss map，从而消除大部分开销。
AI.result: 在与 FastGS 质量相当的条件下训练速度提升 2.15×；在其高质量设置下提升 1.81×。此外还能加速其他快速训练方法，并在动态场景、稀疏视角与表面重建任务上带来加速。
AI.conclusion: 在紧凑高斯模型下，光栅化冗余与损失计算是剩余的两大瓶颈；SprintGS 通过剔除/剪枝/高效反向与融合损失针对性消除这些开销，实现显著端到端加速且不损失质量，并具备良好的通用性与可迁移性。

title: MUSE: Multi-Task Uncertainty-Aware Self-Supervised Encoder for mmWave ISAC
summary: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) allows a wireless system to use the same waveform for communication and environment sensing. At mmWave frequency bands, ISAC enables diverse human sensing tasks, such as localization, gesture recognition, and pose estimation, with high precision. However, each task requires training a dedicated model, typically from scratch on a task-specific dataset, with no mechanism to flag unreliable predictions. This hurts the scalability, transferability, and reliability of mmWave ISAC models. In this work, we propose MUSE (Multi-task Uncertainty-aware Self-supervised Encoder), a unified framework for mmWave human sensing. MUSE leverages a self-supervised transformer model with per-dataset tokenization and is trained via masked autoencoding across five datasets. During fine-tuning, MUSE uses evidential classification heads that enable uncertainty quantification. MUSE replaces N separate encoders with a single shared transformer encoder, an N-times backbone parameter reduction, while achieving a 9.7 percentage points improvement in classification performance compared to the task-specific model, showing that learning jointly across tasks improves per-task generalization. Across four classification tasks, MUSE produces reliable uncertainty estimates that enable selective prediction, improving accuracy by abstaining on the least confident 20% of predictions. We further improve the reliability of the model's confidence estimates using temperature scaling and conformal prediction. Finally, MUSE's uncertainty signal remains reliable even under cross-user deployment, assigning higher uncertainty to wrong predictions than to correct ones 78% of the time, and recovering 9.2 percentage points of accuracy through selective prediction, with no additional retraining on the unseen user.

AI.tldr: 提出MUSE——面向毫米波人体感知的多任务不确定性感知自监督编码器框架，用单一共享Transformer编码器替代多个任务专用模型，在五个数据集上通过掩码自编码预训练并配合证据分类头进行不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 毫米波ISAC支持定位、手势识别、姿态估计等多种人体感知任务，但现有做法需为每个任务从零训练专用模型，且无法标记不可靠预测，损害了可扩展性、可迁移性与可靠性。
AI.method: MUSE采用自监督Transformer编码器，对各数据集进行独立tokenization，并在五个数据集上以掩码自编码（masked autoencoding）联合训练；微调阶段引入证据分类头（evidential classification heads）实现不确定性量化；进一步用温度缩放与共形预测（conformal prediction）校准置信度。
AI.result: 以单一共享编码器替代N个独立编码器，骨干参数减少N倍；分类性能较任务专用模型提升9.7个百分点；四个分类任务上不确定性估计可靠，弃权最不自信的20%预测可提升准确率；跨用户部署下，错误预测的不确定性高于正确预测的比例达78%，无需额外重训练即通过选择性预测挽回9.2个百分点准确率。
AI.conclusion: 多任务联合自监督学习可在显著削减参数的同时提升单任务泛化，且证据式不确定性可用于可靠的选择性预测，在跨用户场景下依然有效，为毫米波人体感知提供了统一、可扩展且可信的框架。

title: DemoFoundry: Toward Scalable Photorealistic Robot Data with Coding Agents and Generative Rendering
summary: Scaling robot learning requires demonstrations that combine realistic visual observations with reliable action supervision. Simulation-based synthesis faces a substantial visual gap relative to real environments, while video-only generation struggles to maintain physically consistent interactions and provide aligned action labels. We present DemoFoundry, an automated framework that couples coding agents with generative rendering to synthesize photorealistic and physically grounded robot demonstrations. Coding agents both construct aligned real--proxy video pairs from existing robot episodes to train a video renderer and write executable interaction programs to generate new demonstrations. Given a scene reference and task instruction, an agent reconstructs task-relevant geometry and writes a control program without requiring target-task human demonstrations. Program execution in a physics simulator produces proxy videos with aligned robot states and actions. The video renderer translates these proxy videos into scene-consistent, photorealistic observations, reducing the need for detailed appearance modeling in each scene. Automated task-execution checks select successful trajectories for rendering and policy learning. Experiments show improved visual quality and action--video consistency. Policies trained on the generated demonstrations outperform raw-simulation training and approach the performance of training on an equal number of real demonstrations.

AI.tldr: DemoFoundry 是一个将编码智能体与生成式渲染相结合的自动化框架，可从场景参考和任务指令出发，合成兼具照片级真实感与物理一致性、且动作标签对齐的机器人演示数据，训练出的策略性能接近同等数量真实演示。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习需要同时具备真实视觉观测与可靠动作监督的演示数据。纯仿真合成存在显著视觉差距；纯视频生成难以保证物理一致的交互，也难以提供对齐的动作标签。作者希望弥合这一矛盾，并在无需目标任务人工演示的前提下规模化生成演示。
AI.method: 1) 编码智能体从已有机器人片段构建对齐的"真实—代理"视频对，用于训练视频渲染器；2) 给定场景参考与任务指令，智能体重建任务相关几何并编写可执行交互控制程序，无需目标任务的示教数据；3) 在物理仿真器中执行程序，得到带对齐机器人状态与动作的代理视频；4) 视频渲染器将代理视频转换为场景一致的照片级观测，降低逐场景精细外观建模需求；5) 自动任务执行检查筛选成功轨迹用于渲染与策略学习。
AI.result: 实验显示视觉质量与"动作—视频"一致性均有提升；在所生成演示上训练的策略优于原始仿真数据训练，并接近使用同等数量真实演示训练的性能。
AI.conclusion: 将编码智能体的程序化仿真与生成式视频渲染相结合，可在无人示教条件下产出物理可靠、视觉逼真的演示数据，为缩小仿真—现实差距、降低真实数据依赖提供了可行路径。

title: What Is a Theory Worth to an LLM Solver? Measuring, Inducing, and Merging Theories in Context
summary: Mathematicians solve problems faster when they know the right theory. We ask how much a stated theory is worth to a large language model (LLM) solver, and whether a model can write that theory itself. In a length-matched protocol, adding the right theory to the context of Qwen3-14B raises pass@1 on pattern waiting-time problems from 0.37 to 0.83 and cuts the median tokens of correct solutions from 10.2k to 6.3k, while worked examples of the same length do not help. The gain shrinks as the solver and its token budget grow (+0.46, +0.26, +0.07), and at a long budget it comes almost entirely from finishing within budget: solutions that finish are correct 98--100\% of the time in every condition. To separate induction from recall, we plant unpublished theorems in custom probability families and measure how much of the oracle theory's gain an induced theory recovers. A strong open model, required to explore the training problems with code before writing, recovers 60\% of the gain on one planted family, 48\% on a second, and almost none on a third, where it finds the right form but not the condition that makes the form computable. No single induced note is complete, but a strong model that merges several notes recovers 61\% of the gain on the classic family, above the best single note (47\%). Theories are worth the reasoning they save, and models can find their pieces before they can assemble them.

AI.tldr: 在长度匹配协议下，向Qwen3-14B上下文注入正确理论可将模式等待时间问题pass@1从0.37提升至0.83，并将正确解答的中位token数从10.2k降至6.3k；同长度的工作示例无此收益。模型可将训练中归纳出的理论笔记部分替代oracle理论（单笔记最高恢复60%增益，多笔记合并可在经典族上恢复61%）。
AI.motivation: 作者提出一个量化问题：对LLM求解器而言，"陈述出的理论"究竟值多少推理开销？以及模型能否自行写出这样的理论。现有工作多关注提示技巧或示例，缺少对"理论 vs. 示例"在等长度条件下的价值度量，也缺少对"归纳获得"与"记忆召回"的区分。
AI.method: 采用长度匹配协议对比"正确理论"与"同长度worked examples"的效果；在不同求解器规模与token预算下测量增益变化；为分离归纳与召回，在自定义概率族中植入未发表定理，测量诱导理论（induced theory）相对oracle理论所恢复的增益比例；要求强开源模型先用代码探索训练问题再撰写笔记，并比较单笔记与多笔记合并策略。
AI.result: Qwen3-14B上pass@1由0.37升至0.83，正确解中位token由10.2k降至6.3k；同长度示例无效。随求解器规模与预算增大，增益递减（+0.46、+0.26、+0.07）；长预算下增益几乎全部来自"在预算内完成"，各条件下完成即正确的比例为98–100%。植入定理实验中，强开源模型在一个族上恢复60%增益、第二个族48%、第三个族近乎为零（找到正确形式但未找到使其可计算的条件）；经典族上多笔记合并恢复61%，高于最佳单笔记的47%。
AI.conclusion: 理论的价值在于其节省的推理量，而非信息量本身；模型能够发现理论的碎片，但尚不能可靠地将其组装为完整可用的理论。理论注入的有效性随求解器能力与预算增长而边际递减。

title: DriftWAM: Faster World-Action Models via Action-Aware Video Drifting
summary: World-action models (WAMs) unify future video prediction and action generation for robotic control, but their reliance on iterative denoising incurs substantial inference costs. Distilling these models into few-step generators offers a promising route to efficient deployment, yet maintaining task performance under aggressive step reduction remains challenging. Existing methods rely on point-wise trajectory consistency distillation, which pursues high visual fidelity while leaving downstream action information unexploited in optimizing video generation, and also lacks explicit distribution-level alignment. To address this, we propose DriftWAM, a few-step WAM distillation framework that incorporates the actions induced by predicted videos into video learning. Specifically, DriftWAM integrates action-aware video drifting, which performs video distribution matching through a joint visual--action similarity kernel to steer sample evolution under the guidance of these induced actions, with action-guided video regularization, which leverages the compatible teacher--student matches identified by the joint kernel to backpropagate action-level gradients directly into the video generator. Evaluations on the RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO benchmarks, as well as in real-world robotic manipulation tasks, show that DriftWAM consistently outperforms prior consistency distillation methods across few-step settings at the same inference speed.

AI.tldr: DriftWAM是一个少步世界-动作模型(WAM)蒸馏框架，将预测视频所诱导的动作信息引入视频生成学习，通过动作感知的视频漂移与动作引导的视频正则，实现分布级对齐，在RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO及真实机器人任务上优于现有一致性蒸馏方法。
AI.motivation: WAM统一了未来视频预测与动作生成以服务于机器人控制，但依赖迭代去噪导致推理开销大。少步蒸馏是其高效部署的有前景途径，然而在激进减少步数时保持任务性能仍具挑战。现有方法依赖逐点轨迹一致性蒸馏，只追求高视觉保真度，在优化视频生成时未利用下游动作信息，且缺乏显式的分布级对齐。
AI.method: 提出DriftWAM少步蒸馏框架，将预测视频诱导的动作纳入视频学习，包含两个组件：(1) 动作感知视频漂移(action-aware video drifting)，通过联合视觉—动作相似度核进行视频分布匹配，在诱导动作引导下驱动样本演化；(2) 动作引导视频正则(action-guided video regularization)，利用联合核识别出的兼容师生匹配，将动作级梯度直接反传至视频生成器。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0与LIBERO基准以及真实世界机器人操作任务上的评测表明，在相同推理速度的少步设置下，DriftWAM一致优于先前的一致性蒸馏方法。
AI.conclusion: 将下游动作信号显式融入视频蒸馏优化并引入分布级对齐，可有效提升少步WAM蒸馏的任务性能，为高效机器人策略部署提供可行方案。

title: Agent-as-a-Verifier: From Scores to Evidence for General Verification
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development
summary: Verification is increasingly critical across various inference and learning paradigms, such as test-time scaling, recursive intelligence and automated research, where feedback can improve efficiency and optimization. Common score-based verifiers, or discriminative reward models, predict a scalar reward for an output. While useful for filtering, rewarding, and ranking, such scores provide no explicit, auditable evidentiary basis for the judgment. In parallel, although existing generative process reward models offer text feedback, most designs do not fully exploit agentic capabilities, such as tool use and iterative reasoning, which are essential for fact-checking and fine-grained claim verification. In this paper, we address these limitations by introducing Agent-as-a-Verifier, an agentic, certificate-producing verification system that places role-separated LLM agents inside a formal-methods-inspired claim-obligation-certificate protocol. Given a generation candidate, Agent-as-a-Verifier produces a certificate by extracting a verdict-blind dependency graph of claims, independently compiling the task's acceptance contract, and deriving checkable obligations. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, Agent-as-a-Verifier achieves higher accuracy than the state-of-the-art approach. Across different downstream applications, the augmented agent also outperforms the plain agent on FrontierMath and CyberGym. More importantly, Agent-as-a-Verifier is able to identify reward-hacking solutions that deceive the benchmark evaluator, highlighting its broader potential for iterative and recursive agent optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/sunyxedu/General-Verifier

AI.tldr: 提出 Agent-as-a-Verifier：在形式化方法启发的"主张—义务—证书"协议中部署角色分离的 LLM 智能体，产出可审计的验证证书而非单一标量分数。
AI.motivation: 验证在测试时扩展、递归智能与自动化科研等范式中日益关键。现有 score-based verifier（判别式奖励模型）只输出标量奖励，无法提供显式、可审计的证据基础；现有生成式过程奖励模型虽给出文本反馈，却未充分利用工具调用与迭代推理等智能体能力，难以支撑事实核查与细粒度论断验证。
AI.method: 构建智能体化、可产出证书的验证系统：给定候选生成，先抽取"判决盲"（verdict-blind）的主张依赖图，独立编译任务的验收契约，再推导可检验的验证义务，交由角色分离的 LLM 智能体依协议执行与举证，形成证书。
AI.result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上准确率超过当前最优方法；在 FrontierMath 与 CyberGym 上，增强后的智能体优于原始智能体；并能识别欺骗基准评测器的 reward-hacking 解。
AI.conclusion: 证书式、智能体驱动的验证在准确性与抗奖励攻击上具优势，对迭代/递归智能体优化有更广应用潜力；代码已开源。

title: RoboEvo$^2$: Recursive Robot Self-Improvement via Harness-Policy Co-Evolution
summary: Robots should adapt to unfamiliar environments and acquire new skills through interaction, then execute those skills efficiently with practice. Vision-language-action policies provide efficient control, but often need additional human demonstrations to handle unfamiliar settings; reasoning agents can discover solutions using broad prior knowledge and robot-control APIs, but repeated deliberation and repair are costly. Inspired by human learning through reasoning and practice, we propose RoboEvo$^2$, a framework for recursive harness-policy co-evolution. In Policy-to-Harness (P2H) evolution, policy failures guide a coding agent to search complementary Code, Code+ICL, and Code+Policy routes, consolidating verified solutions into reusable skills, routing strategies, and experience memory. In Harness-to-Policy (H2P) evolution, verified trajectories provide supervised training, while Counterfactual Preference Distillation (CPD) teaches the policy to favor successful corrections over failures from the same starting state. The improved policy provides stronger motor skills for subsequent search, while its remaining failures redirect harness evolution, closing the reciprocal loop. Through recursive co-evolution without additional human demonstrations, RoboEvo$^2$ improves standalone success from 11.0% to 84.1% and hybrid success from 30.4% to 90.5% on LIBERO-PRO, with similar gains and reduced agentic costs on RoboTwin C2R. Further experiments demonstrate autonomous task acquisition, cross-embodiment harness transfer, and 95.0% hybrid success on the Unitree G1-D. Our models and code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: RoboEvo²是一个"递归式harness-策略协同进化"框架：通过Policy-to-Harness进化把策略失败转化为可复用技能/路由/经验记忆，再通过Harness-to-Policy进化（含反事实偏好蒸馏CPD）把验证轨迹回灌为策略训练信号，形成无额外人类示教的闭环，从而让机器人既能"想"又能"练"。
AI.motivation: 现有两类范式各有瓶颈：VLA（vision-language-action）策略控制高效，但面对陌生环境需额外人类示教，泛化受限；基于推理的智能体可借助广泛先验知识和机器人控制API自主发现解法，但重复的推理与修复代价高昂、效率低。作者希望模拟人类"先推理探索、再练习固化"的学习方式，兼顾自主性与执行效率，且不依赖额外人类示教。
AI.method: 提出RoboEvo²，双阶段递归协同进化。①P2H（Policy-to-Harness）进化：策略执行失败驱动编码智能体在Code、Code+ICL、Code+Policy三条互补路线上搜索解法，把已验证方案固化为可复用技能、路由策略与经验记忆。②H2P（Harness-to-Policy）进化：验证成功的轨迹作为监督数据训练策略；同时提出反事实偏好蒸馏（CPD），在同一初始状态下让策略偏好"成功的修正"而非"失败轨迹"。改进后的策略为后续搜索提供更强运动技能，剩余失败又反过来指引harness进化，闭合互惠循环。全流程递归共进化、无需额外人类示教。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-PRO上，standalone成功率由11.0%提升至84.1%，hybrid成功率由30.4%提升至90.5%；在RoboTwin C2R上取得相似增益且智能体开销降低。进一步实验验证了自主任务获取、跨具身harness迁移，以及在Unitree G1-D上达到95.0%的hybrid成功率。模型与代码将公开。
AI.conclusion: 推理与练习可相互强化的闭环设计有效：harness侧的可复用技能与经验记忆弥补策略泛化不足，策略侧的训练与偏好蒸馏压缩重复推理成本，二者互馈使系统在无额外示教下持续自提升，并具备跨本体迁移潜力。

title: TASK Memory: Beyond Text-Only Memory with Activation Steering and Knowledge Editing against Memory Hallucination
summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on external memory, yet they still hallucinate about what they remember. Often the correct memory is retrieved and placed in the prompt, but the answer contradicts it or the memory is applied to the wrong question. We call these use-time memory hallucinations. Across five open models, we find that they arise from the conflict between parametric knowledge and external memory and take three forms: memory-ignoring, where the model returns to a stale fact in its weights (up to 46% of queries); memory-misapplying, where it attributes the memory to unrelated entities (up to 24%, and 49% when retrieval is combined with weight editing); and version confusion, where 53% of answers about revised facts assert the superseded value when both versions remain stored. We propose TASK memory, which goes beyond text-only memory by combining a Text note with Activation Steering and Knowledge editing that share one in-model address. The text holds the content. A removable knowledge edit supplies the address through its subject key and supports multi-hop composition. A pair of steering vectors decides, query by query, whether the model adopts the memory or keeps its own answer; the vectors store no content and control how the text memory is used. On frozen models under a pre-registered, test-once protocol, TASK reduces memory-ignoring hallucinations to at most 1.5% in all ten model-dataset cells and cuts neighbour misuse from 39.2% to 7.5% (+10.8 pp composite on CounterFact). It improves a 300-memory library over BM25 RAG by 16.4 pp, an advantage that holds at 3,000 memories, resolves fact revisions without fact IDs, and adds 7.5 pp of multi-hop accuracy on MQuAKE. 21 of 23 cross-model comparisons (8B-27B, four families) are significant, and TASK beats three recent context-steering methods in 9 of 10 model-dataset cells.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"使用时记忆幻觉"（use-time memory hallucinations）这一概念，指出检索正确但模型仍误用记忆的三类现象（忽视记忆、错配记忆、版本混淆），并给出TASK记忆框架——将文本记忆与共享同一"模型内地址"的激活引导向量、可移除知识编辑相结合，在冻结模型上显著降低幻觉。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体日益依赖外部记忆，但仍会对"记住的内容"产生幻觉：正确记忆已被检索并放入提示中，回答却与之矛盾，或把记忆用于错误问题。作者将这类问题归因于参数化知识与外部记忆之间的冲突，需系统性诊断并提出解决方案。
AI.method: 先对五个开源模型做诊断，归纳三类使用时幻觉：memory-ignoring（回退到权重中的陈旧事实）、memory-misapplying（将记忆归因到无关实体）、version confusion（新旧版本共存时答出被取代的值）。再提出TASK记忆：Text笔记保存内容；可移除的知识编辑以其主语键提供"地址"并支持多跳组合；一对引导向量逐查询决定模型采纳记忆还是保留自身答案，向量本身不存储内容。冻结模型下采用预注册、仅测一次协议评测。
AI.result: 十个模型-数据集组合中，memory-ignoring幻觉均降至≤1.5%；邻居误用从39.2%降至7.5%，CounterFact上复合指标提升10.8个百分点。300条记忆库上比BM25 RAG高16.4个百分点，3,000条时优势保持；无需fact ID即可解决事实修订；MQuAKE多跳准确率提升7.5个百分点。8B–27B、四个模型家族的23项跨模型比较中21项显著；在10个模型-数据集单元中有9个优于三种近期上下文引导方法。
AI.conclusion: 记忆幻觉的核心是"内容正确但使用受控"的问题，而非单纯检索失败；通过在模型内部为文本记忆锚定一个可由编辑提供、由引导向量调控的地址，可有效抑制参数知识与外部记忆的冲突，并在大规模记忆库与多跳场景下保持优势。

title: Dynamic Forcing: Learning Action-Grounded Sparse Dynamic Representations with Dense Future Guidance for World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) support robot control through visual prediction, but dense future modeling repeatedly encodes static context already available in the current observation, while action-relevant changes are often spatially sparse. We study sparse dynamic representation learning, retaining the current observation as a contextual anchor and using a small set of compact dynamic tokens to represent anticipated changes. We develop CompactWAM, a sparse-dense joint predictive framework that enables sparse representation learning within a video-supervised shared backbone, without requiring a reconstruction objective for the sparse pathway. Since a limited token budget alone does not specify which information to retain, we introduce Dynamic Forcing, which pairs direct action supervision with privileged dense future guidance to promote action relevance and dynamic fidelity. While action prediction gradients directly drive compact tokens to capture control-relevant cues, dense future guidance further shapes them via action functional guidance that matches sparse and dense contributions to the action expert, and dynamics-aware distribution matching, which aligns temporal relational changes relative to a static reference. At inference, a single visual forward pass encodes current observations and compact dynamic tokens for action generation, eliminating dense future modeling. CompactWAM achieves 98.4\% success on LIBERO and 77.9\% on LIBERO-Plus, retaining respective success rates of 98.3\% and 76.6\% with only 9.2\% of the dense future token budget. Evaluations on RoboTwin~2.0 and real-world manipulation further demonstrate the effectiveness of the learned sparse predictive representations.

AI.tldr: CompactWAM：以当前观测为上下文锚点、用少量动态token表示未来变化，通过"动态强制"（动作监督+特权稠密未来引导）在视频监督共享主干中学习稀疏动态表示；推理时仅一次视觉前向即可生成动作，LIBERO 98.4%、LIBERO-Plus 77.9%，仅用9.2%稠密未来token预算仍保持98.3%/76.6%。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAM）通过视觉预测支持机器人控制，但稠密未来建模会重复编码当前观测中已有的静态上下文，而与动作相关的变化在空间上往往稀疏，导致计算冗余与表示低效。
AI.method: 提出稀疏-稠密联合预测框架CompactWAM：保留当前观测作为上下文锚点，用紧凑动态token表示预期变化，并在视频监督的共享主干内实现稀疏路径学习，无需为稀疏路径设计重建目标。为解决"token预算有限但未指定保留何种信息"的问题，引入Dynamic Forcing：将直接动作监督与特权稠密未来引导相结合——动作预测梯度直接驱动紧凑token捕捉控制相关线索，稠密未来引导通过动作功能引导（对齐稀疏与稠密对动作专家的贡献）和动态感知分布匹配（以静态参考对齐时序关系变化）进一步塑造token。推理时单次视觉前向编码当前观测与紧凑token进行动作生成，去除稠密未来建模。
AI.result: LIBERO成功率98.4%，LIBERO-Plus 77.9%；仅使用9.2%的稠密未来token预算时分别保持98.3%与76.6%。在RoboTwin 2.0及真实世界操作任务上的评估进一步验证了所学稀疏预测表示的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏动态表示可在不进行稠密未来重建的条件下有效替代稠密未来建模，显著降低推理与表示开销并保持高控制性能，具备仿真与真实场景的泛化能力。

title: SOC-Net: Second-Order-Cone-Constrained Neural Networks
summary: In many applications, neural networks must learn input-output maps that respect prior knowledge such as physical laws, safety requirements, and operating limits. These requirements constrain which outputs are admissible for a given input and often admit second-order cone (SOC) representations, including norm bounds and robust linear inequalities. Examples in control include friction cones, thrust bounds, and input-robust control barrier function (CBF) conditions. However, existing approaches to enforcing general input-dependent SOC constraints require a conic solver, an iterative scheme whose feasibility depends on convergence, or an interior feasible point for each input. We propose SOC-Net, a neural network architecture that enforces input-dependent SOC constraints by construction for every input, even outside the training distribution. SOC-Net projects an affine lifting of the backbone output onto the reachable slice of a fixed product of Lorentz cones and maps the correction back to the output space. For separable constraints, this projection splits into one projection per cone, and each is available in closed form or reduces to a single scalar equation, regardless of the cone dimension. We prove that SOC-Net retains the expressive power of the backbone network under regularity conditions and accommodates end-to-end training by standard backpropagation with an explicit Jacobian. Experiments on contact force allocation with friction constraints and 3-D obstacle avoidance with an input-robust CBF demonstrate that SOC-Net satisfies the constraints at every evaluated input, with lower evaluation latency than the tested solver-based and iterative baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出SOC-Net：一种神经网络架构，通过将主干输出的仿射提升投影到固定Lorentz锥积的可达切片上，实现输入相关的二阶锥(SOC)约束在构造上对任意输入（含分布外）严格满足，并支持端到端训练。
AI.motivation: 许多应用中神经网络需满足物理定律、安全要求、运行限值等先验知识，这些约束常可表示为二阶锥(SOC)形式（如范数界、鲁棒线性不等式），控制中的摩擦锥、推力界、输入鲁棒CBF条件均属此类。然而现有方法施加一般输入相关的SOC约束需要锥规划求解器、依赖收敛性的迭代方案，或需为每个输入提供内点可行解，存在效率与可行性保障问题。
AI.method: SOC-Net将主干网络输出的仿射提升投影到固定Lorentz锥积的可达切片上，并将修正量映射回输出空间。对可分离约束，投影可分解为每个锥上的独立投影，每个投影均有闭式解或化归为单个标量方程求解，且与锥维度无关。论文证明在正则条件下SOC-Net保持主干网络的表达能力，并给出显式Jacobian，从而可用标准反向传播进行端到端训练。
AI.result: 在带摩擦约束的接触力分配任务和带输入鲁棒CBF的三维避障任务上，SOC-Net在所有评估输入处均满足约束，且评估延迟低于所对比的基于求解器与迭代的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SOC-Net以构造方式保证输入相关SOC约束的严格满足，无需求解器或内点初始化，计算高效、可端到端训练且保持表达能力，适用于安全关键的控制学习任务。

title: ELMO: Emergent Representations In Imitation Learning Via Dynamic Hierarchical Action Chunking
summary: Robot trajectories naturally decompose into variable-length phases with distinct semantic intents, such as reaching, grasping, and lifting. However, training policies to minimize MSE treats all actions as equal, obscuring their semantic structure. While latent action models attempt to create a structured prediction target by compressing action chunks into latent representations, existing approaches rely on two-stage training and context-blind decoders. Consequently, their representations are context-agnostic motion codes (e.g., "move down") which fail to capture behavioural intent (e.g., "pick up the block"). To overcome these bottlenecks, we introduce the Emergent Latent-action MOdel (ELMO), an end-to-end framework that encodes robot trajectories as grounded semantic codes -- representations that ground task-level behavioural intent in the current environment. ELMO jointly trains a VLA planner and an observation-conditioned decoder over dynamically chunked trajectories, learning a semantically grounded action space without separate pretraining. Across standard benchmarks, ELMO outperforms comparable prior methods by 9.6 percentage points on LIBERO-Plus and by 0.75 in average task length on CALVIN. Furthermore, on Blocks -- our shortcut-free simulation and real-world generalization benchmark -- ELMO reaches a 38.6% success rate while all baselines remain below 5%, demonstrating its ability to capture the semantic structure of demonstrations. Website: https://uoft-isl.github.io/elmo.github.io/

AI.tldr: ELMO提出端到端框架，将机器人轨迹编码为"基础语义码"(grounded semantic codes)，联合训练VLA规划器与观测条件解码器，无需两阶段预训练即可学到语义化动作空间。
AI.motivation: 机器人轨迹由变长、具语义意图的阶段（如接近、抓取、抬升）组成，但MSE训练将所有动作等同对待，掩盖了语义结构。现有潜动作模型虽通过压缩动作块构造结构化目标，却依赖两阶段训练与上下文盲解码器，导致学到的只是上下文无关的"运动码"（如"向下移动"），无法表达"拿起方块"这类行为意图。
AI.method: 提出Emergent Latent-action MOdel (ELMO)：以动态分块的轨迹为输入，端到端联合训练视觉-语言-动作(VLA)规划器与观测条件解码器，使潜表示在当前环境中锚定任务级行为意图，从而在无独立预训练的情况下涌现语义化动作空间。
AI.result: 在标准基准上，LIBERO-Plus提升9.6个百分点，CALVIN平均任务长度提升0.75；在自建的Blocks基准（无捷径的仿真与真实世界泛化测试）上达到38.6%成功率，而所有基线均低于5%。
AI.conclusion: ELMO通过端到端、观测条件的语义潜动作建模，有效捕捉演示中的语义结构，在仿真与真实泛化场景显著优于既有方法。

title: Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent: Self-Structuring Learning through Question Answering
summary: We consider the problem of constructing knowledge bases for applications based on large language models, in which the structure of a knowledge base determines how an application can retrieve and connect the information needed to answer a question. We study Self-Structuring Learning, a setting in which questions and expected answers guide the construction of a persistent knowledge base whose editable structure can be a graph schema or the organization of linked knowledge documents. We propose Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent, which diagnoses discrepancies between expected answers and responses obtained through the current knowledge base. At each round, the method proposes a structural edit, rebuilds the knowledge base, and adopts the edit when the learning loss decreases. The retained structure is evaluated on other questions about the same sources. By randomizing over candidate edits, we express the loss change of an edit as a derivative with respect to the probability of selecting it, and we evaluate joint edits as single candidates because their changes interact. Schema Descent instantiates the method for graph schemas. In experiments on large documents, each a bundle of research papers, the updated knowledge cards and graph schemas obtain higher mean Answer F1 on held-out generated questions than their initial structures, with schema gains in every document. On human questions, mean F1 rises for schemas and falls for cards: the updated structures serve the kind of question they were learned from.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"自结构化学习"（Self-Structuring Learning）设定与"知识库梯度下降"（Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent）方法，通过问答反馈迭代编辑知识库的持久化结构（图模式或链接式知识文档组织），在大型文档（研究论文集合）上提升了答案F1。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的应用依赖知识库的结构来决定如何检索与连接回答所需信息，即结构本身直接决定应用能力。然而现有知识库结构多为人工预先设定，不随下游问答需求自适应优化，因此需要研究如何让问题与期望答案反过来指导知识库结构的构建。
AI.method: 提出Self-Structuring Learning设定：问题与期望答案指导持久化知识库的构建，其可编辑结构可以是图模式或链接式知识文档的组织方式。核心方法为Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent：每轮诊断期望答案与当前知识库所得回答之间的差异，提出一个结构编辑、重建知识库，当学习损失下降时采纳该编辑；对候选编辑做随机化，将编辑引起的损失变化表示为对该编辑被选中概率的导数；由于联合编辑之间存在相互作用，将其作为单一候选整体评估。Schema Descent是该方法的图模式实例化。
AI.result: 在大型文档（每份为研究论文集合）实验上，更新后的知识卡与图模式在留出生成问题上获得更高平均Answer F1，且每份文档的模式均有增益。在人类问题上，模式的平均F1上升而知识卡下降，说明更新后的结构服务于其学习来源的那类问题。
AI.conclusion: 知识库结构可通过问答驱动的迭代编辑被有效学习与优化；结构收益具有问题类型依赖性，即结构会向训练问题分布特化，需在应用中权衡生成问题与人类问题的泛化。

title: EvoVAU: Tool Evolution for Video Anomaly Understanding
summary: Video anomaly understanding (VAU) requires reasoning about event progression, interactions, and the contextual conditions that distinguish abnormal behavior from common activity across diverse scenes. Although video agents enable multi-round analysis, the predefined analytical operations may not adequately satisfy these diverse reasoning demands. In this paper, we present EvoVAU, a framework that evolves a reusable tool library for a frozen video solver. Guided by task outcomes and execution trajectories, an external proposer identifies potential limitations in the library and refines it, retaining task experience as analytical operations that can be reused across questions. Specifically, Cross-Version Contrastive Feedback guides tool refinement by combining current errors with paired execution trajectories from historical corrections and regressions. Adoption-Aware Selection accepts a candidate library only when overall development-set accuracy improves and corrections outnumber regressions among questions on which the solver invokes new or modified tools. Using a small development set, EvoVAU alternates tool refinement with candidate evaluation and selection. At test time, the evolved library remains fixed, with no further involvement from the proposer. Experiments on several VAU benchmarks demonstrate strong performance and the flexibility of the evolved library across anomaly domains.

AI.tldr: EvoVAU 提出一种面向冻结视频求解器的可自演化工具库框架，通过外部提议器在小型开发集上迭代精炼工具库，并以跨版本对比反馈与采纳感知选择保证改进，测试时工具库固定不变，在多个视频异常理解基准上取得强劲性能。
AI.motivation: 视频异常理解（VAU）需要推理事件演进、交互以及区分异常与常见活动的上下文条件，场景多样、需求复杂。视频智能体虽支持多轮分析，但其预定义的分析操作难以充分满足这些多样的推理需求，因此需要一个能随任务经验自我演进的分析工具库。
AI.method: 1）框架 EvoVAU：为冻结的视频求解器演化一个可复用工具库，由外部提议器依据任务结果与执行轨迹识别工具库的潜在局限并加以精炼，将任务经验沉淀为可跨问题复用的分析操作。2）跨版本对比反馈（Cross-Version Contrastive Feedback）：将当前错误与历史"纠正"和"退化"轨迹配对，指导工具精炼。3）采纳感知选择（Adoption-Aware Selection）：仅当开发集整体准确率提升、且在求解器调用新增或修改工具的问题上纠正数多于退化数时，才采纳候选工具库。4）使用小型开发集交替进行工具精炼与候选评估选择；测试阶段工具库保持固定，提议器不再参与。
AI.result: 在多个 VAU 基准上的实验表明该方法性能强劲，且演化得到的工具库能灵活适配不同异常领域。
AI.conclusion: 通过将工具库演化与求解器解耦，并在测试时冻结工具库，EvoVAU 以较低成本实现了对多样异常推理需求的自适应覆盖，验证了"经验化工具库演化"范式的有效性；未来可进一步关注演化效率与跨域泛化的稳定性。

title: When High Capacity Becomes Undeployable: Pore-Filling Constraints for Multi-Objective Optimization of Direct Air Capture Sorbents
summary: Amine-impregnated sorbents with the highest nominal CO2 capacity are frequently the least deployable, as amine beyond the pore-volume limit blocks active sites. Yet multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) for direct air capture (DAC) treats formulation search as unconstrained. We encode the pore-filling boundary as an explicit outcome constraint, c(x) = tanh(1 - phi_hat) - tau, and use it as a diagnostic instrument on a hand-curated, DOI-traceable benchmark of 618 solid-amine formulations from 43 publications. Unconstrained MOBO attains higher nominal capacity (3.639 +/- 0.815 vs. 2.964 +/- 0.728 mmol/g, p = 1.0e-11), but across 100 seeds 63.2% of its Pareto-optimal candidates violate the pore-filling boundary versus 39.3% under the constraint: it is rewarded for proposing candidates outside the pore-confined design regime. The constraint steers the front to lower loadings (55.8 vs. 65.2 wt%) and larger pores. The boundary is corroborated once apparatus effects are harmonized hierarchically: 77.8% of kinetic variance is between-laboratory, and pore filling carries a significant kinetic penalty (p = 0.002). Standard hypervolume over-credits feasibility-agnostic methods by 13.9-16.1% (vs. 11.1% constrained), and three surrogate-based analyses---the constrained front, a regeneration-energy third objective, and harmonized kinetics---consistently point to a conservative deployable window at pore filling phi_hat ~ 0.4-0.5 (45-55 wt% loading). The benchmark and associated analysis outputs accompany this submission.

AI.tldr: 将孔填充边界作为显式结果约束纳入固体胺DAC配方的多目标贝叶斯优化，可避免优化器被"名义容量最高但不可部署"的候选所奖励。
AI.motivation: 胺浸渍吸附剂中，超过孔体积上限的胺会堵塞活性位点，使名义CO2容量最高的配方往往最不可部署；然而面向直接空气捕集（DAC）的多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）通常把配方搜索当作无约束问题处理。
AI.method: 构建含618个固体胺配方、来自43篇文献、DOI可追溯的人工整理基准数据集；将孔填充边界编码为显式结果约束 c(x)=tanh(1-φ̂)-τ；对比约束与无约束MOBO（100个随机种子），并分层协调装置效应分析动力学、引入再生能耗作为第三目标，以及用超体积指标评估。
AI.result: 无约束MOBO名义容量更高（3.639±0.815 vs 2.964±0.728 mmol/g，p=1.0e-11），但其Pareto最优候选中63.2%违反孔填充边界，约束下为39.3%；约束使最优前沿转向更低负载（55.8 vs 65.2 wt%）与更大孔径。77.8%的动力学方差来自实验室间差异，孔填充带来显著动力学代价（p=0.002）。标准超体积对不考虑可行性的方法高估13.9–16.1%（约束下为11.1%）。
AI.conclusion: 约束前沿、再生能耗第三目标与协调后动力学三项代理分析一致指向保守可部署窗口：孔填充度φ̂≈0.4–0.5（负载45–55 wt%）。基准数据集与分析输出随文公开。

title: How Well Do Vision-Language Scene Graphs Serve as Memory for Embodied Question Answering?
comment: Accepted at the HOUR workshop, WACV 2027 (non-archival). 16 pages (4-page main paper, references, supplementary material), 9 figures, 22 tables. Divyansh Pandey and Shubh Garg contributed equally
summary: Embodied QA needs memory, but answer accuracy mixes retained evidence, reading errors and question priors. For a simulated multi-room scene-graph pipeline we define answerability: the fraction of questions a fixed rule-based reader answers correctly from the graph alone. The baseline recovers 24.1% of visible object types and its room labels flicker. Four targeted repairs double recall, raise answerability from 27.2% to 37.4%, and improve retrained QA from 71.4% to 75.9%, yet better object F1 can lower answerability. A question-type prior beats this reader on every predicted graph. In one real-video test, graph memory lowers accuracy. These exploratory findings favour scoring retained evidence alongside accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出"可答性"(answerability)指标——固定规则阅读器仅凭场景图能正确回答的问题比例，用以把"保留证据""阅读错误""问题先验"从端到端准确率中解耦；在模拟多房间场景图流水线上，四项定向修复使可答性由27.2%升至37.4%，重训QA由71.4%升至75.9%。
AI.motivation: 具身问答(Embodied QA)依赖记忆，但端到端答案准确率混合了三类因素：记忆中保留的证据、阅读器的理解误差、以及问题先验(question priors)。仅看准确率无法判断性能瓶颈来自记忆质量还是推理环节，因此需要一个只衡量"记忆中保留证据是否足以支撑回答"的独立度量。
AI.method: 在模拟多房间场景图(scene-graph)流水线上定义可答性：用一个固定的规则式阅读器(rule-based reader)，仅基于场景图作答，统计其答对的问题比例。基线仅能召回24.1%的可见物体类型，且房间标签出现闪烁(flicker)。作者据此设计四项针对性修复(针对物体召回与房间标签稳定性)。另以问题类型先验(question-type prior)作为对照，并在一个真实视频案例上做检验。
AI.result: 四项修复使物体召回翻倍；可答性从27.2%提升到37.4%；重训后的QA准确率从71.4%提升到75.9%。但发现更好的物体F1有时会降低可答性(指标不一致)。问题类型先验在每一个预测图上都优于该规则阅读器，说明准确率可被先验"虚高"。在一个真实视频测试中，图记忆反而降低了准确率。
AI.conclusion: 这些探索性发现表明，应把"保留证据的评分"与端到端准确率并列评估，而非仅依赖答案准确率；物体检测指标(F1)与可答性并不单调一致，问题先验会掩盖记忆缺陷，真实视频上的负迁移提示模拟结论需谨慎外推。

title: Probabilistic Monocular Biomechanical Reconstruction via Guided Flow Matching
summary: Reconstructing 3D joint kinematics from a single video is ill-posed due to depth and stature ambiguity, limb occlusion, and missing uncertainty estimates. We introduce the Biomechanical Flow Model (BFM), a continuous-time flow-matching prior over subject anthropometry, anatomical joint-angle trajectories, and virtual markers, trained on multi-camera clinical recordings from 565 participants and steered toward monocular 2D keypoints at test time without paired video training. In a head-to-head comparison on the same clinical trials against a state-of-the-art deterministic trajectory optimizer fitting the identical skeleton, BFM achieves comparable joint-angle accuracy across walking and timed-up-and-go (TUG). Across held-out control, prosthetic, and neurologic participants, BFM reaches 3.91 deg and 4.97 deg mean absolute joint-angle error on walking and TUG while providing credible intervals that bridge temporal and whole-limb occlusions. Where keypoints are hidden, the intervals widen with the error and keep their coverage near nominal. Supplying individual anthropometric calibration removes most monocular pelvis depth error, whereas testing on out-of-distribution pediatric crouch gait produces biased, overconfident extension predictions, highlighting the need for pathologically diverse movement priors.

AI.tldr: 提出生物力学流模型(BFM)：基于565名受试者多相机临床数据训练的连续时间流匹配先验，联合建模人体测量学、关节角轨迹与虚拟标记，测试时由单目2D关键点引导，实现带可信区间的单目3D关节运动学重建。
AI.motivation: 单目视频重建3D关节运动学本质上是病态问题：深度与身高(尺度)歧义、肢体遮挡、以及缺乏不确定性估计。现有确定性轨迹优化器只给出点估计，无法在遮挡下量化置信度。
AI.method: 构建生物力学流模型(BFM)：在受试者人体测量参数、解剖学关节角轨迹和虚拟标记构成的空间上学习连续时间流匹配先验；训练数据为565名参与者的多相机临床记录，无需配对视频；测试时以单目2D关键点为条件引导生成，不使用配对视频微调。与拟合同一骨架的SOTA确定性轨迹优化器在同一临床试次上做正面对比。
AI.result: 在步行与起立-行走测试(TUG)上，BFM关节角精度与SOTA确定性优化器相当；在留出的对照、假肢与神经科受试者上，步行与TUG的平均绝对关节角误差分别为3.91°和4.97°，并能给出跨越时间与整肢遮挡的可信区间；关键点被遮挡时间隔随误差增大而变宽并保持接近名义覆盖率；加入个体人体测量标定可消除大部分单目骨盆深度误差；但在分布外的儿童蹲伏步态上出现有偏且过度自信的伸展预测。
AI.conclusion: 生成式流匹配先验可在不依赖配对视频的情况下实现与确定性优化相当的单目生物力学重建，并提供有意义的不确定性量化；其局限在于对分布外病理步态泛化不足，说明需要病理多样性更充分的运动先验与更可靠的校准机制。

title: Cell-Type-Specific Expression Is Hard to Predict from Bulk, but It Is Still Useful
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD). 5 pages main text, 28 pages total
summary: Single-cell-informed deconvolution provides cell-type-resolved features for clinical bulk RNA cohorts. Most existing methods predict the proportions $π_k$ of the $K$ constituent cell types (CTs). Fewer predict cell-type-specific expression (CTSE) $μ_{kg}$ of gene $g$ in CT $k$, which can capture cell states that proportions miss, but recent benchmarks find it much harder. We explain this gap with closed-form accuracy bounds. For CTSE, we derive an $R^2$ ceiling for per-gene linear estimators. For proportions, the best linear estimator, which pools evidence across genes, has a closed-form $R^2$, and a computable lower bound on it predicts which CTs are learnable. We study targeted deconvolution of 106 biologically curated (CT, gene) pairs, found post hoc to have higher learnability scores. On overall survival in non-small cell lung cancer, estimation difficulty does not predict prognostic value across these targets. Yet a sparse survival model on deconvolved features, mostly CTSE, predicts survival as well as a sparse model on the bulk genes themselves, while attributing its signal to specific cell types. Some deconvolved CTSE features reveal prognostic signal not seen in the corresponding bulk gene.

AI.tldr: 本文用闭式误差界解释了为何细胞类型特异表达（CTSE）反卷积比比例估计更难，并在106个精选（细胞类型, 基因）靶标上验证后，发现估计难度不预测预后价值，而稀疏生存模型可达到与bulk基因模型相当的预测性能并提供细胞类型层面的可解释归因。
AI.motivation: 单细胞驱动的反卷积可为临床bulk RNA队列提供细胞类型分辨的特征。现有方法多估计细胞类型比例π_k，较少估计细胞类型特异表达μ_kg；后者能捕捉比例所遗漏的细胞状态，但近期基准显示其难度显著更高，该性能差距缺乏理论解释。
AI.method: 推导闭式精度界：对CTSE给出逐基因线性估计器的R²上界；对比例则给出跨基因汇聚信息的最优线性估计器的闭式R²，并构造可计算的下界以预判哪些细胞类型可学习。在此基础上开展靶向反卷积，针对106个经生物学策展的(细胞类型, 基因)对（事后筛选出可学习性得分较高者）；在非小细胞肺癌总生存数据上，用反卷积特征构建稀疏生存模型，并与bulk基因稀疏模型比较。
AI.result: 理论界刻画了CTSE与比例估计的可学习性差异。在NSCLC总生存分析中，估计难度并不能预测这些靶标的预后价值；以CTSE为主的稀疏生存模型预测性能与bulk基因稀疏模型相当，同时可将信号归因于具体细胞类型；部分CTSE特征揭示了对应bulk基因中未观察到的预后信号。
AI.conclusion: 反卷积CTSE的固有精度上限解释了其相对比例估计的困难，但估计难度不等于临床价值。靶向反卷积特征在保持与bulk基因相当预测性能的同时提供细胞类型层面解释性，并能发掘bulk层面被掩盖的预后信号，支持其在临床队列分析中的实用价值。

title: SOLVE: Sparse, Ordered Keyposes Make LLM Agents Versatile and Efficient Robot Manipulator
summary: LLM agents have made remarkable progress in robot manipulation, yet they suffer from expensive inference, dense step-by-step control, and tool bottlenecks. We introduce SOLVE, a training-free, versatile and efficient agent policy: a multimodal LLM agent writes a sparse, ordered sequence of 6-DoF end-effector keyposes per call, observes the result, and writes the next, while a motion planner interpolates between them. The agent decides the number and spacing of keyposes for both fast long-range motion and fine-grained manipulation. This granularity matches the sparsity of teleoperated manipulation: most demonstrations in DROID can be compressed into a few keyposes instead of dense actions. SOLVE grounds keyposes with sparse depth queries answered by noisy sources, such as multi-view triangulation, stereo, or monocular depth, and copes with that noise itself. It also improves from execution feedback, reflecting on its own rollouts and distilling a few rules per task. SOLVE reaches state-of-the-art performance of 74.5% on RoboDojo and 84.5% on RoboLab, with only $1.7 per episode on average, 12x less than previous dense-control agent policies. On a real robot, the same agent achieves an 88% success rate (75 of 85 episodes) over 16 challenging zero-shot tasks. Our project page is at https://serenos.github.io/solve-website.

AI.tldr: SOLVE 是一种无需训练的 LLM agent 策略，通过输出稀疏有序的 6-DoF 末端关键位姿序列、由运动规划器插值，并结合稀疏深度查询与执行反馈自改进，在仿真与真机上以更低成本取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM agent 在机器人操作中存在推理开销大、逐步稠密控制、工具瓶颈等问题，需要更高效且通用的策略。
AI.method: 多模态 LLM agent 每次调用写出稀疏、有序的 6-DoF 末端关键位姿序列，观察结果后再写下一批；运动规划器在关键位姿间插值；agent 自行决定关键位姿的数量与间距以兼顾长距离运动与精细操作。关键位姿通过稀疏深度查询进行定位，深度来源可为多视角三角化、双目或单目深度等含噪源，并由 agent 自行处理噪声；同时通过反思自身 rollout 并为每个任务蒸馏少量规则，从执行反馈中改进。
AI.result: RoboDojo 上 74.5%，RoboLab 上 84.5%，平均每回合仅 1.7 美元，比以往稠密控制 agent 策略低 12 倍；真机上 16 个高难度零样本任务达成 88% 成功率（85 回合中成功 75 次）。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏关键位姿的粒度与遥操作演示的稀疏性相匹配（DROID 中多数演示可压缩为少量关键位姿而非稠密动作），证明该范式在通用性、效率与性能上优于稠密控制方案。

title: FlipVLA: Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language-Action(VLA) Models Only Through Bit Flips
comment: 14 pages, including references and supplementary material
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions in real-world environments, making malicious model tampering a potential threat to physical safety. We study whether object-triggered backdoors can be implanted through a small, fixed set of parameter bit flips without retraining. The central challenge is to make persistent weight modifications disrupt trigger-present behavior while preserving performance on non-trigger inputs. We propose FlipVLA, a two-stage selector-amplifier method that exploits existing visual features within an FC-GELU-FC structure. The selector constructs a trigger-dependent response in a selected channel, using GELU to attenuate background activity. The amplifier modifies a connected downstream weight to convert this response into an action-relevant perturbation. Channel screening and discrete bit search construct both components under a limited modification budget. Experiments on OpenVLA-OFT and GR00T N1.7 across four LIBERO suites achieve attack success rates of 90.22% to 100%, with task success decreasing by at most 1.5 percentage points on clean scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出FlipVLA，一种两阶段"选择器—放大器"方法，可在不重训练的情况下仅通过少量固定的参数位翻转，向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型植入物体触发的后门攻击。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在真实物理环境中由视觉观测和语言指令生成机器人动作，恶意模型篡改会威胁物理安全。作者研究能否在无需重训练的条件下，用少量固定参数位翻转植入物体触发后门。核心难点在于：持续性的权重修改既要破坏含触发输入的行为，又要保持非触发输入的性能。
AI.method: FlipVLA采用两阶段选择器—放大器框架，利用FC-GELU-FC结构中已有的视觉特征：选择器在选定通道中构造依赖触发的响应，并借助GELU抑制背景激活；放大器修改相连的下游权重，将该响应转化为与动作相关的扰动；再通过通道筛选与离散位搜索，在有限修改预算下共同构造两个组件。
AI.result: 在OpenVLA-OFT与GR00T N1.7上、跨四个LIBERO套件，攻击成功率达90.22%–100%，干净场景下任务成功率最多下降1.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 表明VLA模型存在可通过极少量位翻转植入的物理安全相关后门风险，且该攻击在高效性的同时保持了干净场景性能，凸显了VLA部署中的权重完整性防护需求。

title: Text-Conditioned Low-Rank Adaptation of Time-Series Foundation Models for Multimodal Forecasting
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems: From Forecasting to World Modeling (FMTS 2026)
summary: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) provide transferable numerical forecasting priors. However, forecast-relevant information may be conveyed in text without being reflected in the observed series. Many multimodal forecasting methods integrate such context through model inputs or intermediate representations. We investigate a complementary mechanism: text-conditioned parameter adaptation. We propose Context-to-LoRA for Time Series (C2LoRA-TS), which encodes text and generates temporary Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) updates for selected weight matrices of a frozen TSFM. Both the numerical backbone and text encoder remain frozen, and the method exactly recovers the frozen TSFM output when context is absent. Evaluated on Time-MMD across nine domains and three TSFM architectures, C2LoRA-TS achieves lower aggregate forecasting error than the frozen-TSFM and Static LoRA baselines for every architecture and seed. Replacing the instance-specific text with a single globally fixed context degrades performance for every architecture. These results support text-conditioned parameter generation as a viable strategy for multimodal forecasting with frozen TSFMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 C2LoRA-TS，通过文本编码生成临时 LoRA 权重更新来对冻结的时序基础模型做文本条件化适配，在 Time-MMD 九个领域、三种架构上均优于冻结基线，且性能依赖实例级文本。
AI.motivation: 时序基础模型虽提供可迁移的数值预测先验，但部分与预测相关的信息只存在于文本中、未反映在观测序列里。现有多模态预测方法多通过模型输入或中间表示注入上下文，作者希望探索一种互补机制：以文本为条件直接对参数进行适配。
AI.method: 提出 C2LoRA-TS：用文本编码器编码上下文，并据此生成临时性的低秩适配（LoRA）更新，作用于冻结 TSFM 中选定的权重矩阵；数值主干与文本编码器均保持冻结，且当上下文缺失时能精确还原冻结 TSFM 的输出。
AI.result: 在 Time-MMD 的九个领域及三种 TSFM 架构上，C2LoRA-TS 在每个架构、每个随机种子下的总体预测误差均低于冻结 TSFM 与 Static LoRA 基线；将实例级文本替换为单一全局固定上下文后，所有架构性能均下降。
AI.conclusion: 文本条件化参数生成是使用冻结时序基础模型进行多模态预测的一种可行策略，且增益来自实例级、动态生成的上下文条件而非静态文本注入。

title: Anytime-Valid Sequential Verification for Sensing-Efficient Robot Navigation under Perception Uncertainty
summary: When a robot navigates an unfamiliar grid, noisy sensor readings can make it hard to tell whether the cells along its next move are free. Additional scans can reduce that uncertainty, but a fixed scan count spends the same sensing effort at every position. In a static-grid simulation, a sequential rule uses a Gaussian likelihood ratio to determine when the cells newly covered by the robot's footprint have enough evidence of free space. On 324 held-out scenarios from 18 public maps, the sequential gate and a four-scan reference chosen on validation data both completed every mission without an observed collision. With their respective validation-selected routing weights, the gate averaged 123.15 scans per episode versus 224.13 for the reference, a reduction of 45.05% (95% map-stratified bootstrap interval: 42.21--48.95%). In a retrospective check on the same scenarios with routing weights held equal, the reductions were 43.91% and 43.37% at the two tested weights, with all missions completed. On 216 scenarios from 12 previously unused maps, allocating more of the same certification error budget near the initial start--goal rectangle cut the sequential gate's scan count by a further 11.58%. The spatial variant completed 206 missions versus 208 for the original gate and increased computation time. The collision bound depends on the assumed observation model and footprint geometry. In a stress test with persistent per-cell bias, the original gate completed 0 of 54 missions.

AI.tldr: 提出基于高斯似然比的序贯传感器门控规则，按需决定对机器人足迹新覆盖栅格的自由空间证据是否充分，从而在静态栅格仿真中大幅降低每回合扫描次数并保持零碰撞完成任务。
AI.motivation: 机器人于陌生栅格中导航时，传感器噪声使"下一段路径栅格是否自由"难以判断；增加扫描可降低不确定性，但固定扫描次数在所有位置投入相同感知开销，存在浪费，需按位置自适应分配感知努力。
AI.method: 在静态栅格仿真中，采用高斯似然比的序贯规则，对机器人足迹新覆盖的单元累计自由空间证据，达到证据阈值即停止扫描；与验证集选出的四次扫描参考策略对比，并考察"路由权重"与"把更多认证误差预算分配到起点—终点矩形附近"的空间变体。
AI.result: 在18张公开地图的324个留出场景上，序贯门控与四次扫描参考均零碰撞完成全部任务；按各自验证集所选路由权重，门控平均123.15次扫描/回合 vs 参考224.13次，降低45.05%（95%地图分层自助区间42.21–48.95%）。等权回溯检验下两个权重处降低43.91%与43.37%，任务全部完成。在12张未使用地图的216个场景中，将更多认证误差预算分配到起点—终点矩形附近使扫描数再降11.58%；空间变体完成206次任务（原门控208次）且计算时间增加。碰撞界依赖观测模型与足迹几何假设；在持续逐单元偏置的压力测试中，原门控54次任务完成0次。
AI.conclusion: 序贯证据门控可在保持零碰撞的同时显著减少扫描开销且具跨地图泛化性，但性能与安全性依赖观测模型假设；失效于持续偏置噪声，空间加权变体收益有限且代价更高。

title: MMotion: Collaborative Cross-Scale Memory for Text-to-Motion Generation
summary: Text-to-motion generation aims to synthesize realistic human motions from natural-language descriptions, enabling applications in animation, virtual avatars, and embodied agents. Despite recent progress, existing methods either retrieve motion exemplars or retain long-range context, but rarely exploit memory to jointly reason about semantics, dynamics, and generation history. In this paper, we propose MMotion, a collaborative multi-scale memory framework that unifies scale-conditioned semantic retrieval, latent dynamics modeling, and causal working memory. Specifically, semantic memory provides motion priors at different generation scales, dynamics memory captures latent state transitions, and working memory preserves causal context from previously generated motions. A collaborative fusion mechanism integrates these complementary memories to determine what motion to generate, how it should evolve, and how it should remain consistent with its history. MMotion is architecture-agnostic and can be readily integrated into both diffusion-based and next scale autoregressive models. Extensive experiments across standard benchmarks and diverse backbones demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出MMotion——一种协同多尺度记忆框架，统一尺度条件语义检索、潜在动力学建模与因果工作记忆，集成多种骨干网络以提升文本到动作生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到动作生成方法要么检索动作样例，要么保留长程上下文，却很少利用记忆来联合推理语义、动力学与生成历史，导致三者信息割裂。
AI.method: 设计三类记忆：语义记忆在不同生成尺度提供动作先验；动力学记忆捕捉潜在状态转移；工作记忆保存已生成动作的因果上下文；再通过协同融合机制整合互补记忆，决定生成何种动作、如何演化、如何与历史保持一致。框架与架构无关，可接入扩散模型与下一尺度自回归模型。
AI.result: 在标准基准与多种骨干网络上进行大量实验，相较强基线取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度记忆的协同利用能有效统一语义、动力学与历史一致性，且具备良好的通用性与可插拔性。

title: Compute-Aware Submodular Online Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
summary: This paper studies policy learning for cooperative task allocation in open multi-agent systems, where submodular utilities model diminishing marginal returns due to overlapping agent contributions. While standard methods evaluate every candidate action to update the policy, this may incur an excessive computational cost online. Hence, we impose a budget on these evaluations and analytically study the effect of query budget on online learning. Our algorithm samples a prescribed number of agent-action pairs and applies inverse-probability weighting to their marginal gains, yielding an unbiased gradient estimate of the expected stage utility for a Kullback-Leibler (KL) mirror-ascent update. We derive a $1/2$-approximate regret bound that elegantly splits into a tracking error between optimal and learned policies, quantified by their KL divergence, and a query-dependent feedback term. Experiments on cooperative information coverage show that our approach retains high performance with significantly less computation online.

AI.tldr: 本文研究开放多智能体系统中基于子模效用的协作任务分配策略学习，在在线查询预算约束下提出基于逆概率加权的无偏梯度估计方法，并给出1/2近似遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 开放多智能体系统中，智能体贡献存在重叠导致边际收益递减，可用子模效用建模。但标准策略学习方法需对每个候选动作逐一评估以更新策略，在线计算开销过大，因此需要对评估次数施加预算，并分析预算对在线学习的影响。
AI.method: 对智能体-动作对按预定数量采样，对采样到的边际增益施加逆概率加权（inverse-probability weighting），从而得到期望阶段效用的无偏梯度估计，并用于KL镜像上升（KL mirror-ascent）策略更新。
AI.result: 推导出1/2近似遗憾界，该界分解为两部分：最优策略与学习策略之间由KL散度刻度的跟踪误差，以及依赖查询次数的反馈项。在协作信息覆盖任务上的实验表明，该方法在显著降低在线计算量的同时保持高性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过采样加逆概率加权可在有限查询预算下获得无偏梯度估计，查询预算对学习性能的影响可通过跟踪误差与反馈项显式刻画，说明在开放多智能体协作任务分配中可大幅节省在线计算而不牺牲性能。
