title: Toward Agentic Robotics: A Large-Scale Study of Harness Design for Robot-Use Agents
summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) can act as robot-use agents that understand diverse scenes and control robots through policy code and tools. However, they predict 3D gripper poses poorly even with extended reasoning, struggling with precise manipulation. Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action (WAM) models are the opposite: they execute fast, smooth control on trained tasks, yet fail under domain shifts or when tasks require long-horizon memory and reasoning. Agentic robots therefore combine VLM reasoning and perception with precise VLA/WAM control through a policy harness. Yet harness design spans thousands of configurations, shifting success by tens of points with the same models. Moreover, testing even one design takes thousands of rollouts at high API and GPU cost, so prior works often commit to a single design chosen from few alternatives. To guide harness design, we evaluate over 470,000 rollouts across eight simulation benchmarks, six VLMs, and 15 VLA/WAM checkpoints. Seven controlled studies show effective harnesses must adapt to both VLM and VLA/WAM capabilities. Our findings specify what structure the VLM's policy code needs, where VLA manipulation needs help from tools and policy code, and when to involve the VLM at test time. The reference recipe X-Harness shows that these findings compose without weight updates, lifting base policies up to $+42.8$ points across memory, reasoning, and domain shifts.

AI.tldr: 大规模实证研究（47万+ rollouts）系统性剖析 agentic robot 中 VLM 与 VLA/WAM 的 policy harness 设计空间，提炼七项受控结论并给出无需权重更新的参考配方 X-Harness，最高带来 +42.8 个百分点提升。
AI.motivation: VLM 具备场景理解与推理能力但 3D 夹爪位姿预测差、精细操作弱；VLA/WAM 执行快而平滑但面对域偏移、长程记忆与推理任务失效。将二者通过 policy harness 结合的 agentic robot 是自然解法，但 harness 设计空间高达数千种配置，同一模型下成功率可相差数十点；而单次设计验证需数千次 rollout，API 与 GPU 成本高昂，导致既有工作往往只从少数候选中挑一个方案。因此亟需系统性理解 harness 应如何设计。
AI.method: 在八个仿真基准、六个 VLM、十五个 VLA/WAM checkpoint 上完成超过 470,000 次 rollout 评测；开展七项受控研究（controlled studies），分别考察 VLM policy code 的结构需求、VLA 操作何时需要工具与 policy code 辅助、以及测试时何时应调用 VLM；据此总结出参考配方 X-Harness。
AI.result: 七项受控研究表明：有效的 harness 必须同时适配 VLM 与 VLA/WAM 各自的能力边界。X-Harness 在无需权重更新的前提下，将各 base policy 在记忆、推理与域偏移三类场景上的表现最高提升 +42.8 点。
AI.conclusion: harness 设计是决定 agentic robot 性能的一阶因素而非实现细节，其效果取决于与模型能力匹配的结构化配置；这些设计原则可组合、可零训练迁移，为 VLM+VLA 混合系统提供了可复用的工程指导。

title: Revisiting Monocular In-Hand Object Scanning: Dataset, Pose Estimation, and Surface Reconstruction
summary: In-Hand Object Scanning (IHOS) from monocular video captured by a commodity smartphone holds immense potential to democratize 3D digitization for non-expert users, facilitating applications in digital archiving, augmented reality, and custom fabrication. Yet, IHOS remains largely understudied due to a lack of realistic datasets and systematic benchmarks. To bridge this gap, we introduce ToysRUs, a high-quality dataset featuring diverse figurines captured by 4K Ultra High-Definition (UHD) monocular videos. Studying IHOS from first principles, we examine structure-from-motion (SfM) for camera pose estimation, which is key to IHOS. We identify two key challenges: small baselines between consecutive frames, and sparse feature matches across large-view, long-range frames, further exacerbated by dynamic hand occlusions. Guided by these insights, we propose performing SfM on video sub-sequences sampled at sufficient angular intervals, and iteratively stitches the corresponding sub-trajectories into a unified global trajectory. Furthermore, for high-fidelity surface reconstruction, we introduce occlusion-aware 2D Gaussian Splatting, which incorporates opacity rendering and omits the opacity loss on hand regions. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms existing approaches, including neural implicit representations and 3D foundation models, in both geometric accuracy and photometric fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出ToysRUs数据集与一套手持物体扫描(In-Hand Object Scanning, IHOS)框架：基于角间隔采样子序列做SfM并迭代拼接全局轨迹，结合遮挡感知的2D高斯泼溅实现高保真重建。
AI.motivation: 单目智能手机视频手持物体扫描可推动3D数字化普及（数字存档、AR、定制制造），但缺乏真实数据集与系统基准，研究不足。作者从第一性原理出发分析SfM位姿估计这一关键环节，识别出两大挑战：相邻帧基线过小，以及大视角、长程帧间特征匹配稀疏，并被动态手部遮挡进一步恶化。
AI.method: 1) 构建ToysRUs数据集：4K UHD单目视频拍摄的多样小雕像；2) 对按足够角间隔采样的视频子序列分别执行SfM，并迭代将各子轨迹拼接为统一全局轨迹；3) 提出遮挡感知2D Gaussian Splatting，引入不透明度渲染并在手部区域省略不透明度损失，以缓解动态手部遮挡对表面重建的干扰。
AI.result: 定量与定性评估表明，该框架在几何精度与光度保真度上均显著优于现有方法，包括神经隐式表示与3D基础模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过合理的数据集设计与针对小基线、稀疏长程匹配及手部遮挡的分阶段SfM加遮挡感知2DGS方案，可在消费级手机单目视频上实现高质量手持物体扫描，为IHOS建立可复现的基准与强基线。

title: Change Point Detection with Generative Models
summary: Change point detection (CPD) methods aim to identify abrupt changes in the properties of time series, which is a key problem in numerous fields. A major class of CPD approaches relies on computing a CPD score, which is either a discrepancy or divergence between two subsequent samples, called windows. A fundamental limitation of window-based CPD is the 'sample size bottleneck.' To ensure temporal precision, windows must be small; however, small samples provide insufficient statistical evidence for the classifiers and deep-learning models currently used to compute CPD scores. This leads to high variance in the scores and frequent mispredictions. Our study tackles this issue by exploring generative models for window augmentation, effectively expanding available data to improve CPD quality. Experiments on synthetic and real data demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly enhances CPD. Specifically, we show that this approach allows simple classifiers to outperform complex deep-learning baselines by stabilizing the CPD score distribution.

AI.tldr: 提出用生成模型对滑动窗口进行数据增强，以缓解基于窗口的变点检测中的"样本量瓶颈"，稳定CPD得分分布，使简单分类器超越复杂深度学习基线。
AI.motivation: 基于窗口的变点检测（CPD）需计算相邻两窗口间的差异/散度得分。为保证时间精度，窗口必须很小，但小样本无法为当前用于计算CPD得分的分类器与深度模型提供充足统计证据，导致得分方差大、误判频繁——即"样本量瓶颈"。
AI.method: 将生成模型引入窗口增强（window augmentation），对可用窗口数据进行扩充，从而有效扩大样本量、提升CPD得分估计的稳定性。在合成数据与真实数据上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法显著提升CPD性能；通过稳定CPD得分分布，使简单分类器在性能上超过复杂的深度学习基线。
AI.conclusion: 窗口增强是缓解CPD样本量瓶颈的有效途径，数据层面（而非模型复杂度层面）的改进可替代重型深度模型，为小窗口高精度变点检测提供简洁方案。

title: Real2SimLab: A Unified Platform for Real-to-Simulation Transfer
summary: Real-to-simulation transfer, which builds simulations from real-world observations, has long been studied in research and industry. Recently, coding agents have become capable of generating simulation programs from video recordings, and several benchmarks have been proposed to evaluate them. However, each individual benchmark defines its own inputs, deliverables, and scoring pipeline. This leads to $N \times M$ integrations when evaluating $N$ methods on $M$ benchmarks. To this end, we present Real2SimLab, a unified platform for real-to-simulation transfer. It evaluates a method by running its written program and scoring the output simulation with the original scorer of each benchmark. Moreover, Real2SimLab provides a pipeline to create training data and reward annotations for real-to-simulation methods. Our pipeline carefully avoids data contamination by filtering out the video recordings that exist in benchmarks. For each video recording, a program is first produced, and then our pipeline computes its reward with the same code that Real2SimLab uses for evaluation. So far, it supports 47 coding agents and 5 non-agent methods on 6 benchmarks. Both the platform and Awesome-Real2Sim, our research map of nearly 300 real-to-simulation papers, are open source, and we invite the Real2SimHub community to build them together.

AI.tldr: 提出统一平台 Real2SimLab，将实到仿转移（real-to-simulation）方法与其所生成的仿真程序在多个基准上统一评测，复用各基准原生评分器，并提供训练数据与奖励标注生成流水线；目前已支持 47 个编码智能体与 5 个非智能体方法、6 个基准。
AI.motivation: 现有实到仿转移基准各自定义输入、交付物与评分流程，导致 N 个方法在 M 个基准上评测需要 N×M 次集成，评测碎片化、成本高，且缺乏统一的训练数据与奖励信号来源。
AI.method: Real2SimLab 以"运行方法输出的程序 + 用各基准原始评分器给输出仿真打分"为评测范式，实现一次集成、多基准复用；同时构建训练数据与奖励标注流水线：先过滤基准中已有的视频以避免数据污染，再对每条视频生成程序，并用与评测阶段完全相同的代码计算奖励。
AI.result: 平台已覆盖 6 个基准、47 个编码智能体与 5 个非智能体方法；开源发布平台代码及收录近 300 篇实到仿论文的研究图谱 Awesome-Real2Sim，并面向 Real2SimHub 社区开放共建。
AI.conclusion: 统一的执行—评分解耦设计显著降低了多方法多基准评测的集成开销，并保证训练奖励与评测口径一致、规避数据污染，为实到仿转移研究提供了可扩展的公共基础设施。

title: MotionODE: Enhancing Autoregressive Text-to-Motion Generation with Continuous-Depth Modeling
summary: Autoregressive text-to-motion generation requires local motion predictions to reconcile cross-temporal textual requirements with the available motion context. While existing methods primarily improve motion representations and generation order, the internal formation of conditioned motion representations remains less explored. We introduce MotionODE, a continuous-depth post-training framework that refines hidden-state evolution in pretrained autoregressive generators. MotionODE reinterprets selected Transformer residual branches as local vector fields and replaces their original updates with midpoint Runge--Kutta (RK2) integration, while preserving the motion representation and outer generation mechanism. To address the mismatch between pretrained update paths and newly introduced intermediate states, we propose mixed one-step/two-step RK2 post-training under motion-token supervision, with optional distillation and update-map constraints to preserve pretrained behavior. This minimally invasive framework supports both next-token and next-scale generation without training the generator from scratch. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D demonstrate consistent improvements in text--motion alignment across MoScale, BAMM and LMR, highlighting internal representation updates as a complementary direction for improving autoregressive motion generation.

AI.tldr: 提出MotionODE，一种连续深度后训练框架，将预训练自回归文本到动作生成器中部分Transformer残差分支重解释为局部向量场并用中点RK2积分替代原更新，在不从头训练的前提下改善文本-动作对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归文本到动作生成方法主要改进动作表示与生成顺序，而对条件动作表示的内部形成过程（隐状态演化）探索不足；同时，局部动作预测需在跨时序文本约束与可用动作上下文之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 将选定的Transformer残差分支视为局部向量场，以中点Runge–Kutta（RK2）积分替换其原始更新，保持动作表示与生成外层机制不变；针对预训练更新路径与新引入中间状态的不匹配，提出在动作token监督下的混合一步/两步RK2后训练，并可选地加入蒸馏与更新映射约束以保留预训练行为；框架微创，兼容next-token与next-scale两种生成范式，无需从零训练生成器。
AI.result: 在HumanML3D上的大量实验表明，在MoScale、BAMM与LMR上均取得一致的文本-动作对齐提升。
AI.conclusion: 说明内部表示更新是改进自回归动作生成的一条互补方向。

title: Train-Only-Constrained LM for Synthetic Clinical Trajectories: Leak-Safe Calibration and Auditable Dynamics
comment: Preprint (pre-review version, 6 pages, 2 figures). Accepted at SECURE AI4H@AAAI 2026, Singapore. Extended version to appear in Springer CCIS vol. 3004 (2027): https://link.springer.com/book/9789819239238
summary: Simulating clinical time series necessitates temporal realism, calibration that preserves model integrity, and privacy transparency. We present a train-only, constrained language-model pipeline that factorizes generation. A compact GPT-style language model learns cross-biomarker co-occurrence through quantile tokens, and temporal directions are enforced by 3x3 per-biomarker Markov transitions fit on TRAIN, allowing dynamics to be audited. We fit a monotone quantile map (QMap) on TRAIN only (SYN(TRAIN) -> SIM(TRAIN)); no TEST statistics are used. The fixed map is then applied to SYN(TEST) severities. The constrained LM demonstrated improved distributional fidelity and co-occurrence in a 5,000-patient simulated testbed (parameters within published clinical ranges) compared to an empirical sampler, maintained near-chance detectability after a small lambda-sweep, and exhibits temporal adherence by construction. A classifier-based membership-inference audit results in an AUC of approximately 0.5; we make no differential-privacy claim. We present multi-seed results with paired 95% confidence intervals and quantify the severity of QMap's alignment (Delta W1 with confidence interval). This is a Stage-1 method result obtained on a controlled simulator; Stage-2 validation on real EHR cohorts with clinical endpoints is planned.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅用训练集、受约束的语言模型流水线，通过分位数token+按生物标志物3x3马尔可夫转移+单调分位数映射(QMap)实现临床时间序列的可审计、校准与隐私透明的模拟生成。
AI.motivation: 临床时间序列模拟需要同时满足时间真实性、保持模型完整性的校准以及隐私透明度；现有方法（如经验采样器）在分布保真、共现结构与时间依从性上不足，且缺乏可审计的动态机制与明确隐私声明。
AI.method: 构建train-only受约束流水线并做生成分解：紧凑GPT式语言模型用分位数token学习跨生物标志物共现；时间方向由仅在TRAIN上拟合的每生物标志物3x3马尔可夫转移强制约束，使动态可审计；仅在TRAIN上拟合单调分位数映射QMap（SYN(TRAIN)->SIM(TRAIN)），不触碰TEST统计量，再将固定映射应用于SYN(TEST)的严重度；进行小规模lambda扫描与基于分类器的成员推断审计，并给出多种子结果与配对95%置信区间、QMap对齐严重度的Delta W1置信区间。
AI.result: 在5,000名患者的模拟测试平台上，受约束LM相较经验采样器在分布保真度与共现结构上更优（参数落在已发表临床范围内）；经小幅lambda扫描后检测可辨性接近随机水平；时间依从性由构造保证；成员推断审计AUC约0.5（不作差分隐私声称）；报告了多种子配对95%置信区间及QMap对齐的Delta W1。
AI.conclusion: 这是一个在受控模拟器上获得的Stage-1方法性结果，表明生成分解+仅训练集约束可在保真度、时间真实性与隐私透明度间取得平衡；Stage-2将在真实EHR队列上以临床终点进行验证。

title: RePace: Reasoning about Demonstration Speedup for Faster Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Since vision-language-action (VLA) policies can inherit the slow pace of human demonstrations, accelerating these demonstrations before fine-tuning can lead to faster VLA policies without an additional speed-selection module at deployment. Several offline speedup methods have focused on identifying segments that require less precision and assigning predefined speedup factors to the segments. However, even within a single segment, a speedup factor suitable for steady motion may be too high when precise alignment is required. To this end, this paper presents RePace, an offline reasoning framework that determines how much to accelerate each part of a demonstration. For the same recorded movement, RePace measures how much each candidate speedup factor shortens the sequence and compares the resulting observation-action pairs used for training. Given the task instruction, a pretrained language model uses the visual context and original motion of successive windows to interpret these candidate retiming effects and select a speedup profile for the complete episode. Experimental results demonstrate that RePace outperforms the baselines in overall task execution efficiency on both LIBERO and RoboCasa-Kitchen. On all three tasks with a gripper-equipped Franka Research 3 arm, RePace matches or exceeds the acceleration baselines in success rate and completes successful trials faster.

AI.tldr: 提出 RePace：一个离线推理框架，为示教轨迹的每一部分自适应决定加速倍数，通过预训练语言模型结合任务指令、视觉上下文与原始运动，比较候选重定时效果并选择整段 episode 的速度剖面，从而在无部署期速度选择模块的情况下加速 VLA 策略。
AI.motivation: VLA 策略会继承人类示教动作的缓慢节奏，因此在微调前对示教加速可得到更快的策略。现有离线加速方法按"低精度需求段落"打固定加速倍数，但同一段落内平稳运动可承受的倍数在需要精确对齐时可能过高，缺乏段内细粒度与自适应性。
AI.method: 给定任务指令，对同一段记录运动枚举候选加速倍数，度量每种候选对序列的缩短程度以及由此产生的训练用 observation-action 对；利用预训练语言模型在连续滑动窗口上，结合视觉上下文与原始运动解释这些候选重定时效果，逐步选择速度并最终给出覆盖整条 episode 的速度剖面；随后用重定时后的数据微调 VLA 策略，部署时无需额外速度选择模块。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 与 RoboCasa-Kitchen 上整体任务执行效率优于基线；在配备夹爪的 Franka Research 3 机械臂的三个任务上，成功率持平或超过加速基线，且成功试验的完成时间更短。
AI.conclusion: 以"推理式、窗口级、依任务语义"的方式选择加速剖面，优于段落级固定倍数的离线加速；在不牺牲成功率的前提下提升执行效率，且保持部署简洁。

title: 3D CoCa v3: Contrastive Learners with Scene Graphs for Urban Scene Understanding
summary: Understanding large-scale 3D urban scenes requires representations that capture both multi-scale geometric structures and complex spatial relationships. However, existing 3D vision-language methods primarily emphasize global semantic alignment or object-level representations, leaving structured relational modeling underexplored within unified contrastive and generative frameworks. In this paper, we present 3D CoCa v3, a scene-graph-enhanced contrastive and generative framework for urban 3D scene understanding. Our framework features a Pyramid Vision Encoder for multi-scale geometric representation learning and a language-model-based decoder with question-guided caption retrieval and visual cross-attention. We further introduce MSG-based relational descriptions to enrich contrastive 3D-language alignment with structured spatial relationships. To support semantic and relational supervision, we construct City3D-9.6K, a multi-view urban vision-language dataset with aligned visual-geometric observations, scene captions, and scene graphs. Extensive experiments on City-3DQA demonstrate that 3D CoCa v3 achieves 88.35% and 64.79% overall top-1 accuracy on the sentence-wise and city-wise splits, surpassing 3D CoCa v2 by 20.88 and 3.57 percentage points, respectively. Furthermore, 3D CoCa v3 achieves the best performance on GeoEval3D, demonstrating its effectiveness in urban spatial reasoning and geometric understanding. Code is available at https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/3DCoCav3.

AI.tldr: 提出场景图增强的对比-生成统一框架 3D CoCa v3，用于城市 3D 场景理解，融合金字塔视觉编码器、语言模型解码器与 MSG 关系描述，并构建 City3D-9.6K 数据集，在 City-3DQA 与 GeoEval3D 上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 大规模 3D 城市场景需要同时刻画多尺度几何结构与复杂空间关系；现有 3D 视觉-语言方法多侧重全局语义对齐或目标级表示，在统一的对比与生成框架内对结构化关系建模关注不足。
AI.method: 1) Pyramid Vision Encoder 进行多尺度几何表示学习；2) 基于语言模型的解码器，引入问题引导的 caption 检索与视觉交叉注意力；3) 采用基于 MSG 的关系描述增强对比式 3D-语言对齐的结构化空间关系；4) 构建 City3D-9.6K 多视角城市视觉-语言数据集，含对齐的视觉-几何观测、场景描述与场景图。
AI.result: 在 City-3DQA 上，sentence-wise 与 city-wise 划分的总体 top-1 准确率分别为 88.35% 和 64.79%，较 3D CoCa v2 分别提升 20.88 与 3.57 个百分点；在 GeoEval3D 上取得最佳性能，体现其城市空间推理与几何理解能力。
AI.conclusion: 场景图增强的对比-生成统一建模能有效提升城市 3D 场景的语义与关系理解，验证了多尺度几何表示与结构化关系监督的互补价值。

title: LLM-coupled interpretable tool wear monitoring with multi-evidence reasoning in CNC machining
summary: Interpretable tool wear assessment in CNC machining is challenging. Existing diagnostic models have high accuracy but provide limited guidance for tool replacement. This study proposes a two layer framework combining deep learning wear classification and LLM assisted reasoning. The first layer uses PCA Loading feature selection and optimized GRU to recognize three wear states, achieving 98.38 percent macro F1 score on the PHM2010 dataset. The second layer uses LLMs to generate natural language reports and replacement suggestions from classification results and feature trends. Engineer evaluation shows the reports outperform rule templates. Cross dataset tests on NASA milling data support the generalizability of this framework.

AI.tldr: 提出"深度学习磨损分类+大模型辅助推理"两层框架：第一层用PCA Loading特征选择与优化GRU识别三种磨损状态（PHM2010宏F1达98.38%），第二层由LLM依据分类结果与特征趋势生成自然语言报告与换刀建议，工程师评价优于规则模板，NASA铣削数据跨数据集测试支持泛化性。
AI.motivation: 数控加工刀具磨损的可解释评估困难：现有诊断模型精度高，但对换刀决策的指导性不足，缺乏可读的诊断依据与建议。
AI.method: 两层框架。第一层为磨损分类：采用PCA Loading进行特征选择，结合优化后的GRU网络，输出三类磨损状态。第二层为LLM辅助推理：将分类结果与特征趋势作为输入，利用大语言模型生成自然语言诊断报告与刀具更换建议。
AI.result: PHM2010数据集上宏F1达98.38%；工程师评估表明LLM生成的报告优于规则模板；在NASA铣削数据上的跨数据集测试验证了框架的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将高精度深度学习分类与LLM推理结合，可在保持分类性能的同时提升诊断的可解释性与决策支持价值，且具备一定跨数据集迁移能力；LLM层相对规则模板在可读性与实用性上具优势。

title: FineDex: Bridging Fine-Grained Human-Object Interaction Generation to Dexterous Humanoid Manipulation
summary: Dexterity is, at its core, finger-level control, yet existing dexterous manipulation and human-object interaction (HOI) generation methods rarely let one specify how an interaction is performed: five-fingered hands are often reduced to grippers, or finger usage is copied from individual human demonstrations. We present FineDex, a framework that makes finger-level intent both expressible and executable. FineDex learns coordinated human body, hand, and object motions that follow fine-grained instructions on hand selection, individual fingers, and contacts with articulated objects. To bridge generation and execution, FineDex leverages generated interactions as actionable priors for an agent that discovers physically feasible contact strategies through practice in a physics-based digital twin. By adapting at test time without per-instance retraining, FineDex generalizes across fine-grained instructions and object configurations. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art HOI generation quality and fine-grained controllability, substantial improvements in dexterous manipulation success, and successful deployment on a real dexterous humanoid robot.

AI.tldr: 提出 FineDex 框架，让"指级意图"既可表达又可执行：学习遵循手部选择、单指与铰接物体接触等细粒度指令的人体-手-物体协同运动，并将生成交互作为可执行先验，在物理数字孪生中通过练习发现可行接触策略。
AI.motivation: 现有灵巧操作与 HOI 生成方法很少允许指定"交互如何执行"：五指手常被简化为夹爪，或直接把手指使用方式从单个人体演示中复制，缺乏细粒度手指级控制能力。
AI.method: FineDex 学习协调的人体、手部与物体运动，可遵循关于手部选择、单根手指及与铰接物体接触的细粒度指令；将生成的交互作为可操作先验，供智能体在基于物理的数字孪生中通过练习发现物理可行的接触策略；在测试时自适应、无需针对每个实例重新训练。
AI.result: 实验显示达到最先进的 HOI 生成质量与细粒度可控性，灵巧操作成功率显著提升，并成功部署到真实灵巧人形机器人上。
AI.conclusion: FineDex 同时实现指级意图的表达与执行，并能跨细粒度指令与物体构型泛化，验证了"生成先验 + 物理练习 + 测试时自适应"路线在仿真与真机上的可行性。

title: The Missing Root: Geometric Imagination Without Images in Large Language Models
summary: This paper proposes a new paradigm and method for giving large language models spatial understanding. Standard language models operate exclusively over discrete words (secondary representations of things rather than continuous space itself), forcing them to guess geometry verbally. Whereas most multimodal approaches equate spatial grounding with camera images or video frames, spatial structure itself is not a picture: it consists of coordinate frames, solid boundaries, and how objects move and relate to each other in continuous space. Motivated by this distinction, we place continuous object tokens combining pose (position, orientation, and scale) and signed-distance shape embeddings alongside word tokens inside a single uninterrupted transformer sequence, allowing language and geometry to attend to each other as object scenes are built and updated step by step. Control tokens switch output automatically between natural-language words and continuous object state updates to a persistent object workspace, while an attention mask blocks earlier prose when generating the answer, so responses must be read directly from settled geometry. To prove this method works, we attach a narrow parallel spatial stream (+4.4% weights) alongside unfrozen Qwen3-1.7B layers. In our two-dimensional tests, the model spawns and transforms multi-object scenes from English descriptions, transfers shapes to held-out nouns, and relies causally on the workspace to answer spatial questions.

AI.tldr: 提出“连续物体token + 单一transformer序列”的空间理解新范式：将结合位姿与符号距离形状嵌入的连续物体token与词token置于同一序列中交替生成，并通过控制token与注意力掩码强制模型从几何工作区读取答案；在Qwen3-1.7B上以+4.4%参数实现二维场景生成、形状迁移与因果性空间问答。
AI.motivation: 标准语言模型只在离散词上运算，词是事物的次级表征而非连续空间本身，导致其只能“用语言猜几何”；同时现有多模态方法把空间grounding等同于相机图像或视频帧，但空间结构本质上是坐标系、实体边界及物体在连续空间中的运动与关系，并非一张图片。因此需要一个直接在连续几何表征上推理的范式。
AI.method: 把连续物体token（编码位置、朝向、尺度的pose + 符号距离场形状嵌入）与词token放入同一条不中断的transformer序列，使语言与几何互相注意力交互，逐步构建和更新物体场景；用控制token自动在自然语言输出与对持久物体工作区的连续状态更新之间切换；生成答案时用注意力掩码屏蔽此前的叙述文本，迫使回答直接从已确定的几何中读取。实现上在未冻结的Qwen3-1.7B旁挂一个窄并行空间流，仅增加4.4%权重。
AI.result: 二维实验中，模型能根据英文描述生成并变换多物体场景，将形状迁移到未见过的名词上，并在空间问答中因果性地依赖该工作区（而非语言先验）。
AI.conclusion: 空间理解应建模为连续几何状态而非图像或纯文本；将连续物体token嵌入统一序列、以控制token与掩码约束解码，可用极小参数代价为大模型注入可读、可干预的显式空间工作区。当前验证限于二维与单一基座模型，三维与规模泛化仍有待检验。

title: LatentCP-DPO: Conformal Pessimism for DPO with Finite-Sample Guarantees
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) learns a response policy from human preference data, but with a limited dataset it can overfit to noisy or weakly informative preference labels. We introduce LatentCP-DPO, a framework that combines conformal prediction with pessimistic preference optimization for Bradley-Terry (BT) pairwise feedback and Plackett-Luce (PL) ranking feedback. Building on LatentCP's construction of uncertainty sets for unobserved model parameters, we address how to incorporate this uncertainty into preference optimization and characterize its effect on policy performance. Under exchangeability and a correctly specified preference model, we construct uncertainty sets for latent relative rewards with finite-sample marginal coverage from conformal prediction sets for observable preferences. We then learn a response policy by maximizing the worst-case expected preference log-likelihood over these uncertainty sets, using an independent collection of prompts and candidate responses without preference labels. Under suitable assumptions, we establish finite-sample upper bounds on regularized policy suboptimality that separate policy-class approximation error, conformal uncertainty, and statistical estimation error. For BT feedback, we further establish a worst-case lower bound for LatentCP-DPO that matches the upper bound's reciprocal dependence on the number of unlabeled optimization examples. The lower bound also shows that the uncertainty sets can induce a bias that persists as the optimization sample grows. Together, these results characterize both the statistical accuracy and potential limitations of preference optimization using conformal uncertainty sets. Experiments support the benefits of the proposed framework in finite preference datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出 LatentCP-DPO，将共形预测（conformal prediction）与悲观偏好优化结合，用于 BT 成对反馈与 PL 排序反馈，给出有限样本次优性上界及匹配的 BT 下界。
AI.motivation: DPO 从人类偏好数据学习响应策略，但数据有限时易对噪声或弱信息偏好标签过拟合，需要把模型参数/奖励的不确定性纳入优化。
AI.method: 在可交换性与偏好模型正确设定下，利用 LatentCP 对可观测偏好构造共形预测集，并据此为潜在相对奖励构造具有有限样本边际覆盖保证的不确定性集；随后在这些集合上最大化最坏情况期望偏好对数似然（悲观/鲁棒优化），优化使用独立的无偏好标签的提示-候选响应集合。
AI.result: 在适当假设下得到正则化策略次优性的有限样本上界，可分解为策略类近似误差、共形不确定性误差与统计估计误差三项；对 BT 反馈进一步给出最坏情况下界，其对无标签优化样本数的依赖与上界互为倒数关系，并表明不确定性集可引入随优化样本增大仍不消失的偏差；实验验证有限偏好数据下的收益。
AI.conclusion: 该工作刻画了基于共形不确定性集的偏好优化在统计精度与潜在局限两方面的性质：共形不确定性可带来有限样本鲁棒性，但其诱导的偏差是结构性限制。

title: Cairn: Object-Centric 3D Trajectory Priors for Steering Frozen VLAs
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are capable low-level controllers, but they tie where objects go to the layouts they were trained on: when objects are moved or obstacles block the way, they carry them to the wrong place or into collisions. Fine-tuning on new layouts needs robot data for each one and erodes skills the model already has. We introduce Cairn, which keeps the VLA frozen and steers it at test time along learned 3D trajectories of the object in its gripper. A small prior reads point clouds of the scene and the held object, along with its pose when grasped and the instruction, and samples SE(3) trajectories up to its release that lead it around obstacles and turn it to fit through gaps. The prior and the VLA form the two levels of a hierarchical planner in which feedback runs both ways: the VLA's intended motion chooses and reshapes the trajectories, and the chosen one guides the VLA's denoising. Its predicted actions, mapped to the held object's poses through the grasp, are pulled toward the next waypoint, while the VLA's weights stay untouched. Across 1,941 held-out LIBERO scenes with displaced objects and obstacles, Cairn raises the success rate of a frozen π0.5 from 24.5% to 95.1%, above that of a π0.5 fine-tuned on our training layouts, without hurting standard LIBERO. On the third-party LIBERO-PRO benchmark, it raises success from 27.3% to 38.0%, and from 54.4% to 81.1% on the episodes it steers. On a real Franka, with a prior trained purely in simulation, it guides the frozen DROID π0.5 around an obstacle and to a placement at the limit of the arm's reach, where it otherwise fails. All code, models and data will be made public.

AI.tldr: Cairn 在测试时冻结 VLA，用一个小型先验采样夹持物体的 SE(3) 轨迹，与 VLA 构成双向反馈的层级规划器，从而在布局改变或存在障碍时仍能正确放置物体。
AI.motivation: VLA 虽是可用的底层控制器，但把"物体去哪"与训练布局绑定：物体移动或有障碍时会放错位置或碰撞；针对新布局微调既需每个布局的机器人数据，又会遗忘已有技能。
AI.method: 冻结 VLA 并在测试时用学习到的夹持物体 3D 轨迹进行引导。小型先验输入场景与手持物体的点云、抓取时的位姿和指令，采样至释放点的 SE(3) 轨迹，可绕障、转向以通过狭窄间隙。先验与 VLA 构成层级规划器，双向反馈：VLA 的意图运动用于选择和重塑轨迹，选定轨迹引导 VLA 的去噪；将预测动作经抓取关系映射为物体位姿并被拉向下一路点，VLA 权重不变。
AI.result: 在 1,941 个含移位物体与障碍的 LIBERO 留出场景中，将冻结 π0.5 成功率从 24.5% 提升到 95.1%，高于在训练布局上微调的 π0.5，且不损害标准 LIBERO。在 LIBERO-PRO 上从 27.3% 提升到 38.0%，在被引导的回合上从 54.4% 提升到 81.1%。真实 Franka 上，仅用仿真训练的先验引导冻结的 DROID π0.5 绕过障碍并完成接近臂展极限的放置，而原模型失败。
AI.conclusion: 测试时通过物体级 3D 轨迹引导冻结 VLA，可显著提升对布局变化与障碍的泛化，无需机器人数据微调且不牺牲原有能力，并具备从仿真到真机的迁移性；代码、模型与数据将公开。

title: SPiXSeg: Rethinking MLLM-based Image Segmentation as Superpixel Classification
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are widely used for image segmentation. However, existing methods either use a decoder or use patch-based approach which trades boundary precision against the number of decisions as coarse grid cells mix foreground and background pixels, while finer grids require many more predictions, and autoregressive mask generation adds sequential decoding overhead. We propose SPiXSeg, which shifts the output from per-patch to per-superpixel label assignment, using superpixel tokens formed by aggregating patch-level visual features. An off-the-shelf model partitions each image into task-agnostic superpixels, so the partition is computed once and reused across tasks. A Spix-to-Mask (S2M) module scores each superpixel token in a single MLLM forward pass by directly comparing the MLLM's hidden representations, without autoregressive generation or a separate scoring network, and the selected superpixels are mapped directly to pixels without refinement. Without any trainable decoder head or post-hoc refinement, SPiXSeg achieves an average cIoU of 80.5 with LLaVA-1.5-7B and 81.9 with InternVL2.5-8B on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+ and RefCOCOg and, when trained only on COCO-Stuff, extends to open-vocabulary semantic segmentation with mIoU of 29.0, 59.5 and 95.4 on ADE20K, PASCAL Context and PASCAL VOC, outperforming several SoTA MLLM baselines. Our results suggest that a fixed, query-agnostic superpixel partition is enough for accurate language-guided segmentation.

AI.tldr: SPiXSeg 将多模态大模型的分割输出从"逐patch"改为"逐超像素"，利用现成超像素划分与单次前向的 S2M 打分模块，在无需可训练解码器与后处理精修的情况下取得有竞争力的参考分割与开放词表分割性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 分割方法存在权衡：依赖解码器头，或采用 patch 级方案，粗网格把前景背景像素混在一起损害边界精度，细网格则需大量预测；自回归掩码生成还带来顺序解码开销。作者希望找到一种既不牺牲边界精度、也不增加预测数量与顺序解码成本的输出范式。
AI.method: 采用现成模型进行任务无关的超像素划分，每张图只算一次并可跨任务复用；通过聚合 patch 级视觉特征形成超像素 token；设计 Spix-to-Mask（S2M）模块，在单次 MLLM 前向中直接比较隐藏表示对每个超像素 token 打分，无需自回归生成、独立打分网络；被选中的超像素直接映射回像素，不做精修，也无训练型解码头。
AI.result: 在 RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg 上，LLaVA-1.5-7B 平均 cIoU 80.5，InternVL2.5-8B 达 81.9；仅在 COCO-Stuff 上训练时，开放词表语义分割在 ADE20K、PASCAL Context、PASCAL VOC 上 mIoU 分别为 29.0、59.5、95.4，优于若干 SoTA MLLM 基线。
AI.conclusion: 一个固定的、与查询无关的超像素划分已足以支撑准确的语言引导分割；逐超像素标签分派是可替代逐 patch 预测与自回归掩码生成的有效输出形式。

title: Scaling Looped MoE Language Models under Matched Budgets: Information Flow and Parameter Allocation
summary: Looped Transformers decouple computational depth from parameter count, and prior studies have demonstrated promising performance gains with increased computation. However, systematic design principles for configuring these models under strict iso-parameter and iso-FLOP constraints remain scarce. We contribute to this direction by improving information flow in looped models and systematically studying loop parameter configurations. Specifically, we refine this information flow via gated inner-loop state updates and a cross-stage residual connection. Building on this design, controlled studies identify a configuration combining a single-pass Core depth of 25%-35% of the total unrolled depth with reallocating saved parameters into extra routed experts per layer, improving performance at zero extra compute while preserving compatibility with existing training infrastructure. Evaluated after 1T pre-training tokens, our 69B MLA and 51B KDA Mixture-of-Experts models outperform budget-matched non-recurrent baselines by an average of 1.16 and 2.29 percentage points across four benchmarks, respectively. Further reproduction experiments on a common backbone with a 200B-token training budget show that our method achieves lower perplexity than other looped methods. Code for these reproduction experiments is available at https://github.com/lxi01766/Scaling-Looped-MoE-Language-Models-under-Matched-Budgets-Information-Flow-and-Parameter-Allocation.

AI.tldr: 在等参数量、等FLOP约束下，通过改进循环Transformer的信息流（门控内循环状态更新+跨阶段残差）并系统研究循环参数配置，提出"单次核心深度为展开深度25%-35%+将省下参数转为每层额外路由专家"的配置，在1T token预训练后69B MLA与51B KDA MoE模型分别平均超越同预算非循环基线1.16和2.29个百分点。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer可将计算深度与参数量解耦，已有研究表明增加计算可带来性能提升，但在严格的等参数量（iso-parameter）与等FLOP（iso-FLOP）约束下，如何配置循环模型仍缺乏系统性设计原则。
AI.method: 1）改进循环模型的信息流：采用门控（gated）内循环状态更新与跨阶段残差连接；2）在该设计基础上进行受控实验，系统扫描循环参数配置（核心深度占比、参数再分配方式）；3）将配置识别为：单次迭代核心深度取总展开深度的25%-35%，并把节省的参数重新分配到每层更多路由专家（MoE）中，且不增加额外计算、兼容现有训练基础设施。
AI.result: 在1T预训练token后，69B MLA模型与51B KDA MoE模型在四个基准上分别平均超过同预算非循环基线1.16与2.29个百分点；在共享骨干、200B token预算的复现实验中，本方法困惑度低于其他循环方法。
AI.conclusion: 在等参数等FLOP约束下，改进信息流并结合"缩减核心深度+参数转投MoE专家"的配置可在零额外计算下提升循环Transformer性能，为循环模型的设计提供了可用的配置原则，且易于与现有训练设施兼容；代码已开源。

title: Memory Is Not Ground Truth: Revising Navigation Authority under Unreliable VLM Evidence for Persistent Semantic Navigation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) enable robots to reason about semantic and spatio-temporal context, verify task-relevant objects, and guide sensing and navigation. Persistent memory can reduce redundant search for field robots, but when should a memory continue to guide behavior? Repeated misses may suggest that a memory is stale. Our experiments show why this evidence can remain ambiguous under VLM-based perception. Using a Boston Dynamics Spot with four fixed cameras and a persistent spatio-temporal visual memory, we measure negative-verification behavior across targets, viewpoints, language queries, and repeated revisits. False-negative rates vary substantially across objects, nearby revisits often reproduce the same detector outcome, and some matched target-present and target-removed experiments yield identical miss histories. This ambiguity persists under changed observation geometry, identity-preserving query reformulation, and conditioning on a previously verified target image. These findings raise two questions: is the object still there, and is this memory still useful for navigation? We introduce a dependence-aware, reversible memory-update mechanism that avoids double-counting correlated misses and stops using unsupported memories as direct navigation goals without claiming that the object is absent. Later positive evidence can restore a memory's use for navigation. One resident onboard VLM is shared across memory verification, semantic frontier reasoning, and in-motion perception. In three matched real-robot decision contexts, an episode-local baseline selected a stale memory as its navigation objective in every case, whereas our method selected semantic frontiers in all three. A complementary trial re-verified the target during motion and promoted fresh memory. These results support revising memory actionability rather than interpreting failed detection as object absence.

AI.tldr: 本文分析视觉-语言模型（VLM）感知下负验证证据的模糊性，提出依赖感知的可逆记忆更新机制，通过修正记忆的"可行动性"而非判定物体缺失来指导机器人导航，并在Boston Dynamics Spot实机实验中优于局部基线。
AI.motivation: 持久性时空视觉记忆能减少野外机器人重复搜索，但"何时应继续让记忆引导行为"缺乏判据。直觉上连续未命中可能意味着记忆过期，然而作者发现 VLM 感知下的负验证证据存在系统性歧义：漏检率因物体而异、邻近重访常复现同一检测结果、目标存在与被移除的场景可产生完全相同的未命中历史。因此需要回答"物体是否还在"与"该记忆对导航是否仍有用"这两个不同问题。
AI.method: 在 Boston Dynamics Spot 上部署四路固定相机与持久时空视觉记忆，跨目标、视角、语言查询与重复重访测量负验证行为，并施加改变观测几何、保持身份的查询重述、以已验证目标图像作为条件等扰动。据此提出依赖感知、可逆的记忆更新机制：避免对相关未命中重复计数，将缺乏支持的记忆从直接导航目标中降级但不宣称物体缺失，后续正向证据可恢复其可导航性。一个机载 VLM 复用记忆验证、语义前沿推理与运动中感知三项任务。
AI.result: 假阴性率在不同物体间差异显著；邻近重访常重复同一检测器结论；目标存在与目标移除的配对实验可产生相同未命中历史，且在观测几何变化、查询重述与图像条件下该歧义依然存在。三个匹配的真实机器人决策情境中，局部基线全部选择过期记忆作为导航目标，而本文方法全部选择语义前沿；补充试验在运动中重新验证目标并将新记忆提升为可用。
AI.conclusion: VLM 感知下的检测失败不应被解读为物体缺失；应修正记忆的可行动性而非其存在性。依赖感知的可逆记忆更新机制为持久记忆机器人提供了一种更审慎、可恢复的决策准则。

title: Continuous Foundation-Guided Pseudo-Label Weighting for Breast Ultrasound Domain Adaptation
summary: Breast ultrasound segmentation models often generalize poorly across scanners, institutions, and patient populations. We investigate continuous foundation-guided pseudo-label weighting for unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA). An exponential-moving-average (EMA) teacher generates target-domain pseudo-labels, while a frozen ultrasound segmentation model (AutoSAMUS) modulates their contribution using a bounded weight that combines the prior's certainty with its probabilistic agreement with the teacher. In contrast to our earlier selective BiRP rule, the proposed formulation supervises every target pixel with a weight in [0.5, 1] and requires no foundation-model inference at test time. We evaluate the method on five public breast ultrasound datasets, spanning three source domains and eleven source-target directions. Under the TransUNet protocol, continuous weighting outperforms both all-pixel EMA and original BiRP on all four BUSI-source targets, and achieves the highest mean Dice and lowest HD95 among the compared methods on all four BUS-BRA-source targets. Results with BrEaST as the source are mixed: continuous weighting performs best on BUSI and comparably to original BiRP on OASBUD, whereas none of the adaptation methods surpasses source-only training on BUS-UCLM. In a separate U-Net pipeline, agreement-only weighting performs comparably to the full formulation, leaving the incremental value of prior certainty unresolved. Because the weighting rule was developed after some target-test results had been examined, we treat the study as exploratory and report adverse as well as favorable outcomes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种由基础模型引导的连续伪标签加权方法用于乳腺超声分割的无监督域适应：冻结的AutoSAMUS为EMA教师的伪标签赋予[0.5,1]区间权重，在所有目标像素上监督，测试时无需基础模型推理；跨五个数据集、三种源域、十一个迁移方向的实验显示多数场景优于全像素EMA与原始BiRP规则，但结论属探索性。
AI.motivation: 乳腺超声分割模型在跨设备、跨机构、跨人群时泛化性差；现有UDA中伪标签质量不可靠，作者此前提出的选择性BiRP规则仅对部分像素施加监督、且需测试时调用基础模型，因此希望以更简洁、覆盖全像素的方式利用基础模型先验。
AI.method: 用EMA教师生成目标域伪标签；冻结的超声分割基础模型AutoSAMUS输出先验，将其确定性与该先验同教师伪标签的概率一致性结合，构成有界权重（[0.5,1]），对每个目标域像素加权监督；不使用BiRP的选择性筛选，测试阶段不进行基础模型推理。在五个公开乳腺超声数据集、三个源域、十一个源→目标方向上评估，分别采用TransUNet与U-Net两种训练管线。
AI.result: TransUNet设置下，连续加权在四个以BUSI为源的目��上均优于全像素EMA与原始BiRP；在四个以BUS-BRA为源的目标上取得最高平均Dice和最低HD95。以BrEaST为源时结果不一：BUSI上最佳，OASBUD上与原始BiRP相当，BUS-UCLM上所有适应方法均未超过仅源域训练。U-Net管线中，仅用一致性（agreement-only）加权即可达到与完整公式相当的性能，先验确定性的增量贡献未被证实。
AI.conclusion: 连续基础模型引导的伪标签加权在多数跨域方向上有效，且实现与部署更简便；但先验确定性项的价值尚不明确，跨源域收益不稳定，加之加权规则是在查看部分目标测试结果后确定的，本研究应视为探索性工作，需在更严格协议下进一步验证。

title: RAP: Radial-Angular Random Projection for Hyperbolic Representations
summary: Random projection is a basic compression primitive for Euclidean representation learning, with the Johnson--Lindenstrauss lemma giving a target dimension $k=O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log n)$ independent of the ambient dimension. As hyperbolic representations gain increasing attention in modern Transformers, vision-language models, and large language models, the same need for oblivious dimensionality reduction arises, but no analogous primitive yet exists for hyperbolic representations. We study this gap. Two natural attempts fail in dual ways: a tangent-space scheme gives a clean local guarantee but is chart-bound and pays a curvature penalty, while a fully hyperbolic projection in the hyperboloid model is geometrically native but mixes radial and angular error before feeding them into the conditioning of $\operatorname{arcosh}$. We propose radial-angular random projection (RAP), which preserves the radial coordinate exactly and applies a Euclidean random projection only to the angular direction, lifting the result back to the target hyperboloid. RAP is hyperbolic-to-hyperbolic by construction, costs one Gaussian matrix-vector product, and reduces hyperbolic compression to a normalized angular JL question on $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}$. We prove a finite-set RAP guarantee with explicit $\sinh(\sqrt{c}\,r_x)\sinh(\sqrt{c}\,r_y)$ conditioning, complemented by a local tangent-space JL theorem and an arcosh-conditioning lemma for the fully hyperbolic comparator. Across an origin-centered broad-radius point cloud, a balanced tree, a clustered Gaussian, and the WordNet noun hierarchy, RAP attains the lowest mean relative distortion in every $(n,k)$ cell, reducing distortion over the strongest hyperbolic baseline by approximately $48\%$--$49\%$ on broad-radius data. RAP also scales to million-point datasets and improves retrieval on vision--language representations over hyperbolic projection baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出径向-角度随机投影(RAP)，将欧氏随机投影用于角度分量、精确保留径向坐标，为双曲表示提供首个双曲到双曲的维度约简原语，并给出有限集失真保证。
AI.motivation: Johnson–Lindenstrauss引理为欧氏表示学习提供了与环境维度无关的目标维度k=O(ε^{-2}log n)的随机投影压缩原语；而随着双曲表示在Transformer、视觉-语言模型与LLM中兴起，缺乏对应的双曲维度约简原语。现有两种自然方案各有缺陷：切空间方案有干净的局部保证但依赖坐标卡且受曲率惩罚；双曲面模型中的完全双曲投影虽几何原生，却在arcosh条件化前混合径向与角度误差。
AI.method: RAP在双曲表示中精确保留径向坐标r，仅对角度方向（S^{d-1}上）施加欧氏随机投影，再将结果提升回目标双曲面，因此天然是双曲到双曲的映射，计算代价仅为一次高斯矩阵-向量乘。理论上将双曲压缩归约为球面归一化角度JL问题，证明有限集保证，含显式sinh(√c·r_x)sinh(√c·r_y)条件化项，并辅以局部切空间JL定理及针对完全双曲对照方案的arcosh条件化引理。
AI.result: 在原点中心广半径点云、平衡树、聚类高斯与WordNet名词层级四类数据上，RAP在全部(n,k)网格单元中取得最低平均相对失真；在广半径数据上较最强双曲基线降低失真约48%–49%。RAP可扩展至百万点数据集，并在视觉-语言表示的检索任务上优于双曲投影基线。
AI.conclusion: RAP填补了双曲表示维度约简原语的空白，兼具几何原生性、低计算成本与可证明的有限集保证，并可实用地扩展到大规模数据与下游检索任务。

title: One Ocean, Many Tasks: A Data-Grounded Simulation Suite and Benchmark for Marine Robotics
summary: Simulation is essential for marine robotics, yet existing platforms often trade off between visually realistic worlds, high-throughput experimentation, and ocean-condition realism grounded in real data. We present OneOcean, a data-grounded simulation suite and benchmark built around a unified spatiotemporal ocean-environment product that harmonizes bathymetry with data-driven currents and tides, with optional pollution fields for cleanup-related evaluation. On top of this environment representation, OneOcean defines a task ladder spanning navigation and station-keeping under currents, waypoint and route following, depth-profile tracking, area scanning, pipeline inspection, and multi-agent coordination, including formation transit, fish protection and patrol (herding), and surface pollution localization, containment, and cleanup. The suite supports multi-agent settings with 2-10 vehicles. Our simulator supports three to six Degrees of Freedom (DoF) and produces standardized metrics and reproducible run manifests, enabling consistent aggregation across tasks, difficulties, and scaling settings. Experiments across dataset variants and scenes systematically stress planning and control under data-grounded disturbances and reveal trade-offs among heuristic baselines, Behavior Cloning (BC), and a Large Language Model (LLM)-based planner.

AI.tldr: 该文提出OneOcean——一个数据驱动的海洋机器人仿真套件与基准，以统一时空海洋环境产品（地形+数据驱动流场与潮汐，可选污染场）为底座，构建从导航、定点、航线跟踪到管道巡检与多智能体协同（编队、鱼群保护、污染围控清理）的任务阶梯，支持2–10智能体、3–6自由度，并提供标准化指标与可复现运行清单。
AI.motivation: 现有海洋机器人仿真平台难以兼顾三方面：视觉/物理真实感、高通量实验能力、以及基于真实数据的海况真实性；缺乏统一环境表征下的可复现、可扩展评测基准。
AI.method: 1) 构建统一时空海洋环境产品，融合水深地形与数据驱动海流、潮汐，可选叠加污染场；2) 在此环境上定义递进式任务阶梯（流中导航与定点、航点/航线跟踪、深度剖面跟踪、区域扫描、管道巡检、多智能体协同：编队航行、鱼群保护与巡护、水面污染定位-围控-清理）；3) 支持2–10个智能体、3–6 DoF；4) 输出标准化指标与可复现运行清单，实现跨任务、难度与规模的一致聚合。
AI.result: 在不同数据集变体与场景上的实验系统性检验了数据驱动扰动下的规划与控制，揭示了启发式基线、行为克隆（BC）与基于大语言模型（LLM）的规划器之间的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: OneOcean以数据驱动的统一海洋环境与分层任务阶梯，为海洋机器人规划与控制提供了可复现、可扩展、可聚合的基准平台，凸显数据真实海况下不同规划范式的性能权衡。

title: Hybrid Reinforcement Learning for One-step Degraded Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Infrared and visible image fusion (IVIF) is essential for robust perception, yet existing methods remain limited under complex degradations. While diffusion models (DMs) offer powerful modeling capabilities to combat such degradations, their iterative process incurs high computational cost. One-step distillation effectively accelerates inference but typically leads to over-smoothed results. To resolve these limitations, we propose a one-step fusion framework with hybrid reinforcement learning, termed OneHRL. We treat degraded inputs as intermediate noisy states along a generative trajectory, enabling a distilled one-step generator to rectify them directly to the clean fusion results. Concurrently, to mitigate the over-smoothed results in distillation, we incorporate the Flow-GRPO paradigm to introduce stochasticity into the deterministic one-step generation. This restores the stochastic exploration necessary for sampling-based reinforcement learning. Furthermore, we design a coarse-to-fine reward that integrates a global semantic reward with an object-level reward. This hybrid reward ensures that the generator captures both naturalness and fine-grained texture. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior fusion quality and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出 OneHRL：将退化输入视为生成轨迹中的中间噪声态，用蒸馏的一步生成器直接校正为清晰融合结果，并借助 Flow-GRPO 为一确定性一步生成注入随机性，配合粗到细（全局语义+目标级）混合奖励，兼顾融合质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 红外与可见光图像融合（IVIF）在复杂退化条件下仍具挑战；扩散模型虽建模能力强但迭代采样计算开销大，而一步蒸馏虽可加速却易导致结果过度平滑、丢失纹理细节。
AI.method: 1）将退化输入建模为生成轨迹中的中间噪声状态，训练蒸馏式一步生成器直接将其映射到干净融合结果；2）引入 Flow-GRPO 范式，在确定性一步生成中引入随机性，恢复基于采样的强化学习所需的随机探索；3）设计粗到细奖励：全局语义奖励与目标级奖励结合，构成混合奖励以同时保证自然度与细粒度纹理。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在融合质量与计算效率上均取得更优表现（superior fusion quality and efficiency）。
AI.conclusion: 一步蒸馏 + Flow-GRPO 强化学习的混合框架可有效缓解一步生成的过度平滑问题，在退化场景下实现高质量、高效率的红外与可见光图像融合。

title: Interpretable identification of constitutive parameter field for three-dimensional heterogeneous and graded hyperelastic materials from full-field displacements
summary: The inverse problem of identifying spatially varying material properties of heterogeneous solids using experimentally available displacement fields and boundary reaction forces alone remains challenging. Being able to characterize heterogeneous and graded solids would be advantageous in the design and manufacturing of functionally graded materials and composites. Additionally, an efficient technique for identifying heterogeneous material properties from in vivo measurements would be useful in biomedical contexts to characterize heterogeneous biological tissues. Although several techniques developed over the past two decades have addressed inverse identification for homogeneous materials, including linear elastic, hyperelastic, viscoelastic, and elastoplastic solids, comparatively fewer studies have considered heterogeneous and graded materials. Furthermore, several recent approaches to characterizing heterogeneous and graded materials employ parameter-heavy, deep learning-based frameworks trained to enforce force equilibrium at specified collocation points within the material. In this work, we propose an interpretable and time-efficient framework that predicts the three-dimensional relative spatial variation of a constitutive parameter field for multiple parameters of a heterogeneous hyperelastic material, using only displacement-field data. In this work, we validate our framework on 3D synthetic and 2D experimental benchmarks involving heterogeneous, graded, and anisotropic hyperelastic materials. By leveraging the linear nature of the inverse problem for hyperelastic materials and directly optimizing for the constitutive parameters at the finite-element level, we achieve acceptable prediction accuracy with significantly lower computational time compared to recently reported deep-learning-based frameworks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可解释、高效率的逆问题框架，仅用位移场数据即可预测非均质超弹性材料多个本构参数场的三维相对空间变化，并在3D合成与2D实验基准上验证，精度可接受且计算时间显著低于深度学习框架。
AI.motivation: 基于实验可测的位移场与边界反力识别非均质固体的空间变材料属性仍是难题；该能力对功能梯度材料与复合材料的设计制造有价值，在生物医学中也可用于由在体测量表征非均质生物组织。已有工作多针对均质材料，非均质与梯度材料研究较少，且近期方法多依赖参数繁重、需在配点处强制力平衡的深度学习框架。
AI.method: 利用超弹性材料逆问题的线性特性，在有限元层面直接优化本构参数，构建可解释、省时的框架，预测非均质超弹性材料多个本构参数场的三维相对空间变化，仅以位移场为输入。
AI.result: 在涉及非均质、梯度与各向异性超弹性材料的3D合成基准与2D实验基准上完成验证，取得可接受的预测精度，计算时间显著低于近期报道的深度学习框架。
AI.conclusion: 直接在有限元层面优化本构参数、利用超弹性逆问题的线性性质，可在保证可解释性的同时兼顾精度与效率，为非均质与梯度材料参数场识别提供可行替代方案。

title: MERLoc: Robust Robot Localization in Dynamic Environments with Pose-Based Retrieval over 3D Gaussian Splatting References
summary: Robots operating in previously mapped spaces must localize accurately despite moving people and rearranged objects. Most localization pipelines match the query against a sparse set of captured reference images retrieved by appearance, which is brittle under scene change and repeating structures. We present MERLoc, which turns a single metric 3D Gaussian Splatting scan into a dense Functional Reference Memory. Reference views are sampled over the navigable space for the robot's morphology and sensors at a target density and rendered offline. Pre-encoding them for the chosen off-the-shelf localizer removes the reference encoder from inference. A pose-based retrieval strategy then selects references by spatial proximity and viewing direction rather than appearance, sidestepping visual ambiguities whenever a prior exists. Across one classical and four learned localizers in simulated and real dynamic scenes, pose-based retrieval matches or outperforms appearance retrieval in most cases, even when the latter is gated by the same prior. On real data, it lowers position RMSE by 15-60 % in nine of ten backend/split combinations, and the rendered memory outperforms real-image caches posed by Structure-from-Motion. The system runs onboard a Jetson Orin NX at 5 Hz, enabling a navigation policy to successfully traverse a hallway with people roaming and rearranging objects.

AI.tldr: MERLoc将单次3D高斯泼溅扫描转为稠密"功能参考记忆"，用位姿检索替代外观检索完成机器人定位，在仿真与真实动态场景中匹配或超越外观检索。
AI.motivation: 机器人在已建图空间中需在有人走动、物体被挪动的情况下仍能准确定位。现有定位流水线多依赖按外观检索到的少量参考图像，在场景变化和重复纹理结构下易失效。
AI.method: 以单次度量3DGS扫描构建稠密功能参考记忆：按机器人构型与传感器在可通行空间以目标密度采样参考视角并离线渲染；预先编码参考帧，使推理阶段无需参考编码器；采用基于位姿的检索，按空间邻近性与视角方向（而非外观）选取参考，从而在有先验时规避视觉歧义。
AI.result: 在1种经典与4种学习型定位器、仿真与真实动态场景上，位姿检索在多数情形下持平或优于外观检索（即使后者同样受先验门控）；真实数据中10个后端/划分组合有9个将位置RMSE降低15–60%；渲染记忆优于由SfM位姿化的真实图像缓存；在Jetson Orin NX上以5Hz板载运行，支撑导航策略在有人流动、物体被挪动的走廊中完成通行。
AI.conclusion: 以渲染稠密参考记忆加位姿检索的可复用框架可显著提升动态变化下的定位鲁棒性与精度，并满足板载实时性，可作为现有定位前端的即插即用记忆层。

title: Structured Noise Diffusion for Echocardiography Haze Removal
summary: Echocardiographic images are frequently degraded by spatially structured haze artifacts that obscure anatomical boundaries and hinder clinical analysis. Conventional diffusion models typically employ pixel-independent Gaussian noise, limiting their ability to represent localized ultrasound haze. In this study, we propose a structure-informed diffusion framework that explicitly models ultrasound haze as an accumulation of localized Gaussian components constrained by the ultrasound fan geometry. The forward process generates spatially correlated corruption by sampling component locations and scales, providing a formulation that better reflects the spatial characteristics of real echo artifacts. During reverse restoration, a dual-head network predicts an anchor probability map and Gaussian scale parameters to progressively remove structured artifacts while reducing the center bias associated with direct coordinate regression. We evaluated the framework on the public DehazingEcho2025 benchmark and two private clinical datasets, without retraining or fine-tuning on either private cohort. Our method achieved the highest mean generalized contrast-to-noise ratio across all three datasets, reaching $0.715 \pm 0.090$ on the public benchmark while preserving tissue edges.

AI.tldr: 提出结构感知扩散框架，将超声雾状伪影建模为由超声扇形几何约束的局部高斯分量累积，改造前向加噪与反向复原过程以去除结构化伪影。
AI.motivation: 超声心动图图像常受空间结构化雾状伪影影响，遮蔽解剖边界、妨碍临床分析；常规扩散模型采用像素独立高斯噪声，难以刻画局部化的超声雾状伪影空间特性。
AI.method: 前向过程通过采样高斯分量的位置与尺度生成空间相关退化，分量受超声扇形几何约束；反向复原采用双头网络，分别预测锚点概率图与高斯尺度参数，逐步去除结构化伪影，并缓解直接坐标回归带来的中心偏置。
AI.result: 在公开基准DehazingEcho2025及两个私有临床数据集上评估，两个私有集未做重训练或微调；三数据集平均广义对比噪声比均为最高，公开基准达0.715±0.090，且保持组织边缘。
AI.conclusion: 以物理几何先验结构化扩散过程可更贴合真实回声伪影分布，实现跨数据集泛化的超声图像去雾并保留结构细节。

title: Inverse Reinforcement Learning with State-Dependent Foresight for Human Decision-Making
summary: Computational modeling of behavior represents individuals with a model fitted to their observed behavior and characterizes them through its parameters. Naturalistic tasks incorporate the complexity of real environments and yield high-dimensional behavioral trajectories. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) infers the latent reward function underlying these trajectories. Standard IRL, however, assumes effectively infinite-horizon planning, whereas human foresight is both bounded and state-dependent. Here we introduce SC-AIRL (State-Conditional Adversarial IRL), which builds these two cognitive properties into the planner. Per-depth policies share one reward but differ in how far ahead they sum it explicitly. A state-conditional router mixes them according to the current state. Across held-out episodes in pedestrian crossing and highway overtaking tasks, SC-AIRL improves imitation over Standard AIRL, raising top-1 accuracy from 0.549 to 0.647 and from 0.629 to 0.718, respectively, while more closely reproducing participant behavior in rollouts. Inferred planning depth correlates with self-reported anxiety and motor impulsivity. SC-AIRL thus reproduces human behavior more closely than Standard AIRL while providing an interpretable, model-derived measure of state-dependent foresight.

AI.tldr: 提出SC-AIRL（状态条件对抗逆强化学习），将"有限视野"与"状态依赖视野"引入规划器，以统一奖励配合多个不同显式加权深度的策略及状态条件路由混合，从而更精确地拟合自然主义任务中的高维行为轨迹。
AI.motivation: 标准逆强化学习（IRL）假设近乎无限视野的规划，而人类前瞻性是有限的且依赖当前状态；自然主义任务的高维行为轨迹需要能刻画这种有限、状态依赖前瞻的建模框架。
AI.method: SC-AIRL：多个"按深度"的策略共享同一奖励函数，但在显式求和奖励的步长（规划深度）上不同；再由一个状态条件路由器依据当前状态对这些策略进行混合，从而在对抗式IRL框架中内生化有限且状态依赖的规划视野。
AI.result: 在行人过街与公路超车任务的留出episode上，SC-AIRL较标准AIRL提升模仿效果：top-1准确率分别由0.549升至0.647、由0.629升至0.718；rollout中更接近参与者真实行为；推断出的规划深度与自我报告的焦虑、运动冲动性相关。
AI.conclusion: SC-AIRL比标准AIRL更贴近人类行为，并提供可解释的、由模型导出的状态依赖前瞻性度量，具备作为个体差异心理指标建模工具的潜力。

title: DexLink: Synthesizing Dexterous Behaviors from Chained Hand-object Poses
summary: Synthesizing diverse dexterous manipulation policies is challenging: existing simulation-based approaches rely on human demonstrations which are difficult to scale, or use generic reward functions, which provide limited control over the hand-object interactions. We propose DexLink, which addresses these limitations by synthesizing diverse dexterous behaviors from sparse, reusable hand-object interaction templates. Given key task waypoints, DexLink retargets static interaction templates to target objects using an optimization that preserves spatial hand-object relationships. It then links the retargeted poses into an approximate reference trajectory and uses residual reinforcement learning to refine this reference into a closed-loop policy in simulation. Experiments spanning single-hand, bimanual, articulated, and dynamic tasks demonstrate that DexLink provides fine-grained control over task timing, grasp types, and high-level execution. The modular interaction templates transfer reliably across object scales, instances, and categories; without object-specific human demonstrations, the framework also matches the performance of dense reference-tracking methods. Finally, zero-shot deployment of policies trained purely in simulation shows promise for the simulation-based framework.

AI.tldr: DexLink 通过稀疏、可复用的手-物交互模板合成多样灵巧操作策略，在仿真中实现细粒度可控且可跨对象迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有仿真方法依赖难以规模化的人类示范，或使用通用奖励函数，导致对手-物交互控制有限，难以合成多样灵巧行为。
AI.method: 以关键任务路点为输入，用保持手-物空间关系的优化将静态交互模板重定向到目标物体；将重定向姿态链接为近似参考轨迹，再用残差强化学习将其精化为闭环策略。
AI.result: 在单手、双手、关节物体及动态任务中实现任务时序、抓取类型与高层执行的细粒度控制；模板可跨物体尺度、实例与类别可靠迁移；无需对象专属人类示范即可达到密集参考跟踪方法的性能；纯仿真训练策略的零样本部署展现潜力。
AI.conclusion: 模块化交互模板+残差强化学习为可扩展、可控的灵巧操作策略合成提供了有效路径，并具备向真实世界零样本迁移的前景。

title: OmniMeld: Enhancing Audio-Visual Understanding via Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: Audio-visual understanding requires perceptual grounding, temporal understanding, and semantic inference. Multi-teacher distillation can consolidate these capabilities, but direct probability matching does not explicitly capture teacher prediction changes across audio-visual conditions. We introduce OmniMeld, a multi-teacher on-policy distillation method that integrates domain expertise through modality-response-guided distribution matching. We train four teachers covering grounding and correspondence, temporal dynamics and event structure, causal and inferential reasoning, and contextual and holistic understanding. Each sample is routed to its corresponding teacher for supervision conditioned on student-generated answer prefixes. We derive transport costs from teacher prediction changes over shared candidate tokens across audio-visual conditions, using optimal transport to match student predictions to those of the teacher under complete audio-visual input. We also construct OmniMeld-20K for domain-specialized teacher training. The dataset spans four capability domains, with responses structured into evidence, reasoning, and answer sections and verified through consistency checks and media-based review. Experiments on audio-visual and general video understanding benchmarks demonstrate competitive teacher performance among similarly sized open-source models. The student improves over its base model across all evaluated benchmarks and surpasses the teachers' base model on several benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出OmniMeld多教师在线策略蒸馏方法，通过模态-响应引导的最优传输分布匹配，将四个领域专家教师的能力整合到学生模型中，并构建OmniMeld-20K数据集。
AI.motivation: 音视频理解需要感知接地、时序理解与语义推理等多种能力，多教师蒸馏可整合这些能力，但直接概率匹配无法显式刻画教师预测在音视频条件变化下的差异。
AI.method: 训练四个覆盖感知接地与对应关系、时序动态与事件结构、因果与推理、上下文与整体理解领域的教师；以学生生成的答案前缀为条件将样本路由到对应教师；由教师在共享候选词上跨音视频条件的预测变化推导传输代价，用最优传输将学生预测对齐到完整音视频输入下教师的预测；并构建OmniMeld-20K数据集（四能力域，响应分为证据、推理、答案三段，经一致性检查与媒体复核）。
AI.result: 同类规模开源模型中教师性能具竞争力；学生在所有评测基准上优于基座模型，并在若干基准上超过教师的基座模型。
AI.conclusion: 基于模态响应变化的最优传输分布匹配优于直接概率匹配，可作为多教师在线策略蒸馏中整合领域专长的有效范式。

title: RAWPrism: A Three-Task Dataset and a Unified Model for RAW-Domain Image Fusion
summary: Research on multi-exposure fusion (MEF), multi-focus fusion (MFF), and infrared-visible image fusion (IVIF) has largely focused on rendered RGB images, while unified fusion across these tasks in the RAW domain before image signal processing (ISP) remains relatively underexplored. To support research in this setting, we introduce the RAWPrism dataset, covering all three tasks, and the RAWPrism model, a lightweight unified multi-task fusion network. The RAWPrism dataset comprises 422 usable MEF scenes and 150 registered MFF pairs from our RAW captures, together with 1,500 FMB-derived IVIF samples, in which the visible RAW inputs are reconstructed by ReRAW and their RGB counterparts rendered by CycleISP. Scene-level partitions and task-specific rendering and scoring protocols connect these resources to method development and evaluation. To our knowledge, the RAWPrism model is the first to unify MEF, MFF, and IVIF directly in the RAW domain. It combines a CFA-aware representation, task-conditioned source gating, and a shared backbone to support all three tasks with one 3.58M-parameter checkpoint. Together, the dataset and model support the study of shared fusion mechanisms across exposure, focus, and spectral complementarity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RAWPrism数据集与RAWPrism模型，首次在RAW域（ISP之前）统一处理多曝光融合、多聚焦融合与红外-可见光融合三项任务，用单一3.58M参数模型实现三任务融合。
AI.motivation: 现有MEF、MFF、IVIF研究多集中于渲染后的RGB图像，而ISP之前的RAW域统一融合尚未被充分探索；同时缺乏支撑该设定研究的数据资源。
AI.method: 构建RAWPrism数据集：422个可用MEF场景、150对配准MFF RAW图像，以及1500个源自FMB的IVIF样本（可见光RAW由ReRAW重建，RGB版本由CycleISP渲染），并提供场景级划分与任务特定渲染/评分协议。模型方面，RAWPrism为轻量统一多任务融合网络，融合CFA感知表征、任务条件源门控与共享骨干，单checkpoint支持三任务。
AI.result: 提供覆盖三任务的RAW域数据集与评测协议；RAWPrism模型以3.58M参数的单一体系统一MEF、MFF、IVIF。
AI.conclusion: 数据集与模型共同支撑对曝光、聚焦与光谱互补性之间共享融合机制的研究，为RAW域统一融合方法发展与评测建立基础。

title: MAFNet-UR$^3$: Mask-Aware Fusion Network for Unified Raindrop and Reflection Removal
comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 LoViF Workshop. Received the Outstanding Challenge Paper Runner-Up Award
summary: Raindrops and reflections frequently co-occur on windshields and jointly obscure scene content, making their unified removal, referred to as UR$^3$, a highly ill-posed problem. Existing approaches are mainly based on diffusion models and thus can produce visually plausible restorations. However, they may generate scene-inconsistent structures in severely corrupted regions. To address this limitation, we propose MAFNet-UR$^3$, which adopts a three-stage framework to exploit multiple observations for scene-consistent unified raindrop and reflection removal. Specifically, Stage I suppresses raindrops while preserving the reflection layer, and Stage II performs prior-guided reflection removal followed by image-space refinement. Stage III estimates degradation masks from intermediate restoration results to provide degradation cues and performs mask-aware multi-scale fusion across observations to preserve scene structure and fine details. As a result, our proposed MAFNet-UR$^3$-L achieves state-of-the-art performance on the RDRF-testing benchmark, outperforming DiffUR$^3$ by 2.33 dB in PSNR and 2.7634 in the challenge score. Our method ranked third in the LoViF 2026 UR$^3$ Challenge, achieving a final score of 41.1416.

AI.tldr: 提出三阶段框架MAFNet-UR³，利用多观测实现雨滴与反光的统一去除（UR³），在RDRF-testing基准上以PSNR超DiffUR³ 2.33 dB、挑战分数超2.7634，并在LoViF 2026 UR³挑战赛排名第三（最终得分41.1416）。
AI.motivation: 挡风玻璃上雨滴与反光常同时出现并共同遮挡场景内容，统一去除（UR³）是高度不适定问题。现有基于扩散模型的方法虽能生成视觉上合理的复原结果，但在严重退化区域容易产生与场景不一致的结构，缺乏场景一致性。
AI.method: 采用三阶段框架以利用多观测：Stage I 抑制雨滴同时保留反光层；Stage II 进行先验引导的反光去除，随后做图像空间精修；Stage III 从中间复原结果估计退化掩码以提供退化线索，并跨观测执行掩码感知的多尺度融合，以保持场景结构与细节。由此形成MAFNet-UR³-L模型。
AI.result: 在RDRF-testing基准上取得SOTA，PSNR较DiffUR³提升2.33 dB，挑战分数提升2.7634；在LoViF 2026 UR³挑战赛中获得第三名，最终得分41.1416。
AI.conclusion: 通过分解式三阶段设计与多观测掩码感知融合，可有效缓解扩散类方法在严重退化区域的结构不一致问题，实现场景一致的高质量统一雨滴与反光去除。

title: Single-Database Rewards Are Hackable: Counterfactual Execution for Trustworthy Text-to-SQL RL
comment: 4 pages + references and appendix (12 pages total). Code: https://github.com/RishiiGamer2201/counterfactual-sql-rewards
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for text-to-SQL agents pays a query when its result matches the reference on one database. However, a wrong query can match by luck when the data lack the rows that expose its bug. We study a counterfactual-database (CF) reward that also runs the final query on a few hidden, code-generated copies of the database and pays only if all results match (strict form) or by the share matched (mean form). On 1,302 synthetic audit questions, the strict form lowers the share of buggy queries paid in full from 29.5% to 16.8% and of reward hacks from 54.1% to 1.9%, rejecting 0 of 2,847 correct queries; copies from a family-blind generator do about as well. In a controlled GRPO comparison on a 3.35B model with three seeds per arm, training on the mean form did not improve in-domain accuracy (8.4% vs 11.7%), because the two rewards disagreed on only 5-7% of rollouts; on Spider it gained 1.6 points. One seed reverses both signs, so single-seed reward comparisons mislead. Code: https://github.com/RishiiGamer2201/counterfactual-sql-rewards ; data, models, demo: https://huggingface.co/counterfactual-sql

AI.tldr: 提出反事实数据库（CF）奖励：在执行最终SQL的原始数据库之外，额外在若干隐藏的、由代码生成的数据库副本上执行查询，仅在全部结果匹配（严格形式）或按匹配比例（平均形式）给予奖励，以缓解结果匹配型RL奖励的偶然正确与奖励黑客问题。
AI.motivation: 现有text-to-SQL强化学习以"查询结果与参考答案在某一个数据库上匹配"作为奖励。但数据库可能缺少能暴露错误查询缺陷的行，导致错误查询"侥幸匹配"而获得全额奖励，产生虚假正奖励与reward hacking，使策略学到有bug的查询。
AI.method: 设计反事实数据库（CF）奖励：对最终查询在若干隐藏的、代码生成的数据库副本上执行，严格形式要求所有副本结果均匹配才付奖励，平均形式按匹配副本比例付奖励；在1,302个合成审计问题上评估，并进行3.35B模型的GRPO对照实验（每臂3个随机种子），与仅在原始数据库上判定结果的基线奖励对比；另测试"族盲"生成器的副本效果。
AI.result: 严格形式将有bug查询获得全额奖励的比例从29.5%降至16.8%，reward hack从54.1%降至1.9%，且未误拒2,847条正确查询中的任何一条；族盲生成器的副本效果相近。在GRPO对照中，平均形式训练未提升域内准确率（8.4% vs 11.7%），因为两奖励仅5–7%的rollout上不一致；Spider上提升1.6个点；但有一个种子使两个方向的符号均反转，说明单种子奖励对比具有误导性。
AI.conclusion: CF奖励能有效压低侥幸正确与reward hacking、且几乎不误伤正确查询，验证了审计层面的价值；但其训练收益不稳定：平均形式在域内无提升甚至下降，跨数据集收益有限且对随机种子敏感，需多随机种子评估并谨慎解读单种子结论。

title: Concept Generalization in Visual Brain Decoding via Encoder-Generated fMRI
summary: Visual brain decoders are typically trained and evaluated on stimuli drawn from similar semantic distributions, leaving their ability to reconstruct unseen concepts poorly understood. We study this concept generalization problem by withholding semantic concepts from a target subject's training data. We find that three recent fMRI-to-image decoders degrade substantially for the held-out concepts, even when the concept remains available for multi-subject models. In contrast, brain encoders that map a pretrained visual representation directly to voxels are markedly more robust to the same semantic holdout. Motivated by this asymmetry, we use such an encoder to generate synthetic fMRI responses for new images and add the resulting image-fMRI pairs to decoder training. Across three decoders, four subjects, and twelve semantic concepts, synthetic data recovers a substantial fraction of the performance lost on unseen concepts without requiring additional, time-consuming fMRI acquisition. We further show that the same approach improves general decoding performance across a wide range of data budgets. Analyses of encoder training conditions, encoder designs, and synthetic-data controls show that the gains depend on both encoder generalization and the semantic content of the synthetic supervision, rather than merely increasing the amount of training data. Together, our results show that encoder-generated fMRI can transfer semantic generalization to decoders.

AI.tldr: 视觉fMRI→图像解码器在未见语义概念上性能显著下降，而"预训练视觉表征→体素"的脑编码器对语义留出更鲁棒；用该编码器为新图像生成合成fMRI并加入解码器训练，可在不额外采集数据的情况下恢复大部分性能损失。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉脑解码器通常在相近语义分布上训练与评估，对未见概念的泛化能力缺乏了解。作者希望系统研究"概念泛化"问题，并寻找无需昂贵fMRI采集的改进途径。
AI.method: 在目标被试训练数据中刻意留出若干语义概念（12个概念、4名被试、3种解码器）；对比fMRI→图像解码器与直接映射预训练视觉表征到体素的脑编码器在语义留出下的表现；随后用编码器对合成/新图像生成合成fMRI响应，构建"图像–fMRI"配对加入解码器训练；并通过编码器训练条件、编码器结构及合成数据对照实验分析增益来源。
AI.result: 三种fMRI→图像解码器在留出概念上性能大幅下降，即使该概念在多被试模型中仍可用；直接映射的脑编码器对同一语义留出明显更鲁棒。合成fMRI数据使三种解码器在未见概念上恢复了相当比例的损失性能，且在广泛数据预算范围内提升整体解码表现。对照分析显示增益依赖编码器的泛化能力和合成监督的语义内容，而非单纯增加训练数据量。
AI.conclusion: 解码器与编码器在语义泛化上存在不对称性；编码器生成的合成fMRI可将语义泛化能力迁移给解码器，是一种免额外采集、可扩展的数据增强方案。

title: Strong Starts, Simple Recipes: Unified Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation from Multimodal Specialists
comment: Project page, code, and model weights: https://amberheart.github.io/Uni-MOPD/
summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates separately trained domain specialists into a single unified model. Existing methods focus on refining the distillation procedure while initializing the student from a base model or a multi-domain SFT checkpoint, which leaves capability integration largely to distillation itself. Instead, we treat the starting point as a design variable and propose Unified MOPD (Uni-MOPD), which pairs a strong start with a simple recipe: a training-free uniform merge of specialists from the same base model initializes the student, and short MOPD with uniform domain sampling and full-vocabulary reverse KL refines it. Across five multimodal domains and 19 benchmarks, our study establishes three findings. (1) The starting point matters more than subsequent training choices: before any training, the uniform merge already matches the score that the base model reaches after 200 MOPD updates, and after short distillation it matches higher-scoring, search-based starts. (2) Short MOPD recovers most of the capabilities the merge leaves unintegrated; it improves every domain, with the largest gains where the domain teacher still leads. (3) From a strong start, uniform domain sampling and full-vocabulary reverse KL match or exceed every evaluated sampling strategy and divergence, without schedules, per-token weighting, or truncation hyperparameters. Uni-MOPD outperforms Open-MOPD at the same training budget while training 3.3 times faster than its released code. We will release the training framework, specialist checkpoints, and unified student.

AI.tldr: Uni-MOPD 把学生模型的初始化当作设计变量，用以同一基座训练的专家权重做免训练均匀合并作为起点，再配合短程 MOPD（均匀域采样 + 全词表 reverse KL）完成能力整合，在五个多模态域、19 个基准上超过 Open-MOPD 且训练快 3.3 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有多教师 on-policy 蒸馏（MOPD）主要改进蒸馏过程本身，却把学生初始化固定为基座模型或多域 SFT 检查点，使能力整合的责任几乎全部压在蒸馏上。作者认为初始化是被忽视的关键变量，需与蒸馏配方联合设计。
AI.method: 1）起点：对来自同一基座的多个领域专家做免训练、均匀权重的参数合并，作为学生初始化（避免搜索式合并的高开销）。2）蒸馏：短步数 MOPD，采用均匀域采样与全词表 reverse KL，不使用课程/调度、per-token 加权或截断等超参。3）实验设置：五个多模态领域、19 个基准，与基座初始化、搜索式合并初始化等对比，并做初始化与训练策略的消融。
AI.result: (1) 起点比后续训练选择更重要：未训练时均匀合并已追平基座经 200 步 MOPD 后的分数，短程蒸馏后追平更高分的搜索式起点。(2) 短程 MOPD 补回合并未整合的大部分能力，所有域均有提升，在领域教师仍领先处增益最大。(3) 从强起点出发，均匀域采样与全词表 reverse KL 匹配或超过所评估的所有采样策略与散度；同预算下优于 Open-MOPD，且训练比其发布代码快 3.3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 把初始化视作设计变量可显著简化多教师 on-policy 蒸馏：免训练均匀合并且短程 MOPD 即构成有效且高效的统一方案，说明"好起点 + 简单配方"优于复杂蒸馏技巧。作者将开源训练框架、专家检查点与统一学生模型。

title: X-Matte: VAE-Free Pixel-Space Flow Matching for Single-Step Image Matting
summary: Pre-trained generative models offer rich visual priors for image matting, but their adaptation often relies on variational autoencoders (VAEs), whose spatial compression can degrade fine alpha details and introduce additional inference overhead. To address these limitations, we propose X-Matte, a VAE-free pixel-space flow matching framework for single-step image matting. By eliminating latent compression, X-Matte formulates the RGB-to-alpha transition as a continuous flow directly in pixel space. We adopt trajectory-wide x-prediction with transition-aware alpha supervision, enabling the model to learn from intermediate states while directly predicting the target alpha matte in a single forward pass. This design avoids both VAE encoding and decoding and iterative sampling. Extensive experiments demonstrate performance competitive with state-of-the-art trimap-free matting methods on P3M benchmarks, together with promising zero-shot generalization to RWP-636 and AIM-500. Moreover, X-Matte achieves up to a 9.4x inference speedup over a constructed single-step latent counterpart at high resolution, demonstrating the effectiveness of VAE-free pixel-space modeling for accurate and efficient image matting.

AI.tldr: 提出 X-Matte：一个无 VAE、像素空间、单步的 flow matching 图像抠图框架，直接从 RGB 预测 alpha，避免潜空间压缩与迭代采样。
AI.motivation: 预训练生成模型可为抠图提供视觉先验，但现有适配多依赖 VAE，其空间压缩会损失精细 alpha 细节，并带来额外推理开销。
AI.method: 去掉潜空间压缩，在像素空间把 RGB→alpha 建模为连续流；采用全轨迹 x-prediction 与 transition-aware alpha 监督，使模型能从中间状态学习并在单次前向中直接预测目标 alpha，无需 VAE 编解码与迭代采样。
AI.result: 在 P3M 基准上与 SOTA trimap-free 方法性能相当，对 RWP-636、AIM-500 具良好零样本泛化；高分辨率下相较构建的单步潜空间对应版本推理最高提速 9.4 倍。
AI.conclusion: 无 VAE 的像素空间建模可在保持抠图精度的同时显著提升效率，是准确且高效的抠图方案。

title: Any-Rate: Half-Bit Multi-Precision LLM Quantization with Coded Bit-Planes
comment: 41 pages, 17 figures. (Equal contribution : Hoonki Lee and Haechan Shin)
summary: Nested multi-precision quantization derives multiple precisions from a single checkpoint by reading only the leading bits of each weight, which makes it attractive for on-device deployment under varying memory and energy budgets. However, existing methods offer only integer bits, leaving large accuracy gaps between adjacent precisions and severe degradation at 2 bits. To address this, we propose Any-Rate, which serves 2-8 bits from one checkpoint, in half-bit steps over 2-4 bits. Any-Rate restricts some bit-planes to extended Hamming codewords in 8-weight blocks (0.5 bits per weight), shares one LUT per row across precisions, and encodes all precisions jointly with a separate target for each, reducing the loss from sharing bit-planes. Across four LLMs, Any-Rate achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among multi-precision methods at 2 and 3 bits, keeping 69% of FP16 accuracy at 2 bits, and is within one point of the best at 4 bits. It decodes about as fast as existing kernels, and an LPDDR energy model estimates up to 27% less energy at equal accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/hoonki2002/Any-Rate.

AI.tldr: Any-Rate 提出一种嵌套多精度量化方案，从单一 checkpoint 以半比特为步长服务 2–8 比特精度（2–4 比特区间为半比特步长），在四个 LLM 上取得多精度方法中最优精度，2 比特保留 69% FP16 精度，解码速度与现有 kernel 相当，同等精度下 LPDDR 能耗降低最多 27%。
AI.motivation: 嵌套多精度量化通过只读取每个权重的前导比特，从单一 checkpoint 派生出多种精度，适合在变化的显存与能耗预算下进行端侧部署。但现有方法只提供整数比特粒度，导致相邻精度之间存在较大精度鸿沟，且 2 比特时性能严重退化。
AI.method: 提出 Any-Rate：(1) 在 8 权重块内将部分比特平面限制为扩展汉明码字（每权重 0.5 比特），从而实现半比特粒度；(2) 各精度共享每行一个 LUT；(3) 对所有精度联合编码，并为每个精度设置独立目标，以降低共享比特平面带来的损失。
AI.result: 在四个 LLM 上，2 比特与 3 比特精度下取得多精度方法中的 SOTA；2 比特保留 FP16 精度的 69%；4 比特与最佳方法差距在 1 个百分点以内。解码速度与现有 kernel 大致相当；LPDDR 能耗模型估计同等精度下能耗最多降低 27%。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入半比特粒度的嵌套量化与共享 LUT 设计，Any-Rate 在单一 checkpoint 下缩小了相邻精度间的精度鸿沟，尤其改善了 2 比特的严重退化问题，并在精度、速度与能耗上同时具备竞争力。

title: Off the Driven Path: Transferable Road Understanding in Driving VLAs
summary: End-to-end driving policies increasingly operate without explicit HD maps at inference, raising the question of what road knowledge they actually internalize. To probe this knowledge through model outputs, we introduce Road-KSU, a framework that automatically converts HD maps and actor annotations into a road-centric scene graph. From this, we derive road-focused question answering and reasoning targets, complemented by map-based trajectory compliance metrics. Pairing Road-KSU with geographically disjoint splits yields a $2 \times 2$ evaluation crossing output modality (language vs. action) with place familiarity (seen vs. unseen roads). On NAVSIM, 95% of test samples lie within 10m of a training sample, and scores of 13 published planners on turns rise steeply with the number of training drives through the test location, pointing to memorized road geometry. Retraining on geographically disjoint splits and probing with Road-KSU confirm that action-space performance degrades most on unfamiliar turns, with failures dominated by geometric compliance. Language accuracy, however, drops on road-centric VQA on straight and curved roads alike, and remains stable on dynamic scene content. Scaling the training data further reveals a double dissociation: more drives through the same places improve driving on unseen roads but leave road question answering unchanged, whereas spreading a fixed data budget over more places increases road question answering with little change in driving performance. These findings show that improved driving scores need not imply broader road understanding on unseen roads, and identify geographic diversity as key to transferable road knowledge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Road-KSU 框架，将 HD 地图与行为体标注自动转换为道路中心场景图，并派生道路问答/推理任务与基于地图的轨迹合规性指标；结合地理不相交数据划分，揭示了端到端驾驶策略在 NAVSIM 上的高成绩很大程度上源于对道路几何的记忆，而非可迁移的道路理解。
AI.motivation: 端到端驾驶策略在推理阶段日趋不依赖显式 HD 地图，但其内部究竟内化了哪些道路知识尚不清楚；现有 benchmark 中测试样本与训练样本地理高度重叠（NAVSIM 中 95% 测试样本距训练样本 10m 以内），使驾驶分数无法区分"理解"与"记忆"。
AI.method: 构建 Road-KSU：把 HD 地图与 actor 标注自动转为道路中心场景图，据此生成道路导向的问答与推理目标，以及基于地图的轨迹合规性指标。配合地理不相交划分，设计 2×2 评估矩阵（输出模态：语言 vs. 动作 × 地点熟悉度：seen vs. unseen）；分析 13 个已发表规划器在弯道分数与训练经过该地次数（training drives）的关系，并在不相交划分上重训练后探测。
AI.result: NAVSIM 中 95% 测试样本距离某训练样本不足 10m；13 个规划器在转弯处的分数随经过测试地点的训练次数上升而陡增，指向道路几何记忆。地理不相交重训练显示：动作空间性能在不熟悉弯道上退化最严重，失败以几何合规性为主。语言侧，道路中心 VQA 在直道与弯道上均出现下降，而在动态场景内容上保持稳定。数据扩展呈现双重解离：增加同一地点的行驶次数提升未见道路上的驾驶表现但道路问答不变；将固定数据预算分摊到更多地点则提升道路问答而驾驶表现变化很小。
AI.conclusion: 驾驶分数的提升并不意味着对未见道路具备更广的道路理解；地理多样性（地点覆盖广度）是获得可迁移道路知识的关键，而非同地重复数据量。

title: DiversePlace: Diversity-Seeking Curriculum Reinforcement Learning for Macro Placement
summary: Macro placement is a critical early-stage decision in physical design because macro locations strongly constrain subsequent implementation stages. The task is difficult because these high-impact discrete decisions must be made before downstream quality can be measured accurately, forcing training to rely on fast but imperfect training-time oracles such as half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL). Existing RL-based placers therefore mostly optimize single HPWL-driven solutions, and their long sequential horizons often require heavy search assistance or offline expert data while leaving little room to preserve multiple competitive layouts. We address this gap by making quality-controlled diversity an explicit objective for macro placement. Instead of relying on a single proxy-optimal solution, we maintain a compact archive of HPWL-competitive yet meaningfully different placements for downstream selection. We realize this idea in DiversePlace, a curriculum proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework that combines a quality-gated diversity reward with an expanding placement horizon, enabling from-scratch RL optimization while keeping exploration inside competitive HPWL regions. On the ISPD2005 benchmarks, DiversePlace consistently improves top-5, top-10, and top-20 archive diversity and achieves lower or virtually identical HPWL on all eight designs with better efficiency. Code: https://github.com/William030422/NIPS2026-DiversePlace.

AI.tldr: 提出 DiversePlace，将"质量可控的多样性"作为宏单元布局(宏布局)的显式优化目标，用课程式 PPO 维护一个小型高质量且彼此差异明显的布局档案库，供下游选择。
AI.motivation: 宏布局是物理设计早期的高影响离散决策，但下游质量无法在决策时准确评估，训练只能依赖 HPWL 等快速但粗糙的代理指标。现有 RL 布局器因此多只优化单个 HPWL 驱动的解，长序列决策需要大量搜索辅助或离线专家数据，且难以保留多个有竞争力的候选布局。
AI.method: DiversePlace：课程式近端策略优化(PPO)框架。核心是"质量门控的多样性奖励"——仅在 HPWL 处于竞争性区域时给予多样性激励，从而把探索限制在高质量区域内；同时逐步扩展布局时间跨度(expanding placement horizon)，实现从零开始的 RL 优化，并维护一个紧凑的布局档案库(archive)以收集 HPWL 相近但差异显著的解。
AI.result: 在 ISPD2005 基准上，DiversePlace 在全部 8 个设计上稳定提升 top-5/top-10/top-20 档案库多样性，同时 HPWL 更低或几乎持平，且效率更优。
AI.conclusion: 将质量可控多样性作为显式目标可有效弥补单一 HPWL 代理的局限，无需离线专家数据即可从零训练，产出多解候选集供下游布局选择，为宏布局提供更实用的问题建模方式。

title: LayoutRecall: Preserving Appearance in Multi-Round 3D Layout-Controlled Image Editing
summary: 3D layout-controlled image editing gives users explicit control over object placement and camera viewpoint. In a sequence of edits, however, the latest image can lose the appearance of an object when it is occluded or leaves view. The target layout specifies where the object should reappear, while its appearance must be recovered from earlier observations. We introduce LayoutRecall, a multi-round editor that stores and reuses appearance in the local coordinate systems of 3D boxes. Box-Surface Latent Memory retains image latents on box faces and retrieves them along rays in the target view. Geometry-Aligned Memory Conditioning supplies the retrieved tokens to a FLUX.2 editor using target-view positions, shared box-local embeddings, and object-wise attention. A correspondence loss encourages the editor to attend to matching observations during denoising. We also introduce LayoutLoop, a multi-round 3D layout-controlled image editing benchmark with calibrated layouts and designed revisits. We conduct extensive experiments on LayoutLoop and real-scene data to verify the ability of our method. The project page is at https://ykchizs.github.io/layoutrecall.github.io/.

AI.tldr: LayoutRecall 是一个多轮 3D 布局控制图像编辑框架，通过在 3D 包围盒局部坐标系中存储并复用物体外观，解决多轮编辑中物体被遮挡或移出视野后外观丢失的问题；同时提出 LayoutLoop 基准用于评测。
AI.motivation: 多轮 3D 布局控制的编辑中，目标布局规定了物体重新出现的位置，但当物体在上一轮中被遮挡或离开视野时，最新图像已不包含其外观信息，必须从早期观测中恢复外观。现有编辑器缺乏跨轮次、跨视角的外观记忆与检索机制。
AI.method: 提出三项核心设计：(1) Box-Surface Latent Memory，将图像潜变量保存在 3D 包围盒表面，并沿目标视角光线进行检索；(2) Geometry-Aligned Memory Conditioning，利用目标视角位置、共享的盒局部嵌入与物体级注意力，将检索到的 token 注入 FLUX.2 编辑器；(3) 对应性损失（correspondence loss），在去噪过程中促使编辑器关注相匹配的观测。此外构建 LayoutLoop 基准，含标定布局与设计好的重访视角。
AI.result: 在 LayoutLoop 基准与真实场景数据上进行大量实验，验证了方法在多轮布局控制编辑中恢复并保持物体外观的能力。
AI.conclusion: 以 3D 盒局部坐标系为记忆载体、结合几何对齐条件注入，可有效实现跨轮次的外观召回；LayoutLoop 为多轮 3D 布局编辑提供了标准化评测平台。

title: Auditing Identity and Timing Signals in Operational Logs
comment: 28 pages. Supplementary code and results included. WhoWhen library: https://github.com/mojolearn/whowhen
summary: Models that predict events from operational logs, such as sepsis in ICU records or failures in hard drives, can score well by recognizing which patient or drive a record came from, or when it was recorded, instead of predicting the event. I introduce two simple audits that measure how much of this information a dataset carries before any event-prediction model is trained, and apply them to seven public datasets in six domains. One asks whether a classifier can tell that two records came from the same unit; the other asks which of two records from the same unit came later. Under the stated nulls, both have expected AUC 0.5. In ICU data, the identity audit flags a common preprocessing step: carrying the last measurement forward raises identity AUC from 0.916 to 0.993. On a 12-hour sepsis forecasting task, carrying forward makes a model look 0.163 AUC better than raw values when a patient's hours are split between training and test, but only 0.046 better when patients are held out. The exaggeration under patient overlap also appears in a second ICU dataset with mortality as the outcome. On the sepsis task, a chronological control with complete follow-up, in which training sees only a patient's earlier, resolved hours, shows no positive mean overlap gap. Timing is a strong predictor: with complete follow-up, hour of stay and measurement counts alone, with no clinical value, score 0.761 on held-out patients, and adding the raw clinical values changes that by +0.018. Outside the ICU, 95% of drives and 75% of loans have records on both sides of a calendar cut, and the overlap gap persists under a calendar split. The audits show which features and preprocessing choices to check; the evaluation protocol decides the consequences. I release the code, a library that runs the audits on any table with a unit column and a time column, and a guide to using the audits.

AI.tldr: 论文提出两种无需训练预测模型的数据集审计方法（单位身份审计与时间先后审计），在六个领域七个公开数据集上揭示操作日志数据中存在的单位重叠与时序泄漏，并证明这些信息会夸大事件预测模型的性能。
