AI.motivation: 从操作日志预测事件（如ICU脓毒症、硬盘故障）的模型可能通过识别记录所属的个体或记录时间而非真正预测事件来获得高分，从而高估真实性能。现有评估缺乏在训练任何预测模型之前对数据集本身所含泄漏信息的度量手段。
AI.method: 提出两个简单审计：(1)身份审计——判断两条记录是否来自同一单位；(2)时间审计——判断同一单位的两条记录孰先孰后。在既定零假设下两者期望AUC均为0.5。在六个领域七个公开数据集上应用，并对比不同预处理（如末次观测值前向填充）与不同划分协议（患者划分 vs 患者内小时重叠划分、日历切分、时序控制）下的事件预测性能差异。
AI.result: ICU数据中，前向填充将身份AUC从0.916升至0.993；12小时脓毒症预测中，患者小时在训练/测试间拆分时前向填充使模型AUC虚高0.163，患者留出时仅0.046，第二份ICU死亡率数据集亦出现同样夸大。时序控制（训练仅见同一患者较早且已解决的小时）下无正的平均重叠差距。仅用住院小时数与测量计数、不含临床数值即可在留出患者上达到0.761 AUC，加入原始临床值仅提升0.018。ICU外，95%硬盘、75%贷款记录跨越日历切分，且日历切分下重叠差距依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 审计可指明应检查哪些特征与预处理选择，而评估协议决定其后果；泄漏信息在多大程度上转化为性能虚高取决于划分方式。作者发布代码、可在任意含单位列与时间列的表格上运行审计的库及使用指南。

title: DeltaRAE: Derivative Tokenization for Long Video Generation
summary: Latent video generators are trained on clips of a few seconds, and much of this limit lies in their tokenizers, which spend as many tokens on a static frame as on a moving one and need future frames that do not exist during generation. We introduce DeltaRAE, a causal representation autoencoder for video. Its derivative tokenization encodes periodic anchor frames in full and all remaining frames with a few tokens each, and its causal encoder and decoder read a frozen pretrained image encoder. On UCF-101 and Kinetics-600, a standard diffusion transformer trained on DeltaRAE latents is competitive with state-of-the-art video tokenizers. DeltaRAE halves the tokenizer GFLOPs on 16-frame clips relative to keeping the same number of patch tokens for every frame, and it represents a minute of video with 18.8x fewer tokens. The tokenizer trains end to end on one-minute videos, and in video prediction a generator on its latents produces a full minute of video. The same generator collapses within 15 seconds in most videos when the tokenizer has the same token budget but no pretrained encoder.

AI.tldr: DeltaRAE 是一种面向视频的因果表征自编码器，通过“导数式”分词（周期性锚帧全量编码、其余帧仅用少量 token）实现高效长视频建模，可在单分钟视频上端到端训练，并以 18.8 倍更少的 token 表征一分钟视频。
AI.motivation: 现有潜空间视频生成器仅训练在数秒级片段上，瓶颈主要在分词器：其对静态帧与运动帧分配同样多的 token，且生成时需要尚不存在的未来帧，因而无法支持长时序建模。
AI.method: 提出 DeltaRAE 因果表征自编码器：采用导数式 token 化，对周期性锚帧做全量编码，对其余帧各用少量 token；因果编码器与解码器读取冻结的预训练图像编码器；分词器可在单分钟视频上端到端训练。
AI.result: 在 UCF-101 与 Kinetics-600 上，基于 DeltaRAE 潜变量训练的标准扩散 Transformer 与最先进视频分词器相当；16 帧片段下分词器 GFLOPs 减半；一分钟视频的 token 数减少 18.8 倍；在视频预测任务中，基于其潜变量的生成器可生成整分钟视频。而同等 token 预算但无预训练编码器的分词器，其生成器在多数视频中 15 秒内即崩溃。
AI.conclusion: DeltaRAE 通过因果化与锚帧—增量式 token 分配，兼顾token 效率与生成质量，验证了冻结预训练图像编码器对长视频潜空间稳定性的关键作用，为分钟级视频生成提供了可行路径。

title: SMOTE 25 Years of Magic: What Has Been Done, What the Evidence Shows, and Whom It Reached
comment: 60 pages, 10 figures, 17 tables. The online appendix (55 pages) is an ancillary file. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24212321
summary: Background. SMOTE was published in this journal in 2002 and reviewed here at its fifteenth anniversary in 2018. At twenty-five it is cited by more than 34,000 indexed works, half of them outside computer science. Objectives. To establish what the methods built on SMOTE change, how strong the evidence for them is, and whom the technique has reached. Methods. We audited a curated corpus of 76 papers, 37 of which propose a SMOTE-family generator, and tested its coverage with a systematic search of 22,426 records in the PRISMA 2020 format. From the corpus we collected 1,756 dataset entries, 1,511 published comparisons with SMOTE and the evaluation design of 71 studies; from the search we drew 300 applications of SMOTE at random. We used an agentic AI approach to extract, screen and code under our written rules, and we report how each step was checked. Results. Every variant re-decides some of the six decisions of the SMOTE rule, and 24 of the 37 are only ever run on two classes. In their own papers, proposed methods beat SMOTE in 79.0% of the decided comparisons, but independent studies find that the gains shrink with strong learners and tuned thresholds, and that resampling damages calibration. The corpus holds 52 of the 3,097 records that pass the screen and covers the early years closely, the recent ones thinly. The reach is very wide, but a benefit at the level of outcomes is undemonstrated, four harms are documented, and an estimated 37% of applications resample the whole data set before splitting it. Conclusions. For tabular classification, a new SMOTE variant should no longer count as a contribution in itself: a new generator should be tested one decision at a time against class weighting and a tuned threshold with a strong learner, with calibration reported. We close with a selection guide, a reporting checklist of fifteen items and a research agenda.

AI.tldr: 该文是对SMOTE二十五周年的系统性审计：文献中37个SMOTE族生成器仅是对SMOTE六项决策的重新取舍（其中24个仅在二分类上验证），自报79.0%比较优于SMOTE但独立研究显示强学习器与调优阈值下收益收缩、重采样损害校准；SMOTE应用极广但缺乏结局层面收益证据、已记录四类危害，约37%应用在划分前对全量数据重采样。作者主张新型SMOTE变体本身不应再视为贡献，需逐决策对照类别加权与调优阈值并报告校准，并给出选择指南、15项报告清单与研究议程。
AI.motivation: SMOTE自2002年发表、2018年十五周年综述后，至二十五周年已被逾34,000项索引工作引用（半数来自计算机科学之外）。作者旨在回答三个问题：基于SMOTE构建的方法究竟改变了什么、其证据强度如何、该技术实际影响了哪些领域，从而检验这一高被引方法的真实贡献与使用规范性。
AI.method: 采用审计式研究设计：(1) 构建精选语料库76篇论文，其中37篇提出SMOTE族生成器；收集1,756条数据集条目、1,511项与SMOTE的已发表比较、71项研究的评估设计；(2) 以PRISMA 2020格式系统检索22,426条记录检验覆盖度，并从中随机抽取300个SMOTE应用案例；(3) 将SMOTE规则分解为六项决策以归类变体改动；(4) 使用智能体式AI（agentic AI）在书面规则下完成抽取、筛选与编码，并逐步骤报告核验方式。
AI.result: 所有变体均只是重新决定SMOTE六项决策中的部分决策，37个生成器中有24个仅在两类别问题上运行。在其自身论文中，所提方法在已判定的比较中79.0%优于SMOTE；但独立研究表明，面对强学习器与调优阈值时增益收缩，且重采样会损害概率校准。语料库仅含通过筛选的3,097条记录中的52条，早期年份覆盖较密、近年覆盖稀疏。SMOTE影响面极广，但结局层面的收益未被证实，已记录四类危害，估计约37%的应用在划分训练/测试集之前即对全量数据重采样（导致数据泄漏）。
AI.conclusion: 面向表格数据分类，新的SMOTE变体本身不应再被计为贡献：新生成器应在强学习器下，针对类别加权与调优阈值、逐一决策进行对照检验，并报告校准指标。文中给出选择指南、15项报告清单及研究议程。

title: SIA: Selective Image Analogy
comment: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 (Conference Papers). 28 pages including supplementary material. Project page: https://selective-image-analogy.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/alimohammadiamirhossein/selective-image-analogy Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/selective-image-analogy/SIA-Multi-Edit-Analogy
summary: Image analogy transfers a demonstrated transformation from a before/after pair (A, A') to a new query image B. Existing methods assume all changes in (A, A') should be fully transferred, limiting flexibility when users want only a subset of the demonstrated edits. We introduce Selective Image Analogy (SIA), a new setting where a single demonstration pair encodes multiple edits, and the user selects at inference time which edits to apply to B. To support this, we curate a multi-edit analogy dataset with full-edit and partial-edit targets. We then train a model that first learns to transfer the complete demonstrated transformation, and then gains selective control through a mask-aligned suppression mechanism: a token-gated LoRA that restricts adapter updates to suppressed edit tokens during denoising, paired with a concept suppression vector that weakens the selected tokens in the text embeddings before denoising. Together, these components allow SIA to suppress unwanted edits that remain visible in A', while preserving the user-selected ones, all without requiring a new demonstration pair for each edit combination. We perform extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations along with user studies to demonstrate the efficacy of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出选择性图像类比（SIA）新设定，单示例对编码多种编辑，用户推理时选择应用哪些编辑，无需为每种编辑组合重新给示例。
AI.motivation: 现有图像类比方法假设示例对(A,A')中的全部变化都要被完全迁移，用户只想应用其中部分编辑时缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: 构建含全部编辑与部分编辑目标的多编辑类比数据集；先训练模型学习迁移完整示例变换，再通过"掩码对齐抑制"机制获得选择性控制：token门控LoRA在去噪时将适配器更新限制在被抑制的编辑token上，配合概念抑制向量在去噪前削弱文本嵌入中的选中token。
AI.result: 可抑制A'中仍可见的多余编辑，同时保留用户所选编辑，且无需为每种编辑组合准备新示例对；大量定量、定性实验及用户研究验证了方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: SIA为图像类比提供了灵活可控的部分编辑迁移能力，验证了选择性抑制在单示例多编辑场景下的可行性。

title: Resilience Analysis Through Automated Stage Identification and Quantitative Assessment
summary: This paper introduced an ML-based approach, designed to be domain- and threat-agnostic, for automated recognition of PARA (Plan/Prepare, Absorb, Recover, Adapt) resilience stages in system-performance time series, enabling subsequent quantitative resilience analysis across different systems. We investigate four ML models for resilience stage recognition: Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM), and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost). We then use the ML models' predictions to quantify system resilience by computing corresponding resilience metrics from system-performance data observed before, during, and after disruptive events. We evaluate the proposed approach using datasets from two distinct operational domain network systems and an airport transportation system, demonstrating its domain-agnostic applicability to resilience assessment. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of resilience stage classification, with the best F1-scores ranging from 74.3% to 99.4% across all resilience stages. The overall resilience metrics R_t and RL are estimated, with the best models' MAPE ranging from 0.35-0.82% on IEEE 802.11 and LTE to 1.65-9.56% for the airport. These results provide a basis for threat-agnostic resilience analysis of complex engineering systems, enabling further assessment of how effectively a system withstands, absorbs, and recovers from disruptive events and stress conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种领域与威胁无关的机器学习方法，自动识别系统性能时间序列中的PARA（Plan/Prepare、Absorb、Recover、Adapt）韧性阶段，并据此量化系统韧性。
AI.motivation: 现有韧性分析通常依赖特定领域知识或针对特定威胁建模，缺乏通用性；需要一种可跨系统、跨威胁的自动化韧性阶段识别与量化方法。
AI.method: 比较随机森林（RF）、支持向量机（SVM）、LightGBM、XGBoost 四种模型对PARA韧性阶段的分类识别，并利用预测结果计算事件前、中、后的系统性能韧性指标。
AI.result: 在两个不同运营领域的网络系统（IEEE 802.11、LTE）及机场交通系统数据上验证：各阶段最佳F1为74.3%–99.4%；韧性指标R_t与RL的最佳模型MAPE在IEEE 802.11和LTE上为0.35–0.82%，机场为1.65–9.56%。
AI.conclusion: ML方法可实现领域无关的韧性阶段识别与韧性量化，为复杂工程系统的威胁无关韧性分析及系统抗扰、吸收与恢复能力评估提供基础。

title: TWIST: Teacher-Weighted Initial-Noise Spherical Transform for Quality-Preserving Diversity in Distilled Diffusion Models
summary: Timestep-distilled diffusion models generate high-quality images in one or a few steps, but often suffer from reduced mode coverage and limited diversity. Recent methods improve diversity by optimizing the initial noise at inference time, requiring costly backpropagation through the denoiser. Moreover, their diversity objectives typically repel generated samples without accounting for how the corresponding teacher model distributes its outputs. We introduce Teacher-Weighted Initial-noise Spherical Transform (TWIST), a lightweight network that transforms the low-frequency components of initial noise to improve diversity without inference-time optimization. TWIST uses a teacher-guided determinantal point process (DPP) objective to align the feature-space diversity of student samples with that of the teacher. By amortizing noise optimization into a single network, TWIST eliminates inference-time backpropagation while preserving the efficiency of few-step generation. On SDXL-Turbo, TWIST matches the diversity of MoNO at less than 25% of its inference cost, while achieving higher recall and better PickScore, ImageReward, and CLIPScore under matched compute budgets. On SDXL-Lightning, it achieves comparable recall at lower cost without the ImageReward degradation observed with MoNO.

AI.tldr: TWIST：用轻量网络变换初始噪声低频分量，以教师引导的DPP目标对齐学生与教师的特征空间多样性，无需推理时反传即可提升少步扩散模型的多样性。
AI.motivation: 时间步蒸馏扩散模型（如SDXL-Turbo、SDXL-Lightning）能一步或少步生成高质量图像，但模式覆盖不足、多样性下降。现有改进方法在推理时优化初始噪声，需对去噪器反复反传，成本高；且其多样性目标仅使样本相互排斥，未考虑教师模型如何分配输出。
AI.method: 提出TWIST（Teacher-Weighted Initial-noise Spherical Transform）：一个轻量网络，直接变换初始噪声的低频分量以提升多样性，无需推理时优化；采用教师引导的行列式点过程（DPP）目标，使学生样本的特征空间多样性与教师样本的多样性分布对齐；将噪声优化摊销到单一网络中。
AI.result: 在SDXL-Turbo上，TWIST以不到MoNO 25%的推理成本达到与其相当的多样性，且在同等算力预算下召回率更高，PickScore、ImageReward、CLIPScore更优；在SDXL-Lightning上，以更低成本取得可比召回率，且未出现MoNO那样的ImageReward退化。
AI.conclusion: 将推理时噪声优化摊销为前馈变换，并借助教师分布加权对齐多样性，可在保持少步生成效率的同时有效恢复蒸馏扩散模型的模式覆盖。

title: Kant-Q: A Q-Learning Algorithm for Kantian Equilibrium in Symmetric Markov Games
summary: AI agents increasingly interact with one another, and many of these interactions are mixed-motive games, which have posed a persistent challenge for learning algorithms. Most multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) algorithms are designed to reach Nash equilibria, yet in many such games these equilibria are Pareto-inefficient. We instead study Kantian equilibria, an economic solution concept in which each agent plays the action it would want all agents to adopt. In symmetric games, this corresponds to an optimal common policy. We propose Kant-Q, a Q-learning algorithm in which each agent learns action profiles where all agents play the same action. Each update is then a sample from a single-agent MDP, so Kant-Q inherits the convergence guarantees of standard Q-learning. We show that every symmetric Markov game has a pure Kantian equilibrium. We also prove that all agents' Q-tables converge to the same limit, whose greedy policy is such an equilibrium, and that greedy play converges whenever the optimal common action is unique at every state. We further show that in a subclass of symmetric monotone games, the Kantian equilibrium is Pareto-efficient among pure strategy profiles and strictly individually rational. Empirically, on the iterated Prisoner's Dilemma and the GovSim fishery with up to 200 agents, Kant-Q learns the Kantian equilibrium, while the baselines underperform. Since copies of the same AI system naturally face one another in symmetric games, these results suggest universalization as a design principle for cooperative AI-AI interaction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Kant-Q：一种让每个智能体学习"全体同动作"配对的 Q-learning 算法，其更新等价于单智能体 MDP 采样，因而继承标准 Q-learning 收敛性；理论上证明对称马尔可夫博弈存在纯 Kantian 均衡、所有 Q 表收敛到同一极限且贪婪策略即该均衡；实验在迭代囚徒困境和 200 智能体的 GovSim 渔业中成功学到 Kantian 均衡。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体之间日益频繁地互动，其中大量是混合动机博弈。主流 MARL 算法以 Nash 均衡为目标，但在这类博弈中 Nash 均衡往往 Pareto 低效。作者转而采用经济学中的 Kantian 均衡概念——每个智能体选择"希望所有人都采纳"的动作，在对称博弈中即对应一个最优的共同策略，从而为合作型 AI-AI 交互提供设计原则。
AI.method: 提出 Kant-Q：每个智能体维护 Q 表但只学习"所有智能体采取同一动作"的动作剖面（action profile），即对共同动作做价值估计。由于每次更新等价于单智能体 MDP 中的一次采样，算法继承标准 Q-learning 的收敛保证。理论上：（1）证明每个对称马尔可夫博弈都存在纯 Kantian 均衡；（2）证明所有智能体的 Q 表收敛到相同极限，其贪婪策略是一个 Kantian 均衡；（3）证明当每个状态下最优共同动作唯一时，贪婪策略博弈收敛；（4）在一类对称单调博弈中证明 Kantian 均衡在所有纯策略剖面中 Pareto 有效且严格个体理性。实验在迭代囚徒困境与 GovSim 渔业（最多 200 个智能体）上，与多种基线对比。
AI.result: 在迭代囚徒困境和 GovSim 渔业环境中，Kant-Q 能够学习到 Kantian 均衡，而基线方法表现不佳（underperform）。理论上给出了生存性（存在纯 Kantian 均衡）、收敛性（Q 表一致性极限）与效率性（对称单调博弈中的 Pareto 有效与严格个体理性）三方面保证。
AI.conclusion: 由于同一 AI 系统的多个副本在对称博弈中天然互为对手，Kant-Q 的结果支持将"普遍化"（universalization）作为合作型 AI-AI 交互的设计原则；该算法简洁、可扩展且具备收敛与效率保证。

title: RelPRM: Grounding Visual Process Reward Models in Relational Evidence
summary: Visual process reward models (PRMs) can detect calculation errors yet assign high scores to steps that misread visual relations. Supervision based on subsequent answer success does not directly establish whether a step's relational claim holds. To strengthen visual-relation verification, we first build an automated pipeline that programmatically verifies each claim and identifies the required objects, relations, and image regions. It produces RelProcessTrain and RelProcessBench (RPB), which tests whether scores respond appropriately to relational evidence through controlled image edits and step rephrasings. Building on this pipeline, we further introduce RelPRM, a visual-relation-oriented method for process reward modeling with two training mechanisms. Relation-evidence self-distillation constructs views preserving necessary objects, relations, and dependencies, reducing the burden of finding decisive evidence in complex scenes and transferring reliable evidence-assisted judgments to full images. Relation-evidence-driven consistency training encourages appropriate score changes when relation edits reverse a step's truth, stability under irrelevant edits, and similar score changes across paraphrases. At inference, RelPRM directly scores the current step using only the original image and reasoning context. RelPRM achieves 66.2% on VisualProcessBench (VPB) and 68.4% on RPB, gains of 4.2 and 9.9 percentage points over VisualPRM-8B. These results show that training for visual relations improves both relational verification and step assessment across broader multimodal reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 针对视觉PRM"能查计算错误、却对误读视觉关系的步骤给出高分"的问题，本文构建自动化关系证据验证流水线，产出RelProcessTrain与RelProcessBench(RPB)，并提出关系导向的RelPRM(关系证据自蒸馏+关系证据驱动一致性训练)，在VPB达66.2%、RPB达68.4%，分别较VisualPRM-8B提升4.2与9.9个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉过程奖励模型(PRM)虽能检测计算错误，但对误读视觉关系的推理步骤仍给高分；而基于"后续答案是否成功"的监督并不能直接判定某一步的关系性陈述是否成立，因此需要强化对视觉关系的验证能力。
AI.method: 1) 构建自动化流水线，程序化验证每个步骤陈述，标注所需对象、关系与图像区域，生成训练集RelProcessTrain与基准RelProcessBench(RPB)，RPB通过受控图像编辑与步骤改写检验打分是否随关系证据合理变化；2) 提出RelPRM，含两种机制：关系证据自蒸馏(构造保留必要对象、关系与依赖关系的视图，降低在复杂场景中定位决定性证据的难度，并把证据辅助下的可靠判断迁移到完整图像)与关系证据驱动的一致性训练(关系反转时分数应改变、无关编辑下应稳定、改写间分数变化应一致)；3) 推理时仅用原始图像与推理上下文直接打分。
AI.result: RelPRM在VisualProcessBench(VPB)上达66.2%，在RPB上达68.4%，相对VisualPRM-8B分别提升4.2和9.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 面向视觉关系的训练同时提升了关系验证能力与步骤评估质量，并可泛化到更广泛的多模态推理任务。

title: Investigating the efficacy of vortex beam speckle patterns for the recognition of atmospheric turbulence and fractional topological charge with a deep learning model
summary: Fractional topological charge (TC) enlarges the usable mode set of orbital angular momentum (OAM) links, but reading it reliably after atmospheric turbulence remains difficult. Interferometric and diffractive methods need an undistorted beam and a careful alignment, while most learned approaches treat integer or coarsely spaced charges and do not include turbulence. Here we ask whether the charge of a scalar vortex beam can be regressed directly from a single speckle image, and at which turbulence strength this stops working. We propagate vortex beams over 1500~m through 150 von Kármán phase screens, scatter them with a fixed random diffuser, and record $256\times256$, 16-bit speckle images for TC from 0 to 10 in steps of 0.01 and turbulence strengths $D/r_0$ from 0 to 50; the results reported here use a subset of 20\,000 images, and a data set of $10^{6}$ images is in preparation. A convolutional neural network estimates the TC and, through an auxiliary head, the turbulence category. On charges withheld from training, the mean absolute error is 0.031 without turbulence (with a common intensity scale) and rises to 0.78 at $D/r_0=10$ and 1.85 at $D/r_0=50$, against 2.5 for a constant prediction, and the turbulence category is identified correctly in 78\% of the images. The results show that, at the present training size, the charge is read accurately only without turbulence, and that the charge and the turbulence oth act on the speckle grain size, which may limit the readout. Experimental validation and the extension to vector vortex beams are left for future work.

AI.tldr: 该文提出用单个散斑图像直接回归标量涡旋光束的分数拓扑荷（TC），并考察湍流强度何时使该读出失效。在1500 m传播、150张von Kármán相位屏、固定随机散射体条件下生成256×256、16位散斑数据（TC 0–10、步长0.01；D/r0 0–50），以卷积网络加辅助湍流分类头进行估计。结果显示无湍流时MAE为0.031，D/r0=10时升至0.78、D/r0=50时1.85（常值预测为2.5），湍流类别识别率78%，表明当前训练规模下仅无湍流时可准确读出。
AI.motivation: 分数拓扑荷可扩展OAM链路的可用模式集，但经大气湍流后难以可靠读出：干涉法与衍射法要求无畸变光束和精细对准，而多数学习方法只处理整数或粗间隔电荷且不含湍流。作者因此追问：能否仅凭单幅散斑图像回归标量涡旋光束的电荷，以及该读出在何种湍流强度下失效。
AI.method: 构建散斑成像链路：涡旋光束经1500 m传播、通过150张von Kármán相位屏，再经固定随机散射体形成散斑，采集256×256、16位图像；参数覆盖TC 0–10（步长0.01）与湍流强度D/r0 0–50。采用卷积神经网络主头回归TC、辅助头进行湍流类别分类；本文报告基于20000幅图像子集的结果，10^6幅数据集在制备中。评估采用训练中未出现的电荷。
AI.result: 在未见电荷上，无湍流（统一强度尺度）时MAE为0.031；湍流下MAE升至D/r0=10时的0.78和D/r0=50时的1.85，而常值预测的MAE为2.5。湍流类别在78%的图像中被正确识别。
AI.conclusion: 在当前训练数据规模下，电荷仅在无湍流时可被准确读出，湍流下精度显著退化。作者指出电荷与湍流均作用于散斑颗粒尺度，可能构成读出性能的限制因素；实验验证与向矢量涡旋光束的扩展留待后续工作。

title: A Simple Yet Effective Agent for Open-World Aerial Object Search
summary: Open-world aerial object search methods often rely on persistent spatial maps, learned world models, or task-specific policy training. To examine how far a minimal, training-free design can go, we introduce SimpleUAV, an agent built around a frozen, off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM). SimpleUAV separates current-view target assessment from history-conditioned action selection, combining fresh candidate evidence with lightweight search context. Local geometry converts visual selections into bounded straight-line movements, depth-based checks halt blocked segments, and measured execution feedback guides subsequent decisions. This closed loop sustains search without persistent spatial maps or task-specific training. SimpleUAV achieves 41.61% Success Rate (SR) on UAV-ON and 11.98% on AerialDojo-200K, compared with 23.80% and 3.20% for the strongest prior baselines, respectively. With limited benchmark-specific adaptation, the same core agent transfers to aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) on TravelUAV, improving Full SR by at least 19.66% across all three splits under L1 assistance. These results establish a strong baseline for evaluating when additional architectural complexity benefits aerial search.

AI.tldr: 提出SimpleUAV：仅依托冻结的现成视觉语言模型（VLM），无需持续空间地图、世界模型或任务专用策略训练，即可完成开放世界空中目标搜索。
AI.motivation: 现有开放世界空中目标搜索方法依赖持续空间地图、学习式世界模型或任务专用策略训练，架构与训练成本高。作者希望检验"最小化、免训练"设计能达到的上限，为判断何时需要增加架构复杂度提供对照基线。
AI.method: 将"当前视角目标评估"与"历史条件动作选择"解耦：前者用冻结VLM从当前视角给出新鲜候选证据，后者结合轻量搜索上下文做决策；再由局部几何把视觉选择转换为有界直线运动，基于深度的检查中止被遮挡航段，并以实测执行反馈驱动后续决策，形成闭环，全程不使用持续空间地图与任务专用训练。
AI.result: UAV-ON上成功率达41.61%（此前最强基线23.80%），AerialDojo-200K上达11.98%（基线3.20%）；经少量基准适配后同一核心智能体迁移至TravelUAV的空中VLN任务，在L1辅助下三个划分的Full SR均至少提升19.66%。
AI.conclusion: 极简、免训练、基于冻结VLM的智能体即可显著超越既有空中搜索基线，并可低成本迁移到空中VLN，为评估额外架构复杂度是否必要提供了强基线。

title: Tortho-Gaussian++: Suppressing Geometric Drift and Floaters for Robust Gravity-Aligned TDOM Generation in Large-Scale Aerial Scenes
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated remarkable performance in aerial scene reconstruction, motivating its recent extension to true digital orthophoto maps (TDOMs) generation. We propose Tortho-Gaussian++, a novel 3DGS training framework that suppresses geometric drift and floaters and automatically prunes unreliable peripheral regions, coupled with a robust gravity-aligned TDOM rendering solution. First, we explore geometric support via viewing-ray-based geometric observability analysis, quantitatively characterizing the reliability for each Gaussian and subsequently pruning peripheral regions with particularly weak geometric support. Second, the optimizer state initialization is refined for newly created Gaussians during densification, intrinsically suppressing drift and floaters without external priors. Lastly, a robust gravity direction estimation solution is designed, combining image-derived gravity cues, camera-distribution priors and nadir views, to achieve a gravity-aligned orthogonal projection reference for TDOM rendering. Extensive experiments on multiple large-scale UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) datasets demonstrate that our Tortho-Gaussian++ outperforms vanilla 3DGS by 0.5-3.5 dB in average PSNR and yields comparable or superior performance to prior-guided 3DGS methods. Notably, it reduces the training time, VRAM and Gaussian number by 45.5%, 47.2%, and 58.6%, respectively. Qualitative evaluations confirm that our method effectively suppresses drift and floaters, while robust gravity direction estimation reduces tilt-induced facade artifacts in TDOMs.

AI.tldr: 提出Tortho-Gaussian++框架，通过几何可观测性分析剪枝外围区域、优化致密化时新高斯的优化器状态初始化、以及鲁棒重力方向估计，实现抑制漂移与浮点伪影的重力对齐TDOM渲染，在大规模UAV数据集上优于原始3DGS 0.5-3.5 dB PSNR，并显著降低训练时间、显存与高斯数量。
AI.motivation: 3DGS在航拍场景重建中表现优异，已被扩展到真数字正射影像图（TDOM）生成，但存在几何漂移与浮点伪影（floaters）问题，外围弱观测区域不可靠，且渲染正射影像需要准确的重力对齐方向，否则产生立面倾斜伪影。
AI.method: 1）基于视线的几何可观测性分析，定量刻画每个高斯的可靠性，并剪枝几何支撑特别弱的外围区域；2）在致密化过程中改进新建高斯的优化器状态初始化，无需外部先验即可内在抑制漂移与浮点；3）设计鲁棒重力方向估计，融合图像重力线索、相机分布先验与天底视角，获得重力对齐的正交投影参考用于TDOM渲染。
AI.result: 在多组大规模UAV数据集上，平均PSNR较原始3DGS提升0.5-3.5 dB，性能与先验引导的3DGS方法相当或更优；训练时间、显存与高斯数量分别减少45.5%、47.2%、58.6%。定性结果表明方法有效抑制漂移与浮点伪影，鲁棒重力估计减少TDOM中倾斜导致的立面伪影。
AI.conclusion: Tortho-Gaussian++通过几何可观测性驱动的剪枝、优化器状态初始化和鲁棒重力对齐，在不依赖外部先验的情况下实现高质量、高效率的TDOM生成。

title: Tune for Retention, Not Just Gain: SFT Forgets Far Less than You Think
summary: Catastrophic forgetting, the drastic loss of previously acquired capabilities when learning new ones, is a central challenge in language model fine-tuning. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is widely believed to be prone to such forgetting. Recent works have attributed this to the off-policy nature of SFT, arguing that on-policy learning is key to continual learning. In this paper, we challenge this premise. We show that while maximizing new-task performance can induce catastrophic forgetting, alternative hyperparameter choices (lower learning rate and batch size) can yield similar gains with little to no forgetting. With hyperparameters selected jointly for gain and retention, vanilla SFT retains prior capabilities far better than previously suggested and can be competitive with Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT), an on-policy approach designed to mitigate forgetting. While SDFT can be more robust to hyperparameter choices, it also requires a retention-aware criterion to identify hyperparameter configurations that avoid catastrophic forgetting. Our results challenge the view that on-policy training is what enables learning with retention and raise broader questions about what drives catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战"SFT的off-policy本质导致灾难性遗忘、on-policy学习是持续学习关键"这一主流观点：通过同时优化新任务增益与旧能力保持来选择超参数（更小学习率与batch size），vanilla SFT可显著缓解遗忘，并可与on-policy的SDFT相竞争。
AI.motivation: 灾难性遗忘是语言模型微调的核心难题。既有工作将SFT易导致遗忘归因于其off-policy特性，主张on-policy学习是持续学习的关键。作者认为该归因可能混淆了"追求新任务性能最大化"与"算法范式"本身的作用，需要重新审视遗忘的真正驱动因素。
AI.method: 以vanilla SFT为对象，考察不同超参数（学习率、batch size）配置下新任务增益与旧能力保留的权衡关系；提出按"增益+保留"联合准则选择超参数；并与on-policy方法Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning（SDFT）进行对比，检验其对超参数的鲁棒性及是否仍需保留感知（retention-aware）的选参准则。
AI.result: 单纯最大化新任务性能确实会诱发灾难性遗忘；但采用更低学习率与更小batch size可取得相近增益而几乎不遗忘。在联合选参下，vanilla SFT的旧能力保留远优于既往结论，且与SDFT具竞争力。SDFT对超参数更鲁棒，但同样需要retention-aware准则才能避免灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: on-policy训练并非实现"学习新任务同时保留旧能力"的必要条件；SFT的遗忘在很大程度上是超参数与优化配置问题而非范式必然。这动摇了现有归因，并引出关于微调中灾难性遗忘真正成因的更广泛问题。

title: FoundSurface: Feedforward Ray-Based 3D Scene Surface Reconstruction from Unposed Images
summary: Accurate 3D surface reconstruction from unposed images remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision. Recent feed-forward pointmap methods eliminate the need for camera poses but inherently produce discrete, sparse representations. In this paper, we present a generalizable pipeline that directly recovers continuous, high-fidelity 3D surfaces from unposed images by seamlessly integrating pointmap- and ray-based representations. Our approach first extracts explicit geometric priors using a pre-trained pointmap model. A query-view-centric selection module then identifies geometrically relevant reference views via a robust surfel voting mechanism. Next, a cross-attention regressor bridges target query rays with reference features to estimate a continuous coarse surface. Lastly, a raylet-based module aggregates local 3D features to carve out high-frequency details and analytical normals. Trained as a single foundation model on 9 diverse datasets, our method demonstrates exceptional zero-shot generalization on 6 unseen datasets, clearly surpassing state-of-the-art baselines in geometric accuracy and detail preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出一个可从无位姿图像直接重建连续高保真三维表面的前馈式通用管线，融合pointmap与ray表示。
AI.motivation: 无位姿图像的精确三维表面重建仍是计算机视觉基础难题；现有前馈pointmap方法虽免去相机位姿需求，但只能输出离散、稀疏的表示，难以获得连续高保真表面。
AI.method: 先用预训练pointmap模型提取显式几何先验；再由以查询视角为中心的选择模块通过鲁棒surfel投票机制挑出几何相关的参考视角；接着用跨注意力回归器将目标查询射线与参考特征关联，估计连续粗表面；最后由基于raylet的模块聚合局部三维特征，刻画高频细节并给出解析法向。整体以单一基础模型在9个数据集上训练。
AI.result: 作为单一基础模型训练后，在6个未见数据集上展现出色的零样本泛化能力，在几何精度与细节保真度上明显优于现有SOTA基线。
AI.conclusion: 将pointmap与ray表示无缝整合，可从前馈无位姿输入直接获得连续高保真表面，并具备强泛化性，为无位姿三维重建提供了通用方案。

title: Event-WAM: Learning to Act with Event-Derived Futures
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) leverage future visual modeling for robotic action learning, with recent studies exploring alternative or complementary objectives beyond conventional RGB prediction. We introduce Event-WAM, which incorporates event-derived visual changes as auxiliary future supervision alongside RGB. Event-WAM constructs temporally structured event representations from RGB demonstrations and encodes them using a frozen pretrained RGB video VAE, without training an event-specific VAE. Joint RGB--Event latent flow matching provides appearance- and change-oriented supervision without requiring event observations or explicit future generation at inference. Across simulated benchmarks, Event-WAM maintains comparable performance under standard conditions, while robustness gains under perturbations are benchmark-dependent, including improvements on LIBERO-Plus. Real-world evaluations further demonstrate improved manipulation success under both standard and unseen perturbation conditions. Further analyses show that policy improvements are not consistently accompanied by higher future prediction fidelity, suggesting the potential of change-oriented supervision for action learning.

AI.tldr: 提出Event-WAM，将事件相机衍生的视觉变化作为RGB之外的辅助未来监督，用冻结的预训练RGB视频VAE编码事件表示并做联合RGB-Event隐空间流匹配，推理时无需事件输入或显式未来生成。
AI.motivation: World Action Models依赖未来视觉建模来学习机器人动作，但现有研究多在RGB预测之外寻找替代或补充目标；事件信号天然刻画视觉变化，可作为变化导向的监督，而无需额外训练事件专用VAE或引入事件传感器。
AI.method: 从RGB示范中构造时间结构化的事件表示，并直接用冻结的预训练RGB视频VAE编码（不训练事件专用VAE）；在隐空间中对RGB与Event两路未来做联合流匹配，从而同时提供外观导向与变化导向的监督；推理阶段不依赖事件观测，也不显式生成未来帧。
AI.result: 仿真基准上标准条件下性能与基线相当，扰动鲁棒性提升依基准而异（如LIBERO-Plus上有改进）；真实机器人实验在标准与未见扰动条件下操作成功率均有提升；分析显示策略改进并不总伴随更高的未来预测保真度。
AI.conclusion: 以视觉变化为导向的辅助监督可有效提升动作学习，且其收益不依赖于未来预测精度的提升，为WAMs的目标设计提供了新视角。

title: ChemoMAE: Self-Supervised Spectral Representation Learning Reveals Chemical Heterogeneity in Historical Wood
comment: 51 pages, 18 figures (9 in the main text and 9 in the appendices)
summary: In historical timber buildings, multiple environmental factors act over centuries on wood whose chemical composition varies across anatomical regions, producing complex patterns of degradation. Understanding how timber members degrade is important for the effective conservation and restoration of historical buildings, yet the mechanisms underlying these patterns remain unclear. To investigate these mechanisms, we used self-supervised learning to establish a common basis for comparing specimens from timber members that differ in wood species and service history. We examined transverse sections of 49 wood specimens from several historical buildings in Japan using near-infrared hyperspectral imaging. ChemoMAE, a self-supervised Transformer, learns pixelwise spectral representations through masked denoising that exploits multicollinearity among spectral variables. Clustering these representations yields spatial maps without predefined chemical-state categories. Because anatomy and degradation can produce spatially continuous regions, we formulated Local Label Agreement (LLA) to quantify agreement among labels assigned to neighboring pixels. Using spectra alone, ChemoMAE yielded higher mean LLA than baseline methods on validation specimens. We then trained ChemoMAE anew and fitted cluster centers across all specimens. Spatial structures consistent with wood anatomy and the expected effects of surface exposure emerged in the resulting maps. By cross-referencing regional spectra and spatial distributions across specimens in light of wood anatomy, service histories, and prior studies, we proposed models of internal and surface degradation as mechanistic hypotheses. This exploratory AI for Science framework gives researchers a basis for linking latent patterns learned through self-supervision with domain knowledge when investigating how material states form.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出自监督Transformer方法ChemoMAE，结合近红外高光谱成像分析49件日本历史木构建筑木材试样的降解模式，并用局部标签一致性(LLA)指标验证其空间连续性，进而提出内部与表面降解的机理假设。
AI.motivation: 历史木构建筑中，多种环境因素数百年作用于化学成分随解剖区域变化的木材，形成复杂的降解模式；理解木材构件如何降解对有效保护与修复至关重要，但其机理仍不清楚。此外，不同树种与服役历史的试样之间缺乏可比较的共同基础。
AI.method: 利用自监督学习为不同树种和服役历史的试样建立可比基础。对日本多座历史建筑的49件木材试样横切面进行近红外高光谱成像。ChemoMAE作为自监督Transformer，通过掩码去噪学习逐像素光谱表征，利用光谱变量间的多重共线性；对表征聚类得到无需预设化学状态类别的空间图谱。针对解剖结构与降解可产生空间连续区域的特点，提出局部标签一致性(LLA)指标量化相邻像素标签的一致性。
AI.result: 在验证试样上，仅用光谱信息时ChemoMAE的平均LLA高于基线方法。随后重新训练ChemoMAE并在全部试样上拟合聚类中心，所得图谱呈现与木材解剖结构及表面暴露预期效应一致的空间结构。结合区域光谱、跨试样空间分布及木材解剖、服役历史和既有研究，提出了内部与表面降解的机理模型假设。
AI.conclusion: 该探索性AI for Science框架为研究者在探究材料状态形成机理时，将自监督学习得到的潜在模式与领域知识相联系提供了基础。

title: Can Visual World Models See Force?
summary: World models and vision-language-action policy models are increasingly proposed as foundations for robot manipulation. They predict how scenes evolve and which actions to take, yet successful manipulation depends not solely on following observable trajectories but also on the hidden variable of interaction force. Neurophysiology has shown that humans possess a visual prior for this hidden variable, motivating us to ask the question: Do the representations of visual foundation models also capture the forces involved in an interaction? We define force awareness as the ability of representations to (1) indicate when contact force is applied, (2) track how it changes during an interaction, and (3) reflect how large it is. We probe frozen image, video, world- and policy model representations with a lightweight readout trained on synchronized video and force measurements from two manipulation datasets. Our experiments show that most models capture when contact occurs but not how much force is being applied. Surprisingly, robot post-training does not improve this either, highlighting an important gap in current models capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"力感知"(force awareness)这一表征能力评测概念，指表征能否(1)指示接触力何时施加、(2)跟踪交互过程中的力变化、(3)反映力的大小；并用轻量读出层对冻结的图像、视频、世界模型与策略模型表征进行探测，发现多数模型能捕捉接触发生时刻，却无法捕捉力的大小，且机器人后训练亦无改善。
AI.motivation: 世界模型与视觉-语言-动作(VLA)策略模型日益被用作机器人操作的基础模型，用于预测场景演化与动作选择；但成功操作不仅依赖可观测轨迹，还依赖交互力这一隐变量。神经生理学表明人类具备对该隐变量的视觉先验，故作者追问：视觉基础模型的表征是否也编码了交互中的力信息。现有模型评测缺乏对这类隐藏物理量的表征层面考察。
AI.method: 定义力感知为三项能力：接触力发生检测、交互中力变化的跟踪、力大小的量化反映。构建冻结表征探测框架：在同步采集的视频与力测量数据上训练轻量读出层(lightweight readout)，对图像模型、视频模型、世界模型与策略模型的表征逐一探测；使用两个操作数据集。
AI.result: 多数被探测模型能够判别接触何时发生，但无法表征所施加力的大小；对机器人数据的后训练(robot post-training)并未改善这一能力，表明当前模型在隐藏物理量表征上存在系统性缺口。
AI.conclusion: 视觉基础模型表征存在"接触可知、力不可知"的不对称性，是当前模型能力的重要空白；后续工作需在预训练或后训练中显式引入力相关监督或跨模态对齐，以支撑力敏感的操作策略。

title: UPP-Gauss: Ultrasound Propagation Physics-informed Gaussian Splatting for B-mode Novel-View Synthesis
summary: Accurate novel-view synthesis of B-mode ultrasound images requires modeling acoustic propagation through tissue and the resulting appearance variations across probe poses. We propose Ultrasound Propagation Physics-informed Gaussian Splatting (UPP-Gauss), which integrates these acoustic interactions into an explicit Gaussian representation. UPP-Gauss constructs acoustic maps by sampling three 3D Gaussian fields using the probe pose and acoustic beam propagation direction, then combines these maps according to ultrasound propagation to synthesize B-mode images. Across three acoustically diverse datasets, UPP-Gauss achieves the best reconstruction quality with efficient rendering, improving PSNR over the best baseline on each dataset by 1.43 dB on average. These results demonstrate accurate and efficient B-mode novel-view synthesis through explicit Gaussian modeling of ultrasound propagation.

AI.tldr: 提出UPP-Gauss，将超声传播物理融入显式高斯基元，实现B-mode超声图像的新视角合成，重建质量最优。
AI.motivation: B-mode超声新视角合成的准确性依赖于对组织内声传播过程及不同探头位姿下成像外观变化的建模，现有方法未充分显式刻画这些声学交互。
AI.method: 基于探头位姿与声束传播方向对三个3D高斯场进行采样以构建声学图，再依据超声传播规律组合这些声学图合成B-mode图像，并将声学交互集成进显式高斯表示。
AI.result: 在三个声学特性各异的数据集上均取得最佳重建质量，渲染高效，PSNR平均较最佳基线提升1.43 dB。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式高斯建模刻画超声传播，可实现准确且高效的B-mode新视角合成。

title: Learning from Crowds with Unsupervised Item Response Models
summary: Item Response Theory (IRT) is the study of tests, including the properties of both test items and test takers. Crowdsourced labelling can be cast as an unsupervised IRT problem: annotators play the role of test takers with varying ability, and annotation tasks play the role of items with varying difficulty. We evaluate unsupervised variants of standard logistic IRT models for latent trait recovery and label inference on six datasets with crowdsourced labels and known ground truths. Unsupervised IRT models can recover annotator and item traits (e.g., ability, difficulty and discrimination) reliably across most datasets when compared to supervised variants trained on the ground truth. IRT models seem to be more stable in label inference compared to most baselines, but might not be the best possible choice depending on the dataset. We further propose to use IRT models to inform classifiers during training and compare against existing crowd-learning methods. We find that crowd-learning methods can improve F1 over majority-vote baselines, but no method significantly improves both F1 and calibration. IRT-informed curriculum methods seem to preserve calibration better than other crowd-learning methods, but are not at the frontier regarding F1, and the best crowd-learning methods in terms of F1 seem to be miscalibrated.

AI.tldr: 该文将众包标注建模为无监督IRT问题，在六个有真值的数据集上系统评估无监督IRT模型恢复标注者与题目特质及推断标签的能力，并探索用IRT指导分类器训练。
AI.motivation: 众包标注质量参差，需要合适的潜在特质模型统一刻画标注者能力与任务难度；同时需检验IRT在无监督设定下能否可靠恢复特质并推断标签，以及能否用于改进下游分类器的性能与校准。
AI.method: 将众包标注视为无监督IRT问题（标注者=被试，任务=题目），在六个含已知真值的众包数据集上评估标准logistic IRT模型的无监督变体，并与基于真值训练的有监督变体对比；进一步提出用IRT信息在训练中指导分类器（IRT-informed curriculum），与其他众包学习方法对比F1与校准。
AI.result: 无监督IRT模型在多数数据集上能可靠恢复标注者与题目的特质（能力、难度、区分度），接近有监督变体；标签推断较多数基线更稳定，但未必总为最优。众包学习方法可提升F1超过多数投票基线，但无任何方法能同时显著提升F1与校准；IRT-informed curriculum在保持校准上优于其他方法但F1非最前沿，F1最佳的方法往往校准不佳。
AI.conclusion: 无监督IRT是众包标注的有效建模与标签推断工具，且在保持校准方面具优势，但F1与校准之间存在权衡，不存在普适最优方法，需按数据集与目标选择。

title: ProManO: Beyond Sim(3) for Metric Upgrade of Feed-Forward Geometry with Visual-Inertial Anchors
summary: Upgrading feed-forward geometry to metric scale with visual-inertial odometry (VIO) raises the question of which correction should align dense feed-forward prediction with sparse metric VIO anchors. Existing methods use either a similarity transformation, which cannot represent depth-dependent distortion, or a projective transformation, which alters pre-calibrated intrinsics. We prove that the transformations compatible with pre-calibrated intrinsics form a ten-dimensional manifold. Beyond Sim(3), this manifold contains three degrees of freedom (DoF) that locate the plane at infinity and leave residuals growing quadratically with depth range after any similarity alignment. These DoF are invisible in the image and can be resolved only by metric depth along viewing rays or by multi-view constraints. To estimate them, we propose ProManO, a probabilistic manifold optimization framework in which every anchor is weighted by its along-ray uncertainty and inlier probability within a single expectation-maximization (EM) procedure. ProManO certifies the similarity synchronization and refines the plane at infinity only where it is observable, which guarantees an objective value no worse than that of the optimal similarity alignment. Experiments on EuRoC, CID-SIMS, Oxford Spires, and KITTI-360 demonstrate that ProManO achieves the highest mean F1 and outperforms Sim(3) alignment on all four datasets. The project page is available at https://h0xg.github.io/ProManO/.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明与预标定内参相容的稠密前馈几何校正变换构成十维流形，超出Sim(3)的三维自由度需度量深度或多视图约束才能确定，提出ProManO概率流形优化框架估计这些自由度。
AI.motivation: 将前馈几何升级到度量尺度时，需要确定何种校正能将稠密前馈预测与稀疏度量VIO锚点对齐。现有方法中，相似变换无法表达深度相关畸变，投影变换会改变预标定内参，二者均不理想，因此需要刻画相容内参的正确变换类并加以估计。
AI.method: 先从理论上证明相容预标定内参的变换集合为十维流形，指出其中Sim(3)之外的三维自由度用于定位无穷远平面；再提出ProManO，在单一EM过程中，以每个锚点的沿射线不确定性和内点概率加权，进行概率流形优化，先认证相似同步再仅在可观测处精化无穷远平面。
AI.result: ProManO保证目标值不劣于最优相似对齐；在EuRoC、CID-SIMS、Oxford Spires和KITTI-360四个数据集上取得最高平均F1，且在全部四个数据集上优于Sim(3)对齐。
AI.conclusion: 与内参相容的稠密前馈-稀疏VIO对齐应工作在十维流形而非仅Sim(3)；Sim(3)之外的三个不可见自由度是深度范围二次增长残差的根源，ProManO可在可观测区域稳健估计它们并带来一致性能提升。

title: Towards 360$^\circ$ Embodied UAV Tracking Without Turning
summary: Conventional embodied UAV tracking couples target observability with heading control because targets may leave the field of view of forward-facing cameras. We investigate a complementary paradigm that uses full-spherical perception to follow designated targets without active heading adjustment. To support this setting, we introduce 360UAV-ETrack, a simulation benchmark comprising 2,652 sequences, over 1.73 million synchronized observations, eight tracking tasks, and 150 held-out closed-loop scenarios. We propose 360UAV-TVLA, a panoramic vision--language--action (VLA) framework integrating persistent visual referring (PVR), compressed temporal memory (CTM), and geometry-aligned trajectory supervision (GTS) for instance identification, motion reasoning, and three-dimensional control. Experiments across two VLA backbones show consistent gains over standard fine-tuning, with normalized average tracking frames increasing from 22.56\% to 35.28\% for $π_0$ and from 25.68\% to 33.64\% for $π_{0.5}$. Our benchmark further reveals a substantial gap between offline imitation accuracy and closed-loop tracking reliability, establishing a challenging testbed for future research https://libingyu01.github.io/360UAV-ETrack_360UAV-TVLA/

AI.tldr: 提出全景感知的解耦式无人机跟踪范式，构建360UAV-ETrack基准并提出360UAV-TVLA框架，显著提升开环与闭环跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 传统具身无人机跟踪将目标可观测性与航向控制耦合，前视相机易使目标脱离视野，需通过主动转向来维持观测；本文探索用全球形（全景）感知在不主动调整航向的条件下跟踪指定目标的互补范式，但该设定缺乏数据基准与方法支撑。
AI.method: 构建360UAV-ETrack仿真基准：2,652条序列、超173万条同步观测、8类跟踪任务、150个留出闭环场景；提出360UAV-TVLA全景视觉—语言—动作框架，包含持续视觉指代（PVR）用于实例识别、压缩时序记忆（CTM）用于运动推理、几何对齐轨迹监督（GTS）用于三维控制。
AI.result: 在两个VLA骨干上均优于标准微调：π_0的归一化平均跟踪帧数由22.56%提升至35.28%，π_0.5由25.68%提升至33.64%；基准同时揭示离线模仿精度与闭环跟踪可靠性之间存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: 全景感知可在不进行航向调整的情况下实现有效目标跟踪，验证了解耦范式的可行性；离线精度不能可靠预测闭环表现，360UAV-ETrack为后续研究提供了具有挑战性的测试平台。

title: Automated Batch-Variable Selection for ComBat-Based Radiomic Harmonization
summary:
ComBat harmonizes multicentre radiomic features, but batch variables are usually chosen manually, without a standardized criterion across image acquisition parameters. We propose ParsiComBat, which selects acquisition parameters for ComBat, balancing batch-effect removal against feature-structure preservation and abstaining when technical variation is negligible.
  ParsiComBat ranks candidate acquisition parameters by batch effect, filters redundancy, and scores sequential ComBat corrections. We evaluated it in three experiments: in simulations, testing whether it recovered a known batch variable and abstained without one; in CT (NSCLC-Radiomics) and MRI (MAMA-MIA) cohorts, comparing batch-effect removal against manufacturer (manual), every feasible parameter (greedy) and AutoCombat; and in clinical prediction, internally and externally.
  In simulations, ParsiComBat identified the true batch variable in 92.9% of positive trials and abstained in 99.2% of null controls. In CT, correcting for reconstruction kernel reduced mean k-nearest neighbour batch-effect test from 0.276 to 0.032, almost matching greedy correction of six variables. In MRI, correcting for slice thickness and manufacturer reduced it from 0.680 to 0.325, slightly more than manual selection but less than greedy correction of seven variables. Removing technical variation did not improve clinical discrimination: no strategy, including raw features, differed significantly from ParsiComBat in area under the curve.
  ParsiComBat provides a data-driven framework that removes technical batch effects using minimal acquisition parameters, preserving feature structure and clinical discrimination. It selects variables verifiable against the acquisition protocol and abstains when no correction is needed, supporting transparent, reproducible multicentre radiomics.

AI.tldr: 提出ParsiComBat，一种数据驱动地自动选择ComBat批次变量的框架：按批次效应排序候选采集参数、去除冗余、对序列式ComBat校正打分，并在技术变异可忽略时弃权；在模拟、CT/MRI队列与临床预测三组实验中验证其可恢复真实批次变量、有效去除批次效应且不损害临床判别力。
AI.motivation: ComBat虽可协调多中心影像组学特征，但其批次变量通常依赖人工指定，缺乏跨采集参数的标准化准则，易导致过度校正或校正不足。
AI.method: ParsiComBat先对候选采集参数按批次效应大小排序，进行冗余过滤，再对逐级叠加的ComBat校正结果打分，在"去批次效应"与"保留特征结构"之间权衡，技术变异可忽略时自动弃权。实验设计三部分：(1) 模拟实验检验能否恢复已知批次变量且在无批次时弃权；(2) 在NSCLC-Radiomics（CT）与MAMA-MIA（MRI）队列中，与人工选择厂家、贪心法（纳入全部可行参数）及AutoCombat比较批次效应去除效果；(3) 内部与外部临床预测评估。
AI.result: 模拟中，ParsiComBat在92.9%的正例试验中识别出真实批次变量，在99.2%的零假设对照中弃权。CT队列中校正重建核使k近邻批次效应检验均值由0.276降至0.032，接近纳入六个变量的贪心校正；MRI队列中校正层厚与厂家使该值由0.680降至0.325，略优于人工选择但不及纳入七个变量的贪心校正。去除技术变异并未提升临床判别力：包括原始特征在内，各策略的AUC与ParsiComBat均无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: ParsiComBat提供了以最少采集参数去除技术批次效应的数据驱动框架，既保留特征结构又维持临床判别力；其选定变量可对照采集协议核验，并在无需校正时弃权，有助于实现透明、可重复的多中心影像组学。

title: Who Is Ego? Scaling Cross-View Camera Wearer Identification and Segmentation beyond Humans
summary: A first-person (ego) image reveals what a camera sees, but not who or what carries it. Given a synchronized third-person (exo) image, camera wearer identification asks who is ego: which candidate carries the ego camera? We extend this task beyond humans to robots, vehicles, animals, and drones, and broaden its spatial scope (where is ego) from selecting a provided candidate mask to wearer segmentation with absence prediction and mutual camera localization across ego-exo views. We introduce FindEgo-1M, comprising 1.16M real and simulated ego-exo pairs across 12 wearer types, 17 domains, and 111 test settings. Our approach exploits a geometric relation: the ego camera's projection into the exo image, i.e., the epipole, lies on or near its wearer. We introduce EgoRay-ZS, the first method to turn a frozen feed-forward 3D reconstruction model, VGGT-$Ω$, into a training-free solution for wearer identification and segmentation. Its geometric readout ranks candidate masks or segmentation proposals by angular offset and distance to the ego camera, while the relative pose provides mutual camera directions. We then develop the full EgoRay model through pose-supervised training on FindEgo-1M and label-free test-time adaptation constrained by candidate masks. Without task-specific training, EgoRay-ZS achieves 78.0% identification accuracy on TF2023's original labels, versus 52.9% reported for the dataset-trained PEN. On FindEgo-1M, EgoRay achieves state-of-the-art chance-corrected accuracy of 87.1 and 77.7 on seen and unseen settings. On matched queries, EgoRay also outperforms GPT-6 Astra by 31.6 and 21.3 points on seen and unseen settings, respectively, while running $18\times$ faster. Data, code, and models will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出FindEgo-1M数据集与EgoRay方法，利用ego相机在exo图像中的投影点（对极点）几何关系，实现免训练与训练后的第一人称穿戴者识别、分割及双向相机定位。
AI.motivation: ego图像只反映相机所见，不反映携带者身份与位置；现有穿戴者识别任务局限于人类、空间范围仅限候选掩码选择，缺乏跨载体（机器人、车辆、动物、无人机）与整体空间定位（含缺失预测、分割、互定位）的统一基准。
AI.method: 构建FindEgo-1M（116万对真实与仿真ego-exo数据，12种穿戴者类型、17个域、111种测试设置）；提出EgoRay-ZS，将冻结的前馈3D重建模型VGGT-Ω转为免训练方案，按候选掩码/分割提案与ego相机对极点的角度偏移和距离排序，并由相对位姿给出双向相机方向；再通过位姿监督训练与基于候选掩码的无标签测试时自适应得到完整EgoRay。
AI.result: EgoRay-ZS在TF2023原始标签上达78.0%识别准确率（数据集训练的PEN为52.9%）；FindEgo-1M上EgoRay在seen/unseen设置取得87.1/77.7的chance-corrected准确率；匹配查询下较GPT-6 Astra分别高31.6与21.3分，速度约快18倍。
AI.conclusion: 对极点几何约束是穿戴者定位的有效先验，冻结3D重建模型可零样本迁移至该任务；FindEgo-1M与EgoRay将ego-exo穿戴者识别推广至多载体、多域并统一识别、分割与互定位，数据与模型将开源。

title: BayesPath: Reliability-Aware Bayesian Reasoning for Whole-Slide Pathology Agents
summary: Diagnosing whole-slide images (WSIs) requires hypothesis-driven reasoning: pathologists form a differential diagnosis, seek discriminative evidence, weigh its reliability, and stop once it suffices. However, existing training-free WSI agents lack an explicit framework for such reasoning. They typically use a large language model (LLM) to aggregate the region descriptions of a multimodal LLM (MLLM), without a belief over the candidates or regard for the descriptions' reliability. Consequently, a repeated model error counts as independent evidence for an incorrect diagnosis. We introduce BayesPath, a training-free WSI agent that casts the pathologist's Scan-Look-Weigh-Decide process as reliability-aware Bayesian reasoning. An explicit belief over the candidates is updated with each observation through a reliability-aware likelihood and guides where to look next and when to stop. This likelihood corrects for the models' answer bias, discounts correlated observations, and captures diagnostic confusions estimated without labels. The updates form an interpretable evidence trail of how each observation shapes the belief. On five MultiPathQA tasks spanning slide classification and slide VQA, BayesPath achieves the highest average accuracy among training-free agents, 58.6% against 34.1% for the next best, with large gains on slide classification. On identical observations, Bayesian updating outperforms LLM aggregation on average, even with a larger LLM. BayesPath's belief is also better calibrated than naive Bayes, so uncertain cases can be deferred to pathologists. Code is available at https://github.com/bryanwong17/BayesPath

AI.tldr: BayesPath：一种免训练的全切片图像（WSI）智能体，将病理医生的"扫描—观察—权衡—决策"过程形式化为可靠性感知的贝叶斯推理，在五个 MultiPathQA 任务上取得免训练智能体中最优平均准确率 58.6%（次优 34.1%）。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练 WSI 智能体缺乏显式的假设驱动推理框架：通常由 LLM 聚合 MLLM 的区域描述，既不维护对候选诊断的信念分布，也不考虑描述可靠性，导致同一模型的重复错误被当作独立证据，从而强化错误诊断。
AI.method: 构建显式候选信念分布，随每次观察通过可靠性感知似然进行贝叶斯更新；该似然对模型答案偏置进行校正、对相关观察降权、并利用无标签方式估计的诊断混淆结构；信念驱动下一步观察位置的选取与停止判据，更新过程形成可解释的证据链。整个流程无需训练。
AI.result: 在覆盖切片分类与切片 VQA 的五个 MultiPathQA 任务上，平均准确率 58.6%，显著优于次优免训练智能体的 34.1%，切片分类增益尤为明显；在相同观察序列下，贝叶斯更新平均优于 LLM 聚合（即使后者使用更大的 LLM）；其信念校准优于朴素贝叶斯，可将不确定病例转交病理医生。
AI.conclusion: 显式、可靠性感知的贝叶斯推理可作为免训练 WSI 智能体的有效推理骨架，兼顾准确性、可解释性与校准性，并支持人机协同的病例分诊。

title: DecisionReplay: A Corpus and Offline Simulator for Ensembling Decision Models
summary: Comparing ensembles, routers and cascades requires the output of every model on every item, and its cost. Stored collections built for routing keep no per-option probabilities. We provide a dataset on which ensemble methods, routers and cascades are simulated quickly, without new model calls. DecisionReplay holds the probability vectors of 17 commercial decision models, endpoints that return a probability for every answer option, on 35 benchmarks, with the token counts, billed cost and measured latency of every call, all released. A deterministic simulator replays any policy that selects, combines or cascades them. One well-chosen model per benchmark is hard to beat: pooling all models loses 2.7 accuracy points to it, and stacking gains 1.0 points at 3.4 times its cost. The models are wrong together: two that are both wrong choose the same wrong option in 72% of cases. The best router matches that model at 64% of its cost, and certified early exit cuts the cost of a stacked ensemble by 43% without changing an answer. DecisionReplay makes it cheap and fast to test whether a new method changes these results.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DecisionReplay数据集，存储17个商用决策模型在35个基准上的概率向量、token数、计费成本与实测延迟，并配套确定性模拟器，可免新模型调用快速回放集成、路由与级联策略。
AI.motivation: 比较集成、路由器和级联方法需要每个模型对每个条目的输出及其成本，而现有为路由构建的存储集合不保留各选项的概率，导致方法对比昂贵且不可复现。
AI.method: 构建DecisionReplay数据集：涵盖17个商业决策模型（端点为每个答案选项返回概率）、35个基准，记录每次调用的概率向量、token计数、计费成本和实测延迟，全部公开；并提供确定性的模拟器，回放任意选择、组合或级联这些模型的策略。
AI.result: 每个基准上选一个合适模型很难被超越：全模型池化比其低2.7个准确率点，堆叠以3.4倍成本换取1.0点提升；模型错误高度相关，两个都错的模型在72%的情况下选择同一错误选项；最佳路由器以64%的成本达到该单模型水平；经认证的提前退出在答案不变的情况下将堆叠集成的成本降低43%。
AI.conclusion: DecisionReplay使检验新方法能否改变上述结论变得廉价而快速。

title: Motion Beyond Pixels: Learning Future Visual Representations for Object-Centric Dynamics
summary: Many embodied world models predict future states in latent spaces optimized for RGB reconstruction, which do not explicitly prioritize object-level semantics and geometry relevant to motion generation. We present MotionRep, a visual representation world model that jointly generates future DINO representations and 3D object flow, coupling semantic and geometric information with object-centric dynamics. To make high-dimensional DINO features amenable to generative modeling, we introduce DINO-VAE, which combines temporal and channel compression with latent regularization to produce compact latents while preserving semantic and geometric information. Conditioned on an initial observation, object query points, and a language instruction, a unified diffusion transformer predicts future visual representations and 3D object flow through joint attention. MotionRep employs asymmetric modality-specific noise schedules to keep the visual stream ahead of 3D object flow during joint denoising, allowing progressively refined future visual representations to guide flow generation. Experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that MotionRep outperforms pixel-based baselines in 3D object flow accuracy and generalization to unseen scenes, while requiring only three denoising steps for inference. These results support predictive visual representations as an effective future-state space for object-centric dynamics modeling.

AI.tldr: MotionRep 是一种视觉表征世界模型，同时生成未来 DINO 表征与 3D 物体流，将语义与几何信息同以物体为中心的动力学耦合，在 3D 物体流精度与场景泛化上优于像素基线，且推理仅需 3 步去噪。
AI.motivation: 现有具身世界模型多在面向 RGB 重建优化的潜空间预测未来状态，未显式优先考虑与运动生成相关的物体级语义与几何信息，导致预测空间与运动生成目标不匹配。
AI.method: 提出 DINO-VAE，通过时序与通道压缩结合潜变量正则化，将高维 DINO 特征压缩为紧凑潜变量并保留语义几何信息；以初始观测、物体查询点与语言指令为条件，用统一扩散 Transformer 通过联合注意力同时预测未来视觉表征与 3D 物体流；采用非对称的模态专属噪声调度，使视觉流在联合去噪中领先于 3D 物体流，以逐步细化的未来视觉表征引导流生成。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实机器人操作基准上，MotionRep 在 3D 物体流精度和对未见场景的泛化能力上优于基于像素的基线，推理仅需三步去噪。
AI.conclusion: 预测式视觉表征可作为以物体为中心动力学建模的有效未来状态空间，替代 RGB 重建潜空间。

title: TAT-Det: A Dataset for Testicular Appendage Torsion Detection and Segmentation in Ultrasound Images
summary:
Background: Testicular appendage torsion (TAT) is the leading cause of acute scrotal pain in prepubertal children. Yet, its diagnosis remains challenging due to nonspecific clinical manifestations and the absence of standardized datasets for pediatric acute scrotal emergencies.
  Results: We present TAT-Det, an expert-annotated ultrasound dataset specifically designed for TAT. TAT-Det comprises 2,600 ultrasound images from 1,203 patients collected at the Children's Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine. Each TAT-positive image is accompanied by lesion-level bounding boxes for detection and pixel-level segmentation masks for fine-grained delineation. Annotations were produced through a multi-stage workflow involving independent annotation by board-certified pediatric sonographers, consensus review, and refinement. Baseline benchmarks for object detection and semantic segmentation using representative deep learning models are further provided, with YOLO11m achieving the best detection performance and RWKV-UNet the best segmentation performance.
  Conclusions: TAT-Det addresses the lack of publicly available resources for pediatric emergency ultrasound and establishes a foundation for developing and evaluating artificial intelligence methods for automated TAT analysis.

AI.tldr: 该文提出TAT-Det——首个专家标注的儿童睾丸附件扭转超声数据集（2,600张图像，来自1,203名患者），含病灶级检测框与像素级分割掩膜，并提供检测与分割基线基准（YOLO11m检测最优、RWKV-UNet分割最优）。
AI.motivation: 睾丸附件扭转是青春期前儿童急性阴囊疼痛的首要病因，但临床表现非特异、缺乏标准化儿科急症超声数据集，导致诊断困难且缺少可公开利用的AI研究资源。
AI.method: 构建经专家标注的超声数据集TAT-Det（浙江大学医学院附属儿童医院，2,600张图像/1,203例患者），每张阳性图像配有病灶级边界框与像素级分割掩膜；标注采用多阶段流程：儿科超声医师独立标注、共识复核与精修；并采用代表性深度学习模型建立目标检测与语义分割基线基准。
AI.result: 提供检测与分割基线基准结果：YOLO11m取得最佳检测性能，RWKV-UNet取得最佳分割性能。
AI.conclusion: TAT-Det填补了儿科急症超声公开资源空白，为自动化TAT分析AI方法的开发与评估奠定基础。

title: Predicting acute food crises and discovering actionable drivers with causal machine learning
summary: Acute food insecurity is driven by a compound of conflict, adverse climate events, displacement, and economic shocks. We enrich the open-access Harmonized Food Insecurity Dataset with driver variables (monthly, subnational, 80 countries, 2007--2024) and develop missing-data-resilient machine learning pipelines forecasting crisis occurrence at 3, 6, and 9-month lead times using both FEWS NET and, for the first time at scale, IPC/CH classifications. Pipelines, evaluated through nested cross-validation, outperform no-skill baselines by 15 to 50 percentage points in PR-AUC, with performance correlated with crisis prevalence rather than the classification system. TreeSHAP-based explainability reveals compound, geography-specific predictive signal profiles, with three recurrent forecasting archetypes. Comparing predictive importance against doubly robust causal estimates of actionable drivers, we find that acute conflict events, having the weakest predictive signals, emerge as primary causal drivers of crisis classification whilst agroclimatology is the sole dimension in which predictive importance and causal effect align.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了缺失数据稳健的机器学习流程，在80国次国家级月度数据上预测急性粮食不安全危机，发现模型预测能力主要随危机流行率变化，且预测重要性（以冲突最弱）与因果效应（冲突为主）严重错位。
AI.motivation: 急性粮食不安全由冲突、极端气候、流离失所与经济冲击复合驱动；现有数据分散、缺失严重，且预测建模与因果推断割裂，导致"能预测"与"可干预"之间的政策脱节。
AI.method: 在开放获取的Harmonized Food Insecurity Dataset中补充驱动变量（80国、次国家级、月度、2007–2024），构建抗缺失的机器学习流程，提前3/6/9个月预测危机发生；同时使用FEWS NET与IPC/CH两套分类体系（后者首次大规模应用）；通过嵌套交叉验证评估，用TreeSHAP进行可解释性分析，并与双重稳健因果估计对比驱动因素的预测重要性与因果效应。
AI.result: 相较无技能基线，PR-AUC提升15–50个百分点；性能与危机流行率相关，而与所用分类体系无关；TreeSHAP揭示地理特异性的复合信号剖面，归纳出三类反复出现的预测原型；对比发现急性冲突事件预测信号最弱却是主要因果驱动，农业气候是预测重要性与因果效应唯一一致的维度。
AI.conclusion: 预测性能高度依赖危机流行率而非标注体系，说明跨区域可比性需谨慎；预测重要性与因果效应普遍不一致，仅农业气候兼具两者，故基于预测重要性的政策优先级排序可能误导，应将预测与因果证据结合使用。

title: Was the Model Given the Right Action? Auditing and Repairing Action Interfaces in Navigation World Models
summary: World models are evaluated by predicting future observations from actions. These evaluations assume that actions are prepared the same way as during training, but an unchecked mismatch can make a model appear less accurate than it is. We audit this assumption in Navigation World Models (NWM) and find three interacting differences between its training and rollout code. Correcting the inputs, without retraining, reduces mean visual prediction error by 42%, measured with DreamSim on the RECON navigation dataset. The correction also changes the ranking of NWM checkpoints in an exploratory analysis and removes or reduces two alternative models' measured advantages. Correcting only the normalization offset instead increases error, showing why interacting mismatches must be checked together. To test whether sensitivity to input preparation extends beyond NWM, we deliberately introduce encoding errors into two alternative models; both become less accurate. We introduce ActRosetta, a tool that checks whether action encoding matches training, identifies supported causes of disagreement, and repairs inputs when sufficient information is available. Repair helps little where predictions barely respond to actions, the tool's diagnosis has limited coverage, and improved control remains unproven. For any action-conditioned world model, the lesson is the same: before reporting rollout error, verify that evaluation encodes actions exactly as training did.

AI.tldr: 本文审计"动作条件世界模型评估中动作编码与训练一致"这一隐含假设，发现NWM训练与推理代码存在三处相互作用的差异，仅修正输入即可在不重训的情况下将平均视觉预测误差降低42%，并指出只修正归一化偏移反而会增大误差，最后提出检测与修复工具ActRosetta。
AI.motivation: 世界模型以"由动作预测未来观测"的方式评估，而此类评估默认推理阶段的动作与训练时准备方式一致。作者指出，这一未被检验的错配会使模型看起来比实际更不准，因此需要系统审计该假设。
AI.method: 以Navigation World Models (NWM) 为对象审计训练与rollout代码，定位三处相互作用的动作编码差异；在不重训的前提下修正输入，用DreamSim在RECON导航数据集上度量视觉预测误差；做checkpoint排序的探索性分析并比较替代模型；再做消融，仅修正归一化偏移；并向两个替代模型人为注入编码错误以检验敏感性是否普遍；最后开发诊断工具ActRosetta，用于检测动作编码是否与训练一致、识别可支持的分歧原因并在信息充分时修复输入。
AI.result: 修正输入后，平均视觉预测误差（DreamSim, RECON）下降42%；修正改变了NWM各checkpoint在探索性分析中的排序，并消除或削弱了两个替代模型原先测得的优势；仅修正归一化偏移反而使误差上升，说明相互作用的多处错配必须联合排查；对两个替代模型注入编码错误后，二者精度均下降，表明对输入准备的敏感性不限于NWM。
AI.conclusion: 对任何动作条件世界模型，在报告rollout误差前都应验证评估阶段的动作编码与训练完全一致。作者同时坦承ActRosetta的局限：在预测对动作几乎无响应时修复效果有限、诊断覆盖范围有限、控制性能提升尚未被证实。

title: A Computational Model of Continuous Recognition Memory for Natural Images
summary: Recognizing an image we have seen before is a basic function of human visual memory. Understanding human continuous recognition memory (CRM) can help machine vision systems predict which images people are likely to remember and generate more memorable images. It can also inform the diagnosis of memory impairments and the development of interventions to improve memory. This paper proposes the first computational model for CRM. The model captures three key components of continuous recognition memory (CRM): image encoding, memory decay, and decision making. It encodes each image as a distinct random variable in a perceptual space. As the memory of an image fades, the distribution of its random variable drifts within that space. To decide whether the current image has been seen before, the observer retrieves samples from the distributions associated with previously encoded images and compares them with the current image. Our model predicts human observers' trial-by-trial responses in CRM tasks within the variability observed across human participants. Our model is parameter efficient, requiring only four shared parameters and two parameters per observer. It can accurately predict the memorability of an image no worse than prior methods that require millions of parameters.

AI.tldr: 首次提出连续再认记忆(CRM)的计算模型，以图像编码、记忆衰退、决策三组件建模逐试次人类反应，仅需少量参数即可匹敌大规模模型。
AI.motivation: 理解人类连续再认记忆可帮助机器视觉预测并生成更易被记住的图像，也可用于记忆障碍诊断与干预；但此前缺乏CRM的计算模型。
AI.method: 将每幅图像编码为感知空间中的一个独立随机变量；记忆衰退表现为该变量分布随时间的漂移；决策时从已编码图像的分布中采样并与当前图像比较，以判断是否见过。
AI.result: 模型能在人类被试间变异范围内预测逐试次反应；参数高效，仅需4个共享参数与每位被试2个参数；记忆性预测精度不逊于需数百万参数的既有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了首个CRM计算模型，以极简参数化统一解释编码、衰退与决策，兼具行为预测与图像记忆性预测能力。

title: Distractor-Robust Reinforcement Learning via Variational Bisimulation
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) promises data efficiency and generalization, but typical reconstruction-based objectives encourage models to waste representational capacity on task-irrelevant distractors. We introduce VIBES (Variational Inference for Bisimulation-based Encoded States), a new objective that replaces pixel reconstruction with an adversarial term, which enforces that latent states suffice to predict both rewards and the next latent state. We show that this objective measures how far the encoder is from reward and dynamics sufficiency, and that whenever exact sufficiency is attainable, its global optima induce bisimulation relations on histories. Combined with a fixed-capacity latent bottleneck, this encourages latent states to retain task-relevant information while discarding irrelevant variation. Our method serves as a drop-in replacement for Dreamer's model-learning component, achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Distracting Control Suite, and extends to visually complex manipulation in Realistic ManiSkill. Unlike prior approaches, it does not rely on image-specific augmentations and applies equally well to high-dimensional vector-state tasks, demonstrated on a 100-link swimmer robot. Finally, latent-space analyses (UMAP embeddings and nearest-neighbor probes) confirm that the learned representations are sensitive to task-relevant structure while invariant to distractors.

AI.tldr: 提出VIBES目标，用对抗式变分推断替代像素重建，使潜状态满足奖励与动力学充分性并逼近双模拟关系，在干扰视觉环境中显著提升MBRL样本效率与泛化。
AI.motivation: 基于重建的MBRL目标会迫使模型将表征容量浪费在与任务无关的干扰因素上，导致表征不紧凑、泛化差；且现有基于图像增强的方法依赖图像先验，难以用于高维向量状态任务。
AI.method: 用对抗项替换像素重建：训练判别器区分真实转移与由潜状态生成的"伪"转移，以此迫使潜状态足以预测奖励与下一潜状态；理论上证明该目标度量编码器与"奖励+动力学充分性"的距离，且在精确充分性可达时全局最优解诱导历史上的双模拟关系；配合固定容量潜瓶颈，抑制无关变化。作为Dreamer模型学习模块的即插即用替换。
AI.result: 在Distracting Control Suite上取得SOTA；在Realistic ManiSkill的视觉复杂操作任务上有效；并成功扩展到100连杆swimmer的高维向量状态任务，无需图像专用增强。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间分析（UMAP嵌入与最近邻探针）表明所学表征对任务相关结构敏感、对干扰因素不变；VIBES是通用、无图像先验的MBRL模型学习目标。

title: HOG-WAM: Improving Visual Robustness through Future Gradient Prediction
summary: World-action models jointly predict future observations and actions, yet visual corruption can disrupt the resulting policies. We introduce HOG-WAM, which adds future Histograms of Oriented Gradients (HOG) as structural supervision derived directly from demonstration images. An auxiliary HOG diffusion transformer (DiT) module reads RGB features through asymmetric attention, allowing its objective to shape the visual representation used for control. The module is used only during training and removed at inference, preserving FastWAM's RGB-to-action architecture. We evaluate four controlled observation corruptions through a visual-corruption extension of RoboTwin, termed RoboTwin-Plus; HOG-WAM achieves the highest success among the compared policies under all four. Mixed-noise success increases from 78.86% to 82.86% relative to FastWAM, with comparable performance on clean scenes. On LIBERO Plus, overall success increases from 74.49% to 75.26%, with the largest gain under sensor noise, from 74.14% to 78.89%. Across four Franka tasks, average success increases from 40% to 59% under clean observations and from 17% to 24% under noisy observations. A representation ablation favors combining RGB observations with auxiliary HOG prediction over replacing RGB with HOG. These findings support future-gradient prediction as complementary supervision for visually robust control, with larger absolute gains on physical tasks than in simulation. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/HOG-WAM.

AI.tldr: HOG-WAM 将未来 HOG 直方图作为结构监督，用仅在训练期引入的辅助 DiT 模块增强视觉表征，提升世界-动作模型在观测腐蚀下的鲁棒性，推理时模块移除、架构不变。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型（world-action models）联合预测未来观测与动作，但视觉腐蚀（噪声、混合干扰等）会破坏由此产生的策略。作者希望在不改变推理架构、不增加推理开销的前提下，提升策略对观测腐蚀的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出 HOG-WAM：从演示图像直接生成未来 HOG（方向梯度直方图）特征作为结构监督。增设辅助 HOG DiT 模块，通过非对称注意力读取 RGB 特征，使该目标反向塑造用于控制的视觉表征。该模块仅训练期使用，推理时移除，保持 FastWAM 的 RGB-to-action 结构。评估方面构建 RoboTwin-Plus（RoboTwin 的视觉腐蚀扩展）与 LIBERO Plus，并在 4 个真实 Franka 任务上验证；另做表征消融。
AI.result: RoboTwin-Plus 四种受控腐蚀下成功率均为最高，混合噪声 78.86%→82.86%，干净场景持平；LIBERO Plus 总体 74.49%→75.26%，传感器噪声增益最大（74.14%→78.89%）；4 个 Franka 任务干净观测 40%→59%，含噪观测 17%→24%。消融显示"RGB 观测 + 辅助 HOG 预测"优于"以 HOG 替代 RGB"。
AI.conclusion: 未来梯度预测可作为视觉鲁棒控制的有效互补监督，且相较仿真，在物理任务上的绝对增益更大；方法零推理开销、可直接叠加于现有 world-action 架构。

title: Where to Approximate: Understanding and Accelerating Looped Multi-View Reconstruction
summary: Looped multi-view reconstruction refines scene features by repeatedly applying a shared transformer block. Making these updates cheaper requires knowing how an approximation at one step affects the rest of the refinement. We study this with paired interventions in Déjà View and stacked reconstruction transformers, separating the error an approximation injects, how that error propagates, and how it affects the output. In Déjà View, approximation errors are attenuated more strongly than matched random perturbations under a scale-adjusted state-error measure, and a local Jacobian decomposition separates the contribution of channel gating from the response to spatial error structure. Spatial approximations made early benefit from subsequent refinement, whereas cross-step reuse depends on which quantity is cached and how reuse steps are spaced. At equal final norm, approximation errors change the predicted rotations 1.55 times as much as random errors. These findings guide our proposed method, which reduces spatial resolution and pools keys and values early in refinement, then interleaves attention-output reuse with full attention, and is adapted through lightweight self-distillation. Across five reconstruction benchmarks, the balanced configuration runs $1.63\times$ faster than the official 16-step Déjà View model with a 1.86-point reduction in average pose AUC@$3^\circ$. At matched latency, it exceeds the interpolated curve of a trained baseline using full refinement blocks by 4.73 points in AUC@$3^\circ$ and improves the corresponding geometry metrics.

AI.tldr: 通过Déjà View中的配对干预实验分离近似误差的注入、传播与输出影响，据此提出降分辨率、KV池化、注意力输出复用与自蒸馏结合的高效环式多视图重建方法，在五个基准上实现1.63倍加速且精度仅小幅下降。
AI.motivation: 环式多视图重建通过反复应用共享Transformer块迭代细化特征，计算开销大；要使这些更新更廉价，必须先弄清某一步的近似如何影响后续整个细化过程，而现有工作缺乏对近似误差机制的系统刻画。
AI.method: 在Déjà View与堆叠重建Transformer中设计配对干预实验，分别度量近似注入的误差、误差的传播方式及其对输出的影响；采用尺度调整的状态误差度量比较近似误差与匹配随机扰动，并用局部Jacobian分解区分通道门控贡献与对空间误差结构的响应；在此基础上提出方法：细化早期降低空间分辨率并池化key/value，随后将注意力输出复用与完整注意力交替，并通过轻量自蒸馏进行适配。
AI.result: 近似误差在尺度调整度量下比匹配随机扰动衰减更强；早期空间近似可从后续细化中获益，而跨步复用效果取决于缓存对象与复用步间距；在相同最终范数下，近似误差对预测旋转的影响是随机误差的1.55倍。最终方法在五个重建基准上比官方16步Déjà View快1.63倍，平均姿态AUC@3°仅下降1.86点；在同延迟下，AUC@3°比使用完整细化块的训练基线插值曲线高4.73点，并改善相应几何指标。
AI.conclusion: 对近似误差机制的分解性分析能有效指导高效环式重建的设计；所提出的降分辨率、KV池化、注意力输出复用与自蒸馏组合在保持精度的同时显著降低延迟，并在同延迟对比中优于全细化块基线。

title: Do We Still Need Reinforcement Learning When We Can Read the World Model?
summary: Reinforcement learning has achieved remarkable success in sequential decision-making, but learning effective policies often requires substantial interaction experience. Model-based reinforcement learning alleviates this dependence by leveraging world models, which are typically used to support planning or policy optimization. In this paper, we investigate an alternative paradigm in which autonomous LLM-based coding agents directly synthesize control policies by reasoning over readable world models. By examining environment source code, these agents translate environmental knowledge into executable decision rules and iteratively refine their policies using online feedback or offline data, without task-specific RL training. Experiments across diverse decision-making benchmarks show that synthesized policies match or outperform conventional RL methods while requiring substantially less experience. Further analyses reveal interpretable decision rules and how they evolve through feedback-driven refinement. Comparisons with policies generated without source code access and experiments under challenging conditions further demonstrate the benefits of readable world models. These findings suggest that direct policy synthesis can reduce reliance on trial and error, challenging the necessity of task-specific RL training.

AI.tldr: 论文探索一种新范式：让基于大语言模型（LLM）的自主编码智能体通过推理可读的世界模型（环境源代码）直接合成控制策略，在无需任务特定强化学习训练的情况下，以更少经验达到或超越传统 RL 方法。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习依赖大量交互经验，样本效率低；基于模型的 RL 虽借助世界模型缓解该问题，但世界模型通常仅用于支撑规划或策略优化。作者希望验证另一条路径：若世界模型对人类/LLM 可读（如环境源码），智能体能否直接"读懂"环境并写出可执行策略。
AI.method: 提出由 LLM 编码智能体直接进行策略合成：智能体检视环境源代码，将环境知识转化为可执行的决策规则（策略代码），并利用在线反馈或离线数据迭代精炼策略；整个过程不进行任务特定的 RL 训练。辅以对照实验：无源代码访问的策略生成，以及困难条件下的实验。
AI.result: 在多个决策基准上，合成策略的性能达到或超过常规 RL 方法，且所需经验显著更少；分析显示生成的决策规则具有可解释性，并能通过反馈驱动的迭代不断演化改进；无源代码访问的对照及困难条件实验进一步证实可读世界模型带来的收益。
AI.conclusion: 直接策略合成可降低对试错的依赖，对"任务特定 RL 训练是否必要"提出挑战，说明可读世界模型 + LLM 编码智能体是有前景的决策学习替代范式。

title: BOP-Refer: Benchmark for Monocular 3D and 2D Object Grounding
summary: We introduce BOP-Refer, the first benchmark for monocular 3D and 2D grounding of everyday and industrial objects sourced from 9 diverse BOP datasets. We pair images from these datasets with VLM-generated and human-verified referring expressions, and derive accurate ground-truth 3D and 2D bounding boxes of the referred objects from their 3D models and 6DoF pose annotations. Our systematic evaluation of 17 frontier VLMs across the major proprietary and open-weight families (Gemini, GPT, Claude, Qwen, Gemma) shows that the best model, Gemini 4 Carbon, reaches 72.6% AP_IoU2D in 2D but only 12.4% AP_IoU3D in 3D, despite the more lenient IoU thresholds in 3D. The predicted 3D boxes are usually centered on the target objects in the image but often off in depth by more than the object's size, suggesting that metric scale estimation, which needs reliable object size priors, is currently by far the main source of error.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出BOP-Refer，首个面向日常与工业物体的单目2D/3D grounding基准，覆盖9个BOP数据集；对17个前沿VLM的系统评测表明，2D grounding已较成熟（最佳72.6% AP_IoU2D），而3D grounding仍困难（最佳12.4% AP_IoU3D），主要误差来源为度量尺度估计。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM的视觉定位评测多集中于2D，缺乏统一的、涵盖日常与工业物体的单目3D grounding基准；同时3D定位中度量尺度估计的瓶颈尚未被系统量化。
AI.method: 构建BOP-Refer基准：从9个BOP数据集采样图像，配以VLM生成并经人工校验的指代表达；利用物体3D模型与6DoF位姿标注推导精确的3D/2D真值框；在统一协议下系统评测17个主流专有与开源VLM（Gemini、GPT、Claude、Qwen、Gemma）。
AI.result: 最佳模型Gemini 4 Carbon在2D上达72.6% AP_IoU2D，但3D仅12.4% AP_IoU3D，且3D的IoU阈值更宽松；误差分析显示，预测3D框在图像平面上通常对准目标中心，但深度偏差常超过物体自身尺寸。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM的2D grounding能力明显领先于3D；度量尺度估计（依赖可靠的物体尺寸先验）是单目3D grounding的主要误差来源，是未来研究的核心方向。

title: RefMix: Expanding Endpoint Proposals for Diversity-Preserving Reward Fine-Tuning
summary: Online forward matching aligns flow-based generative models by repeatedly generating, rewarding, and fitting model-produced endpoints. However, this behavior creates an on-policy feedback loop: as high-reward modes become increasingly favored, alternative modes become less likely to appear in subsequent training pools, progressively reducing visual diversity. We introduce RefMix, a reference-assisted endpoint proposal strategy that addresses this limitation by injecting alternative candidates into the training pool while retaining the original task reward and forward matching objective. In particular, RefMix uses a reference model during early high-noise steps to expose alternative visual modes, followed by the current reward-tuned model for endpoint completion. Across state-of-the-art online forward matching methods, RefMix consistently improves visual diversity while preserving task reward performance. Controlled inference experiments further demonstrate that training-time endpoint exposure is critical to improve reward--diversity trade-offs, beyond the impact of reference-assisted inference. By rethinking how training endpoints are proposed, RefMix achieves up to 44% higher diversity over forward matching baselines at comparable reward levels.

AI.tldr: 提出 RefMix：在早期高噪声步骤引入参考模型生成候选端点，随后由当前奖励微调模型完成端点，从而在保持任务奖励与正向匹配目标的同时缓解在线正向匹配的多样性退化。
AI.motivation: 在线正向匹配通过反复"生成—奖励—拟合"模型产出端点来对齐流生成模型，形成同策略反馈回路：高奖励模式被不断偏好，其他模式在后续训练池中出现概率降低，视觉多样性逐步衰减，奖励—多样性权衡恶化。
AI.method: RefMix 是一种参考辅助的端点提议策略：在训练早期高噪声阶段使用参考模型生成部分轨迹以暴露替代视觉模式，再交由当前奖励微调模型完成端点生成；将候选注入训练池但保留原任务奖励与正向匹配目标，仅改变端点提议方式，不改变优化目标。
AI.result: 在多种SOTA在线正向匹配方法上一致提升视觉多样性且不损失奖励表现；受控推理实验表明训练阶段的端点暴露对改善奖励—多样性权衡至关重要，其作用超出参考辅助推理本身的影响；在可比奖励水平下多样性最高提升44%。
AI.conclusion: 通过重新设计训练端点如何被提议（而非修改奖励或匹配目标），RefMix 有效抑制同策略反馈回路导致的模式收缩，实现更优的奖励—多样性权衡，为流生成模型在线对齐中的多样性保持提供了简洁且可插拔的方案。

title: Learning to Be Truncated: Preparing LLM Checkpoints for SVD Compression
summary: Compression based on singular value decomposition (SVD) often requires subsequent fine-tuning or weight correction to mitigate performance degradation. Budget-specific optimization must be repeated for different compression ratios. We introduce LLift, which prepares a pretrained model for SVD compression across ratios without further fine-tuning. LLift fine-tunes a low-rank approximation at a single ratio using the original model as a teacher. We merge the learned updates into the original weights while preserving the complementary components excluded from the training forward pass. We apply SVD to the prepared model's target matrices and reuse the decompositions at different truncation ranks. On LLaMA-7B, we demonstrate accuracy gains across three compression ratios using a single prepared model. The gains extend across model families, model sizes, and SVD compression operators. We analyze gradients and an early training update to provide local evidence that updates learned at one ratio can benefit compression at other ratios. These results show that LLift can improve compression across deployment budgets without fine-tuning each compressed model separately.

AI.tldr: 提出 LLift：用单一压缩比下的低秩微调为模型“做好准备”，使 SVD 压缩可在不同压缩率下复用且无需逐预算再微调。
AI.motivation: 基于奇异值分解（SVD）的压缩通常需要后续微调或权重校正来缓解性能下降，且针对每个压缩预算都要重复做特定比例的优化，代价高。
AI.method: 以原始模型为教师，在单一比例下微调低秩近似；将学到的更新合并回原始权重，同时保留未参与训练前向传播的互补分量；随后对目标矩阵做 SVD，并在不同截断秩（压缩率）下复用同一分解结果。
AI.result: 在 LLaMA-7B 上，用同一个准备后的模型在三个压缩比上均取得精度提升；提升可跨模型家族、模型规模与不同 SVD 压缩算子泛化。梯度分析与早期训练更新分析提供了局部证据，说明某一比例下学到的更新可惠及其他比例的压缩。
AI.conclusion: LLift 表明可按部署预算灵活压缩而无需对每个压缩模型单独微调，实现“一次准备、多预算复用”的 SVD 压缩范式。

title: Where Does Free-Text 3D Grounding Fail? An Error Analysis of Report-Sentence Segmentation in Chest CT
summary: Free-text 3D grounding, segmenting in a CT volume the region described by one sentence of the radiology report, could link reports to images at scale, but it is unclear where current models fail. We analyse the publicly released VoxTell model on all 381 findings of the 200-scan ReXGroundingCT validation set, where it grounds 53.5% of findings. Its failures are rarely about which lesion or side is meant. No miss lies on the side opposite to the one named, and findings are almost never confused with one another. Instead, predictions are too large, land on a neighbouring lesion on the correct side, or are missing for small findings, and diffuse findings are rarely grounded. Removing location words halves performance, to the level of label-only prompting, and anatomical rules derived from the sentence never improve the full-sentence output. The same pattern holds on the hidden 300-scan test set. Further progress therefore depends on extent estimation and small-lesion sensitivity rather than on anatomical post-processing.

AI.tldr: 对 VoxTell 模型在 ReXGroundingCT 验证集全部 381 条 findings 上做细粒度失败分析：成功接地 53.5%，失败主要源于范围估计过大、小病灶漏检与弥漫性病灶，而非左右/病灶混淆；去除位置词后性能减半，基于句子的解剖规则后处理无增益。
AI.motivation: 自由文本 3D grounding（按报告句子在 CT 体积中分割对应区域）有望大规模连接报告与影像，但现有模型的失败模式尚不清楚，难以指导后续改进方向。
AI.method: 对公开的 VoxTell 模型在 ReXGroundingCT 验证集（200 例扫描、381 条 findings）上进行逐条错误归因，并在隐藏测试集（300 例扫描）上验证；同时进行消融：移除句子中的位置词、对比仅标签提示，以及将句子推导的解剖规则用于后处理。
AI.result: 接地成功率 53.5%。错误几乎不涉及病灶身份或左右侧（无一条漏检位于所述侧的对侧，findings 之间极少互相混淆）。主要失败为：预测范围过大、落在同侧相邻病灶上、小结节漏检、弥漫性病灶几乎无法接地。移除位置词后性能减半，降至仅标签提示水平；解剖规则后处理相对完整句子输出从无提升。隐藏测试集呈现相同模式。
AI.conclusion: 当前自由文本 3D grounding 的瓶颈在于范围（extent）估计与小病灶敏感性，而非解剖推理；解剖后处理并非有效改进路径。

title: Provably Efficient Concave Utility Reinforcement Learning with Linear Function Approximation
summary: Concave utility reinforcement learning (CURL) unifies a diverse range of problems, including standard reinforcement learning (RL), imitation learning, and maximum entropy exploration. Unlike standard RL, CURL generally requires estimating high-dimensional state-action occupancy measures. Consequently, existing methods for CURL either sidestep the exploration problem, are restricted to the tabular setting, or lack computationally efficient policy optimization. To address this, we study CURL in finite-horizon episodic bilinear MDPs, where the transition model admits a low-dimensional representation in known feature spaces. We use the bilinear structure to efficiently estimate occupancy measures via low-dimensional feature expectations, and propose a model-based optimistic concave utility policy optimization (OCUPO) framework. We first instantiate OCUPO in the on-policy setting, where each iteration uses independent trajectories to estimate the concave utility policy gradient, and prove an $\widetilde{O}(ε^{-4})$ sample complexity. To improve sample efficiency, we then instantiate OCUPO in the off-policy setting. We propose a novel backward feature regression subroutine that reuses trajectories collected by past policies to estimate the occupancy measure of the current policy. Under suitable technical assumptions on the policy class (satisfied, e.g., by log-linear policies with sufficiently expressive features), we prove that the resulting algorithm achieves an $\widetilde{O}(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity, up to a controllable projection error. We further extend our framework to linear MDPs and show that the resulting off-policy algorithm retains the same sample complexity. In these settings, the dependence on $ε$ matches that for standard RL with linear function approximation. Moreover, our algorithms do not rely on the integral oracle required by prior work.

AI.tldr: 该文在有限时域分幕式双线性MDP中研究凹效用强化学习（CURL），通过低维特征期望高效估计占用测度，提出基于模型的乐观凹效用策略优化框架OCUPO，on-policy版本样本复杂度为Õ(ε⁻⁴)，引入后向特征回归的off-policy版本达到Õ(ε⁻²)，并扩展至线性MDP，且无需已有工作所需的积分预言机。
AI.motivation: CURL统一了标准RL、模仿学习与最大熵探索等问题，但通常需估计高维状态-动作占用测度，导致现有方法或回避探索问题、或局限于表格情形、或缺乏计算高效的策略优化。
AI.method: 在转移模型具备已知特征空间低维表示的分幕式双线性MDP中，利用双线性结构经低维特征期望估计占用测度；构建模型-based乐观凹效用策略优化（OCUPO）框架。on-policy实例每次迭代用独立轨迹估计凹效用策略梯度；off-policy实例提出后向特征回归子程序，复用历史策略轨迹估计当前策略占用测度；并将框架推广到线性MDP。
AI.result: on-policy OCUPO的样本复杂度为Õ(ε⁻⁴)；在策略类满足技术性假设（如具有充分表达能力的特征的对数线性策略）时，off-policy算法达到Õ(ε⁻²)（至多差一个可控投影误差）；扩展至线性MDP的off-policy算法保持相同样本复杂度；对ε的依赖与线性函数逼近的标准RL相匹配，且算法不依赖先前工作所需的积分预言机。
AI.conclusion: 双线性结构下的低维占用测度估计可使CURL获得计算高效且样本复杂度最优阶的策略优化，off-policy特征复用显著提升样本效率，框架亦适用于线性MDP。

title: Embodied-VGGT: Preserving Reliable Local Geometry for Long-Sequence Reconstruction
summary: Long sequence reconstruction must correct accumulated drift while preserving locally consistent geometry. In robotics and autonomous driving, embodied acquisition provides recurring platform- environment geometry and repeated observations of scene structure and platform motion. We present Embodied-VGGT, which exploits these cues to establish reliable local relationships and selectively preserve them during global refinement.
