summary: In real-world applications like egocentric recording, visual accessibility, and surveillance review, visual evidence for Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) is often only partially captured. A reliable model should match its response to the evidence: answering when sufficient, guessing from visible clues when partial, and abstaining when absent. Yet existing benchmarks enforce a binary answerable-or-unanswerable split, leaving partial evidence unmeasured and obscuring whether failures arise from missing evidence or misjudging sufficiency. We introduce ClueProbe, a diagnostic benchmark to (1) separate perceiving evidence from judging sufficiency, and (2) validate our diagnosis via targeted fine-tuning. ClueProbe comprises 1,721 human-annotated questions across 598 natural videos, labeled Answerable, Guessable, or Unanswerable, alongside controlled perturbations altering wording or visual input. Evaluating 10 open-source and proprietary Video LLMs reveals that failures stem from judgment rather than perception: models perceive the evidence yet lack graded sufficiency awareness, answering or refusing outright while rarely guessing from partial clues. Targeted fine-tuning shows that this reflects missing supervision rather than insufficient capacity: supervising the guess level lifts appropriate guessing from 1.6% to 40.4% without extra false refusals, whereas conventional refusal tuning rejects 92% of guessable questions. Data and code will be released at https://github.com/suat-llm/ClueProbe.

AI.tldr: 提出ClueProbe诊断基准，将"感知证据"与"判断充分性"分离，发现Video LLM的失败源于判断而非感知，并通过针对性微调验证这是监督缺失而非能力不足。
AI.motivation: 现实应用（第一视角录制、视觉无障碍、监控回看）中视频证据常常只被部分捕获。可靠模型应根据证据充分性分级响应：充分则作答、部分则基于可见线索推测、完全缺失则拒答。但现有基准仅采用"可答/不可答"二元划分，未度量"部分证据"情形，也无法区分失败是源于漏看证据还是对充分性的误判。
AI.method: 构建ClueProbe基准：598个自然视频、1,721个人工标注问题，标注为Answerable/Guessable/Unanswerable三类，并配有改写措辞或改变视觉输入的受控扰动，以解耦感知与判断。评测10个开源与专有Video LLM，并进行针对性微调实验（对比猜测层监督与传统拒答微调）。
AI.result: 模型失败主要源于判断层面：模型能够感知到证据，但缺乏分级的充分性意识，倾向于直接作答或直接拒答，极少从部分线索推断。微调结果显示：监督"猜测"层级可将恰当猜测率从1.6%提升至40.4%，且不增加误拒；而传统拒答微调会拒答92%的可猜问题。
AI.conclusion: Video LLM缺乏分级充分性判断反映的是监督信号缺失而非容量不足；基准应引入"Guessable"中间类别以准确诊断模型行为。数据与代码将开源。

title: From Diagnosing Alignment to Joint Supervision in Multimodal Draft Training
summary: Multimodal drafts learn from multimodal (MM) and text-only (TXT) supervision, yet their effects on alignment and how to combine them remain unclear. We diagnose draft-target alignment through paired predictions with and without visual input, decomposing distributional error into text-conditioned and visual-response components. Drafts with similar text-conditioned alignment can still differ markedly in visual-response risk and acceptance. Controlled continuation training shows that high-risk groups outperform random and low-risk groups, and visual-response risk guides MM training more effectively than aggregate risk. Building on these diagnostics, we propose MNRS-Joint, which configures joint supervision from a given draft's component-risk distributions, using modality-specific mean risks to determine the MM:TXT mixture. Across three warm-ups, its distinct mixtures fall in high-performing regions of the ratio sweeps. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, MNRS-Joint improves mean accepted length from 3.35 to 3.53 and mean speedup from $2.04\times$ to $2.16\times$ over composition-matched random training under greedy tree decoding. The gains also hold under stochastic chain decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文通过诊断多模态草稿模型的对齐（拆分为文本条件误差与视觉响应风险两部分），提出基于分量风险分布配置多模态/纯文本联合监督比例的 MNRS-Joint 方法，在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上提升投机解码的接受长度与加速比。
AI.motivation: 多模态草稿模型同时接受多模态（MM）与纯文本（TXT）监督，但两者对草稿-目标对齐的影响尚不清晰，且如何组合两种监督缺乏原则性指导。
AI.method: 通过有/无视觉输入的成对预测诊断草稿-目标对齐，将分布误差分解为文本条件分量与视觉响应分量；用受控的续训实验验证不同风险组的差异；进而提出 MNRS-Joint，依据草稿的分量风险分布配置联合监督，用模态特定平均风险确定 MM:TXT 混合比例。
AI.result: 高风险组在续训中优于随机组与低风险组；视觉响应风险比聚合风险更能有效指导 MM 训练；三次 warm-up 下其混合比例均落入比例扫描的高性能区间；LLaVA-1.5-7B 上贪心树解码时平均接受长度由 3.35 升至 3.53，平均加速由 2.04× 升至 2.16×，随机链解码下同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 将草稿对齐误差按文本条件与视觉响应分量分解，可更细粒度地指导多模态草稿训练；按分量风险分布配置 MM:TXT 混合比例是有效且可迁移的监督组合策略。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Multi-UAV Data Harvesting Under Variable Team Sizes and Agent Loss
summary: Collecting data from wireless sensors can be challenging when limited communication infrastructure prevents them from offloading their measurements. In such settings, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can exploit their mobility to harvest data locally, while coordinated UAV teams can provide efficient and redundant coverage of remote areas. Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables such teams to learn decentralized coordination policies. However, training separate policies for different team and sensor populations is costly, and fixed-population policies may be vulnerable to agent failures. This work proposes F-MADDPG, a flexible variant of Multi-Agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (MADDPG) that supports data harvesting with varying numbers of wireless sensors and UAVs. The framework also accommodates unexpected catastrophic failures that permanently remove agents during a mission. We compare F-MADDPG with a MADDPG baseline that uses multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) and evaluate training strategies based on team-size sampling and exposure to agent terminations. The results show that F-MADDPG learns across the evaluated population sizes, completes missions faster than the baseline on average, benefits from inverse-cardinality team-size sampling compared with uniform sampling, remains effective after permanent agent losses, and gains no consistent benefit from exposure to failures during training.

AI.tldr: 提出 F-MADDPG，一种支持传感器与无人机数量可变、并容忍智能体永久失效的灵活 MADDPG 变体，用于无人机团队协作数据采集。
AI.motivation: 通信基础设施受限时，无线传感器无法上传测量数据，需无人机抵近采集；多智能体强化学习可实现分散式协同，但按不同团队与传感器规模分别训练策略代价高，且固定规模策略在智能体故障时鲁棒性差。
AI.method: 在 MADDPG 基础上构建 F-MADDPG，使其输入/策略结构支持可变数量的传感器与无人机；框架同时容纳任务中导致智能体永久退出的灾难性故障。实验采用基于团队规模采样的训练策略，并考察训练时暴露于智能体终止情形的影响，与使用 MLP 的 MADDPG 基线对比。
AI.result: F-MADDPG 在所评估的各群体规模上均能有效学习，平均任务完成速度快于基线；相比均匀采样，逆基数（inverse-cardinality）团队规模采样更有益；在智能体永久损失后仍保持有效性；训练中暴露于故障未带来一致收益。
AI.conclusion: 灵活架构结合合理的团队规模采样，可让单一策略泛化到多种规模并具备故障容忍性；而显式训练故障情景并非必要，为可扩展、鲁棒的无人机协同数据采集提供了可行方案。

title: Exploring the Design Factors of Pixel-space Diffusion
summary: In this paper, we introduce EiT by exploring the key design factors of pixel-space diffusion from three perspectives: model architecture, representation, and frequency domain. Inspired by Denoising Autoencoders (DAE) which perform denoising through a bottleneck, we construct a U-shaped pixel diffusion transformer that performs explicit compression along the channel dimension. In terms of representation, we find that both pixel and latent diffusion transformers exhibit a three-stage representation dynamics across layers and timesteps: denoising/local feature expansion, basis lift-up, and posterior projection. Moreover, earlier denoising and a longer basis lift-up stage are associated with better generation, which EiT naturally achieves through its channel bottleneck and increased network depth. From the frequency perspective, we establish the equivalence between pixel-space and frequency-space diffusion when keeping the network operating in pixel space. On ImageNet $256\times256$ and $512\times512$, EiT consistently outperforms JiT (Just image Transformers) in generation quality. Specifically, our EiT achieves better FID than JiT: 1.61 vs. 1.85 at $256\times256$, and 1.73 vs. 1.99 at $512\times512$. Remarkably, EiT can be seamlessly applied to video pixel diffusion by simply extending the patch size to temporal dimension and outperforms video latent diffusion in FVD evaluated on Kinetics-600 (resolution 256), under comparable total network parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/forever208/EiT

AI.tldr: 本文提出EiT，从模型架构、表征与频域三个角度探索像素空间扩散的关键设计，构建带通道瓶颈的U形像素扩散Transformer，在ImageNet 256/512上取得优于JiT的FID，并可无缝扩展到视频像素扩散。
AI.motivation: 像素空间扩散相比潜空间扩散具备潜力，但其关键设计要素尚不清晰；作者希望系统剖析模型架构、表征动力学与频域特性，从而设计出更强的像素扩散Transformer。
AI.method: 受去噪自编码器（DAE）通过瓶颈进行去噪的启发，构建U形像素扩散Transformer，在通道维度上显式压缩；分析逐层/逐时间步的表征三阶段动力学（去噪/局部特征扩张、基提升、后验投影）；并建立像素空间与频率空间扩散在保持网络于像素空间运算时的等价关系。
AI.result: ImageNet 256×256上FID 1.61 vs JiT 1.85；512×512上1.73 vs 1.99。将patch尺寸扩展至时间维即可用于视频像素扩散，在Kinetics-600（256分辨率）上FVD优于视频潜扩散（参数量相当）。
AI.conclusion: 通道瓶颈加深网络可自然实现更早去噪与更长的基提升阶段，从而提升生成质量；像素扩散在图像与视频任务上均可超越对应基线，验证了三视角设计的有效性。

title: LoopTitan: What Does Parameter Revisit Buy a Mixture-of-Experts?
comment: 45 pages. Phase 1 technical report. Project page: https://datamllab.github.io/LoopTitan/ ; code: https://github.com/datamllab/LoopTitan ; models: https://huggingface.co/NaturalScale
summary: Looped Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures revisit layer parameters across depths. This design increases effective depth without adding parameters. Recent looped MoE studies report substantial gains over the standard MoE at matched budgets (parameters, FLOPs and KV cache). However, the reported gains still confound parameter revisit with other design choices, e.g., network shape and residual scale. We ask, what does parameter revisit itself buy? Using matched non-revisit controls, we find that parameter revisit itself buys almost nothing. We argue that revisit only offers a freedom an MoE already has, i.e., trading experts for depth (more layers, fewer experts each) at fixed parameters. First, at matched budgets, we decompose the state-of-the-art looped recipe, with revisit last. A non-revisit control retains all the gain. Most comes from network shape, and the rest from residual scale. We prove this scale acts as a lower learning rate on revisited layers. This helps under AdamW's uneven layer step sizes, but disappears under Muon, which keeps them nearly equal. Second, beyond matched budgets, we evaluate revisit by adding compute at fixed parameters. One extra visit gains more than doubling the experts. Yet without revisit, a deeper standard MoE at equal parameters and compute obtains 90.2% of that gain under Muon. Overall, gains come from network shape, the optimizer and added compute, which a standard MoE can adopt. Accordingly, we propose LoopTitan-Base as a stronger MoE baseline. Under Muon, it matches the strongest looped recipe without revisit or residual scale. We open-source LoopTitan and release 17 pretrained models (including LoopTitan-Base and the control). Our experiment record is public as GitHub issues, with predictions pre-registered and the full exploration history kept. This is our Phase 1 technical report, laying the foundation for follow-up studies.

AI.tldr: 通过匹配的非复访对照实验，作者发现Looped MoE中"参数复访"本身几乎不带来收益；增益主要来自网络形状、残差缩放（等价于更低学习率）与额外算力，这些标准MoE同样可采用。
AI.motivation: 近期Looped MoE研究报告在等预算（参数、FLOPs、KV cache）下显著优于标准MoE，但这些增益混淆了参数复访与网络形状、残差缩放等其他设计选择。作者希望厘清：参数复访本身究竟带来什么？
AI.method: 1）在等预算下对SOTA looped配方做逐项消融分解，将复访放在最后；2）用匹配的非复访对照（同等参数与算力下更深的少专家标准MoE）检验复访效应；3）理论分析残差缩放，证明其作用等价于对复访层施加更低学习率；4）在AdamW与Muon两种优化器下对比层间步长均匀性；5）固定参数增加算力（多一次复访 vs 专家数翻倍）进行比较实验。
AI.result: 非复访对照保留了全部增益：大部分来自网络形状，其余来自残差缩放；该缩放效应在Muon下层步长近乎相等而消失。固定参数增加算力时，多一次复访优于专家翻倍，但在Muon下等参数等算力的更深标准MoE可获得该增益的90.2%。Muon下LoopTitan-Base无需复访与残差缩放即可匹敌最强looped配方。
AI.conclusion: Looped MoE的收益来自网络形状、优化器与额外算力，而非参数复访本身，标准MoE均可采纳。作者提出LoopTitan-Base作为更强的MoE基线，开源LoopTitan并发布17个预训练模型（含基线与对照），实验记录以GitHub issues公开、预测预先注册，作为Phase 1技术报告为后续研究奠基。

title: FoMNet: Adaptive Kernels Meet Contextual Matching for Cross-Modal Homography Estimation
summary: Cross-modal homography estimation requires reliable correspondences despite appearance differences between sensing modalities. Multi-scale refinement progressively reduces the search range, but its accuracy remains limited by the ability of matching features to distinguish nearby candidates. The vision foundation model (VFM) provides complementary representations, yet integrating these features through fixed interpolation leaves their spatial aggregation independent of image content and the correspondence objective. We propose the Foundation Model-Enhanced Matching Network (FoMNet), which combines learned spatial adaptation of VFM features with contextual correspondence estimation. Patch Feature Upsampling (PFU) progressively predicts location-specific kernels to aggregate neighboring features on upsampled grids, preparing VFM representations for fusion with CNN features at different matching scales. Contextual Correlation Refinement (CCR) then jointly processes source descriptors and local correlations with spatial context to refine candidate scores before each homography update. To reduce upsampling overhead, we develop FoMNet-D, which replaces PFU with bicubic interpolation and uses multi-scale feature-relation distillation to recover accuracy. Experiments on five cross-modal datasets show that FoMNet achieves the lowest mean average corner error (MACE) among the evaluated methods, reducing MACE by 10.6%-72.7% relative to MCNet. FoMNet-D retains competitive accuracy while reducing inference latency by 34.0% relative to FoMNet.

AI.tldr: 提出FoMNet，将视觉基础模型特征的空间自适应聚合与上下文对应估计相结合，用于跨模态单应性估计，在五个数据集上取得最低MACE。
AI.motivation: 跨模态单应性估计需在表观差异下建立可靠对应；多尺度细化虽缩小搜索范围，但匹配特征的判别力限制精度。视觉基础模型（VFM）可提供互补表征，但固定插值融合使空间聚合与图像内容及对应目标无关。
AI.method: FoMNet包含两个模块：Patch Feature Upsampling（PFU）在稠密上采样网格上逐步预测位置相关卷积核，聚合邻域特征以实现VFM特征的学习式空间自适应，并在不同匹配尺度上与CNN特征融合；Contextual Correlation Refinement（CCR）联合处理源描述子与局部相关性及空间上下文，在每次单应性更新前细化候选得分。另提出轻量版FoMNet-D，以双三次插值替代PFU，并用多尺度特征关系蒸馏恢复精度。
AI.result: 在五个跨模态数据集上，FoMNet在评估方法中取得最低平均角点误差（MACE），相对MCNet降低10.6%–72.7%；FoMNet-D保持有竞争力的精度，同时推理延迟较FoMNet降低34.0%。
AI.conclusion: 内容自适应、任务导向的VFM特征聚合与上下文相关性细化能显著提升跨模态单应性估计精度；通过蒸馏可在精度基本保持的前提下有效降低计算开销。

title: Routeability Before Routing: Routeability Audit Protocol (RAP) and RouteabilityBench for Audited LLM Model Selection
summary: LLM routing aims to choose, for each prompt, which model in a portfolio is most likely to answer correctly. This only makes sense when the benchmark contains enough prompt-specific variation for different models to be best on different inputs. On coarse-scored LLM benchmarks, however, many models often tie for the best score, and the single best model may already leave little room for improvement. We therefore propose a routeability-first audit, instantiated as RAP and RouteabilityBench, a runnable claim-verification package. The audit is retrospective: it runs once the benchmark-portfolio score matrix exists and before router comparisons are interpreted as general evidence, rather than certifying a portfolio that has not yet been evaluated. Across four benchmarks and 66 LLMs, generic routing enhancements such as larger embedding sets, dimensionality reduction, selective abstention, clustering, and stronger regressors do not consistently outperform the single best model. The clearest positive evidence is concentrated in portfolio-dependent Omni-MATH settings, while GPQA, MMLU-Pro, and IFEval show different ways in which routing can remain hard or predictor-sensitive. Our practical recommendation is that routing gains should be reported together with routeability diagnostics, tied-best analysis, portfolio construction details, and family-corrected statistical tests.

AI.tldr: 提出"可路由性优先"审计框架 RAP 与 RouteabilityBench：在解读路由收益前，先检验基准是否具备足够的提示级差异。在 4 个基准、66 个 LLM 上，扩大嵌入集、降维、选择性弃答、聚类、更强回归器等通用增强并不能稳定超越单一最优模型；明确正收益主要集中于 Omni-MATH，GPQA/MMLU-Pro/IFEval 则显示路由仍难或对预测器敏感。
AI.motivation: LLM 路由的前提是基准中存在足够的提示级差异，使不同模型各有所长。但在粗粒度打分的基准上，多个模型常并列最优，且单一最优模型本身已留出很小提升空间，导致路由比较结果被过度泛化解读。因此需要一个在比较路由器之前先检验"是否值得路由"的前置审计。
AI.method: 提出 routeability-first audit（可路由性优先审计），实例化为 RAP 与 RouteabilityBench 可运行声明验证包。审计是回顾性的：在基准—模型组合得分矩阵生成之后、将路由器比较解释为通用证据之前运行。测试了四类通用路由增强——更大嵌入集、降维、选择性弃答、聚类、更强回归器——并辅以并列最优（tied-best）分析与族校正统计检验。
AI.result: 在 4 个基准、66 个 LLM 上，上述通用增强并不一致地优于单一最优模型。最清晰的正向证据集中于依赖组合构成的 Omni-MATH 设置；GPQA、MMLU-Pro、IFEval 分别以不同方式显示路由依然困难或对预测器敏感。
AI.conclusion: 建议路由收益须与可路由性诊断、并列最优分析、组合构建细节及族校正统计检验一并报告；路由结论应建立在经验证具备可路由性的基准与组合之上。

title: Lost in the Grid: Where Multimodal LLMs Fail Between Seeing and Planning
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel at static visual understanding and are increasingly applied to spatial planning, where a model interprets a visual layout and outputs an action sequence to reach a goal. Grid games are a common testbed for this ability because their rules are explicit and a solver can verify every move. Yet existing benchmarks mostly report end-to-end success rates, which hide whether a failure stems from visual perception, rule application, or multi-step planning. We introduce GridProbe, a diagnostic benchmark that 1) locates the failing stage between visual perception and planning and 2) verifies the diagnosis by targeted fine-tuning. On Sokoban, GridProbe pairs end-to-end solving with four probes (recognition, localization, single-step prediction, and state tracking) and gives every board both as an image and as an equivalent text grid. Evaluating seven MLLMs on Sokoban and a maze game reveals distinct bottlenecks behind similar success rates: proprietary models are limited by multi-step planning, whereas open-source models are limited by rule application or by visual grid indexing, i.e., counting rows and columns. Planning failures also hide perception failures: when planning is easier, the visual cost of the same model grows from 7.6 to 37.7 points. The diagnosis identifies what to train: fine-tuning only the vision module of the perception-limited model on board reading raises its interactive Sokoban success 3.5-fold (5.8% to 20.4%) and transfers zero-shot to the unseen maze game (single-turn success 13.8% to 67.1%), whereas the same data does not help a rule-limited model and training on solver solutions brings no gain. We will release the benchmark and code at https://github.com/suat-llm/GridProbe.

AI.tldr: GridProbe 是一个诊断式基准，在 Sokoban 与迷宫游戏中通过四项探针（识别、定位、单步预测、状态跟踪）把 MLLM 的失败定位到视觉感知或规划阶段，并用定向微调验证诊断，证明仅微调视觉模块即可显著提升交互成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有空间规划基准多以端到端成功率报告结果，无法区分失败源自视觉感知、规则应用还是多步规划，导致相似成功率掩盖了不同的能力瓶颈，也难以指导针对性训练。
AI.method: 在 Sokoban 上构建 GridProbe：将端到端求解与四项探针（棋盘识别、元素定位、单步预测、状态跟踪）结合，每个棋盘同时提供图像与等价文本网格两种形式；评测 7 个 MLLM，并在迷宫游戏上做迁移检验；随后通过对比"仅微调视觉模块""对规则受限模型微调""用求解器解训练"三种干预来验证诊断结论。
AI.result: 相似成功率背后瓶颈不同：闭源模型受限于多步规划，开源模型受限于规则应用或视觉网格索引（行列计数）。规划失败会掩盖感知失败——当规划更容易时，同一模型的视觉代价从 7.6 升至 37.7 个百分点。对感知受限模型仅微调视觉模块，交互式 Sokoban 成功率由 5.8% 提升至 20.4%（约 3.5 倍），并零样本迁移至未见迷宫游戏（单轮成功率 13.8%→67.1%）；同样数据对规则受限模型无效，且用求解器解训练无增益。
AI.conclusion: 端到端成功率不足以刻画 MLLM 空间规划能力，分阶段诊断能揭示被掩盖的感知瓶颈并直接指导训练干预；干预实验的可迁移性与特异性（对规则受限模型无效）验证了诊断的有效性。基准与代码将开源。

title: When Position Favors the Wrong Part: Evaluating Left-Right Discrimination in Semantic Correspondence
summary: Overall part-discrimination accuracy can conceal failures when image position favors the wrong bilateral part. We examine whether dense descriptors distinguish the correct part under this conflict and whether their discrimination scores help select matching coordinates. We evaluate position agreement and conflict within the same target images and annotated part pairs, using a bounding-box-side score to define the conditions. We compare the original descriptors with their even and odd components under horizontal reflection, examine feature upsampling with the backbone and adapters fixed, and test candidate-selection rules based on odd scores. On SPair-71k, odd discrimination accuracy falls from 86.66% under agreement to 19.63% under conflict for frozen DINOv2, compared with 95.27% to 86.16% for MARCO. With MARCO's input geometry fixed, odd accuracy in box-side conflict was 34.12% on the native grid and 88.84% after learned upsampling and pooling back to that grid. Odd-score rules improve on the original hard-peak matchers overall for DINOv2 and DINOv3 and on conflict queries for MARCO. With MARCO's soft decoder fixed, reranking the cosine peaks changes mean per-pair PCK by +0.47 pp. For supervised GeoAware-SC, using the odd score to select the localization window center yields only 15 net additional correct matches, with 330 corrections and 315 introduced errors. Evaluating discrimination under position conflict reveals failures hidden by aggregate accuracy. Reporting corrections and introduced errors separately also shows whether a discriminative score produces useful matching decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用"位置冲突"条件（part 判别得分与图像位置线索相矛盾）检验稠密描述子的细粒度部位判别能力，发现总体准确率掩盖了镜像/奇偶成分的严重失效，并据此设计基于奇成分得分的候选选择规则改进匹配。
AI.motivation: 整体 part-discrimination accuracy 可能被位置线索"抬高"：当图像位置与正确双侧部位一致时得分很高，位置与错误部位冲突时则可能失效，但这一失败被聚合指标掩盖。作者希望检验稠密描述子在冲突条件下是否真正区分正确部位，并检验其判别分数能否用于坐标选择。
AI.method: 在同一批目标图像与标注部位对上，用基于边界框一侧（bounding-box-side）的得分定义"位置一致"与"位置冲突"两种条件；将原始描述子分解为水平反射下的偶成分与奇成分分别比较；在 backbone 与 adapters 冻结条件下检验特征上采样；并测试基于奇成分得分的候选选择/重排规则。数据集为 SPair-71k，模型涉及 DINOv2、DINOv3、MARCO 及有监督的 GeoAware-SC。
AI.result: SPair-71k 上，冻结 DINOv2 的奇成分判别准确率从一致条件下的 86.66% 降至冲突条件下的 19.63%，而 MARCO 为 95.27%→86.16%。固定 MARCO 输入几何时，框侧冲突下奇成分准确率在原网格为 34.12%，经学习式上采样并池化回原网格后升至 88.84%。奇得分规则对 DINOv2、DINOv3 整体优于原始 hard-peak matcher，对 MARCO 在冲突查询上更优。固定 MARCO 软解码器时，对余弦峰值重排使平均每对 PCK 提升 +0.47 pp。有监督 GeoAware-SC 中以奇得分选择定位窗口中心仅净增 15 个正确匹配（330 次纠正、315 次引入错误）。
AI.conclusion: 在位置冲突条件下评估判别能力可揭示被总体准确率掩盖的失败；分别报告"纠正数"与"引入错误数"能判断一个判别得分是否真正带来有用的匹配决策，仅看净收益会掩盖其高方差特性。

title: Gradient TD($λ$) for Non-Linear Function Approximation
summary: Temporal difference (TD) learning is central to reinforcement learning. Many methods use semi-gradient TD, which may diverge, or develop algorithms with mean-squared Bellman or TD-error objectives that are difficult to analyze. Gradient TD algorithms overcome these challenges by using projection of the value function and present convergent off-policy algorithms. However, the algorithm for $λ$-return was limited to linear function approximation. Here, we extend the same to non-linear function approximation, which is desirable since many strong modern function approximators are complex and non-linear. Recent works have derived similar algorithms with a generalized projected Bellman error objective. Alternatively, we continue working with the projected Bellman error.

AI.tldr: 将梯度TD（Gradient TD）中针对λ-回报的算法从线性函数逼近推广到非线性函数逼近，坚持使用投影贝尔曼误差（Projected Bellman Error）目标。
AI.motivation: TD学习是强化学习核心，但半梯度TD可能发散；基于均方贝尔曼误差或TD误差目标的算法难以分析。梯度TD通过值函数投影克服这些困难并可得到收敛的离策略算法，然而其中λ-回报版本此前仅限线性函数逼近，而现代强函数逼近器多为复杂非线性，故需推广。
AI.method: 在非线性函数逼近下扩展λ-回报的梯度TD算法，继续以投影贝尔曼误差作为优化目标（而非近期工作中采用的广义投影贝尔曼误差）。
AI.result: 给出了适用于非线性函数逼近的λ-回报梯度TD算法框架，保持投影贝尔曼误差目标的可分析性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把λ-回报梯度TD从线性推广到非线性函数逼近，为在复杂非线性逼近器下获得可分析、收敛的离策略算法提供了途径。

title: Beyond Logits: Coherent Hallucination Mitigation via Attention Contrastive Decoding
summary:
Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate impressive multimodal capabilities, yet suffer from hallucination - generating factually inaccurate content. Contrastive Decoding (CD) mitigates this by contrasting amateur and expert branches at the logit level. However, our investigation reveals that such logit-level interventions fundamentally compromise generation coherence, necessitating restrictive penalty constraints unrelated to hallucination suppression.
  We introduce Attention Contrastive Decoding (ACD), a training-free plug-in that complements logit-level CD by relocating part of the contrastive operations to the attention mechanism. Operating at an earlier stage of the forward pass, ACD performs smooth semantic-preserving interventions through an Adaptive Subtraction Strategy (ASS), which attenuates hallucination-associated attention patterns while amplifying critical visual information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that combining ACD with existing CD methods (e.g., VCD+ACD) produces substantially more coherent outputs with further reduced hallucinations, eliminating restrictive penalties while enabling trustworthy multimodal generation.

AI.tldr: 提出注意力对比解码（ACD），将部分对比操作从logit层前移到注意力层，实现无需训练的可插拔幻觉抑制，兼顾生成连贯性。
AI.motivation: LVLM存在幻觉问题；现有对比解码（CD）在logit层对比业余/专家分支虽能抑制幻觉，但logit层干预根本性地损害生成连贯性，被迫引入与幻觉抑制无关的惩罚约束。
AI.method: ACD为无需训练的插件，在前向传播更早阶段介入：通过自适应减法策略（ASS）对注意力进行平滑、语义保持的干预，削弱与幻觉相关的注意力模式，同时放大关键视觉信息，与logit层CD互补。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ACD与现有CD方法结合（如VCD+ACD）可产生更连贯的输出并进一步降低幻觉，同时无需限制性惩罚项。
AI.conclusion: 将对比操作部分迁移至注意力层是缓解logit层CD连贯性损失的有效途径，ACD使可信多模态生成成为可能。

title: What Makes a Gavagai? Learning Visual Concepts from One Positive and Few Negatives
summary: Humans can recognize novel concepts from only a few observations by identifying defining visual attributes and eliminating alternative interpretations. However, a single observation is consistent with multiple possible concepts, and accurate visual perception alone is insufficient to determine the intended interpretation. Negative evidence can reduce this ambiguity by eliminating competing hypotheses. Inspired by Quine's gavagai problem, we introduce the Gavagai Benchmark to evaluate whether vision-language models can identify the attributes defining a novel concept from positive and negative examples. The benchmark consists of synthetic images depicting novel combinations of visual attributes and real images of newly described species. Using these datasets, we examine how models use negative examples to identify novel concepts and analyze the respective roles of visual perception and reasoning. Several models struggle even when correct attributes are provided, while others show large gaps when ground-truth attributes are replaced with model predictions. These diagnostic comparisons highlight challenges in both attribute perception and inference from limited evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Gavagai Benchmark，用于评估视觉语言模型能否从正例与负例中识别定义新概念的关键视觉属性，并区分感知与推理的作用。
AI.motivation: 人类能从少量观察中识别候选概念的界定属性并排除其他解释，但单一观察与多种概念相容，仅靠视觉感知不足以确定意图解释；负例可通过排除竞争假设降低歧义。受 Quine 的 gavagai 问题启发，作者希望系统检验 VLM 利用负例进行概念归纳的能力。
AI.method: 构建由两部分组成的数据集：(1) 合成图像，呈现视觉属性的新颖组合；(2) 真实图像，对应新描述的物种。在此基础上设计正例/负例条件，并设置"提供正确属性"与"用模型预测替换真实属性"的对照，以解耦视觉感知与推理环节。
AI.result: 多个模型即使被直接给出正确属性仍表现困难；另一些模型在真实属性被模型预测替换后出现显著性能下降。诊断性对比揭示了在属性感知与从有限证据推理两方面均存在挑战。
AI.conclusion: VLM 在利用负例消除歧义、识别定义性属性方面仍存在明显不足，感知与推理是两类独立瓶颈；该基准为诊断少样本概念学习提供了可分离的评测工具。

title: Not all world models can doubt: how training objective and architecture shape epistemic uncertainty in JEPA and RSSM world models
summary: World models predict how an environment responds to actions, so that candidate actions can be evaluated before execution. Executed actions, or decisions, taken in this manner are only as reliable as the model's predictive capabilities, and predictions in turn are only reliable within the model's experience. Epistemic uncertainty (EU) is the signal that marks where that experience ends. In this work we offer an extensive empirical study on how training objectives and architectures shape epistemic uncertainty of world models. More precisely, we present a controlled comparison of post-hoc EU (last-layer Laplace and ensembles) between two dominant models of different paradigms: 1) LeWorldModel (LeWM): A joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA), which predicts the next embedding without a decoder, and 2) DreamerV3: A recurrent state-space model (RSSM), which reconstructs the observation from a recurrent latent state. In ten simulated visual-control environments, we follow a controlled state perturbation of the environment state through every stage of the models up to the final EU estimate. We find that the RSSM attenuates the state perturbation through two mechanisms before it reaches an estimator on the predictor feature. Its recurrent update averages over context, so a change in a single frame reaches the state at a fraction of its size and recovers only as the change persists. Its reconstruction objective weights an entity by the pixels it covers, so a small object can be lost due to the training objective. The JEPA has neither mechanism and passes the change through all stages to the uncertainty. We further show that this translates to gaps in five uncertainty related downstream tasks, from unfamiliar-state detection to uncertainty-penalised planning: the RSSM uncertainty misses deviations that its own posterior registers, whereas the JEPA uncertainty reports what its model sees.

AI.tldr: 论文在十种视觉控制环境中受控比较JEPA类LeWM与RSSM类DreamerV3的事后认知不确定性（EU），发现RSSM在循环更新与重建目标两处衰减状态扰动，致其不确定性漏报自身后验已察觉的偏离；JEPA无此机制，扰动全程传递。
AI.motivation: 世界模型的决策可靠性依赖于其在经验范围内的预测能力，而认知不确定性（EU）正是标记经验边界的信号。然而，训练目标与架构如何塑造世界模型的EU尚不清楚，缺乏受控的实证对比。
AI.method: 对两种范式代表模型做受控对比：LeWM（联合嵌入预测架构JEPA，无解码器，预测下一嵌入）与DreamerV3（循环状态空间模型RSSM，从循环隐状态重建观测）。在十个仿真视觉控制环境中，采用事后EU估计器（最后一层拉普拉斯近似与集成），对环境的真实状态施加受控扰动，并逐阶段追踪该扰动穿过模型各环节直到最终EU估计。
AI.result: RSSM在扰动到达预测器特征上的估计器前，通过两种机制衰减状态扰动：(1) 循环更新对上下文做平均，单帧变化仅以部分幅度进入状态，且需变化持续才恢复；(2) 重建目标按实体覆盖的像素加权，小目标可能因训练目标而被丢失。JEPA不具备这两种机制，变化可全程传递到不确定性。该差异进一步导致五项不确定性相关下游任务（如异常状态检测、不确定性惩罚规划）上的差距：RSSM的不确定性漏报了其自身后验已记录的偏离，而JEPA的不确定性如实报告其模型所见。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型的不确定性估计质量由训练目标与架构结构决定；重建式RSSM的循环平均与像素加权重建会系统性遮蔽不确定性的敏感性，而JEPA的表征预测路径更忠实地传递状态偏离，对下游安全决策更具参考价值。

title: GeoCAM: Self-Supervised Sonar-Optical Representation Learning via Geographic Overlap Supervision
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the IEEE International Conference on Advanced Visual and Signal-Based Systems (AVSS 2026)
summary: Cross-modal self-supervised learning for paired side-scan sonar and underwater optical imagery is a promising direction for benthic habitat understanding, but it remains underexplored because existing methods do not fully exploit the one-to-many correspondences and geographic metadata available in real opti-acoustic surveys. This limits the ability to learn representations that are both semantically meaningful and geometrically consistent from abundant unlabeled marine data. To address this problem, we present GeoCAM, a geography-guided framework that learns a shared embedding space for sonar tiles and their associated optical views without semantic annotations. GeoCAM achieves its goal by combining three components: (i) a Set Attention Aggregator that adaptively summarizes multiple optical observations into a single tile-level representation; (ii) a geometry-weighted InfoNCE objective that converts GPS-derived footprint overlap into soft positive supervision; and (iii) an optional cross-modal masked reconstruction branch that encourages physically grounded cross-modal alignment. Experiments on the BenthiCat SSS-CAM dataset show that GeoCAM can be effectively exploited to learn which sonar and camera samples describe the same seabed patch, improving cross-modal retrieval and alignment over strong contrastive baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/FadiZidiDz/GeoCAM.

AI.tldr: GeoCAM：面向侧扫声呐与水下光学影像的地理引导跨模态自监督框架，用集合注意力聚合、几何加权InfoNCE与跨模态掩码重建学习共享嵌入空间。
AI.motivation: 真实光声联合调查中声呐瓦片与光学视图存在一对多对应关系并带有GPS元数据，但现有方法未充分利用，难以从大量无标注海洋数据中学到兼具语义意义与几何一致性的表征。
AI.method: 三部分组成：(i) Set Attention Aggregator 自适应地将多个光学观测汇总为瓦片级表征；(ii) 几何加权InfoNCE，将基于GPS的足迹重叠度转化为软正样本监督；(iii) 可选的跨模态掩码重建分支，促进物理一致的跨模态对齐。全程无需语义标注。
AI.result: 在BenthiCat SSS-CAM数据集上，GeoCAM能有效判别哪些声呐与相机样本对应同一海底斑块，跨模态检索与对齐性能优于强对比学习基线。
AI.conclusion: 利用一对多对应与地理元数据可显著提升光声跨模态自监督表征质量，为底栖生境理解提供可行路径；代码已开源。

title: Detectable by Design: Learning a Continuous 3D Saliency Field from 2D Detector Responses
summary:
The 3D points kept in a map decide whether a camera can be localized against it, and this choice matters more as the map becomes sparser. Existing 3D keypoint detectors usually define saliency by semantics, repeatability, reconstruction or descriptor matchability. None of these definitions asks whether a point will actually be detected in an image, and as a result most of the points they select are not detected again in images.
  In this paper, we define 3D saliency as image detectability: the response of a 2D interest-point detector at a surface point, aggregated over all views in which the point is visible. We propose DetField, a continuous field over 3D space that takes a point cloud as input and predicts detectability at any location around it. The supervision is the response of a 2D detector, back-projected from images onto the point cloud. Multi-scale curvature invariants are passed to the decoder at every query point, bypassing the voxel pooling of the encoder.
  In a localization benchmark that isolates the choice of 3D points, DetField outperforms Harris-3D and five learned 3D keypoint methods on objects and on real indoor scenes. On unseen rooms, it improves localization success by 7.4 points over Harris-3D, the strongest baseline. On objects, it also leads under a 2D detector not used in training. On sparse maps, it stays ahead of Harris-3D on both objects and real scenes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以"图像可检测性"定义3D显著性，训练连续场 DetField 预测任意3D位置的2D检测器响应，用于稀疏地图下的定位点选择。
AI.motivation: 地图中的3D点决定了相机能否被定位，地图越稀疏该选择越关键。现有3D关键点检测器的显著性定义（语义、可重复性、重建质量、描述子可匹配性）均未直接回答"该点是否会在图像中被检测到"，导致所选点大多在图像中无法被再次检测。
AI.method: 将3D显著性定义为image detectability：某表面点在所有可见视图中2D兴趣点检测器响应的聚合。提出DetField——以点云为输入、在3D空间中连续预测任意位置可检测性的隐式场。监督信号为2D检测器响应从图像反投影到点云。解码器在每个查询点接收多尺度曲率不变量，绕过编码器的体素池化。
AI.result: 在隔离3D点选择的定位基准上，DetField 在物体与真实室内场景上优于 Harris-3D 及五种学习式3D关键点方法。在未见房间上定位成功率比最强基线 Harris-3D 提升7.4个点；在物体上，使用训练中未见过的2D检测器仍领先；在稀疏地图上，物体与真实场景中均保持对 Harris-3D 的领先。
AI.conclusion: 以可检测性作为3D显著性准则并借助连续隐式场建模，可选出更易被图像检测的3D点，从而提升稀疏地图下的定位性能，且对未见场景与未见2D检测器具有泛化性。

title: Provably Efficient Offline Discounted Reinforcement Learning under Recursive Entropic Risk
summary: We study risk-sensitive reinforcement learning in finite discounted infinite-horizon Markov Decision Processes with recursive entropic risk measures (ERM), parameterized by $β\neq 0$. We consider both risk-averse ($β>0$) and risk-seeking ($β<0$) settings. We consider the offline RL setting, where the agent is provided with a fixed dataset and wishes to learn a near-optimal policy using this dataset. We introduce a model-based algorithm, called ERM Value Iteration Lower Confidence Bound (ERM-VI-LCB) and derive a PAC-type bound on its sample complexity. We also establish a corresponding lower bound, demonstrating that exponential dependence on $|β|/(1-γ)$ asserted by the upper bound is unavoidable in the worst case. The presented bounds provide the first rigorous sample complexity guarantees for offline RL under recursive ERM across both risk-averse and risk-seeking regimes.

AI.tldr: 研究有限折扣无限期MDP中基于递归熵风险度量（ERM，参数β≠0）的风险敏感强化学习，涵盖风险厌恶（β>0）与风险偏好（β<0）两种情形，首次给出离线RL下递归ERM的样本复杂度理论保证。
AI.motivation: 现有工作缺乏对离线强化学习中递归熵风险度量的严格样本复杂度分析，尤其在风险敏感（风险厌恶与风险偏好）场景下无理论刻画，因此该文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出基于模型的算法ERM-VI-LCB（ERM Value Iteration Lower Confidence Bound），在固定数据集上进行带下置信界的值迭代，并据此推导PAC型样本复杂度上界；同时构造对应的下界进行分析。
AI.result: 得到样本复杂度的PAC型上界；下界表明上界中对|β|/(1-γ)的指数依赖在最坏情形下不可消除，即上下界在指数依赖阶上匹配。
AI.conclusion: 该文给出了离线RL中递归ERM在风险厌恶与风险偏好两类情形下首个严格的样本复杂度保证，且指数依赖为问题本质而非算法缺陷。

title: Put the World Back: Timestamps Matter in Time Series Reasoning
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems. 34 pages. Equal contribution: Tingrui Huang and Yuanyuan Deng
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to time series reasoning. However, current evaluations often give models events in chronological order and already matched to the time series. This makes it unclear whether models use timestamps to connect events with observations or simply take shortcuts. To expose this ambiguity, we reformulate time series reasoning from a world-to-series projection perspective, viewing timestamps as explicit indices that connect numerical observations and external events to shared world states. We identify three structures that timestamps can make explicit: temporal causal structure, time semantics, and event-series alignment. Building on this perspective, we develop a diagnostic protocol that distinguishes timestamp-grounded reasoning from correlational shortcuts, a distinction that accuracy-based benchmarks cannot make. Controlled interventions on 310 questions from two tasks show that high accuracy can persist when timestamps are replaced by relative offsets or removed, while breaking event-series alignment induces systematic failures. When context is pre-aligned, models barely need timestamps. When order is missing, they use dates to recall world knowledge. Without dates, they rely on correlational shortcuts and rarely notice incorrect timestamps. These findings show that high accuracy on pre-aligned, ordered inputs does not establish that a model uses timestamps to synchronize observations with the world. We release our code, model outputs, and trajectory labels at https://github.com/tingrui-huang/timestamps-matter.

AI.tldr: 论文指出当前时序推理评测把事件按时间顺序给出且已与时间序列对齐，无法判断模型是否真正使用时间戳；作者从"世界到序列投影"视角把时间戳视为连接观测与事件的显式索引，识别出时间因果结构、时间语义、事件-序列对齐三种结构，并提出区分"时间戳接地推理"与"相关性捷径"的诊断协议，实验发现高准确率可在时间戳被替换或移除时依然保持。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM时序推理评测存在混杂因素：事件按时间顺序呈现且已与序列匹配，导致模型既可能真正利用时间戳把事件与观测关联到同一世界状态，也可能仅凭顺序或相关性走捷径。基于准确率的基准无法区分二者，因此需要可诊断的评测方法以厘清模型是否具备时间戳接地推理能力。
AI.method: 提出"世界到序列投影"的重构视角，将时间戳视为连接数值观测与外部事件的显式索引，并归纳时间戳可显式化的三种结构：时间因果结构、时间语义、事件-序列对齐。据此设计诊断协议，在两个任务的310个问题上进行受控干预：用相对偏移替换时间戳、完全移除时间戳、破坏事件-序列对齐，并对比准确率变化以区分时间戳接地理性与相关性捷径。
AI.result: 高准确率在时间戳被替换为相对偏移或移除时仍可保持，而破坏事件-序列对齐会导致系统性失败。具体表现为：上下文预对齐时模型几乎不需要时间戳；缺少顺序信息时模型借助日期回忆世界知识；无日期时模型依赖相关性捷径且极少察觉错误时间戳。
AI.conclusion: 在预对齐、有序输入上的高准确率并不能证明模型使用时间戳来同步观测与世界。评测需引入时间戳干预与对齐破坏等诊断手段，以检验模型的时序接地能力。作者开源代码、模型输出与轨迹标注。

title: From Prediction to Decision: Decision-Focused Fine-Tuning of Autoregressive Tabular Transformers for Cost-Sensitive Financial Events
summary: Autoregressive transformers trained on tokenized tabular event streams are a simple and strong baseline for predicting financial events such as fraud. Yet institutions do not act on probabilities; they act on decisions whose consequences are asymmetric and heteroscedastic: the cost of a missed high-value fraud and that of a wrongly declined small purchase are not the same. The standard bridge is post-hoc Bayes-optimal thresholding of calibrated probabilities under a cost matrix. We ask whether fine-tuning the model to the decision objective can do better. We fine-tune the same pretrained model so that its restricted softmax over label tokens (already a distribution over business actions) maximizes expected utility under an institution-specified, amount-scaled cost matrix. Because the reward is a known function of (action, outcome, amount) and the outcome is observed in the data, the expected-utility objective and its gradient are available in closed form. This is example-dependent cost-sensitive learning whose per-example loss is linear in the predicted probability, with no sampling, critics, or advantage estimation. A KL anchor to the pretrained model and an auxiliary language-modeling term preserve calibration and the generative event model. A sampled, group-normalized (GRPO-style) variant provides the extension point to trajectory-level rewards.

AI.tldr: 提出对预训练自回归表格事件流模型进行面向决策目标的微调：利用受限softmax对标签token的分布直接优化机构指定的、按金额缩放的非对称成本矩阵下的期望效用，闭式求解目标与梯度，并用KL锚定与辅助语言建模项保持校准与生成能力。
AI.motivation: 现有做法是先校准概率、再按成本矩阵做事后贝叶斯最优阈值决策；但真实业务后果是非对称且异方差的（漏掉高额欺诈与误拒小额交易代价不同），作者希望验证直接针对决策目标微调模型能否优于这一"概率+阈值"两段式桥接方案。
AI.method: 对同一预训练模型微调，使其在标签token上的受限softmax（本身即业务动作分布）最大化期望效用。由于奖励是(action, outcome, amount)的已知函数且结果在数据中可观测，期望效用目标及其梯度可闭式获得；本质上属于样本相关（example-dependent）成本敏感学习，逐样本损失对预测概率线性，无需采样、critic或优势估计。附加KL锚定项（约束回预训练模型）与辅助语言建模项以保持校准和生成式事件模型；并给出采样式、组归一化（GRPO风格）变体作为扩展到轨迹级奖励的接口。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，仅说明该目标可闭式优化、无需采样与critic，并指出GRPO风格变体可作为轨迹级奖励的扩展点。
AI.conclusion: 将决策论目标（金额缩放的非对称成本矩阵下的期望效用）直接内嵌进生成式事件模型的微调，是一种免采样、计算简洁的样本相关成本敏感学习方法；KL锚定与辅助LM项兼顾校准与生成建模，采样式组归一化变体为处理序列级/轨迹级奖励留出扩展空间。

title: StateWeaver: Multi-Agent Coordination of Story-State Transitions for Long-Horizon Video Generation
summary: Modern video foundation models generate high-quality short clips, but preserving long-video consistency and correctly depicting event-driven state changes remain challenging. Existing agentic workflows face these challenges because continual planning and repair accumulate context, while reference updates remain limited. We introduce StateWeaver, which combines Active States and Hierarchical Collaboration to connect review-driven visual reference updates with cross-shot state inheritance. Active States translate state discrepancies identified during review into concrete visual asset requirements that guide reference construction, validation, and regeneration, preserving identity and already-correct content while repairing target attributes. Confirmed generation results are linked to the corresponding asset states, story time, and reference versions for verification and reuse by subsequent shots. Hierarchical Collaboration isolates execution contexts by task, clip, and repair round, and uses hierarchical memory to organize this process across multiple sets. Across multiple benchmarks, StateWeaver outperforms existing methods and produces long videos with sustained cross-shot consistency under predefined and autonomously planned storyboards.

AI.tldr: StateWeaver：用“主动状态”与“分层协作”解决长视频生成中的跨镜头一致性与事件驱动的状态变化问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视频基础模型能生成高质量短视频，但长视频一致性与事件驱动状态变化的正确刻画仍困难；现有智能体式（agentic）管线中持续规划与修复导致上下文累积，且参考更新受限。
AI.method: 提出 StateWeaver，结合主动状态（Active States）与分层协作（Hierarchical Collaboration）：将审阅中发现的状态差异转化为具体视觉资产需求，指导参考构建、校验与重生成，在修复目标属性的同时保持身份与已正确内容；将确认的生成结果与资产状态、故事时间及参考版本关联以便校验和复用；分层协作按任务、片段、修复轮次隔离执行上下文，并用分层记忆跨多集合组织流程。
AI.result: 在多个基准上优于现有方法，可在预定义与自主规划的故事板下生成具有持续跨镜头一致性的长视频。
AI.conclusion: 通过状态化参考更新与上下文隔离的记忆机制，StateWeaver 有效缓解上下文累积与参考滞后，实现长视频的跨镜头一致性生成。

title: Interpretable and Accurate Hybrid Decision Trees with Selective Case-Based Splits
summary: Decision trees are among the most well-known interpretable models in Machine Learning. Over the years, a wide variety of strategies have been proposed to define split conditions within the greedy learning framework, aiming to guide instance routing and enhance predictive performance. These strategies range from axis-parallel and oblique splits based on feature values to proximity-based splits using exemplar instances and more complex hybrid approaches. However, no single method has emerged as universally superior. In this work, we present two key contributions to the construction of greedy decision trees. First, we propose a hybrid tree architecture that integrates both feature-based and case-based splits, allowing for heterogeneous splits throughout the tree. Second, we introduce a novel type of split that leverages a selective case-based approach: when a split is needed, our method searches for the most informative subset of features to define the split, effectively balancing the specificity of case-based methods with the simplicity of feature-based ones. Experiments on a diverse set of tabular datasets show that our method outperforms standard decision trees and achieves performance on par with ensemble methods, while producing shallow trees that retain or even improve predictive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种混合贪心决策树架构，融合基于特征与基于案例（原型实例）的两类分裂；并提出"选择性案例式分裂"，在需要分裂时搜索最具信息量的特征子集来定义分裂，从而兼顾案例式方法的特异性和特征式方法的简洁性。
AI.motivation: 现有贪心决策树的各类分裂策略（轴平行、斜向、基于邻近性的原型实例分裂、混合方法等）各有优劣，尚无普遍最优者；因此希望统一并改进分裂机制，在保持可解释性（浅树）的同时提升预测性能。
AI.method: 1）设计混合树结构，允许树中不同节点采用异构分裂（特征式与案例式共存）；2）引入选择性案例式分裂：当节点需分裂时，先搜索最具信息量的特征子集，仅在该子集上定义分裂，以平衡案例式分裂的高特异性与特征式分裂的简单性；在标准贪心学习框架下训练。
AI.result: 在多个多样化表格数据集上的实验表明：该方法优于标准决策树，性能与集成方法相当，同时生成更浅的树，并保持甚至提升预测精度。
AI.conclusion: 异构分裂的混合决策树与选择性案例式分裂是提升贪心决策树的有效途径，可在不牺牲可解释性（浅树）的前提下获得接近集成模型的精度。

title: WebVibe: Multimodal Interactive Website Generation via Reverse Synthesis and Visual Self-Distillation
summary: Although multimodal large language models translate single screenshots into static HTML, generating interactive functional websites from design specifications still struggles with multi-page routing and stateful widget transitions. Examining existing training pipelines reveals two bottlenecks: (1) in forward data synthesis (X -> Y), writing the specification X before code execution leaves unimplemented or altered requirements in X as supervision noise; and (2) in reinforcement learning, scalar rewards discard the rich state transitions observed during replay. Based on these findings, we introduce WebVibe and Interactive-SDPO to train InteractiveCoder. WebVibe reverses synthesis into Y -> X by verifying cross-page and in-page interactions in the browser before deriving multimodal inputs from replay-confirmed states to build the 31,542-site WebVibe-32K corpus with reusable execution contracts. Interactive-SDPO then conditions a weight-sharing self-teacher on the replay trace and a 2x2 state-transition montage to provide token-level supervision at zero inference-time overhead. On the public Vision2Web L2, one-shot InteractiveCoder-9B nearly 3x its base model's functional score (20.2 to 55.2 FS) and matches a 1T-parameter coding agent in a single pass with 111x fewer total parameters and 78x fewer tokens. On our WebVibeBench, InteractiveCoder-4B and 9B further outperform all evaluated baselines by over 23 points.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出WebVibe数据合成管线与Interactive-SDPO训练方法，训练InteractiveCoder模型，实现从设计规格自动生成可交互、多页面网站。
AI.motivation: 现有方法虽能将单张截图转为静态HTML，但在多页面路由与有状态控件的状态切换上表现不佳。原因在于：(1) 前向数据合成(X→Y)中，先写规格X再执行代码，导致X中未被实现或被改动的需求成为监督噪声；(2) 强化学习使用标量奖励，丢弃了回放过程中丰富的状态转移信息。
AI.method: 提出两条改进：其一，WebVibe将合成方向反转为Y→X，先在浏览器中验证跨页面与页内交互，再由回放确认的状态推导多模态输入，构建含31,542个网站的WebVibe-32K语料并附带可复用执行契约；其二，Interactive-SDPO将权重共享的自教师模型以回放轨迹与2×2状态转移拼图为条件，提供token级监督，且不增加推理时开销。
AI.result: 在公开Vision2Web L2上，单次推理的InteractiveCoder-9B功能得分由基线的20.2提升至55.2 FS（近3倍），以单次通过匹配1T参数编码智能体，总参数少111倍、token少78倍；在WebVibeBench上，4B与9B版本均超出所有评测基线23分以上。
AI.conclusion: 以执行验证驱动的反向数据合成与基于状态转移轨迹的token级偏好监督，可显著提升大模型生成交互式功能性网站的能力，并在参数与token效率上具备明显优势。

title: A Calibration-Referenced Protocol for Measuring Decision Stability under Reference Bank Compression
comment: 54 pages, including supplementary material (Tables S1-S11 and Figures S1-S4). Interval summaries and probe-sensitivity CSV files are included as ancillary material
summary: Reference banks used for industrial image inspection can be compressed to fit a deployment budget, but the resulting anomaly decisions depend on both the compressed scores and the operating threshold. We present a four-step protocol that compares compression methods at matched deployment sizes, establishes a reference distribution from 200 recalibrations, evaluates disagreement against two calibration benchmarks, and measures changes by distance from the full-bank threshold. With WideResNet-50, budget-matched product quantization (PQ) at the 10% budget has the lowest decision disagreement among five matched methods, including int8 scalar quantization, on VisA and MVTec AD at both operating levels. Int8 scalar quantization gives lower disagreement than PQ at the other four budgets. On MVTec AD at the lower operating level, PQ meets the calibration median in 34/39 cells and the upper quantile in 39/39 cells. Category-equally weighted image-level AUROC loss at this budget ranges from 0.0003 to 0.0037 across the evaluated configurations. On VisA at the 1% budget and a 1% operating level, disagreement reaches 28.12% (95% CI 23.25--33.58%) among near-threshold anomalies and 1.30% (0.79--2.14%) across the normal holdout. The 10% budget-matched PQ setting retains the lowest disagreement among four compared methods with ResNet-18, with clean reference banks, and when thresholds are estimated from normal-directory probes. The protocol connects deployment size to a calibration-referenced decision measure and identifies the evaluation populations most informative for inspection.

AI.tldr: 提出四步协议，在同等部署规模下比较参考库压缩方法并评估其对异常决策（含阈值）的影响；10%预算下的乘积量化(PQ)在五种方法中决策不一致率最低，但其他四个预算下int8标量量化更优。
AI.motivation: 工业图像检测中的参考库（reference bank）需压缩以满足部署预算，但压缩会同时改变异常分数与工作阈值，仅报告AUROC等分数级指标不足以刻画实际部署中的异常判定差异，缺少将部署规模与校准参考的决策度量联系起来的评估协议。
AI.method: 四步评估协议：(1)在匹配的部署规模下比较压缩方法；(2)用200次重校准建立参考分布；(3)针对两个校准基准评估不一致率；(4)按与全库阈值的距离度量变化。在VisA与MVTec AD上，以WideResNet-50和ResNet-18为骨干，比较PQ、int8标量量化等五种方法在5个预算与两个工作阈值水平下的表现，并考察类别等权图像级AUROC损失、近阈值异常与正常留出集两个评估总体，以及干净参考库、正常目录探针估计阈值等鲁棒性设定。
AI.result: WideResNet-50下，10%预算的PQ在五种匹配方法（含int8）中决策不一致率最低；其余四个预算int8标量量化优于PQ。MVTec AD低工作水平下，PQ在34/39个单元达到校准中位数、39/39达到上分位数；该预算下类别等权图像级AUROC损失为0.0003–0.0037。VisA在1%预算与1%工作水平下，近阈值异常的不一致率达28.12%（95% CI 23.25–33.58%），正常留出集为1.30%（0.79–2.14%）。ResNet-18、干净参考库、正常目录探针阈值设置下，10%预算PQ仍保持最低不一致率。
AI.conclusion: 该协议将部署规模与经校准参考的决策度量相连接，并识别出近阈值异常与正常留出集是检测评估中最具信息量的总体；最优压缩方法依赖于部署预算与工作阈值水平，需在固定预算下按决策不一致率而非仅分数指标选择。

title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
summary: Looped Transformers boost expressivity by reusing shared layers across loops, yet at the cost of efficiency. Pushing their expressivity-efficiency frontier requires rethinking the core mechanism connecting adjacent loops: What should be passed as a Transformer loops? We introduce Mixture-of-Loops Transformer (MoLT), whose Mixture-of-Loops Attention (MoLA) uses keys and values (KV) as memory for selective reuse across depths and loops. Under loop residual, MoLT-R retains the residual stream and reads local KV across loops for expressivity. Under loop KV, MoLT-KV instead restarts from embeddings and reads current-loop local KV with preceding-loop memory KV at earlier positions for efficiency. MoLT-KV eliminates same-position cross-loop dependence and, paired with loop forcing for parallel training, unlocks single-traversal Mixture-of-Loops (MoL) decoding beyond the training loop horizon. To balance efficiency and quality, we introduce U-shaped MoLT (U-MoLT), which separates memory construction from prediction readout and skips unused decoder traversals without changing predictions. In 400B-token pretraining, U-MoLT outperforms OLMo3 across 700M/1.5B dense and 3B MoE models, achieving 1.7x validation cross-entropy (CE) token efficiency at 700M while improving 3B MoE 10-domain perplexity by 0.75 and 10-task accuracy by 2.1 percentage points. In 100B-token continued pretraining of Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base, our U-MoLT adaptation lowers CE on all 11 domains over the matched baseline with 1.4x mean token efficiency. At inference, U-MoLT with MoL-Hybrid-2 matches non-looped OLMo3 latency at 996.6 vs. 1,000.6 ms on S-size (~113M) models. Code is available at https://github.com/hustvl/MoLT

AI.tldr: 提出 Mixture-of-Loops Transformer (MoLT)，用「选择性复用 KV」重新定义循环间传递的内容，在保持表达力的同时提升效率；U 形结构 U-MoLT 可跳过无用解码遍历，在 400B token 预训练与继续预训练中均优于 OLMo3。
AI.motivation: 循环 Transformer 通过跨循环复用共享层提升表达力，但牺牲效率。要在表达力—效率前沿上取得突破，必须重新审视相邻循环之间的核心连接机制，即「应该把什么传给下一个 Transformer 循环」。现有做法对所有信息一视同仁地传递/复用，缺乏对内存读写位置与粒度的选择性控制。
AI.method: 1) 提出 MoLT，其 Mixture-of-Loops Attention (MoLA) 将 keys/values (KV) 作为内存，支持跨深度与循环的选择性复用。2) 两种变体：MoLT-R（loop residual）保留残差流并在循环间读取局部 KV 以增强表达力；MoLT-KV 从 embedding 重启，读取当前循环的局部 KV 与前一循环在更早位置的内存 KV，以提升效率。3) MoLT-KV 消除同位跨循环依赖，配合 loop forcing 实现并行训练，并支持超出训练循环视界的单次遍历 Mixture-of-Loops (MoL) 解码。4) 提出 U 形 MoLT (U-MoLT)，将内存构建与预测读出分离，在不改变预测的前提下跳过未使用的解码器遍历，平衡效率与质量。
AI.result: 400B token 预训练：U-MoLT 在 700M/1.5B dense 与 3B MoE 上均优于 OLMo3；700M 上验证集 CE 的 token 效率提升 1.7×；3B MoE 上 10 领域 perplexity 改善 0.75，10 任务准确率提升 2.1 个百分点。Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base 上 100B token 继续预训练：U-MoLT 适配在全部 11 个领域降低 CE，平均 token 效率 1.4×。推理端：U-MoLT + MoL-Hybrid-2 在 S 规模（~113M）模型上延迟 996.6 ms，与非循环的 OLMo3 的 1,000.6 ms 相当。
AI.conclusion: 将「跨循环传递/复用何种 KV 记忆」作为循环 Transformer 的核心设计变量，可在不牺牲推理速度的前提下显著提升预训练 token 效率与下游质量；U-MoLT 通过分离内存构建与读出实现可跳过的解码遍历，使循环架构在延迟上与非循环基线持平。

title: An Image Detectability Field as a Viewpoint Utility for 2D-3D Localization in Sparse Maps
summary: In 2D-3D localization, a camera estimates its pose by matching an image to a 3D map. A camera held in a hand or mounted on a robot can often choose its viewpoint before it takes the image. In this work, we ask whether an image detectability field is a useful viewpoint utility when the planner reads only the geometry of the map. The field can be queried at any 3D point near a surface. From the local geometry around the point, it predicts how likely a 2D image detector is to fire at the projection of the point. We use the trained field as it is, without fine-tuning it for view selection. A fixed SuperPoint and EPnP-RANSAC localizer then estimates the pose from the chosen view. We answer in two settings, each with a test registered before the runs. On synthetic ShapeNet objects with sparse point maps, summing the field over the visible landmarks beats counting them by +2.0 points of localization success rate (object-clustered 95% interval [+0.7, +3.2]). It also beats summing Harris-3D ranks by +2.2 [+0.8, +3.5]. On real indoor scenes from SceneFun3D, our adaptation of the learned view scorer LWL falls below counting on the test rooms. We therefore add the field to a learned per-landmark planner. On the test rooms with sparse maps whose landmarks the field also selects, the planner with the field beats the same planner without it by +1.8 points. It beats the planner with Harris-3D or curvature in its place by +1.0 and +0.8 points. All three room-clustered intervals lie above zero. In both settings, the field helps in sparse maps and is on par with Harris-3D in dense maps.

AI.tldr: 该文提出将"图像可检测性场"（image detectability field）作为视角规划中的效用函数：仅凭地图局部几何即可预测2D检测器在3D点投影处响应的概率，并用于主动视角选择以提升2D-3D定位成功率。
AI.motivation: 手持或机器人搭载的相机在拍摄前常可自主选择视角，因此在2D-3D定位中，视角规划直接影响可匹配地标的质量。已有规划器多依赖几何计数或手工特征（如Harris-3D、曲率）来评估视角效用，未直接建模"2D检测器是否真的会在该点触发"这一关键因素。
AI.method: 训练一个可在表面附近任意3D点查询的可检测性场，由点的局部几何预测检测器在该点投影处触发的概率；直接使用训练好的场（不针对视角选择微调）。以固定的SuperPoint与EPnP-RANSAC定位器在所选视角上估计位姿。设置两组实验，均预先注册测试：合成ShapeNet对象（稀疏点图）与真实室内SceneFun3D场景；并与地标计数、Harris-3D秩求和等基线比较。在真实场景中，将场接入学习式的逐地标规划器（替代或补充LWL式视角评分）。
AI.result: ShapeNet稀疏点图：对可见地标求和的场比计数高+2.0个百分点的定位成功率（对象聚类95%区间[+0.7,+3.2]），比Harris-3D秩求和高+2.2[+0.8,+3.5]。SceneFun3D：自适应的学习视角评分器LWL在测试房间上低于计数基线；将场加入逐地标学习规划器后，在场同时筛选地标的稀疏图测试房间上，比无场版本高+1.8点，比以Harris-3D或曲率替代者分别高+1.0与+0.8点，三个房间聚类区间均高于零。两种设置下，场在稀疏图中有效，在稠密图中与Harris-3D相当。
AI.conclusion: 图像可检测性场是一种无需微调即可用于视角规划的有用效用函数，尤其在稀疏地图中显著优于地标计数与手工几何特征；在稠密地图中与Harris-3D持平，表明其增益主要体现在稀疏条件下。同时，学习式视角评分器（LWL）直接迁移到新场景效果有限，而将场嵌入逐地标规划器更为稳健。

title: A gene informed benchmark for BioScoring of pathology foundation models
summary: Pathology foundation models are usually compared by their performance on downstream tasks such as classification and retrieval. While such benchmarks measure how useful a model is, they provide no insight into the biology it represents. We introduce BioScore, a benchmark that quantifies how well an image encoder captures cell identities, with spatial transcriptomics of the same tissue as the reference. A sparse autoencoder splits the encoder's patch embeddings into sparse features, which we cluster into a fixed number of groups. BioScore then measures, for each of 52 cell identities defined by marker genes, how specifically one group follows the identity's expression over the tissue. Because the autoencoder training is fully unsupervised, a match shows that the model represents the cell identity from the image alone. We score 8 pathology foundation models and 3 natural-image models. Every pathology model scores above every natural-image model (0.299--0.371 \vs 0.214--0.232), and paired tests separate three tiers among the pathology models. Unlike a supervised probe, BioScore needs no labels, builds its reference from the data and scores even from few sections, yet it ranks the encoders as a probe does. Its per-identity breakdown indicates which cell identities each encoder captures or misses.

AI.tldr: 提出BioScore基准，用同组织空间转录组为参照，通过稀疏自编码器将编码器patch嵌入分解为稀疏特征并聚类，量化图像编码器对52种细胞身份的编码特异性，无需标签即可评价病理基础模型的生物学表征能力。
AI.motivation: 现有病理基础模型多以分类、检索等下游任务性能比较，只能反映"有用性"，无法揭示模型所表征的生物学信息。需要一个能直接衡量编码器是否捕捉细胞身份（生物学语义）的评测基准。
AI.method: 以同一组织的空间转录组为金标准：用稀疏自编码器对编码器patch嵌入做稀疏分解，将稀疏特征聚为固定数量特征组；对由marker基因定义的52种细胞身份，逐一测度某一特征组在组织切片上跟随该身份表达的特异性。自编码器训练完全无监督，因此匹配成立即说明模型仅凭图像即可表征该细胞身份。评测8个病理基础模型与3个自然图像模型。
AI.result: 所有病理模型得分均高于所有自然图像模型（0.299–0.371 vs 0.214–0.232）；配对检验在病理模型间区分出三个层级；BioScore与监督线性探针的排序一致，但无需标签、参照由数据自身构建，且少样本切片即可评分；逐身份细分可指出各编码器捕捉或遗漏的细胞类型。
AI.conclusion: BioScore提供了无需标注、可解释到细胞身份粒度的生物学表征评测，可作为下游任务指标的补充；结果表明病理域预训练确实带来细胞身份层面的表征优势，并能量化模型间的差异。

title: Benefit of Structured Representations: When Equivariance Helps in Image Classification
summary: Equivariant neural networks promise improved representation learning through structural guarantees. However, mainstream vision encoders rarely incorporate equivariance for most geometric symmetries. Images are a particularly interesting modality with many such symmetries and extensive datasets from which to learn this structure. In this work, we investigate when vision encoders benefit from geometric inductive biases. We study the discrete rotation group of quarter-turns (C4) which acts losslessly without interpolation or boundary artifacts. Combined with image classification as a controlled invariant objective, this allows for a principled empirical investigation into the role of structural guarantees. We introduce ConvNeXt-C4 as a rotation equivariant ConvNeXt with dimension-equivalent yet orientation-structured representations. Training from scratch, our experiments show, that the C4 variant outperforms its base model across all tasks while operating with 6x fewer parameters and 1.6x fewer FLOPs. Its performance advantage increases log-linearly with decreasing training set size, with pre-training providing a similar improvement across both model variants. Analyzing the classifier head reveals that orientation information from the representations' structure is actively used, improving performance by 4.90% across all datasets. Our results highlight the sample-efficiency benefits of equivariance and the value of retained orientation information, motivating further investigation beyond image classification. Code is available at https://github.com/hlzl/equivariant-convnext.

AI.tldr: 提出 ConvNeXt-C4，一种对四分之一转（C4）旋转群等变的 ConvNeXt 变体，在参数少 6 倍、FLOPs 少 1.6 倍的条件下于所有任务上优于基线，并揭示等变带来的样本效率收益与方向信息的价值。
AI.motivation: 主流视觉编码器很少引入几何等变性等结构保证；图像模态蕴含大量几何对称性且有充足数据可学习此类结构，因此需要系统性实证研究视觉编码器何时能从几何归纳偏置中获益。
AI.method: 选择无插值、无边界伪影的离散四分之一转旋转群 C4，并以图像分类作为受控的不变目标；构建 ConvNeXt-C4，即在 ConvNeXt 中引入 C4 等变结构，使表示在维度等价的前提下具有方向结构化的组织方式；从零训练，对比基线与 C4 变体在不同数据规模下的表现，并分析分类头对方向信息的使用情况。
AI.result: C4 变体在所有任务上均优于基模型，同时参数量减少 6 倍、FLOPs 减少 1.6 倍；其性能优势随训练集规模减小呈对数线性增长；预训练对两种变体带来相近的提升；分类头分析表明表示结构中的方向信息被有效利用，使各数据集上性能平均提升 4.90%。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了等变性带来的样本效率优势以及保留方向信息的价值，并支持将此类研究推广到图像分类之外的更广泛任务。

title: Attack Policy Selection can Mislead Monitor Evaluators
summary:
AI monitors, classifiers that flag dangerous behaviour by AI agents, are often evaluated against transcripts generated by attack policies acting as proxies for dangerous behaviour in deployment. We evaluate an ex-production OpenAI monitor as a case study and find that measured false negative rate is highly sensitive to both the method used to generate attack policies and the level of optimisation applied within that method. This rate ranged from 0.5\% to 20.8\% across optimisation levels of a single method (reinforcement learning), and from 6.4\% to 23.0\% across methods at their best observed optimisation level (optimised prompting vs.\ transcript editing). Every attack policy was developed against proxy monitors only: all reported results show attacks transferring to the held-out GPT-5.4 target monitor. Our results suggest that monitor evasion evaluations can easily mislead: an evaluation using only basic attack methods may give false confidence that a monitor is strong.
  The sensitivity to attack-policy choice raises a problem: interpreting any particular result as evidence about deployment performance requires justification. The transcripts produced by attack policies are proxies for the dangerous behaviour a monitor must flag in deployment. These proxies can introduce visible artefacts, such as reasoning about a ``side task'' absent from the instructions shown to the monitor, that affect monitor judgements. Given the sensitivity above, the choice of proxy can change an evaluation's conclusion. Reading these results as evidence about deployment therefore requires a separate legitimacy argument for why the proxies are informative, including any justification of conservativeness. Making convincing arguments remains an open problem.

AI.tldr: 以一款已投产的OpenAI监控器为案例，发现其漏报率对攻击策略的生成方法与优化程度高度敏感（同一强化学习方法内0.5%–20.8%，不同方法间6.4%–23.0%，均迁移至held-out的GPT-5.4目标监控器），因此监控器规避评估极易误导；将代理攻击结果解读为部署证据需另行论证代理的合法性，而这仍是未解问题。
AI.motivation: AI监控器（标记AI agent危险行为的分类器）通常用"攻击策略"生成的对话记录作为部署中危险行为的代理来评估，但这类代理的有效性本身缺乏检验。作者担心：若评估结论高度依赖代理攻击策略的选择与强度，则单次评估可能给出错误的安全信心。
AI.method: 案例研究：对一款已退出生产的OpenAI监控器进行红队式评估，系统比较两类攻击策略生成方法（优化提示词 optimised prompting、对话记录编辑 transcript editing）及单一方法（强化学习）在不同优化程度下的表现；所有攻击策略仅针对代理监控器开发，再测试其对held-out目标监控器（GPT-5.4）的迁移；同时定性分析代理记录中可能影响监控器判断的可见伪迹（如推理中出现指令中并不存在的"side task"）。
AI.result: 测得的漏报率（FNR）在强化学习不同优化水平下从0.5%波动到20.8%，在各方法最佳优化水平间为6.4%–23.0%；所有攻击均成功迁移至held-out的GPT-5.4目标监控器。此外，代理记录带有可见伪迹（如关于"side task"的推理）会系统性影响监控器判断。
AI.conclusion: 监控器规避评估容易误导：仅使用基础攻击方法会带来虚假的安全信心。由于结果对代理选择高度敏感，任何单一结果要作为部署性能证据，都需额外论证代理策略的合法性（包括保守性论证），目前尚无成熟方案，仍为开放问题。

title: Spe3DUp: Faithful Trajectory Distillation for Fast Image-to-3D Generation
summary: Recent 3D generative models can produce high-quality meshes with complex structures and fine geometric details, with broad applications in games, film, and digital design. However, high-quality generation typically relies on long multi-step sampling processes that repeatedly evaluate large networks, leading to long inference times. At the same time, reference-driven tasks such as game-asset reconstruction and product digitization demand close correspondence to the input image: generated geometry must faithfully reconstruct the specific reference object. Acceleration must therefore reduce sampling computation while preserving the model's ability to reconstruct that object. To enable fast and faithful 3D generation, we introduce Spe3DUp, a coarse-to-fine framework based on Faithful Trajectory Distillation (FTD). FTD directly supervises few-step students with the teacher's input-conditioned denoising trajectories to preserve its generation behavior. We apply FTD separately to coarse geometry generation and geometric refinement, compressing both sampling processes while maintaining correspondence to the reference input. We further accelerate the complete mesh-generation pipeline with efficient geometry decoding and parallel remeshing. Experiments show that Spe3DUp maintains geometric quality and input correspondence close to those of the teacher, accelerates the coarse and refinement DiTs by 10.0x and 19.9x, respectively, and achieves a 7.7x end-to-end speedup over the original teacher pipeline.

AI.tldr: 提出Spe3DUp粗到细框架，基于Faithful Trajectory Distillation（FTD）将参考图像驱动的3D网格生成的多步采样蒸馏为少步生成，并结合高效几何解码与并行重网格化，实现端到端7.7倍加速且保持几何质量与输入对应性。
AI.motivation: 高质量3D生成模型依赖长多步采样与大型网络反复推理，导致推理时间过长；而游戏资产生成、产品数字化等参考驱动任务要求生成几何忠实对应输入图像，因此加速必须在减少采样计算的同时保留模型对特定参考物体的重建能力。
AI.method: 提出FTD（Faithful Trajectory Distillation），直接用教师模型以输入为条件的去噪轨迹监督少步学生模型，以保留其生成行为；并将FTD分别应用于粗几何生成与几何细化两个阶段，压缩各自采样过程；同时用高效几何解码与并行重网格化加速完整网格生成流水线，形成粗到细框架Spe3DUp。
AI.result: 几何质量和输入对应性接近教师模型；粗阶段与细化阶段DiT分别加速10.0倍和19.9倍；相对原始教师流水线端到端加速7.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于轨迹蒸馏的分阶段加速策略可在参考驱动的3D生成中有效兼顾效率与保真度，且与解码、重网格化等流水线级优化叠加后获得显著端到端收益。

title: Can image generation help visual reasoning? An empirical study
summary: Language models think in words; then multimodal models might think in images. We test whether a generated helper improves the answer to a visual question. A model describes the helper it needs and then answers using the original and generated images together. Across 13 vision-language model and generator pairs, generation lowers mean accuracy by 3.7 percentage points, with declines on nine of ten tasks. Two unified models, BAGEL and Janus-Pro-7B, each lose accuracy on eight tasks. On VSTAR, adding a generated image to the same planning hint lowers accuracy by 10.47 points. Repeated image edits yield different outcomes across tasks. ChartQAPro and MathVista stay below their no-generation baselines, while ERQA gains three points after ten edits.

AI.tldr: 论文检验"多模态模型是否能在图像中思考"：让模型先描述它需要的辅助图像，再结合原图与生成图像作答；结果在13组模型/生成器配对中平均准确率下降3.7个百分点，说明"生成式视觉思维链"目前并未带来收益。
AI.motivation: 语言模型以词元（words）进行推理，"思维链"在文本任务中有效，因此有理由假设多模态模型可用图像作为中间推理载体（thinking in images）。作者希望验证：让模型自行生成"辅助图像"能否提升视觉问答的作答质量，即显式的视觉化中间步骤是否真的有用。
AI.method: 提出"生成辅助图再作答"的范式：模型先以文本描述它所需的辅助图像（helper），由图像生成器合成该图，随后模型同时以原始图像与生成图像为输入回答视觉问题。实验覆盖13组"视觉语言模型 × 图像生成器"配对、10项任务，并对统一多模态模型（BAGEL、Janus-Pro-7B）单独评测；另外考察多次图像编辑（repeated edits）对结果的影响，并与无生成基线对比。
AI.result: 1）跨13组配对，生成辅助图使平均准确率下降3.7个百分点，10项任务中9项出现下降；2）两个统一模型中，BAGEL与Janus-Pro-7B各有8项任务准确率下降；3）VSTAR上，在同一规划提示中加入生成图像使准确率下降10.47个百分点；4）重复编辑结果因任务而异：ChartQAPro与MathVista始终低于无生成基线，而ERQA在10次编辑后提升约3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态模型"以图像思考"的收益为负：自行生成的辅助图像总体上是噪声而非有效推理中间态，重复编辑也难稳定补偿。少数任务（如ERQA）的增益提示该范式存在任务依赖的潜力，但尚无普适性。作者据此对"图像即思维链"的直觉提出质疑，并指出需要更可靠的视觉中间表示与生成-验证机制。

title: SemProxy: Semantic 3D Proxies for Controllable Agentic 3D Modeling
summary: Coding agents are increasingly capable of generating 3D models, yet enabling users to effectively control the modeling process remains challenging. Existing workflows rely primarily on text prompts and reference images, which often struggle to convey precise spatial intentions and require iterative corrections. We introduce SemProxy, a lightweight intermediate representation that bridges intuitive human interaction and agentic 3D modeling. Instantiated as labeled 3D bounding boxes, semantic 3D proxies allow users to directly specify object parts and spatial arrangements while leaving geometric details to coding agents. These proxies can be serialized into structured text and rendered as images, making them directly accessible to existing coding agents without additional training or modifications. We further develop ProxyStudio, a user interface that integrates text, image references, and interactive 3D proxy editing into agentic modeling workflows. We demonstrate the versatility of SemProxy across object- and scene-level modeling tasks with different coding agents, and evaluate its effectiveness in supporting controllable human-agent collaborative 3D modeling through a user study.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量中间表示SemProxy（语义3D代理，实例化为带标签的3D包围盒），将用户直观的空间/部件意图编码为可序列化文本与可渲染图像，无需额外训练即可接入现有编码智能体进行可控3D建模，并配套ProxyStudio交互界面。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体已具备生成3D模型的能力，但用户难以有效控制建模过程。现有工作流主要依赖文本提示与参考图像，难以表达精确的空间意图，往往需要反复迭代修正。
AI.method: 提出SemProxy作为人与智能体3D建模之间的中间表示：以带标签的3D包围盒直接指定物体部件与空间布局，几何细节交由编码智能体完成；代理可序列化为结构化文本并渲染为图像，从而被现有编码智能体直接使用，无需额外训练或修改。同时开发ProxyStudio界面，整合文本、图像参考与交互式3D代理编辑。
AI.result: 在不同编码智能体上，于物体级与场景级建模任务中展示了SemProxy的多功能性，并通过用户研究评估了其在支持可控人-智能体协同3D建模方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以语义3D代理作为人机之间的轻量契约，可在不改变现有编码智能体的前提下实现更精确、更少迭代的可控3D建模，为人-智能体协同创作提供了可行范式。

title: Non-Linear Motion from Two Frames: Cubic Hermite Trajectories for Video Frame Interpolation
summary: Two-frame video frame interpolation commonly resamples endpoint optical flow by the query time, which selects a constant-velocity straight-line path even though the same endpoint displacement is compatible with many intermediate trajectories. We present HermiteVFI, which replaces independent query-time motion prediction with one explicit continuous trajectory per pixel. The measured endpoint displacement fixes the two trajectory positions, while two latent endpoint derivatives learned from the frame pair control the interior path. A cubic Hermite curve is the minimum-degree polynomial that can independently satisfy these two position and two derivative boundary quantities. Its residual form contains linear motion exactly, structurally preserves the measured displacement endpoints for any network output, and has coefficients that are predicted once per frame pair and evaluated in closed form at arbitrary t. We further show that one interior query time gives a rank-deficient constraint on the two free trajectory coefficients, whereas any two distinct interior times are full rank at the representation level, motivating multi-time supervision. Appearance-derived directional cues help infer the latent derivatives that endpoint displacement alone cannot identify. On X4K1000FPS, SNU-FILM, and Vimeo90K-Septuplet, the largest gains occur for difficult non-uniform motion and high interpolation ratios. The amortization applies to trajectory-coefficient prediction; downstream reversal, refinement, and synthesis remain query dependent.

AI.tldr: HermiteVFI用"每像素一条显式连续轨迹"替代传统的查询时刻独立光流外推：端点位移固定轨迹两端位置，网络为每对帧预测一次两个潜在端点导数，用三次Hermite曲线闭式求值任意 t 的中间位置，并给出多点监督的秩论证。
AI.motivation: 传统两帧插值在查询时刻对端点光流重采样，等价于强制匀速直线轨迹，即便相同端点位移对应众多中间轨迹，也难以表达非匀速、非直线的复杂运动，尤其在高插值倍率与难样本上退化明显。
AI.method: 将插值重构为轨迹表示问题：端点位移作为两个位置边界条件，帧对学习两个潜在端点导数作为速度边界条件；采用最低次数的三次Hermite多项式构造残差形式，其线性运动成分被精确包含、端点位移对任意网络输出结构守恒，系数每帧对预测一次并以闭式公式在任意 t 求值。另证明单一内部时刻对两个自由系数仅构成秩亏约束，任意两个互异内部时刻在表示层面满秩，据此引入多时刻监督；并用外观导出的方向线索辅助推断端点位移无法辨识的潜在导数。
AI.result: 在X4K1000FPS、SNU-FILM与Vimeo90K-Septuplet上验证，增益最大处集中于非匀速运动等困难场景与高插值倍率；摊销仅作用于轨迹系数预测，下游的反向(反转)、细化与合成仍依赖查询时刻。
AI.conclusion: 以显式连续轨迹参数化替代逐查询时刻的运动预测，可在保持端点保真与线性运动精确性的同时提升复杂运动建模能力；多时刻监督对系数可辨识性必要，且该设计可与既有插值主干解耦配合。

title: HSTTA: Hierarchical Selective Test-Time Adaptation for Label-Free Cross-Subject EEG-to-Image Retrieval
summary: Cross-subject EEG-to-image retrieval suffers from substantial performance degradation on new subjects due to subject shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) can mitigate this shift by adapting pretrained models with unlabeled target-subject EEG. However, most existing TTA methods struggle to match supervision granularity to each query's prediction confidence, leaving many queries without reliable pseudo-labels. To address this, we propose a novel framework named Hierarchical Selective Test-Time Adaptation (HSTTA). HSTTA builds a hierarchy over gallery image embeddings, uses hierarchical selective prediction to assign each EEG query a supervision granularity matching its current prediction confidence, and constructs adaptation objectives accordingly. We further propose Cross-Session Consistency Calibration (CSCC), an unsupervised method that calibrates the global confidence threshold to target a predefined accuracy level for hierarchical predictions. Moreover, we introduce Reciprocal Hierarchical Backoff (RHB), which moves queries lacking reverse-matching support to coarser nodes to mitigate error reinforcement. Experiments on two public benchmarks and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of HSTTA and its key components. On THINGS-EEG2, HSTTA outperforms the strongest EEG-specific TTA baseline by 17.9 (13.4) and 8.9 (3.7) percentage points in Top-1/Top-5 accuracy, respectively, under cosine (CSLS) ranking. Further analyses show that HSTTA yields more accurate pseudo-labels during adaptation, supporting more reliable model updates.

AI.tldr: 提出分层选择性测试时自适应框架HSTTA，为每个EEG查询按预测置信度匹配监督粒度，并用CSCC与RHB提升伪标签可靠性，在THINGS-EEG2上Top-1/Top-5分别较最强EEG专用TTA基线提升17.9/8.9（余弦）与13.4/3.7（CSLS）个百分点。
AI.motivation: 跨被试EEG到图像检索存在显著被试偏移，导致在新被试上性能大幅下降。测试时自适应（TTA）可利用目标被试的无标注EEG微调预训练模型，但现有TTA方法难以使监督粒度与每个查询的预测置信度相匹配，导致大量查询无法获得可靠伪标签。
AI.method: 1) HSTTA：在gallery图像嵌入上构建层次结构，通过分层选择性预测为每个EEG查询分配与其当前置信度匹配的监督粒度，并据此构造自适应目标；2) CSCC（跨会话一致性校准）：无监督地校准全局置信度阈值，使分层预测达成预设准确率水平；3) RHB（互惠分层回退）：将缺乏反向匹配支持的查询移至更粗粒度节点，抑制错误强化。
AI.result: 在两个公开基准及消融实验上验证了HSTTA及其关键组件的有效性。THINGS-EEG2上，余弦排序下Top-1/Top-5分别超过最强EEG专用TTA基线17.9和8.9个百分点，CSLS排序下分别超过13.4和3.7个百分点。进一步分析表明，自适应过程中HSTTA产生的伪标签更准确，从而支持更可靠的模型更新。
AI.conclusion: 按查询置信度动态匹配监督粒度的分层选择性TTA能有效缓解跨被试偏移；结合无监督阈值校准与互惠分层回退，可显著提升EEG-to-image检索的跨被试泛化性能与伪标签质量。

title: One Representation to Rule Them All -- Open-Vocabulary Change Detection from Text or Visual Examples
summary: Open-vocabulary change detection (OVCD) aims to localise user-specified changes without retraining for predefined categories. Existing approaches typically rely on textual descriptions and combine separate models for region proposal, semantic recognition, and temporal comparison. This limits how target concepts can be expressed and makes detection dependent on several intermediate predictions. We introduce OVTSID3, a training-free framework that unifies region grouping, concept identification, and temporal comparison in the representation space of DINOv3. OVTSID3 supports two complementary modes of concept specification: zero-shot textual queries or one-shot visual prompting through a masked reference pair. OVTSID3 outperforms all prior training-free OVCD methods on two building and two natural-disaster benchmarks, raising the average F1 by 8.9 points. OVTSID3 also supports semantic change detection and achieves state-of-the-art on SECOND. These results demonstrate the flexibility of a unified representation for text- or example-guided change detection without task-specific model training.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 OVTSID3，在 DINOv3 表征空间内统一区域分组、概念识别与时相比较，支持零样本文本查询与单样本视觉提示两种概念指定方式。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇变化检测方法依赖文本描述，且将区域提议、语义识别与时相比较拆分为独立模型，限制了目标概念的表达方式，并使检测结果依赖多个中间预测。
AI.method: 免训练统一框架：在 DINOv3 的表示空间中同时完成区域分组（region grouping）、概念识别与时相比较；概念指定支持两种互补模式——零样本文本查询，或通过掩码参考图像对进行单样本视觉提示。
AI.result: 在两个建筑类与两个自然灾害类基准上优于所有既有免训练 OVCD 方法，平均 F1 提升 8.9 个点；同时支持语义变化检测，在 SECOND 数据集上达到 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 统一的表征空间可在无需任务特定模型训练的情况下灵活支持文本引导或示例引导的变化检测，兼具零样本与单样本提示能力。

title: OceanFix: Reference-Guided Diffusion for Sparse-View Underwater 3D Reconstruction
summary: Recent advances in Gaussian splatting have enabled efficient underwater reconstruction, but sparse observations, light attenuation, and backscatter still leave scene regions underconstrained and cause novel-view artifacts. We present OceanFix, a reference-guided framework for sparse-view underwater 3D reconstruction that combines diffusion-based view repair with Gaussian scene refinement. Our repair model follows a two-stage training strategy that separates underwater appearance adaptation from geometric refinement. The first stage learns underwater appearance from reference observations and estimated medium features. The second uses camera poses and reference depth to align reference features, with relative-depth supervision guiding structural repair without requiring target-view depth at inference. We further propose medium-aware distillation that transfers repaired views into the 3D scene according to geometric repair demand and channel-specific optical observability. Through iterative rendering, repair, and distillation, OceanFix refines underconstrained regions while retaining supervision from the observed views. Experiments on underwater datasets demonstrate that OceanFix improves rendering quality in sparse-view 3D reconstruction, reducing visible artifacts and recovering finer scene details.

AI.tldr: OceanFix是一个参考引导的稀疏视角水下三维重建框架，将基于扩散模型的视角修复与高斯场景精化相结合，通过两阶段训练和介质感知蒸馏，在稀疏观测下改善渲染质量、减少伪影并恢复细节。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯泼溅虽能高效实现水下重建，但稀疏观测、光衰减与后向散射导致部分场景区域约束不足，新视角渲染出现伪影。因此需要一种能在稀疏视角条件下对欠约束区域进行有效补全与监督的方法。
AI.method: 提出OceanFix：1）修复模型采用两阶段训练，第一阶段从参考观测与估计的介质特征学习水下外观，第二阶段利用相机位姿与参考深度对齐参考特征，并以相对深度监督引导结构修复（推理时无需目标视角深度）；2）提出介质感知蒸馏，依据几何修复需求与通道相关光学可观测性将修复视角迁移至三维场景；3）通过渲染—修复—蒸馏的迭代流程精化欠约束区域，同时保留观测视角的监督。
AI.result: 在水下数据集上的实验表明，OceanFix提升了稀疏视角三维重建的渲染质量，减少了可见伪影，并恢复了更精细的场景细节。
AI.conclusion: 将扩散式视角修复与高斯场景精化耦合，并引入介质感知的蒸馏策略，可有效缓解稀疏水下观测的欠约束问题，为稀疏视角水下三维重建提供了可行方案。

title: Most of the Way There: Turning a Strong Video Prior into an Action-Conditioned World Model
summary: Modern video generators excel at producing visually plausible futures guided by text and image prompts. Yet their emphasis on semantic plausibility does not guarantee fidelity to the physical consequences of specific actions. Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs), in contrast, aim to simulate how the world responds to robot actions, enabling scalable policy evaluation and improvement without costly real-world rollouts. The challenge is not merely to generate a plausible future, but to predict what follows from a specific physical action. As video priors grow stronger, we ask how little adaptation is truly needed to bridge this gap. We introduce Dianjing, a minimal recipe that preserves and unlocks the capabilities of strong video priors through unified physical action conditioning, training concentrated at the high noise levels where motion and layout, and thus the consequences of actions, are decided, and native history conditioning. Built upon MiniMax H3, a 33B video foundation model, Dianjing freezes the pretrained backbone and trains only 0.34% of its parameters using approximately 65 hours of robot video across two embodiments, without additional robot-specific pretraining or camera calibration. Controlled ablations show that where training is allocated across noise levels matters more than how actions enter the network. On WorldOracle, which evaluates predictions against paired real-world executions, Dianjing achieves the best scores on four of the five evaluation tracks and ranks second on AgiBot-Long. Our findings suggest that strong video priors already bring us most of the way to world modeling; lightweight physical action grounding can unlock their potential for real-world prediction.

AI.tldr: Dianjing 在冻结的 33B 视频基础模型 MiniMax H3 上仅训练 0.34% 参数，用统一的动作条件注入、集中于高噪声水平的训练与原生历史条件，即以极小的自适应代价把视频先验转化为动作条件世界模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成器擅长生成视觉上合理、语义可信的未来，但不保证遵循特定动作的物理后果；而动作条件世界模型（ACWM）需要刻画"给定某一具体物理动作后世界如何响应"，以支持无需真实部署的可扩展策略评估与改进。作者由此追问：在视频先验已足够强的今天，弥合这一差距所需的适应究竟可以有多小。
AI.method: 提出 Dianjing 这一"极简配方"：1）统一的物理动作条件注入；2）将训练集中于运动与布局（即动作后果）被决定的高噪声水平；3）原生历史条件。基座为 33B 视频基础模型 MiniMax H3，冻结预训练骨干，仅训练约 0.34% 参数，使用两种本体、约 65 小时机器人视频，无需额外的机器人专用预训练或相机标定。并通过受控消融比较训练在各噪声水平的分配与动作进入网络的方式。
AI.result: 在以下两项上得到验证：受控消融表明，训练在噪声水平上的分配比动作如何注入网络更关键；在将预测与真实配对执行结果进行对比的 WorldOracle 上，Dianjing 在五个评估赛道中的四个取得最佳分数，在 AgiBot-Long 上位列第二。
AI.conclusion: 强视频先验本身已把大部分通往世界建模的路走完；轻量级的物理动作接地即可释放其用于真实世界预测的潜力。动作条件世界模型的瓶颈不在规模或结构复杂度，而在"在哪里适配"——把有限参数预算花在决定动作后果的高噪声阶段收益最大。

title: Modality-Shift Contrastive Decoding for Temporally Grounded Audio-Visual Understanding
summary: Audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) are designed to represent the temporal structure of audio and video, yet it remains unclear how effectively they use this temporal information to relate sounds to visual events. To examine this, we probe an AV-LLM on an audio-visual synchronization task by shifting the audio so that the queried sound overlaps a different visual event. We observe that the model still favors the originally aligned event over the newly aligned one, indicating limited sensitivity to changes in audio-visual temporal alignment. To address this, we propose Modality-Shift Contrastive Decoding (MSCD), a training-free decoding method that emphasizes audio-visual temporal alignment in model predictions. MSCD contrasts logits under preserved and disrupted temporal alignment to favor predictions supported by aligned audio and video. We disrupt this alignment by temporally shifting either the audio or the video, while keeping the other modality fixed. Extensive evaluations with two AV-LLMs across three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of MSCD for temporally grounded audio-visual understanding. In particular, MSCD improves accuracy over the base models on Daily-Omni by 2.2 and 2.8 percentage points for OmniVinci and video-SALMONN 2+, respectively, suggesting that emphasizing temporal alignment can also benefit broader audio-visual understanding.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示 AV-LLM 对音视频时间对齐变化不敏感（存在"原始对齐偏置"），并提出免训练的解码方法 MSCD，通过对比保持对齐与破坏对齐条件下的 logits 来强化时间对齐信息的使用，在两个模型、三个基准上取得提升。
AI.motivation: AV-LLM 声称能表征音视频的时序结构，但其是否真正利用时间信息来关联声音与视觉事件尚不清楚。作者通过诊断实验发现模型对音视频时间错位不敏感，因而需要一种方法来提升其时间对齐敏感性。
AI.method: 诊断：在音视频同步任务中平移音频，使查询声音与另一视觉事件重叠，观察模型仍偏好原始对齐事件。方法：提出 Modality-Shift Contrastive Decoding（MSCD），一种免训练的解码策略，将保持对齐与破坏对齐（对音频或视频之一做时间平移、另一模态固定）两种条件下的 logits 进行对比，从而偏向由对齐的音视频共同支持的预测。
AI.result: 在两个 AV-LLM（OmniVinci、video-SALMONN 2+）和三个基准上评估，MSCD 均有效；在 Daily-Omni 上相对基模型分别提升 2.2 和 2.8 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: AV-LLM 对音视频时间对齐的利用有限；显式强调时间对齐的对比解码可有效且免训练地改善时间接地的音视频理解，并能泛化惠及更广泛的音视频任务。

title: ProxyGenBench: Benchmarking Proxy-Guided Video Generation
summary: Recent video generators produce realistic videos, yet controlling how scenes unfold remains challenging. Structural proxies, such as animated 3D blockouts, guide generation by specifying scene layout, motion, camera behavior, and event order. However, these coarse inputs leave details unspecified and may contain artifacts that should not be reproduced. Successful proxy-guided generation must therefore Preserve intended structure, Complete missing content and correct proxy artifacts, and Bind text, image, and audio conditions to the right entities and events. We introduce ProxyGenBench to study these interacting requirements, with 312 evaluation cases from 60 scenes across three scene tasks and controlled variations in proxy fidelity, text detail, and multimodal inputs. We evaluate five video generators using verified, case-specific checklists.
