Experiments show that proxies improve spatiotemporal control, but greater proxy detail can coincide with poorer completion, while strong structural adherence does not ensure correct binding.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ProxyGenBench，用于系统评测"结构代理（3D 动画草模）引导的视频生成"，围绕保持结构、补全内容/修正代理瑕疵、多模态条件正确绑定三项交互需求，构建 312 个评测用例（60 个场景、3 类场景任务）并控制代理保真度、文本细节与多模态输入变量，用经校验的逐例检查表评测 5 个视频生成器。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成器虽能生成逼真视频，但难以控制场景如何展开。动画 3D 草模等结构代理可指定布局、运动、相机行为与事件顺序，然而这类粗粒度输入细节缺失且自身带有伪影，不应被原样复现。因此需要明确"保留意图结构—补全缺失内容并纠正代理伪影—将文本/图像/音频条件绑定到正确实体与事件"这三项相互耦合的需求，并缺少针对性的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 ProxyGenBench：选取 60 个场景、覆盖 3 类场景任务，共 312 个评测用例；对代理保真度、文本细节程度、多模态输入配置做受控变化，形成因子化评测设计；采用经人工校验、针对具体用例的检查表（checklist）对 5 个视频生成器进行评测，并分解考察结构遵循、内容补全与条件绑定等维度。
AI.result: 实验表明：结构代理能提升时空控制能力；但代理细节更丰富时，内容补全质量可能反而下降；同时结构遵循度高并不能保证条件绑定正确，说明三项需求之间存在权衡与解耦现象。
AI.conclusion: ProxyGenBench 揭示了代理引导视频生成中"遵循—补全—绑定"三者的交互与矛盾，指出单一指标（如结构相似度）不足以评估该任务，需以多维、逐例检查表方式进行诊断性评测，为后续方法设计提供明确的改进方向。

title: Admoab-DETR: Resolution-Tiered Fusion for Infrared-Visible Object Detection with Missing Modalities
summary: Infrared and visible images offer complementary cues for all-weather object detection, yet real-world sensor dropouts can leave one stream unavailable and degrade paired-input detectors. Meanwhile, existing modality-adaptive methods apply heavy cross-modal attention uniformly across scales, incurring prohibitive token overhead on high-resolution maps. We propose Admoab-DETR, a unified real-time detector supporting infrared-only, visible-only, and paired inputs with a single set of weights. Specifically, \emph{Resolution-Tiered Fusion} (RTF) allocates fusion capacity by spatial token density and feature granularity: a lightweight Spatial Modality Gate governs fine local fusion at the highest-resolution scale with zero-cost single-view pass-through, while channel-compressed deformable Admoab necks capture cross-modal correspondence at coarser semantic scales. Furthermore, \emph{Mode-Matched Feature Distillation} (MMFD) aligns multi-scale encoder features with an availability-synchronized full-fusion teacher, avoiding ill-posed cross-modal hallucination while cutting parameters by 18.1\% and paired latency by 39.6\% at zero inference overhead. We also construct Admoab, a strictly registered 20,000-pair infrared--visible benchmark across diverse scenes. Experiments show Admoab-DETR achieves state-of-the-art accuracy--efficiency trade-offs across missing-modality and paired benchmarks. Our code will be available at https://github.com/liwenchao0615/Admoab-DETR.

AI.tldr: 提出 Admoab-DETR，一套权重同时支持红外单模、可见光单模与双模输入的实时目标检测器，通过分层融合与模态匹配蒸馏在零推理开销下实现更优精度-效率折中。
AI.motivation: 红外与可见光图像互补，可支撑全天候目标检测，但实际传感器掉线会导致单路缺失、成对输入检测器性能退化；同时现有模态自适应方法在各尺度上统一施加沉重的跨模态注意力，在高分辨率特征图上产生难以承受的 token 开销。此外缺乏严格配准的红外-可见光评测基准。
AI.method: 1) Resolution-Tiered Fusion (RTF)：按空间 token 密度与特征粒度分配融合容量——最高分辨率尺度用轻量 Spatial Modality Gate 做细粒度局部融合并支持零成本单视图直通；较粗语义尺度用通道压缩的可变形 Admoab neck 建模跨模态对应关系。2) Mode-Matched Feature Distillation (MMFD)：以可用性同步的全融合教师对齐多尺度编码器特征，避免不适定的跨模态幻觉。3) 构建 Admoab 基准：严格配准的 20,000 对红外-可见光数据，覆盖多样场景。
AI.result: 在缺失模态与成对输入基准上均取得 SOTA 的精度-效率折中；参数量减少 18.1%，成对推理时延降低 39.6%，且无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 分层分配融合容量并按模态可用性匹配蒸馏，可在单一权重下统一三种输入模式，兼顾鲁棒性与实时性；新构建的严格配准基准为缺失模态检测研究提供评测基础。

title: Angular Interpolation in Sparse-View Low-Dose CT Reconstruction: Placement Effects and Data-Consistency Step-Size Scaling
summary: Dual-domain networks combine projection and image processing for sparse-view low-dose computed tomography (CT). We quantify the contribution of angular interpolation before learning and distinguish its roles in sinogram initialisation and the image residual base. On synthetic parallel-beam data, parameter-free interpolation reduces noise-free missing-view mean absolute error by 99.7% relative to zero filling at 60 views. Full-view filtered back-projection (FBP) of the jointly learned completed sinogram adds 1.27 dB of peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) over interpolated FBP. In a data-consistency dual-domain network (DC-DuNet), a 2x2 configuration ablation controls branch width, depth and training schedule while varying these placements and their associated input channels. After 20 epochs, the PSNR contrasts are +1.98 dB for sinogram initialisation and -2.16 dB for the interpolated image base; the image-base ranking also reverses during training. The sinogram-initialised variant exceeds an image-only U-Net by 0.96 dB at 60 views and 10% dose, and by 1.28 dB on independently generated synthetic data. The U-Net leads at higher view counts and with a shared interpolated image base. Without retraining, the variant retains a 0.12 dB advantage on held-out CHAOS abdominal CT under simulated degradation; the image-base contrast rounds to zero. The implemented projection/backprojection pair has empirical dominant gain of approximately 0.85NK, where N is image-grid width and K acquired view count. These results distinguish interpolation placement from network architecture and support NK normalisation for step calibration.

AI.tldr: 该文将无参数角度插值置于双域CT网络的两个不同位置（正弦图初始化 vs. 图像残差基底），通过2×2配置消融、跨数据独立验证及投影/反投影尺度分析，量化插值位置对稀疏视角低剂量CT重建性能的独立贡献。
AI.motivation: 双域网络混合投影域与图像域处理，但此前工作未厘清"学习前角度插值"本身的贡献，也未区分插值分别置于正弦图初始化与图像残差基底时的作用差异，导致架构效应与预处理效应混杂，难以指导设计。
AI.method: 在合成平行束数据上比较插值与零填充；用全视角FBP评估联合学习补全正弦图；以DC-DuNet为平台进行2×2配置消融，在控制分支宽度、深度与训练计划的前提下改变插值位置及对应输入通道；并在独立生成的合成数据与仿退化CHAOS腹部CT上做无重训泛化测试；同时测量实现所用投影/反投影算子对的支配增益。
AI.result: 60视角下插值较零填充降低无噪缺失视角MAE达99.7%；学习补全正弦图的全视角FBP较插值FBP提升1.27 dB PSNR。20 epoch后正弦图初始化增益+1.98 dB，插值图像基底为−2.16 dB且排序随训练反转。正弦图初始化变体在60视角、10%剂量下超图像-only U-Net 0.96 dB，独立合成数据上1.28 dB；高视角与共享插值图像基底时U-Net占优。无重训条件下在CHAOS上保留0.12 dB优势，图像基底对比趋零。投影/反投影算子对经验支配增益约0.85NK。
AI.conclusion: 插值放置位置是与网络架构可分离的独立设计变量，正弦图初始化优于图像残差基底；结果支持以NK归一化进行步长标定，并提示需在目标视角/剂量区间内验证配置选择。

title: Loop4D: Embodied World Modeling with 4D VAEs and Looped Diffusion Transformers
summary: Predicting the outcomes of robotic manipulation requires modeling both visual appearance and evolving 3D geometry. This poses two challenges: video compression can obscure fine-grained robot motion, while jointly predicting RGB and geometry demands sufficient generative capacity. We introduce Loop4D, a framework that addresses these challenges through motion-preserving 4D representations and recurrent generative refinement. Our 4D VAE encodes RGB and pointmap sequences into compact spatiotemporal latents while preserving motion details and geometric structure. Our RGB VAE combines geometry-guided supervision with predictive reconstruction to reduce compression-induced motion artifacts. Our geometry VAE uses lightweight adapters to adapt pretrained RGB representations while preserving their priors. Building on these representations, our Dual-Stream Looped Diffusion Transformer maintains separate appearance and geometry streams with shared Transformer weights and cross-modal connections. By reusing Transformer blocks across loops, we increase effective depth without replicating backbone parameters, enabling models with fewer parameters to improve joint RGB-geometry prediction through additional computation. Experiments demonstrate high-quality 4D generation and validate Loop4D in simulated robotic manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Loop4D，用运动保持的 4D 表示（RGB+pointmap 序列）与循环式生成式精炼，联合预测机器人操作的视觉外观与演化 3D 几何。
AI.motivation: 预测机器人操作结果需同时建模视觉外观与动态 3D 几何；但视频压缩易模糊精细机器人运动，且联合预测 RGB 与几何需要足够生成容量，二者构成双重挑战。
AI.method: 1) 4D VAE 将 RGB 与 pointmap 序列编码为紧凑时空潜变量，保持运动细节与几何结构；2) RGB VAE 采用几何引导监督+预测式重建以减少压缩引起的运动伪影；3) 几何 VAE 用轻量 adapter 适配预训练 RGB 表征并保留其先验；4) Dual-Stream Looped Diffusion Transformer 维护外观与几何双流，共享 Transformer 权重并设跨模态连接，通过跨循环复用模块块增加有效深度而不复制主干参数。
AI.result: 实验实现高质量 4D 生成，并在仿真机器人操作任务中验证了 Loop4D 的有效性；较少参数模型可借助更多计算提升 RGB-几何联合预测。
AI.conclusion: 以运动保持的 4D 潜表示结合循环扩散精炼，可在控制参数量的前提下有效提升机器人操作结果的 4D 联合预测质量。

title: PURA: Video Token Pruning via Unified Spatiotemporal Redundancy Assessment
summary: Video large language models incur substantial inference costs from long visual token sequences. Existing video token compression methods mitigate these costs by exploiting spatial redundancy within frames and temporal redundancy across frames. However, many approaches impose predefined processing orders or fixed allocation ratios for spatial and temporal compression, limiting their ability to adapt to the varying balance of spatiotemporal redundancy across videos. To address this limitation, we propose PURA, a training-free method that prunes visual tokens through unified spatiotemporal redundancy assessment. For each token, PURA constructs spatial and temporal reference candidates and selects the reference with the lowest representation error across the two dimensions. The representation error is combined with token importance to determine each token's removal cost. To avoid the time overhead of removing the lowest-cost token one by one, we introduce Coordinated Pruning, which iteratively groups mutually compatible low-cost removals into batches for simultaneous execution and updates the pruning state after each batch until the target budget is reached. Extensive experiments on three video large language models and five video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that PURA achieves a favorable trade-off between task performance and inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的视频token剪枝方法PURA，通过统一的时空冗余度评估决定token去留，并配合Coordinated Pruning批量剪枝，在三个视频大模型和五个基准上取得性能与效率的良好平衡。
AI.motivation: 视频大语言模型因长视觉token序列带来高推理开销。现有压缩方法利用帧内空间冗余与帧间时间冗余，但多采用预定义的处理顺序或固定的时空压缩分配比例，难以适应不同视频中时空冗余比例的变化。
AI.method: PURA为每个token同时构造空间参考候选与时间参考候选，选取在两维度上表示误差最低的参考；将表示误差与token重要性结合，得到每个token的移除代价。为避免逐个移除最低代价token的时间开销，引入Coordinated Pruning：迭代地将相互兼容的低代价移除分组为批次并行执行，每批后更新剪枝状态，直至达到目标预算。方法无需训练。
AI.result: 在三个视频大语言模型和五个视频理解基准上的大量实验表明，PURA在任务性能与推理效率之间取得了有利的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 统一时空冗余度评估可自适应视频内容，避免人工设定时空压缩顺序与比例；配合批量协调剪枝降低剪枝开销，使PURA成为免训练且高效的视频token压缩方案。

title: HAS: Hierarchical Adaptive Frame Sampling for Video Understanding
summary: Due to context-length constraints, most MLLMs cannot process full-length videos and therefore rely on sampling a subset of frames as input. However, existing sampling methods, ranging from uniform sampling to relevance-based selection, are often driven by a single sampling principle and thus struggle to accommodate the heterogeneous evidential requirements of different queries: some demand a holistic understanding of how the video unfolds over time, while others hinge on fine-grained events within a short temporal window. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{Hierarchical Adaptive Frame Sampling (HAS)}, a two-stage frame sampling framework. In the first stage, \emph{Backbone Frame Construction}, we apply a Determinantal Point Process (DPP) to sample frames that are both query-relevant and non-redundant. These selected frames capture key moments across the video and form the backbone of the sampling set, providing a foundation for subsequent enrichment. In the second stage, \emph{Adaptive Contextual Enrichment}, we analyze the temporal distribution of the backbone frames to infer the query's requirements and adaptively allocate the remaining frame budget between Local and Global Context. The Local Context enriches the backbone with fine-grained temporal dynamics and short-range causal relations, whereas the Global Context connects temporally isolated evidence and provides a holistic view of the entire video to support global understanding. Through such a hierarchical two-stage process, HAS effectively addresses diverse query requirements. Incorporated into three leading MLLMs, it demonstrates consistently superior performance across the Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and MLVU benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段层次化自适应帧采样框架HAS：先用DPP选查询相关且不冗余的骨干帧，再依据骨干帧时间分布推断查询需求，将剩余预算自适应分配给局部与全局上下文。
AI.motivation: MLLM受上下文长度限制无法处理全长视频，需采样帧输入；但均匀采样、相关性选取等现有方法多由单一采样原则驱动，难以兼顾不同查询的异质证据需求——有的需整体时序理解，有的依赖短时窗内的细粒度事件。
AI.method: 两阶段框架。阶段一"骨干帧构建"：用行列式点过程（DPP）采样兼具查询相关性与非冗余性的帧，覆盖关键时刻并作为后续增强的基础。阶段二"自适应上下文增强"：分析骨干帧的时间分布以推断查询需求，在局部上下文与全局上下文之间自适应分配剩余帧预算；局部上下文补充细粒度时序动态与短程因果关系，全局上下文连接时间上孤立的证据并提供视频整体视图。
AI.result: 将该方法集成到三种主流MLLM中，在Video-MME、LongVideoBench和MLVU三个基准上均取得一致的更优性能。
AI.conclusion: 层次化两阶段采样能有效应对多样化的查询需求，验证了"查询相关非冗余选帧+按需分配局部/全局上下文"这一设计的有效性与跨模型可迁移性。

title: Variation-aware Temporal Correspondence for Self-Supervised Video Representation Learning
summary: Self-supervised video representation learning has achieved remarkable progress by leveraging large-scale unlabeled video data. Recent methods commonly extend Masked Image Modeling (MIM) to Masked Video Modeling (MVM), where video representations are learned by capturing semantic information from temporal contexts during masked content recovery. Unlike static images, videos exhibit inherent temporal variation, as visual objects continuously change their positions, appearances, and motion states across frames. Therefore, MVM needs to preserve semantic consistency while capturing temporal changes of corresponding regions, which raises two central challenges: 1) how to establish reliable temporal correspondence across frames, and 2) how to formulate an appropriate representation learning objective for modeling both semantic consistency and temporal variation. To address these challenges, we propose Variation-aware Temporal Correspondence for video Representation learning (VT-CoRe) framework. For challenge 1), VT-CoRe introduces a sandwich sampling strategy to construct two-sided temporal references and a Patch Registration Module (PRM) to establish reliable patch-level correspondence. For challenge 2), VT-CoRe imposes latent-space semantic alignment on registered representations through a self-distillation architecture and further proposes temporal variation modeling to constrain representation trajectories over time. Experiments on 8 downstream tasks across 16 benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and applicability of VT-CoRe across pixel-level, frame-level, video-level, and vision-based robotic learning scenarios. Complementary representation analysis shows that VT-CoRe learns a more structured latent space for variation-aware temporal correspondence learning.

AI.tldr: 提出VT-CoRe框架，通过"三明治采样+块配准模块"建立可靠帧间时序对应，并用自蒸馏语义对齐与时序变化建模约束表征轨迹，兼顾语义一致性与时序变化。
AI.motivation: 视频的视觉对象在帧间持续变化位置、外观与运动状态，因此掩码视频建模（MVM）在恢复被掩码内容时，既要保持区域语义一致性，又要刻画其随时间的变化。这引出两个核心挑战：1）如何跨帧建立可靠的时序对应关系；2）如何设计能同时建模语义一致性与时序变化的表征学习目标。
AI.method: 针对挑战1，VT-CoRe引入sandwich采样策略构建双侧时序参考，并提出Patch Registration Module (PRM) 建立可靠的块级（patch-level）对应。针对挑战2，通过自蒸馏架构对配准后的表征施加隐空间语义对齐，并进一步提出时序变化建模（temporal variation modeling）以约束表征随时间的演化轨迹。
AI.result: 在16个基准、8类下游任务上进行实验，覆盖像素级、帧级、视频级以及视觉机器人学习等场景，验证了VT-CoRe的有效性与适用性；补充的表征分析表明，该方法学习到了更具结构性的隐空间，有利于变化感知的时序对应学习。
AI.conclusion: VT-CoRe通过显式建立变化感知的时序对应与相应学习目标，统一了语义一致性与时序变化建模，在多种下游场景中表现良好，为自监督视频表征学习提供了有效范式。

title: Recalling the Past to Answer the Present: Context-Aware Multi-Evidence Reasoning for Streaming Video Question Answering
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding, yet existing video question answering (VQA) benchmarks mainly evaluate models in offline settings. Real-world streaming scenarios instead require models to answer context-dependent queries by retrieving and reasoning over evidence distributed across the video history. We introduce StreamRecall, a benchmark for context-aware Multi evidence reasoning in streaming video QA. StreamRecall requires models to retrieve, associate, and reason over temporally scattered evidence to answer queries at the appropriate moment. It contains 4,983 questions over 462 videos, with context-aligned query times and fine-grained temporal evidence annotations. We further propose the Evidence Utilization Cascade to diagnose model reasoning through evidence localization, grounding, chain completion, and answer derivation. To enable efficient long-term streaming reasoning, we present EviStream, a training-free causal visual memory mechanism that preserves reasoning-critical evidence under a fixed KV budget. Experiments reveal substantial gaps between current VLMs and realistic streaming requirements, establishing StreamRecall as a foundation for developing evidence-aware streaming video intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出面向流式视频问答的基准 StreamRecall（4,983 问题、462 视频，含上下文对齐的提问时刻与细粒度时序证据标注）、证据利用级联诊断框架，以及免训练的因果视觉记忆机制 EviStream。
AI.motivation: 现有视频问答基准主要在离线设定下评测，而真实流式场景要求模型在恰当时间点、依赖分布在视频历史中的多段证据进行检索与推理，二者存在明显评测缺口。
AI.method: 构建 StreamRecall 基准：问题在上下文对齐的时间点提出，并提供细粒度时序证据标注；提出 Evidence Utilization Cascade，按证据定位、证据接地、证据链补全、答案推导四阶段分解诊断模型推理；提出 EviStream，一种免训练的因果视觉记忆机制，在固定 KV 预算下保留推理关键证据。
AI.result: 实验显示现有视觉语言模型与真实流式需求之间存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: StreamRecall 为发展具备证据感知能力的流式视频智能提供了基础评测平台，EviStream 为高效长时流式推理提供了可行路径。

title: AnyCam4D: Ray-Based 4D Gaussian Rendering for Arbitrary Camera Models
summary: Real cameras are not pinholes, yet most dynamic Gaussian splatting assumes they are. Footage is therefore undistorted first, losing field of view or detail, especially with wide-angle and fisheye cameras. Static Gaussian splatting has largely solved this with ray-based rendering, which suits any camera. Native 4D Gaussians, which model motion in space-time, cannot use it directly: each Gaussian's orientation and size cannot be recovered reliably from its covariance. We present AnyCam4D, which trains native 4D Gaussians on original footage by ray-based rasterization, preserving field of view and resolution at about the per-step cost of standard projection. Our key contribution is a numerically stable way to obtain orientation and size: we condition a square root of the 4D covariance. Trained models render through other cameras, with rolling shutter, depth of field or chromatic aberration. With a synthetic 170-degree fisheye camera, training on original images improves peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) by 3.0-8.1 dB. On real footage, AnyCam4D has lower perceptual error than the standard projection adapted to each camera, at comparable PSNR and without camera-specific derivations. With the synthetic camera rotated 60-80 degrees away from the capture rig's view, it leads by 6.2 dB against ground truth.

AI.tldr: 提出AnyCam4D，用基于射线的光栅化直接在原始（含畸变）视频上训练原生4D高斯，并通过稳定的4D协方差平方根分解获得高斯的朝向与尺寸，从而避免去畸变带来的视场与细节损失。
AI.motivation: 现有动态（4D）高斯泼溅默认相机为针孔模型，需先去畸变，导致广角/鱼眼数据丢失视场或细节；静态高斯的射线式渲染虽已解决该问题，但原生4D高斯因运动建模使协方差难以稳定恢复朝向与尺寸，无法直接套用。
AI.method: AnyCam4D在原始素材上用射线式光栅化训练原生4D高斯，每步开销与标准投影相当；关键是对4D协方差做数值稳定的平方根条件化（conditioning a square root of the 4D covariance），以可靠提取高斯的方向与尺度。渲染时可直接通过其他相机模型成像，支持卷帘快门、景深与色差等效应。
AI.result: 合成170°鱼眼相机下，使用原始图像训练使PSNR提升3.0–8.1 dB；真实素材上在PSNR相当的情况下感知误差低于逐相机适配的标准投影方案，且无需针对相机做专门推导；将合成相机相对采集装置视角偏转60–80°时，相对真值领先6.2 dB。
AI.conclusion: 射线式光栅化结合稳定的4D协方差平方根参数化，使原生4D高斯可直接在畸变广角/鱼眼视频上训练，在不损失视场与分辨率的前提下实现跨相机、跨效应的新视角合成，且计算成本与标准投影接近。

title: Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence
summary: Establishing effective scaling laws for medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains a persistent and fundamental challenge. Our systematic evaluation shows that existing medical MLLMs tend to underperform frontier general-purpose MLLMs across a range of medical tasks, while scaling model size primarily improves text capabilities rather than multimodal perception, and enabling reasoning modes fails to close this visual gap. To investigate how medical multimodal intelligence scales in practice, we introduce Sage-Med-Preview, a 35B-parameter medical multimodal model with 3B activated parameters, built by combining stage-specific curation over 322.7 million candidate records with a progressive training curriculum spanning medical pretraining, staged supervised fine-tuning, and adaptive reinforcement learning. Across this curriculum, progressive supervised refinement and adaptive reinforcement learning yield consistent stage-wise gains, substantially advancing both specialized visual understanding and medical language capabilities. Evaluated against 77 competing models across 238 clinical tasks spanning 61 public and 13 private multi-center benchmarks in more than 40 modalities, Sage-Med-Preview achieves an average score of 58.26% on the 31 public multimodal benchmarks. It outperforms the state-of-the-art open-source medical model Hulu-Med-235B-A22B at 50.99% and the general scientific model Intern-S2-Preview at 52.24%, and approaches the advanced proprietary model GPT-6.2-Sol across multiple tasks such as comprehensive multimodal understanding, report generation, and visual grounding. Although substantial challenges remain in complex medical reasoning and multi-step clinical workflows, this report provides empirical evidence, actionable data and training recipes, and a rigorous benchmark toward scalable clinical multimodal intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估发现现有医疗MLLM落后于通用前沿MLLM、扩规模只提升文本能力，进而提出35B总参数/3B激活参数的Sage-Med-Preview，通过3.227亿记录的数据筛选与"预训练-分阶段SFT-自适应RL"渐进课程训练，在31个公开多模态基准上平均58.26%，超越Hulu-Med-235B-A22B(50.99%)与Intern-S2-Preview(52.24%)。
AI.motivation: 医疗多模态大模型缺乏可靠的缩放律（scaling law）：现有医疗MLLM在多类医疗任务上不及通用前沿MLLM；单纯增大模型规模主要提升文本能力而非多模态感知；开启推理模式也无法弥合视觉能力差距。因此需要实证研究"医疗多模态智能在实践中如何缩放"。
AI.method: （1）系统性基准评估，揭示规模与推理模式的局限；（2）构建Sage-Med-Preview，总参35B、激活3B的MoE式医疗多模态模型；（3）数据侧对3.227亿候选记录进行阶段特定策展；（4）训练侧采用递进课程：医疗预训练→分阶段监督微调→自适应强化学习；（5）在61个公开与13个多中心私有基准、40余种模态、238项临床任务上与77个模型对比。
AI.result: 渐进式监督精修与自适应RL带来稳定的分阶段增益，专业视觉理解与医疗语言能力同步提升；31个公开多模态基准平均得分58.26%，超过开源SOTA医疗模型Hulu-Med-235B-A22B（50.99%）与通用科学模型Intern-S2-Preview（52.24%），在综合多模态理解、报告生成、视觉定位等任务上接近先进闭源模型GPT-6.2-Sol。
AI.conclusion: 在复杂医疗推理与多步临床流程上仍存在显著挑战；本工作报告提供了缩放医疗多模态智能的实证证据、可复用的数据与训练配方以及严谨的评测基准，为可扩展的临床多模态智能提供路径。

title: EgoMyo: Physical Hand State Estimation from Egocentric Video and Wrist Electromyography
summary: Physical hand interaction depends on configuration, contact, and force, yet nearly identical appearances can conceal different contact states and exerted forces. We therefore formulate physical hand state estimation from egocentric video and wrist surface electromyography (sEMG), combining visual geometry with neuromuscular evidence to jointly recover these coupled components. To support this task, we introduce EgoMyo, a benchmark spanning 5.75M video frames, 50 participants, 34 contact configurations, and repeated donnings, synchronizing these inputs with 3D hand pose and with contact and normal force registered onto the hand surface from bare-hand pressure. Controlled analysis reveals that vision resolves spatial structure while sEMG better estimates force magnitude, that sEMG's gains concentrate in regions where vision is least reliable, and that contact localization limits force accuracy. Guided by these findings, we propose MyoBridge, which makes the hand region the unit of vision-sEMG fusion, lets each region gate its own share of sEMG, and distributes regional force magnitudes only over predicted contact vertices at inference. On held-out trials, MyoBridge reduces pose and force error by 39.8% and 18.5% over the strongest baseline and achieves the lowest pose error on unseen sessions and subjects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出从第一人称视频与腕部表面肌电（sEMG）联合估计物理手部状态（姿态、接触与法向力），并构建大规模基准 EgoMyo 与区域级融合方法 MyoBridge。
AI.motivation: 手部物理交互由构型、接触与力共同决定，但外观几乎相同的手势可能隐藏完全不同的接触状态与施力大小，仅依赖视觉无法区分；因此需要引入神经肌肉证据，将视觉几何与 sEMG 结合来联合恢复这些耦合分量。
AI.method: 构建 EgoMyo 数据集：5.75M 视频帧、50 名被试、34 种接触构型、含重复佩戴，输入与 3D 手部姿态、以及由裸手压力传感配准到手部表面的接触与法向力标注同步。基于受控分析得出的结论，提出 MyoBridge：以手部区域为视觉-sEMG 融合单元，每个区域对 sEMG 特征做自门控加权，并在推理时仅将区域级力幅值分配到预测的接触顶点上。
AI.result: 受控分析表明：视觉负责恢复空间结构，sEMG 更擅长估计力的大小；sEMG 的增益集中在视觉最不可靠的区域；接触定位精度制约着力估计精度。在留出试验上，MyoBridge 相比最强基线将姿态误差降低 39.8%、力误差降低 18.5%，并在未见过的会话与被试上取得最低姿态误差。
AI.conclusion: 多模态融合应按手部区域而非全局进行，并显式建模接触与力的层级关系；该范式在跨会话、跨被试泛化上优于纯视觉或全局融合方案。

title: LiveRelight: Sub-Second Global Illumination Editing for Gaussian Interiors
summary: Relighting reconstructed 3D scenes remains challenging due to the complex nature of light transport: slow or approximate visual feedback restricts the editor's ability to fine-tune the results to satisfaction. We present a hybrid relighting approach that enables interactive, high-fidelity updates of direct and indirect indoor illumination without per-edit optimization. Our approach permits the editor to make a wide range of relighting edits at room-scale, with near-instant feedback. Our key insight is to precompute geometric light exchange rather than illumination responses, retaining an inexpensive transport solve that accommodates changes in emission and surface reflectance. We evaluate direct illumination on reconstructed 2D Gaussians using visibility-aware sampling of one-sided emitters, while propagating diffuse interreflection through sparse radiosity on a triangle proxy. A sparse projection fitted through Gaussian alpha compositing transfers the proxy solution to the reconstruction. Our formulation further supports fast fixture transformations and emitter insertion by recomputing light source injection. Across eight relighting conditions of our synthetic test suite, our sub-second edits improve relighting fidelity over prior path-traced editing by an average of 5\,dB PSNR, while reducing editing latency by up to three orders of magnitude. Qualitative results further demonstrate realistic, interactive relighting of real-world captures.

AI.tldr: 提出混合重光照方法：预计算几何光交换而非光照响应，实现房间尺度近实时高保真直接与间接光照编辑。
AI.motivation: 重建3D场景的重光照仍具挑战：光传输复杂，现有方法视觉反馈慢或近似程度高，编辑者难以交互式微调到满意结果；且以往做法需针对每次编辑进行优化，无法提供近即时反馈。
AI.method: 核心思想是预计算几何光交换（而非光照响应），保留廉价的传输求解以适配发射与表面反射率变化。直接光照在重建的2D高斯上评估，采用单面发光体的可见性感知采样；漫反射互反射通过三角代理网格上的稀疏辐射度传播；再用经高斯alpha合成拟合的稀疏投影把代理解转移到重建表示上。该形式还通过重算光源注入支持快速灯具变换与发光体插入。
AI.result: 在合成测试套件的8种重光照条件下，亚秒级编辑相比既有路径追踪编辑平均提升约5 dB PSNR，编辑延迟降低最多三个数量级；定性结果展示了真实场景采集的逼真交互式重光照。
AI.conclusion: 预计算光交换+稀疏辐射度代理+投影转移的混合方案，可在无需逐次编辑优化的前提下实现房间尺度高保真、近实时的直接与间接光照编辑，兼顾保真度与交互效率。

title: VisualMontage: Manipulating the Beliefs of Vision-Language Agents with Authentic Image Sequences
summary: As agents based on vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly interpret social-media content, errors in their analysis may lend credibility to rumors and amplify their spread. In this paper, we study the problem of visual cognitive collusion, in which coordinated posts combine authentic images and locally faithful captions to induce VLM agents to infer and accept attacker-chosen target claims through their own reasoning. To enable systematic evaluation of this cognitive threat, we introduce a new benchmark comprising 544 target cases and 33.2K candidate images across eight application domains. We further propose VisualMontage, a multi-agent framework for simulating such attacks through narrative planning, image selection and ordering, and caption assignment under iterative review. We evaluate this threat through extensive experiments across 12 vision-language models, examining modality effects, production-team components, and downstream defenses. Using identical attack feeds across models without victim-specific optimization, we demonstrate cross-model transferability, achieving mean attack success rates of 61.93% for proprietary models and 68.71% for open-weight models. Moreover, 92.65% of generated feeds pass independent model-based validity auditing. Even after downstream review, residual attack success rates range from 35.3% to 76.7% across the evaluated configurations. Our additional controlled comparisons further reveal that captions can improve model-rated posting naturalness while reducing attack success. Together, these findings reveal a novel cognitive threat in social-media interpretation and motivate safeguards that assess how authentic posts jointly shape agents' reasoning and conclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"视觉认知合谋"（visual cognitive collusion）威胁：协同发布真实图像与局部忠实的配文，诱导VLM智能体通过自身推理接受攻击者选定的目标论断；构建544个目标案例、33.2K候选图像、8个领域的基准，并提出VisualMontage多智能体攻击模拟框架，在12个模型上验证跨模型可迁移性（专有模型平均成功率61.93%，开源68.71%），下游审查后残余成功率仍达35.3%–76.7%。
AI.motivation: VLM智能体日益用于解读社交媒体内容，其分析错误会为谣言背书并放大传播。现有研究多关注单条内容的对抗样本或指令注入，而忽略了"真实图像+局部忠实配文"在多帖协同下如何通过模型自身推理链诱发错误结论，这一认知层面的威胁缺乏系统评估手段与基准。
AI.method: 1) 构建新基准：544个目标案例、33.2K候选图像，覆盖8个应用领域；2) 提出VisualMontage多智能体框架，通过叙事规划、图像选择与排序、配文分配，并在迭代评审下生成协同攻击信息流；3) 在12个视觉语言模型上进行实验，分析模态效应、生产团队组件贡献及下游防御；采用与受害者无关的同一攻击流测试跨模型迁移性，并用独立模型有效性审计（92.65%通过）与下游审查评估残余攻击。
AI.result: 使用同一攻击信息流、不做受害者特定优化时，攻击具备跨模型可迁移性：专有模型平均攻击成功率61.93%，开源权重模型68.71%；92.65%的生成信息流通过独立模型的有效性审计；经下游审查后，各实验配置的残余攻击成功率仍为35.3%–76.7%。受控对比还显示，配文可提升模型评定的发布自然度，但同时降低攻击成功率（自然度与效力存在权衡）。
AI.conclusion: 真实帖文的协同组合能通过VLM智能体自身推理构成新型认知威胁，且对下游审查具有一定鲁棒性。研究呼吁发展面向"真实内容联合塑造智能体推理与结论"方式的防护机制，而非仅检测单条内容的真伪或对抗扰动。

title: OS-Omni: Benchmarking Generalist Computer-Using Agents on Long-Horizon Workflows Across Platforms
summary: Computer-using agents are increasingly expected to complete realistic user goals rather than isolated GUI actions. However, existing benchmarks typically isolate web, mobile, or desktop environments, leaving it unclear whether a single generalist agent can execute long-horizon workflows that span multiple operating systems and persistent application states. We introduce OS-Omni, a live cross-platform benchmark and execution environment for evaluating computer-using agents across Windows, Ubuntu, macOS, iOS, Android, and Web environments. OS-Omni is released in versioned waves of 300 tasks each; this paper focuses on the first release, v1, which contains 48 tasks per platform and 12 cross-platform workflows that pair a desktop with an Android phone. OS-Omni provides reproducible initialization, platform-specific adapters, trajectory logging, and executable final-state evaluators, and includes controlled service-backed applications for workflows involving account, cart, budget, calendar, message, and other persistent state. Human studies show that OS-Omni tasks require 67.54 interaction steps, substantially exceeding OSWorld references of 15.0 steps. On v1, the strongest evaluated agent, Claude Opus 5.5, reaches 68.5% average success, trailing the 77.3% human reference by 8.8 points; the gap is uneven across platforms, with frontier models exceeding humans on Linux but trailing them by more than 25 points on iOS and macOS. These results indicate that current agents remain far from platform-robust, long-horizon computer use, especially when success requires sustained state tracking and durable final-state changes.

AI.tldr: 提出跨平台实时基准 OS-Omni，评估能跨 Windows/Ubuntu/macOS/iOS/Android/Web 完成长程任务的通用智能体；v1 最强智能体 68.5%，低于人类 77.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多将 Web、移动端、桌面环境割裂评估，无法判断单一通用智能体能否执行跨多操作系统、跨持久应用状态的长程工作流。
AI.method: 构建实时跨平台基准与执行环境 OS-Omni，覆盖六大平台，按版本波浪发布、每波 300 任务；v1 每平台 48 任务加 12 个桌面—安卓配对工作流。提供可复现初始化、平台适配器、轨迹日志与可执行终态评估器，并接入账户、购物车、预算、日历、消息等服务化应用以承载持久状态。
AI.result: 任务平均需 67.54 个交互步，远超 OSWorld 的 15.0 步；v1 上 Claude Opus 5.5 平均成功率 68.5%，落后人类 77.3% 约 8.8 点；平台差异显著，Linux 上超越人类，iOS 与 macOS 上落后逾 25 点。
AI.conclusion: 当前智能体距平台鲁棒的长程计算机使用仍有明显差距，尤其在需持续状态跟踪与持久终态修改时。

title: VibeVideoAgent: Closing the Perceptual Loop for Code-Driven Video Generation
summary: Code-driven video generation asks a coding agent to write and run rendering programs. This gives exact control over typography, data visualizations, synchronized audio, and multi-shot scenes, and it leaves an editable project behind. A program that exits cleanly can still render overlapping labels, a camera aimed away from its subject, broken object interactions, or narration that drifts out of sync, and none of these raise a runtime error. Feeding rendered frames and audio back into the coding session bloats its long-horizon context, while critiquing only the finished full-resolution render turns early design mistakes into costly rewrites. We introduce VibeVideoAgent, a training-free framework that lets coding agents inspect their drafts throughout production. Multimodal perception runs in short-lived contexts kept apart from the coder and returns compact, grounded Findings. Seven primitives operate on a unified multi-clock representation of assets and drafts: they explore media from coarse to fine, verify quoted requirements with evidence from every required modality, compare a draft with a reference or an earlier revision on separate clocks, and measure stream signals locally. A lightweight staged protocol has the agent test its riskiest decision on a minimal preview first. On all 239 VibeVideoBench tasks, with matched agent runtimes and a fixed perception model, VibeVideoAgent improves holistic audiovisual quality (L3) for Claude Opus 5.5 (4.03 -> 4.43, while L2 rubric compliance rises from 98.87% to 99.35%), GPT-6 Astra (4.03 -> 4.27), and Claude Sonnet 5.5 (3.97 -> 4.10), with the largest gains in audio-visual synchronization (up to +0.56). Controlled ablations show that each component contributes, and trajectory audits show that the granularity of code edits governs the trade-off between rubric adherence and perceptual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 VibeVideoAgent，让编码智能体在视频生成全过程中通过隔离的短时多模态感知检查草稿，以紧凑 Findings 反馈，显著提升整体视听质量与音画同步。
AI.motivation: 代码驱动视频生成中，程序可正常退出却仍产生标签重叠、镜头偏离主体、物体交互错误、旁白失同步等运行时无法报错的缺陷；把渲染帧与音频回灌编码会话会膨胀长程上下文，而仅对最终高分辨率成片做评审又使早期设计错误变成昂贵重写。
AI.method: 免训练框架：多模态感知在独立于编码器的短生命周期上下文中运行，返回紧凑、有据可依的 Findings；七个原语作用于资产与草稿的统一多时钟表示，支持由粗到细的媒体探查、跨模态证据核验引述需求、在分离时钟上比较草稿与参考或早期版本、局部测量流信号；轻量分阶段协议要求先在最小预览上检验最高风险决策。
AI.result: 在全部 239 个 VibeVideoBench 任务上，匹配智能体运行时与固定感知模型：Claude Opus 5.5 的整体视听质量 L3 由 4.03 升至 4.43（L2 评分规范符合率 98.87%→99.35%），GPT-6 Astra 4.03→4.27，Claude Sonnet 5.5 3.97→4.10；音画同步提升最大达 +0.56。消融显示各组件均有贡献；轨迹审计表明代码编辑粒度决定规范符合与感知质量之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 将过程性、隔离上下文的多模态感知反馈引入编码式视频生成，可在不训练的前提下稳定提升成片质量，且反馈粒度是影响质量与规范权衡的关键设计变量。

title: Carrying Feature Ablations Across Sparse Autoencoder Seeds
summary: A vision encoder turns an image into one vector per patch, refined layer by layer. A sparse autoencoder (SAE) writes each vector of one layer as a sum of learned directions, most with a coefficient of zero. Researchers call each direction a feature and edit the encoder by removing one feature. An SAE trained from another random seed learns different features. Earlier work matches the two SAEs' features one to one by how closely their directions agree. Matched features can point alike yet respond to different image parts, so removing them may change the encoder differently. We remove a feature and, separately, its match, then compare the changes in the encoder's output on the same held out images. When the second change nearly reproduces the first, we say the removal carries across seeds. A setting fixes a DINOv2 or SigLIP layer and its SAE feature count. At our tolerance, the removal carries for 12% to 70% of matched pairs across three settings. The share is 0% in two controls: an SAE whose directions stay random and, post hoc, matches shuffled among trained features. Post hoc, predicting which removals carry is more accurate with layer contributions than with directions. Some incorrect predictions remain. One persists on independent images. So pairs can be screened at the layer. Measuring the output detects errors this screen misses.

AI.tldr: 该文研究跨随机种子训练的稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征匹配的可靠性：提出以"移除特征后编码器输出的变化能否被其匹配特征的移除所复现"来检验匹配是否carry across seeds，发现该比例仅为12%–70%，而在随机方向和对打乱的对照中为0%。
AI.motivation: 先前工作仅依据方向相似性（cosine一致性）对两个不同随机种子训练的SAE特征做一对一匹配，但方向相似的特征可能响应图像的不同部分，因此移除它们对视觉编码器输出的影响可能不同。方向相似性不足以作为匹配正确性的判据，需要基于功能影响的验证手段。
AI.method: 固定DINOv2或SigLIP的某一层及其SAE特征数，在两个独立种子的SAE间按方向一致性匹配特征。对每个匹配对，分别移除一个特征及其匹配特征，在相同留出图像上比较编码器输出的变化；若第二次变化近乎复现第一次，则称该移除"carries across seeds"。设置对照：方向保持随机的SAE，以及在训练好的特征间事后打乱匹配。另用层贡献量与方向来预测哪些移除会carry。
AI.result: 在设定容差下，三种设置中有12%–70%的匹配对满足移除可迁移；两个对照（随机方向SAE、打乱匹配）中该比例为0%。事后分析中，用层贡献预测可迁移性比用方向更准确，但仍存在错误预测，且其中之一在独立图像上依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 方向一致的匹配并不保证功能等价；可在层级别对匹配对做筛选（基于层贡献的预测优于方向），但该筛选会遗漏错误，需要辅以对编码器输出变化的实测来检测。

title: Analemma $\infty$: A Temporal Benchmark for Geospatial Foundation Models
comment: 30 pages, 13 figures, 17 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: Satellite time series capture how land surfaces change over time. Pixel-wise temporal foundation models read a year of satellite observations per pixel, yet public benchmarks lack a temporal axis or subsample it to a few dates. We introduce Analemma, a temporal benchmark of six datasets that carry every 10 and 20 m Sentinel-2 band and a time series spanning a growing season, completed where their releases omit geometry, dates, or cloud masks. One frozen-encoder protocol evaluates all models across label ratios and three seeds, with two baselines without pretraining. The TESSERA model ranks first overall. A from-scratch model on monthly composites outranks every foundation model except OlmoEarth v1.3-Base, suggesting that temporal input explains most of the performance. Three evaluation choices left unstated by the source publications each shift TESSERA v1 by 7.6 to 18.6 mIoU, against top-two gaps of 0.6 to 2.8. Data, harness and leaderboard will be publicly released soon.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Analemma——一个包含六个数据集的时间序列遥感基准，保留全部Sentinel-2 10m/20m波段与整个生长季的时间序列，并补全原始发布中缺失的几何、日期与云掩膜信息；通过冻结编码器协议在多种标签比例与三个随机种子上评测，TESSERA综合排名第一，但仅用月度合成影像从头训练的模型已超越除OlmoEarth v1.3-Base外的所有基础模型，表明时间维度输入本身解释了大部分性能。
AI.motivation: 现有时空基础模型以"逐像素读取一年卫星观测"的方式工作，但公开基准普遍缺乏时间轴，或仅下采样到少数几个日期，导致无法公平评估模型对时序信息的利用能力；同时原始数据集发布常缺失几何、日期与云掩膜等关键元信息，进一步限制了可复现的时序评测。
AI.method: 构建Analemma基准，整合六个数据集，保留每景全部10m与20m Sentinel-2波段及覆盖生长季的完整时间序列，并补齐原始release中缺失的几何、日期与云掩膜。设计统一的"冻结编码器"评测协议，在多种标签比例与三个随机种子下评测所有模型，并设置两个无预训练基线；额外进行消融以量化评测设置选择的影响。
AI.result: TESSERA模型总体排名第一。一个基于月度合成影像、从头训练的模型优于除OlmoEarth v1.3-Base之外的所有基础模型，说明时间输入贡献了大部分性能。此外，源论文未明确说明的三项评测选择各自使TESSERA v1的mIoU波动7.6–18.6，而排名前二模型之间的差距仅为0.6–2.8，表明评测协议细节对结论的影响远大于模型间真实差异。
AI.conclusion: 时序输入与评测协议细节是决定基准结论的关键因素，现有基础模型相对于简单时序基线的优势有限；Analemma为时序遥感提供了更严格、可复现的评测框架，数据、评测工具与排行榜将公开释放。

title: Detector Operating Behavior Inference via Data-Space Sampling
summary: A detector scores candidate detections, but the recall and false alarms at a given confidence threshold depend on the input distribution. We introduce Detector Operating Behavior Inference (DOBI), a second-level inference task: estimating a fixed detector's threshold-dependent, distribution-level operating response from the internal evidence of a single unlabeled image. DOBI treats the detector's threshold response, i.e. recall, false positives, and precision across thresholds, as a latent behavioral state under the current data condition. Controlled data-space sampling probes this state space offline, and a lightweight monitor learns the inverse map from one image to this state, whose single functional output supports multiple operating policies. In a controlled proof of concept with a fixed YOLOv10-Nano person detector and COCO-derived degradations, predicted PR behavior reduces mean absolute deviation from 0.128 for an image-independent mean-behavior prior to 0.054, and predicted functional distances track empirical regime distances (Spearman 0.96). From one unlabeled image, the inferred behavior selects operating points as well as a non-deployable lookup that knows the true regime (macro-regime $F_1$ 0.6604 for both, versus 0.6407 under pristine calibration; oracle 0.6620). On this discrete benchmark, regime-supervised curve lookups are strong controls. Pre-specified continuous and compositional probing shows where functional inference matters: on unseen combinations, the functional decoder has a lower mean curve error than a template lookup, increasingly with distance from the training conditions, whereas the lookup is more accurate for interpolation. These results establish the feasibility of single-image inference of distribution-level detector behavior over the probed conditions. Source code is available at https://github.com/beckerio/dobi

AI.tldr: 提出DOBI（Detector Operating Behavior Inference），一个二级推断任务：仅凭单张无标签图像估计固定检测器在当前分布下随阈值变化的运行行为（PR曲线），用离线数据空间采样构建行为状态空间，并训练轻量级monitor学习"图像→行为状态"的逆映射。
AI.motivation: 检测器在给定置信度阈值下的召回率与误报率依赖输入分布，而部署时往往无法获知当前数据条件，也无法使用真值评估。作者希望在不访问标签、不做在线统计的前提下，从单幅图像内部证据推断检测器的分布级运行响应，从而支持阈值/运行点的自适应选择。
AI.method: 将检测器的阈值响应（跨阈值的recall、FP、precision）视为当前数据条件下的潜在行为状态；离线通过受控数据空间采样探测该状态空间；训练轻量级monitor从单张图像回归到该状态，输出单一函数型表示，可派生多种运行策略。在固定YOLOv10-Nano人物检测器+COCO衍生退化数据上做受控验证，并设计连续与组合式探测实验（含regime监督查表、模板查表、图像无关均值先验、oracle等对照）。
AI.result: 预测PR行为将平均绝对偏差从图像无关均值先验的0.128降至0.054；预测功能距离与经验regime距离的Spearman相关为0.96。单张无标签图像推断出的行为在运行点选择上媲美知晓真实regime的不可部署查表（macro-regime F1均为0.6604，原始校准0.6407，oracle 0.6620）。在未见组合上，功能解码器的平均曲线误差低于模板查表，且随偏离训练条件距离增大优势增强；而查表在插值情形更准。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了在所探测条件下从单幅图像推断分布级检测器行为的可行性；离散基准上regime监督查表是强基线，功能推断的价值主要体现在连续、组合及分布外条件下。

title: TORE: Token-Wise Taylor Order Selection via Decomposed Residual Error Estimation for Diffusion Acceleration
summary: Diffusion models excel at image and video generation, but iterative denoising incurs substantial inference latency. Recent token-adaptive acceleration methods select Taylor prediction orders for the full-model residual using shallow-layer proxy scores. However, candidate orders are evaluated on these proxy features but used to predict the full-model residual, creating a proxy--target mismatch: the proxy-preferred order may not minimize residual prediction error. To address this mismatch, we propose \textbf{TORE} (\textbf{T}aylor \textbf{O}rder selection via \textbf{R}esidual \textbf{E}rror estimation), which selects token-wise Taylor orders based on estimated prediction errors for the full-model residual. Yet direct error evaluation requires future ground-truth residuals, which are unavailable during order selection. TORE therefore estimates prediction error by analyzing how errors arise in Taylor extrapolation. Specifically, it decomposes prediction error into truncation error and finite-difference derivative error, then estimates both contributions from cached residuals to preselect token-wise orders for upcoming skip steps. Extensive experiments show that TORE achieves $4.31\times$ speedup on FLUX.1-dev and $4.18\times$ on Wan2.1 while maintaining high generation quality and fidelity.

AI.tldr: TORE通过直接估计全模型残差的泰勒预测误差来选择token级阶数，缓解了现有token自适应加速方法中的代理—目标不匹配问题，在FLUX.1-dev和Wan2.1上分别实现4.31×和4.18×加速并保持高质量生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型迭代去噪推理延迟高。现有token自适应加速方法用浅层代理特征上的分数为全模型残差挑选泰勒预测阶数，导致代理—目标不匹配：代理偏好的阶数未必最小化全模型残差预测误差。
AI.method: 提出TORE，基于对全模型残差预测误差的估计来选择token级泰勒阶数。由于阶数选择时无法获得未来真值残差，TORE通过分析泰勒外推中误差的产生机制来估计误差：将预测误差分解为截断误差与有限差分导数误差，并利用已缓存的残差分别估计二者，从而为后续跳步预选token级阶数。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TORE在FLUX.1-dev上获得4.31×加速、在Wan2.1上获得4.18×加速，同时保持较高的生成质量与保真度。
AI.conclusion: 以全模型残差预测误差估计替代浅层代理打分进行阶数选择，可有效消除代理—目标不匹配，在图像与视频扩散模型上同时实现显著加速与质量保持。

title: Semantic State Reading for Joint Image-Semantic Diffusion Transformers
summary: Pretrained visual representations improve diffusion-transformer training, yet exploiting both global context and local spatial structure requires deciding which semantic states to model and how to access them. We introduce Semantic State Reading (SSR), which jointly denoises image latents, a global CLS token encoding image-level context, and a compact patch state preserving spatial correspondence. SSR couples this global-local modeling with distinct reading paths: local states are fused with corresponding image tokens at the input, while independent projections inject the current global state into every transformer block. Both semantic scopes thus remain accessible throughout denoising. Ablations show complementary benefits from local-state modeling and repeated global reading, and semantic-trajectory interventions alter image layout under a fixed class label. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$, SiT-XL/2 with SSR reaches or surpasses the reference FIDs of SiT, REPA, and Representation Entanglement for Generation (REG) with $100\times$, $40\times$, and $2\times$ fewer training iterations, respectively. SSR achieves unguided FID 1.78 at 2M iterations and FID 1.34 with classifier-free guidance alone. Combining classifier-free guidance with autoguidance yields FID 1.31 at 1M iterations, achieving the best FID in our main comparison table.

AI.tldr: 提出Semantic State Reading (SSR)，联合去噪图像潜变量、全局CLS语义状态与紧凑patch局部状态，并通过双通路读取机制实现全局-局部语义建模，在ImageNet 256×256上以更少迭代达到更优FID。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉表征虽能改进扩散Transformer训练，但需决定建模哪些语义状态以及如何访问它们；同时利用全局上下文与局部空间结构是核心难点。
AI.method: SSR联合去噪图像latent、编码图像级上下文的全局CLS token及保持空间对应关系的紧凑patch状态；局部状态在输入端与对应图像token融合，全局状态经独立投影注入每个Transformer块，使两种语义范围在去噪全过程可访问；并支持语义轨迹干预。
AI.result: 消融显示局部状态建模与重复全局读取具有互补收益；语义轨迹干预可在固定类别标签下改变图像布局；ImageNet 256×256上SiT-XL/2+SSR分别以100×、40×、2×更少迭代达到或超越SiT、REPA、REG的参考FID；2M迭代无引导FID 1.78，仅CFG为1.34，CFG+autoguidance在1M迭代达FID 1.31，为主对比表最佳。
AI.conclusion: SSR通过显式的全局-局部语义状态读取机制，显著提升扩散Transformer的表征利用效率与采样质量，具备良好的训练加速与生成可控性。

title: ReMeDi: Single-Image PBR Material Estimation via Reparameterization between Metal and Dielectric Hypotheses
summary: Physically based rendering (PBR) material estimation facilitates relighting, material editing, and 3D content creation. As the reflectance of a surface heavily depends on whether it is a metal or a dielectric, producing any map that determines albedo involves a decision on metalness, which we call the "intended metalness" of the map. Rendering maps with mismatched intended metalness yields physically implausible or misinterpreted materials. The metallic--roughness workflow makes metalness explicit and thus encourages base color to match it, but does not enforce this match, especially for automated methods directly predicting each map. Therefore, we propose ReMeDi, which enforces the match through two components. First, we reparameterize base color as a metalness-weighted blend of its two variants, estimated under the all-metal and all-dielectric hypothesis, respectively. Second, as available supervision cannot teach a single network both hypotheses at every pixel, we restrict each of two separate networks to one hypothesis, so that each variant is ensured to follow its hypothesis. Besides enforcing the match, this also improves each estimated material map. Experiments show that ReMeDi outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both material accuracy and relighting fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出ReMeDi框架，通过金属度加权混合与双网络分假设监督，强制base color与metalness map保持一致，从而提升PBR材质估计精度与重光照保真度。
AI.motivation: PBR材质估计中，反照率图必然隐含对金属度的判断（即"intended metalness"），但metallic–roughness工作流仅显式给出metalness而不强制base color与之匹配；自动化方法逐图独立预测时尤其容易失配，导致渲染结果物理上不合理或语义被误读。
AI.method: ReMeDi由两部分组成：1）将base color重参数化为两种变体的金属度加权混合，两个变体分别在全金属与全介电假设下估计；2）由于现有监督无法让单一网络在每个像素同时学到两种假设，采用两个独立网络各自固定于一种假设，保证每个变体遵循其假设。
AI.result: 实验表明ReMeDi在材质估计精度与重光照保真度上均优于现有最先进方法，且该约束在强制匹配的同时也改善了各材质图的估计质量。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并强制base color与metalness的假设一致性，是提升PBR逆向渲染可靠性的有效途径；分解假设+分离网络监督的设计是可推广的约束手段。

title: Find the Clue, Not the Scene: Rethinking Reasoning for Entity Recognition in Vision-Language Models
summary: Answering a knowledge-based visual question requires first recognizing the entity in the image and then recalling knowledge about it. Thinking vision-language models (VLMs) reason for thousands of tokens before answering, yet it remains underexplored how well such thinking VLMs perform each of these two steps. We therefore analyze thinking VLMs on this task and make two key observations. (1) Recognition is the bottleneck, since 76.3% of errors across four models on ViQuAE stem from misrecognizing the entity, and 84.9% of these failures are resolved once the entity name is provided in the question. (2) Recognition is driven by entity-recall clues rather than by general descriptions of the image. An entity-recall clue is a distinctive visual detail that helps the model recall the entity, such as keys, a traditional attribute of Saint Peter. Based on these findings, we propose ClueRL, a reinforcement learning approach that extends Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with an advantage localized to the entity-recall clue in the thinking trace. Rather than injecting new entity knowledge, ClueRL changes how VLMs think: it leads them to attend more closely to visual details and spot these clues, helping them use the knowledge they already have. Consequently, it outperforms both GRPO and a perception-reward baseline on three entity recognition benchmarks. Moreover, this clue-seeking behavior generalizes beyond entity recognition, the only task used for training. Since recognition is the bottleneck, the gains carry over to knowledge-based visual question answering. They even extend to general multimodal reasoning, raising Qwen3.5-4B by 4.4 and 4.0 points on the ScienceQA and MMMU subsets of MMStar, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了thinking VLM在知识型视觉问答中的两步（实体识别与知识回忆），发现识别是瓶颈且由"实体回忆线索"驱动，据此提出ClueRL——将GRPO的优势估计局部化到思维链中的线索片段，提升实体识别并泛化到知识型VQA与通用多模态推理。
AI.motivation: 知识型VQA需先识别图像实体再回忆相关知识；thinking VLM虽会生成数千token的推理，但其在这两步上的表现尚缺乏系统分析。作者希望诊断瓶颈所在，并针对瓶颈改进推理过程，而非简单注入新知识。
AI.method: 先在ViQuAE上对四个模型进行错误归因分析：(1) 76.3%的错误源于实体识别错误，其中84.9%在题干给出实体名后被解决；(2) 识别依赖"实体回忆线索"（如圣彼得的钥匙这一标志性视觉细节）而非泛化图像描述。基于此提出ClueRL：在GRPO基础上，将advantage局部化到思维链中的实体回忆线索片段，引导模型更关注视觉细节、发现线索，从而利用已有知识。对比基线为GRPO与perception-reward方法。
AI.result: 在三个实体识别benchmark上优于GRPO和perception-reward基线；线索寻求行为可泛化到训练任务之外的实体识别任务；由于识别是瓶颈，增益传导至知识型VQA；并进一步迁移到通用多模态推理，使Qwen3.5-4B在MMStar的ScienceQA子集和MMMU子集上分别提升4.4和4.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 实体识别是thinking VLM在知识型VQA中的主要瓶颈，且其关键在于捕捉实体回忆线索。ClueRL通过局部化线索级advantage改变模型的"思考方式"而非注入知识，在实体识别、知识型VQA与通用多模态推理上均取得稳定增益，说明线索寻求是一种可迁移的推理能力。

title: PostMesh: Self-Rewarded Preference Post-Training for Flow-Based Artist Mesh Generation
summary: Artistic mesh generators turn a dense 3D object into an artist mesh: a compact, quad-dominant mesh that is easy to edit. Most of current models are auto-regressive methods which decode a mesh token by token, take tens to hundreds of seconds per mesh. Diffusion- and flow-based generators are much faster, but their meshes still fall short of artist quality. To our knowledge, PostMesh is the first post-training method for a diffusion- or flow-based artist mesh generator, and it needs no expensive artist-made ground truth: the generator is trained on its own samples, scored by a reward computed from the dense input and the output. We propose an artistic mesh reward that keeps the output consistent with the dense input while making the mesh structure into artistic. We also propose a multi-negative flow preference optimisation that transfers the reward to the generator. After a short LoRA post-training, PostMesh is comparable to or better than slow autoregressive generators on most artist-mesh quality metrics and in a blind VLM preference test, at a fraction of their time.

AI.tldr: PostMesh 是首个面向上艺术化网格（artist mesh）生成的扩散/流模型后训练方法，无需昂贵的人工标注真值，仅用自生成样本与稠密输入计算奖励，通过多负样本流偏好优化（multi-negative flow preference optimisation）配合短时 LoRA 后训练，在多数艺术网格质量指标与盲测 VLM 偏好中媲美甚至超越缓慢的自回归生成器，且耗时仅为其中一小部分。
AI.motivation: 艺术化网格生成要求输出紧凑、以四边形为主、易编辑的网格。现有自回归方法逐 token 解码，每网格需数十至数百秒，速度慢；扩散/流模型虽快，但生成网格的艺术质量不及自回归方法。同时，获取艺术家制作的标注真值代价高昂，难以用于监督微调。
AI.method: 提出 PostMesh，首個面向扩散/流式艺术网格生成器的后训练方法。其一是设计艺术网格奖励：结合稠密输入与输出的一致性约束，并引导网格结构趋向艺术化（紧凑、四边形主导、拓扑规整）；其二是提出多负样本流偏好优化，将奖励信号蒸馏进生成器；训练数据来自生成器自身采样，配合短时 LoRA 微调完成。
AI.result: 经短暂 LoRA 后训练后，PostMesh 在大多数艺术网格质量指标上达到或超过耗时的自回归生成器，并在盲测 VLM 偏好评估中获得相近或更优的评价，而推理时间仅为后者的一小部分。
AI.conclusion: PostMesh 表明：无需人工真值，利用基于稠密输入的奖励与偏好优化即可有效提升扩散/流式网格生成器的艺术质量，兼顾质量与效率，为艺术化网格生成提供了一种高效的后训练范式。

title: SPARC: Semantic Calibration with Latent Multimodal Knowledge for Robust Image-Text Retrieval
summary: Robust image-text retrieval aims to maintain accurate cross-modal matching when image or text queries are incomplete, supporting reliable information access in real-world applications. However, existing methods typically focus on adapting to distribution shifts, without adequately addressing candidate discrimination for incomplete queries and ranking instability. To this end, we propose semantic projection and alignment with relational constraints (SPARC), which elicits latent multimodal knowledge from frozen encoders to improve candidate discrimination and ranking stability. Specifically, we first devise a semantic calibration module on a product of spheres that refines incomplete visual and textual features through tangent-space updates, maintaining the unit-sphere structure used for cosine similarity. Second, we introduce a robust semantic guidance module that combines latent multimodal knowledge encoded in complete image-text features with cross-modal semantic anchors to promote semantic alignment of the calibrated features. Finally, we introduce a matching relation constraint module that fuses original query features with their calibrated counterparts and applies a soft ranking constraint to penalize reductions in initially positive matching margins, thereby limiting ranking perturbations. Extensive experiments on Flickr30K and COCO demonstrate that SPARC outperforms competing methods under various image occlusion and word deletion settings, while achieving consistent gains across different pretrained backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出SPARC方法，通过语义投影与关系约束从冻结编码器中提取潜在多模态知识，提升不完整图文查询下的候选区分度与排序稳定性。
AI.motivation: 鲁棒图文检索需在图像或文本不完整时保持准确跨模态匹配。现有方法多聚焦于适应分布偏移，未充分解决不完整查询下的候选区分（candidate discrimination）不足与排序不稳定（ranking instability）问题。
AI.method: SPARC包含三个模块：(1) 语义校准模块，在球面乘积空间上通过切空间更新精炼不完整的视觉/文本特征，保持用于余弦相似度的单位球结构；(2) 鲁棒语义引导模块，将完整图文特征中编码的潜在多模态知识与跨模态语义锚点结合，促进校准特征的语义对齐；(3) 匹配关系约束模块，融合原始与校准后的查询特征，并施加软排序约束惩罚初始正匹配间隔的减小，以限制排序扰动。整体基于冻结编码器。
AI.result: 在Flickr30K与COCO上，SPARC在多种图像遮挡与词语删除设置下优于对比方法，并在不同预训练骨干网络上取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过球面切空间校准、潜在多模态语义引导与匹配关系软排序约束，可有效提升不完整查询下的候选区分度与排序稳定性，且方法对骨干网络具有良好通用性。

title: AIRIS: Benchmarking Social Embodied Intelligence in Egocentric Streaming Videos
summary: Embodied agents operating around people must not only recognize social cues, but also decide when the available evidence is sufficient, whether to intervene, and how to respond without violating social norms. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate these abilities in isolation or with access to completed videos, obscuring where an online social decision fails. We introduce AIRIS, a causal streaming benchmark that formulates social embodied intelligence as a time-anchored chain of Attention, Intention, Reaction, and Interaction (A-I-R-I). AIRIS contains 8,000 expert-curated questions grounded in 357 egocentric clips across 11 context categories and 36 capability dimensions. At each query, models receive only the observation prefix available at that time; decision-aware metrics reward calibrated waiting and complete reactions while penalizing premature commitment. Evaluating 45 proprietary and open-source general-purpose, embodied, streaming-video, and omni-modal models reveals fragmented and temporally miscalibrated competence. General-purpose VLMs excel at passive cue grounding and intent recognition, whereas embodied specialists lead on isolated reaction sub-decisions; yet across all families, models frequently guess intents before sufficient evidence emerges and fail to jointly align intervention timing, action domain, and concrete execution within the same episode. AIRIS thus provides a diagnostic foundation for bridging the gap between passive social perception and reliable embodied interaction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AIRIS——一个因果流式基准，将社交具身智能建模为"注意—意图—反应—交互"(A-I-R-I)的时间锚定链条，含8,000个专家标注问题、357个第一视角视频片段、11类场景与36个能力维度，并引入决策感知指标评估模型在线社交决策的时机校准性。
AI.motivation: 面向人群的具身智能体不仅要识别社交线索，还需判断证据是否充分、是否介入以及如何在不违反社交规范的前提下响应。现有基准往往孤立评估这些能力，或使用已完成的完整视频，因而无法揭示在线社交决策究竟在哪一环节失败。
AI.method: 构建AIRIS因果流式基准：每个查询仅提供该时刻可获得的观测前缀，要求模型沿注意、意图、反应、交互四个阶段逐步决策；设计决策感知指标，奖励有校准的"等待"与完整反应，惩罚证据不足时的过早表态。
AI.result: 评估45个专有与开源模型（通用、具身、流式视频、全模态四类）显示能力碎片化且时间校准失准：通用VLM擅长被动线索定位与意图识别，具身专用模型擅长孤立的反应子决策；但所有模型家族普遍在证据充分前猜测意图，且难以在同一片段内同时对齐介入时机、动作域与具体执行。
AI.conclusion: AIRIS为弥合被动社交感知与可靠具身交互之间的差距提供了诊断性基础。

title: One Patch, Many Policies: Object-Associated Physical Patch Attacks on Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World Action Models (WAMs) are vulnerable to adversarial visual interference, motivating the study of universal and transferable physical patch attacks. We propose Object-Associated Patch Attack (OAPA), a universal and transferable physical patch framework that enables an attacker to select which task object's manipulation to disrupt through patch placement, without re-optimizing the patch. Our framework combines object-associated placement, differentiable physical compositing, and final action-expert representation divergence. Physical compositing accounts for perspective and occlusion across camera views, while representation divergence guides patch optimization using either relative RMS or cosine distance. Experimental results demonstrate strong attack transferability across task suites and policies, together with the ability to selectively disrupt manipulation of an attacker-chosen task object through patch placement.

AI.tldr: 提出对象关联补丁攻击OAPA，一个通用可迁移的物理补丁框架，通过对VLA与WAM的对抗视觉干扰，且仅靠补丁摆放位置即可选择干扰哪个任务对象的操作，无需重新优化补丁。
AI.motivation: VLA与世界动作模型（WAM）对对抗性视觉干扰脆弱，现有攻击缺乏通用性、可迁移性与物理可实施性，且无法按攻击者意图定向选择被破坏的任务对象。
AI.method: OAPA由三部分构成：（1）对象关联放置，将补丁绑定至特定任务对象，通过摆放位置实现目标选择性；（2）可微物理合成，在多相机视角下建模透视与遮挡；（3）最终动作专家表征发散，以相对RMS距离或余弦距离作为优化目标引导补丁优化。
AI.result: 实验显示在多个任务套件与策略上具有强攻击可迁移性，并能通过补丁放置选择性地破坏攻击者指定任务对象的操作。
AI.conclusion: 证明物理补丁攻击在VLA/WAM上具备通用性、可迁移性与对象级选择性，揭示了具身智能策略在物理世界中的安全风险。

title: MoCA4D: Monocular 3D Bounding Box Lifting and Tracking with Camera and Object Motion
summary: Monocular 3D bounding box tracking must account for both object motion and changes in camera viewpoint. Framewise box lifting with temporal filtering leaves these motion components implicit, while static-scene fusion assumes stationary objects. We introduce MoCA4D, a framework for 3D box lifting and tracking from monocular video, associated 2D box prompts, and camera intrinsics. An observation branch estimates per-frame geometry, while a dynamic branch predicts a camera transformation shared across objects and a separate rigid transformation for each object. We propose Star Optimization to refine current depth and orientation using the observation and historical boxes propagated through these transformations. The refined box then guides subsequent propagation. Across all evaluated objects in Argoverse 2 and ADT, Star Optimization reduces center motion error by 38.1% and 38.7%, respectively, relative to Kalman filtering of the same observations. On MOVi-F, the dynamic branch achieves the lowest corner and rotation errors and the highest IoU among the evaluated methods over eight-transition motion windows. Real-data camera-only controls further link predicted object motion to improved localization on dynamic-object tracks.

AI.tldr: 提出 MoCA4D 框架，将单目视频中的 3D 框提升与跟踪分解为逐帧观测分支与动态分支（全局相机变换 + 每物体刚性变换），并用 Star Optimization 迭代精化深度与朝向，显著降低中心运动误差。
AI.motivation: 单目 3D 框跟踪需同时处理物体自身运动与相机视角变化。逐帧框提升加时序滤波会把这两类运动成分隐式化，而静态场景融合方法则假设物体静止，均无法准确建模动态场景中的复合运动。
AI.method: MoCA4D 以单目视频、关联 2D 框提示与相机内参为输入。观测分支估计逐帧几何；动态分支预测所有物体共享的相机变换及每个物体独立的刚性变换。Star Optimization 利用观测框与经上述变换传播的历史框共同精化当前深度与朝向，精化后的框再指导后续传播。
AI.result: 在 Argoverse 2 与 ADT 的全部评估物体上，Star Optimization 相对同观测的 Kalman 滤波分别将中心运动误差降低 38.1% 与 38.7%；在 MOVi-F 的八次转移运动窗口上，动态分支取得最低角点误差与旋转误差及最高 IoU。真实数据纯相机对照实验进一步表明预测的物体运动可改善动态物体轨迹的定位。
AI.conclusion: 显式解耦相机运动与物体运动并结合历史框迭代精化，是提升单目 3D 框跟踪的有效途径，在合成与真实数据上均优于时序滤波类基线。

title: Plausible Is Not Proven: Testing Failure Explanations in Monocular Depth Estimation
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Code, ratings and results: https://github.com/Md-Zeeshan-Ali/vision-error-observatory
summary: Failure analyses of monocular depth models often name a cause for each error, such as an occluding boundary, a thin object or a reflective surface, but such labels are rarely tested. We present the Vision Error Observatory (VEO), an audit that finds regions failing the $δ_1$ criterion on sensor-measured pixels, labels each with a likely cause or abstains, and then subjects the labels to four tests: agreement with object annotations on data the label model never saw, agreement with blinded human raters, response to targeted image edits, and value as a training signal. We apply it to eight models on NYU Depth V2, DIODE and iBims-1, with labels also checked on Hypersim, and fix most decision rules before their results. The occluding-boundary label agrees with annotations (AUROC 0.85 on NYU, 0.81 on Hypersim, 0.69 on iBims-1), but a single depth-edge cue does as well, and most boundary failures of the strongest model vanish under a 2-pixel tolerance. The reflection label does not transfer to synthetic data, the textureless label is near chance against annotations, and only one of four edit tests, an exploratory one, supports its label. Evaluated against five blinded raters, VEO's labels matched the human consensus only at chance level (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.05). In addition, an increase in the weight on the diagnosed regions during fine-tuning led to an increase in the error on targeted pixels at every weight tested. The architecture-specific failure fingerprint claimed by an earlier version of this project also failed to replicate across the datasets. Plausible failure explanations, in short, need to be tested before they are trusted; we release the protocol, code, ratings and every result file.

AI.tldr: 提出VEO审计协议，对单目深度模型失败区域的"归因标签"做四项检验，结果发现多数看似合理的失败解释（遮挡边界、反射、无纹理等）经不起验证，包括与人类共识仅达随机水平（κ=0.05）。
AI.motivation: 现有单目深度模型的失败分析常为每个错误直接命名原因（遮挡边界、细薄物体、反射面等），但这些标签几乎从未被检验，本文旨在系统性地审查这些失败归因是否可信。
AI.method: 提出Vision Error Observatory (VEO)：在传感器实测像素上定位违反δ1准则的失败区域，为其打上可能原因标签或弃权，再对标签施加四项检验——(1) 与标签模型未见过的数据上物体标注的一致性；(2) 与盲评人类评分者的一致性；(3) 对定向图像编辑的响应；(4) 作为训练信号的价值。在NYU Depth V2、DIODE、iBims-1上评测八个模型，并在Hypersim上校验标签，多数决策规则在结果前固定。
AI.result: 遮挡边界标签与标注一致（AUROC：NYU 0.85、Hypersim 0.81、iBims-1 0.69），但单一深度边缘线索表现相当，且最强模型多数边界失败在2像素容差下消失；反射标签无法迁移到合成数据；无纹理标签相对标注接近随机；四项编辑检验中仅一项探索性检验支持其标签；与五名盲评者对比，VEO标签仅以随机水平匹配人类共识（Cohen's κ=0.05）；微调中提高诊断区域权重在所有测试权重下均增大目标像素误差；早前版本声称的架构特异失败指纹也未能跨数据集复现。
AI.conclusion: 看似合理的失败解释在被信任之前必须经过检验；作者公开协议、代码、评分与全部结果文件。

title: Solve Vision with Code: Coding Agents Are Stronger Visual Reasoners Than Video Models
summary: Video generation models are increasingly evaluated as visual reasoners: given a first frame and a natural-language prompt, can the model produce the video in which the specified task is carried out? The paradigm is considered advantageous because the reasoning is native to the visual medium, unfolding directly in the frames rather than through language or code. Whether this native route is in fact the more reliable path to visual reasoning has not been tested against a symbolic alternative under the same conditions. We therefore pose the same tasks, with identical inputs, output specification and evaluator, to both media: rather than denoising pixels, a coding agent writes a program that renders the answer video, which an unmodified rule-based evaluator scores. On VBVR-Pro-Bench (Xu et al., 2026), a 500-instance suite spanning five cognitive categories with symbolic ground truth, the agent receives the same first frame and prompt as the video model, with no access to ground truth, metadata or generation models, and one attempt per instance. Three closed-model agents (Codex with gpt-6-astra, Claude Code with Fable 5.1 and Gemini CLI with Gemini 3.1 Pro) score 0.923, 0.894 and 0.893, each more than 0.22 above the strongest video model. Among 23 runnable open-weight models, the best, GLM-5, reaches 0.572, above all video models except the RL-trained one. Together, we show that for tasks whose solutions can be computed from a first frame and a prompt, program synthesis is currently a substantially more reliable route to visual reasoning than video generation. We further distinguish depictive programs, which navigate the image to recover a transferable scheme, from propositional programs, which operate on hard-coded values, revealing how visual reasoning unfolds in agent-written programs and what it implies for its nature of reasoning in general.

AI.tldr: 该文在同一条件（相同首帧、提示词、输出规范与评测器，单次尝试、无标准答案或元数据）下，比较"视频生成"与"程序合成"两条视觉推理路径。结果显示编码智能体显著优于最强视频模型，说明对可由首帧和提示词计算求解的任务，程序合成目前是更可靠的视觉推理途径。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型日益被当作"视觉推理器"来评测，其被宣称的优势在于推理原生地发生在像素帧中，而非经由语言或代码。但这一"原生路径"是否真的比符号化替代方案更可靠，此前从未在同等条件下被检验过，该文填补这一对照实验的空白。
AI.method: 提出受控对照设计：同一批任务、完全相同的输入（首帧与自然语言提示词）、相同的输出规范与同一个未修改的基于规则的评测器，分别交给视频模型和编码智能体。编码智能体不进行像素去噪，而是编写渲染答案视频的程序。在 VBVR-Pro-Bench（500 个实例，覆盖五类认知范畴，带符号化真值）上进行评测，智能体无真值、元数据与生成模型访问权限，每实例仅一次尝试。测试对象包括三个闭源智能体（Codex+gpt-6-astra、Claude Code+Fable 5.1、Gemini CLI+Gemini 3.1 Pro）及 23 个可运行的开源权重模型（最佳为 GLM-5）。此外将程序区分为"描绘性程序"（在图像中导航以恢复可迁移的图式）与"命题性程序"（操作硬编码数值）两类进行分析。
AI.result: 三个闭源智能体分别得分 0.923、0.894、0.893，各自比最强视频模型高出 0.22 以上；23 个可运行开源权重模型中最佳的 GLM-5 达到 0.572，超过除强化学习训练的那个视频模型之外的所有视频模型。
AI.conclusion: 对于解可由首帧与提示词计算得出的任务，程序合成目前是比视频生成显著更可靠的视觉推理路径。通过区分描绘性程序与命题性程序，进一步揭示了视觉推理在智能体所写程序中如何展开，以及这对一般意义上的推理本质意味着什么。

title: SPGSR: A Small Pixel-Space Generator for One-Step Super-Resolution
summary: In one-step super-resolution (SR), vision-only models extract semantic cues directly from the low-resolution (LR) image, keeping those cues spatially aligned with the structures they help restore. Recent models achieve high restoration quality with generators of up to 1.4 billion parameters. Given how much structure the LR image already provides, could a much smaller generator achieve comparable quality? We introduce SPGSR, a vision-only framework that adds a learned RGB correction to the LR image. A frozen DINOv2 guides prediction, and a lightweight block refines the correction locally. SPGSR achieves higher PSNR/SSIM and lower LPIPS/DISTS than VOSR, a leading vision-only SR method, across three benchmarks. Its $31.8\mathrm{M}$-parameter generator is just $6.5\%$ the size of VOSR-0.5B's. SPGSR also achieves competitive quality against T2I-based SR methods. SPGSR's generator uses only $0.60\%$ of the HR pixels used to train and distill VOSR's generator. For $512\times512$ outputs, SPGSR achieves $2.80\times$ and $3.35\times$ GPU-pipeline speedups over VOSR-0.5B and VOSR-1.4B, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出 SPGSR：一种仅依赖视觉的轻量级一步式超分框架，通过冻结 DINOv2 引导学习 LR 图像的 RGB 残差修正，以 31.8M 参数生成器在质量与速度上超越大模型 VOSR。
AI.motivation: 现有一步式超分视觉模型（如 VOSR）依赖高达 1.4B 参数的生成器，而 LR 图像本身已提供大量结构信息；作者质疑是否有必要使用如此庞大的生成器，探索小模型能否达到同等复原质量。
AI.method: SPGSR 为纯视觉框架：在 LR 图像上叠加一个可学习的 RGB 修正量；使用冻结的 DINOv2 特征作为引导来预测该修正；再由一个轻量级模块在局部对修正进行细化。整体为一步式（非扩散/非多步迭代）流程。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，PSNR/SSIM 高于 VOSR、LPIPS/DISTS 更低；生成器仅 31.8M 参数，为 VOSR-0.5B 的 6.5%；与基于 T2I 的超分方法相当；训练与蒸馏所用 HR 像素仅为 VOSR 的 0.60%；512×512 输出下 GPU 流水线相对 VOSR-0.5B/1.4B 加速 2.80×/3.35×。
AI.conclusion: 超分质量不必依赖超大生成器：在冻结视觉基础模型引导下，极小生成器配合残差式修正确实可在质量、参数效率、数据效率与推理速度上同时优于现有大模型方法，说明 LR 结构先验的高效利用是关键。

title: DocSEAM: Bidirectional Cross-Page Encoding for Multi-Page Document Understanding
summary: Multi-page document vision-language models encode each page independently, creating a feature-level discontinuity at page boundaries: visual tokens are formed without access to content on adjacent pages, and the language model must reason over these page representations formed in isolation. We introduce DocSEAM (Document Selective Enrichment via Anchored Masking), a lightweight module inserted between a pretrained vision encoder and the language model that injects the inductive bias of local cross-page context into visual representations. For each page, DocSEAM forms a local triplet with its two neighbors, applies center-anchored masked self-attention with directional salience gates to fuse information from neighbor pages, and returns only the enriched center-page tokens, leaving the visual token count unchanged. After a supervised cross-page warm-up and multi-page fine-tuning with DocSEAM frozen, our 9B-parameter model achieves state-of-the-art results among the evaluated open-weight models of up to 10B parameters on five multi-page document VQA benchmarks. We further show that under controlled re-pagination, DocSEAM reduces sensitivity to boundary placement and improves cross-page span localization

AI.tldr: 提出DocSEAM——一个插在视觉编码器与语言模型之间的轻量模块，通过中心锚定的掩码自注意力融合相邻页信息，在不改变视觉token数量的前提下为多页文档VLM注入跨页局部上下文，在五个多页文档VQA基准上取得≤10B开源模型中的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有多页文档视觉语言模型逐页独立编码，在页边界处产生特征级不连续性：视觉token在未接触相邻页内容的情况下生成，语言模型只能基于这些孤立形成的页表示进行推理，导致跨页语义割裂、对分页方式敏感、跨页跨度定位困难。
AI.method: DocSEAM（Document Selective Enrichment via Anchored Masking）为轻量模块，置于预训练视觉编码器与语言模型之间。对每一页构造包含其两个邻居页的局部三元组，采用中心锚定的掩码自注意力（center-anchored masked self-attention）配合方向性显著性门控（directional salience gates）融合邻居页信息，仅返回被增强的中心页token，视觉token总数保持不变。训练流程为：先进行跨页监督预热（cross-page warm-up），再在多页微调阶段冻结DocSEAM。基于9B参数模型。
AI.result: 在五个多页文档VQA基准上，于参数量不超过10B的已评估开源权重模型中取得SOTA。在受控重分页实验下，DocSEAM降低了对页边界位置的敏感性，并提升了跨页跨度定位能力。
AI.conclusion: 以极低开销（不增加token数、参数高效、可插拔）将跨页局部上下文的归纳偏置注入视觉表示，是缓解逐页独立编码所造成边界不连续性的有效途径，同时改善了对分页扰动的鲁棒性与跨页证据定位。

title: Probing Visual Idiosyncrasies in Text-to-Image Models
summary: Text-to-Image (T2I) models turn short text descriptions into images, and the leading models now produce images of comparable visual quality. Whether their outputs still carry model-specific characteristics matters for attribution, for model comparison beyond aggregate quality, and for evaluations that assume anonymity. We ask whether images from frontier T2I models can still be classified by source, and which visual properties make this possible. Here we show that a standard ResNet-50 identifies the source of an image among HiDream-O1-Dev, FLUX.2-dev, HunyuanImage-3.0, and Qwen-Image-2512, the four highest-ranked open-source models on the Text-to-Image Arena, with 100.00% accuracy on held-out prompts. Human participants reach only 62.61% on the pairwise version of this task, so the distinguishing cues are not visually obvious. They are also not tied to a particular classifier and survive severe image corruptions and out-of-distribution prompts. We trace them to visual idiosyncrasies at three levels. Low-level texture statistics alone let a lightweight multi-layer perceptron match ResNet-50. Object layout, depth, and albedo estimated from the images each carry a source signal. Image captions reveal model-specific preferences in style and background that the prompts never specify. A one-sentence hint about these cues raises human accuracy by 9.03 percentage points. These idiosyncrasies make source classification a tool for measuring similarity between models and between real and generated images, and they caution against assuming anonymity in human preference evaluation of T2I models.

AI.tldr: 前沿文生图模型生成的图像仍保留可被分类器识别的模型"指纹"，来源识别准确率达100%，而人类仅62.61%；这些特异性体现在纹理统计、几何/光照属性与风格背景偏好三个层次。
AI.motivation: 当前领先T2I模型输出视觉质量已相当接近，作者关心其输出是否仍携带模型特有特征。这一问题对图像溯源归属、超越聚合质量指标的模型比较，以及假定匿名性的评估（如人类偏好投票）都具有意义。
AI.method: 在Text-to-Image Arena排名前四的开源模型（HiDream-O1-Dev、FLUX.2-dev、HunyuanImage-3.0、Qwen-Image-2512）间做来源分类：用标准ResNet-50在留出提示上测试；设置人类成对判断基线；进行严重图像损坏与分布外提示的鲁棒性测试；并从低层纹理统计（MLP）、物体布局/深度/反照率、图像描述揭示的风格与背景偏好三个层次追溯判别线索；最后用一句提示线索检验能否提升人类准确率。
AI.result: ResNet-50在留出提示上实现100.00%来源识别准确率；人类成对任务仅62.61%。判别线索不依赖特定分类器，并能在严重图像损坏与分布外提示下保持。仅用低层纹理统计的轻量MLP即可匹敌ResNet-50；布局、深度、反照率各自携带来源信号；图像描述显示模型特有的风格与背景偏好（提示中并未指定）。给出一句关于这些线索的提示后，人类准确率提升9.03个百分点。
AI.conclusion: T2I模型输出存在稳健、跨分类器、跨退化的模型特异性"指纹"，使来源分类可作为度量模型间相似性及真实与生成图像相似性的工具；同时提示在T2I模型的人类偏好评估中不应假定匿名性，因为评估者可能受模型风格特异性影响。

title: PreserveReward: Reliable Consistency Reward Modeling for Image Editing via Dual-Teacher On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Instruction-guided image editing has a wide range of applications, yet existing models may inadvertently alter content that should remain unchanged. Reliable consistency evaluation is therefore essential for assessing content preservation and providing reward signals for Reinforcement Learning (RL). However, existing reward models may overlook subtle visual changes or fail to distinguish necessary modifications from unintended alterations, limiting the reliability of consistency assessment. To address this challenge, we propose PreserveReward, a consistency reward model for image editing that integrates visual On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) to enhance fine-grained visual perception and consistency assessment. PreserveReward learns from reference preservation scores through a regression-based scoring loss and employs two complementary teacher views for self-distillation. The local teacher uses matched crops to identify subtle visual changes, while the joint teacher combines local details with global context to determine whether these changes align with the editing intent. To improve the reliability of distillation supervision, we calibrate teacher score distributions via minimum-KL projection under reference-score error constraints and adaptively select teacher process supervision based on gradient alignment with the scoring objective, mitigating scoring bias and optimization conflicts. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that PreserveReward achieves strong alignment with human preference on non-edited content preservation and generalizes well across diverse editing scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出 PreserveReward——面向指令式图像编辑的一致性奖励模型，通过视觉 On-Policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）结合局部与联合双教师视图、KL 校准与梯度对齐的自适应监督选择，提升细粒度视觉感知与一致性评估可靠性，在多个基准上与人类偏好高度对齐并具备良好泛化性。
AI.motivation: 指令引导图像编辑中，模型常会意外修改本应保持不变的内容，因此可靠的一致性评估对衡量内容保持能力、并为强化学习提供奖励信号至关重要。现有奖励模型存在两点不足：一是忽略细微视觉变化，二是无法区分必要修改与意外改动，导致一致性评估可靠性受限。
AI.method: 构建一致性奖励模型 PreserveReward，引入视觉 On-Policy Self-Distillation：以回归式打分损失从参考保持性分数中学习；采用两个互补教师视图自蒸馏——局部教师用匹配裁剪识别细微视觉变化，联合教师融合局部细节与全局上下文判断变化是否符合编辑意图；并通过在参考分数误差约束下的最小 KL 投影校准教师分数分布，同时依据与打分目标的梯度对齐程度自适应选择教师过程监督。
AI.result: 多基准实验表明，PreserveReward 在非编辑内容保持方面与人类偏好实现强对齐，并在多样化的编辑场景中表现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将自蒸馏式细粒度视觉感知引入一致性奖励建模，并以分布校准与梯度对齐缓解打分偏差与优化冲突，可有效提升图像编辑一致性评估的可靠性，为 RL 提供更可信的奖励信号。

title: SceneDesigner++: A Unified 9-DoF Pose Control Framework for T2I and T2V Generation
summary: Precise 9-DoF pose control is essential for visual content generation, enabling users to specify object location, size, and orientation in 3D space. However, existing methods typically focus on either text-to-image (T2I) or text-to-video (T2V) generation, with limitations in pose controllability and temporal coherence. We present SceneDesigner++, a unified framework for 9-DoF pose control across both T2I and T2V generation. We construct ObjectPose9D++, a dataset containing high-quality images and videos with accurate pose annotations. Trained on ObjectPose9D++, SceneDesigner++ combines absolute and relative pose encoding strategies to decouple frame-wise spatial grounding from inter-frame motion modeling. Specifically, absolute pose encoding leverages CNOCS map sequences to provide explicit, frame-wise 9-DoF pose guidance. Meanwhile, our relative pose encoding, termed VPRoPE, incorporates relative pose information into rotary position embeddings to explicitly model inter-frame pose transitions, thereby promoting temporally coherent object motion. A learnable orthogonal transformation is further introduced for each attention head, allowing different heads to capture complementary geometric relationships while preserving input feature norms to promote training stability. We further adopt a two-stage training strategy to learn the absolute and relative pose encoding mechanisms separately. Benefiting from this lightweight and decoupled design, SceneDesigner++ also supports integration with an independently trained camera-control module, enabling separate or joint control over object and camera motion. Finally, we introduce T2IVPoseEval, a benchmark for evaluating diverse object poses and motion patterns in both T2I and T2V tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SceneDesigner++ consistently outperforms same-backbone baselines in pose fidelity and motion quality.

AI.tldr: SceneDesigner++：面向T2I与T2V的统一9自由度位姿控制框架
AI.motivation: 现有方法多局限于T2I或T2V单一任务，位姿可控性与时序一致性不足；缺少高质量带精确位姿标注的图像/视频数据与统一评测基准。
AI.method: 构建ObjectPose9D++数据集；提出绝对位姿编码（CNOCS图序列提供逐帧显式9-DoF引导）与相对位姿编码VPRoPE（将相对位姿注入RoPE建模帧间位姿过渡）；为每个注意力头引入可学习正交变换以捕获互补几何关系并保持特征范数稳定训练；采用两阶段训练分别学习绝对/相对位姿编码；轻量解耦设计支持与独立相机控制模块集成，实现物体与相机运动的独立或联合控制。
AI.result: 在同骨干基线对比中，位姿保真度与运动质量均稳定领先；提出T2IVPoseEval基准，覆盖T2I与T2V下的多样物体位姿与运动模式评测。
AI.conclusion: 统一的绝对—相对位姿解耦编码可在T2I与T2V中实现精确9-DoF控制，并具备与相机控制模块组合的扩展性。

title: Enhancing Maritime Domain Awareness using Latent Space Representations
summary:
This work presents a novel application of Earth Observation (EO) embeddings for Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA) from the perspective of the geospatial foundation model TerraMind. By operating directly on compressed latent-space representations rather than on the original Sentinel-1 imagery, this approach directly addresses the data gravity bottleneck that increasingly constrains operational EO processing, in line with the objectives of the Embed2Scale project. In particular, linear and non-linear probing of compressed embeddings, latent space representations of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery, is used to detect, localise, and characterise vessels from Sentinel-1 GRD images. Vessel detection achieves a ROC-AUC of 0.95, while vessel localisation has a median error of around 300 m for vessels longer than 100 m, and vessel AIS type-code classification achieves 62% accuracy for the majority classes. The latter, however, is highly correlated with vessel length. These results reveal both the potential and current limitations of Geospatial Foundation Models (GeoFMs) when applied to fine-grained MDA understanding in real-world scenarios.
  Additionally, a new maritime remote sensing dataset is released, pairing about 2,000 Sentinel-1 images with temporally aligned AIS signals from commercial vessels. Through manual inspection, each candidate sample was verified for bounding-box quality and for consistency between the AIS-reported vessel length and the observed vessel extent, cross-checking vessel identity and location against publicly available vessel records and, where available, photographs. The dataset was made ready for use with the NeuCo-Bench neural compression benchmark framework, publicly available on HuggingFace through https://huggingface.co/datasets/embed2scale/S1-single-ship-downstream .

AI.tldr: 该工作基于TerraMind地理空间基础模型，在Sentinel-1图像的压缩潜空间嵌入上做线性/非线性探测，实现船舶检测、定位与AIS类型分类，并发布约2000幅Sentinel-1与时间对齐AIS配对的海事遥感数据集。
AI.motivation: 面向海上态势感知（MDA）的EO处理受"数据引力"瓶颈制约，需验证在压缩潜空间而非原始影像上运算的可行性。
AI.method: 以TerraMind的EO嵌入为对象，对Sentinel-1 GRD的潜空间表示进行线性/非线性探测，分别完成船舶检测、定位与AIS类型码分类；同时构建约2000对Sentinel-1与时间对齐商业船舶AIS信号的数据集，经人工核验边界框质量、AIS船长与目视船体尺寸一致性，并交叉比对公开船舶记录，数据集适配NeuCo-Bench基准框架并发布于HuggingFace。
AI.result: 船舶检测ROC-AUC达0.95；对长度超过100 m的船舶，定位中位误差约300 m；AIS类型码分类在多数类上准确率为62%，且该结果与船长高度相关。
AI.conclusion: 结果同时揭示了GeoFM在真实场景细粒度MDA理解中的潜力与当前局限，并提供了可用于神经压缩基准评测的公开数据集。

title: Evidence-Aligned Benchmarking and Learning for Medical Video Language Models
summary: A medical video language model should answer from the visual evidence its question asks about. We find three places where this breaks down and address each with an approach we call MedEvidU. First, benchmarks reward answers that ignore the video: on one dataset, the position of a clip within its recording predicts the surgical step in 37% of questions, and a constant answer beats every trained model on a standard safety-assessment metric. We build MedVidBench-v2, 34 tasks from 18 surgical and clinical video datasets, in which prompts and metrics are audited with answers given without video, and which tests unseen hospitals and windows cut blindly from whole recordings. Second, common video encoders merge consecutive frames into shared tokens, so a question about one frame is answered from a blend of two. Query-slot inputs give each queried frame its own tokens at almost no extra cost. Third, a fine-tuned model has memorized its training questions, which leaves little to learn from. Label-matched question resampling (LQR) adds unseen questions about the same recordings while keeping the answer distribution fixed, in a final supervised epoch and in reinforcement learning. Together, these raise the grounding IoU of a 4B model from 30.4 to 44.4, above a supervised 27B model, and instrument grounding at an unseen hospital from 33.9 to 72.5. On blindly cut windows, event-presence accuracy improves by 5.5 points and localization F1 by 8.1 points. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/MedEvidU/

AI.tldr: 论文指出医学视频语言模型在三个环节未真正依赖视觉证据，提出MedEvidU：构建审计过的MedVidBench-v2基准、Query-slot输入为每个被查询帧分配独立token、标签匹配问题重采样(LQR)抑制训练问题记忆；使4B模型grounding IoU由30.4升至44.4，超过27B监督模型。
AI.motivation: 医学视频语言模型应当基于其问题所指的视觉证据作答，但现状并非如此：(1)基准本身存在视觉捷径——某数据集上仅凭片段在整段录像中的位置即可预测手术步骤（37%的问题可被位置预测），且常量回答在标准安全评估指标上优于所有训练模型；(2)常见视频编码器将连续帧合并为共享token，针对单帧的提问实际由两帧混合信息作答；(3)微调模型已记住训练问题，导致可学习的信号不足。
AI.method: MedEvidU从三方面对症改进：①构建MedVidBench-v2，包含18个手术与临床视频数据集、34项任务，提示与指标均经过"无视频作答"审计，并设定未见过医院与从整段录像中盲切窗口的测试设置；②Query-slot输入，让每个被查询帧拥有独立token，几乎不增加计算开销，避免帧间token混合；③标签匹配问题重采样(LQR)，在同一批录像上引入未见问题而保持答案分布不变，应用于最后一个监督epoch及强化学习阶段。
AI.result: 4B模型的grounding IoU由30.4提升至44.4，超过监督训练的27B模型；在未见过医院上的器械grounding由33.9提升至72.5；在盲切窗口上，事件存在性准确率提升5.5个点，定位F1提升8.1个点。
